༄ bhebhe//blartobhrangabakrashisasto 4lāstogyi gdan/ rtor rgilirngachen/

rka 9 sgotro lhoṣṭakhulho sduXtu kṣeṇḍaṃ khyadze ṇḍaḍākto rto.eglo( po tshi khyuphyo lja lnga —dkukyo 0larkyopo tshu7ོ kṣiṃ tshushārnyi edichi 4ṣṭa 1ོtsa — yo popho rdzo ljaphya ndhugloo ༅ kṣiṃ7chi60 losko ḍā 8tshiṇa~X po myo ṭāsang lo nga phoo tsathi7༵ ca tsha nghru rkye sko khyukhyo ayoḍāphyo dku khri5ོ snyo 7khrukhro rdzi po po slobasmordzo hu1sna ṣi9 — 6 rkyo7ོ lholakho tsho sgro phrokhyulku ltoṇa lko0 mi jorirtsi1ོlcotu 6ngangu 9sgori khyeo~Xku nga/4ni zamu ṇḍaṃ/

tsho rī ci hūṃ ci cirosum̐chi haṃ ཿci chi ༷riwatsho ṭwāṃ ci kṇi ci ci / sdi shā cirdoṭwāṃtsho tso5rtso spya ri tshi9 sturi tsho chi mi rnyotsho ri ri ṭwāṃ rdo rdo 9 lke rme pa sdo ṣka chi skerlo snyu skuci rī ci ri ci ci ci rī ruhūṃdzātsachi wīlowaṃdropaṃtshotsha dzwalkesdutsho rdo5 sa spe ’ci

da wa da wa 1dpar skrun byas pa'i glerdo gzhi/ — grangs nyung mi rigs kyi ga/na' ṭwāṃbs dpe cha'i khongs su chos dang / tshad ma/ rnam thar/ lo rgyus/ brda sprod/ rig rtsal/ rtsom rig gtam rgyud/ sgyu rtsal/ rtsis dkar nag sa gshis/bzo rig gso rig mdzes mophywal/ thon skyed sogs 'dus yod la /sgos su bod mi rigs la mtshon na rig pa'i gnas bcu yod de/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos mngon par gsal zhing / mes rgyal gyi rig gnas dar zhing rgyas par btang ba'i lo rgyus kyi ya gyal 'gangs chen zhig dang / deng gi 'gyur bzhi skrun par yang phan chen po thogs bzhin yod pas/ grangs nyung mi rigs kyi gna' dpe gang myur skyob pa/ gung sgrig pa/ dpar du skrun pa ha cang gal che zhing / rnam dpyod kyi 'jug pa tshegs che ladus yun gyi bstung ba tshabs che ba zhig kyang yin no/ /spyi lo1985 bar nga tshos gung sgrig 'go brtsams pa nas bzung / zhing chen gyi 'brel yod 'go 'dren pa dang / bod kyi mkhas pa rnam pas bya rmeb 'dir gtsigs su bzung ba dang rgyab skyor ba'i drin gyis nga tshos bya ba 'di don du gnyer bar mthun rkyen 'dzoms song /zhing chen yongs kyi bod yig gi gna' dpe mdzod du bzhag yod pa'i

2 da na wa—da gezhi sa gnas khag la rgyab rten bcol nas/ deng rabs kyi sgrig tshul ltar gsung rab skor zhig rnam par phye zhing / dpyad pa btang nas/ kha skong zur brgyan/ rim bzhin dpar du bskrun rtsis yin/bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan rabs lha'i rnga chen zhes bya ba/ nga tshos bod kyi mkhas pa smon lam rgya mtsho mchog la re ba bcol nas khong gis 'di'i nang gi dogs gzhi dang tha snyad 'gangs chen kha shas shig sngon byon mkhas pa'i rnam thar dang yig cha khungs btsan pa skor la gtugs nas zhu dag gnang ba dang / zhing chen mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi rgyab skyor thob pa bcas la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu/ kan su'u zhing chen grangs nyung mi rigs gna' dbe legs sgrig galhang skub khang nas/spyi lo 1985 ba'i zla 12 par/

dge—da —da da wa da wad wa 1zhu dag pas zhu ba // bod kyi rig gnas dang lo rgyus kyang rgya che la gting zab pa yun ring ba'i byung ba can zhig tu nges pas/ mes rgyal gyi rig gnas bang mdzod nang gi rin chen 'od snang 'phro ba zhig tu gyur yod/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa nas bzung ste/ tang gi lam phyogs dang byed phyogs/ srid jus bcas kyi 'od stong rab tu 'phro ba'i 'og chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ tshan rig rig gnas sogs gong nas gong 'phel ngang /gcig rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyis can bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun ci myur mngon du 'gyur ba la brtson pa'i bsgang 'dir/ gna' bzang deng spyod dang / mi rigs dang chos lugs/ rig gnas dang lo rgyus sogs la zhib 'jug gi las su 'jug pa'ang phyi phyir zab rgyas su 'gro mus kyis/dpe 'di zur blta'i dpyad gzhir mkho 'don du dpar du bskrun na phan skyed 'byung ba'i dgos pa ldan par mthong nas )da bdams kyis dpar skrun byas pa red/thengs 'dir dpar du 'debs skabs/ gdan sa ba dang / skabs don mtshan byang rnams shing par du gzhung gi tshul du dkyus subazhugs pa

2 dag pha 'dir zhal bshus kyis skabs don dang le tshan 'tshol bde ba'i ched legs sgrig gi rnam par dkar chag bsgrigs yod/bla brang dgon pa ni grub mtha' dge lugs pa dang / chos dang rig gnas la mkhas pa grags canartsomang bo byon cing / mdo sngags kyi grwa tshang drug bzhugs pa'i yul mdo smad kyi chos sde che shos shig red/ mdo smad khul spyi dang / lhag rmer rma chu'i lho byang gi dgon sgrub sde phal mo cher chos rgyun spyag len gyis ma khyab sa med pa'i ma dgonartsolta bu zhig tsu song zhing /ci 1982 lo'i zla 2 pa la/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis krung rgo'i nang ba'i chos lugs kyi dgon sdo chen po drug gi ya gyal du brtsis te/ rig gnas gna' rdzas srung skyob bya sa'i lte ba'i gras su thag bcade/ phyogs gang cir srung skyob dang do dam sogs bka' drin chen pos skyong mus la brten/ rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu grags pa'ang che ba dang / dpe 'di sngar a mchog dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling du shing par bskrun kyang phyis mā jag gis me klong du bltams pas dpe rgyunayang shin tu dkon pore gyur/ gnyis/ bla brang dgon pa ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa glang ( 1709)lor gsar 'debs gnang / de skabs/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje rang nyid kyis thog mar chos khri byin rlabs kyi zhal bdag mdzad pa nas gdan rabs 'di brtsams zin gyi lo ste/ rab rgyu nga bcu gsum pa'i lcags sprel ( 1800 ) lo'i khri thog pa brtsis pa'i tshogs chen gdan rabs nyer ga nyis pa'i bar dpe 'dir bkod la/ de'i

dag sa / 3steng nyer gsum pa nas nga gsum pa the ba'i gdan rabs sum cu kha bskangs te bsdoms pa'i nga gsum gyi bar de/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing glang (1865) lor bragadagon pa dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas kyis brtsams pa/ 1982 lor kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpar du btab pa'i deb ther rgya mtsho'am〈〈mdo smad chos 'byung 〉〉las 4bla brang dgon pa'i gdan rabs rim byung dang / zhar byung 'phros tsam bcas/ ’ zhis pa'i shog grangs 398da 515 ba'i bar du gsal ba de lags dang / gong smras spyi lo 1865 ba de nas da lo ste/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing glang (1985)lor 'bo ra'i mu to sprul pa'i sku skal bzang 'jigs med rigs pa'i sosgos gdan khri skyong bzhin pa 'di — reg la lo 120yun la gdan rabs sum cu rtsa grangs shig phebs zin pa de/ thengs 'dir kha skong gi tshul du bsnan na da lta yan gyi gdan rabs rnam thar kha tshang tsam shes 'dod mkhan dag la dkyus gcig tu ngesatsho 'drong ster ba'i nus pa ldan par mthong nas 'brel yod 'gar zhu bskul bgyis mod de/ gnas skabs don ngo ma shar yang 'gyang min kha skong mdzad na legs tshogs che bar snyam pas 'ar la gzhen bskul du zhu'o/ /gsum/ shing par du yi ge dag cha'i thad la dogs gnas re 'ga' mchis pa'i mi bcos mi rung ba skor zhig bcos pa de las re zung ma yig gi mjug thogs der ( )gug rtags su bcos yig bkod yod/ yang / sog skad kyi ming gi char/ dper na/ er ti rna /erti ni/ er te ne lta bu dang / no min han/ no mon hane/ no

da wa—— — wa dgadnghad da min hang / er khe/ ekhe/ mer gan/ mergan/ hu thog thu/ho thog thu/ — ba thur/ bā thur/ pā thur/ the'i ji/ tha'i ci/ ce sang / je sang /eldi/ el chi/ ur ge/ uge/ e/ra ge/ ku shri/ ko shrī /gu sri/ kau sri/ cun gar/ cung gar/ jo'an gar lta bu sogs sa khul re zung gi skad gdangs cung zad ma 'dra bas de'i gdangs thon ched yi ge'ang khyad zhugs pa tsam las bstan bya tha dad du gtong ba'i shan mi — 'asnyica la par nges pas rang sor bzhag de'i don ni/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma/ sum pa masken chen/ brag dgon pa dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas sogs kyi skesung du dang / tshig mdzod 'gar yang gong du bkod ma thag pa'i yi ge 'dra min 'dug pa skad 'dum bde ba gcig gis thams cad gong bur sgril ga 'o/ 'o(theg/ tsho gzhan yang / legs sbyar skad kyi de ba dang / de wa/ e bam̐ dang / e waṃ zhes pa la yig gzugs 'dra min gnyis gnyis 'byung yang /de ni/ lan war gnyis karacib dang wa'i yig gzugs gcig las med cing gzugs gnyi ga'i gang yang rung / skabs 'dir bstan bya gcig nyid du gyur pa'i gnad kyis/ sgra sgyur ba sngon ma rnam pas gnyis ka bris pa'i rgyun 'byams par nges kyang / dpe mang bor wa dang waṃ 'byung ba shas tshe bar mthong bas de ltar bkod/ yang mnga' ris tho ling dang / mtho lding gnyis lkas ji ma

—dzom/—1—— 5phyis kyi dpe du mar 'dug pa rgyug che bar snyam de ltar bcos/ b.ri dang bā ri/ pa tshab dang ba tshab lta bu don tha dad pa'i nges tshig ma mthong zhing gsham zhu'i dpe 'ga' na gnyi ga bkod pa'i phyir 'brangs te de mur bzhagabacos pa'i rigs kyang / 〈〈bka' gdams glegs bam las pha chos〉〉〈〈bu ston chos 'byung〉〉〈〈rje'i rnam thar chen mo〉〉〈〈rje'i gsan yig〉〉〈〈kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rnam thar nee ta ka'i phreng ba〉〉〈〈kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung dge ldan chos 'byung rtsom 'phro〉〉〈〈mdo smad chos 'byung〉〉tshig mdzod sogs bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos tshad thub kha shas bcas la gtug ci thub kyis zhu bcos byas mod/ 'on kyang / phran rang skyes sbyangs kyi shes yon ha cang 'an gshis bcos nor dang bco lus gang mchis gzur gnas mkhas pa'i spyan sngar 'chags la/ sman pa'i bslab ston gyi bka' drin skyong bar zhu zhu/zhes smon lam rgya mtshos 1985lo'i zla 1tshes 1la gus pa dang bcas zhus so/ /

1 mdzad pa bo mtshams sbyor ma dor bsdus/ gdan rabs 'di mdzad pa bo dbal mang sku 'phreng gnyisabyub paṇḍi rta chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa yin la/ khong ni bsang gzhung (da lta'i shā ho rdzong khongs) tshar tsha'i rgyud du yab dbang drag skyabs dang / yum bde bza' lha mo rgyal gyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i thing sprel ( 1 764) lor sku bltams/ skyabs mchog 'jigs med dbang bos dalasbul mang blo bzang don grub kyi sprul skur ngos 'dzino gnang ste/ dgung lo drug pa la gdan sar bkod/ skyebs cha/gon mchog las rab tu byung ste mtshan dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhes gnang / rgyud smad dge bshesaci bsam gtan seṅga ba klog gi slob dpon du bsten nas yig rigs klog pyi— thabs dang / tshogs 'don gyi chos spyod du ma sogs kyi debyangs thung tha ra rta dang bcas pa phyag len ltar byang chud par mdzad/ gzha na yango /rgyan 'jug dang paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi sa gsum ma'i ṭīkka sogs thugs la byang bar gnang / dgung lo bcu gcig pa la lnga mchod du chos grwar zhugs pa— nas dbu phar bskyar sbyangs lo drug la gnang ba bcas lo bcu bdun gyi ring la bsdus grwa/ blo rtags/ dbu phar/ 'dul mdzod sogs skabs su gang babs kyi yig cha'i thal 'phreng zur bkol mang bo thugs 'dzin dang / grub mtha' chen mo sogs tshogs rgyugs kyang

2 da badzo mtsha rna doja ba da sde phul/ tshogs hūṃs 'grim pa'i skabs shig nas sku chas bkren pris brag ja dang / gtor skam gyi thug pa bskol/ bzhugs gdan tsam yang med par rgyun du sa rjen sa bzhugs/ gzims shag tu grang dus zla gam bzhes nas bzhugs pa las na bza' gzhan med pa sogs sku ngal chen po byung yang de'i rtsol sgrub mdzad pa lta zhog cung zad kyang zhum pa med par thos bsam kho nar gzhol/ grwa skor gnyis dang tshogs gleng du ma gnangu zhing mkhyen dpyod dang dka' spyad la 'gran zla bral ba'i snyan pa rgyas/dgung lo bcu dgu ba la skyabs mgon mchog las bsnyen rdzogs gyi sdom pa bzhes/ dus gseng gang byung la sgra dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor rtsis dkar nag sogs thun mong ba'i rig gnas la sbyangs te dka' tshegs med par bhe thugs la nges pa byung / dpe mtshams sgyudang bsnyen pa las rung 'ga' zhig kyang gnang / dgung lo sum cu ba chu glang dpyid (1 793) rdo rams pa'i dam bca' 'jog bzhed kyis rgya bod kyi gzhung chen mang bor zhib gzigs mdzad/ zhal nas kyang bag chags kyi rten du bsams yig cha thams cad la re re bltas nas smon lam rgya chetma po re btab yod gsungs/ lo de'i hor dme dang bor rgyud khrir phebs dgos byung ba nas lo bzhi'i ring la 'grel ba bzhi sbrags dang / bskyed rdzogs/ ṭīkka che chung gi brtsi bzhag blos bslang brtsig pa'i srol baktod pa/ dbang lung du ma gnang ba dang / rten bzhengs/ phyag len mang bor dag ther mdzad pa sogs kyis gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che mi nyams gong 'phel du spyong bar mdzad/

—— — da pa rdzo mardoḍa—sa rdo ra rda sdo—༷—༷ — — — da —da 3me sbrul ( 1 797) lor gong ma kyā ching chen por zhus lan bka' phebs bzhin/ skyabs mgon mchog sprul rin po che thugs thag gcodatreched dbus su phebs te sku don lhun gyis grub pa byung / dga' ldan khri chen tre bo blo bzang bkra shis/ paṇa chen ba stan pa'i nyi ma'i yongs 'dzin 'brong rtse blo bzang tshul khrims dang / gu ge blo bzang bstan 'dzin sogs las 'di phyogs su rgyun dkon pa'i dbang lung khrid sogs chos bka' mang du gsan/ phar yang / yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mar gsung 'bum kha shas kyi lung dang /'khrul 'khor lcags mkhar/ zhi khro sprags sgrub sogs kyi khrid sogs de phyogs nyag phra ba'i chos rgyun ci rigs spel/ sgra ka la pa dang / dbyangs can ma rtsa 'grel/ snyan ngag sdeb sbyor sogs kyi sgo nas 'dun ldan mang bo'ire ba bskangs/ 'di skabs/ yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis kyis gtsang du dang / rgyal tshab rta tshag rin po che/ de mo no mon han sogs kyis dbus su bzhugs na chos kyi che ba'i go sa dang bstan 'gror phan sleb che bar gsungs kyang sku zhabs blos btang nas go sa tsam don du gnyer nas ci byed snyam pa yin gsungs/ 'di lta bu'ang rang don rgyab basmyur gyi sar gnas sems dpa' chen po'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /sa rta lo'i zla ba dgu bar bkra shis 'khyil du slar phebs so na byung / dgung lo so drug pa lcags sprel(1800)lor gdan rabs 'di brtsams rgyub/ dgung lo zhe gcig pa shing byi nas lo ngo drug gi ring tshogs chen khrir bzhugs te/ rmad byung thos bsam gling grwa tshang la gzhung bka' pota lnga'i 'chad nyan dang / grwa

4 —5tshisha ldang— ge——— —tshang gzhan gsum gar 'don rta dbyangs/ thig rdul tshon dang bca' bzo/ bskyed rdzogs dang sman gyi rgyud bzhi/ 7 rig gnas sogs cho ga phyag len gang tshugs pa mtha' dag zur phra mo re yan chad la dag ther dang do dam gang drag gnang bas mdo sngags zung gi 'chad nyan shin tu 'phel ba byung / gdan sa rang dang dgon sde mang bor sgrub mchod du ma gsar 'dzugs dang / 'ga' zhig tu gzims khang rten dang brten pa gsar bzhengs dang nyams gso gnang ba sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad tshul sogs zhib par 'god mi lang ngo / /spyir logatsho 'tsho dang chos brgyad ma 'dres shing dad gshin gyi rdzas chud mi za ba'i legs mdzad 'gangs che zhing bka' gdams rnam thar gtsang ma lhur bzhes pa zhig go /bstan 'phel sne nga gi khrir lo nyer lnga bzhugs pa'i mtshon skabs la lar khri khur gnyis dang gsum re mnyam bzhes dang bskyar bzhugs/ gdan sa rang gi gtsos mdo smad lho byang gi dgon ri khrod shin / tu mang bor dbang lung man ngag gi chos char phab/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'a chang chen pos bka' chos gang gnang chag med du gsan cing 'ga' re zin— bris su btab/ thu'u bkwan rin po che chos kyi nyi ma/ rje gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ cha gar bka' 'gyur ba chen po sogs la bka' 'gyur gyi lung soshas zab chos mang du zhus te/ dbang lung man ngag gi gter mdzod du gyur/ spyir mdo dbus gtsang gsum du dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag gsum lhag tsam bsten nasachoru/ bka' rgya cher gsan pa'i thob yig pota long ba bzhugs/ zhal nas kyang rang cag thos bsam pa bya

mtshod bathatshordo1༷——rwadzaḍa—— 5ba yin pas/ thos bsam sgom pa gang yin yang tshe dang 'grogs pha dgos gsungs nas dpe gzigs gtsor 'don gyis 'chad nyan dang zhal 'don/gsung rtsom sogs kyis dus 'da' bar mdzahwa pas bka' rtsom pota bcu tham pa'i par a mchog dgon du bzhugs pa sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i smra ba'i khyu mchog chen po'i go 'phang brnyes pas ma hā paṇḍi ta dbal mang rin po che zhes kun gyis dad gus bsngags gsum gyi yul du gyur pa don la gnas so/ /sngar lo nas bzung na bza' nyer spyad 'gang chen gang yod spong thag gi tshul du 'gyed btang ste/ dgung lo dgu bcu ba chu glang (1853)lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus/slob ma'ang mdo smad du mtshon na/ dbang lung man ngag gi gter mdzod chen po rje shes rab rgya mtsho dang / sde khri 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma/ su nyid dkon mchog nor bu sogs bstan pa'i srog shing du gyur pa'i thugs sras du mas sog phyi nang dang bcas ma khyab sa med pa lta bu byung snang ngo / /'dir thun mong gi rnam thar mdor bsdus tsam bkod pa las/spyir 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi bcas pa'i cha phra mo las kyang mi 'da' bar tshul khrims kyi phung bo yongs su rdzogs shing mthong thos dran reg gis 'brel tshad don ldan du gnang ba sogs phyag rjes bsam gyis mi khyab pa gre bar bskyil du phangs pa du ma zhig dgod byar snang yang yig tshogs la 'jigs pas mtshobris/ zhib par rtags 'dod rnams /〈〈rnam thar thar 'dod 'jug ngogs 〉〉su gzigs pas 'thus par
snyam pas 'dir de tsam mo/ / zhes smon lam rgya mtshos 1985 lo' zla 3tshes la bris pa'o//

1dkar chag gleng gzhi/ ( 1 )dgon pa phyag 'debs mdzad pa bolirnam thar/ ( 5 )dgon sde ji ltar btab tshul/ (112)bshad sgrub kyi srol ji ltar tshugs tshul/ (156)rgyud smad grwa tshang ji ltar tshugs tshul/ ( 189)bde mchog gi rgyud kyi byung ba/ (194)rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi byung ba/ (196)rgyud dbyangs sogs bshad pa/ rdzi(200)rgyud grwa dngos kyi lo rgyus/ (202)dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi byung ba / (205)rigs ldan gyi rgyal po rnams khrir nam byo na gyi dus/— (214)kun rig gi byung ba/ 7 (217)rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud/ ma (228)gso rig gzhan phan gling gi phyag bzhes kyi gtso’bor mdzad pa sman gyi lo rgyus/ (236)grwa tshang gi 'don 'grig sogs kyi skor/ (265)gnas brtan mchod chog gi byung ba/ (268wa

2 — dkarna ga cho 'phrul smon lam gyi byung ba/ (270)gling bsre'i byung ba/ tsho bye lha (272)lnga mchod chen mo/ ༷ (274)rigs grwa'i tshogs gleng sogs/ ༷ ci ( 276 )gdan rabs dngos/ (27spre )gdan rabs dang bo kun mkhyen bzhad pa'i rdo rje rje ngag dbang brtson 'grus pa chen po/ ( 280) gdan rabs gnyis pa thugs sras ngag dbadzwa bkra shis/ (2 83)gdan rabs gsum pa sde khri blo bzang don grub/ (309)gdan rabs bzhi ba rje ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ (346) gdan rabs lnga ba rje ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ — (350)gdan rabs drug pa rje blo bzang don grub/ (375 )gdan rabs bdun pa rje blo bzang gnas brtan/ (380)gdan rabs brgyad pa rje ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bskyar bzhugs/ ༷ (384)gdan rabs dgu ba rje blo bzang don grub ba skyar bzhugs/ 5 zu (384)gdan rabs bcu ba rje don grub rgya mtsho/ — ( 38 5)kaidan rabs bcu gcig pha kun mkhyen sku 'apreng gnyis pa the

dka ga 3'jigs med dbang bo'i sde/ (388)gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa rje ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs bkra shis/ (389)gdan rabs bcu gsum pa rje blo bzang snyan grags/ (390)gdan rabs bcu bzhi ba rje ngag dbang 'phrin las/ (399)gdan rabs bco lnga ba rje bsod nams dbang rgyal/ (409)gdan rabs bcu drug pa rje 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtsho (417)gdan rabs bcu bdun pa rje bsod nams grags pa/ (422)gdan rabs bco brgyad pa rje rab brtan rgya mtsho/ (433)gdan rabayobacu dgu ba rje dkon mchog bde chen/ (441)gdan rabs nyi shu ba rje 'jigs med rigs pa'i seṅge/ ( 445)gdan rabs nyer gcig pa rje darkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me (po/60) gdan rabayonyer gnyis pa rji blo bzang chos dar/ (483)rgyud smad grwa tshang gi gdan rabs/ (487)gdan rabs dang bo rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje rang nyid/ sa (487)gdan rabs gnyes pa rje hor blo gsal rgya mtsho/ (487) gdan rabayogasum pa rje blo bzang mkhas mchog myo (489)gdan rabs bzhi ba rje ngag dbang dbal ldan/ (491)

dka ga gdan rabs lnga ba rje dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ (493)gdan rabs drug pa sde khri blo bzang rdon gruspu/ rte (494)gdan rabs bdun pa rje 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan/ myu(494)gdan rabs brgyad pa rje ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ (496)gdan rabs dgu ba rje blo bzang gnayobartan/ (496)gdan rabs bcu ba rje ra ba brtan rgya mtsho/ (497)gdan rabs bcu gcig pa rje bkra shis rgya mtsho/ (499)gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa rje dbon mchog bde chen/ (502)gdan rabs ba/cu gsum pa rje shes rab rdo rje/ (502)gdan rabs bcu bzhi ba rje bsod nams grags pa/ (504)gdan rabs bco lngari rje blo bzang sbyin pa/ (505)gdan rabs bcu drug ba rje blo bzang mchog grub/ (507)gdan rabs bcu bdun pa rje don grub rgya ma/tsho/ (512)gdan rabs bco brgyad pa rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ (512)gdan rabs bcu dgu ba rje 'jigs med mkhas mchog (513)gdan rabs nyi shu ba rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ (514)gdan rabs nyer gcig pa rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ (519)e waṃ chos 'khor gling gi gdan rabs/ (522)gdan rabs dang po kun mkhyen sku 'phreng gnyis pha rje dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bo/ (522)

kar ge 6gdan rabs gnyis pa rje blo bzang bkra this/ (523)gdan rabs gsum pa rje rab brtan rgya mtsho/ (524)gdan rabs bzhi ba rje blo bzang rin chen/ (524)gdan rabs lnga ba rje blo bzang bkra shis/ (528)gdan rabs drug pa rje don yod tshul khrims/ (529)gdan rabs bdun pa rje ngag dbang phun tshogs/ (530)gdan rabs brgyad pa rje ngag dbang don grub/ (531)gdan rabs dgu ba rje 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ (535)gdan rabs bcu ba rje dkon mchog dar rgyas/ (535)gso rig gzhan phan gling gi gdan rabs/ (541)gdan rabs dang bo kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo/ ༷ (541)gdan rabs gnyis pa rje blo bzang 'jigs med/ (541)gdan rabs gsum pa rje blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ (543)rten sogs don gzhan bshad pa/ rtso (545)

gleng gzhi/ ༄ / /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas chos sde ṅkachen po dga' ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan rabs rang bzhin dbyangs su brjod pa'i lha'i rnga bo che zhes bya ba/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i zhabs kyi padmor gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su bzung du gsol/ /rgyal sras dus nas bde gshegs grangs med kyis/ /pad dkar ltar bsngags mi mjed zhing gi mgon/ /lha mi'i ston pa shākya seng ge zhes/ /drang srong yongs kyi khyu mchog de la 'dud/ /dpal ldan thub pa de yi sras kyi mchog /rab 2byams rgyal ba'i 'phrin las sgrub pa bo/ /mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes sa gsusta na/ /snyan pa'i ba dan g.yo ba de la 'dud/ /shin tu dpag dka' pha rol phyin pa'i don/ /ji bzhin 'grel mdzad sa gsum 'gro ba'i mig /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur thing rta che/ /klu sgrub thogs med zhabs la spyi bos 'dud/ / rab 'byams mdo rgyud mtha' dag gdan gcig tu/ /gruci bzhir 'khyer ba bka' gdams bstan pa'i srol/ /gang gi drin las ljongs 'dir khyab gyur pa/ /mar me mdzad dpal

hūṃ ga brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ /tshig spyi'i bshad sgrub me khyer snang ba la/ /snying bor bgyid rlom rmongs pa'i mun ljongs su/ /'khrul bral bstan pa'i nyi 'od gsal mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa sras dang bcas la 'dud/ /'jam dbyangs bla mari ring lugs padmo'i tshal/ /bzhad pa'i 'phrin las bshad sgrub nyi ma'i 'od/ /spro mdzad rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan de la 'dud/ /cher rlom phal gyis bskal brgyar cha tsam yang / /bsgrun min rmaṅge byung mdzad pas thub pa'i bstan/ /rjerges ldan dpyid du bsgyur mkhas thams rtad mkhyen/ /skyabs mchog 'jigs mede dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /thub bstan dpyid du ches dkar mi mnyam dge legs ga bur thigs pa'e ri mo ni/ /bshad sgrub las su bzhad pa'i kun da'i phreng ba sa gsum kun tu khyab par bris/ /de bzhin rang rigs rgyu skar bye ba'i tshogs bcas thub bstan nam mkha'i rgyan du gyur/ /smra mkhas yongs kyi gtsug rgyan smra ba'i zla ba mchog des byang chub bar du skyongs/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i 'phrin laso chu klung 'bum/ /skal bzang legs byas khor yug ri bo'i khong / /mngon par 'khyil ba bkra shis 'khyil gling zhes/ /grag sa dkar g.yo ba'i sde chen 'di rmad byung / ri /gang der bshad sgrub chos kyi gru bo che/ / thugs bskyed dar chen 'phyar me'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /tshul bzhin

gzhi 3skyong ba'i ded dpon zla med pa/ /gdan rabs rim byon bka' drin snying nas dran/ dngha/srid zhilidage mtshan mtha' dag gzugs can gyi/ /dngos por grub pa bkra this 'khyil gling gi/gnas tshul lhug par brjod pas skal bzang tshogs/ /yid 'phrog tshig gi bdud rtsi 'gyed la spro/ /gang phyir dam pa'i ngo mtshar rang bzhin phyogs kyi 'khor lo gsal byed cing / /skal bzang dad pa'i chu gter 'phel bas legs byas rlabs phreng phyogs brgyar g.yo/ /bkra shis dge mtshan 'od dkar phreng bas nor 'dzin dpal mo mdzes pa'i gtam/ /gsar ba'i 'od chags zla ba gang des thub bstan lha lam mdzes phyir ro/ /gang gis gang du ji ltar btab tshul dang / /der ni bshad sgrub bstan pa gnas pa'i tshul/ /rim byon bstan 'dzin dam pa'i rnam thar te/ /'di dag ngo mtshar gtam gyi gleng gzhi yin/ /yid 'phrog gtam gyi sbrang rtsi gsar ba'i ros sems kyi rkang drug myos pa'i rnam 'gyur can/ /kun dga' rgyas pa'i rmad byung dus ston la/ /rol 'dod de dag gzur gnas sems kyis nyon/ /de yang lus can yongs kyi phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas gcig bu ni bcom ldan 'das bde bar gshegs pa thugs rjedzee bdag nyid can de'i bstan pa rin po che nyid yin la/ de nyid ring du gnas

4 gagi/pa yang dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las pas na/ sngon gyi bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams kyis phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad du dge 'dun gyi sde spelagibar mdzad pa'i sgo nas/ nor 'dzin gyi gzhi 'di nyid spyang 'gro ba yongs kyi mchod 'os su bsgrub par mdzad pa las/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i chos sde chen po mdo sngags bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dge ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis kun nas 'khyil ba'i glingo zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid rten dang brten par bcas pa las brtsams te ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyi dga' ston cung zad spel ba la/

5dgonaḥpa phyag 'debs mdzad‘pa bam̐'i rnam thar/ ri7ོ//de yang chos sde chen po 'di nyid 'debs par mdzad pa bo ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba rang nyid dang sgo kun nas mtshungs pa'i khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha ba chen po'i ring lugs 'dzin skyong spel bar byed pa'i mkhas grub klu dbang bye ba'i gtsug na mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar gyi gdengs ka mngon par brjid cing 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'phrin las nyi zla'i 'od kyis nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon kun mngon par khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes snyan pa'i ba dan sa gsum na mngon par g.yo ba de nyid yin no/ /de la bdag nyid chen po 'di ni sprul sku grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi ma 'ongs lung bstan las gsang bdag gi sprul par gsungs shing / ma cig lab kyi sgron ma'i lung bstan dang bka' gdams sprul pa'i glegs bam sogs las spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par gsungs la/ lung bstan gzhan du ma ltar na rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul par yang grub pas na gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan mtha' dag par brjod par ga la nus/ 'on kyang rje rang gi gsung las/ skyes pa'i yul dang gzhon dus bag chags dang / /chormos sgor zhugs dang bshes gnyen bsten tshul —dang / /sgom la ༈nga —

8 dargo ge zhi sa da ma rus gzhan la phan sems dang / /thub bstan rgyas 'dod bdag gi rnam thar yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ /rnam thar rgyas pa gzhan du gsal bas 'dir thun mong ba'i go rim ni mtshams sbyor gyi gzhir bzung / gsang ba'i rnam thar gyis zur brgyan te cung zad mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis brjod na/thog mar gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ rje nyid kyis/ skye yul bsang gi rdo ger lhas khra ru/ zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ gna' dus ge sar rgyal pos bsang btang ba'i dbang gis bsang gzhung du ming chags par grags thing bka' gdams glegs bam sogs las spang ser po gser gyi maṇḍal zhes gsal bar bstan pa'i bsang gzhung la lung chen dngatrīlung phran gyi yan lag ches mang ba'i nang tshan rgan gya smad kyi cha rdo ger dang nye ba rting ring lhas khra ding zer bar sku bltams pa yin la/ rus ni ldong shul chen bco brgyad kyi nang tshan dbal shul gyi dpon brgyud yin tshul rnam thar skal bzang 'jug ngogs sogs su gsal lo/ /de yang a rig dang dbal shul gnyis rma stod phyogs su lhan du sdod cing phan tshun nye sdeb sogs byed srol yod pa las skabs shig nang mi gshin pa byung ba'i dbang gis rje 'dilinye tshan rnams kyis phyogs 'dir yul gzhis bzung ba yin te/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ khri dmag bzlog nus mes sogs rigs yin kyang / /sdeg can dpa' ba nyid las choso rigs min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rje 'di'i yab mes rnams dpa' 'dzangs( mdzangs )brtul phod pa dang chos la dga' ba sha stag yin par grags che zhing / khyad par mes po bla ma skyabs dad pa che zhing gsang bdag gi bsnyen pa 'asdongs pa rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur

dgon pha ga debs mtshod ba ma rnam 7rin po che dngul gyis bzhengs pa sogs bsod nams mi dman pa zhig yin snang / bla ma skyabs la bu gsum byung ba'i chung ba dpal 'byum rgyal ni rje 'di'i yab yin zhing / de la bu bzhi byung ba'i che ba rje 'di dang / de 'og gcig la dbal shul no yon sde ba rab 'byams pa blo gros zer/gcig khyim dor te paṇa chen thamasajicad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes kyi drung nas rab byung byas shing yongs grags dge rgan gu ru zer/ gcig khyim thab byas pa'i ming la dbal shul klu ba zer/ de la bu gcig byung ste dbal shul dge 'dun skyabs zhes phyogs 'dir 'byor ldan gyi tshad du gleng ba zhig yin no/ /de lta bu'i rigs rus phun sum tshogs par rje 'di nyid rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa pho byi ba'i lor hor zla dang po'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin dbyar gyi lang tsho gsar du ngoms pa bzhin du 'brug sgra dal bur bzhad cing char rgyun snyoms par 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku bltams/ 'khrungs ma thag nas bsnyal na yang mi nyal bar tsog bur spyan phye/ 'dzum pa dang bcas bzhugs pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i spyod pa ngang gis brtas/ de dus gzigs snang la shin tu mdzes/ pa'i 'od sgor sngo dkar ser sogs kyi snang ba rgyun du 'char ba zhig byung ba ni sku tshe snga mar dus 'khor sbyor drug la sbyangs pa'i lag rjes su zhal gyis brazhes pa yin snang ste/ gsang ba'i rnam thar dad pa'i snye ma las/ zhi dul mdzes ma'i mngal rgya grol ma thag /'ja' tshon zlum po'i 'od sgor yang yang gzigs/ /de ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug la/ /sku tshe du mar 'dris pa'i lag rjes gsungs/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang de dus gtsug

8 dargon ga mdebs mad ba tha rna rna/tor gyis mdze0pa'i bde gshegs nam mkha' gang ba phyogs bcur nas sam 'bras spungs pa lta thu'am sprin 'khrigs pa bzhin du yod pa'i gzigs snang byung tshul ni rje rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsang rnam las/ — kun 'dus phyogs bcur nas sam 'bras spungs ltar/ /uṣṭi dzi ldan dpag med sprin bzhin 'khrigs/ /gang gang bltas bltas mang po de de rang / /zhes so/ /'di sems dben gyi rtogs pa brnyes pa'i rtags su rje rang nyid kyi gsung zur du ma las yang yang thos zhes thugs sras ngag dbang bkra shis pas gsungs so/ /sku na phra ba'i dus sku rtsed mdzad pa na'ang / dgon gnas dang ri khrod 'debs pa dang / lha khang bzhengs pa dang / mchod pa 'bul ba dang / phyag mnyam bzhag byas te sgom tshul byed pa dang / grogs kyi byis pa rnams la chos 'chad pa/ phyag dbang 'jog pa/ bum chu ster ba'i rnatshwa pa mdzad pa sogs sngon byung dang phyis 'byung gi rten 'brel gyi snang ba bsgro phrag mngon gyur du byung zhing / lhag par dgon gnas khang ba spen thog yod pa/ zur na lha tho spen kha can yod pa zhig yang yang shar ba/ phyis srad rgyud du phebs skabs de kho na bzhin du 'dug gsungs/'di ni 'khrungs rabs ltar sngon dpal ldan srad rgyud du bstan pa'i bdag po du ma'i sku'i skye ba bzhes pa'i 'bras rtags rmu gdon mi za'o/ /dgung lo bdun pa'i du sa yab kyi phu bo dge slong bsod nams lhun grubaribya ba dam tshig gtsang zhing 'byung 'dul gyi bsnyen pa 'khyongs pa/ skye brtag la yang lcarnga lo can du skyes pa'i mtshan ma shar ba zhig yod pa des yi ge bslabs pas 'bri klog dang bris sku 'bri ba sogs kyang tshegs med par thugs su

dargo bapyag༈rjorda—rjo —sbo —8—rda masdi— / 9chud/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa'i tshe 'dul 'dzin chen po khyu mchog ye shes rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar rab tu byung bar mtshan blo bzang rgyal mtshan zhes btags shing dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang de las mnos/ mkhan po de nyid kyi drung nas 'jigs byed kyi rjes gnang gsan nas sgrub thabs chag med dang /sku tshams (mtshams )mdzad de ya ma rā dza bye chen gcig song skabs/rwa lo4tsā ba yin zer ba'i dge slong zhig gis phyag mtshan bi rnyi pā la gtad de 'di bdud kun srung ba'i sring mo bcu gsum yin pas phyin chad khyod kyis zungasajibazlas pa des chog gsungs/ da dung mang du bzlas pas slar yang sngar ltar byung nas bzlas pa rtsa sngags des chog lha 'di'i sgo nas las rab 'byams thams cad gyis zhes pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can thob/ tshul 'di gsang rnam las/ 'bigs byed skyongs gtang (skyong gtad )'di ni mā ra ṇa/ /kun srung sring mo bcu gsum yin da zungs/ /lca la des chog slar na dza pag to/ /zhes so/ /de yang sring mo bcu gsum ni yum bcu gsum gyi brda yin pas dkyil 'khor gyi bdag por mnga' gsol ba'i mtshan ma khyad par can du shes so/ /gzhan yang bsnyung gnas srung ba dang / brgya rtsa chag med dang / ngag bcad kyi sgo nas lha zhi khro mang po'i bsnyen sgrub dang 'pho ba'i man ngag la thugs sbyong mdzad pas rtags thon zhing / khyad par du gsang bdag 'byung 'dul gyi bsnyen pa mdzad skabs gnas lcang lo can du 'byung 'dul nam mkha'i khams gang ba lta bu gzigs pa dang /rje'i gsang ba'i rnam thar zhal 'don du mdzad pa'i tshe rje rin po che la zhal gzigs pa'i lha dang chos skyong paṇa grub thams cad kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan

10 dargon gamageb ma da basbod —dngha ———rgyan cha lugs mtha' dag ri mor bris pa bzhin du gsal bar shar ba'i nyams byung tshul ni/ gsang rnam rtsa ba las/ — gsang rnam 'don dus de de bris bzhin du/ /chung dus 'byung 'dul sogs kyi bsnyen dus yin/zhes so/ /dgung lo bcu drug gi dus dge sbyor gyi ched du sku chings bkrol nas mi gzims pa'i dam bca' mthod/ dgung lo nyi shu'i bar du dge sbyor gyi zhar la sngags kyi bklag thabs dang / sman dpyad rtsis sogs bslab cing gzhan gyi rim gro byed pa dang / /za yig sbyin pa dang sman dpyad byed pa bsrung (srung)'khor 'dogs pa/ rtsis dang sa dpyad byed pa/sngags dang mkhyud spyad sogs kyi (kyis)skye bo mang po nye zho'i rgud pa las grol bar mdzad pas nus pa che bar yongs su grags/ ska bas shig dge ba'i bshes gnyen su cug thu zer ba khuchos kyi gleng mo mang du mdzad pa dang /gnas bcu'i zhal thang du ri khrod kyi ri mo gzigs pa'i rkyen gyis 'khor ba mtha' dag srin mo'i gling ltar gzigs pa'i skyo shas rgyun mi 'chad du byung ste da ni chos rnam par dag pa zhig byed dgos par 'dug pa la ngag bcad bzlas brjod phyag skor dpe klog sogs sngar ltar byas pas chos pa'i gral du bsdad rung tsam yin kyang bslab rgyu 'i chos dang slob mkhan gyi bshes gnyen med pa shin tu yi mug par 'dug pas/ gzhung lugs nam mkha' lta bu la thos pa rgya mtsho ltar spyod pa'i mkhas mang gi dbus su slebs te nyin mtshan chos la spyod pa zhig nam 'ong na snyam pas lha dang chos srung rnams la gsol 'debs 'phrin bcol yang yang mdzad/ rang nyid kyisatshig nan dang sngar gyi mkhan pos bka' nan mdzad pas yab mes rnams kyis dbus su 'gro

dargond rwa—ḍigi—rda—dzadabadzo rnam nga/ 11bar gnang ste dgung lo nyer gcig pa la dbus gtsang du chibs bsgyur mdzad/ de'i tshe phyi nyin gang du 'byon pa'i ri thang sogs snga nyin nas 'char ba dang / gzhi bdag rnams kyis ba su skyel sogs bsnyen bkur tshul bzhin du sgrub pa zhig byung / ldang lar bzhugs pa'i mtshan mo ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa zhal gzigs shing nam mkhar mi snying gcig la bung ba mang po 'phro 'du byed pa 'dra ba la zhib tu gzigs pas phyogs bcu nas sangs rgyas dpag med byon te snying de la thim zhing / de yang rang gi thugs kar thim pa dang mnyam du shangs bug nas rlung dri zhim pa zhig byung ba sogs kyis sngar skye ma myong ba'i dga' bde tshad med pa 'khrungs shing /snga sor thugs mi bde ba'i nyams zhig (shig ) yod pa yang lhag med du sangs/ de dag ni gsang rnam rtsa ba las/ dga' dang dad rnams rmi lam nyams dang 'dres/ /lam du 'gro dus gang babs de dag dang / /ldang lar tsitta iṣā de wa 'char/ /zhes dang / gsang rnam dad pa'i snye ma las/de yi mod la gzi brjid drag 'barapyiba'i/ /dpal ldan ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i gar bzhin mngon sum gzigs/ /zhes so//lha sar mchod mjal skabs jo bo shikya mu ni dang 'jam dbyangs gyang thim ma gnyis kyis snyan dar phyag gis bzhes shing zhal 'dzum mdzad pa'i gzigs snang byung tshul ni/ gsang rnam dad pa'i snye ma las/ chos 'khor lha sar shākya mu ne dang / /'angom dbyangs sku yis snyan dar phyag bzhes te/ /'dzum bzhad gsung byon dgyes pa'i nyams mang mdzad/ /ces so/ /'bras spungs su mchod mjal skabs/ lam rim lha khang du rgyal

12 dargozi——tshokai2 dza ma pa — dbang gi lder sku 'i/ga bzhugs pa sku dngos su gyur te phyag dbu la bzhag nas khyod la nad med/ yon tan 'ong sogs gsung mang po byon/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtshos bzhengs pa'i rje tsong kha ba'i sku brnyan kyang rje dngos su gyur te dbu la phyag bzhag nas khyod lnga bcu 'og tu bzhag pa na 'dir 'byung gsungs pas thugs dgongs la lnga bcu brgya'i dkyil yin pa bzhin yon tan 'bring gcig yongs (yong ) rgyu yin nam dgongs kyang / phyis su dgung lo nga gsum pa'i tshe bkra shis sgo mang gi khrir phebs dgos kyi lung bstan yin 'dug gsungs/ de dag ni rnam thar bka' rtsom las/ 'du khang steng dang lam rim lha khang gi /ltas bzang sngags khang 'jigs byed lha khang gi /ltas rnams phal cher legs rmis don mthun byung / /zhes so//'di'i 'jigs byed lha khang gi lo rgyus bdag gis ma 'tshal bas don gnyer can gyis 'tshol bar gyis thig 'jam dbyangs gyang thim ma nam mjal skabs gzigs snang khyad par can re 'byung ba dang / gzigs snang gzhan yang mang du byung ba yin snang ste zhal nas de dus ma dred pas mchod mjal sogs kyi skabs lha sku gang mthong lha dngos kyi rnam par 'char ba zhig yod gsungs/ kun gzigasakelnga ba chen por mjal skyabs 'jug zhu ba sogs mdzad nas 'bras spungs su byon/ dgon pa mthong ba dang dung 'bud pa dus mnyam byung bas rten 'brel 'grig ('grigs)/ de nas dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi dpon slob yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po klu 'bum blo gros rgya mtsho'i drung du gsar 'jug gi snyan gsan phul te dgu ba'i nyer lnga'i nyin chos grwar zhugs/ chos thun gnyis kyi brtsi

rgonapa rgatram̐dzi rwatshokatshoshaṃ—rda 13bzhag thugs 'dzin mdzad pa nas rtsod grwa rnyed cing ston chos gsum pa tshugs dus bgro gleng shar shar byed thub pa byung / bsdus grwa mi 'dra ba mang bo thugs 'dzin gnang / rtsod pa la 'gran zla med pas phal cher gyis snga sor chos grwar 'gro myong ba zhig yin nam zhes gleng / dgun chos la bsdus 'bring du zhugs shing / dgung lo nyer gnyis pa la bsdus grwa dang blo rtags rdzogs nas 'dzin grwa gzhung gsar du phebs pa yin te/rnam thar bka' rtsom las/ lo der rgyan 'jug grub mtha'i rnam bzhag dang / /blo rtags man chad bsdus tshan nyer lnga kun/ /zhib bzung brgal brtag sgo nas gtan la phab/ /ces so/ /debyunas rim gyis rnam bshad skabs dang po thugs 'dzin dang / gser phreng sogs rgya bod kyi yig cha mang po zhib gzigs mdzad/ zur brkal bzhi sogs la yang 'dzin skyor dang sbyangs pa mdzad tshul ni/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ lcags khyir legs bshad snying po chos 'byung gi /drang nges rnam 'byed chos grags rnam rgyal ba'i/ /drang nges rnam 'byed dge 'dun rgya mtsho yi/ /dka' 'grel bde legs nyi ma dam chos dpal/ /mo ma'i rten 'brel dge 'dun nyi shu dang / /dge 'dun nyi shu chos 'byung byams lhun gnyis/ /bsam gzugs mtha' dpyod spyi don brgyad tsam sogs/ /mang po phal cher bzung zhing la la bltas / /ston gyi srod chos rten 'brel skabs gsum pa / de dag dbyar dgun chos 'tshams (mtshams ) gnyis po la/ /drang nges rnam 'byed dge 'dun nyi shu dang / /bsam gzigs sogs kyang 'dzin chos stsal ba gnang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar sbyangs

14 da ———rjiḍi kai—di— —tshod rnardo—lda——/da wa pas rnam par dpyone pa'i klong rdol zhing / khyad par brtsi bzhag sbyor lam la slebs dus 'jam dbyangs kyi sku zhig mdun du bzhag ste gang blo mashābabastod sgrub kyi sgo nas gsol ba drag tu btab pas 'od sngon po sgor khyil le ba zhig gi nang du 'jam pa'i dbyangs mi'i bong ( bongs ) tshod dang mnyam pa blta (lta ) bas chog mi shes pa zhig yun ringo bo'i bar du gzigs pas sher phyi na gyi don lhag ma med par thugs su chud/ de phyin chad mdo rgyud gang gzigs kyangajitshig don dngos shugs ma 'dres pa chu dwangs pa/'i nang gi de'u 'am shel la tshon bzhine du 'char ba dang / tshig phal cher yang thugs thog nas 'don thub pa byung gsungs/ 'di dag ni gsang rnam rtsa ba las/ pashtsa'i kri har 'od sngon dbus su yab/ 'dod pa'i lha mthong zhes dang / bka' rtsom las/ de dus rnam par dpyid pa'i klong rdol ltar/ /grub pa'i mtha' dang yig 'jog so so la/ /bltas pa tsam gyis chu dwangs rde'u ltar/ dngos shugs ma 'dres shel la tshon bzhin 'char/ /zhes pa ltar ro//dgung lo nyer bzhi ba la 'dzin grwa phar phyin ston mor phebs/ rnam bshad snying po rgyan dang gsor phreng gi dka' gnad phal cher/ 'grel chung don gsal/ legs bshad snying po'i rang rgyud pa'i bar bcas kyi thugs 'dzin 'phro grub cing / dgongs pa rab gsal phal cher thugs 'dzin mdzad/ zhar la 'dul mdzod sbyangs tshul yang / zhal nas/ lcags phag lo la dbu ma'i rnam bshad kyi/ /phal cher bzung la 'dul mdzod bde legs dang / /rje btsun pa dang bsod grags skyo ṭīka dang / /dngos grub gnyis dang rin chen shing rta gsum/ /rang 'grel 'grel bshad ci rigs lta rtog bcug /

dadzi—ḍa———ka/de—bsamadzad basbo'arna1—— 15ces so/ /dgung lo nyer lnga ba la dbu ma'i 'dzin grwar phebs shidzwaphar phyin ston mo'i dam bca'i skabs rigs smra'i khyu mchog rnams kyang mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod pas lung rigs smra ba la 'gran zla med pa'i grags snyan thob/ rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal thugs 'dzin dang dbu ma'ithugs gnyer dpyis phyin pa mdzad/ gsang phur dka' bcu'i mtshan btags gnang zhing kwa bsgyur skabs mkhas grub rin po che'i ka ba thob pas smra ba'i seng ge zhig 'ong ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ /'di skabs rnam 'grel la ṭīkka zhig mjad par sems te/ bka' rtsom las/ rang ṭīka gsar ba'i steng nas dka' bcu byas/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /lo rjes mar chos khri ser po'i grwa skor byed rgyu'i snyan gsan phul/ rigs smra'i khyu rgyan nyi thang shes rab sbyin pa dang mjal/ khong nas dpe mtshams kyi mthun rkyen sbyar te grwa tshang gi yig cha'i dbu ma dang / 'dul ba lung rig sa gter mdzod thugs la bzung / dpe khrid dang dogs gcod zhus tshul sogs bka' rtsom las/ 'jam dbyangs dngos gyur pradzñā dā na la/ /tshad ma 'dul mngon dka' gnas zla phyed lhag /zhib zhus skabs 'gar dgun gyi mtshan ring 'das/ /nyi rtse shar gyi bar du dpyad par byas/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /dgung lo nyer drug pa la rgyal sras chen po thor god don 'grub rgya mtshos grwa tshang gi khri mdzad par dbu ma bskyar tshugs kyi skyor dpon mdzad de zhib par sbyangs/ gsang phur chos khri ser po'i grwa skor du grags pa dbyar chos skabs sa dge'i grwa tshang bcu gcig 'tshogs pa'i dbus su nyi ma lnga'i ring la po ti lnga'i dam bca' bzhag par khong tsho'i khrod nas dge ribashes

16 dargo —sdashu1ḍirwa—ma da batha rnam ra—/—bzang ba thams cad bzhe ngas kyang sus spyang rigs lung ma song bas mkhas grags kyis 'dzam gling khengs pa tsam byung / 'di skabs chos skyongasnyebasetākhrab pa 'i gzigs snang byung tshul thun mong ba ni rnam thar skal bzang 'a jug ngogs su gsal la/ thun mong ma yin pa ni/ dad pa'i snye ma las/ ne'u tog tu grwa skor mdzad pa'i tshe/ /lus ring mdog sngon mig zab a tsaryas/ byod kyi grags snyan sa steng thams cad du/ /khyab par 'gyur zhes gsal bar lung bstan mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de yang lung bstan gyi skabs su khyod kyi legs bshad kyis sa steng khyab pa 'ong zhes lung bstan kyang 'dir rtsom lugs kyi dbang gis grags snyan zhis gsungs la grags snyan dang legs bshad kyis khyab pa gnyis la rgya che chung gi khyad par chen po yod pas legs bshad kyis khyab pa la go dgos gsungs so/ / dgung lo nyer bdun ba la kun gzigs lnga ba chen por bsnyen rdzogayokyitrerīsdom pa mnos shing / de nas bzung ste mtshan mo yang tsog bu'i rnal 'byor kho na mdzad/ lo 'di dang dgung lo nyer brgyad pa gnyis la mdzod dang rnamaji 'grel la zhib tu sbyangs pas lung rigs kyi mngon pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go 'phang brnyes te dbal shul ngag dbang zhes mkhas pa'i snyan grags kyis sa steng khyab par gyur/ bar skabs rnams su mthun rkyen shin bludakon zhing gsol chas med kyang khog ma'i nang du sran ma chu la sbang khog ma nyi mar bzhag nas chos grwar phebs/ chos spyo nas chur phebs pa na sran rdog kha shas re bzhes/ chu cung zad re btung ba de tsam gyis kyang slob

dgonab ga 'tshos—ma —da da sbo rnam ga/ 17gnyer la brtson par mdzad pas dka' spyad dang snying rus kyi tshad du 'dzin pa byung ste/ sngon gyi dam pa du ma'i bcud len gyi rnam thar yang 'di las lhag pa min no/ /chos grwar phebs pa'i snga phyi 'di dag tu 'jam mgon blo gros rgya mtshor gsang 'jigs kyi dbang / 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi rjes gnang so gas chos mang du gsan cing ci gsung bka' bzhin du sgrub par mdzad/ paṇa chen bka' 'gyur ba sbyin pa rgya mtshor mdo sngags kyi chos du ma dang / khyad par 'jam dpal zhal lung gi nyams khrid zla ba gsum du gsan pas lam rim gyi sgophye ba lta bu byung gsungs/ rgyal sras mer gan rin po cher chos bka' mang du gsan/ nga yis chos tshugs zin tsam 'di'i drin yin zhes bka' drin che bar rtsi zhing / bla ma 'di chab bsags kyis sku 'das skabs su sku las zag (zags)pa'i chab thams cad cung zad kyang ma lus par bzhes pas nyams rtogs kyi klong rdol ba lta bu byung / pha bong kha ba 'jam dbyangs grags pa la yang chos bka' mang du gsan cing /khyad par rje 'di'i drung du dbang gi thog ma gsan skabs bgegs kyis mi tshugs pa'i ltas khyad par can byung / sngags pa dpon slob tshul khrims mtshan can la yang chos bka' 'ga' zhig gsan cing / rje 'dis 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen sgrub mdzad tshul la thugs dgyes te rang nyid kyis kyang rtsa sngags mang du bzlas pa'i rnam thar sogs gsungs/ gzhan yang klu 'bum chos rgya mtsho la bka' 'gyur kyi po ti phal cher dang / grub chen sha por gra/gas pa bla ma bsod nams mtshan can gyi drung du paṇa chen gyi gsung nyer mkho'i skor so gas bla ma du ma las chos mang du gsan par 'dug kyang rnam

da zid da —da gordatram̐rdadzo 'akyibs ma da dzo rnam ra gethar dang gas na yig las shes ‘4ra bya'o/ /dgung lo nyer lnga phyin chad nas po ti lhag ma bzhi la sbyangs pa zung 'brel du mdzad pa yin te/ bka' rtsom las// nyer lnga chu byi'i lo la dbu ma dang / /rnam 'grel spyo ri / grwar zung 'dzin nang du yang / /mdzod 'dul bzung zin bshes gnyen dam pa gnyis/ /grwa skor ster bar gsungs kyang ma blangs par/ /zhes dang /nyer bdun shing stag lo la slar rnam 'grel/ /shing yos slar mdzod rnam 'grel 'dul ba 'ang // zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ka'i zhar la sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs du ma dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos ska ra rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa la zhib par sbyangs thing / phyag len 'ga' zhig kyang sbyangs par mdzad/ sgra dang snyan ngag so/gas la yang gzigs rtog gnang zhing / khyad par du sgra la cher ma sbyangs kyang rang shugs kyis shes pa zhig yod ces zhal nas gsungs/ dgung lo nyes dgu pa'i tshe sgo mang dpon slob don grub rgya mtsho la rgyud du phebs rgyu'i dgongs pa zhus pas/ khyed dge bshes gzhan dang mi 'dra bas re zhig chos grwar phebs na nga'i rjes la sgo mang bla ma yong byed gsungs par/ bdag gis tshe 'di blos btang nas chos thig byed snyam pa yin pas dgongs pa cis kyang gnang dgos zhus pas dgyes bzhin du gnang ba khrol/ de nas rgyud smad mkhan thog pa blo gros rgya mtsho'i drung du mjal bas sngar nas thugs rtsi sa che ba ltar dgyes pa chen po mdzad/ zhogs gur bloon gyi chos thog gi skabs su gangs can sngags grwa'i yang rtse smad rgyud grwa tshang du zhugs/ lo 'dir ṭīka chung gi skyor dpon mdzad de bskyed rdzogs dang ṭīkka chung ba thugs 'dzin mdzad/ 'grel ba

da sdakai ba rdaṣa 'akaib sa—ma—pha kwa di sga / — rna ma rna 19bzhi sbrags kyi gzab brtso/da gsan cing sa khungs dang / gzhung gi khog la go ba thebs pas thugs dga' bdes khyab par gyur/ gzhung gi bkas lha sar lho 'brug pa la lcags mkhar rtsig skabs rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgya mtsho dang / rje ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan rnam gnyis las lcags mkhar gyi thig dbyangs/ rnga chings/ sa 'khor dang gnam 'khor gyi bri rtsigazan ling dang shog ling gi man ngag sogs zhib par bslabs shing phyag len mdzad skabs rtags mtshan byung tshul rnam thar du gsal lo/ /de gong zhig lho 'brug pas chos skyong chen por ar gtad byas pas chos skyong gi zhal nas/ lho g.yu 'brug kha nas ser drag 'ong / /mthu nus pa yod na de dus ston/ /zhes gsungs pa 'byung 'gyur 'di nyid yin par grwa rgan rnams gleng / 'brug tu ser ba phab pa khyab 'jug gi lus kyis zhing bkab kyang ma khogs pa lho 'brug pas mngon sum du mthong ba'i lo rgyus kyang yod do/ /gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor so so dang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg mchod rten brgyad sogs kyi thig gar dbyangs sogs rgyud na gang yod bslabs pas/ phyag len la yang mkhas pa'i tshad du 'jog pa byung ste smad rgyud pa'i dge bskos gzhung brgya smra ba mon pa dbu mdzad kyis thig dpon gnang dgos zer ba ba'i/na mdzad nas gsang 'dus kyi thig tshon dang / 'jigs byed kyi sgrub mchod la rdul tshon gyi phyag len 'khrul ba med pa rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bzhin du gsar 'dzugs kyang mdzad/ lha sa rgyud khang gi nag po skor gsu ma la gzungs gzhug kyang lcang skya rdo rje 'chang dang rje 'di ba rnam gnyis nas (kyis )phul zhing / skabs der phreng ba pa

20 gi————nd+ra' rwaziṣadzi rna rna phun tshogs legs 'byor las phyag len zhib khrid mdzad pa'i zin bris kyang snang / snga phyir rgyud chen rdo rje 'chang la sher seng nas rgyud chenabyurim par brgyud pa'i bskyed rdzogs chen mo gnyis kyi gzab bshad dang ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi bshad pa/ bde lam dang bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ nā ro chos drug gi khrid sogs dang / phreng ba pa la rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang / se ra zhabs drung du grags pa skyid shong (shod)sprul sku bstan 'dzin 'phrin las la 'jam dbyangs chos skor sogs kyi khrid/ dus 'khor ṭīka chen gyi lung sogs chos bka' mang du gsan/ skabs zhig (shig)ba sor bsags sbyangs dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor la 'bad cing lta khrid bskyangs pas ring bor ma thogs par zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs tshul dang / chu mig lung du khrid la bzhugs skabs rtags ya mtshan pa byung tshul ni gsang rnam dad pa'i snye ma las/ chu mig lung du rgyud rgyal 'dus pa'i lam/ /rim pa lnga yi zab khrid bskyangs pa'i tshe/ /khri chen steng na rin chen rgyan mang gis/ /legs par brgyan pa'i paṇa grub yang yang gzigs/ /zhes dang / klu sgrub yab sras gzhung gi dka' gnad la/ /legs par dpyad pas zab mo rten 'byung don/ /sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis bkral ba ji bzhin du/ /mngon sum gzigs shing zab lam dga' ston myong / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//rgyud kyi dam bca' chen mo bzhag skabs su dbus gtsang khams gsum nas byon pa'i dge bshes chen po mang pos mdo rgyud gang nas bgro gleng btang kyang (yang)lan thogs med du btab pas mkhas pa yongs kyi thugs 'phrog ste ('phrogs te )bsngags brjod kyi rdza rnga brdungs/de ltar

dargon pha ga mgebs ma da tsā rnam 21mdo sngags kyi gsan sbyong mthar phyin nas gzhung lugs kyi don la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas pa chen por gyur pa na nges par tshe 'di'i 'khri ba btsan chod du spangs te sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i dus la babs par dgongs te rgyud nas dgongs pa nan zhus kyis khrol bar byas nas dgung lo so gsum par grub pa'i gnas mchog ri bo dge 'phel du byon/ de nas bzung dgung lo nga gsum bar du gnas mchog de nyid du sngon gyi bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin du 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo snyoms shing 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi la gnas pa'i sgo nas lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum dang rim gnyis zab mo'i nyams bzhes la rtse gcig tu brtson par mdzad pas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa yin te/ rje nyid kyi gsung mgur las/ blo bzang rjes 'jug mkhas mchog gser sbyangs kyi/ /'khor los thub bstan gling bzhir dbang bskur ba/ /grub pa'i brgo skal thub bstan ri dbang spor/ /mdo sngags mig stong ldan 'di kho bos thob/ /ces rang gi rtogs pa dbyangs su brjod pa ltar ro/ /rtogs brjod drangs ma thag pa ltar dben pa'i gnas mchog 'di nyid du lo nyer gcig gi ring la malas grub zung 'brel dang bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi rnam thar rgya che yang 'ga' zhig 'og tu yang 'byung la zhib par yi ge mang dogs nas 'dir rags bsdus tsam 'god na/ skabs de dag du dge ldan pa'i man ngag gi gter mdzod ni sre (srad ) rdo rje 'chang gcig bu yin zhing / khong dgung lo brgyad cur phebs pa bcas snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa rnams nub tu nye ba thugs kyis ma bzod nas/ dka'

22 dargon ga na da da——— rna tshegs /chen pos rgyud chen denyid kyi drung du phebs te/ kha daralnga 'a brel zhig phul nas zhabs spyi bor blangs/ chos bka' ci rigs stsan gsan phul bas/ bdag gzugs po bde zhing khyed rang la skal ba yed na gang yod ster gsungs nas thugs dgyes pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad de/ rim gyis bde gsang 'jigs gsum dus 'khor dang bcas pa'i bskyed rim/ khrid chen brgyad/ yan lag drug khrid/ yi dam gyi lha du ma'i las tshogs kyi khrid/de dag kyang gnang ba'i rnam grangs tsam min par rgyud dang man ngag dang phyag len gsum ngo sprod pa'i rgyun rdo rje 'chang nas byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i chig brgyud mtha' dag rgyas par gnang zhing / rje nyid nas kyang thob lo tsam ma bsags par/ gsan 'phral du khrid skyong ba dang /dogs gcod dang zin thun sogs ca/dzad chu kṣ-ir ni do rje 'jigs byed kyi chos 'byung khams —gsu ma las rnam par rgyal ba'i nyi 'od las/ gsang 'dus shes na mdo sngags thams cad shes par 'gyur/ da khyod la gsang 'dus rdzogs par ster gsu ngas nas/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi dbang ṭīka gi tshig don rdzogs par khrid cing sa bzung ba'i rdo rje rtse gcig rtse gsum/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'gros dang ṅkang stabs phal cher rin chen rtser song zhes dang / dus 'khor gyi thig mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung zin bris dang / 'dul 'dzin pa'i gar dpe sogs de dag re re'i ljagayobashad nam mkha' ltar rgya che zhing ngo mtshar ba du ma gnang zhing dgyes pa yang yang mdzad pa/ 'di la dpag (dpags )na dbus gcang du rgyud kyi bla ma so sor khrid byin pa dang / thig sogs bslabs pa dang / 'di phyogs su rgyud

———sdo—nadzo ga rdazhisdos ma da pa tho shaṃ —rna 23 waganyisabatsugs pa yang bstan pa la phan pa zhig yong ngam snyam pa'i gsung zur du ma yod snyam zhes dang / khrid chen brgyad la thob lo tsam gyi rna ma grangs ma bsags par/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang lhan gcig tu lo ma lon gyi bar du gzab bshad dang bcas te nyan/ zhes dang / dpon slob rdo rje 'chang gi phyag phyi byas nas phyin cing / bskyed rdzogs du ma'i khrid dang / snyan brgyud gleng mo'i tshul du chos thun gang mang ja sbyor gyi dus lhan du/ de min kho bo gzims phug nas khrid skyong ba dang / bla ma so so'i bzhed pa'i zur mi 'dra ba dag la zin thun yang byas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dus rgyun du yang / rje rang nyid kyi rtogs brjod las/ gsang bde rim lnga sbyor drug rnal 'byor bzhi/ /nā ro ni gu'i chos drug 'pho khrid dang / /byin rlabs bzhi ldan snyan rgyud rdzogs rim la/ /legs sbyangs rgyun du goms la gco/la ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ltar khrid chen brgyad kyi nyams bzhes chag med mjad pa dngos slob du ma'i gsung rgyun 'khrul med thos so/ /yang gshin rje gshed kyi man ngag skor gsan tshul yang / de nyid las/ zla ngo gsum gyi bar der drug cu ba'i lcags mkhar gzab khrid/ rtsa tshig gi 'bru 'grel/ 'phen pa dgu so so'i las sbyor/mnan pa dang / bsad pa'i lag len dang / sbyin sreg la dngos grub rgya mtsho'i tshig zin ltar gyi lha bskyed tshul dang / mnan pa dang / bsad pa dang / zhi ba dang / rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bri rko rtsig gsum gyi thab sogs mdzad nas phyag len rgyas par bslabs ces (zhes ) dang / yang rgyud rtsa bshad gnyis kyi bshad rgyud ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs chen

24 — —༷ginaX — —ga 'a—sdo—dis ma dza sda ba tsāsdo —rna — nga /——da wa mo'i steng nas sngar ltar dang / man ngag la yang mthun pa'i rdzas dang /rten pa'i rdzas dang / bsnyen sgrub kyi skor dang / las sbyor la dgug pa'i lakhyi dang / gzir ba thun gyi dang / bsad bskrad dbye rengs sogs kyi 'khor lo dang / dbye ba'i rdzas dang / lkug par byed pa'i mnan pa/ lha sogs dang bral dbye kha sbyor dbye ba/ zlog pa zor gyi las/ ltas ngan gyis dkrug pa ma he'i las/ sreg pa sbyin sreg gi las/ 'brub pa hom khung gi las/ srog dang bral ba kha sbyor dbye ba sogs las sbyor mang rab yod snang yang deng dus ming yang shes pa shin tu mtho ba dang / bar ma dang / dman pa su'i kha nas mi grags par snang / rtsa ba'i rgyud las kyang / me mar la nici pa ṭa bzhag gsungs pas tshig tsam las ston par mi mdzad pa rgyud na bka' rgya shin tu dam drag pa yin no/ /zhes dang / rtsa ba'i bla ma sre (srad) rdo rje 'chang gi zadun nas kho bo 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes phyag len mang po dang / rgyud so so'i khrid dang / lag len sogs lo phyed bar du mdzad de lugs du ma dang chig brgyud mang po gnang rbas 'dren par rlom pa gzhan gyi rang bzo dang / ngang tshul me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar rtogs par gyur cing /snyan brgyud dran res kyis ba spu lhags par gyur to/ /yang 'khrul 'khor gyi mar me'i yig chung rnams dang / yang chung rnams dang / sngags 'chang dge 'dun mtshan can gyi zhal shes bla ma ku shri chen po'i zin ris/ ra ba'i nyi ma bzhi'i sngags bzla tshul/ la li ta'i srung 'khor rnams kyi lung rnams kho bo 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes thob cing / dogs gcod yang

— dargonapha gardagebasam da badzimirnarda nga/ 25(kyang) drug cu ba chen mo la dang yig chung so so la ci rigs byas/ zhes so/ / 'di'i mar me'i yig chung rnams zhes gsungs pa la dpags na shin tu zab pa'i mar me'i yig chung gzhan yang mnga' bar snang ste/ de nyidalas/ de'i gdams ngag yang deng dus kyi a lo ke'i yig chung dag dang gtan mi gcig par mar me gcig gi yun tshad la gsod pa'i gdams ngag mjug tu kai ka ni'i sdig pa sbyong tshul yod pa zhig yin zhes gsungs pas so//lung 'di ltar na 'khrul 'khor dang drug cu ba'i dogs gcod zin bris kyang yod par mngon te/ 'di dag gter gyi kha byang gi tshul du bris pa lags pas snyan brgyud tshol 'dod rnams kyis shes par gyis shig yang de dus lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung li thang mkhan chen nyag ri chos grags pa las gzhan la med stabs mkhan chen pa dge 'phel du spyan drangagote 'bad pa chen pos gsan nas dge 'phel rang du yang tshar bcu gsum bstsal pa sogs snga phyir mang du spel bas dar so che bar byung zhing / da lta lam rim gyi bshad rgyun mtha' dag rje 'di las brgyud pa sha stag tu snang /yang mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang rgyun nub la nye skabs su rje 'dis jo gdan mkhan chen blo bzang mkhas btsun la gsol ba btab ste rje 'di dang nyi thang zhabs drung ngag dbang gzhon nu/ phyis kyi sgo mang bla ma blo bzang shes rab sogs nyung bsdus kyis gsan nas spel bar mdzad pa las/ da lta dbus gtsang du sgo mang bla ma blo bzang shes rab dang / mdo smad du rje 'di las ma brgyud pa'i mi tra'i dbang rgyun dkon par snang zhes skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas (gis ) gsungs te bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mi nub

2skye gihūṃX— gedzo'azhi— dzo — rdarda lda —dzi'itshe wadzo par bzung ba'irnamatshothar mchog tu shes par gyis/ ya nga snga phyir phreng ba pa phun tshogs legs 'byor la rtog bdun/ rto ga gsum/ 'khrul 'khor gyi sa 'khor gnam 'khor gyi thig lisgo sngags med kyi khyad par/ sngags can la yang mi 'dra ba mang du yod pa rnams dang / dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang / grub chen ye shes bzang bo gnyis la mgon po'i chos skor gang yod gsan/ ho ra smin grol chos rgyal la mnga' ris chos bstan pa nas brgyud pa'i kṣe tra pā la yab yum gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum/ yab yum gyi srog 'khor thun mong ma yin pa dang / spel(sprel) khrid kyi chos skor 'bod bad gsad gsum sngags 'grig dang bcas pa/ rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgya mtsho la dben sa nas brgyud pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang / bde mchog lha dril gnyis/ 'dus pa 'phags lugs/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ dpa' cig rnams kyi dbang / de dag gi rim gnyis kyi khrid/lam khrid/ lta khrid/ chos drug gi khrid/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor/sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ pā ri brgya rtsa/ snar thang brgya rtsa/ rjerigasung 'bum sogs chos bka' mang du gsan cing / snyan ngag gi bstan bcos dbyangs can zhal lung / ri 'phrin yig gi rnam bzhag blo gsal rna rgyan/drang nges rnam 'byed kyi mtha' dpyod chen mo/ bsam gzugs kyi mtha' daphyod chen mo/ lam rim chen mo'i mchan 'grel gser gyi 'khor lo rin po che phal cher rnam 'grel gyi mji' dpyod chen mo le'u gsum pa tshugs pa'i bar/ grub mtha' rtsa ba dang de'i rang 'grel grub mtha' chen mo/dbu ma lung rigasagater mdzod/ gsang 'jigs so so'i bskyed rdzogs du

tsholi ba— ga'agebag —ka rwardzutram̐rna wa 27ma dang bsnyen yig sgrubs (sgrub) thabs sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung dang snyan brgyud kyi yig cha du ma yang gnas 'dir mdzad do/ /don gnyer ba rnams kyis zhus ngor snga phyir lam khrid rgyas pa tshar lnga bcu rtsa grangs dang /rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang / gzhan yang brgya rtsa gsum/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor/ mgon po bka' bcu gsum/ rnam sras bka' bco lnga sogs kyi rjes gnang / gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs/ khrid chen brgyad/'grel ba bzhi sbrags/ bslab btus/ legs bshad snying po/ rim lnga gsal sgron/ sbas don kun gsal/ lam rim chen mo/ rtsa 'jug gi rnam bshad gnyis sogs kyi bshad lung rnams lan du mar bstsal te bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad pas dge 'phel dpon slob ngag dbang pa zhes ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan 'dzin kun gyi dbus na 'phrin las 'gran zla med pa'i grags snyan gyi ba dan srid rtse'i bar du g.yo bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe dge lugs kyi bshad sgrub la sdang ba'i bdud rigs 'ga' zhig gis gzhan phyogs kyi rig sngags mkhan mang bo'i rna bar phra ma bskyal te rbad pa byed bcug pas kyang ma tshugs shing / dug gi sbyor ba lan du ma byas kyang re 'bras grub pa lta ci/ lcang thang sgang du dug sbyong mdzad pa'i shul du grags pa'i rdo ba nag po zhig da lta'i bar du ston rgyu yod pa sogs rang rang gi gtam ngan gyi ba dan 'phyar ba'i rgyur song ba'i lo rgyus mang na yang/ ngan skyu—gas khron pa su zhig slong / /zhes pa kho nar zad/ rje 'dir de 'dra'i sbyor bas tshugs pa'i go skabs ga la yod de/ tha na mnal lam 'jigs pa zhig byung na yang rdo rje 'jigs byed

28 dasgru5 gamagib da —rna kyikyis 'bral med srung ba zhig yod snang ste/ gsang rnam rtsa ba las/ shar zur nor skyong steng sar mi nyal min/ /mu kha ka ra yongs rdzogs 'o da 'bar lo/ /snye7grur 'jigs rung chu 'khor 'khor ba las/ /sgrol ba'i mnyan par rta'i dgra'i shi re khe/ /sngar bzhin byung bas ma 'khor ma nub par/ chu brgal dga' dang dad pa'i chu gter rgyas/ /zhes mnal lam du 'bras spungs kyi shar ngos nas khyi zhig gis bdasasmopas/ khyi dechasteng du rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs thig gzigs pa dang / snye thang gi thad kyi gru la zhugs pas gru chu 'khor du bying bar rtsom pa dang rdo rje 'jigs gled zhal phyag yongs rdzogs shig gzigasapas 'jigs pa de las grol bar gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /'di dag dgon gnas bkra shis 'khyil sogs sku 'phreng rim byon gyi bzhugs gnas du mar rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las phyi sa 'a byung gi ltas su zhal gyis bzhes thing / de mtshungs gzhan yang mang ste rje nyid kyi gsung las/ snga gong mkha 'a la me tog yang yang char/ /zhes sogs dang / rgyas pa'e rten 'brel rmi lam sgyu ma'i gar/ /'di mthong 'bras bu mi bslu da ston shog /ces gsungs pas so yang skabs shig mar khu bu myur mjal bar phebs pas/ brag gcig dang ting 'dzin ka ba gnyis 'ja' tshon gyis sbrel byung bar/ der phebs rtsis mdzad pas rgyus yod rnams kyis lam mi rnyed zhus kyang lam 'di na yod gsungs nas phebs pas rje rin po che'i zhabs rjes rnyed/ de nas brag de sges pas rje rin po ches dus 'khor gyi mun mtshams gnang ba'i brag phug bzhugs khri/ mchod stegs sogs rnyed pas sngon rje rin po cher 'khrungs dus

rgo ba ga'agebaḍad darjoza'arnam 29kyi mdzad pa dran pa red ces skye bo dag gis gleng ba byung snang / de skabs brag der rje rin po che shin tu che ba ri bo ltar brjid cing / paṇa zhwa'i sne mo gnam la reg pa lta bu zhig gzigs pas dga' bde'i nyams 'bar ba zhig byung ba dang / stod lung rtsa skye mor phebs skabs sprin dkar bo rngalidabyibs ltar shin tu blum pa zhig gi dbus su 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhal gzigs thing / tshur lam sa der yang bskyar gyis zhal gzigs pas rje rang nyid sngar dge bshes po to bar sku 'khrungs pa'i gnas skabs thugs la wal gyis shar ba zhig byung ba'i tshul de dag ni/ gsang rnam rtsa ba las/ skyor lung brag tu 'ja' bzhin grags chen 'bar/ /zhes dang / dad pa'i snye ma las/ rtsa sgyer rab dkar sprin gyi phung po3) dbus/ /'brom rje ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ni/ /lan 'ga' gzigs pas dga' bde'i nyams snang 'phel/ sngon gnas rmi lam ji bzhin rjes su dran/ /zhes so/ /yang mnal lam du dge 'phel gyi zam chung gcig yod pa de'i khar dge slong zhig gis 'di na rwa lo tsa (tsā) ba'i gter yod pa de khyod kyis thon zer ba zhig byung / de rgyud 'grel zhig mdzad dgos pa'i brdar dgongs te/ rtog bdun gyi mchan 'grel snyan brgyud rin chen phreng ba mdzad pa yin snang ste/ gsang rnam rtsa ba las/ zam par rwa gter 'don pa'i mtshan ma sogs/ /rgyud don legs rnyed dam pa de'i drin gyis/ /rgyud bshad mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod yid ches gnas/ /legs bzung dngos grub rgya mtsho'i dga' ston yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di dag ni rje rang gis thugs sras rnams

30 dargo ga — ༷—da bam rna /la ji ltar bstsal ba'i gsung rgyun ltar bkod la/ da dung ka lan ta kalidris lan tshigs bcad ma dang mnal ltas tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa/ me hor khong gnyis mi thub paṇḍi ta'i/ /sgyu 'phrul 'gugs par 'dod na sems 'di zungs/ /zhes sogs rnam tharosnyan brgyudasprem yang ches mang po yod par snang ngo / /de yang rje 'di la 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i mtshan gsol ba ni/ 'ga' zhig gis/ shes bya'i gnas tshul kun la thogs med pa'i/ /blo gros zer gyis 'jam dbyangs zhal gyipad/ /rab tu bzhad byed thub bstan dpal gyur pa/ /zhes pa ltar yin zer ba dang / la las 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gzigs snang las btags pa yin zer ba ni rang 'dod kyi gtam ste/ sgra rig smra ba rnams la kun bshad kyimatshan zhes yongs su grags pas/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos sgra'i dka' gnad kyi dogs pa bzhi phyogs so sor bkram pa la rje 'dis lan rnam dpyod can zhig phul ba'i skabs su mtshan de ltar phul bar skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas (gis )gsungs so/ /kun mkhyen zhes rgyal ba'i dbang po rin po che'i bkas bsngags pa yin te/ rgyal dbang drug pa blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rje 'di nyid kyi ñtsa gsol 'debs las/ brda sprod rtog ge gzhan dag tshar gcod chos/ / rjes 'dzin bzo gso tshig phreng mdzes byed rgyan/ /rang nyid kun shes nang don rig pa co/gas/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mnga' ris tho ling (mtho lding )gser gyi gtsug lag khang gi gser khri 'di

man pa —3 dzi/— 'a srurdza midzid — nime rnami—— —sdo—da —da —khe sdo—dzee——da mnyamamed jo bo tstsha rno po 'i bzhugs khri/ yin pas de dang / chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha ba po'i bzhugs gdan dga' ldan gser khri ci rigs la phebs khyad shar byang gi gdan sa zhig dmigs bsal gyis zhal bdag mdzad dgos zhes lan du mar zhus pa dang / de mtshungs skyor mo lung 'di 'dul 'dzin thag ma ba'i bu chen sbal ti dgra bcom pa'i gdan sa yin stabs der bzhugs nas 'dul ba'i bshad pa dang / rdor phreng gi dbang sogs/ gsang sngagasabyukyi chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba gnang dgos zhus kyang zhal gyis ma bzhes/ phyis su grub mtha' chen mo rgyal dbang drug pa rin po che la gzigs 'bul zhus par/ sde srid kyis kyang zhib gzigs mdzad de/stag tshang bas 'jam mgon tsong kha ba la 'gal khur bco brgyad btang ba la nyid nas lan bun 'phar gyi tshul du 'gal khur nyer bdun btang ba rang bstan gyi zhabs 'degs yin tshul gyi bsngags brjod dang / mi dbang rang gi thugs kyi khye'u chos srid kyi thang du rgyu ba'i bar skabs su 'u nga rigs kyi na bun 'thibs pa'i rang mdangs dogs gcod na gu la'i sgra dbyangs zhes pa gsar du brtsams te phul zhing / delimajug tu yang snga sor skyor mo lung dang byang shar gyi gdan sa sogs dgongs bstun zhus par thugs bzhed ma byung ba ltar bzhag kyang / da dung nyid lta bus gdan sa re zhal bdag mdzad na rang bstan la phan pas/ gdan sa che chung gang bzhes nang lhug gi tshul du ngag ma yod pa dgos zhes phebs kyang rje nyid la gcan zan la rtsa'i (rtswa'i )'dam nga btang ba lta bur song mod/ 'di skabs sgo mang grwa tshang nas gzhung la zhus pa ltar/ drug pa rin po che tshangs dbyangs rgya

32 sdorda dzo go diṭaṃḍi —— rdopaka di sdo— rda— — —/ mtsho'i bkas sgo mang bla ma byed dgos thabs med byung ste dgung lo nga gsum nas drug cu me phag gi bar du dpal ldan bkra kshis sgo mang gi chos kyi khri la zhabs sen nye bar bkod de bka' pota chen po lnga'i 'chad nyan gyi rgyal mtshan sgrongs ( bsgrongs ) par mdzad/ de yang brtsi bzhag gnang tsam ma yin par po ti lnga'i dka' gnad thams cad la 'phags bod kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag gung bsgrigs/ rang gzhan gyi lugs du mar dgag sgrub kyi spros pa rnam par bskyang ste gsung bshad zab cing rgya checibs blo gsal yongs la legs bshad blta (lta) ba'i mig 'byed par mdzad pas gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i dgongs don la nang byan chud pa'i dge bshes kyis sa steng khyab par gyur/ chos grwa'i gsung chos la lam rim chen mo/ bslab btus/spyod 'jug mdo sde rgyan sogs kyi gsung bshad zab cing ngo mtshar ba du ma bstsal pas skal ldan rnams kyi rgyud yongs su smin te gcig tu dam pa'i chos la yongs su gzhol ba'i shugs kyis klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor los nyin mtshan 'khor mo yug tu 'da' ba zhig byung / snga sor dbu ma yongs rdzogs dang / rnam 'grel le'u gsum pa'i bar du gsung rtsom gnang yod kyang / 'di skabs grwa tshang spyi nas bskul ma mdzad pa ltar 'dul mdzod kyi mtha' darpād chen mo gnyis gsar rtsom mdzad/ phar phyin yang skabs lnga pa'i bar du yul dbus nas brtsams shing mjug mdo smad du rdzogs par mdzad de/ mdor na bka' pota chen po lnga sogs sngon med pa'i legs bshad 'gran zla dang bral ba/ rtog ge la sbyangs pa dag gis ci tsam brtags kyang 'khrul pa'i dri ma rdul tsam yang med pa/ don zab cing barming ba/ gzhung

— dedzidnghadi— rwa—phyob——sda /rjirjitshu —— —di——— 33 lugs 'bum sde'i chu rgyun glegs bam gyi rgya mtsho gcig tu 'khyil ba lta bu'i lung rigs kyi gter du gyur pa 'di dag bka' rtsom gnang ste thos bsam pa yongs kyi spyi nor du bstsal pa ni mdzad pa kun gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur cing / rang cag rnams kyis bka' drin gzhal dka' ba'i phyag rjes rlabs che ba zhig yin pas na ji skad du skyes pa rabs kyi rgyud las/ phan pa'i lan du mchod pa bya ba ni/ /bsgo ba'i tshig bzhin nyams su len pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bka' drin dang yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas bshad sgrub la 'bad par bya dgos so/ /de yang dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod blo la byang bar bzung na skye ba rting mar stong nyid nges par rtogs pa la the tshom mi dgos zhes rje rang nyid kyis kyang zhal gyis bzhes shing / sbyogs sras ngag dbang bkra shis pa sogs dbu ma 'di'i brtsi bzhag thog mar nyan pa'i slob gnyer ba rnams kyi khrod na phyis su lta ba ma rnyed pa mi srid pa lta bu byung ba yig cha'i byin rlabs yin par 'dug ces mdo smad du cun gar blo bzang phun tshogs pa dang / rje ngag dbang bkra shis pa rnam gnyis kyis gsung 'phros mdzad skabs dngos su thos zhes bshes gnyen chen po rin chen chos bzang pa gsungs/ de bzhin du bsam gzugs kyi mtha' dpyod chen mo blo la bzung na skye ba phyi mar dran pa gsal bo zhig nges par 'ong zhes zhal bzhes mdzad pa skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas gsungs pa'i gsung rgyun 'khrul med thos so/ /de ni rje nyid kyi gsung las/ dang por mkhas mang bsten nas thos bsam byas/ /bar du bsgoms pas sgro 'dogs rab bcad cing / /ngos shes rnyed nas di

da wa3 4 da —— —bo ka ma lhago zhib thatsād tho bobam̐ —spe/ dge— mar ska la ldan 4/ma/ /byas phyir yig hrul gzhan dang ji ltar mtshungs / /zhes gsungs pa ltar thos bsam sgom gsu ma mthar phyin pa'i stobs dang / thugs bskyed kyi mthu yin pas mchog tu dad par gyis shig gzhan yang blo rtags kyi brtsi bzhag thugs thog nas btang ba dang / lo snga phyilisrod kyichos la 'dul ba'i dus tshigs/ dbu ma'i bden gnyis/ drang nges rnam 'byed/ rten 'brel sogs thugs thog nas gnang ba la sngon med pa'i legs par bshad pa mang du yod gsungs so/ /de yang 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po rje sgo mang pa‘blo bzang phun tshogs kyis ma dzad pa'i gsang rnam gsol 'debs las/ grub mtha' rtsa ba rtsom dus mi wang sgra/ /dngos su gsan nas phyag bris mdzad pa dang / /yig 'bru yan chad ma lus gdams 'char gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rje 'dilisamado sngags kyi yig cha thamyo/sa cad lhag pa'i lhas rjes su gnang zhing byin gyis brlabs pa dang / bla ma brgyud pa'i gdarma sa ngag dang ldan pa dang /shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa ste bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu phun 0 sum tshogs/ pa gsum dang ldan pa kho na yin te/ dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod las/ spyi bor bla ma snying la 'jam dbyangs zhabs/ /lce la dbyangs can bsto/da pa'e legs bshad kyi/ /stong nyed rgyud stong dbyangs su sgyu ma'i chos/ /rten 'byung gar du sgyur la ci yang brel/ /zhes gsungs pa rtsom nyams btod pa tsam min la de 'dra the/sa dgos/ pa mang ngo / /snga phyir don gnyer ba sprin ltar 'dus pa la dbang dang rjes gnang / lam khrid/ lta khrid/ mdo sngags kyi lam rim chen rma gnyis kyi bshad pa sogs dam

༷༷ rda—pyi—ditiX——ka—brwa—tram̐ 35pa'i chos kyi 'khor 'o rgya cher bskor bas thub bstan bshad sgrub kyis 'dzin par nus pa'i slob mas nub dza ladzha ra nas shar rgya mtsho'i bar du khyab par gyur te/ rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gdan sar bzhugs pa'i khri chen/'gro ba du ma'i 'dren par gyur pa'i bla chen/ chos kyi gdan khris mtho ba'i mkhan chen/ sgrub pa snying ngo/ra bgyid pa'i sgom chen/ 'chad nyan gyi rgyal mtshan bsgrong (sgrong )ba'i slo ba dpon/ lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i bshes gnyen/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta bgrang las 'das pa byung ba'i nang nas rags rem zhig rnam thar skal bzang 'jug ngogs ltar la/ der mi gsal ba'i slob ma grags can yang / chu bar dge 'dun bkra this/ rwa sgrong rtse nya bla ma blo bzang dbang bo/ gdong kong phun tshogs rgya mtsho/ brag yab che tshang blo bzang rnam rgyal/ rab 'byams pa chos dbang dang skyor mo lung bla chen/ dus 'khor ba yon tan dar rgyas/ sman lam bla ma ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ gdong dkar shod pa yon tan dar rgyas/ skyor mo lung pa legs pa don grub/ dka' chen shes rab dar rgyas/ gser khang chos rje gu ṇa ma ti/ / phun tshogs gling pa lhun grub rgya mtsho sogs mang du yod par skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs so/ /gzhan yang mkhas dbang go bo legs bshad/ se ra paṇḍi ta blo bzang sbyin pa/ dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags/sman rams pa chags pa chos 'phel/ cun gar bstan pa lhun grub/ li thang mkhan chen sangs rgyas chos 'phel sogs dang / mdo smad phyog sa 'dir yang stag tshang dpon slob blo bzang rab brtan/ tsa yu a lags

36 danog ga mgi byu da mi rna 'phrin las rab brtan/ klu tshang dpon slob blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ a mo dka' bcu ngag dbang bsam gtan/ 'be sprul sku theg mchog dbang byug lung bzang nang ba ngag dbang smon lam/ reb tsa bka' 'gyur ba ngag dbang blo bzang nyi ma/ ma ṇi ba shes rab bkra shis sogs kyang slob ma yin par gsan yig nem thar ci rigs las 'byung ngo / /snga sor sgo mang gi bca' yig bor nas lo mang bo song ste phar phyin ston mo'i srol nub pa dang / lo gsar gyi skabs su bskol ldan 'thung ba la mi 'dzem pa sogs sgrigs (sgrig) lam nyams chag che bar byung yod par 'di skabs bca' yig yang gsar du rnyed nas sgrig lam nub pa rnams gsar du btsugs/ nyams pa rnams slar gsos/ gnas pa rnams gong 'phel du btang ste bstan pa rin po che la phan pa'i gsos su 'gyur ba kho na mdzad/dbu ma 'jug pa yang bla ma snga ma mang pos 'dzug bzhed la lus par zla grags sprul pa'i zlos gar 'di nyid kyi 'phrin las sgo mang grwa tshang la tshugs shing / de'i dmigs rkyen gyis mdo dbus gnyis kar dar rgyas che bar byung ba 'ari bzhin no // longs spyod kyang khrir bzhugs 'phral dkon po byung na yang / bstan srung rnams la ched du gnyer nas 'phrin bcol mdzad pa las/ skabs shig bla brang gi thug nag gi stod du bya rog gis dzam la'i sku zhig bskyal ba blangs nas mchod pa dang chu sbyin mdzad pas dpon slob thams cad la log 'tsho dang bral ba'i mkho dgu'i longs spyod char ltar babs pa'i tshul rnam thar du gsal la/ 'di skabs sgo mang bla brang gi zhig gsos kyang legs par grub/

dzee—1 tsho — diḍiḍarwa—rjokage dzi da / nu7'bras spungs sngags khang gi 'jigs byed byin rlabs can rwa lo'i sku gdung nang rten du bzhugs pa der byi ba'i skyon zhugs pa yang spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa zhig gis bcos dgos pa'i lung bstan ngag rgyun ltar rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs pa la zhus pas sgo mang bla ma la zhus gsungs pa ltar rje 'di nyid nas legs par bco sa/ rje'i rnam thar brgya dang nga gsum ma'i ras bris kyi srol yang skabs 'dir btod/ sgo mang gi chos grwa gong ma yang rgya bskyed/ rje rin po ches gsung bkod ltar gyi zhal zas rgya mtsho ma su gang gis ngo mi shes pa ltar song ba yang srol gsar du btod pas da lta phyogs thams cad du khyab che ba sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo yang rgya che ba byung snang ngo / / chos grwa bskyed skabs klu'i bum gter gyi cho ga yang gsar rtsom mdzad de chos grwar bum gter rgyud nas bshad pa ltar sba ba dang / shing mang po 'dzugs par gnang ba ma 'gyangs par shing sdongabyublor mi shong ba skyes/ khyad par seng gdong ma'i pho brang zer ba'i pha bong gi rtsar brag phug cig yod par mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 'khor byed pa yin zer nas chos grwa nas grwa ba glo bur du khyer 'gro ba zhig yod pa snga sor sus kyang bcos su ma btub pa la grwa mang gis rje 'di la gsol ba btab par brten/ rje 'dis brag gi sgo rtsig pas bcad de rwa sgrong gi shug pa gser ldan gyi yal ga zhig btsugs nas/ shug pa 'di yag por skyes na 'di ltar bzhag pas skyon mi 'ong /skam song na grwa ba la cung zad gzan yang brag phug gi sgo ma phye na 'chad nyan la cung zad gnod ces gsungs pas/ri shug pa'i yal ka(ga)de ring

da smo— rdo na— —rwa—༈——da 3——— /rnami bor ma thogs par sdong bor long zhing (longs shing)/ da lta shug sdong de'i rtsa ba rgyas na sgo mang grwa tshang dang / rtse mo rgyas na rje nyid kyi gdan sa bkra shis 'khyil la legs po yong ba 'dug ces sgo mang gi grwa rgan rnams gleng ba thos te ting nge 'dzin dang tshul khrims zung du 'jug pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar ba yin no//de skabs bka' gdams sprul pa'i glegs bam las/ bod kha ba can gyi gdul bya rnams/ /bu snying med pha la gshe ba bzhin/ /nga phan bde'i 'byung gnas rin chen la/ /sems rtog pa che zhes smod par byed/ /ces pas rgyal dbang drug pa rin po che blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho dang / kye khyung chen mkha' la lding ba la/ /bya tshal bus khyim nas 'phya ba bzhin/ /nga ye thes khyu nga chen nam mkha' lding / /sems khong skran can des 'phya bar byed/ /ces rgyal dbang drug pa rin bo che pad dkar 'dzin pa ngag dbang yoshes rgya mtsho lung bstan cing gnyis ka'imadzad 'phrin la phyogs lhung gi 'phya smod kyis gnod par gsungs pa'i lung bstan thog tu babs te tshangs dbyangs pas bslab 'bul mjod pa la gong nas gleng gzhi byung ba dang rgyal bo lha bzang dang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gnyis nang ma 'chams pa'i rkyen gyis 'ur zing byung ba la/ rje 'dis rgyal ba tsong kha ba'i bstan pa thugs la bcangs nas bla ma rnams kyis par (bar )chings yang yang gnang ba'i skabs sogs su dus gsum rjen par gzegs pa'i 'gyur med rdo rje'i tshig sba gsang med par bstsal/ phrag dog gi dbang gis byung ba'i phan tshun gyi nad pa grangs gang mang zhig la dug sbyong

da wa /rgo rdarda— — rjo ge—ba—sa ci—masdoX—rjo—sdo /spra 39mdzad nas mi 'jigs srog gi sbyin pas bskyabs/ bstan srid kyi rim gror zla ba gcig gi ring la mtshan mo dus dgra 'i dbang po'i zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg gnang ba sogs nyin mtshan gnyis kar bsrung bzlog sogs kyi sgo nas bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa rim gnyis ting 'dzin gyi bsrung ba'i rwa bar btsud/ gsung ba ko/da gnang ste chosdo/ grwar la nga rim gro mang po sgrub bcug pa sogs thugs khur che bzhes mdzad pas yid kyis mi bzod pa'i gegs chags shig gi mgo brtsams kyang mthar bde 'jags byung ba yin pas bstan pa la bka' drin mchog tu che bar shes par gyis/ de skabs rang gzhan kun la phan pa'i gsung mang po byon pa la/ phyogasalhung gi dbang du gyur pa dag gis ji 'dis rgyang ba tshangs dbyangs pa po'i thugs la mi 'bab pa'i bya ba mang po byas par bsgrags mod kyang / tshangs dbyangs pa chen po nyid nas bslab 'bul ma mdzad gong du sgo mang grwa tshang nas bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa'i rje 'di'i gsol 'debs las/ /dge 'dun spyod log dmag gi dpung tshogs bshoms/ /blo ngan sems kyis mi mthun nag po'i phyogs/ /'jig rten mi bde sdug bsngal spyod pa kun//zhi mdzad 'jam dbyangs bzhad par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa dus gsum rjen par gzigs pa'i gsung yin pas/ tshur mthong gi spyod ngan gyis 'phags chen gyi mdzad pa la bar bkab byed pa'i 'khrul snang gi gtam de 'dra spangs na rang gzhan la dge'o// 'o na gong du bkod pa'i bod kha ba can gyi gdul bya rnams/ /zhes sogs kyi sho lo ka de nyid bai ddharya ser po sogs las kun gzigs lnga pa chen

40 dargon ba ga zheb ma da tha rnam podzilung bstan du sbyar ba min nam zhe na/ de ni bden mod kyang 'di ni kun mkhyen mchog gi gsung rgyun ltar bkod la kun gzigs lnga pa'i mdzad pa 'phrin layobacas rgyas par bka' gdams glegs bam las ji ltar bstan tshul kyang kun mkhyen rin po che nyid kyi gsung rgyun ltar dpyod ldan ngo mtshar skyed pa zhig spro bar ni nus te glegs bam las me'i sa bon la rus byas pa zhes pa nas 'u yug tu btsun pa byas dmu ru brtul ba'i bar dang / bzang po bzang po 'ga' re dang mi ring ba ni lcang ma can zhes dang / tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do/ /zhes sogs thor bu yang snang ngo / /spyir 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas padma skyes/ /zhes pa slob dpon gyi lung bstan du drangs shing /blo thazang zer tshad rje rin po che'i lung bstan du drangs pa thal che bar sems te/ de lta na bzang spyod las/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang / /zhes pa sde srid rin po che rang gi lung bstan la sbyar na mdzes so/ /de yang mkhas dbang chos rje sgo mang ba no yon mkhan pos mdzad ba'i rnam thar gsol 'debs las/ dgung lo nga gnyis spung gi gdan la 'khod/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa nyi ltar gsal bar mdzad/ /khyad par dgra bgegs 'tshub 'gyur byung ba'i dus/ /thabs mkhas zhi drag las kyis zhi bar mdzad/ /chos kyi rgyal pos bstan dang lar (la )rgyar dgongs//dga' ldan khri gtso dgon chen dpon slob rnams/ /bsdus par bstan srid skor gyi dri ba mdzad/ /mchod yon ma lus the tshom dra ba bcad/ /
