dgon ba tshodzaḍa—rjo da go——rka 5/ 41de dus tshangs pa dung thod can gyi lung / /gsal kyang sa yi tshangs pa'i dgongs pa zur/ /'gran zla med pas lung bstan gsal mdzad pa/ ma 'ongs dus 'khrugs mngon sum mkhyen mnga' ba/ /zhes dang / dung thod can gyi lung bstan du ma dang / /sprul pa'i chos skyong chen po nas kyang / 'di na skal yod ban chung 'dus tshogs kyis/ /rnam pa rtag tu bkur zhing gus btud na/ /bstan dang la rgyar dge ba lha ngas shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skabs 'dir 'chad dgos pa ches mang yang mang dogs nas ma bkod pas/ rnam thar dang lo rgyus gzhan dang gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /rje 'di nyid kyi lo zla re re'i rnam thar yang rgya che mod kyang / dgon pa gsar 'a debs kyi skor sogs 'og tu 'chad pas 'dir mdo smad du byon pa yan chad tsam dang / de yang rnam thar chen mo'i zur 'debs kyi tshul du bkod pas lo rgyus dngos gzhi rnams rnam thar las shes dgos te 'phros don tsam mo/ /da ni dkyus la 'jug ste/ dgung lo nga dgu pa me khyi la gzhug mar gnas pa dang / phyogs nas phebs pa bcas dge 'dun bdun stong 'dus pa la 'gyed chag med dang bcas rigs grwa nyi ma nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi bar du btang nas drug cu ba me phag la zur bzhugs mdzad pa las bod skyong lha bzang han gyis pha bong kha'i gdan sa phul ba rten 'brel legs par dgongs nas zhal bzhes mdzad de 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang myug gi khri la zhabs/ skyes kyi padmo mngon par bkod/ der bzhugs ring dge

42 dargonaphalhani'adebasamawad pabo ma nga/bshes mang po la legs bshad snying po'i bshad lung dang khrid chen brgyad / lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung / bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ gdugs dkar gyi dbang sogs bstsal te chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor zhing legs bshad kyi rtsom pa yang mang du mdzad/ de nas nges pa rdon gyi chos kyi rgyal bo dga' ldan eti ni ju nang gis mdo sma da du 'byon par gsol ba btab pa ltar sa mo glang gi lo hor zla drug pa'i nang du chibs kyi kha lo mngon par bsgyur/ zla ba dgu ba'i tshes la bcom ldan 'das sum cu rtsa gsum nas 'dzam gling du byon pa dang / chos mtshungs par nor 'dzin gyi snying po go/cig tu bsdus pa lta bu'i rtse gzhung sa yi thig ler zhabs kyi padmo mngon par bkod/ lo 'di rje rin po ches dga' ldan btab pa'i lo yin pas rten 'brel bsgrig dgos gsungs nas dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi skar 'jin tsam byas shing / re gsum pa lcags stag gi lo dgon pa gsar 'debs mdzad pa yin no// //smras pa/ gang zhig thub bstan dziyi lding khang gi /rtse dga' dgod pa'i skal bzang 'dzin pa na/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu nyi ma gnyis pa zhig /skal bzang legs byas shar ri'i rtse las thon/ /na tshod ches phra'i dus nyid nas/ /tshangs spyod dri bzang rab rdzogs shing / /yon tan yal 'dab cher rgyas pa'i/ /gtam gyis sgra 'dzin bdud rtsir byed/ /mdo snga gas chos kyi chu klung ni/ /bye ba phrag brgya nyin bzhin du/ /btung bas nam yang mi ngoms pa'i/ /dam chos rin chen gter dugyur/ /ma stsa da thos bas ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che/ / sgom sgrub mardo ra yis bsrubs pa kṣes/ /rmad byung rtogs pa'i zla dkyil

dgin dge ga'azhibs mardzu rngi1tram̐spernam rna 43gsar ba ni/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug yongs kyi spyi bor 'dzin/ /lung rtogs rin chen bdun la dbang bsgyur des/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo yīs/ /thub bstan gling bzhi'i khyon la dbang bsgyur tshe/ /'bas skyes nor bu skye dgu'i gtsug na mdzes/ /gang zhig mchod dang bsten pa lta zhog gi /mthong thos dran pa tsam yang rnyed dka' ba'i/ / dam pa'i byin gyis shis par bsgrubs pa yis/ /mdo smad nor 'dzin e ma skal ba bzang / /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//de la mgon po de nyid bsam bzhin mi'i srid pa'i gar gyis rnam par rol pa shes bya thams cad chags thogs med par mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi mnga' bdag nges pa don gyi ma hā paṇḍi ta 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i sde zhes grags snyan gyis nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon kun yongs su khyab pa'i rje btsun thugs rje'i bdag nyid can de'i rnam par thar pa nyung shas shig bri ba la/rje btsun dam pa de gang du sku bltams pa'i yul ni bod dang bod chen po gnyis su phye ba'i nang tshan bod chen mdo smad kyi lho rgyud dge bcu'i yon tan thams cad mngon par tshang ba'i gnas snang ra/ lung ba'i bye brag gram pa nang zhes bya bar/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi'i ya gyal ldong gi rigs las/ gcan tsha'i dpon po ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhes bya ba khams kyi rgyal phran lta bu'i gzi brjid dang 'byor bas phyug pa de ni rje 'didzeeyab yin la/ yum ni gnam skyid ces bya ba bud med kyi rten la yon tan gyi phung bor gyur pa yul mi kun gyis rang gi ma dang bla ma ltar gus pa'i yurme du

44 gin ——tshordaḍoshas dzad pathame rna — 'dzin pa zhig go /de lta bu'i yab yum de gnyis kyi sras su rje 'di sku bltams pa'i snga phyir/ yab yum gyi rmi lam du gser sku byon legs pa zhig rang gi phang bar thogs pa dang / rang gi khang ba'i nang du nyi ma shar ba dang lhas nang du mar khu'i rdzing bu 'khyil ba dang / nam mkha' na nyi zla rgyu skar thams cad cig char bkra lam mer yod pa rmis pa dang / snang ra'i gser khang nas dge 'dun mchod rdzas thogs pa dpag tu med pa'i ser sbrengs kyis yab yum gnyis khri mthon por spyan drangs te bzhugs su dzi gsol ba sogs rmis shing / lhag par yum gyi rmi lam du mo rang sku 'bum du mjal bar 'gro rtsis byas par mngal gyi byis pa na re/ a ma khyod sku 'bum du 'gro mi dgos khyod kyi phyi ma'i lam mgo thon yong / nga rje btsun tsong kha ba chen po'i skye mtha' yin zer ba dang / yang mo rang sku 'buyodu lam phyed tsam sleb skabs nam mkha'i ngos su bltas par/ bar snang la khri steng 'og gnyis 'dug pa'i gong ma'i steng na bla ma na bza' ser po dbu la sne ring gyon pa zhig bzhugs/ khri 'og ma'i steng na bla ma na bza' dmar po can zhig gis mo rang la gzigs nas sprul sku'i nyi ma legs po 'char gin yod ang gsungs/ yodapyilags zhus par/ nga la gsol ba legs par thob dang khyod kyi don thams cad ngas sgrupha nus/ nga rje btsun tsong kha ba chen po'i skye mtharme yin zer ba dang / yul mi 'ga' zhig gi rmi lam du/ yab kyi khang ba dar gyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbyibs ltar yod pa dang / ra skor du gser gyi mchod rten nyi zla'i 'od 'phro ba zhig yod pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i rmi lam dang yul phyogs su'ang bkra shis pa'i dge

ge wa dgon watsho'adzee ma dbapa nga 46mtshan mang du byung bar yul mi dag gleng ngo //sku bltams nas ma 'gyangs pa'i skabs shig yum gyi nyams snang la/lho ngos bya rong phyogs kyi nam mkha' nas bla ma paṇa zhwa gyon pa gsum byon nas gos ser po me rtog gi ri mo bkra lam me yod pa zhig sras kyi steng du bkab nas byis pa'i gos gyis zer ba zhig byung ba ni/ sngon gzhon nu don thams cad grub par lha klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis khrus dang na bza' phul ba dang cha mtshungs par 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis sri zhu mdzad pa yin snang ste/ gsang rnam gsol 'debs las/ dge mtshan ltas dang bcas te bltams pa na/ /'jig rten skyong rnams lha yi gos bzang phul/ /tshul khrims phung po yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /gos bzang dran shes nor buliska rags 'chang / /zhes so/ /lar 'di 'dralisteng nas rnam thar thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis re 'byed shes dgos te/ sngogaston pa sku bltams pa'i skabs brgya byin gyis ka shi'i ras kyis blangs par gsungs pa yang snang tshod la ma ma'i cha byad du yong bar mdo las gsungs pas shes so/ /yum 'di nyams snang dang rmi lam shin tu gsal zhing thugs sgam pa sogs bud med tha mal ba zhig min par nges zhes yul mi dag mabun par gleng ngo / / / 7 'khrungs nas ring bor ma lon par grub pa'i dbang phyug mkha' spyod —pa sangs rgyas chos 'phel rnal 'byor pa phal ba'i cha byad kyis phyogs der byon pas sku srung sogs mdzad cing khong gi mnal lam du/ ma cig lab sgron gyis dre'u dkar po zhig chibs nas byon te/ byis pa 'di dbal

46 sgrun ge 'azhi mtshod pa sbo rna shul dpon slob rin po che la sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa gsum 'byung ba'i nang nas thugs kyi sprul pa yin gsungs pa rmis shing / de mtshungs rje nyid kyi rigs kyi khu bo maspyo shrī lnga pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgya mtshos kyang thugs dam brtag pa mdzad par yang de dang mthun pa byung / 'on kyang re zhig gsang rgya byas nas/ dgung lo lnga pa'i tshe dge ba'i bshes gnyen tog nor bu'i mtshan can gyi drung nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang / dgung lo drug pa la dge phyug chos rje don grub rgya mtsho'i drung nas rab byung bsgrubs/ dgung lo bdun pa nas stong 'khor rin po che nas sku mdun du blangs/ mtshan la sgo bla zhes btags/ lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin du skyong bar mdzad/ yab yum gyi khyim du nam yang bzhugs su ma bcug par gyer thang ri khrod/ rnga dgon byang chub gling /mdo mkhar bshad sgrub gling sogs su res mos kyis bzhugs/ sku zhang dge slong blo gros rgya mtsho zhes chos srid yongs la gzigs pa mchog tu yangs pa des klog bslabs pas phyogs 'gro re tsam bstan pas kyang 'bri klog thams cad tshegs med par mkhyen/ bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos sum rtags gnyis dang / dag yig mang po/ sngags kyi bklag thabs sogs kyang sbyangs pa mdzad pas legs par thugs su chud cing / stong 'khor rin po che'i gsung rtsom mang po'i drung yig kyang mdzad/ lha bris kyang yid 'phrog pa mkhyen zhing / mdo sngags rig gnas gang la yang gzigs pa tsam gyis rnam darpāod thogs med du 'jug pa zhig byung / sku na shin tu phra ba'i skabs de dag tu yang / myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po

tshosdi——dzig mazhibs dzid— lnga 47dang / dam can chos kyi rgyal po/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras gsum bran bzhin du 'grogs pa yin snang ste/ skabs shig yum gtsang sbra la cung zad g.yel ba'i rmi lam du/ chos rgyal gyi 'bag chas gyon pa mang pos mo rang la brdung brdeg (rdung rdeg)byed pa yang yang rmis tshul stong 'khor rin po che la zhus pas/ chos rgyal gyi bskang bgang mang sgrubs/ byis pa la gtsang sbra rem gsungs/ bskang ba phon cher sgrub pa'i skabs shig mo rang la phyogs bzhi nas chos rgyal bzhis rub brgyab ste/ rdung rdeg byed par sngon gyi bskang chos pa rnams kyis ngo chen byas nas gtong ba rmis pa dang /sku zhang dge slong gis me sug gis bdegs nas/ rjes sor na bo ma byung ngam zhus par nga'i mgon rgan gyis nga la me sug 'phog tu ga la 'jug ces gsungs pa dang / yul mi rnams kyi rmi lam du khu bo us cang nang sos dngul gyi khrab me tog gi ri mo can zhig gyon phrag par nyi zla gnyis bzung ste yab kyi sgo drung du bsdad yod pa dang / yang lho ngos nas dge 'dun mang pos mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs te yab kyi khang ba ga na yod par 'gro ba la sku zhang dge slong blo gros rgya mtshos stod dung dang smad dngul las byas pa'i khrab cig gyon te sgo srung gi tshul du yod par rmis pa sogs kyis shes so/ /rje nyid kyi zhal nas rje rin po che'i ring lugs pa la skyes bu gsum gyi chosaskyong 'dis mi chog rgyu gang yang mi 'dug pas chos skyong mang po'i rjes su ma 'brangs pa yin/ mgon po zhal 'di brten(bsten)dgos zhes paṇa chen rin po ches yang yang bka' nan gnang stabs dus 'khor grwa tshang du btsugs pas 'thus par byas zhes gsungs pa dang / rje nyid nas mgon

48 rdo sdo zhi mapad rna chos gnyis la gtor 'bul 'chag med dang / rnam sras kyang tshul khrims —kyi srung mar dgongs nas gtor 'bul gnang tshul dang / yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed dang chos skyong 'di dag gi mthus thugs bzhed 'grub tshul sogs zhal nas dngos su thos so/ /de ltar yang / de nas gzigs pa lnga yis mkhyen bzhin du/ /ddha ki'i mtshan ldan yum gyi lhams zhugs tshe//chos kyi rgyal po rgyal chen rnam sras sogs/ /chos srung rgya mtshos g.yel med bya ra mdzad/ /ces so/ /gzhan yang sku na shin tu phra ba'i skabs de dag tu lha dang bla mali gzigs snang nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu byung bar mngon te/ sku bsnyang ba'i skabs shig rje nyid kyi sngas mgor pha dam pa rgya gar bzhugs pa la mo dge slong zer ba'i dge sbyor ba zhig yod pas kyang mthong ba dang / lan cig sku nam mkha' la 'phar nas thal skad gtong ba gnang bar/ yum skrag nas brtag pa'i ched du yul de'i lugs srol ltar zha nye bzhus nas chu nang du glugs pas a ti sha'i sku zhig byon par/ dpyod ldan rnams kyis jo bo chen po sogs paṇa grub du ma'i sku'i snang ba 'gog med du shar ba na sngon gnas rjes dran gyi tshul du rigs pa'i gad rgyangs bsgrags pa ra the tshom mi dgos zhis gleng ba dang / skabs shig rje rin po che'i sku 'dra zhig rnyed nas gser gsol dang mchod 'bul mdzad de/ gsol ba nan tan du btab pas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa'i rnam dpyod phul du byung ba brnyes pa'i tshul mdzad pa sogs kyis shes so/ /de ltar yang /lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan jo bo a ti sha /mngon sum gzigs pas dga' ba

dargon bgyag 'a1sa lospra rjod wa 49dpag med 'khrungasaṃ/ /paṇa chen du mar 'khrungs pa'i ngang tshul kyang / /rjes dran rnam 'gyur rigs pa'i gad rgyangs bsgrags/ /dge ldan bstan la dbang bsgyur rten 'brel gyis/ /'jam dpal snying po'i snang brnyan rnyed pa na/ /nyin mtshan kun tu phyag mchod lhur mdzad pas/ /'jam dbyangs bla mas mngon sum rjes su bzung / /zhes dang / cung zad snyun gyis zin tshe pha dam pa/ /mngon sum byon nas gegs sel bsrung ba mdzad/ /yum chen lab sgron dus nas lhan cig tu/ /thugs bskyed smon lam zab mos 'brel bar nges/ /zhes so/ /sku bsnyung ba'i skabs shig saṃ ṭalisteng du ban de bse theb can dang / bud med skra gzings pa dang / mi dmar rta dmar can dang / sbrul gyi gzugs sogs mang du bri bar mdzad pas/ /sku zhang dge slong blo gros rgya mtsho zhes mkhyen spyan yangs pa can des rgyal bsen dang klu btsan gyi bcos mdzad/ rim gyis ri mo re re nas bzhag ste sbrul gzugs kho na 'bri bar mdzad pa na klu bcos kho na byas pas skabs shig sbrul thur du bstan pa'i steng du rgyal mtshan ser po btsugs pa 'bri bar mdzad nga/sa bsnyun dwangs par gyur/ tshul 'di ni sngon dpal ldan zla bas ri mo'i ba las 'o ma bzhos nas bden zhen bzlog pa'i tshul dang mtshungs par gzur gnas mkhas pa yongs kyis bsngags pa'i me tog lan brgyar 'thor bar mdzad do/ /de lta bu'i ya mtshan pa'i mdzad pa dang / rtags dang rmi lam sogs yab yum gyis phyi 'khyar med pa byas pa'i rkyen gyis re zhig cher ma mngon na yang / skabs shig khong tshos chos skyong khag la sprul sku 'di gsang nas

50 dargon gam—tsho——rdo —dbasdo rnam bzung e chog zhus par/ mi chog tshul phebs pa dang / yugagyi rmi lam du yang sngags pa ral ba can mang pos nga'i bla ma'i spul sku nga/nga na yod ces bsdig (sdig)mo byed pa yang yang rmis pa sogs kyi rkyen gyis gsang ma — tshugs par/ dgung lo brgyad pa shing yos kyi lo stong 'khor rin po che nas dpon mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma zi ling du phebs skabs shig stong 'khor dgon du gdan drangs te/ ston mo sogs rgyas par phul ba'i mjug tu dpon mo gcig bu la lo rgyus zhib tu gsungs/ de ma thag gzims chung phur rje 'di bzhugs pa mdor spyan drangs pa la dpon mos/nga ngo e mkhyen dri sa par shes chog rgyu red de/ yin kyang nga na tshod chen po red ang gsungs pas dpon mo ha las pa lta bur gyur/ tshur phebs nas bla brang dbon tshang nas mi ched du mngags te nyer spyad ngos 'dzin phul/ gdan 'dren myur du zhu rtsis gnang mod kyang / 'jam mgon khri rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis pas brtag pa mdzad pa'i mnal lam du sre mong zhig byung ba — sogs ha cang gsal ba ma byung tshul dang / wang bstan 'dzin dbang phyug gi sras dga' ldan bsam grub 'khrungs dus mnal lam 'ga' zhig byung tshul kha shas la gsungs pa'i rkyen gyis ri bong cal gyi dpe bzhin dga' ldan bsam grub kun mkhyen mchog gi sprul sku yin pa red ces rlung ltar grags thing / ching wang bstan 'dzin dbang phyug dang / dpon mo edhe sha ra gnyis kyang tshul der mos pa'i rkyen dang gtso cher ma cig lab kyi sgron ma'i sku'i skye ba snga mar brag phug bha dra lar sgom la bzhugs pa'i durtswasu lha dang bdud nor ba thengs 'ga' byung ba'i rten 'brel gyis ma cig yum

dargopyib gamarnab da ba za rnam 51sras kyis gang du bston 'gro'i srog 'dzin pa der bdud kyis 'khrul ba bslang ste/ 'dra min 'dra nor gyi bar chad mang po 'byung ba'i lung bstan gyi dus la babs te/ shin tu blun pa 'ga' zhig gis/ gsang rnam rtsa ba las/ rū la des chog slar na dza pag to/ /zhes pas kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa de nyid kyis/ rang gi mi lus la des chog slar sprul sku mi 'byon gsungs pa yin zer ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis skyes bu dam pa mang pos kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa la sprul sku mi 'byon/ rang gis sprul pa'i bla ma rgyal tshab pa la thim gsungs pa red ces zer ba sogs rang 'dod kyi gtam rtswa spur me mched lta bu byung ste lo kha shas kyi bar gdan 'dren zhu ma thub par brten/ dgung lo bco lnga'i bar du stong 'khor rin po che de nyid kyi drung du bcar bzhugs mdzad/dgung lo bcu gsum pa'i dus 'gro ba'i mgon po de nyid las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes shing / gzhan yang dam pa de nyid kyi drung du byang chub lam rim gyi khrid dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang sogs gsan nas gong smos kyi dgon sde rnams su lha dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed dang gsang ba'i bdag po sogs yi dam du ma'i ljags bsnyen dang / chos skyong rigs mang po'i bsnyen bsgrub (sgrub)sogs rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa bzang pos dus 'da' bar mdzad/skabs shig sku zhang dge slong gis rtsed molitshul du khyed 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku ga la yin/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sprul sku mis gdan 'dren zhus tshar ba red zhus par skyon med/ dus phyis chos rgyal

52 dargozha ba ga bdeb mdzad ba tho rnam gyis ma he zhon nas de phyogs su thon song / zhes gsungs patshistar ma 'gyangs par tshul min byed mkhan rnams la mi 'dod pa thog babs kyi maspo/ tshugs shing / khyad par lcags bya lo dpon tshang nas dbus su mi sna ched mngags kyis chos skyong khag la lung bstan gyi yi ge phul bar/ gnas chung chos kyi rgyal po dang / dga' gdong chos skyong gnyis nas da bar du slo ba dpon gdan sar mi 'bab pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/ mi mthun pa byed mkhan rnams la chu srin gyi (gyis)sder mo btab yong zhes bka' drag tu phebs shing / lung bstan gyi yi ge dgon par 'byor 'phral/ ngan rtsa byed mkhan rnams so so'i rang skyon gyis yul 'don dgos pa byung ste/mchod yon thams cad mjub mo lnga bcing du gyur pa'i dbang gis bcu drug pa chu phag gi lo rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i chos sde chen po dag/'a ldan bkra shis 'khyi la zhes rang nyid kyi thugs bskyed dang smon lam mchog gis bskrun pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can der yab rje gong ma gang de'i zhabs zung bkra shis 'khor lo'iri mo mchog dang lan brgyar 'grogs pa'i mi 'jigs seng ge'ikhri la zhabs sen nye bar bkod pa yinate/ gsol 'debs shel dkar nor bu'i phreng mdzes las/ dug gsum gyis myos bdud sde'i bar chad rnams/ /mthu ldan bstan srung tshogs kyis zhi byas nas/ /lung bstan rgya mtshos gsal bar dbugs dbyung ba/ /'khrul med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa la rigs smra ngang mo'i khyu dang lhan cig gsan sbyong brgal brtag gi dbu tshugs/ smi

da da dzi——batram̐/ḍirngiḍardamadzadababo rna 63nyer gnyis pa la 'dul ba 'bum sde'i mnga' bdag thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ nyer lnga pa la dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing du zhabs kyi padmo nye bar bkod de mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes chen du ma'i zhabs la gretugs/ sde snod dang rgyud sde smra ba mtha' dag dang brgal zhing brtags pa sogs kyis mang thos rgya mtsho'i pha mthar so na/so gnyis pa la slar yang mdo smad du chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur/so gsum pa la gdan sar bka' po ti lnga'i 'chad nyan mdzad cing rim gyis bstan pa'i srol sngar med gsar tshugayodang sngar yod gong 'phel gyi thabs mkhas bla na med pa mdzad/ so drug pa la dgon lung byamasapa gling dang / so brgyad pa la sku 'bum gyi gdan sa pa mdzad de gnyis ka'ang lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas gong 'phel du mdzad/ zhe gnyis par shar phyogs gser gyi rgyal khab chen por byon nas lcang skya rdo rje 'chang la rim lnga gsal sgron sogs dang / dkyil 'khor rgya mitsho'i mnga' bdag mtshan sgrogs mkhan chen la mi tra brgya rtsali dbang sogs gsan zhing zhar la tsho chen zhe dgu'isar 'khod pa'i skye bo phal cher gsung gi bdud rtsis smin par mdzad/ zhe lnga ba la mdo smad du byon zhing de nas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du mdo smad lho byang gi yul gru thams cad zhabs kyis bcags te dge 'dun gyi sde dang sngags kyi bshad sgrub sa khyab tu spel/ nga brgyad pa la yang bskyar dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du byon nas dge 'dun gyi sde rnams rnyed

54 rgorna — — —ge — —zhi ba — — mi rdod — dzi — /——— —pa dang bkur stis tshims par ma chod/ dam pa'i chos kyi rgyun nub pa dang nyag phra ba rnams kyang slar gsos/ sngar ma gsan pa'i chos kyi rgyun du ma yang gsar du btsal te drug cu pa me lug la mdo smad du byon nas pal cher gdan sa rang du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher skor (bskor)zhing byams sku mthong ba don ldan rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bzhengs mdzad/re gnyis pa la bya khyung theg chen bshad sgrub gling du chos rje don grub rin chen gyi gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa skyong bzhin par re bzhi ba lcags phag gi lo hor zla bcu pa'i mar ngo'i nyer brgyad la ka mdo bkra shis chos rdzong du dag pa'i zhing du dgongs pa gtad pa yin la/ de lta bu'i sku tshe stod smad kyi mdzad pa thams cad kyang ji skad du/ rgyal ba 'brom gyi gsung las/ nga thos pa'i dus na bsam sgom gnyis ka bdo/ /nga bsgom pa'i dus na thos bsam gnyis ka bdo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bshad sgrub zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde rdzogs ldan du sgyur bar byed pa dang / mdzad pa'i zur re res kyang lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab par dpon nus pas zhib tu bkral na mkhas pa dga' ba skyed pa'i gtam rgya cher spro bar nus mod kyang tshig tshogs mang bas 'jigs te phyogs tsam zhig mdor bsdus te 'god na/de yang rje 'di nyid sku'i na tshod phra mo'i dus nas sku tshe sngon ma rnams su sbyangs pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bsdus pa'i lungabyugi yon tan dang / bslab gsum rim gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'gog med du mngon du gyur pa ni kun la mthun grub kyi rnag

— —dgon — — — go— shakai ba — ma da — — —mi —rdo / 55par thar pa yin te/ 'chad pa'i yon tan gyi dbang du byas na dgung lo bcu drug par gdan sar phebs pa'i nyin phyogs nas 'ongs pa dang gnyug mar gnas pa'i gdul bya nyis stong du nye ba la lam rim chen mo'i dbu nas chos thun gcig bstsal pas dad pa dang mi dad pa'i skye bo der 'tshogs kun gyi yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog par byas thing / de'i phyi lo cho 'phrul smon lam gyi gsung chos la skyes rabs so bzhi pa dang spyod 'jug gnyis la gsung bshad nam mkha' ltar rgya che ba bstsal te mkhas pa'i mdun sar lung rigs la sbyangs pa'i mang thos rgan po rnams kyang som nyi'i yul du gyur pa'i dka' ba'i gnad mtha' dag lhug par bkrol bas gzur gnas blo yi mig can mtha' dag gi yid kyi chu mtshor dad pa'i 'dab stong rgyas par gyur pa ni de rdus gsung gi bdud rtsi myang ba'i skye bo kun gyi mig gi yul du gyur to/ /de ltar yang / 'jam dbyangs gzhon nus mngon sum byin brlab cing (brlabs shing)/ /skyes thob blo gros lus rtsal rab rdzogs pas/ /rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /smra ngan dpung bcom blo gsal dga' ba bskyed/ /ces so/ /rtsod pa'i yon tan gyi dbang du byas na gdan sar phebs pa'i nyin mkhas dbang ngag dbang 'phrin las dang tshar tsha shes rab rdo rje sogs kyis bzhugs gral nas bgro gleng mdzad pa na sngar mtshan nyid kyi rtsod pa ma gnang yang so so'i brgal zhing brtag pa'i rigs pa'i 'gros thams cad legs par thugs su chud tshul sogs phyis dgung lo mtho ba'i skabs su gsungs pa dngos su thos shing / bkra shis 'khyil du mtshan nyid gsan

/de 5—6 — da rgo—na— ba rda 'deb mdzid ba mami rnam —da da wa sbyong gsar du tshugs pa'i nyin bgro gleng la bzhengs nas rnam 'grel gyi rigs pa'i gnad mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa la bsdus grwa zhes grags tshul/ de yang gzhon nu la klog slob pa ltar kha dog dkar dmar sogs sla rim nas slob dgos tshul/ de yang chos kyi dung 'bud pa dang chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa sogs kyi rten 'brel gyi ched du brtsi bzhag gi thog mar chos dung dkar po'i kha dog rtsod gzhir bzung ba yin tshul sogs kyi gsung bshad gzhung 'god lta bur gnang nas bgro gleng mdzad pas der 'khod mtha' dag ngo mtshar bar gyur ces mtshan nyid zhabs phyi ba rnams las dngos su thos/ phyis phar phyin gyi brgal brtag mdzad pa'i skabs su rigs pa'i seng chen blo bzang gnas brtan pa sogs kyang gdan drangs nas rtsod pa gnang bar/ rigs lung zhabs phyi thams cad phyogs gcig tu byas nas brtsad kyang / dge bshes gnas brtan pa 'di ba'i rtsod zla mi yong na yang / rje 'dis rtsod rigs kyis zil gyis gnon pa yin snang ste/ lan gcig dge bshes pas bde ba can gyi lha mi'i khyad mig 'dzum tshul gyis bzhag par rje 'dis lha'i mig gi mngon shes thob pa thams cad skyon du 'phangs nas brtsad pas dge bshes pa ngag bcad la gnas dgos byung ba dang / yang dag mtha'i rtsod pa gnang ba'i skabs shig rgyan snang gi rtsod lan mdo rgyan gang la yin tshul gyi steng nas dge bshes pa de dang nyin gsum gyi bar rtsod pa gnang bas der 'tshogs phal cher gyi blo yul las 'das shing thams cad kyang the tshom gyis 'phyang mo nyug tu gyur ces rigs pa'i dbang phyug dpon slob blo bzang sbyin pa'i zhal nas dngos su thos so//

da da rgon pa pyag mazhibs dzid ba dzi rnam— — ṇang wa rtsom pa'i yon tan ni/ dgung lo brgyad pa'i dus su brtsams pa'i chos rgyal gyi bstod pa dang / bcu gnyis pa'i dus su gnang ba'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi bstod pa dang / bcu drug pa'i dus su gnang ba'i 'jam rīdakar gyi bstod pa dang / dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa ma li ka'i phreng mdzes/ rje rin po che'i bstod pa ngang ba'i bu moli'aphang (phang)'gro'i sgra dbyangs sogs la mkhas pas brtags na shes par 'gyur ro/ / rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi dbang du byas na/ lam thun mong ba nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems yang dag pa'i lta ba rnams rang 'khrungs sayod tshul sku gzhon nu lidus su gnang ba'i mgur skal ldan yid bskul tsam la bltas na yang shes rab can gyis dpog nus la/ rim gnyis kyi rtogasapa yang sku tshe snga mar thob pa'i yonacitan thams cad ma nyams par lhan skyes su yod pa yin snang ste/ grwa slob sgros (bgres)pa 'ga' zhig gis rje nyid la gzhan gyis mthu byad kyi sbyor ba rtsom shasache bas dmigastse bsal gyi mthu bzlog gnang dgos tshul nan zhus byas par/ sku gong mas ya ma rā dza dung phyur bton pa des nga la mi phan pa e red ces gsungs pa dang / rgya nag nas phebs skabs su yang 'ga' zhig gis lba ba dgu brtsegs kyi lo rgyus ltar deng sang rgya 'dre 'jug shas che bas dpe gzigs sogs bzhag nas zhal 'don gtso bor mdzad dgos zhus par/ skrag mi dgos spol gnas pa'i byang sems tsho la gling bzhi yang dbang ba red ces gsungs pa ni/ sa thob phyin chad rtogs pa nyams pa mi srid pa mi shes sam zhes pa'i gsung du go sku'i dpyad pa la yang / sku rked la stag sham gyi ri mo bkra

5skye lhaka —ṣa—ṣa———sha— 3——ma rna lam me 'khor mar yod pa bdud rtsi chab tshan sogs kyi phyag g.yog zhus pa'i nye gnas du ma dang / sku gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bur phran gyis kyang mjal kha zhus te mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa'i skal bzang thob la/ de ni rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor pa'i rtags su tshad ldan gyi gzhung du ma las 'byung ngo / /des na lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / sngon rabs skyes pa'i phreng bar yongs goms pa'i/ /dam pa'i rang rtags lung rtogs yon tan tshogs/ /gcig char mngon du gyur pa'i dpal mnga' ba/ /dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bor gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes bsngagasa'ipa dang / gsol 'debs shel dkar nor bu'i phreng mdzes las kyang /mkhas btsun bzang bo'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing / /rnam dag spyod pa'i 'od stong spro bzhin du/ /shar tshe zog rdzuligadol phrug me khyer dag/ri mo'i gnas su bkod la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pa gnyis rang bzhin brjod pa kho na yin no/ /de lta na yang rje nyid kyi gsung las/rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'jings bzang ma brgal na/ /rnam grol rin chen gling du mi phyin zhis/ /tshul der 'bad pas sbyong mdzad lnga rig pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rjes 'jug gi nyams len la dgongs nas thos bsam sgom gsum dang 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang sngon byon dam pa yongs kyi rnam thar phyag len la thebs par mdzad pa yin te/ de la thog mar klog pa thos bsamakhagyi sgo nasangabastan pa'i bya ba mdzad tshul la/ mtshan nyid kyi gsan sbyong mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ dang por rigs lam phra zhing zhib par smra ba'i mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa zhig tu bka' pota chen po lnga la mkhas par

dgozi pa dzi sha—1diḍoḍirda —ṣa—zitsho 6byesbyangs pa zhig med du mi rung bas bkra shis 'khyil rang du chos grwar phebs bzhed kyi bka' gnang bar/ sde khri rin po ches rigs pa smra ba'i blo gsal bzang bsgrigs kyi chos ra bla brang du tshugs na legs tshul gyi 'char ston phul bar brten dgung lo bcu bdun pa shing byi'i lo hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin rigs pa'i sgo 'byed bsdus grwa'i gsan sbyong thog mar tshugs/ bsdus tshan nyer lnga yongs rdzogs thugs 'dzin da nga /bsdus grwa mi 'dra ba du ma la gzigs rtog rigs pa smra ba rnams dang lhan du brgal brtag sogs mdzad pas tshad ma'i gzhung nas 'byung ba'i rigs pa bzang pos thugs 'phrogs par gyur/ phyis dgung lo shin tu mtho ba'i skabs su yang rtsod pa bdar sha gcod pa dang / rtsod pa rno zhing gtsang ba la bsdus grwalirigs pa 'di med mi rung yin gsungs nasabasdus grwa ba rnams sku mdun du 'dzin grwa gtugs nas rtsod pa byed bcug pa dang /rwa stod ltar bsdus grwa ba rnams kyis chos mtshams skabs su tshogs gleng byed srol dang / ser byes ltar brtsi bzhag dge bshes bskos nas chos mtshams la bsdus grwa ba rnams la brtsi bzhag thugs thog nas gnang srol dang / de yang 'dzin grwa so sor rwa stod bsdus grwa btsan po'ibasdus grwa sogs bsdus grwa mi 'dra ba du ma brtsi bzhag la gtong 'jug pa sodas bsdus grwa'i rtsod pa gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i thabs tshul mang du gnang / zhal nas kyang khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis pa de nyid kyis bsdus grwalirigs pa la thugs shin tu dgyes shing bsngags brjod cher gnang bas khong gi slob ma dge bshes bgres pa rnams mtshan nyid kyi rtsod pa bzang

60 sprarjib dgeb dzadage —— skyage ——ba'i tshad sha stag yin/ khri chen de nyid kyis bsdus grwa'i rtsod pa 'di sgrib sbyong gi yang mchog yin/ rnam mkhyen 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po yin pas drug sgra brtsi ba sogs kyi skabs su rnam mkhyen zhes re re brjod pas kyang bskal ba mang po'i sdig sgrib 'dag pa mtshan brjod pa las kyang lhag ces gsungs pa red gsungs/ yig cha'i blo rtags gnyis thugs 'dzin dang / mdo dang sde bdun rtsa 'grel la zhib gzigs dang / dka' ba'i gnad la brgal zhing brtags pa zhib tu mdzad pas rigs pa'i dbang phyug gnyis kyi bzhed srol lhag ma med par thugs su chud/ zhal nas sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rang don le'u dang gzhan don le'u gnyis kyi gnad mtha' dag zur du bkol ba rtags rigs dang / tshad ma grub pa'i le'u dang / mngon sum le'uligand zur du bkol ba la blo rig ces btags pa 'di rnam 'grel la 'jug pa'i we mig lta bu med mi rung yin/ skye ba snga phyi sgrub pa sogs rnam 'grel nas 'byung ba'i rigs pa 'di dag gis mkhas pa'i yid dbang med du 'phrog pa'i gnad kyis rje rin po ches kyang 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ges mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel rigs mdzod la gzigs nas spyan chab yang yang shor ba yin gsungs/rnam 'grel gyi 'chad nyan rkang tshugs pa zhig 'dzugs rtsis nan tan mdzad kyang rten 'brel ma 'dzoms pa'i dbang gis rang btsan du lus/ 'on kyang khri rin po che bsod nams dbang rgyal ba la bka' babs te blo rig gi dka' gnad kyi mtha' dpyod khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis pas mdzad pa de nyid srod chos la gnang zhing / khri rin po che rab brtan rgya mtsho pam

dargod ba ga 'anebs ma da ba tho'i rnam rna/ 61bsdus grwa lo re bzhin rdzogs pa'i mjug tu rtags rigs kyi zur 'debag dmar ser thun mtshams ma brtsi bzhag la btang / grwa ba gling bsresdzaskabs su rnam 'grel gyi gzhung phal cher la bshad pa dang brgal brtag byed srol gsang phu ltar tshugs te blo dang ldan zhing don du gnyer na dpyod pa'i sgo rnyed pa'i thabs tshul rmad du byung ba gnang / phar phyin la gsan sbyong mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ 'grel ba don gsal thugs 'dzin dgabargya skyor mang po/ yig cha'i thal 'phreng zur bkol bzhi bcas thugs 'dzin gnang ste bkra shis 'khyil dang dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gnyis kar brgal brtag phra zhing zhib pa dang / 'phags bod kyi yig cha mtha' dag la zhib tu gzigs te rigs pa bzhi'i sgo nas legs par dpyad pas rgyal ba mi pham pa'i dgongs don 'phags seng gnyis kyis ji ltar bkral ba ltar legs — par thugs su chud de/ de la yang rje yab sras kyi gzhung gi rjes su 'brang ba'i spyi don dang thal phreng gi yig cha ji snyed cig yod pa'i nang nas kun mkhyen mchog gi gsung 'di rnams 'gran zla med pa yin rung tshig tshogs ha cang che bas blo dman rnams kyis 'chun dka' bar dgongs nas skabs dang po dang brgyad pa gnyis kyi tshig sna bstung zhing ( bstungs shing)skabs bzhi ba'i rname pa'i skor zur du bkol ba dang / sa lam rnam bzhag grub mtha' rin chen 'phreng ba/ bsam gzugs chen mo mdor bsdus te legs bshad bum bzang mdzad pa dang / rten 'brel dang kun gzhilimatha' dpyod sogs ljags rtsom mdzad/ zhal nas kyang / bu ston rin po che sogs sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi sku ring la phar phyin kham lugs 'ablom

62 dadzi———/————ma da ba4rnarnam ra lugs sogayol bshad srol mi 'dra ba mang na yang / deng sang bshad srol shes pa phar zhog yig cha mthong ba yang dkon par snang zhes bugs skyo ba'i gsung byon pa dngos su thos so/ / dbu ma'i gzhung la gsan sbyong mdzad tshul ni/ yig cha'i dbu ma yongs rdzogs thugs 'dzin thog dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar brgal brtag dang / khyad par lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa bod du phebs dus dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod kyi steng nas dgongs pa/rab gsal gyi dka' gnad mtha' dag zhib khrid mdzad pas klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs don rgyal ba gnyis pas ji ltar bkral ba bzhin thugs su chud/ de'i dbang gis rje bdag nyid po'i rjes 'brang gi yig cha phal cher 'a kyang yig cha 'di khyad par du 'phags par gzigs nas yig cha'i tshig sna bsnangs te don gyi gnad tshang zhing 'dzin skyor bde ba'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba 'di nyid bka' rtsom mdzad pa yin snang ste/ dbu ma lung rigs sgron me'i mjug tu/ blo bzang rgyal ba'i dgongs don gzhir bzung nas/ /mkhas pas spel pa'i rgyas bsdus gzhung mang yang / /dka' gnad sgo brgya 'byed la kun mkhyen gyi/ /gsung 'di legs bshad lde mig yin nam snyam/ /legs par bshad pa gang 'dis mig phye ste/ /yab sras gzhung la zhib tu dpyad pa na/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i dgongs bzhed thal 'gyur gyi/ /lugs bzang khyad par ma 'dres mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rke 'dul mdzod la gsan sbyong mdzad tshul ni/ grwa sar slob gnyer gyi

ge dargond ga3sdorjoX—rwad ma spyod 63lugs ltar sbyang ba ma mdzad kyang dbus nas mdo smad du phebs pa nas bzung ste re zhig gi bar du bkra shis 'khyil dang sku 'bum sogs gar bzhugs de ka'i dge bshes rnams sku mdun du bos nas 'dul mdzod kyi rtsod pa byed 'jug pa gnang zhing / phyis su dgung lo drug cur nye ba'i skabs su yang thang ring nas smra ba'i dbang phyug rgya seṅge sbyan drangs te zla ba mang po'i bar du dam pa'i chos kyi gsung gleng 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad pa mngon sum gyi yul du gyur cing / de skabs phal cher 'dul mdzod kyi gsung 'phros kho na mdzad par 'dug ces thos te shin tu dad par bya ba'i gnas so/ /gsang sngags la gsan spyong mdzad tshul ni/ deng dus rgyud sde gong 'og thams cad kyi bshad srol cha tshang bar mi bzhugs na yang / dbang rgyun phal cher ma nub par bzhugs pa rgyud kyi bshad sgrub kyi rmang bla na med par dgongs nas/ mi tra brgya rtsa/ rdo rje phreng ba/ 'dus pa 'phags lugs dang ye shes zhabs lugs/ bde mchog tso nag dril gsum/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ dus 'khor/ kun rig rdor dbyings/ dpal mchog rtse mo/ sbyong rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis sogs spyi bka' dang zur bka'i dbang gi rigs rgyun gang yod gsan te grangs bsnyen sogs rang rang gi gzhung ltar legs par gtong ba gnang zhing / de nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs/ /khrid chen brgyad/ man ngag gsum sogs khrid kyi rigs mtha' dag gsang 'dus kyi bskyed rdzogs mo gnyis dang 'grel ba bzhi sprags/ bde

64 dargo ga mazhibs ma da dzo rna /mchog myud 'gril sbas don kun gsal/ 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs chen mo/ dus kyi 'khor loli'agrel chen dri med 'od kyi bshad lung sogs zhib par gsan zhing 'gran zla med pa'i yongs 'dzin mkhas pa mtha' dag la dri gtugs dang bcas yang yang gtan la phab pas rgyud sde mtha' dag gi dgongs don la 'phyug med kyi gzer thebs par gyur/ de'i gnad kyis rjes gnang re tsam gnang ba la yang sla chos gtan nas mi mdzad par/ sgrub gzhi bkram tshul/ mchod pa bayams tshul yan chad kyang rang rang gi gzhung dang rgyud sde'i bshad tshod ltar las cung zad kyang mi 'da' zhing / skabs su gang babs kyi dmigs rnam brda sprod pa dang / phyag len so sor dgag bzhag lungajirigs kyis brgyan pa kho na ma gtogs/ da res gzhung dang mi mthun pa'i sla chos shig mdzad song ngam snyam pa su gang la yang skye ba'i go skabs med do/ /zhal nas kyang sku phyogs lnga pa chen pos mtshan nyid pa tsho sngags la rigs 'gre byed gsungs nas bka' bkyon yang yang —mdzad pa bstan pa'i dag ther yin/ khri nam mkha' bzang dang /mkha' chen rdo rje 'chang sogs tha na bum pa'icakha rgyan 'jog lugs dang srad bu dkri lugs yan chad kyang gang zhib gnang ba de 'dra zhig dgos / bdag gis kyang bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin dang / rang gis dpe cha le bltas/ shes tshod kyis lag len gang zhib byas pa yin zhes gsungs shing sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes ga nang skabs/ rjes gnang zhig la cung zad nor ba byung bas des rjesajiganang gi go mi chod gsungs nas yang bskyar bskur ba mdzad de bdag lta bu 'di'i dod 'dis pher zer ba ske— —

da wa rgo—nad —ga ma— rdarda rdasdo dapha ma 65rnams thabs kyis 'dul bar mngon no/ /rig gnasal sbyangs pa mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ sku na phra ba'i dus stong 'khor bsod nams rgya mtsho'i drung du bzhugs/ skabs sum rtags dang dag yig sogs sbyangs pa mdzad cing / phyis su mkhas dbang dbyig kya rab 'byams pa ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs dang / rong bo chos rje ngag dbang rgya mtsho las sgra mdo dbyangs can ma dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor bcas zhib slob dang / si tu paṇa chen karma gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba la tha snyad rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa'i slob dpon zhig zhus pa ltar khong gi dbon po gtsug lag pa kun dga' sangs rgyas mngags pa'i drung du ka tsan gnyis dang / skar rtsis legs par sbyangs te rig gnas smra ba yongs kyi gtsug na snyan pa'i ba dan mngon par btsugs pa bzhin du gyur tshul rnam thar rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs su gsal ba ltar ro/ /gsung rab spyi la thos bsam mdzad tshul ni/ rgyal ba'i dbang po blo bzang skal bzang rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes/ skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje/ bstan pa'i srog shing rje ngag dbang byams pa/ grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i mthar son mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho sogs sku tshe'i stod smad la yongs 'dzin mkhas pa bzhi bcu tsam bsten nas mdo rgyud bstan bcos du malibashad bka'/ rgyud sde gong 'og thams cad kyi dbang dang rjes gnang man ngag solas gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir mkhas grub tshad ldan rim par brgyud pa'i thub bstan rnam dag gi rgyun gang yod thams cad ma lus par

cha dargo ga gib da spe ge/gsan/ de yang gsan pa tsam la ma bzhag par de dag so sor rgya bod kyi mkhasapa so so'i yig cha gang yod thams cad zhib tu gzigs pas tha na tha snyad phran bu zhig gi don 'chad pa'i tshe yang 'di rje yab sras kyis 'di ltar bshad ces pa'am/ rje yab sras kyi gzhung nas mi 'byung yang mkhas pa 'di dang 'dis 'di ltar bshad ces pa lta bu dang / dbang rjes gnang zhig gnang skabs su yang sa lugs pa dag gis 'di ltar bshad kyang rje rin po ches 'diltar gsungs zhes pa'am/ sgrub thabs phran bu zhig gi lung gnang na yang lha 'di'i sgrub thabs grub mtha' so solidam pa ris med kyis mdzad pa 'di snyed cig yod ces gsungs pa sogs gsung gi zur re res kyang mang thos mkha' ltar yangs pa dpog nus pa ni shin tu mang ste brir mi lang ngo / /de yang bla ma ji snyed cig bsten pa thams cad la skyon rtog dang ma gus pa lta ci mtshan nas rjen par mi brjod pa dang / bla malidrung du che tshugs dang 'gying bag mi mdzad par bkur sti bla na med pa'i sgo nas bsten tshul gsung rab nas bshad pa bzhin mdzad pa yin te bla ma byams pa rin po ches dgos med du bka' bkyon mang po mdzad kyang zhal 'gyur ba tsam yang yoganang bas thugs mnyes pa'i yang rtse byung bas phyis su bslab bya gnang ba'i mgor/ rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa la/ /'jam dbyangs dang mtshungs mkhyen pa can/ /khyod kyi rnam dpyod me long ngos/ma shar shes bya ci zhig mchis/ /zhes dang / mjug tu yang gzhal bya'i gnas la chags thogs mi mnga' ba'i/ /khyod thugs 'chi med lha lam yangs pa la/ /bdag blo sprang bu'i gshog rgyangs (brgyangs)'dis ci bya//

sgrun tram̐dzidzaXst+rasdo1padzi rna 67'on kyang rang blos nus bzhin brjod pa yin/ /zhes bsngags brjod mdzad/ de bzhin du/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dang lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi sku mdun du zhabs phyi nang bcar lta bu'i tshul gyis phyag g.yog gang dgos zhu bar rgyus yod kyi rigs mgrin gcig tu gleng / rgyal dbang gong ma sku bsnyun skabs thig rgyal ba nyid kyi zhal nas/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa tshang 'dir thongs dang nga'i gnyid dgrog dgos zhes phebs pa ltar rje 'di phebs nas yab sras gnyis kyis rtsom pa'i rtsal 'gran pa lta bulitshul gyis nyin mang por snyan ngag gi phreng ba spel te gzims bsang tshul mdzad cing de'i zhar la bsnyung g.yog gang dgos kyang zhus pa dang / gsol 'debs dad pa'i 'khri shing 'di yang de dus mdzad par khri chen bsod nams grags pa'i zhal nas dngos su gsungs/ dus rgyun du yang phyag dpe zhu dag gi phyag g.yog nar ma lta bu mdzad par thos/ des mtshon bsten tshul ma nor ba'i dbang gis bla ma thams cad dang thugs yid gcig 'dres kho nar gyur pa las bla ma 'di zhes bya ba dang sel cung zad zhugs sam snyam pa'i the tshom tsam yang skyon brtag nas btsal na yang rnyed pa'i go skabs ga la yod/ zhal nas kyang ngas tshe 'dir chos ldan gyi bya ba gang byas lam du 'gro ba ni bla ma tshul bzhin bsten pa kho na'i mthu yin zhes gsungs pa dngos su thos so/ /thugs dam gyi gtso bo dpe gzigs kho na gtso bor mdzad cing / tha na phebs bzhud sogs kyi tshe phebs byams nang nas dpe gzigs gnang zhing / chibs thog nas phebs skabs su yang tsha 'bog yan chad kyi skabs

68 dgin ṣa— gang — mdzad rna —da wa sadape gzigs gnang bas phyag dpe po ti khri phrag brgal bar yod pa de dag thams cad rgyang ring bo nas thum dang bcas te gzigs 'bul zhus na yang 'chug pa med par brda sprod pa zhabs 'brang du 'khod pa kun gyis mngon sum du grub pa yin te/ mkhas pa dang grub pa'i mtshan gyi snyems ba dang 'gying bag che yang tshig bzhi ba gcig gi don zhus na dpral ba'i dbyings nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun rtsol med du 'bab par ma zad/ pota chung gcig phyag tu phul na yang ri rgyal gyis non pa lta bur 'gro ba'i chen po rnams kyis 'gran du med pa'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /zhal nas kyang sngon dus mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis bla ma dam pa bsten nas de'i drung du mdo rgyud thams cad kyi bshad pa gsan gyin thugs gnyer gnang ba red/ da lta mdo rgyud phal cher gyi bshad rgyun yang nub/ ma nub pa rnams kyang tshul bzhin du 'chad shes pa yang dkon pa'i du sa 'dir sngon gyi mkhas pa de dag rang rang dang dngos su mjal na yang de las lhag pa gsungs ( gsung)rgyu med pa'i zhal chems yi ger bris pa lta bu'i legs bshad 'di dag la yang yang bltas nas rgyal ba'i dgongasapa 'tshol ba 'di de'i dod yin pas shin tu gal che/ rje bdag nyid chen pos rim lnga gsal sgron gyi bar skabs tshigs bcad du/ sa 'di mkhas grub brgya stong gi /rin chen khur 'dzin pa'i tshe/ /'bad pas mkhas pa de dag gi /spyan sngar so solilegs bayad len/ /du sa kyi dbang gis de nyams tshe/ /de dag so sorithugayokyi bcud/ /yi ger bris pa'i gzhung bzang rnams/ bla mdziman ngag la brten nas/ /legs par brtags nas len pa 'di/ /

— dargonab rgumanebasaziṣa sga rna 69de yi dod du mkhas pas shes/ /des ni yang dag ltar snang gi /lam gyi dbye ba ji bzhin phyed/ /ces gsungs pa 'di ra6 re tshorsā lag len la thebs shing phan che ba'i snying gtam zhal gdams su bstsal pa yin pas snying la 'chang dgos zhes gsungs pa dngos su thos so/ / dus rgyun du nyin mtshan gnyis kar dpe gzigs kyis 'da' bar mdzad pas rje nyid kyi khu bo chos rje ngag dbang dpal 'byor gyis zhal 'don mdzad dgos tshul yang yang nan gyis zhus par zhal nas/ phreng ba 'dzin pa'i grub thob lug rdzi la yang yod/ ngas phreng ba ma bzung bar grub thob cig byed snyam pa yin zhes gsungs pa ni/ sngon rje gong mas nye gnas sngags rams pa dpal 'bar la ngas chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong yi ge na gcig gi nang du bsdus nas 'chad dgos na yang 'chad shes/ de las lhag pa'i grub rtags ci dgos gsungs pa ltar shes bya thams cad la chags thogs med pa'i ye shes la mnga' brnyes pa'i stobs kyis bdud bzhi phra rags las rnam par rgyal ba ni grub thob kyi mchog tu 'doms pa'i gsung du shes so/ /de dag kyang gzigs pa tsam dang dpyad pa phyogs 'gro tsam gyis tshim sla ba min par rigs pa bzhi'i sgo nas dpyad pa rgyun du mdzad pa yin snang ste zhal nas khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal 'jog tshul 'di ha cang blo la 'char bde ba zhig ma byung bas zi ling mkhar nas bkra shis 'khyil du ma bslebs kyi bar zhag bdun gyi ring la bsam blo btang ba yin zhes cho 'phrul gyi gsung chos shig gi skabs su gsungs pa dngos su thos so/ / —

7tu ge zhi mdzid pa me rna dzo ji ltar dpyad nas nges pa rnyed pa'i don de yang 'phral du rgyang bamyur byas te brjed ngas kyi dbang du gtong ba de 'dra ma yin par dran 'dzin dam po mdzad pas gzhung ci 'dra zhig yin kyang thugs 'dzin mdzad phyin chad bsnyel ba med pa ni drung du yun ring bcitud pa rnams kyi ngag nas thos shing / /khyad par 'bras spungs dge 'phel rdu 'jam dbyangs dkar polib snyen sgrub mdzad pas zhal mngon sum du gzigs phyin chad gang dngha gzigs pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad kyi tshig don mi brjed par thugs la bzhugasapasagasung rab thams cad skyu ru ra lag mthil du gnas pa ltar 'dod dgur dbang bsgyur ba zhigabyung ba yin snang ste/ ngag gi dbang rgyug 'jam dbyangs dkar po yis/ /mngon sum rjes bzung mkhyen pa'i klong brdol zhing / /tshig don mtha' dag mi brjed gzungs thob pas/mdo rgyud man ngag kun gyi gter du gyur/ /ces so/ /zhalanas kyang mi ba rjed pa'i gzungs sgrub pa la 'jam dbyangs dkar po 'di byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che / nga yang brjed ngasdo chung ba bzlas pa dum tsam byas pa'i thugs rje yin zhes gsungs pa thos so/ /de ltar skyes pas thob pa'i blo gros kyi mthu rmad du byung bar ma zad sku tshe 'dir ngas thos bsam gnad du 'gro ba sngon gyi dam pa'i rnam thar phyag len la btab pa dang / lha dang bla mas mngon sum du rjes su bzung ba'i mthu las gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba'i mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa yin snang ste/ zhal nas ngalirmi lam du rje bdag nyid po byon nas sbyi bo mgrin pa rnying ka gsum du reg pa'i brda' zhig mdzad par/ bdag gis lus ngag yid gsum rgyal ba'i

— dgon ba —kau kairjo—rdartekarwasdomarna 71dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i spyod pa la gnas dgos pa'i brdar zho song zhes rgyu mtshan rgyas par bkrol nas ga/sungs pa rnam thar rgyal sras rgya mtshori 'jug ngogs su yang gsal ba ltar ro/ / lar nyams len byin rlabs rgyud kyi byin gyis brlabs tshul la 'di 'dra'i rigs shin tu mang zhing / te lo nā ro sogs kyis brda' tsam la brten nas dbang gi ye shes ngo 'phrod pa so gas dang mtshungs pa'i rnam thar dang / de yang rtogs pa phyogs re tsam ma yin par rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang mthun pa'i rtogs pas rgyud grol ba'i rnam thar du shes’par gyis/ de ltar gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar ba'i stobs kyis 'chad pa'i tshe gzhung che chung ci 'dra zhig 'chad kyang yi ge na gcig kyang the tshom gyis 'chad pa dang btang snyoms su 'dor rgyu med par bshad pa zhib mo ra 'gro bas ma bayad pa'i skyon dang bral/ gang gsungs pa thams cad gzhung chen rnams dang 'gal ba dang mi mthun pa ci tsam brtags kyang mi rnyed pas log par bshad pa'i skyon dang bral/ don dka' sla gang la yang bshad pa ha cang 'byams te gdul bya blo gros zhan pa rnams mgo rmongs pa yang med pas ha cang bshad pa'i skyon dang bral bar 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa'i tshe smra babazang bar grags pa su gang gi yid kyi dgu la yang mi 'char ba'i rigs pa snga ma las phyi ma nus pa je che dang / zhib cha je thon du 'gro ba dang / thal 'gyur re res kyang log rtog brgya phrag gzhom pa dang / rigs lam brgya phrag gi sgo 'byed pa rje nyid nas thal 'gyur lan kha shas 'phen pa gnang ba'i mjug tu gzhan su 'dra zhig gis blo gros

72 dargon ga mde da rna /kyi rtsal ci wad kyi sa 'phangs kyang gser dang ra gan bsres pa lta bur 'gro ba dang / rtsom pa'i tshe brjod bya chu skyes dang mdzes ma sogs las brtsams tshe nyams thon kyang zab don las brtsams pa'i tshe smra ba'i ro 'dzin gre phug gi khang bzang du g.yo med kyi bsam gtan la gan sa pa rnams dang mi 'dra bar brjod bya ci 'dra zhig lasabartsams kyang tshigarna bar snyan pa/ don yid la 'bab pa/ sdebagyisbyor brjod bde ba sogs snyan ngag gi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs shing skyon phra mo tsam yang med pa sogs gzu bor gnas pa'i blo ldan dag gi mngon sum gyi yul du gyur pa 'di'o/ /de yang zhal nas/'chad pa la 'chad rgyu'i don de rang gis dogs pa chod pa zhig dang / de yang gnas skabs der blo la nges pa dang blo dang 'tshams ('tsham )par smra shes pa zhig dgos pas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi nang nas 'chad pa dka'/ rtsod pa pha rol po'i blo dang bstun chog pas de las cung zad sla/ rtsom pa dpe cha la bltas rpāsam blo btang nas rim gyis byas chog pas de las sla gsungs te nang byan chud pa'i gsung du snang ngo / / — de dag ni klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul yin la/ spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang du byas na/ de yang bslab gsum rim gnyis sogs kyi yon tan thams cad pha rol tu phyin pa drug tu 'du bas na/ phar phyin drug ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gang la bslab par bya ba'i gnas kyi sdom du gsungs so/ / des na 'dir yang phar phyin drug gi nyams bzhes ji ltar mdzad pa'i

dargorda sha ——ga 'akairjorwa—/tshobo rnam / 7 3tshul brjod na/ de yang sbyin pa la chos dang zang zing dang mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa ste gsum yod pa'i nang nas chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ shar za 'og thags su 'thag pa'i yul gru nas nub dzā ti'i nags tshal 'khrigs pa'i yul gyi bar nas skal ldan gyi slob ma sprin 'dus pa lta bur byung ba la dbang lung man ngag bshad bka' khrid bka' sogs gang la gang 'tsham gyi chos char rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / blo rab 'bring tha gsum dang bstun nas 'bel gtam gleng mo'i tshul dang / 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya tshun chad kyi sgo nas ris med pa'i skye bo thams cad legs lam la sbyor zhing / tha na tha/ser zangs shing lcags kyi bzo tshun chad slob bcug ste/ de yang tshogs sog ( gsog )pa'i yan lag tu bsgyur bar mdzad/ de yang rang gi rnyed bkur dang grags pa sogs la blta ba ma yin par gzhan don kho nar dgongs pa'i shugs kyis thag nye ring gi skye bo su 'dra zhig la yon tan gyi rnam pa 'di lta bu yod ces pa'i gtam snyan du son pa tsam la yang thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i sgo nas de dang de la dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas yon tan gong 'phel la sbyor ba'i thabs tshul kho na mdzad pa yin no / / zang zing gi sbyin pa ni/ mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi yul phyogs gang dang gang du zhabs kyis bcags pa dang bzhugs pa der/ chos sde che chung rnams su dge 'dun la mang 'gyed/ sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa/gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa sogs kyi phyag rjes rlabs che zhing / drung du btud pa'i skye bo chos kyi yon tad can dang / yul phyogs la phan pasgrusgrub nus pa'i chos srid 'dzin pa thams cad la babs(bab)'os kyi gnang chas

74 dargo ga' byesam da ba—thamarna /tshims par mdzad de/ 'chad nyan dang dge bcu'i khrims sogs kyis yul phyogs bde skyid la 'god pa'i bslab bya gnang ba dang / slong ba'i skye bo rnams la rta nor zam ras bza' bca' sogs kyi sgo nas ngo cung zad kyang mi sdog par mdzad cing / de yang lan dang rnam smin la re ba lta zhog bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa'i mi bsrun pa dag gis log sgrub ji ltar byas kyang khros pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam yang mi mnga'o/ /mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa ni/ phyogs mtha' dag nas 'jigs pas nyen te skyabs 'tshol du 'ong ba ni sbrang ma padmo'i tshal du 'du ba lta bu yod la de dag thams cad brtse bas dbugs dbyung / 'jigs pas nyen pa las bskyabs/ chos dang zang zing gis bskyangs te 'di phyi'i bde ba la 'god pa ma gtogs skyob nus bzhin du yal bar 'dor ba'i kun slong gi rgyu ba tsam yang shes bya la mi srid pas rgyal po chen pos btson durtsobazung ste srog/ji dang yan lag dang mig sogs kyi chad pa 'bab nges la gser dngul gos dar sogs kyis phangs pa med par blus nas btson ra'i 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa ches shin tu mang la/ yul phyogs dang grong sde du ma 'khrugs nes skye bo brgya wag lhag tsam re gsod res byas te sus kyang sgrig ma thub pa'i g.yul 'khrug du ma chos dang zang zing gi gnang sbyin dang / bka' btsan brjid pa'i lung gisa'adum par mdzad pa dang / de bzhin du rgyal pho dang sde dpon gyi rigs che chung rdu ma'i ris nas longs spyod dang bza' mi bye bral dang 'u lag thu sa sogs kyi chad pa babs pa du ma 'jigs pa de dag las baspyobs pa dang / phyogs su rgyu 'grul byed pa dag la bko'

gin ga mneb dzid sdome rna ṭī6shog tshun chad kyi sgo nas dgra jag chom rkun dang sho gam gru btsas mi theg pa sogs kyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa bgrang gis mi lang ste/ mdor na yid la re ba cung zad dang bcas nagredrung du mjal ba thams cad kyis bdag la thugs 'dogs che bar byung snyam pa las don mthun gyi re 'khang cung zad kyang byed pa'i mthong thos tsam yang med de/ sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam thar ro tshotshul khrims kyi nyams bzhes la/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i dbang du byas na/so thar gyi pham lhag lta zhog gzhan gyis phul ba'i zang zing gi dngos po dkon mchog gi ched dang gzhan don kho nar 'chang ba ma gtogs 'dod sred dang rang don gyi re bas 'chang ba mi mdzad pas rang cag la 'byung shin tu nye ba'i yokhyad dang 'brel ba'i ltung ba phra mokhyitsam gyis gos pa'i go skabs med la/ tshul 'di ni ji skad du/ mdo dkon mchog sprin las/'di la byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i phung po ri rab tsam thob na yang len to/ /dngos po ran pa zhig thob na yang len to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de 'di ltar sems te sems can 'di dag ni ser sna can brkams pa 'dod pas bkol ba 'jungs pa yin te/ rgyu de dang rkyen de dang gzhi des chu'i phung po chen pos non pa bzhin du 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'byung ('bying )nub byed pa de dag la yun ring bor don dang phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro snyam ste/ de blangs nartswabadag gir mi byed chags pa'i sems mi bskyed do/ /gzhan du na sems can thams cad dang thun mong du sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dag la yang bya ba byed do/ /sems

hā6 da na —rji—zi——rwad dzimi ma can sdug bsngal ba rnams la yang phan par 'dod do/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po de yang gzengs bstod pa dang shin tu dga' bar byed do/ /zhes gsungs te byang chub sems dpa'i thabs mkhas rmad du byung ba de 'dras zin pa — la dgongs nas/ 'dul ba lung las kyang / dge slong sde snod gsum pa la gos pa na lnga brgya ri ba dang / kha zas ro brgya ba dang / khang ba brtsegs pa lnga brgya sogs kyang dbang bar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'on kyang de 'dra la snyad btags nas bag yangs su mi mdzad par ma zad tha na mthang gos zlum por ma bgos pa dang / brtseng ba dang 'jol ba sogs gos la brten pa dang / mchong ba dang brkyangs bskums kyis 'gro ba sogs 'gro ba'i nyes pa dang / stan la ma brtag par sdod pa sogs 'dug pa'i nyes pa dang / kham ha cang chung ba dang che ba sogs zas la brten pa'i nyes 0samatshon bslab byalinyes byas phra mo tsam gyis gos pa yang tshe gcig la drung du bcar ba rnams kyis ci tsam brtags na yang dran du med pa ste/ mdor na tshul khrims dang / cho ga dang / 'tsho ba dang / spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i brtul zhugs las cung zad kyang mi 'da' ba'i tshul la sus kyang bsnyon du med do/ /byang sems kyi sdom pa'i dbang du byas na/ rnyed bkur la chags pa'i sgo nas bdag bstod gzhan smod lta zhog sku'i che ba'i yon tan cung zad re drung du gleng ba yang dang du mi len pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang mgon med pa la ser snas chos nor mi ster ba phar zhog gzhan gyis ma bskul bar yang phongs pa mang po chos dang zang zing gi bde ba la 'god pa dang / shad sbyangs dab du

— — dgonab gage'adiḍa—smyo da babo rna 77mi len pa phar nog sku la bdo bar mi 'tshom pa'i skye bo ma rungs pa du ma bka' drin tshad med pas bskyangs pa sogs mdor na rtsa ltung brtsa brgyad dang nyes byas zhe drug gis gos pa phar zhog de dag gi gnyen por gyur pa'i rgyal sras kyi lag len las dang po ba'i rjes su yi rang tsam yang bya dka' ba mtha' yas pa zhig bsgrubs pa dang / de bzhin du ba/sang sngags kyi bslab bya'i dbang du byas na slob dpon smod pa'i rtsa ltung gis go sa pa phar zhog chos 'brel gsan tshad kyi bla ma thams cad la/ bla ma lnga bcu ba las 'byung ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi blang dor thams cad phyag len la thebs par mdzad pa kun gyi mngon sum gyi yul du gyur pa sogs shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar mdo rgyud tshang ma dpang du bzhag ste bshad par bya ba mang yang yi ges 'jigs so/ /de ltar theg pa gong 'og gi bslab pa'i rim pa mtha' dag gnang bkag gi cha la 'khrul ba cung zad kyang med par lag len du thebs par mdzad pas na sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod mtha' dag dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang / sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims su 'gyur ba las don med du 'da' ba cung zad kyang med pas na/ su gang la yang gcam bu dang kha gsag gi tshig brjod pa dang 'bad rtsol gyis bsgrubs pa med par mkho ba'i longs spyod char sprin ltar 'du ba dang / drag po'i las kyis bsdi gas pa med kyang skye bo kun ngang gis 'dud pa dang / dgra gnyen bar ma'i skye bo til gyi gang bu ltar 'tshogs kyang sku'i gzi brjid zil gyis mi non pa dang / zhabs kyis reg pa'i rdul dag kyang 'dris pa dang ma 'dris pa'i skye bo'i tshogs kyis mchod

78 dargo ga zhi da pa'i zhing du 'khyer ba sogs lugs gnyis kyis/ snyems pa'i 'gying bag can thams cad kyis cha tsam yang bsgrun du med pa'i rang bzhin gyi rgyan gyis mdzes par gyur pa la gang dag phrag dog gi mun pas yid yongs su tsho bsgribs pas log par 'dzin pa dag ni nyi 'od kyis 'ug pa'i mig la rang grib bskyed pa dang chos mtshungs pa nyid de/ ji skad du/ dpal ldan ma khol gyis/ tshig tu ma brjod tshegs su ma gyur kyang / /nyams su mkho ba'i longs spyod ngang gis 'du/ /bsdegs pa med par 'jig rten kun 'dud de/ /tshegs med ma bsgrubs dbang phyug thob par 'gyur/ /rkang bas bkra shis gyur pa'i rdul dag kyang / /spyi gtsug dam pas blangs shing lha dang mis/ /phyag 'tshal mgos gtugs thob pa kun tu 'khyer/ /de phyir tshul khrims dang ldan rigs mchog yin/ /zhes tshul khrims kyi dbang gis rgyal rigs zil gyis gnon par gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzod pa'i nyams len ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dang bden pa bzhisdzablang dor sogs/ dad ba dang mngon du bya ba dang blang dor bya ba'i yul thams cad la yul gyi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin du gzigs pa'i chos la nges sems kyi bzod pa dang / khyad par du dbu ma 'jug pa las/ bdag med mthong ba'i byang chub se mas dpa' la/ gang zhig gang gis gang tshe ji ltar gcod/ gang zhig chos kun de yis gzugs brnyan ltar/ /mthong ba des kyang de yis bzod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnod pa dang sdug bsngal gyi 'khor gsum bden med du gzigos pas mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i shugs kyis rjes thob tu yang

dgoṣab —rngi/tshoḍarjo tsho—1—rjo——/ di — ma /— 79'a jig rten chos brgyad sogs tha mal ba la yid bde mi bde dang dga' khro sogs kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i spros pa mtha' dag sgyu ma lta bur nges ba'i nges shes spyod lam kun tu 'bral ba med cing / de'i mthus gzhan gyi don du gnod pa dang sdug bsngal ci tsam thog tu babs kyang glang bo che la tsher ma zug ba ltar cir yang mi rtsi ba'i snying stobs kyi yon tan mkhas pa dang blun po mtha' dag gis mngon sum du grub pa dang / de tsam du ma zad delirkyen gyis gnod byed la snying rje dang byang chub la 'god 'dod kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa rgyun mi 'chad du 'jug pa zhig yod pas dang por rmongs pa'i dbang gis dgra mi sha bo lta bur shin tu sdang ba dag kyang phyis su bka' 9 bzhin sgrub pa'i slob ma dang sbyin bdag tu gyur pa ches mang ste/ sems can gyi 'o5na sgrub kyis gzhan don las mi ldog par ma zad me 'bar ba la bugashing bsnan pa ltar log sgrub ji tsam 'phel ba de tsam gyis bzod stobs dang snying rje'i stobs lhag par 'phel te gzhan don gyi go cha bla lhag tu bgo ba'i bzod pa'i phar phyin bla na med pa'i rnam par thar pa kun la mthun snang du grub nga 'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin gyi nyams len ni/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu bshad sgrub bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i 'du 'god bar mtshams med pa gsol ba bzhes long tsam yang dka' ba ltar yod kyang skyo ngal mi mdzad par ma zad bstan 'gro'i don la gcig tu dgongs pa'i lhag bsam gyi ngang las g.yo ba med par sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa thams cad bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'phel ba'i thabs su 'gyur ba kho na thugs spro ba 'ba' zhig gi sgo

80 5ge—1 dnghage —sa rda—2 rna ra nas lhur len zhing / de'i mthus chos dang srid kyis bsdus pa'i thugs kyi bzhed don mtha' dag dpag bsam shing gi longs spyod bzhin 'dod dgur lhun gyis grub pa kun gyi mig yul du gyur pa lags te/ ji skad du/ phar phyin bsdus pa las/ yongs su skyo med brtson 'grus che ldan na/ /mi 'thob mi 'grub rnam pa gang yang med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'bras bu'i gtan tshigs mngon sum gyis grub pa nyid do/ /bsam gtan dang shes rab kyi phar phyin ni lus sems shin sbyangs bskyed pa'i mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa dang / mngon shes rnam thar zilaganon sogs kyi yon tan sgrub pa dang / sems can gyi don bya ba rnam pa bcu gnyis sogs byed pa'i bsam gtan dang / don dayochos nyid dang kun rdzob rig pa'i gnas lnga sogs gzigs pa'i shes rab ste/thun mong bzhi lhag zung 'brel dang / thun mong ma yin pa rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa phul du byung ba mnga' bas/ dpe gzigs la thugs 'byams pa dang / zhal 'don sogs kyi tshe gang ci'i byed sgo zhus kyang mi gsan pa dang / res 'ga' gsan kyang lan mi gnang ba dang / res 'ag 'a skabs der lan gnang kyang (yang)slar thugs nas mi nges pa lta bu ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams su mngon pa ches mang bar zhabs 'brang ba dag gleng ngo / /ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes sogs yod pa'i zur tsam yang mi gsungs kyang / gsung gi zur gyis 'byung 'gyur gang gsungs thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pa ltar phyis su cung zad bslu ba med par thog tu khel 'gro ba kho na yin te zhib par bri bas mi lang ngo / /tha na blo gsal

lhanab go'anaib sdaḍod—ḍomerna 81 ba nang phan tshun dogs pa ma chod pa dag kyang 'gol bzhugs kyi skabs 'di la khyed tshos ci zer gsungs te gleng bslangs nas dogs pa gcod pa dang / gsung bshad kyi skabs su 'di la dogs pa 'di ltar skye yang deligand 'di yin zhes zhib par bkrol te gdul bya'i khams dang mos pa mkhyen pa zhes pa de 'di red snyam du sems la dad pa dbang med du skye ba zhig kun la yod cing rang gis myong bas grub pa yang ches mang ngo / /des na gsang rnam gsol 'debs las/ rtag tu sbas pa'i brtul zhugs lhur mdzad kyang / /thol byung tshul gyis 'byung 'gyur bslab bya sogs/ /gang bstsal rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin cung zad kyang / /dus las mi yol sgrib med mkhyen pa'i gter/ /zhes dang / pha rol sems kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs dang / /som nyi'i dra bar tshud rnams ma zhus kyang /gdul bya'i mos pa ji bzhin gzigs pa yis/ /gsal bar 'doms mdzad thar pa'i sa mkhan mchog /ces gsung4 so/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i shes rab smos mi dgos la/ don dam rtogs pa'i shes rab mnga' ba ni rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ klong rdol bla ma la dge sbyor zer ba'i zur ba gzhan med byang chub kyi sems dang / stong pa nyid kyi lta ba'i nyams bzhes kho na mdzad kyin bzhugs zhes gsunganu pa dngos su thos la/ klong rdol bla ma nas kyang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad sprul rin po ches thugs bzhed thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu 'gro ba ni rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bur gzigs pa'i mthu yin/ zhes sogs lta ba brnyes pa'i bsngags brjod mdzad pa mang du thos te/ rnal 'byor pa nang phan tshun gyi rtogs pa'i

82 dargo— zagamarnab dzad gli so rnamo gdengs so so rang rig gi tshul du shes pa ma gtogs bdag lta bus brjod pa'i rngo ga la thogs/ 'on kyang lta ba'i gnad las brtsams pa'i gsung bshad mdzad pa na/ dag ga bya phra rags kyi mtshams dang / dgag bya lhag ma med par khegs ma khegs kyi mtshams sogs mig gis mthong rgyu dang lag pas 'dzin rgyu yod pa lta bu dbang bo rnon po dag la da res kyi chos grwa 'dir dga' 'jigs kyi nyams 'phral du bskyed nus pa 'dra snyam pa zhig 'chad pa ni mngon sum gyis grub po/ /rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa phul du byung ba mnga' ba'i tshul ni/ de yang sngar grwa sar bzhugs skabs dpal ldan 'bras spungs su 'jigs byed kyi dbang gnang bas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi gzigs snang byung tshul thugs kyi sras po gung thang mchog sprul rin po ches sgo mang dpon slob hor skal bzang dngos grub pa'i zhal nas dngos su gsan te/ rje nyid la zur tsam gyis gleng mo zhus pa na de dus shes rgyud ma dregapas rtags mtshan dga' mo byung zhes gsungs don la bla ma dang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed tha mi dad pa la dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du nod par mngon te gsang rnam las/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde chen nas/ /'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe/ /yi dam lha tshogs rten dang brten pa rnams/ mngon sum gzigs shing byin rlabs dga' ston myong / /zhes so/ /der ma zad lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gis rang gi yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog gi bka' rje 'di la babs pas/ phyis su bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgyabadkuri'i rtse mo bde mchog klad ces

dargon ba ga 'gebs mdzad ba tho rnam 83grags pa 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang mngon sum du bzhugs par rje gong mas kyang gsungs pa der gzims spyil bting ste skabs skabs su 'gol bzhugs kyis thugs dam mdzad pas bde mchog gi lha tshogs zhal gzigs shing bde stong gi ye shes kyang thugs la 'khrungs tshul mdzad pa yin snang ste/gnas der gung thang mchog sprul rin po ches gnas bstod brtsams pa'i nang du/ lhan cig skyes dang sngags skyes zhing skyes mkha' 'gro 'du badzeeganas zhes pa gzigs nas gnas 'di bde mchog gi dmigs rnam re skyong ba la khyad shin tu che bas mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas su grags pa shin tu bden par snang zhes gsal bar gsungs pa thugs sras nyid kyi zhal nas dngos su thos te/ gsang rnam du yang / grub pa'i zhing mchog dben gnas thar pa rtser/ /zab gsang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gnas tshe/ he rugyika dpal rten dang brten pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i snang brtsomangon sum gzigs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ / 'di dag nyams snang la gzigs tsam ma yin par lha de dang de la brten pa'i rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa tshad dang ldan pa rgyud sde'i gsang ba'i gnad mthar thug pa dag mngon du gyur pa'i brdar shes dgos te sngon sku na phra ba'i dus mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang nas chos rgyal gyi rjes gnang bstsal te maṇḍil ston pa gnang skabs/ gtor ma'i go sar gsang rdor 'jigs su rung ba ri bo tsam zhig gzigs pa ci yin snya/ma dgongs pa gtad pas nam mkha'i ngos kun rgya mthing bzang pos byugs pa lta bu sngo zhing dwangs pa'i snang ba shar ba la zhib tu gzigs pas dam can chos kyi rgyal po'i sku che ba

84 dargon ba ga zhi mtshod sbo rnam gnamasa'i khyon boms cad yongs su gang ba zhig gzigs te mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang la zhus pa na/ 'jam dbyangs zhi drag mi'i gar gyis rol ba rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i bka' sdo da thun mong ma yin pa 'dis thog mar gsang ba'i gnas kyi gzigs snang bstan pa 'di la rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi gsang mdzod mtha' dag mngon du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa dang rten 'brel tsho shin tu che gsungs nas thugs mnyes pa'i bsngags brjod mdzad par thos te zhib par 'god ma nus so/ /de ltar yang gnam sa'ikhyon kun 'gengs pa 'jigs pa'ijigazugs/ /'jam dpal bka' sdod 'thab kyi gshin rje yis/ /dge ldan chos kyi gsang mdzod yongs gtad nas// /bgegs tshogs kun 'dzoms rdo rje'i g.yar dam bcas/ /zhes so/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo la thos bsam dang 'brel ba'i mdzad pa phyag rjes kyi dbang du byas na/ de yang sku tshe'i stod smad bar gsum du nyi ma shar nub kyi/ mtha'i bar gyi yul gru du ma zhabs kyis bcag ste (bcags te) dam pa'i chos kyi char phabs pa'i lo rgyus zhib par mang bas 'jigs la/'dir rang gis zhabs pad lo nyi shu lhag tsam bsten pa'i ring la bkra shis 'khyil rang du gsung gi bdud rtsi ci ltar nod pa tho tsam 'god na/ de yang dbang gi skor la/ mi tra brgya rtsa/ rdo rje phreng ba/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ bde mchog dril bu phyi nang / 'jigs byed dpa' bogacig pa/ dus 'khor/ kun rig rnam snang mngon byang / mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu dang bcu gsum/ gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun dang lha mang /bugs rje chen po bcu gcig zha la/ tshe dpag lha dgu sogs zur bka'i

dargon ga bas ma da ma 85rigs 'di rnams phal cher bskyar ma mang du song zhing / rjes gnang gi skor la/ sgrub thabs brgya rgyam gnyis/ snar thang brgya rtsa/ sgrub thabs rin 'byung / 'jam dbyangs chos skor/ gsang bdag snyan brgyud skor/ sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i bka' chen bcu gsum/ zhal gyi rnam 'gyur skor/ rnamaglesras bka' chen bco lnga/ gzhan yang gsan yig rnams su gsal ba'i rjes gnang zur bka' rnams phal cher sbyin bdag gi gang mos 'phral du gnang bas star chags lta bu dang / bshad pa'i skor la/ lam rim chen mo/ 'grel ba bzhi sbrags/ legs bshad snying po/ rim lnga gsal sgron/ lam rim chung ngu/ gas nga 'dus bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho/ na (nā) ro chos drug gi khrid yig yid ches gsum ldan sogs dang /rig gnas skor la/ dbyangs can dgyes glu rtsa 'grel/ dbyangs can sgra mdo 'grel ba dang bcarsā pa/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas rtsa 'grel sogs kyi bshad pa phal cher bskyar ma song ba dang / khrid kyi skor la/ lam khrid 'jam/ dpal zhal lung / dmar khrid thams cad mkhyen par bgrod pa'i bde lam/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs / khri da chen brgyad/ gzhan yang 'khrul 'khor/ snying po don gsum/ bla malirnal 'byor mi 'dra ba mang po/ 'pho khrid tshe khrid sogs yang dang yang du gnang zhing / lung gi skor rin po cherigater kha phye ba lta bu gnang ba rnams re re nas bgrang gis gararshalang / de bzhin du bu slob nyi zla lta bu rnams kyis kyang dbang rjes gnang khrid sogs mdor na mdo sngagayorig

86 dargon ba ga zhe snye ma da ba za rnam 6 gnas thams cad kyi 'chad nyan zur chos kyi tshul du bar ma chad par skyong ba 'di yang / ji skad du yon tan rin po che sdud pa las/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung ji snyed cig 'bab pa/ /me tog 'bras ldan sman dang nags tshal ji snyed pa/ /ma dros gnas pa'i klu dbang klu bdag brten gnas te/ /de ni klu yi bdag po de yi mthu dpal yin/ /rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang / /'chad dang rigs pa dag dngu ldan par brjod pa dang / /mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa/ /de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu/ /zhes gang gsungs pa ltar rje nyid kyi rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las las byung ba kho na yin no/ rna / de ltar 'chad pa'i yon tan gyis bskyangs pa'i mthu las/ mkhas pa yid bzang rtse ba'i zhal nas/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag yin pas gzhan gyis bshad pa brgya tshar byas pa las rje rin po ches tshar gcig gsungs pa bstan pa'i gsos su gyur to/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal ba nyi ma'iganyen gyi bstan pa'i snying po 'khrul ba med pa/ chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha ba po'i bka' srol las 'ongs pa'i mdo dang sngags kyi chos tshul sngon byon lo paṇa rnams kyis 'phags pa'i yul nas lus srog thed la bor ba'i dka' spyad myis spyan drangs pa'i mkhas grub yongs kyi snying gi gces nor lta buli gdams pa mtha' dgadhedeng dus pus mo btsugs te maṇḍal sor rtser 'degs thub phyin ci 'dod du nyan chog pa'i skal ba bzang po la phyogs 'dirdzilus can kun gyis 'dod dgur spyod pa 'di ni nachad pa'i sgo naspo

dargonapha —ga'ade wa —3badzo rnam 87bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i phyag rjes yin no/ /rtsod pa'i sgo nas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad tshul ni/ de yang phyogs gang dang gang du bzhugs pa der gsung gi bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba'i skal ldan gyi slob yosprin 'dus pa lta bu rnams kyis dam pa'i chos kyi dri ba gang zhus bhams cad kyi tshig gi cha la sgra dang / don gyi cha la gtan tshigs kyi sgo nas 'khrul ba bsal te the tshom gcod par mdzad cing / deng dus bstan pa'i gnad rig pa la mtshan nyid kyi rtsod pa 'di med mi rung yin gsungs nas mdo smad kyi chos sde chen po phal cher gyi gdan sa pa mdzad skabs mtshan nyid kyi rtsod pa gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i mdzad bzang gi sgo 'phar yangs por phye/ lhag par bkra shis 'khyil du/ bsdus tshan nyer lnga/blo rtags/ phar phyin skabs brgyad ka zur bkol bzhitsā dbu ma stod smad yongs rdzogs/ mdzod gnas brgyad/ 'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun dang / rnam 'byed cha lag dang bcas pa la rtsod pa hor khongs su— mi lus pa'i ched du chos thog 'di la 'di rtsod kyi bca' yig bzhag pas sngon dus bla mas brtsi bzhag gang gnang tsam la rtsod pa byed pa lta bu ma yin par/bka' pota chen po bzhi bsdus grwa blo rtags dang bcas pa tshig gcig kyang ma lus par brgal zhing brtag par nus pa'i skal ba bzang po'i mchog sbyin 'a di ni sde 'dir zhugs pa'i rigs smra don gnyer pa rnams la gzhal du — med pa'i bka' drin mchog tu shes par gyis/ gzhan yang sngon dus bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis dka' bzhi dang dka' bcu'i grwa skor byed srol yod pa ltar/ mkhas pa'i mdun sar dzra ba'i spobs pa gzengs su mtho

—88 —sarda—ṣa—— tshoji—zizi— ༷dzi— snyeb rnams la grwa sa so sor grwa skor byed dgos kyi bka' phebs ltar 'bras spungs sgo mang nas 'ongs pa'i dge bshes zung chu ngag dbang / gtsang ba rab 'byamaspopa bstan pa dar rgyas/ a ma dge bshes bstan dar/se ra dge bshes blo bzang nyi ma bzhis bkra shis 'khyil du bka' pota bzhi'i grwa skor byas shing / de gong gdan sa rang gi dge bshes che bgres kyi skor nas/ tshar tsha shes rab rdo rje/ da lta ba rin chos bzang /sko kya rab 'byams pa gsum gyis reb gong nyin srib kyi chos sde rnams su grwa skor/ yang dge bshes po a bar bzod pa dang / rigs smra 'jam dbyangs bsod nams gnyis kyis sku 'bum dgon lung sogs su po ti lnga bsdus grwa blo rtags dang bcas pa'i grwa skor 'gran zla med pa dang /yang rab 'byams pa ngag dbang tshul khrims/ rab 'byams pa blo bzang 'jigs med/ rab 'byams pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ hor chen zhabs drung blo bzang dkon mchog ste smra ba thogs med bzhi bo 'dis rma chu lho byang gi chos sde che chung phal che bar po ti lnga'i grwa skor/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang bsam gtan/ rab 'byams pa blo bzang dge legs/ sog po dung dkar gsum gyis dpa' ris phyogs kyi dgon khag phal cher la grwa skor/ rdo rams pa 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog ni khrod du bzhugs skabs gnas mjal dang sbrags nas sku 'bum byams pa gling sogs su dge bshes su mngon nges kyi shrī skor/ rdo rams pa dkon mchog dar rgyas dang / dkon mchog dge legs gnyis kyis bya khyung dang sku 'bum du grwa skor/ gzhan yang dus phyis su yang blo gsal mang rab

dgon pha pyarga 'dezu mtshod pa sdome rnam skyebyecig gis grwa skor snga phyir byas pa sogs bstan pa'i srol bzang po ma nyams par gnas pa 'di bzhin legs so/ /gzhan yang mdo sngags rig gnas kyi mgrin rgyan yongs su mdzes pa'i mkhas dbang rnams sku drung du 'ongs pa na/ gang dang gang la mos pa'i chos lugs de las brtsams te 'beel ba'i gtam spro ba ni ji ltar sprin chus gang ba na/ 'brug sgra rang dbang med par rgod pa dang mtshungs te shin tu bsngags par 'os pa'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /des na thub bstan thin tu nyams dma' ba'i dus 'dir bka' pota chen po lnga'i don brgal zhing brtags pa'i lam nas gtan la phab pa'i mabu las rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi dgongs don rigs lam nas smra ba'i sgo nas 'gro ba yongs kyi rmongs pa'i mun pa drungs nas 'byin pa'i thar pa'i sa mkhan bshes gnyen sde snod 'dzin pa sha stag gis mdo smad nor 'dzin gyi khyon 'gengs par bzod pa 'di ni rtsod pa'i sgo nas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i phyag rjes yin no/ / rtsom pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad tshul ni/ bka' rtsom po ti bcu phrag long (longs )pa thams cad kyang / ji skad du/ 'jam mgon mkhyen gzi las 'ongs 'khrul mun bral/ /dbyangs can lha mos smras bzhin snyan 'jebs 'grig /thub dbang gsung bzhin thog mtha' bar du dge /'dzam gling rgyan mchog lugs kun 'dus bzhin brling / / zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yon tan dang ldan pa'i tshig don gyis spras pa sha stag ste gzur gnas mkhas pas legs par brtags nas khong du chud par

90 dargon ga mdeb ma da pha rnam ri bya'o/ /legasarkabashad kyi rtsom pa 'di dag kyang sdebasbyor 'grig tsam la rtsom pa'i ming gis btags pa tsam ma yin par bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu gsum legs par tshang ba yin te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas brgyud de dam pa bar ma chad pa'i man ngag dang ldan pa dang /shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa gnyis gong du brjod zin/ lhag pa'i lhas gnang ba thob pa ni/ gsang rnam las/ bstod tshig don yod zhags pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /mngon sum mgron du bkug pa'i dbyangs ldan ma/ /mgrin par 'khyud pas sngon med legs bshad kyi/ dga' ston spel ba'i spobs pa bla na med/ /ces pa ltar ro/ / de yang 'bras spungs su bzhugs skabs shig zhal nas mdang nga'irmi lam du bu mo mdog dkar zhingayid du 'ong ba'i rgyan dang ldan pa zhig gis thod le kor zhig ster ba rmis te/ da dbyangs can ma la bstod pa zhig bri dgos gsungs nas 'phags ma zla mdzes ma la bstod pa don yod pa'i zhags pa zhes pa de rtsom pa gnang ba yin zhes bu slob yongs kyis rje nyid dang 'dra bar tshad mar 'dzin pa rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal nas dngos su thos te/ ngag gi lha mo dbyangs can mas legs bshad ci 'dod du spel cig pa'i brda bstan pa'i mnga' gsol dang slar yang ngag gi dngos grub zhu ba'i ched du bstod pa mdzad pa na sgra dbyangs lha mo rang nyid dngos su don yod pa'i zhags pas bkug pa bzhin du mgrin par zhugs pa la the tshom mi dgos so/ /der ma zad bu slob mdo sngags rig gnas smra ba rnams kyis blo rab

dargon ba ga mazhib ma da pha sbo rnam 91'bring tha gsum la phan pa'i tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i gsar rtsom mang po spel bar 'gyur ba ste/ mdor na 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pa'i gsung las/ skal bzang blo gros padmo kha 'byed pa'i/ /gsung rab dal gyis 'chad pa'i smra mkhas dang / /log smra phyi rgol spobs pa 'phrog byed pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sar rtsod pa'i khri la dbang / /gsung rab dgongs don tshul bzhin rab 'byed pa'i/ /sdeb legs rtsom pas mkhas rnams dga' ba skyed/ /rmad byung mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum po de/ /'jig rten 'di na mun sel sgron me yin/ /gsungs pa ltar/ mtha' 'khob rmongs pa'i mun khrod du mkhas pa'i skye bo du mas yongs su gang ste 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi srolashing rta'i lam lta bus 'jig rten gsum gyi mun pa sel bar nus pa'i thub bstan rin po che'i sgron me ches cher sbar ba'i dga' ston 'di ni klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas bstan pa la bya ba sto mdzad pa'i phyag rjes yin no/ /sgrub pa'i yon tan sbyin sogs phar phyin drug gi lag rjes kyi dbangado byas na/ sku 'bum dgon lung bya khyung bkra shis 'khyil dgon ma lag dang bcas pa sogs mdo smad lho byang gi chos sde che chung thams cad dang /se 'bras dge gsum bkra shis lhun po sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde che chung rnams su yang dang yang du mang 'gyed kyis bsnyen bkur bsgrubs pa sogs ni zhib par ma bris la/ bkra shis 'khyil du byams sku mthong ba /don ldan rten dang brten par bcas ba sogs gong gsal chos sde rnams su sku gsung thugs rten dang gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs kyang grangs las

zhu2 dargo5 gamageb ma dbade rna 'das shing / tha na phyag dpe sku tshe 'dir gsar bsgrigs gcig bu la po ti khri phrag brgal ba sogs dang / dgon pa'i 'dzin bdag dang grwa tshang gsar 'debs gcig bu la yang dgon ma lag bzhi bcu skor yod pa slar dgon lag so so'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur la/ de dag so sor 'du khang gzims khang / sku gsung thugs rten/ sbyi rdzas sogs sbyor 'jags dang / rang rang gi nye 'khor gyi rong 'brog gi sde phalomo che mchod gzhis su sbyar te bstan pa rin po che rnyed pa dang bkur ste dang bcas te yun ring du gnas pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig mdzad pa de dag ni sbyin pa'i sgo nas gzhan don mjod pa'i phyag rjes dang / de 'dra'i thabs kyi sgo nas yul phyogs phal cher la ma ṇi dang bsnyang gnas sogs kyi rgyun — 'dzugs pa/ yul phyogs spyi'i rim gror/ klu dbang rgyal po'i gzungs sogs lo ltar bsgru ba srol 'dzugs pa/ ri dwags gsod pa dang nya rgya 'dzugs pa sogs kyi sdig pa las bzlog pa/ jag rkus mtshon 'byin sogs kyi khrims sdom pa/ 'byor ldan phal cher la bskul ma btab ste dge 'dun gyi sde mchod du gzhug pa sogs kyi thabaspomakhas mdzad de/ sngon grub chen skal ldan rgya mtshos zhabs kyis bcags pa'i yul dag tu dge ba'i srol dod (btod)kyang / deng yang de phyogs su gsod gcod kyi las snying por 'dzin pa'i dus su shin tu rmongs pa'i yul 'dir drag zhan kun gyi rna bar blang dor gyi brda byang tsam byung ba rje 'di nyid kyi bka' drin kho na las yin te de dag ni tshul khrims kyis gzhan don mdzad pa'i phyag rjes yin no/ / de yang bkod dang 'goda'agyur ltar spyir snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro ba rnams

da5na—ma 'tshi pa ༷—1—— rnam nga 93bskal bzang rgyal ba stong gi nang nas kyang shākya thub pa ma gtogs pas 'dul thabs ma rnyed pa ltar gyur pa dang / de'i nang nas kyang byang phyogs gangs can gyi ljongs 'di mchog gi sprul sku'i sku dngos kyis 'dul ma nus par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis 'dul ba'i zhing du byin gyis brlabs shing / rigs gsum kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul chos rgyal mes dbon rnams dang / gangs can rgyal ba'i nyi ma bdun gyis kyang sku dngos kyis 'dul bar ma nus pa'i ma rungs dmu rgod kyi skye bo gsod gcod dang rlang (brlang )spyod 'ba' zhig gis 'tsho ba/ rgyal po chen po'i khrims lugs cir yang mi rtsi ba/ phar drin gyis bskyangs pa la tshur log sgrub byed pa 'di dag thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa 'jam tsub sna tshogs kyis yang dag pa'i lam la 'god pa la dka' tshegs skyo ngal gyi rnam pa skad cig kyang mi mdzad par snyigs ma'i ngang tshul ci tsam bdo ba de tsam du snying stobs kyi go cha ches bla lhag tu bgos pa'i mthu las byang phyogs aungs pa'i mun khrod chos kyi snang bas dkar lam du mdzad de dbus gtsang chos kyi mdun sa la 'gran bzod pa 'di ni bzod pa dang brtson 'grus zung du 'jug pa'i phyag rjes bla na med pa yin no/ / bsam gtan gyi phar phyin dang 'brel ba'i phyag rjes ni/ ri khrod yi da dga' chos 'dzin du lo star lo mtshams pa bzhi re dang / bkra shis dge 'phel du lo star lo mtshams pa gsum re rgyun chags dang / nangs nub la ri khrod gnyis ka nas thun brda btang ste lam khrid dang bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid skyong ba/ cho ga dang phyag mchod la brtson pa sngags kyi
