94 ge na ba ge dzagi mdzid bo rna ge bzlas brjod byed pa sogs rang rang gi blo tshod dang bstun nas thun shin tu ring ba gnyis re'i ring la dge sbyor kho nas bzhugs pa ma gtogs sgo'i phyi rol tu 'gro ba dang / me gtong ba tsam yang byas mi chog pa'i rnam dkar gyi srol bzang po dang / gtor sgrub dang lcags mkhar la tshags btsugs phyin rdo rje 'jigs byed dang mgon chos kyi bsnyen pa las rung nges can du gtong dgos pa'i srol dang / ri khrod gsar 'debs dang / /'dzin bdag gnang ba nyi shu skor yod pa phal mo tshe la gzhi gesum gyi phyag len/ma ṇi dang bsnyung gnas/ yar ngo mar ngoritshes bcu/ zla ba re re bzhin dus bzang / lnga mchod smon lam sogs rang rang gi rgya che chung dang mthun pa'i rnam dkar gyi srol tshugs shing / ri khrod de dag phal cher gyi 'grig lam rje rin po ches 'ol kha byams pa gling gi dben gnas 'dzin pa rnams la bstsal pa'i bca' yig de ka gzhir bzhag dang / de'i steng du yul dus dang bstun pa'i blang dor bca' khrims kyi yi ge 'jog pa gnang zhing / bkra shis 'khyil du yang mdo sngags kyi slob gnyer rdzogs pa'i dge bshes dang / dge sbyor la gcig tu gzhol ba'i 'du/na ldan mang pos lo mtshams tshe mtshams mdzad nas sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i srol tshes cher dar ba dang / tshe 'di blos btang nas gnas nges med kyi ri khrod 'grim pa'i bya btang ba yang ches mang bar byung ste/ mdor na gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas pa'i steng nas mdo sngags kyi nyams bzhes dang /bzlasagabarjod la brtson pa'i drang srong spong ba pa'i tshogs kyis phyogs dang mtshams yongs su mdzes pa 'di ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i — —

dargogi ba ga mdeb mthad ba sbom rnam 95phyag rjes yin no/ / shes rab kyi phar phyin gyi lag rjes ni/ bkro shis 'khyil du grwa tshang thos bsam gling la zhugs pa rnams kyis bsdus grwa blo rtags dbu phar 'dul mdzod dang bcas pa rtsod pa zhib mor 'gro ba'i ched du chos thog 'di la 'di rtsod kyi yi ge bzhag pa ltar blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis tshig gcig kyang lhag chad med par dpyad pa zhib mor cho'agro ba dang / lo re la ston dpyid brtsi bzhag gi rgyug (rgyugs)/ rigs lung gi rgyugs bcas len rgyu dang / 'dzin grwa gtug rgyu/ phar phyin ston mo'i grwa skor sogs rtsod pa gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i thabs dang / 'dzin bzang ba rnams la rje yab sras kyi mdo sngags kyi yig cha chen mo re skyor bcug ste rta gos sogs kyi gnang sbyin dang gsung gis gzengs bstod gnang bas bzang 'gran gyi tshul du lo star yig cha chen mo re'i rgyugs 'bul mi lnga drug man chad star chags su byung ba dang / rgyud par gsang 'jigs kyi sgrub mchod tsam sngar nas yod kyang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod dang 'chad nyan sogs smad rgyud/ ltar dang / e waṃ chos 'khor gling du dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi cho ga sgrub mchod dang bcas pa/kun rig gi sgru ba mchod cha lag dang bcas pa/ rgyud sde spyi rnam/ dus 'khor dang rnal 'byor rgyud kyi 'chad nyan/ spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang gi cho ga tshugs pa dang / sgra dang / sa ris/ largyusna/ thig bca' bzo sogs zhib mor slob rgyun dang / gso rig gzhan phan gling du sman gyi lag len dang / bya rgyud kyi bathad sgrub rkang tshugs pa'i ched mi

96 dargo5 —tshotsho ————dzodzra rnam ra 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga sogs tshugs shing / bkra shis dge 'phel du mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu dang bde mchog lus dkyil/ yid dga' chos 'dzin du bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ sman chog che ba/ bde lam/mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum sogs tshugs pa dang / gong gsal gyi dgon lag las mtshan nyid grwa tshang rnams la bkra shis 'khyil dpe 'dra'i po ti lnga'i 'chad nyan/ 9 rnga dgon dang dga' ldan chos 'khor gling gi rgyud pa grwa tshang sogs su rgyud kyi 'chad nyan rgyud stod ltar/ brag dkar dgon/mdzod dge dgon/ chos rdzong sogs su smad rgyud dpe 'gre sogs/mdor na bde mchog tso dril gnyis/ gsang 'jigs/ dus 'khor/kun rig 'khor chen/ rdor dbyings/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu dang lha bcu gsum/ gdugs dkar/ mngon byang sogs/ dga' ldan sgrub mchod la gang yod phal cher dgon ri khrod ci rigs la tshang bar btsugs pa ni bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer ba'i rnam thar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lag rjes rmad—du byung ba'o/ /zhal nas bkra shis lhun po'i sngags pa grwa chang dang / zhwa lu sogs na sngags kyi phyag len rnam dag gang yod rtsad bcad nas phyogs 'dir spel nas dga' ldan sgrub mchod lta bu byed ma khan zhig byung na legs zhes gsungs kyang / de bzhin gshegs pas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba bsgom na bskal ba'am bskal ba las lhag par gnas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs yul gyi kun dga' bo ltar gyur sdo ches mang ngo gzhan yang bkra shis 'khyil gcig bur yang mdo sngags kyi lung khrid

dargon mig mdebasam da ba tsā rna / 97dbang man ngag phyag len gyi rigs dang / sgra snyan ngag sdeb sbyor rtsis dkar nag yig ris sna tshogs/ dpar rkos/ lha bris/ shing bzo/gos bzo/ rdo bzo lcags bzo sogs bzo rigs gcig bu yang yul gru gangan gang zhib pa de dang de nan can du slob par mdzad de mdor na/rgyalasrasarnams kyis mi slob pa'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi lag len la kun gyis bung ba pad mtshor 'jug pa ltaradaga'abalhur len zhing / de'i mthus chos srid kyi bya ba gang la yang sgrub pa'i spro ba dang nus pa rang stobs kyis tshang phyin grogs stobs kyis 'di ma tshangazhes bya ba gcig kyang med par theg mchog 'khor lo bzhi ldan du spub pa'adi yang shes rab phun sum tshogs pas gzhan don rnam pa thams cad pa la zhugs pa'i lag rjes yin te zur tsam smras pa'o/ /paṇa chen thamasacad mkhyen pa rgya nag tu phebs skabs/ phyag mdzod drung ba hu thog thu dang / gsol dpon mkhan po sogs kyi gtsos drung 'khor zhabs phyi sum brgya la lha 'brum 'debs par thag bcad skabs/ rgya dpon sne shan pa rnams dang / lhag bsam dkar pa'i mi shes yongs can kun gyis mgrin gcig tu nam zla tsha ba rgyas pa'i dus/ sa cha shin tu dma' ba rgya khog nas na tshod lo lnga bcu drug cu zin pa grangs brgya phrag mang po la lha 'brum btab nas sang gnangs nyes skyon byung na paṇa rin po che'i 'phrin las la gnod pa/ nyid kyi mtshan don la gnod pa/ gong ma bdag po chen po yang thugs mi mnyes pasardzinyen che tshul nan gyis zhus pa na/paṇa chen rin po che dang gong ma'i sku don la gang phan khyed tshos mi shes

98 dargo ge mazhib ma da rnam rda/gsungasathonaspolha 'brum btabapas gcig la yang skyon ma byung zhing paṇa chen mchog la 'brum thar yin min zhus par mtha' 'khib nas byung ba'iskyes 'ga' zhig phyag tu bsnams pa'i rkyen gyis 'brum dkar thon tshul gsungs /des 'drongs yod med mi shes pas da res sku la tshod bgam ched lha 'brum btab na zhes lan gnyisazhus kyang nged 'brum tharayin gsungs/ gsum pa'i skabs nan gyis zhus par/ nged 'brum thar yin pa tsam du ma zadalan gsum thar zhes rtsed mo'i rnam pa rna dzad de gtan nas gsan bzhed ma gnang zhes thos te/ lta phyis su rgyal kheb chen por rkyen de'isgo nas gzhan don du dgongs pa gtad pa'i thugs 'dun snyigs dus skye bo'i bsod nams kyi dpung gis bsgyurachodu ma btub pa kho na'o/ /'on kyang zhabs phyi rnams nas rgyaldomatshan mthon polibastan srid ma nyams par bzung chog pa byung ba 'di rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i thugs rje yin zhes bka' drin che bar 'dzin te byas pa gzo ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ / yang a lag shar phebs skabs krung lang gyinye 'dab zhig ('dabs shig)tu char zhod che bas dzwa 'od drag po byung nas phan tshun gyi grong sde phal cher brlags kyang rje nyid gang du bzhugs pa 'i gnas kyi nye 'khor la tshu 'jigs kyi nyen ma byung ba dang / nad dang gdon gyis gtses pa thams cad la bka' bsgo dang / bsrung (srung)mdud ched gtad kyi phyag dbang re gnang ba tsam gyis nyer 'tshe las grol ba chos nyid dang / bka' bsgo sogs kyis dwangs skyed ma byung na dus kyi chad pa zlog tu med pa rna kun la mthun snang du grupa pa dang / than pas gdungs pa'i yul phyogs 'ga' zhig tu char

rgon ga mdedzas mi da ba tsu rna ra skyenyaphob gsungs pa tsam gyis char 'bab pa dang / gang du phyag gis reg pa'i nas sogs kyis bkra shis par byas pa'i yul der sad ser mi 'byung ba dang / smyo 'bog pa dang / 'dre brlams sogs gzhan gyis btsan thabs su ma khyer bar sku mdun du 'gro mi nus pa dang / khyim gzhis dang gnas khang 'dre can sogs la zhabs kyis bcags pas bkra shis shing byin chags pa sogs la ma gus pa'i skye bornams kyis kyang bsnyon du med pa'i lo rgyus mtha' yas pa bris pas 'dzad pa med la/ de dag ni mdo ltar na ma mtha' thabs shes kyi rtogs pa dbang du gyur pa dang / sngags ltar na ma mtha' bskyed rim mthar phyin pa'i 'bras rtags mngon sum du bstan pa yin te/mdo sdud pa las/ mi yi 'jig rten 'byung bo'i gdon dadzwa nad mang ba/ /phan dang snying brtser ldan pa'i bden pa'i byin gyis zhi/ /'on kyang rlom sems med kyang nga rgyal mi skyed pa/ /de ni mi ldog lung bstan yin par rig par bya/ /zhes dang / 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /sangs rgyas rim bzhin bkod byas nas / /chu yi steng du bcag par bya/ /zhes dang / de 'dra rgyud gzhan las spyang gsungs so/ /rim gnyis kyi rnal 'a byor la mnga' brnyes pas chos skyong srung ma rnams dang / dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu boche rnams kyis 'phrin las tshul bzhin du sgrub pa yin snang ste/ gsol dpon gtsadzwa ba rab 'byams pa bstan pa dar rgyas lha 'brum gyis 'chi la thug pa'i skabs spos shig sbar nas cung zad bzhugs te skyon mi 'dug gsungs pa de nub nas bde ru song ba'i gtam paṇa chen rin po ches gsan te/ gsol

100 da ga 'a da spo rna / dpon gtsang ba lha thor gyis na skabs khyed kyis sa thag ring nas khrid 'ongs pas nad 'di 'dras 'chi mi nyan zhes spos shig sbar nas thugs dam zhig mdzad kyin 'dug zer ba ci yin gsungs la na/ mgon po phyag drug pa rang gi chos skyong yin pas 'phrin bcol zhig byas pa yin/ gzhan byed rgyu cang med zhus pa thos shing / de mtshungs ye shes kyi mgon por las bcol ba tsam gyis chos srid kyi 'phrin las thogs pa med par grub pa'i lo rgyus gzhan yang mang ngo /yang sa skyar phebs skabs bo dong gi 'dabs nas rlung nag 'tshub ma zhig byung bar bo dong 'dir lha mo mngon sum du bzhugs yod tshul gsungs pa dang / rong byams chen du bzhugs skabs nub nas sprin dkar po thag 6gi pa brkyangs pa tshi bu zhig byung bar 'di bkra shis lhun po nas 'ong ba yin 7 'dra gsungs pa la dpags na jo bo (bos)ni ser bas skyel ma mdzad dam snyam/ 'ol kha chos lung du phebs skabs 'o de gung rgyal gyi rtse nas sprin dkar po zhig dpon slob rnams kyi mdun drang thad du 'ong ba'i nang nas kha char 'dres ma zhig babs shing / 'o de gung rgyal gyis gzugs dngos su bstan nas 'phrin las bsgrubs pa'i lo rgyus zur tsam gsungs pa thos la/lab tse khrab gon nas lha bsang mdzad skabs rma chen gyi gangs ri'i rtse nas spyang sprin dkar po sog gur gyi dbyibs lta bu zhig bar snang du chags pa'i rtse nas sbrin dkar po spos ring gi dud pa lta bu zhig mdun ngos su 'ongs shing / de dang mnyam du gangs zhal gsal bar bstan pa dang / gshi stod du yang rma la bsang btang skabs nang mchod khol zhing 'khyur ba

dgin ba gaXrdarda— ṣa—1rdashaṃ/rna 101da dang / ldang lar bsang btang skabs mdun gyi ri rtser na bun 'thibs pa ri de la thim pa gzigs te gzhi bdag rnams nas char zhod gtong rgyu ba(nag pa yin pa 'dra zhes gsungs pa dang / de'i nye 'khor gyi ri zhig la rin chen te'u 'bur dang / phar kha tshur kha'i ri gnyis la stag g.yag ces ming btags pas mtshon phyogs gar phebs su ri dang thang dang chu dang nags tshal du mar ming gsar du sbos te chu mig la gtsang spra dang / nags mi gcod pa dang / ri dwags mi gsod pa sogs kyi bkod khyab rgyun du mdzad pa dang / yul thams cad nas yul lhabibasang mchod zhus pa phal cher la phyogs de'i yul lha thams cad 'dus pa'i sdom lta bu kho na mdzad pas ldang la man chad kyi bar khams dang mdo smad lho byang byang phyogs yul gyi gzhi bdag phal cher gyi gsol mchod cha tshwang bar yod pa lta bu dang /phyogs su chibs thog nas phebs skabs su res 'ga' rgya sog gi skad dang /skabs su a tsa ra'i skad lta bu dang / gtan nas thos ma myong ba'i skad rigs 'ga' zhig sogs kyis gsung re re tsam phebs pa thos te su la gsung 'phros mdzad pa yin snyam nas bltas na ci yang mi gsung bar bzhugs/de'i nyams shes pa 'ga' zhig gis ma shes pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis bsdad pa na gsung 'phros mang tsam mdzad kyang / nam shes mdog byung ba na rbad kyis bcad nas mi gsung zhes chibs kha ba du ma'ingag nas thos te/ yul de dang de'i mi min gyis bka' nod pa dang bsu skyel sogs kyi 'phrin las bsgrubs pa'i rtags su gor ma chag go /gsang rnam las/ bo dong dasgon par 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /'ol khar lha 'o de gung rgyal dang / /

102 datshon ga mazhibs ma da ci rnam rgyun gyi 'byon bzhud la yang rma rgyal sogs/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba kun gyis bsu skyel mdzad/ /cesaso / /de yang kun mkhyen gong ma gter lung du 'byon pa'i lam nas bkra shis lung dkar dang / nor 'dzin chos lung dang / dbang ldan nor lung6dang / bde yangs tshal sogs kyi ming 'dogs gsar du gnang ba dang / gter bzhes nas yar phebs pa na yang dga' rgyas gong kha zhes pa'i ming 'dogs gnang ba sogs sku phreng gong 'og la 'di 'dralirnam bar thar pa mang du yod do/ / gzhan yang 'di ka'i dpon sa gong ma rnams sku tshe mthar 'khyol mi srid pa lta bu yin kyang cun wang ngag dbang dar rgyas rgyal sar bzhugs nas ring bo ma lon pa'i skabs sku tshe ring ba'i ched du rengs pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi sgrub pa cung zhig mdzad pas/ dpon 'di bar gzhan gyis mthu byad mnan gtad 'phang sreg gi sbyor ba ci tsam byas kyang mi tshugs par da lta dgung lo drug cu brgal bar slebs pa dang / bkra shis 'khyil gyi 'du khang rnying ba ar chog skabs su me long bstan ma thag rje gong mas bzhengs pa'i 'jigs byed dang mgon chos kyi logs ris gas ka shig shig por song ba dang / byams sku mthong ba don ldan rab gnas mdzad ma thag zhal nas/ rab gnas byas pas sku'i gzi byin la khyad zhugs song ang zhes gung thong rin po cher gsungs pa la/ khong nas gzi byin shin tu je cher song zhes zhus pa phran gyis thos pas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa mngon sum du zhugs pa'i gzigs snang yab sras gnyis ka la byung bar gdon mi za ste/

phodalhan ba ga ma ma da dzo rnam ri 103gsang rnam du nga/nga / 'gro kun mi pham mgon gyis rjeyo'adzin cing / /nyid kyi zhal skyin la dgongs byams mgon gyi/ /snang brnyan gsar bskrun rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ /ye shes mngon sum zhugs pas gzi byin 'bar/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang lha sar mchod mjal mdzad skabs 'jam dbyangs kho yo na ma la snyan shal phul ba rje gong mas snyan shal phul ba'i skabs ltar sa la ma lhung bar sku'i cha shas la na bza'i tshul du — gnas pa zhabs phyi dag gis mthong ba dang / ri bortse lngar yang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku zhig gis snyan dar bzhes pa'i lo rgyus nges 'drongs thos shing bkra shis 'khyil 'du khang rab gnas grub ma thag 'du khang phug gi logs ris kyi rje bdag nyid chen po'i sku la snyan shal 'phangs pa ra la gri'i yu ba dang pad sdong la 'byar ba'i tshul gyis lo mang por yod pa kun gyis mthong zhing / phyis su dkon gnyer zhig gis rten gyi ba sam pas yin nam nan gyis 'then nas khyer shul gyi zhal ba sen mo tsam gog pa'i shu4 da dung yod de/ de dag ni gzigs snang gi brda mtshon tsam dang / yang lo kyā tun du bde mchog rang byon gyi mdun nas bde mchog gi cho ga dang tshogs 'khor mdzad pa dang / der 'ja' shar ba'i sne mo bkra shis 'khyil du zug pa chos grwar 'gro mkhan kun gyis mthong ba dang / cho 'phrul smon lam gyi gsung chos 'ga' zhig gi skabs nam mkha' nas 'ja' dang me tog gi char babs pa dang / bde mo dga' ldan chos 'khor gling du rdor phreng gi dbang gnang skabs yang dang yang du nam mkha' 'ja' tshon gyis khebs par gyur pa lta bu ches mang na yang dpag par ma nus pas — —

104 dargon go mgib ma da rnam btang snyoms su byas so/ / de yang bka' gdams gong ma'i zha la nas las dang po bas gzhan don byasapa ni bum stong byo ba dang 'dra/ ci tsam ngal ba byas kyang thigs gcig tsam yang 'bab rgyu med/ byang sems so skyes kyis gzhan don byas pa ni bum pa gang byo dang 'dra ste gzha na gang tsa na rang nyid stong bar 'gro/sa thob nas gzhan don byas pa ni bum pa bzang bo 'dra ste gzhan ci tsam gang yang rang nyid la gang stong med ces gsungs pa ltar spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan zla ba nya gang ba lta bu la bri gang gi rnam pa cung zad kyang mi mngon pa'i gzi byin mngon par gsal bzhin dbus gtsang ru bzhi /mdo smad lho byang / byang phyogs rgya hor gyi yul gru thams cad zhabs kyis bcags te mthong thos dran reg gi sgo nas smin grol la 'god par mdzad/de yang rang don gyi 'khri ba cung zad kyang ma zhugs pa'i tshul bka' mi 'gyur ba'i bden pas zhal gyis bzhes pa yin te/ pe cin du bzhugs skabs bkra shis 'khyil 'dus spyi la gnang ba'i chab shog las/ 'de na mang thos dge sbyong rgan po yang / /bshul ring lam du tsha zhing grang ba yi/ /gnod pas ma reg rtse lnga'i gnas mjal dang / /khyab bdag rol pa'i rdo rje'i zhal mjal te/ /rim lnga gsal sgron gzab bshad rgyas par tho ba/ /rigs pa'i dbang byug mtshan sgrogs mkhan chen drung / /mi tra'i dbang yang yongs su rdzogs par zhus/ /de phyir kho bo shar phyogs rgyal khab tu/ /'ongs pa'i dgos pa'i gtso bo grub mod kyang / /snying nas dad pa lhur len 'ga' zhig gi /re ba skong phyir cung zad 'gyangs

dargo pha ga 'geb ma da pha dzomi rna nga 105par gyur/ /'od stong lan brgyar spro ba'i nyin byed de/ /'dab brgyalidapal la sred pa min mod kyang / /mthun pa'i rlung gi thing rtas nyer drangs te/ /mi sdod gling bzhi myul bar su zhig bshung / /zhes gsungs so/ /des na dgon lung byams pa gling gi khrir phebs kyi snyan gsan phul skabs/ nga'i rmi lam du spyan ras gzigs kyi tham ga zhes thathag dmar po btab pa'i yi ge zhig 'byor ba rmis shing / de'i phyi nyin 'ji rnams 'byor bas der cis kyang 'gro dgos gsungs pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis rang gi 'dul zhing bod dang bod chen po'i ljongs na gnas pa'i skye bo 'di rnams khyod kyi snying rje'i stobs 'di lta bu ma gtogs gzhan gyis 'dul dka' bas phyag mtshan du bzhes shig ces bskul ma btab pa'i brdar mngon la/ de bzhin du phur bu lcogs su (lcog tu)sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa'i chu ma sngags rams pa zhes pa rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i nyams snang yod pa zhig la yang / rje btsun ma'i bkas rma chu lho rgyud kyi sa cha phal cher gyi ming smos nas 'di dag khyod kyi bla ma'i 'dul skal yin pas log sgrub kyis skyo ba med par dman cha bzung / ngang bsrings nas 'gro ba'i don gyis shig ces bla ma la nga'i skad bskur 'di rnams zhus gsungs pa ltar/ des kyang yi ger bris nas phul ba3dang /stag phu rin po che dge 'dun chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i lung bstan shel gyi 'khar ba sogs su yang de rigs mang ste yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas bzhag go / de lta bu'i mtshungs med yon tan gyi phung po'adi nyid dag pa'i zhing

106 dalha gam zhe wa da rnam du dgongs pa gtad pa'i lo zla tshes grangs sogs gong du bkod zinacol/zhing 'dir gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdu bar bzhed pa na/ gre phug gi mkha' dbyings su a da7kar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig yod pa chos nyan pa'i gral du bsdad pa du mas mthong la/ de ni 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal bos stong chen thig le'i spro bsdu dang mtshungs pa'i mdzad pa khyad par can du gsungs pa ni shin tu mad de/ mdzad pa'i tha ma 'brom stonajigyi mdzad pa'i rgyas btab pas slar yang mdo smadadkukyi phyogs 'dir 'brom ston slar yang byon pa bzhin du bka' gdams rnam thar gcong mas 'gro kun smin grol la 'god pa'i 'phrin las nam yang 'dor ba med pa'i bdo'o/ /'di'i rgyu mtshan 'og tu yang 'chad la / 'dir yang rnam grangs tsam 'god na/ rje 'di dbus nas mdo smad du phebs skabs /paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa yang po ta la nas chibs bsgyur te yab sras gnyis rwa sgreng du zhal 'dzoms te zhag shas bzhugs — shing / der paṇa chen mchog gi drung nas byang chub lam rim gyi khrid dang /chos rgyal phyi nadzogasang gsum gyi rjes gnang sogs yang bskyar gsan/ phyis su paṇa chen rin po che mdo smad rdu phebs skabs/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa tshang khyed mdo smad du phebs skabs su ngas rwa sgrong mngol ba'i khul byasanasakhyed la chibs skyel zhus pa yin jung gsungs pa skabs der drung na 'khod pa kun gyis gleng ba thos te sngon bla ma dri ma med pa dang / rgyal bu tshodakon mchog 'bangs sogs u rgyan gyi gnas su zhal 'dzoms pa dang /jo bo chen po a ti sha dang bka' gdarmas kyi mes po ston pa rin po che

dgonab gam ba dzad1ma rnam ju ’07 gnyis yer ba lha ri snying po'i mgul sogs su zhal 'dzoms pa dang / da dung ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar du mgon po 'od dpag med dang /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa rgyun mi 'chad kyi bsil ldan gangs can gyi ljongs nam yang mi 'dor ba'i snga phyisdzamatshams sbyar du yab sras rtso gnyis mkha' 'gro'i gnas chen rwa sgrong sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du zhal 'dzoms te dag pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi rol pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa'i gtan tshigs zad mi shes pa brjod du yod pas tshul 'di la skal ba bzang ba'i 'du shes dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang / bka' drin dran pa dang /dad cing mngon par 'dod pa'i 'du shes mchog tu 'phel bar gyis thigarje btsun dam pa 'di nyid ni gdul byalimos pa'i rdzing bu ji snyed pa de snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i brtan g.yolibakod pa mig 'phrul ltar ston kyang kun rtog thams cad nye bar zhe ba'i spros4bral chos sku'i ngang las g.yo ba med par mdzad pa lhun grub tu 'ijug pa'i sku bzhi'i rgyal srid la mnga' brnyes rto pa'i dbang gis/ thub pa'i bstan pa 'di nyid la mkha' khyab kyi 'jig rten kun tu rgyal bstan spel ba'i thugs bskyed kyi nyi 'od dus su smin pa'i dbang gis spyir sprul pa'i zlos gar grangs las 'das pa dang / khyad‘par rgyal ba'i sras po dri med grags pa nas bzung ste kun mkhyen chen po de nyid la zug gi bar gyi 'khrungs rabs padma dkar po'i phreng ba tshar du dngar bsabashad sgrub sprang rtsi'i dga' ston spel bar mdzad pa yin te/ gsang rnam gsol 'debs las/ mi mnyayothugs bskyed dbyar gyi dpal mo'i byin/ /rgyal bstan nor 'dzin khyab par spro ba yi/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar padma dkor

108 rgo ge mgib dzad mum poliphreng / /bshad smub sbrang rtsilidaga' ston ci yang rgyas/ /mtha' klas 'gro ba'i khams kyi rdzing bu ru/ /brtan g.yo rab 'byams bkod pa'i zla snang 'bum/ /cig char spro yang nyer zhi'i mkha' dbyings las/ /mi g.yo sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs bla na med/ /ces so/ /'on kyang tshul de ni 'dir yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ / sku'iskye ba 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas te brjod na yang / thun mong ba rig pa'i gnas lnga dang / thun mong ma yin pa sde snod gsum mkhyen pa'i lung gi yon tan/ thun mong ba bslab pa gsum dang / thun mong ma yin pa rim gnyis sogs rtogs pa'i yon tan te mdor na rgyal ba thams cad kyi spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par mnga' ba mngon sum dang rjes su dpag pa dang yid ches pa'i tshad mas legs par grub pa yin la/ des na ji skad du/ nya dang rus sbal phag rgod dang / /seng ge mi'u thung dga' byed gnyis/ /zhes khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcus brtan g.yo mtha' dag la khyab par bshad pa ltar/ mgon po gang gi stobs bcu'i ye shes kyi bdag rkyen las byung ba'i 'phrin las kyi byed pa ni srid pa dang zhi ba'i dngos po ma lus pa'i rjes su 'gro ba nyid kyi phyir na lta ba'i yon tan las spros te bshad na zab mdo dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa 'ubs kyis 'du ba dang / snying rje'i yon tan las brtsams te bshad na rgya che ba'i mdo sde dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa der 'gril ('dril)ba sogs mdor na rgyal ba thams cad kyis srid zhi'i skyon yon las brtsams te/ gsung gi gsang ba ji snyed cig bstsal pa thams

dargon da ༷tshodebs da tsā ma 109cad mgon po 'di nyid kyi rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa nyid du 'du bas na/ gang gi rnam par thar pa dang / rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang ba'i mdzod ni su zhig gis rdzogs par nus te/ ji ltar ngang mo 'bum phrag gis rtse dgas 'jug par byas spyang gting yangs rol mtsho'i phyogs cha tsam yang mi rdzogs pa bzhin no / /'on kyang thog ma med pa'i dus nas mtha' med kyi 'khor ba 'dir sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras kyis bar mtshams med par mnar bas ngal zhing dub pa bdag da res mgon po gang gi thugs rje tsan dan gyi sngon pa la brten nas gtan du bde ba'i 'bab stegs dam pa dge ba'i lam gyi grib bsil — du cung zad ngal bso ba rnyed de/ deliphyir bde ba'i mchog sbyin gang gis mdzad pa de yi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i yon tan gyi bsngagayopa brjod pa la shin tu spro ba skyes te/ tsha bas gdungs pa'i skye bo tsan dan gyi ljon pa'i grib bsil du ngal gso ba'i bde ba rnyed pa na gling bu bsgyur ba la sbo ba bzhin no/ /de skad du yang / stobs bcu'i 'jug pa srid zhi'i dngos kun gyi/ /rjes 'gro rab 'byams rgyal gsung gsang ba'i mdzod/ /grags pa gting yangs rol mtsho'i phyogs cha yang / /dbyangs can ngang mo 'bum gyi rtse dga'i gnas/ /'on kyang thugs rje ha ri tsan dan gyi /grib bsil dge ba'i lam du ngal bso ba/ /gang zhig de yi ngo mtshar bsngags pa yi/ /gtam gyi gling bu bsgyur la spro ba 'dzin/ /zhes so/ /de yang skyes bu dam pa su la yang sku gsung bugs kyi mjod pa thams cad sde snod gsum dang mi 'gal ba las lhag pa'i rnam thar bshad du med mod

110 dargon ga mde ma da sbo'i rnam kyang / deng dus sde snod dang mthun pa'i spyod pa la rtsis cher mi byed cing /zhal gzigs dang nus pa'i yon tan sogs la ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa'i tsho skorigs ches mang bas de dag dang blo ldan gzur gnas kyi tshogs rnams sked ga' pa bskyed pa'i phyir du rnam thar gyi don bsdus te brkod cing /gsang ba'i rnam thar gyi gtan tshigs 'ga' zhig rang gi spyod yul du ma gyur cing / /'ga' zhig da dung yu ladus kyis sbed dargos pa yang yod pa rnams btang snyoms su bzhag gsung gi zur tshun chad la brten nagorang gi blo gros kyis gang dpog pa rnams kyis zur brgyan te/ rang bzhin brjod pa'i gtam kho nas ci mdzes par bkod pa yin no/ /smras pa/ dag pa'i zhing gi phun tshogs 'byor ba la/ /nam yang sred min snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gror/ //rjesachags ye shes sgyu malirnam rol gyis/ /mi 'jigs mchog sbyin stsol pa 'di rmad byung / /ring mo zhig nas mkhyenartobartse'i dkyil 'khor cha/ /yongs su rdzogs ba'i mgon du grub zin mod/ /thos bsaspa sgom pa'i them skas rim bgrod pa'i/ /rnam thar 'dis khyod don grub gnyis pa bzhin / /khyod ni spangs dang rtogs pas dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal ba'i nyi ma kun dang dbyer med kyang / /snyigs dus 'gro kun thugs rjeli'od dkar gyis/ /lhag par skyong 'di rgyal ba kun las lhag /mdzad bzang sman gyi ljon pa'i cha shas res/ /gzhil dka' rgud pa'i zug rngu drungs 'byin pa'i/ /ngo mtshar sgyu masdzacho 'a phrul 'di mthong nas/ /thugs bskyed mchog der mi dad blo ldan su/ /khyod kyi 'phrin lartswanyi 'od kyis smin pa'i/ /blo— bza nga rgyal bstan pad

sga pha pyag deb da pha sbo rnam rna 111ma'i tshal chen por/ /bshad sgrub /sbrang rtsis myos pa'i rkang drug tshogs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i glu dbyangs sgrog pas brel/ /da dung 'gro 'di sgrib gnyis dgra sde las/ rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' bo chen po'i sar/ /ma phyin de srid thugs rje'i dpung tshogs dang / /lhan cig brtse ba'i spyan gyis rtag tu skyongs/ /skye dgu'i khams kyi rang bzhin dang mthun par/ /'bad med 'jug pa'i 'phrin las rten 'byung mthus/ /dge bcu'i 'od dkar mtha' dag 'jig rten du/ /khyab pa'i mchod sprin rtag tu rgyas par smon/ /zhes bya ba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /mgon po gang gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che 'jigs med thub bstan nyi ma'am/ blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho'am/ thub bstan 'jigs med dbang po'i sde sogs mchan gyi dbyangs snyan tsam gyis kyang rgud pa'i dri ma sel bar nus shing / dgung lo dgu bzhes pa 'di nyid yul gang du sku 'khrungs pa'i tshul dang / srid pa'i phun tshogs thams cad lam srang gi rdo bzhin du 'dor ba'i nges 'byung gi yon tan dang / mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad gzigs pa tsam gyis thugs suchud pa'i mkhas pa'i yon tan dang / lha dang chos skyong nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu'i snang ba rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rtogs pa'i yon tan dang / zhi zhing dul ba'i kun spyod lhur len pas btsun pa'i yon tan bcos min du yod pa sogs kyi rnam par thar pa ni slar 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /e ma ye shes 'phrin las la/ /mnga' brnyes thugs bskyed tsam gyis ni/ /bstan 'gro'i mgon du sprul pa'i gar/ /mkha' la nyi shar bzhin du mdzes/ /zhes bya'o/ /

—dzee—2 debosna ste ji lngar ba6 ba’tshal/ / / don 7 ( ra mid ni 'alda brjod par bya ste/ de la gang du btab pa'i gnas sgru/dge bcu'i yon tan mtha' dag yongs su tshangs shing (tshang zhing )/phyogs dang phyogs mtshamaspo su rgyal srid sna bdun dang bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs kyis nye bar mdzes pa/ tshad ma'i skyes bu du mas lung bstan me tog dkar po char du bsnyil ba'i snyan pa mngon par mtho ba/ sngar nas rang cham su grags pa'i ming la bkra shis 'khyil zhes grags pa'i gnas mcho ga de nyid yin no zhis shes par bya'o/'o na de lta bu'i gnas der rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i gnas zhes grags na/ rgyal bas lung bstan tshul gang yin/ tshad maliskyes bu gzhan gyis lung bstan tshul ji ltar yod ce na/ de la sher phyin gyi mdo las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di byang phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ byang phyogs nas kyang byang phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa sogs kyis lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi mdo drangs pa las/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can du dam pa'i chos rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di gnyis kas dgon sde 'di nyid kyang lung bstan pa yin te/ sngar mdo smad du bstan pa snga dar gyi dus nas da lta'i bar du bar ma

go/getshorjorjo ma 113chad par bstan pa'i srol ches cher dar mod kyang lo nyis stong lnga brgya rdzogs nas drug brgya ma song ba'i bar skabs der thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshad sgrub sgo gang nas kyang zur ma nyams par chos sde gcig la dang po nyid nas tshang ba 'di 'dra byung ba gzu bo'i blos dpyad na thin tu rnyed dka' ba'i rigs pas kyang grub la/ 'di'ibyang dang po dbus ci gtsang gnyis dang / byang gnyis pa dgon sde 'di nyid la ngos 'dzin par kun mkhyen gong ma yab sras kyi gsung rgyun thos so/ /de yang ston pa'i 'a khrungs lo la mi mthun pa mang yang bu ston dang mkhas grub rje sogs kyis me rta dang / phug lugs pa dag gis lcags sprel yin par bshad pa gnyis grags che la/ me rta'i dbang du byas na ston pa 'das nas nyis stong bzhi brgya nyag ma brgyad cu 'das pa'i gya gcig sa byi la kun mkhyen rin po che sku bltams nyis stong lnga brgya nyag ma zhe lnga pa sa glang dang /lcags sprel gyi dbang du byas na nyis stong lnga brgya nyag ma nyer gcig 'das pa'i nyer gnyis sa byi la 'khrungs nas lnga brgya gya gcig 'das pa'i sa glang la dgon sde 'di nyid gsar 'debs kyi mgo brtsams pa yin te/ zhib par 'og tu shes so/ /der ma zad skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang yul dbus su phebs te gtsang dbus kyi dpe cha mang po bsdus nas mdo smad du gdan drangs skabs snyan brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ deng sang byang nas dbus su 'ong rgyu nom rdzas kho na yin la/dbus nas 'phags bod kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag gi glegs bam byang du

114 dargon 2 ta /bsdus nas khyer 'gro ba 'di la dpags na bstan pa byang nas byang du 'pho ba'i dus skabs dngos yin par snang zhes gsungs pa dang / lha ldan nor 'dzin dga' tshal du klong rdol grub chen rin po che dang skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang rnam gnyis gsung sgros skabs su bstan pa byang nas byang du dar ba de bkra shis 'khyil yin pa dang bkra shis 'khyiladu dge 'dun khri tsho brgyad 'tshogs pa'i lung bstan yod pa yang lam zhugagokhri tsho brgyad 'tshogs pa'i lung bstan yin par zhal 'cham par byung zhes skyabs mgon mchog gi thugs kyi sras po gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal nas dngos su thos la/ thugs sras pa nyid nas kyang yongs 'dzin rin po cher phul pa'i chab shog las/ rgyal bstan dar bar lung bstan byang dang po/ /'phags yul ming don rim bgrod ngal gsolistegs/ /rna ba'i grags 'bar dbus 'gyur ma la yar/ /byed po tsan dan ljon pa mgon khyod tsam/ /zhes gsungs pa de 'dra la dgongs par snang ngo / /gzhan yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las kyang / /nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /sa yi steng 'di stongs pa na/ /khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /de tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ /kha ba can na yod pa yin/ /zhos pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha ba chen pos dge ldan 'debs par lung bstan pa'i zhar la kun mkhyen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes dgon sde 'dinyidatsho'adebs par lung bstab pa yin te/ /'jam dpal gyi sprul par bshad pa ni kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje de nyid po to pa rin chen

dgon rta tab 115gsal dang thugs rgyud gcig pa dang / de nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul par gsungs pa dang gung 'grigs/ dgon chen rab dga' ba zhes pas dga' ldan bkra shis 'khyil zhes pa'i mtshan sgra gsal bar bstan pas so/ /des na rje rang gi gsung las/ dga' brgya ldan pa'i bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling / /zhes dang / rgyal bas lung bltan pa'i chos sde chen po dga' ldan bkra shis 'khyil zhes yang yang sbyar ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin no/ /der ma zad rje gong ma chos grwar phebs skabs rje rin po che sgo mang chos grwar phebs kyin yod par 'bras spungs gling thams cad la grags pa dang /mar khu spus (bur)kyur phebs pa'i skabs kyi rnam thar gong du bkod pa ltar dang / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang sku bltams par nye ba'i skabs shig yum gyi mi lam du/ yum rang nyid sku 'bum du mjal bar 'gro rtsis byas par mngal gyi byis pa des a ma khyod sku 'bum du mjal bar 'gro mi dgos/nga rje rin po che'i skye ba yin pas khyod kyi lam mgo thon yong zer ba zhig rmis pa sogs la dpags na/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ blo ldan dang po yi ge ma/ /zhes pas kyang rje rin po che'i mtshan ma ti bha tra zhes pa dang /kun mkhyen mchog gi mtshan mañtsa sgo dzi zhes pa gnyis ka'i yi ge dang po dang /yi ge dang po pa bsten pa zhes pas kyang rje rin po che'i mtshan blo bzang ngam bzang po zhes spu dang / kun mkhyen mchog gi mtshan brtson 'grus sam thadma zhes pa'i yi ge dang po bstan par sems so/ /lung bstan tshul gzhan yang yod de bka' gdams glegs bam las/ shar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na/ /gnas pur rgyal bod ces bya ba yod/ //ces pas bod

116 gargon ———/btab— / khams spyi tsam bstan nas/ ri mthon po gnam gyi ka ba yod/ /mtsho dma' mo g.yu yi maṇḍal yod/ /gangs dkar po shel gyi mchod rten yod //spang ser po gser gyi maṇḍal yod/ /ces pas dgon pa'i nye 'khor gyi ri mthon po dkyil 'ger/ rta rdzong g.yu mtsho/ rma chen gyi gangs ri/ bsang gzhung bzhi rang ming gis gsal bar bstan/ kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /yul de na khyod kyi zhing khams yod/ zhing de na khyod kyi gdul bya yod/ ces pas kunatremakhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje sbyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par gsungs te zhing khams gdul bya dang bcas pa bstan/ ri padma stong ldan dbyibs legs pa/ /dus dgun gsum dkar po shel gyi mdog /dus dbyar gsum sngon po g.yu yi mdog /dus ston gsum ser po gser gyi mdog dus dpyid gsum khra bogazi yi mdog /mdog phun sum tshogs pa'i ri bo la/ /ltas khyad par 'phags pa'i mtshan ma yod/ /ces pas gnas 'di'i shar ri maṇḍal klad dbyibs kyi sgo nas lung bstan te bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi padma la ngos bzung zhing / ri de'i ngos kyi nags tshal gyi kha dog las zhi rgyas drag po gsum dang las rab 'byams kyi dngos grub 'grub par gsungs/ dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba la/ /dar dmar po rā ga'i cod pan yod/mi khyod kyi snyan pa phyogs bcur 'phel/ /zhes pas byang shar gyi ri bkra shis ska rags dbyibs kyi sgo nas lung bstan cing / rtags brgyad kyi dung la ngos bzung ste snyan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i mtshan ma dang /dar dmar po rā ga'i cod pan gyis dbang gi dngos grub 'grub par

dargon rwarjotab 117gsungs/ ri bogs chad g.yu yi bum pa la/ /chu yan lag brgyad ldan chu mig 'bab/ /mi khyod kyi thugs rjes bsil bar byed/ /ces pas nub phyogs su klu tis zhes pa'i ri bogs chad mdun du nags tshal stug poligaseb tu chu mig brgya phrag 'bab pa de mi 'chug pa'i rtags kyi sgo nas lung bstan nas rtags brgyad kyi bum par ngos bzung / 'di la nyin srib kyi chu mig che ba gnyis yod par klu dung skyong dang / 'dzin pa lag mang gnyis gnas zhes rje gong mas gsungs pas da lta dung skyong chu mig lag mang chu mig zer zhing / 'di nas bzung ste dgon pa'i mdun gyi chu rgyud la nyin lam du malibar du chu mig dang nags tshal bar ma chad par yod pas/rgyal bu dad pa brtan po'i skyes rabs las dung skyong chu bdag dang /'dzin pa lag mang nags tshal gyi bdag por bshad pa dang yang 'grig la snga dus char dkon pa'i tshe khri rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis pa nags tshal 'dir phebs nas dad pa brtan po'i skyes rabs bklags pas char babs pa'i lo rgyus kyang yod do/ /gnam sngon po g.yu bya'i gdugs su phub/ /las nyon mongs tshad pa zhi bar byed/ /mi khyod kyi dge bshes 'phel ba'i rtags/ /zhes pas de dang mi ring ba na rma bya de bo zhes pa'i ri phyogs 'ga' zhig nas bltas na gdugs phub pa lta bu zhig yod pa de ming sgra gsal bar lung bstan nas rtags brgyad kyi gdugs la ngos bzung / ri zur gsum brag gzhung gnam du mtho/ /deng mkha' 'gro'i rgyal mtshan sgrong ba 'dra/ /mi khyod kyis gnas der bstan pa spel/ /zhes pas nub phyogs su rgyal mo zhes pa'i brag ri zur gsum pa chos 'byung gi dbyibs

118 dargon nta bta tsho / can zhig yod pa de mkha' 'gro zhes rang ming dang dbyibs kyi sgo nas bstan te rtags brgyad kyi rgyal mtshan la ngo sa bzung / sa rtse brgyad lung pa phyogs su gyes/ /kye 'khor lo rtsibs ba rgyad phub pa 'dra/ /mi khyod kyi mi mthun gcod pa'i rtags/ /zhes pas rtse gzhung rang ming gis ba stan te rtags brgyad kyi 'khor lor ngos bzung / yongs grags sha pho ru rtse/mdzo mo nu rtse/ bya dur rgod rtse/ spa ra stag rtse/ chu dmar mthong rtse mdzod srung khyung rtse ste rtse drug dang / chu nag sgro snying / gad pa g.yag snying / ma mo mkhris snying / paṇa chen shi'u snying / glo ba glang snying /gad pa 'ug snying / gser snying ste snying bdun nam 'ga' zhig gis khra moli'ug snying dang bdun zer yang 'dir khyung rtse dang ba rtse gnyis bsnan nas rtse brgyad du gsungs pa yin no/ /de yang rtse gzhung 'di sa padma 'dab brgyad dang / gnaga'akhor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi dbyibs su yod cing / /rtse chu g.yas skor du 'bab pa sogs gnas bzang zhing rten 'azel gyi khyad par gzhan yang yod ces rtse brgyad kyi nang tshan sha pho ru rtse'i rtsar grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs mdzad cing / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas kyang phyogs gang du phyin kyang / dpyad bzang ba/ rtswa chu 'dzoms pa/ skyid cing bag phebs pa/ sa rus bzang ba kun 'dzoms shig la rtse gzhung las lhag pa rnyed dka' zhes yang yung gsungs pa tha mal ba'i yul gyi zhen chags dang ga la mtshungs/ thang chen po'i dkyil na ri chung nyal/ /mtsho chen po'i nang gi nya mo 'dra/ /mi khyod kyi spyan snga 'phel ba'i rtags/ /zhes pas sgrog thang na thang tis

dargon rta btab ma 119zer ba'i ri chung zhig yod pa de ming zur gyi sgo nas bstan te/ rtags brgyad kyi gser nya la ngos bzung / 'bru sna tshogasasmin pa'i zhing sa can//'bru bang mdzod rgyas pa'i rtags su bzang / /shing sna tshogs skyes pa nags kyi khrod/ /gnas khang bzar 'phel ba'i rtags su bzang / /chu mi che rgya mtsho chen po med/ /chu mi chung chu bo dpag med 'bab/ /chu snyoms pas yul mi rtag tu bde/ /zhes dang / gong du/ dri zhim po sman gyi bdug spos yod/ /dbyar bkra ba gser gyi me tog yod/ /ston bkra ba g.yu yi me tog yod/ /ces pa rnams bsdoms pas gnas 'dir dge bculiyon tan tshang bar bstan/ de yang / chu mi che rgya mtsho chen po med sogs kyi don ni chu ha cang che bas rgya mtsho ltar srog chags gdug pa can gnas shing bgrod dka' bas gdul bya'i 'gro 'ong la gnod pa de lta bu yang ma yin la/ ha cang chung bas than pa'i dus sogs su longs spyod rgyu mi rnyed pa lta bu yang min par che chung snyoms pa'i don yin no/ /de yang bsang chu 'di yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu yin pas nad kyi rigs mi skyed cing / tshe ring ba sogs kyi yon tan 'byung zhes rje gong mas gsungs/ rlung nad la pan zhing rigs pa dwangs pa sogs 'byung zhes rnam thar ke ta ka'i phreng ba las gsungs/ yan lag brgyad ni bsil dang zhim dang yang dang 'jam/ /dwangs shing dri ma med pa dang / /'thung na lto la mi gnod dang / /mgrin pa la ni mi gnod pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ / spyir sprul pa'i chu'i yon tan ni/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/

12khye dalhan rto2 ta sprul pa'i chu 'thung bas sdug bsngal cung zad drangs pa na sems can dag chu la smod cing sdug bsngal drangs par mi lta zhes pa nas sprul pa'i chu des yun mi ring bar thar bar byed do/ /zhes so/ /de yang skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang de nyid rwa sgrong du phebs nas chu mig ring mo la gzigs skabs/ rang re'i bsang chu'i mgo yang 'di nas babs pa yin zhes dngos su gsungs pa dge bshes dkon mchog dar rgyas kyi ngag nas thos so shar lhun po'i rtse nas nyi ma 'char/ /phyogs gzhan gsum mi nor shugs la gsal/ /zhes pas shar rilirtse nas nyi ma 'char bas phyogs gzhan gsum mi 'khrul bar shes pa de bstan/ de yang spyir dgun nyi thung ba mthar thug gi nyi ma 'char mtshams nas/ dbyar nyi ring ba mthar thug gi nyi ma 'char mtshams kyi bar ni shar dang / dgun nyi thung ba mthar thug gi nyi ma nub mtshams nas/ dbyar nyi ring ba mthar thug gi nyi ma nub mtshams kyi bar ni nub dang / shar nub kyi g.yas g.yon gyi bar gnyis lho byang du bshad pas dgon pa 'di'i grwa shag phal cher mdun ri'inags tshal ngos la phyogs pa shas che yang / 'du khang gi dbus drang bo ni/ mdun ri kha tshur blta'i g.yas phyogs kyi ri chung 'bur bo gsum gyi dbus ma la bstan yod cing / ri chung dbus ma de'i rtser nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus kyi nyi ma 'char bas shar gyi dbus mi nor bas shes pa yang lung bstan 'di ltar yin no/ / khyad chos 'di ra sgreng la yang 'grig dka' bar snang ste/ rwa sgrong gi

dgon btab ma 121lung bstan skabs su/ phu rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi nyi ma 'char/ /phugs 'bras bu bzang ba'i rtags su 'tshal/ /rgya rig pa'i chu bo mdun du 'bab/ /ces nyi ma 'char phyogs dang / mdun lho ri bags kyis gzhol ba la/ /'od stong ldan gsal ba'i nyi ma 'de/ /zhes bgrod lugs dang nyi ma'i 'char dus snga ba ni/ slob ma myur du 'du bar 'tshal/ /nyi ma nub dus 'phyi ba ni/ /dam tshig yun ring bsrung bar 'tshal /zhes 'char nub kyi tshad bstan pas so/ /'char mi snga snga dus bsam gtan 'phel/ /zhes pas dgun dus nyi ma 'char mi snga bas ting 'dzin 'jig pa'i dus su bshad pa'i nyi ma zar zer gyi sngar thun sogs long yod pa dang / 'char mi 'phyi nyi 'od smin pa la/ /lus bag phebs bde bar sbyor bar byed/ /ces pas dbyar dus nyi ma 'char snga bas nyin gung shin tu tsha ba'i sngar lus bag phebs par byed pa'i nyi 'od smin pa 'byung ba dang / rgas mi snga pho rab 'dun stangs 'phel/ /zhes pas dgun dus nyi ma rgas 'phyi bas 'dun ma mtha' dag bsgrub long yod pa dang / rgas mi 'phyi mdzad ma'i las rnams 'grub/ /ces pas dbyar dus nyi ma rgas snga bas nyi ma nub nas mtshan dus ma bslebs pa'i bar der ji ltar 'os pa'i bya ba bsgrub long yod pa de bstan/ kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /zhes pas kun mkhyen mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par gsungs/ yul bkra shis 'byung de khyod kyi zhing / /zhes pas bkra shis 'khyil gyi mtshan sgra thon pa'i sgo nas gsal bar lung bstan la/ yang dkon mchog 'bangs kyi skyes rabs de nyid las/ sa pad ma 'dab

122 dargo rta tab ma brgyad yul gyi dbus/ /gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phib pa'i 'og /phyogs bkra shis rtags brgyad yod pa'i sa/ /gnas phun sum tshogs pa dam pa'i yul/ mi khyod kyi zhing khams dam pa yin/ /gnas debyuru las can dpag med 'du/ /chos bde stong rol pa'i glu len zhing / /nyams bkra shis bde bar skyong ngorshazhes/ /nga gsang ba ye shes mgur du sgrog /ces pas kyang gnas 'di'i gnam sa'i dbyibs dang / phyogs mtshams kyi mtshan ma/ mtshan sgra sogs gsal bar bstan cing / byang rgyal po chen po'i mdun drung du/ /thang sngon po g.yu yi maṇḍal la/ /zhes pas rma rgyal sbom ra'i ming zur gyi sgo nas gnas 'di nyid kyi sa phyogs bstan cing / mi rgyal ba khyod kyis der bzhugs te/ /deng mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag skyong byed cing / /thugs sbas pa'i tshul gyis gzhan don spyod/ /ces pas kun mkhyen rin po che de nyid don la 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dngos yin kyang / de ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa mi mngon par sbas pa'i tshul gyis 'gro don spyod par lung bstan to/ /'di ni ma cig gi lung bstan dang shin tu mthun te/ de'i gter yig las/ e ma ho/ma yengs legs par nyon dang bu slob kun/ /de'i dus su bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i gang zag ni rtsod ldan snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus yin yas zhin tu dalta/na te/ me tog u du sba ra lta bu ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa 'di 'dra 'byung / /'brom gyi sprul pa skyes bu dam pa ni/ /ngur smrig tshul 'dzin bslab pa gsum dang ldan/ /rgyud sde'i chos la snying po bcud du 'dren/ /rma stan pa'i rgyal mtshan skyes bu de 'dra 'byung / /

dgon rtarna btab / 123'di dang 'di yi tha snyad mi 'gyur ro/ /dus kyi khyad phar yin pas gab par bya/ /zhes don la 'brom gyi sprul pa yin kyang / dus kyi khyad par gyis de 'dra'i tha snyad gab pa'am sbas te mi mngon par bzhugs nas mardo sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa spel bar lung bstan pas so/ /yang glegs bam las/ sngon phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus pas/ /thang lag mthil ltar mnyam bai ḍūju/ /'phang mthon po gser gyi ba gam can/ /gnas gzhal yas chen por byin gyis brlabs/ /de ya mtshan ngang gis 'byung ba yin/ /zhes pas gong du bayad pa'i ri mthon po dkyil 'ger gyi g.yas phyogs su gser chen zhes pa'i sa dang mi ring ba na sba yu zer ba'i ri ba gam mam mda' yab kyi dbyibs can zhig yod pa de bstan/ ya mtshan ngang gis 'byung zhes pa ni rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dang cha mtshungs pa'i ngag rgyun 'ga' zhig snang ste dpyad gzhi che'o/ /der ma zad zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba'i chos lugs phun sum tshogs pa'i le'u las/ kye sum cu rtsa gsum khang bzang na/ /khong lha dbang 'byor ba chos kyi rgyan (kyis brgyan)/ /lha nye dbang rnams kyis rab mchod cing / /nyams dpag med dag (dga')pa'i zhing khams ltar ( bzhin)//nga bka' gdams tshad med khang bzang na ( nas)/ /chos 'byor ba bslab—gsum ngang gis 'phel/ /khong drang srong khrims ldan du mas bskor/ /nyams dpag med dga' kha'i lo 'dab rgyas/ /bkra shis so bka' gdams lhar bcas rnams/ /yar shog cig grangs med sems can rnams/ /nga skyob po lha chos bdunabyu ldan gyis/ /phugs btsan no thar

124 dargon/de da ta pa'i zhing khams yin/ /zhes 'brom gyis zhus pa— la/ /jo bos/ /'brom gting mtha' yangs ( zab )pa'i rgya mtsho khyod/ /da dam bca' 'dor na dam pa min/ /da khur chen ma 'dor (bor)yi dam chos/ /zhes sogs bslab bya mang du bstsal te/ rgyal ba 'brom de nyid kyis lha chos bdun ldan bka' gdams rnam thar gtsang mas sems can grangs med thar lam la 'god par dam bcas shing smon lam btab pa de nyid kyang dgon gnas 'di la 'grig par snang ste/ de'i gong du/ chos bzang bo dge ba yar ldan de (te)/ /da (nga)rnam thar gtsang ma'i chos su snang (gnang )/ /zhes dge ldan pa'i rnam thar gtsang ma skyong ba dang / chos bstan pa zab mo'i chu rgyun de/ /nga gser bya spyod pa'i dga' bder gnang / /zhes gnas kyang gser bya zhes bsang gzhung gi rgya bya be'us mtshon nas bstan pas so/ /de yang kun mkhyen gong ma rtse gzhung sogs su phebs bzhud skabs med mi rung lta bur rgya bya bee'u'i rtsar skesol tshigs gnang ba dang /zhal nas kyang 'di la gser bya byi'u byas pa zur chags nas rgya bya bee'u zer snang / sa 'di nga rang gi sdod sar 'brom gyis gnang ba yin zhes gsungs par dngos slob du ma'i gsung rgyun kyang thos la/ dgon pa'i sa'adul skabs phyin chad rgya bya be'u man chad nas rgyud sde bzhi'i las gang byed kyang sa brtag bslang mi dgos gsungs pas 'di man chad dgon gnas kyi nang du 'du ba sogs shes dgos so/ /sprul pa'i glegs bam gyi lung bstan de dag ni kun mkhyen gong mas rwa sgrong gi gnas kyi dpyad thams cad dgon gnas 'di la legs par tshang yod pas/ sprul pa'i glegs bam

da na rta phata 126las rwa sgrong dang dgon gnas 'di gnyis mnyam du lung bstan pa yin zhes ji ltar bstsal pa'i gsung rgyun ltar bkod la/ ma cig gi lung bstan de 'jam mgon khri rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis pas mdzad pa'i rnam thar ke ta ka'i phreng mdzes ltar bkod cing / phyi ma 'di la da dung dus dang mtshan ma sogs kyi 'chug pa med pa'i gtan tshigs kyang khri chen nyid kyis rang gi bu slob rnams la bstsal pa'i gsung rgyun kyang thos so/ /rnam thar de nyid las rgyal bas lung bstan pa zhes pa bka' gdams glegs bam gyis lung bstan pa la bshad par 'ga' zhig gis dogs pa byed kyang skyon che bar mi sems te/ jo 'brom yab sras la rgyal ba yab sras zhes pa bka' gdams kyi spyi skad yin pa ltar glegs bam rin po cher yang lan mang du snang bas so/ /gong du bshad pa de dag tu ma zad/ mdun riwiri zhol gcig bur bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi mtshan ma tshang bar yod cing /'di dag thams cad da lta'i sa dpyad mkhan po dag gis dbyibs sogs las dpyad pa dang gtan nas mi 'dra bar kun mkhyen gong ma de nyid nas rang gi ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs pa ji lta ba bzhin du so sor ngos 'dzin mdzad pa yin pas/ 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs pa mi bslu ba ltar don la yang gnas zhes skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi gsung las dngos su thos te/ zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/ mdor na phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su bkra shis kyi rdzas bkra shis kyi rtags sa dgra non pa'i lha blos mi 'khyud cing dpag tu med pa bzhugs te/ de dag gi rang bzhin 'phags pa rnams kho nas mthong ba'i chos so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /

126 sgru rte /gzhan yang tshad ma'iskyes bu mang po'inyams snang cidang mngon sum gyi — gzigs pas kyang 'di ltar grub pa'i gtan tshigs mang du snang ngo / /gnas 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar tshul yang sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa'i rjes 'gro zhig 'byung bar nges te/ sprul sku grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi ma 'ongs lung bstan las/ phreng rdog 'ga' zhig 'dzin pa phyag rdor gyi/ /sprul pa dgoslong gcig tsam 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'jam mgon chos kyi rgyalapo tsong khajipa'i/ /mdo sngagasabastan pa sprin bar nyi ma 'dra/ /skal ldan padma'i tshal smin 'gyur ba la/ /skabs der nyi maliganyen ni kho bo tsam/ /zhes nyi ma'iganyegagyi mdzad pa ston par gsungs la/ de yang gsung gi mdzad pa'i sgo nas yin zhing / gsang phur bse khrab pa zhal gzigs skabs khyed kyi legs bshad kyis sa steng khyab par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa'i lo rgyus gong du bkod pa sogs kyis shes so/ / sde 'dir lung rtogs kyi bstan pa'i gnas tshad ni rje gong ma'i zhal nas/ phyogs gzhan na bstan pa ming tsam du song skabs kyang nga'i dgon pa 'dir bshad sgrub tshu la bzhin du gnas pa zhig 'ong zhes dang / mchod rten mgo mjug log kyang bang rim dbus gad bus su 'ong zer ba'i dpe ltar 'dzam gling 'jig la thug kyang dgon pa 'di rkyen cung zad tsam la yang brten te gnas 'ong zhes gsungs par bu slobajigong ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun yang thos la pha chos nang tshan ma 'ongs lung bstan le'u las kyang / e ma/bdag gi gnas chen 'di la ni/ /ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar / /

dargon bta 127bstan pa'i me ro bsten par byed/ /'di la'ang gzhan du zer gcig 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /'di la'ang gzhanardzodu zer gcig 'byung zhes pas bstan pa'i gnas tshad bshad ma thag pa de rwa sgrong las gzhan pa'i gnas gcig la yang zer tshul lam bshad tshul gcig yod ces pa'am/bshad tshul 'di'i zur gcig gam zer gcig gnas gzhan la yang sbyar dgos par gsungs shing / de yang dgon gnas 'di la sbyar dgos par dge 'dun khri phrag brgyad 'tshogs pa'i lung bstan sogs gtan tshigs du mas 'grub po/ /'di la'ang zhes pa'i 'ang sgras 'di tsam du ma zad dkon mchog 'bangs kyi skyes rabs las gsungs pa'i lung bstan de yang gzhan dang thun mong yin par bstan/ 'di skyes rabs de brtsams pa'i rjes nas yin te/ 'di /nyid las/ nga yi chos grwa rwa sgrong ni/ /rgyal ba khyed kyis gsal bar bstan/ /da ni zlos la dgos ma mchis/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang glegs bam las/ chos rgyal snyarma kirnyi yis/ /rgyal mtshan stod du chos grwa spel/ /zhes pa gtsang gi bkra shis lhun po dang /mdo smad kyi dgon lung byams pa gling la sbyar ba dang / des mtshon nas lung pastan gyi tshig re res bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu du ma dang / chos grwa du ma ston tshul sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas lung bstan snang bas/ blo chung sbug 'thum pa'i skyon ngan rgyang ring du bsrings ( bsring )bar bya ste/ le'u 'di nyid kyi mjug tu jo bo'i zhal nas/ la la zhib po zhib po byung / /la la 'brel can 'brel can byung / la la zur tsam go re byung / /la la don gyis bstan te byung / /zhes dang / 'brom gyi zhal nas/ jo bos

128 dargon gi rta da pang mdzod grogs po rnams/ /de ring yod nges dam pa rnams/ /gang nas zin zin thor bur bsgrags/ /de la nyes gang mthol lo bshags/ /la la chad dang lhag srid na'ang / /dgos pa'i dbang yin nongs pa med/ /dngos su bstan dang shugs la byung / /la la bsres pa nyid du bstan/ rta/de nyid dgos pa'i dbang nyid yin/ dgos ldan bshad pa gang yin pas/ci /bka' gdamakha/ phyogs mthar rgyas par shog /ces gsungs pa ltar daphyad shes par gyis shig 'o na gong du de ring yod nges dam pa rnams zhes gsungs na kun mkhyen chen po de dus jo bo'i 'khor du bzhugs par ga las shes zhe na/ bka' gdams ma 'ongs lung bstan las khu na re/ thams cad dus mnyam 'ong ngam/ dus tha dad par 'ong sprum/ gzhan gyis 'gal bar mi sems sam/ bshes gnyen pa na re/ 'gal na'ang mi 'gal na'ang / dpon slob bcu bcu tsam la sprul pa bo gcig las med pa yong / la la'i tshe'i mgo la/ la lalimajug tsam yang / jo bo'i zhal nas khye'u dkar po 'di la da lta pod ( bod )na bkod pa drug cu rtsa lnga mthong / khye'u ser po na re nga la bkod pa dgu bcu mchis zhes pa 'brom dang pono to bar shes par gyis/ da dung lung bstan bkral danyos pasto mang du yod spyang glegs bam las phal cher gab pa mngon byung ltos/ 'been las ringagyidu mda' ma 'phen zhes gsungs pa ltar btang snyoms su cazhag sho /'dir smras pa/ ngo mtshar dag pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams kyi/ /bkra shis dge mtshan mtha' dag dus gcig tu/ /rab 'khyil dpal dang 'byor ba'i nor bu'i mdzad/ /tshangs

dason jirtangabasprab ———— 129spyod 'dus pa'i banyi gnas 'di rmad byung / /der nirab 'byams rgyal bsras bcasakyis/ /ched brjod tshig gi sbrang rtsi'i dog pa can/ /lung bstan me tog dkar bo'i phreng 'thor bas/ skye dgu'i sgra 'dzin bung ba mngon dga' thob/ /ma smad bshad sgrub ga bur zer phreng gis/ /lung bstan kurdo bzhad pa'i gnyen gcig bu/ /smra ba'i zla ba kun mkhyen mchog de yi/ /bka' drin bsam tshe lus skyes gar thabs 'gyed/ /kye ho yongs rdzogs thub pa'i bstan/ rdzogs ldan dpal la 'gran pa yi/ /skal bzang mgron du nyer khug pa/ /bdag cag dga' ba skyed pa'i rigs/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gnas der dgon sde ji ltar chags pa'i tshul ni/ de yang spyir bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar gnyis su grags pa'i snga dar la lha tho tho ri'i ring la bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ chos rgyal srong btsan gyi ring la chos dge bcu'i srol btod/ khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho dang / slob dpon padma sasnya wa spyan drangs nas mkhan slob chos gsum gyis bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i lo rgyus grags che la/ de'i tshe mdo smad kyi ljongs 'di nyid kyang slob dpon gyi zhabs kyis bcags nas lha 'dre dam la btags pa sogs kyis phyogs mtha' dag tu slob dpon gyi zhabs rjes dang phyag rjes su grags pa mang du yod la/ yul gru chags pa ni bod dang hor gyi sa srung gi tshul du chags par bshad pa yod kyang bstan pa snga dar nas bzung ste da lta'i bar du bshad sgrub kyi rgyun ma nub par bzhugs —pa bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal

130 dgon rta ba ma gyi rnam thar sogs las shes so/ / mdo smad la byang rgyud dang lho rgyud gnyis su yodapas / /byang rgyud la rab byung bcu ba'i sa stag gi lo sogs nas rim gyi (gyis )sku 'bum du gnas gzhi tsam chags shing 'brug lo rgyal sras don yod chos kyi rgya mtshos dgon lung byams pa gling btab/ chu byi lo 'dul ba chos rje 'od zer rgyamatshos sku 'bum du mtshan nyid grwa tshang tshugs/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags yos lo se chen hung tha'i jis sbyin bdag byas te btsan po don 'grub rgya mtshos gser dgon dam chos gling btab/ de gong chos rje don grub rin chen gyis bya khyung dgon btab par rab byung bcu ba'i chu phag la chos rje bstan pa rin chen gyis mtshan nyid tshugs pa sogs phal cher lnga brgya phrag bcu'i nyis stong bzhi brgya ma song tsam nas nyis stong bzhi brgya nyag ma sum cu'i skor la chags pa sha stag yin zhing / lho rgyud la rong po dgon sogs dgon dang sgrub sde phran tshegs re yod kyang / yongs su grags pa'i chos sde chen po rgyal bas lung bstan pa ni dpal ldan bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i gling 'di nyid kho na 'gran zla dang dpe zla bral ba kho nar nges te/ gnas bgrang gis mi lang ba yod pa phal cher yang bkra shis 'khyil gyi phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su kho ra khor yug gi tshul du yod do/ /de yang sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la klu'i rgyal po ma dro sa pas dung phul ba re zhig dge 'dun gyi chos dung mdzad/ de nas rgyal ba tsong kha ba'i dgon gnas 'brog ri bo cher gter du sbas pa ltar/ gnas 'dir yang chos sde 'di lta bu 'byung bar dgongs nas ma cig lab kyi sgol —

gen ra tadzo 31 ma yum sras kyis zhabs kyis bcags shing gter sbod pa sogs mdzad pa yin te/ de yang ma cig de nyid la bu slob rnams kyis bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib kyi lung bstan zhus pa na/ bstan pa mar 'grib lugs dang / de nas rje rin po che'i bstan pa dar tshul/ de nas mtha' dbus su chos sde chen po du ma 'byung tshul/ khyad par du a zhes bya ba'i yul du nyan thos kyi dgon chen khyad par can 'byung ba dang / der yum sras rnams kyis bstan pa skyong bar lung bstan pa na/ 'khor rnams kyis yum sras de rnams yul phyogs dang sa phyogs ci 'drar 'byung ba dang / bshad sgrub kyi 'phrin las dzee'aphel 'grib ji ltar 'byung ba sogos zhib tu zhus lan gyi sgo stonas rgyas par gsungs pa'i mthar yum sras so sos rang rang gi thugs bskyed dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus babs dang btsūn pa'i smon lam btab ste snyegater rdzas bsags/ phod bsnyon rdo rje seng ges gter bum bzos/ thod bsnyon bsam 'grub kyis gter lcibs kyis btum/ stong sde ngag gi dbang phyug sogs kyis gter yig bris te phul/ ma cig gis gter bum la rgya btab ste yum sras gnas 'dir rdzu 'phrul gyis byon/ phyogs 'dir zhabs kyis bcags te g.ya' ri'i rmog lung bar du rkang gis byon/ der klu bdud nag po'i pho brang yod pa/ 'og tu pha bong bong bu nyal ba 'dra ba dang chu mig gru gsum pa yod pa/ phug pa'i byang phyogs na brag seng ge kha byang phyogs su bltas nas nyal ba 'dra ba/ lam gyi ri rgyud na mchod rten brtsegs pa 'dra ba yod pa'i sar sbas te/ chos rgyal dang / gnyan mgon zhal bzhi ba gnyis la gtad de yusausras rnams slar yang elalab tu

132 sgrun rta tab ma/rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs pa yin zhes kun mkhyen mchog nas sngon gnas rjes dran gyi tshul du bstsal pa bu slob rim byon gyi gsung rgyun ltar bris so/ /dus ni lab sgron gyi 'khrungs lo la mi mthun pa mang du yod pa las me yos la 'khrungs pa'i dbang du byas na dgung lo gya drug dang / chu rtar 'khrungs pa'i gya gsum/ chu lug la 'khrungs pa'i gya gnyis bzhes pa rab byung gsum pa'i shing 'brug lo nag zla'i tshes bcu'i nyin gter sbas par gter —yig dang bstan rtsis las gsungs so/ / de yang / a zhes pa'i yul gsungs pa ni/ bsang gzhung zhes pa'i ming a mes ge sar gyis bsang btang ba'i dbang gis thogs par yul skad la grags pas a mes kyi ming yig dang po zer ba ltar na/ chos skyong 'ga' zhig gi lung bstan las/ a mes ming legs dgon gnas 'phel rgyas che/ /zhes pa dang 'grig la spang ser po gser gyi maṇḍal yod//ces pa ltar/ spang ljongs zur chag nas bsang gzhung du grags par 'ga' zhig gis bshad cing / gong ma'i rnam thar du spang stod ces bris pa yang snang bas dpyad par bya'o/ /des na bkra shis kyi skad dod a tha dang / 'khyil ba'i skad dod a brta zhes pa'i ming yig dang po la go dgos gsungs par rnam thar dang gsung rgyun las 'byung ba ltar yin te/ a rig dang a mchog sogs kyi ming zur la a yig yod kyang gang thad nas 'grig dka' bas so/ /'ga' zhig gis a rig ra rgya sgogs na sa bkra legs po zhig yod tshul gsan nas sa rtagasaudagos gsungs par g.yo 'phrul gyis bye ma zhig phul nas sa thams

dargo5 rta bta 133cad 'di ltar snang zhes zhus pas btang snyoms su bzhag zer ba ni mi bden par nges te/ de dus 'di phyogs kyi dpon khag phal cher bstan pa la shin tu gus shing / rje 'di la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'gashes yod pa dang / rang phyogs kyi sa char dgon pa re thebs na snyam pa kun la yod pas dbuske skor byed mi srid cing / rnam pa gcig tu bye ma sa rtags la phul na yab de tsam la mkhas grub chen po 'di lta bu mgo 'khor ba ga la srid/ der ma zad mer gan dā'i ching gis zhus pa'i bsang mchod kyi nang du/ rtochen sbom ra 'khor bcas spyi dang ni/ /khyad par a mes khyung mgon 'khor bcas kyis/ /bsang mchod gtor ma 'di bzhes dpon chen po/ /yab yum sras bcas stobs 'byor mnga' thang skyed/ /ces dpon sa 'di nyid kyi sras brgyud bcol dan mdzad pa ltar/ dpon ju nang phyin chad du ching wang gi dpon sa 'dzin pa rnams rigs brgyud de nyid las thon pa kun gyi mngon sum gyis grub pa 'di bzhin dang / bde mo thang du sa brtag bslang skabs gnyan rje gong sngon la bsang brtsams pa'i nang du/ dge 'dun mchod gzhis mi nor 'khor bcas rnams/ /khyed la gnyer gtad bsrungs (srung )skyob spel mdzod la/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ da lta yul der dga' ldan chos 'khor gling chags pa dang / de bzhin du mtho(mdzod )dge smad kyi gur dkar la/ nye 'khor gyi 'dus sde bcol dan gyi bsang mchod ltar/ da lta de'i nye 'khor du dasha' ldan rab rgyas gling chags pa sogs ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi gnas tshul rnams mngon sum du gzigs rnya par the tshom med nges kyi gtan tshigs mang༄ yod kyang 'dir de tsam mo/ /

134 rgo ju pata phyis su gter ji ltar bton pa'i tshul yang bri na/ — kun mkhyen chen po de nyid nas dgon pa gsadzo'adebs kyi lonas gter 'di ltar6sbas pa dran pa'i tshul mardzod nas 'don dgos kyi gsung bgros mang du phebs kyang thugs brel gyi dbang gisaritshwa'agyangs sgye lus pa las/ sa khyi'i dpyid gter 'don pa'i ched de phyogs su byon/ gter kha noor ba'i tshul dang / ma rnyed pa'i tshul gyis der bzhugasaspus sgo mang bla mas gter 'don pa la 'gro zhes 'ur lang gis phyogs phyog sa na sa mjal mi lung ba'i8phu mdar mi shong ba 'dus/ chos skyong gnyis dang klu bdud kyi gsol mchod brtsams te bsang btang bas chos skyong gnyis bya rog gi rnam par byon te shug sdong gi lo ma phra mo bcad nas 'phangs pa'i sar btsal ba na gter khang gi sgo dngos gzhi rnyed de/ gter spyan drangs shul du dzam lha 'brug zhon gyi bum gter sba bar mdzad/ de nas bapo shis 'khyil du byon skabs grwa mang gisaser sbrengs kyis bsus te mjal kha zhus pa na gter nas spyan drangs dze'i tsherdzodapag med kyi sku dang gter bum gyis mjal kha gnang nyin gcig shog ser gyi ngos nas bshu ba'i ched du kun mkhyen mchog nas gzims khang gi steng shod du dbu zhwa paṇa zhwa zhig mnab nas bzhugs/ mkhan po no mon han dang / rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs dpalazildan gnyis zhabs phyi byas nas bzhugs yod pa dge bshes ngag dbang bsod nams rgya mtshos dgon pa'i rgyab kyi skor lam nas mig gis mthong zhing gter yig nas zur du phyung ba'i lung bstan 'gag sdom gyi mjug tu/ gter shog ser rgyal mkhan po blo bzang don grub dang / rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan

dargon dzi rta btab / sdu36gnyis kyis bklags nas nged kyis bris pas so/ /zhes gsungs mkhan yang kun mkhyen mchog nyid yin zhes dge bshes de nyid kyis gsungs par bdag gi bla ma snyan brgyud mnga' bdag ngag dbang grags pa rin po cheli zhal nas dngos su thos so/ / gter rdzas bu slob dang sbyin bdag rnams la gnang sbyin mdzad cing /de skabs zhal nas thu ( thu'u )bkwan tshang dang nged tshos gter mnyam du‘ sbas pa yin pas/ thu'u bkwan tshang la sku skal bskur dgos gsungs nas/rje thu'u bkwan pa ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho la gter skal bskur ba na/khong nas nga la gter rdzas bskur ba thugs rje che yang / gter yig sped dgos pa'i nongs pa med ces zhus pa'i lan du/ gter 'don cung zad 'gyang nas lung bstan 'ga' zhig sngar thal zin/ 'ga' zhig dus babs kyi bar du sbed dgos sogs kyis khrom bsgrags ma byas pa yin/gter yig gi yong lugs 'di 'dra zhig snang zhes don tshan gyi 'gag sdom zur du bris pa'i shog dril zhig kyang gnang 'dug la/ gter rdzas sogs kyang da dung nged kyi lag tu yod ces mi dbang gtsug gi nor bus (bu )ma rnyi pakṣi thu'u bkwan hu thog thu blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal nas dngos su thos so/ /gter gzhan mang po yang yod par ngag rgyun du smreng ba bden par sems te/ gter yig de nyid nas zur du bton pa'i lung bstan 'gag sdom las/ e ma ho/dam pa khyod kyi skal ba'i gsang gter ni/ /gzhan du zin mod kha byang 'di bzhin 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /phyis su 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po'i dus su mtsho bzhi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / mkhas pa 'bri

136 dgon——— matab gung mi gsum du grags pa'i grub thob 'ga' zhig byon spos yul 'di'i klu bdud btsan gsum dam la btags shing / de dag gi kha gnon du mgar ba'i sol khung du grags pa'i gnas khang du mgar gyi ti dzar grags pa'i mchod rten mgo mjug bzlog par brtsigs pa dang / mthon po'i mdo dung g.yas 'khyil gyi mtshan ma yod sar gter 'ga' zhig sbas pa dang /gnas 'di'i brag lha mgon po'i gdong du mgon po zhal gzigs te sgar yang brag la thim pa dang / phyogs 'di'i sa 'dul gyi rdo 'bum dang lab tse 'ga' zhig brtsigs pa dang / brag dkar dang seng ge brag shel dgon sogs kyang byin gyis brlabs tshul gyi lo rgyus 'ga' zhig mthong mod kyang 'dir ma bris la/ lo rgyus der 'bri gung mi gsum gyi slob ma 'ga' zhig gis grub pa thob pas reb gong gyub pa thob pa'i gnas brgyad du grags pa byung tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus 'dug spyang 'thad bar mi sems te/ rje grub pa'i dbang phyug skal ldan rgya mtsholigasung mgur las/ bod kha ba can gyi sa phyogs su/ /dpal u rgyan padma 'byung gnas phebs/ /spyir mkha' 'gro'i gnas sgo grangs med phye/ /sgos cig char sprul pa brgya phrag gis/ /shar gnya' gong gnas chen brag dkar dang / /gnas bcu gcig shel gyi dgon pa sogs/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i pho brang brgya phrag gi /sgo phye zhing lha 'dre dam la btags/ /sngon a mdo'i bstan pa snga dar dus/ /yul reb gong gi grub thob gnas brgyad tses/ /mtshan snyan pa nyi zla lta bur grags/ dku /zhes grub thob gnas brgyad ni snga dar gyi dus nas yod par gsungs shing / 'bri gung dgon ni bstan pa phyi dar rab byung gsum

dargon ta ma 137pa'i sa phag la btab par chos 'byung dang bstan rtsis du ma las gsungs la brag lha mgon po yang gdod nas grub pa'i gnas su 'jigs byed chos 'byung las gsungs pas so/ /des na yang dag dang ltar snang 'dres pa'i gtam 'di 'dra la legs par brtag dpyad gal che'o/ /de ltar kun mkhyen chen po de nyid dus gsum rjen par gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi mnga' bdag yin pas de lta bu'ilung bstan gyi dus la babs phar ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs nas/ ri bo dge 'phel du bzhugs skabs nas tshul der rkyen sel mgyin sgrub kyi spyan dmigs kyang cher mdzad pa yin snang ste/mdo smad du bzhugs skabs/ khya dge sgom chen blo gros rgya mtshos dge 'dun 'du ba'i 'khor lo sgrub tshul gyi dri ba zhus par brten/ 'khor lo de sgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag la de'i dbang gis 'dus pa'i dge 'dun thams cad gang du skyes kyang btsan thabs kyis mtho ris su 'dren thub pa zhig spyo dgos sogs 'khor lo'i rgyu mtshan 'khor rnams la mang po gsungs pa'i zhar la/ nga rang gis 'khor lo de snga mo dge 'phel nas bsgrubs song dge 'dun yang khri tsho brgyad 'a dzogs pa'i mtshan ma shar/ zhes gsungs pa dang / yang dge 'phel du brtags pa mdzad pa zhig gi skabs su grwa tshang gsar du tshugs pa'i thog mar grwa ba mang po 'dug kyang phal cher na bza' ngan zhing pags pa'i thul ba gyon pa dang phu thung ma yang re gnyis 'dug pa rmis shing phyis su yang de bzhin byung bar rnam thar du gsal ba ltar ro/ /kun mkhyen chen po de nyid la rang bstan gyi sbyin bdag thun mong ma yin

138 rgo ji —sda ba sna— dzha— ske —— pa o rod jun gararshagyi phyogs nas rgyal po jo jug thu hung thasdzaji/ radapon phun tshogs ba kra shis sogs kyis gdan 'a dren gyi zhu ba snga phyir phul ba dang /rje 'phrin las lhun grub pasakyang btsan dgon du phebs dgos kyi bka' 3 nagaganang ba dang / 'di phyogs su yang dga' ldan bo shog tu ju nang dang /gzhan yang rong tsho chen bco brgyad kyi mi chen drag shos du mas gdan 'dren zhu ba phul yang spyan ma 'drongs la/ sngon gyi smon lam dang 'brel ba'i dbang gis mtsho sngon gyi rgyal phran rgyu skar lta bu'i dbus na stobs 'byor mnga' thang zla ba nya gang lta bur gsal ba'i stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen po dga' ldan ernyi dziju nang dbus su phebs skabs rje gong ma de nyid nas dzi'abras spungs sngags khang 'jigs byed bskyar bcos mdzad nas rab gnas kyi yon bdag bgo skabs thog mir mjal bas nga'i khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin khyod yin zhes mnyes mnyes mdzad/ ju nang gis kyang mdo smad du 'byon par gsol ba btab pas/ nga mdo smad du 'ongs na khyod kyis dgon po 'bras spungs tsam zhig 'debs e thub gsungs/ de tsam gyi kha.oṃlen dka' yang dgon chen zhig 'debs rgyu'i khas len 'bul zhus pas thugs mnyes nas phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes dang sngar nas thugs 'dris che ba ltar paṇa chen rin po che dbus su sbyon nas rgyal dbang drug pa pad dkar 'dzin pa bsnyen rdzogs skabs rje 'a dis las gral (grwa )pa mdzad cing / byang phyogs sutshudagon pa 'debs rgyu'i skor zhus par thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad nas/ dga' ldan dam chos bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling zhes mtshan gnang bar bdag

dargon —da rjishata 139gi bla ma khri chen bsod nams dbang rgyal bas gsungs/ des na rje 'di nyid kyi gsung ris du mar res 'ga' dga' ldan dam chos bkra shis 'khyil dang /res 'ga' dga' ldan bshad sgrub bkra shis 'khyil zhes 'byung ba rgyu mtshan des yin nam snyam/ gong gsal zhal bzhes mdzad pa'i lo 'di shing sprel gyi lo yin la me phag gi lo bkra shis sgo mang gi khri zur bzhugs mdzad pa las bod skyong lha bzang han gyis pha bong kha'i mkhan po mdza da dgos zhus par/pha bong kha 'di gnas nyer bzhi'i nang tshan de wi ska ṭi bya ba yin pas bod na sa 'dul gyi gnas 'di las bzang ba med/ srong btsan sgam pos kyang lha sa'i sa 'dul 'di nas mdzad 'dug pas byang phyogs su dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi sa 'dul 'di nas byas na rten 'brel legs par 'dug dgong sa nas zhal bzhes mdzad de/ der zhabs kyi padmo rnam par bkod/sa byi'i ston rgyal po ju nang gis dbal shul dar han dge slong 'phrin las bang chen la btang nas gdan 'dren zhus par lo rjes mar phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang / dgun gyi ring phal cher la byang phyogs su 'byon pa'i gegs sel dang / dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi sa 'dul la dmigs nas sku mtshams mdzad pas dgon pa'i gnas dang 'phel rgyas dang sbyin bdag ji ltar 'byung ba sogs gsal bar gzigs/ pha bong khar bka' rtsom gnang ba mang po yang ma 'ongs pa la gzigs pa'i dgongs gzhi can du mngon/ dgun smad yang bskyar rgyal po ju nang gis dpal 'bub eḍā je sang gdan 'dren la btang / gzhung sa rin po cher de lugs kyi dgongs pa zhus nas lo rjes mar byang phyogs su beebs par thag bcad/ sa glang gi

140 rgo rta ta dpyid rgyal po ju nang gis dbal shul dar han dge slong la khal rta bskur nas bsu bar btang / gzhung gi bka' ltar po ta lar byon nas gzims chung khams gsume zil gnon du bzhugs/ gajims chung bkra shis bkod par thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho dpal bzang por bka' chos mang du gnang / de skabs da phyin chad nged rang tsho gang du song ba'i sa la bkra shis zer ba zhig yong / thog mar bkra shis sgo mang gi bla ma byas/ de nas mchod gzhi bkra shis rtse byung / 'di bkra shisa'abakod pa yin 'dug gsungs pas don gyis bkra shis 'khyil yang lung bstan/ de dus gzhung nas kyang dga' ldan khri rin po che dang mnyam pha'i bkur gzos dang 'bul ba tshad med pa bstabs shing de dang cha mtshungs par 'bras spungs su phebs skabs bla ma rnams dang tshogs chen dge bskos sogs las sne mang mas chibs bsu dang / grwa mang gis ser sbrengs so gas rgyal ba rin po che phebs pa'i lugs ltar gus 'dud lhur blangs pas da lta sdobar du cher rlom phal cher zil gyis gnon bzhin pa 'di'o/ /de nas phebs chas sogs gra sgrig dang grwa sa grwa tshang so sor mang 'gyed spyi 'jog sogs gya nom pa gnang / dga' gdong rtsos skyong zha sa/ spyo ཿbyang phyogs mun pa'i sha zan gyi rgyal pos pho nya mngags pa la brten nas slob dpon gyi chibs kha byang phyogs su bsgyur skabs 'dre'i gnas khang du rib tsam phebs nas dngos mjal gnang na rten 'brel gyi legs tshogs shin tu che bas cis kyang phebs par zhu/ zhes snyan sbrin phul par brten/ dga' ba gdong du byon/ chos skyong gis bsus nas kha dar phul/ rje

dargon dzi rta btab tho / 141nyid kyis tshan grangs sogs phul te 'phrin bcol mdzad pa'i lan du/sdi ཿyid dga' chos 'dzin rgyal ba'i gdan sa nas/ /sras kyi thu bo sdom brtson 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /byams brtse'i spyan gyis rgyun chad med pa ru/ /dngos su gzigs pa 'jam mgon blo bzang grags/ /mgon khyod deng nas byang chub ma thob par/ /gus pas 'dud rdo brtse ba'i lcags kyus zungs//sngon bka' gdams klu mes dus nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen ston pa chen po/ gzugs med dregs pa dang 'brel ba'i yang srid/ rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo/ zhing 'dir srid gsum rnam rgyal 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i phyir bsam bzhin du ngur smrig gar gyis rnam par rol pa'i tshul bzung ba'i slob dpon dang lha tshes de ring mjal ba/ gzugs med shing bya can nga yang skal ba bzang zhing spro ba che ste/ re zhig zhing 'di'i gdul bya ma rdzogs pas cha shas tsam bzhugs par 'os na yang / nag po'i pho nyas dus btab ste chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur bar nged cag chos skyong dregs pa'i tshogs kyang khren cha shin tu che na'ang / da lam sha zan gyi rgyal po'i bkod pa bzlog tu dka' zhing / byang phyogs rgya hor yul gyi sems can rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi bgo skal stsol pa'i dus 'a 'ang babs pas/ chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba la bgegs rigs bar chad kyi mtsha na ma cher med pas 'dres kyang rnam pa kun tu 'phrin las gang drag e 'byung lta/ dgon pa yang bkra shis 'khyil zer ba zhig la btab na legs zhes mi 'gyur rdo rje'i tshig gi lung bsgrags shing / de mtshungs 'bras

142 dargon ta / spungs chos skyong gis kyang lung phebs dang g.yar dmadzobazang po gnangatsho/ chos skyong gnyis nas khog zhugs dgos na gsobu re phul dang 'bod pa sto — btang res kyis 'ong zhes gsungs par 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub na /khog zhugs la ltos pa med zhus/ 'o na gzugs med bsang gsur la re bas bsang mchod re gyis dang 'phrin las nam yang g.yel ba med ces gsungs pas phyis su chos skyob gnyis ka la gsol mchod brtsams shing / spyibla brang nas chag med gtong bzhin pa 'di lags so/ / drug pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin 'bras spungs nas lha sar chibs bsgyur mdzad/ lha sar mchod mjal dang bstan pa rgyas pa'i bsngo smon gang rgyas gnang / tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin lha sa nas chibs bsgyur mdzad/ ri.oṃ gyis phebs pas lam bar gyi grong ba'i skye bo mtha' dag gis bsnyen bkur gyis mngon par mchod/ de dus bar khams kyi sa cha thams cad mtsho sngonasgenghrus 'dzin bzhin pa yin pas bdun pa'i nyi shu skor la rdza chu mob na rgyal po ju nang gi su rug yod pa'i steng du phebs par bsu skyel dang bsnyen bkur zhabs tsā tog phun sum tshogs pa zhus/ brgyad pa'i tshes la 'bri chu brgal zhing ri0gyis phebs par dpon tshang nas mtsho so lo ma'am skar ma thang zhig nas bsu rtsis kyis bsu ba dang por bstan pa dge slong dpon g.yog btang /so lo ma 'dzur nas zhag gsum tsam song ba na stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba dga' ldan ernyi ni ju nang / sras don grub dbang rgyal/ dpon rnam rgyal tshe brtan sogs kyis thog drangs rta ba sum brgya tsam chibs bsur 'byor zhing yon mchod rnams mjal phrad mdzad/ dpon tshang na sa gdugs/

/ dargono/de — —rna—ḍirdodi— tram̐/ 143rgya gling dung chen sogs phul bar/ zhal nas/ nga ri khrod pa tshe blos btang zhig la de 'dra mi dgos kyang / gdul bya tshogs rdzogs ched du sangs rgyas kyis gnang yod pas chog gsungs/ de nas bzung gzims brda sogs bla chen gyi srol bzhin btang / gzhan yang khal rta sogs gang dgos 'bad med du phul bas dpon slob thams cado thugs mnyes/ de nas mi'i dbang mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma sogs bla chen dpon chen mi chen gyi bsu ba lho sprin gyi 'gro 'ong lta bu bar ma chad pas bsus te dgu pa'i tshes la dang po'i mdor unde'i steng du phyag phebs/ dpon tshang nas ston chen phul zhing rim gyis rmugs 'dzin gyi bang mdzod kha phye ba lta bu'i bdog pa sna tshogs pa'i yo byad kyis dpon slob thams cad ci yang brel ba med par nyams dga' bag phebs par bzhugs/ phyogs ris med nas mjal ba zad mi shes pa lta bu nyin bar ma chad du byung ba'i khrod nas/ rkang tsha'i dka' bcu/ rgan gya paṇḍi ta/ 'bo ra mthu stobs sogs kyis dgon pa 'debs yul gyi ched du bkra shis 'khyil dang rgan gya brag dkar/ rgya sgar thang sogs phul bar thugs mnyes pa'i bka' phebs gnang /uṅge steng du zhabs brtan gyi grwa tshang zhig yod par zhwa zlam sogs dang bcas te tshogs pa'i srol btod cing gsang sngags smin rgyas gling zhes ming 'dogs pa gnang /lngamachod kyi nyin dpon tshang nas grwa tshang gi tshogs dbur spyan drangs te/ gser gyi maṇḍal la gser gyi tshom bu brkod pas thog drangs/ rin ri po che dang cha spyad du ma/ gos chen dar yug mogs kyi tshan grangs lnga brgya spya rta rnor lnga brgya/ lug stong phrag bzhi sogs zhabs brtan gyi 'bul ba rgya

144 dargon thotab che zhing dpang (dpangs )mtho ba phul/ des mtshon phyogs mtha' dag nas dad ldan gyi skye bo sprin ltar 'dus pas zang zing gi 'bul ba char bab pa lta bu byung / lo 'di rje rin po ches dga' ldan btab pa'i lo yin pas rten 'brel gyi khyad kyis dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi skar 'dzin tsam byed dgos gsungs pa ltar bu slob kha shas gnyan rje gong sngon gyi ri zhol du phebs naspo bkra shis kyi gso sbyong dang sa brtag bslang shis brjod bcas rgyas par gnang zhing rten 'brel kyang shin tu legs zhes grwa rgan rnams gleng /kun mkhyen rin po che nyid nas dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi ched du lo deli dgun yongs rdzogs dang / lo rjes ma lcags stag gi dpyid zla dang po gnyis la sku mtshams mdzad nas gsum pa'i tshes gcig la grol/ rtse mdor thugs dam gyi rten byams pa'i sku zhig bzhugs pa byams mgon dngos su gyur nas ma 'ongs lung bstan du ma gnang bas byams sku de la rtse gzhung byams pa zhes da lta bla brang thub bstan pho brang gi gzims khang —bsam 'grub rnam rgyal gyi yang rtser bzhugs shing gnas der bka' rtsom skyi gnang ba phal cher la mi pham mdun sa theg chen chos kyi gan mdzod du sbyar zhes dang / bzhugs sgar gyi gnas de la bkra shis chos rdzong zhes 'do gas par mdzad/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin bzhugs sgar bteg nas sha pho ru rtse'i mdor phebs/ gnas 'di ming bkra legs shing chu yang g.yas bskor du 'bab pas sa dpyad legs pa dang / tshes bco lnga ston pas dus 'khor rtsa rgyud dang sher mdo gsungs pa'i dus chen yin pa sogs rten 'brel rang 'grig tu song 'dug pas grwa tshang btsugs pa'i ming

non nta btab ma 146tsam byed dgos gsungs/ tshes bco lnga'i snga dro gso sbyong mdzad de gung tshigs skabs zhabs phyi'i dka' rams rnams dpon tshang nas grwa ba bco lnga phul ba dang bcas dge 'dun brgya lhag tsam chos grwa'i lugs ltar 'tshogs pa la lam rim gyi dbu nas gsung chos mdor bsdus shig bstsal/ brtsi bzhag la bde mchog ṭīka chen/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i ṭīs/ de'i bskyed rdzogs/ 'dul mdzod/ rnam 'grel/ dbu phar bsdus grwa bcas kyi brtsi bzhag nyin bco lnga'i ring la ma chag par gnang ste mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ chos grwa sku rim sogs sgo mang grwa tshang ltar gyis zhes bka' phebs pa ltar lag len la btab/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin chos mtshams byas/ chos thog gi sbyin bdag dpon tshang nas gnang zhing sku zhabs su 'bul chen dang grwa ba rnams la mang 'gyed gya nom pa phul/ lo snga ma'i dgun dbus su 'tshams zhus la mngags pa'i mi sna chos thog gi mjug tsam la phyir 'byor bar rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku zhabs nas kun mkhyen mchog la sgo mang arnyi ni no mon han zhes pa'i mtshan dang dbugadugs tham ga sogs chen por 'os pa'i gzengs bstod mdzad 'dug par dpon tshang nas dga' spro'i ston mo dang legs 'bul bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ zla ba de ka'i tshes gsum gyi nyin dgon gnas 'tshol ba'i ched du dpon slob rnams dang dpon ju nang yab yum sras bcas chibs bsgyur nas rim gyis rong phyogs su phebs/lam bar de dag tu'ang brtsi bzhag gnang rgyu ma byung na yang rje dge 'dun grub kyi phyag len ltar chos grwa'i srol ma nyams pa byed dgos gsungs nas

17 —gigi———sdo shaṃ——dipaṃspro kyizhogs ko chos grwa grol nas sgar btegs/ dgung mo sku rim dang rtsod grwa sogs choblu thog ltar byas/ de skabs tog ti'i bde mo thang dudagos pa du ma'i ched du bkra shisari kyi gsocisbyong dang sa brtag bslang lto 'phye'i thig btab nas sa brko ba sogs mdzad pas gnas der phyis su bde mo dga' ldan chos 'khor gling chags/ rgya sgar thang du 'bo ra dang tsa yus rgan gsum so sos dgon pa 'debs dgos zhus par slar btab chog gsungs pa ltar/ 'bo ra sngon po thang durnadaga' ldan bshad sgrub gling chags/tsa yus lung bar yang ma 'gyangs par dgon mags/ rab 'byams pa mchog ldan sogs gtsos dpon po skya ser rnams kyis rgya mkhar sgar phul ba phyis su mtshan nyidacigrwa tshang tshugs te dga' ldan dam chos gling zhes grags/ rgya mkhar sgar du mdzod dge smad/ kyi bla dpon mjal bar 'ong ba rnams la lung bstan pa ltar der bkra shis chos 'phel gling chags/ dpon pho us jing tha'i jis kha gya'i dgon pa phul nas mtshan nyid tshugs tsho dgos zhus par 'du khang nang nas mkhas dbang smra ba'i seng ge ngag dbang bkra shis dang / rigs pa'i dbang phyug 'gran zla med pa a khyung mkhas mchog rnam gnyis la tshogs gleng byed bcug ste rten 'brel bsgrigs pas phyis su bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge bshes du ma bka' bgros nas po ti lnga'i 'chad nyan tshugs shing / des mtshon gang dang gang du zhabs kyis bcags pa phal cher la phyis su dgon pa re chags/ — kun mkhyen gong mas zhabs kyis ma bcags pa'i phyogs mang por skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nyid ched gnyer gyis phebs te zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa las kyang
