dgon rta bta ma/ 147dgon sde du ma gsar du chags pas/ da lta mdo smad lho rgyud kyi phyogs 'di zhwa ser 'chang ba'i dge 'dun gyis khyab par gyur te / mdo sngags kyi bshad sgrub skyong bzhin pa 'di lags so / /bsang gzhung du phebs nyin sgrog mdor rkang tsha'i dka' bcu sogs rkang tsha'i rta ba mang po chibs bsur 'ongs te bkra shis 'khyil du phebs rgyu'i zhu ba phul bar kun mkhyen rin po ches nged rgan gya'i paṇḍi tas brag dkar du gdan drangs nas/ mthen po la bud nas 'gro rtsis yin/ ba skru shis 'khyil la 'di nas ka tsam 'gro dgos gsungs par/ thag nye lugs dang de nas brag dkar du phebs chog pa sogs zhus pas/ zhal gyis bzhes/ rim gyis gnas gzigs mdzad pas gad pa lug mang dang gzhi mo gle drug gnyis gnas bzang po 'dug mkhar lung klad sa dpyad legs kyang mkhar chen gyi phung shul yin pas dgon gnas la mi legs gsungs/de ni mi nyag si'u rgyal po'i gdung rabs bdun pa mi nyag rgyal rgod kyi dus su yul 'dir mkhar gzhi mang po yod pa bod la rgyal por grags pa sgro ring mdo brtan zer bas dgra thabs kyis bcom par grags pa ltar te zhar byung tsam mo bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas khri thog tu bzhugs 'phral sku zhang za yu ba rnams kyis gsol zho dang bcas mjal kha zhus pa la zho 'di bkra shis pa'i rdzas yin pas rten 'brel legs zhes dbu mdzad chen mo la 'dren pa mnyam med ma 'then gsungs nas thams cad kyis 'then par mdzad/ de nas rkang tshas ston mo mdor bsdus shig phul ba'i thog rgan gya'i paṇḍi ta mjal

148 dargon tab dzā /bar 'ongs/ paṇḍi tas gnas 'di dpyad shin tu legs stabs brag dkar la dgon pa 'debs rgyu mi yong snyam nas rkang tsha dang za yu ba rnams la mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur mang tsam byas par grags/ ston mo zin phral zho dkar yol gang mdun cog steng du bzhag ste chibs thog nas mdun ri la phebs/ gser nya yin zer ba'i ri chung 'bur bo gnyis yod pa'i steng du bzhugs nas gnas gzigs mdzad/ ra rong chos grags kyi skuliskye b.ragrags pa mdzod dge sku skye sa dpyad kyi ched du zhabs phyir khrid yod pas/khyod song la rgyab ri dang g.yas g.yon gyi sa'i zung sogs ga nga cir dpyad pa zhib mo gyis gsungs/ de nas mdzod dge sku skyes kyis gsung ltar ri so soringos nas dpyod pa zhib tu byas te slar sku mdun du 'ongs nas rgyab ri 'di glang chen nyal ba la yid bzhin gyi rtsor bu bkal ba lta bu'iri byin chags pa zhig 'dug ces sogs sa dpyad zhib tu zhus par/ de ltar yin gsungs nas thugs dgyes dgyes mdzad/ paṇḍi tas rgyab ri sa la smug zhag med pa'i thal skya zhig 'dug byang ngos sa shor 'dug zhus par/ glang chen thal dkar zer ba ma tshor ram/ khyod paṇḍi ta yin pa bung gsungs/ de nas yig chen lam shar la bud/ bkra shis lung dkar la phebs/gnas gzigasaumadzad phas 'dir dgon pa btab na longs spyod 'phel ba darnga dar rgyas che yang / rgyab ri glang chen lang yod pa lta bu yin pas ha cang brtan chags pa mi yong ba 'dug 'on kyang bkra shis 'khyil du ri glang chen nyal ba 'dra ba yod ba dang / 'dir glang chen lang ba 'dra ba yod pazuni/ 'brom gyis/ glang chen 'gying dang bzhugs 'dra ba/ /

dgoje ra btab ma/ 149mthar thug bsam gtan lhun grub shog /ces pa'i smon lam gyi thog tu babs pas legs zhes gsungs/ de nas bkra shis ska rags brgyud nas bya lag mdor phebs/ maṇḍal gyi nags la gzigs nas/ nags 'di la dbyar gsum sngon po g.yu yi mdog /ston gsum ser po gser gyi mdog /dgun gsum dkar po shelasagyi mdog /dpyid gsum khra bo gzi yi mdog 'char ba yin/ 'di la dgon pa'i mdun ri byed dgos gsungs/ de nas bkra shis 'khyil la phebs nas/ gad pa lug mang / gzhi mo gle drug bkra shis 'khyil gsum la mar me brtag pa mdzad pas bkra shis 'khyil gyi mar me shin tu legs pa byung / yun yang thog mar gzhi mo gle drug gi mar me dang / de nas gad pa lug mang gi mar me zin/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi mar me nyi ma 'char kha'i bar du bsdad pas rten 'brel legs par byung / de nas bkra shis 'khyil du dgon pa 'debs par thag bcad de bkra shis kyi gso sbyong dang sa 'dul mdor bsdus shig gnang / de yang gser nya'i ri nas tshur gzigs nas lto 'phye'i lte ba gang la babs na legs gsungs par gsol dpon shes rab dpal ldan gyis brag dmar po'i sna rgyud pha ki dmu dag lta bu byas nas sbra zhig phub yod pa der lto 'phye btab na legs zhus pa ltar de dus lto 'phye'i thig 'debs pa gnang ba'i sa mig dngos gzhi ni da lta gser khang chen mo rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs yod pa 'di lags so/ /de nas rkang tsha ba rnams kyis ston mo gang rgyas phul te/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che cha tshang zhig dang grwa ba lnga phul bas thugs shin tu

160 dgon rtar tam tshom/dgyes nas 'di rnams nga'i 'khor lngarnasde yin gsungs pas/ 'khor lnga sde zhes ming yongs grags la thogs pa byung / de yang 'khor lnga sder grags ba gzhan rnams sngar nas 'das zin 'dug kyang 'di'i nang nas a rig brtson 'grus zhes pa dgung lo bdun cu rtsa grangs kyi skabs shig sba 'khar la brten nas phebs te gzims chung thub bstan pho brang du kun mkhyen sku 'phreng gnyis pa 'i zhal dkyil mjal/ maṇḍal dang phyag rten phul nas tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug zhus/ sku mdun der gdan gyi steng du thugs dayol bzhugs nas gshegs song ba phran bu spyo sogs chos nyan pa du mas mngon sum du mthong ste 'phros don tsam mo/ /de nas spyil bo chung ngu zhig byas lkorgyab tshang rab 'byams pa ngag dbang zer ba gnas srung la bzhag nas rgan gya phyogs su phebs/ gnas gzigs mdzad par brag mgo spang gis btum pas mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa 'phel lhami yong ba 'dug 'on kyang bde mchog gi pho brang bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i gnas su snang bas rgyud grwa zhig tshugs na legs gsungs par/ paṇḍi tas ngas mtshan nyid grwa tshang btsugs na dge bshes re e yong snyam pa yin/gsang 'dus 'don mkhan gyi ban rgan nged kyi phyugs rdzi'i khrod na yod ces zhus skad/ phyis su paṇḍi ta khornarang gi 'dod pa ltar mkhas dbang dbyig gya rab 'byams pa ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs pas mtshan nyid kyi grwa tshang btsugs pa bar skabs su chag nyams su gyur pa las/ gung thang mchog sprul rin po che ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pas slar legs par gsos te rgyud grwa rmad du byung ba zhig gsar 'dzugs gnang ba da lta gong

———— dgon btab ma 1kyi 1'phel gyi skabs lags so/ / de phyogs kyi 'gro don zin nas zla ba lnga pa'i tshes la bkra shis 'khyil du phyir phebs/ kun mkhyen chen ponyid nas sa 'dul gyi ched dusku mtshams la bzhugs rgyu yin/ gzhi bdag rnams kyis sa 'di byin na legs ma byin na 'phrog dgos gsungs 'di yang gsung rang ga ba ma yin te/dkyil 'khor gyi don dus bslang bas mi ster na rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis 'phrog dgos par rgyud dang rgya gzhung las gsungs pas so/ /cun gar rab 'byams pa grags pa gzhung nas mdo smad du chibs skyel bar btang yod pa la/ khyod sgo mang gi 'chad nyan pa'i thog ma drung grags pa rin chen pa dang ming mthun pa'i rten 'brel gyi khyad nas nga'i tshab tu re zhig bar la brtsi bzhag thong gsungs pa ltar drung rams pas phar phyin gdong melnga'i sgra dbyangs sogs kyi brtsi bzhag btang nas braco lnga'i chos thog byas/ sku mtshams grol nas gnas 'di'i gzhi bdag thams cad dkar phyogs par snang bas dga' bzhin dunged la gnas ster bar 'dug sngon chad su la yang ma byin par srung bsdad pa 'dra gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang sngon grub pa'i dbang phyug rong bo skal ldan rgya mtsho ba de nyid bkra shis 'khyil 'dir phebs nas rong bo dgon chen btab na dgongs nas brtag pa mdzad pa'i mnal lam du/ grwa ba zhwa mo dang zla gam gyon pa mang po gang nas 'ong cha med par glo bur du 'tshogs nas nged tsho'i sa char khyod kyis ci byed byas pa yin zhes zhwa lag gis deg grabs byed pa sogs mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du ston pa zhig byung bar sa 'di sngon nas gzhan gyis bdag

162 dargo rta ta byas pa'am gzhan gyi dus babs shig la sgug sdod dgos pa yin par snang zhes gsungs par mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun rgya mtshos gsungs zhes de nyid kyi drung yig pa blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal nas thos so/ /de bzhin du byang chub mi las kyang gnas 'dir ri khrod 'debs rtsis gnang bar yang de mthun zhig byung bar de nyid kyi rnam thar grags pa 'od zer gyis mdzad pa na snang ngo / / de yang gna' dus dgon gnas kyi mthil 'di sbrul gdug pas gang ba lta bur yod cing / 'dukhang chen mo'i go sa 'dir yang chu mig mgo mang zhig 'bab pa las kun mkhyen mchog nas dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i klu gnas nas spo ba'i cho ga mdzad pa na sku mdun der sbrul mang po phyogs gcig tu 'dus shing mthar phyogs phyogs su gyes 'gro ba kun gyis mthong zhing / de nas sbrul yang nyung la chu mig gi mgor 'du khang phub chog pa byung ba yin snang ste ma cig gi lung bstan las kyang / dgon gnas dang gter kha klus srung bar bshad pa dang legs par 'grig go /de nas bdun phrag gcig gi ring la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas snga dro zhi ba dang phyi dro rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gang mang mdzad/ de nas rgyud nas bshad pa ltar bum gter bri sgrub byas nas sba ba dang / sgo bzhi'i gsol 'debs/bgegs la bka' bsgo ba sogs sa chog gi skabs ltar ma tshang ba med par bsgrubs nas/ drug pa'i tshes la rtse gzhung du chibs kha bsgyur/ der yang drung rams pas brtsi bzhag btang nas/ zhag bco lnga'i chos thog btsugs/ lo der zla bshol yod pas bdun pa phyi ma'i tshes la grwa tshang gi

dasgru—gednghadnghardorwatab 163gzhi bteg nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ dpon ju nang nas grwa ba brgya/ rnam rgyal tshe brtan nas grwa ba brgya/ mkhan po no mon han dang / edhe dā'i ching gnyis nas grwa ba kha shas re phul ba rnams bkra shis 'khyil du bsdus/ dpon tshang nas phying gur gru bzhi tshogs pa brgyad brgya tsam shong ba cig bzos nas tshogs gur du phul/ de dang dus mtshungs par skya kya'i gcod pa zer bas tshogs khro chen po zhig kyang phul ba sogs gang cilirten 'brel 'grigs/ dka' bcu pa ngag dbang bkra shis tshogs chen dge bskos dang / rje nyid sgo mang bla ma gnang skabs grwa tshang dbu mdzad dang /phyis su 'bras spungs tshogs chen dbu mdzad yang thon pa dpa' ris dbu mdzad chen mo ngag dbang mkhas mchog tshogs chen dbu mdzad du bskos/grwa ba sngar yod rnams dang bcas sum brgya lhag tsam 'dus nas zla ba de kalitshes bcu gsum gyi nyin chos thog tshugs/ bcu bzhi'i nyin zhogs ka bya lag gi thang du tshogs gur phub yod pa'i nang dutshogs la 'tshogs dpa' cig bdud las rnam rgyal tshogarsā 'don du btsugs shing / dpa' cig dang khro bcu dgon pa nam gnas kyi bar dum chag pa byed dgos kyi bka' khyab bstsalasde tshogs grol nas grwa ba rnams bkra shis 'khyil gong mar phebs nas chos grwa sgo mang ltar tshugs/ sgrol 'don grol nas rje nyid nas dka' rams rnams la 'dul mdzod dang / dbu phar gyi brtsi bzhag gsar zhugs snga ma rnams la rang rang gi brtsi bzhag gi mtshams nas bsdus tshan gong ma'i brtsi bzhag gsar bu nyis brgya lhag la kha dog dkar dmar gyi brtsi bzhag gnang / chos thog 'di'iring la nyin re bzhin rje nyid

164 dargo bta /nas brtsi bzhag chag med dang / lam rim chen moribashad lung yang bstsal pa sa bzhugs khri rdo mchod dang bcas pa re zhig bar du yod kyang dus phyis zhing pa rnams kyi spyod pa ma gzo bas sa 'og tu nub pa kho bos legs par gsos rdo sku yang bzhengs yod do/ / de nas dka' rams rgan pa rnams phebs nas/ gsar bu rnams tshan pa tshan pa byas te dge rgan lta burdzitshul du tshig bzhag de bskyar nas gsar bu rnams kyis legs par zin pa dang skyor sbyangs byed bzhin du bkra shis 'khyil 'og mar phebs nas gung tshigs la tshogs pas da lta'i bar du tshogs chos grwa'i phebs lam du brtsi bzhag skyor bzhin phebs pa dang /chos thun re re bzhin du dge bskos nas chos thun snga ma de ka'i brtsi bzhag gi rgyugs rgyun du len pa'i dpe srol bzang po ma nyams par yod pa 'di bzhin lags/ de grol nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas gung tshigs chos grwar 'tshogs pa sogs chos grwa'i 'grig lam sgo mang ltar byas te chos thog tshugs shing brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la chos mtshams byas/ chos thog gi skabs su zhogs gung dgung ja gsum la mang ja bdun re dang / chos mtshams la zhogs gung gnyis kyi mang ja lnga re bla brang nas gtong ba gnang / dpon rin po che nas kha gya tsho drug la shing cha 'dren dubacugarong tsho chen bco brgyad/ rong bo yar nang mar nang / rdo sdis/ jibis mdo/ rnga ba/ ra mdo/ tsha kho sogs nas u lag pa bsdus te 'du khang ka ba brgyad cu ba dri gtsang khang dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i gzhi bzung zhing mang 'gyed nar mar

dgon —lharabata 155bsgrubs/ rtse gzhung dang 'bal gzhung sogs nas kyang sa cha phul zhing /ra mdodud khag lnga brgya skor sogs mchod gzhis thebs su phul/ mkhan po rno mon han nas zho 'phong la dpyi sogs dang / ernyi ni tha'i jis the bo gza' ru sogs mchod thebs su phul/ mtsho sngon yongs kyi gtsug rgyan zhabs drung dkar po rin po ches kyang zhabs spyi bor blangs te rnyed bkur gyi mchod sprin rgya pos mnyes par byas/ mtsho sngon gyi rgyal po a khu bā thur tha'i jis kyang bla mar bzung ste 'bul nod bstabs shing dgon pa'i sa cha'i don du bka' shog kyang gnang / cun gar gyi rgyal pohung tha'i jis kyang rgyang ring bo nas 'bul ba dang zhu yig bar ma chad pa phul zhing dgon par grwa rgyun dang sbyin bdag gi mthun rkyen byed pa'i dam bca' — phul/ meṅgen dā'i ching dang erte dā'i ching sogs mtsho sngon gyi dpon khag rnams dang / mdzod dge dpon po rab brtan sogs bod kyi dpon phran du mas rnyed pa dang bkur ste'i mchod sprin gyis dpon slob sde dang bcas pa mngon par mchod/ khyad par du gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma dā'i ching khang zhi bde skyid rgyal pos/ kun mkhyen rin po cher bstan pa 'dzin zhing skyong bar byed pa'i paṇḍi ta ernyi ni no min han zhes chos kyi rgyal por bsngags pa'i bka' lung dang / dpon dga' ldan ernyi ni ju nang la yang cung wang dang ching wang gi lung dang las kas mngon par bstod de mchod yon zung gi chos srid nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'jig rten khyab par gyur to//smras pa/ dge bcu kun rdang mdo smad nor 'dzin ga zhir/ /dga' ba brgya ldan

156 bshad sgrub bkra shis 'khyil/ /phan bde'i gling du chags pas mtha' yas 'gro/ /nges legs khang bar ngal gso'i skal bzang rnyed/ /bstan 'dzin ngur smrig 'chang ba'i 'dus pa'i sde/ /thub bstan rgyal srid skyong ba'i dam pa'i mgon/ /bsnyen bkur me tog gsar ba'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /phan tshun 'gran pa dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin/ /yid 'phrog gzi byin 'bar ba'i mchog gsum rten/ /phyag mchod gus pa lhur len gdul byasdzatshogs/ /nyes brgya'i nad las grol ba'i byin rlabs mabu/ /bya byed las kyi chos nyid lhun gyis grub/ /der ni mang thos ngang mo 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /bshad sgrub rtsed 'jor rol pas thub bstan gyi/ /chu gter bdag po phan bde'i rlabs phreng stong / /g.yo ba'i rnam 'gyur gsar ba ci yang 'dzin/ /gang gi mthu las blang dor blta (lta)ba'i mig /rnyed phyir srid pa'i klong du 'khyam gyur kyang / /thar lam 'tshol la spobs pa mngon mtho ba'i/ /thar 'dod de yang thar pa'i ded dpon nyid/ /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //bshad sgrub kyi sbol ji ltar tshugs tshul/ra / /de nas rim gyis 'phel rgyas dang bshad sgrub kyi srol ji ltar byung tshul mdor bsdus pa zhig 'god na/ lcags stag de ka'i zla ba bdun pa'i nang du kun mkhyen mchog nas gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son

da thab rkye zom ra gabyu mi 167pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dka' bcu ba ngag dbang bkra shis 'chad nyan gyi bla mar bsko bzhag mdzad cing / khong gis dgung lo so gnyis nas re gcig gi bar du'achad nyan mdzad pas 'jam mgon khri rin po che dang bla ma khri rgan tshang zhes kun mkhyen mchog dang mnyam pa'i dad gus dang tshad mar 'dzin pa byung / dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi lo 'dir thog mar re zhig zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du chos thog gcig zla ba dgu pa'i nang du chos thog gcigazla ba bcu pa'i nang du lnga mchod kyi chos thog gcig bcas la nyi ma ba/co lnga re byas shing / de nas bcu gcig pa'i bcu bdun la dgun chos chen mo tshugs/ de skabs kun mkhyen mchog gi bkas da phyin chad sgo mang ltar zla chos bzhi/ bar chos bzhi dang brgyad/ rigs grwa'i skabs chos thog gcig dang bcas chos thog dgu re ma chag pa gyis gsungs pa ltar/ de nas bzung ste da ltalibar du gnas la/ grwa tshang gsar tshugs kyi skabasartso'adzin grwa gsum las med kyang / lcags yos kyi dpyid grwa ba gsar zhugs rnams la myur du po ti phyi ma tshugs dgos pas brtsi bzhag 'gro gang che gyis gsungs pa ltar dpon slob khri rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis pas de nas bzung ste lo kha shas kyi bar du chos thog la brtsi bzhag gnyis dang / chos mtshams la brtsi bzhag re ma chag par btang / lo re'i grwa rgyun bsags pas 'dzin grwa re snon thub pa byung stabs grwa ba gsar zhugs kyi 'dzin grwa de la lcags yos kyi lo de'i dgun chos skabs phar phyin dang / de nas lo bzhi song ba shing lug gi lo phar phyin rdzogs nas dbu ma dang / de nas lo gnyis song ba me bya'i lo 'dzin grwa de la mdzod tshugs shing / rgan pa rnams la sngar

168 mudaskub dzeerjo— shar gas ma/nas 'dul ba tshugs yod pa bcas 'dzin grwa bcu gsum la po ti lnga'i 'chad nyan star chags su byung ba yin no/ / de yang rigs lam smra ba yongs kyi ngag na bsdus tshan nyer lnga zhe sa grags che yang bsdus tshan nyer lnga dngos kyi rtsod pa ni bsdus tshad smra ba'i tshad du brtsi ba stag tshang ra ba stod du yang nyag phra bar mngon te/ sngon rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs pa'i thugs gnyer dus su sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos rwa stod bla ma tshul khrims rin chen sogs la bsdus tshan nyer lnga'i grangs 'dren dris pas / la las bsdus tshan nyer lnga zer ba tsam las 'dren rgyu med zer/ 'ga' zhig gis 'dren khul byas pas tshang ma 'dren rgyu ma rnyed par lag/ thogs nas bar shun zer ba sogs drangs shing / da lta rwa stod bsdus grwa sogs su bsdus tshan 'ga' zhig gi rigs lam zur ba phran tshags logs su bton nas bar shun dang yin gyur min gyur dgag gshag sgrub gshag sogs kyi tha snyad btags nas bsdus tshan rer byas 'dug pas so/ / 4 snasde 'di gsar tshugs skabs su khri rin po che nas kun mkhyen mchog la bsdus grwa ljags rtsom gnang dgos zhus pa'i lan du bsdus tshan bco lnga tsam sngar brtsams zin kyang lhag ma bri ma thub/ da lta na so rgas shing byed dgos mang bas mi lcogs par 'dug sngar rwa stod pa tshos bsdus tshan nyer lnga 'dren ma shes par sde srid kyis nged la dris skabs bsdus tshan nyer lnga'i rtsa tshig brtsams yod pas de nyid rtsa bar byas (byos)/ shes byed rgyas pa sde bdune yid kyi mu/na sel nas kha bskang ste brtsi bzhag thong gsungs pa

sna da sku kyi thom ji ra gas / 159ltam smra ba'i dbang phyug dam pa dpon slob zhal snga nas kyis lo sum cu 'i bar du 'dzin grwa sum cu la bsdus grwa mi 'dra ba sum cu btang ba skyor nedapon so sos zin bris byas pa'i bsdus grwa yongs rdzogs nyer bdun dang /mjug ma tshang ba gsum ste sum cu yod la/ de'i nang nas skyor dpon bkra shis rgya mtsho'i zin bris kyi bsdus grwa 'di nyid bsdus chen gyi skor bsdus grwa gzhan las khyad thon par yod stabs dbal mang blo bzang don grub pas rteng bskul byas pa ltar erje sha ras dpar du brkos pas da lta bkra shis 'khyil gyi bsdus grwa zhes yongs su grags 'di yin no/ /bsdus grwa 'di nyid 'dzin chos su byas te rtsod pa shin tu bdar sha chod pa rtsal du 'ardon pas rwa ba stod sogs su bsdus tshad mtha' chod par sbyangs pa'i rigs smra'i tshad 'jog mang po yang snyems pa'i ri bo rdul du brlags pa 'i lo rgyus mang la/ bsdu sa grwa yongs rdzogs kyi rgyugs 'bul mkhan yang lo re bzhin mang mtha' brgya phrag longs pa nas nyung mtha' nyi shu sum cu re tsam rgyun du mchis so/ /des na rwa stod sogs su yang da lta cher ma gragasatshupa'i bsdus tshan nyer lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i rigs lam gyi yur gcig gis sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i chu rgyun ril bor 'dren pa 'di ni gzhan las rmad du byung ba'i khyad par 'phags chos shig go /blo rtags la kun mkhyen chen po nyid kyi blo rtags gnyis 'dzin chos su gtong la/ der mi gsal ba gtan tshigs ltar snang / dgag rtags kyi rab dbye/ rang nges gzhan nges kyi rnam bzhag yid mngon gyi mtha' dpyod sogs 'jam mgon khri rin po ches brtsi bzhag la btang ba skyor ri

160 da skub kyi sdom rna sa ma/dpon so sos zin bris byas pa mang du yod la/ blo rab kyis tshad ma'i gzhung spyi la go ba chags pa dang / de tsam mi lcogs pa rnams kyis kyang kun mkhyen mchog gi blo rtags gnyis la gong gsal gyi rang lugs dang tre mtha' dpyod kyis zur btab ste rtsod pa the tshom chod nges su bgyid pas slob gnyer ba gang yin gyis blo rtags kyi rgyugs 'bul bar snang la/ sdebadun yid kyi mun sel daja / sbyi don rigs rgyan sogs kyi rgyugs 'bul mkhan yang yod do/ / de yang rtags rigs kyi rang lugs dmar ser thun mtshams mar grags pa 'di brtsi bzhag srod chos la gnang ba skyor dpon dge legs rgya mtshos zin bris su btab ste gzigs 'bulazhus par thugs dgyes nas khyod kyis 'di la mgor mchod brjod cig zhog gsungs pas dmar ser thun mtshams lang tsho'i dpal gyi gos/ /zhes sogs kho rang gis brtsams par ngag rgyun du gleng / bsdus grwa blo rtags dang bcas lo lnga'i bar du rtsod/rigs lam gyi bdar sha gcod lugs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba shing rta polisrol bzhin yod pas sde 'dir zhugs pa'i rtog ge ba rnams blo rtags bsdus grwa'i rigs lam smra ba la phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan btsugs pa lta bur yod pa la rigs pa smra ba sus kyang bsnyon du med do/ /phar phyin skabs dang po gnyis pa bzhi pa rnams thal phreng dang skabs lhag ma rnams srod chos la lo res mos kyi tshul du rdzogs par gtong zhing / zur bkol bsam gzugs kun mkhyen chen po nyid kyis mdzad pa dang / 'ja mgon khri rin po ches bsam gzugs legs bshad sgo 'byed dang /

skud ba smo rna gas ma/ 161skyabs mchog thams cad mkhyen pa nas bsam gzugs legs bshad bum bzang mdzad pa dang / drang nges rnam 'byed la kun mkhyen chen po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i drang nges rnam 'byed rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ rten 'brel la kun mkhyen chen po nyid nas rten 'brel rgyas pa rtsom 'phro can zhig dang shin tu bsdus pa shog grangs bcu lhag can zhig las med stabs 'jam mgon khri chen nas rten 'brel chen mor grags pa legs bshad rgya mtsho shog grangs nyis brgya longs pa zhig mdzad/ dus phyis gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs nas rten 'brel gyi mtha' dpyod zab cing 'dus che ba nyin byed snang ba dang / kun gzhi'i mtha' dpyod legs bshad rba rlabs gnyis mdzad/ dge 'dun nyi shu la khri rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis pas dge 'dun nyi shu chen mor grags pa skal bzang 'jug ngogs dang / de las bsdus pa gnyis mdzad/ yang skabs brgyad pa'i 'phrin las kyi skor la khri chen de nyid kyis mtha' dpyod gaṅgā'i chu rgyun mdzad/ yang skabs bzhi pa'i skor cung zad bsdus te skyabs mgon mchog nas pad dkar 'khri shing mdzad pa sogs 'dzin skyor gyi yig cha rgyas bsdus lag mi thogs pa'i stabs kyis thal phreng zur bkol cha tshang re rgyas bsdus sna tshogs kyi sgo nas phal cher gyis 'dzin skyor byed la/ blo gros rab dang ldan pa rnams kyis ni/yig cha'i skabs brgyad dang / zur bkol chen mo bzhi/ 'grel chung don gsal/ rnam bayad snying bo rgyan/ gser phreng yongs rdzogs dang skabs ci thon sogs 'dzin skyor dang rgyugs 'bul ba snang la/ rtsod pa hor khongs su mi lus pa zhib mor 'gro ba dang / lo re bzhin nye logs dgra

162 — —da wargyazo gas tre logs bsres nasaubargal brtag byed pa dang / pha ra phyin ston mo'i dam bca' sogs kyang bkra shos sgo mang gi phyag srol yar ldan du yod do/ / dbu ma la lo gnyis kyi ring la lung rigs gter mdzod kyi stodajicha kyi thal phreng dang / smad cha zur bkol byas nas rtsod pa zhib mor 'gro la/—yig cha de nyide 'dzin skyor rngowaṃ thogs pa rnams kyis— dbu ma lung rigs sgron me nges can du 'dzin skyor byed pa dang / rna4bshad dgongs pa rab gsal dang / legs bshad snying bo 'dzin skyor dang rgyugs 'bul mkhan yang ches shin tu mang la/ yig cha de nyid kyi thal zlog gnad bsdus 'jam mgon khri rin po che nas mjod pa dang / yang tshad 'gog la tshig gsal stong thun gyi tshad malirnam bshad shin tsu rgyas pa kun mkhyen mchog nas mdzad pa res 'ga' srod chos la gtong ba'i srol yod la/ dbu phar gnyis la gna' dus nas 'chad nyan me ltar 'bar bas rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dang ldan pa mang pos mdo dbus kyi chos sde chen po rnams su smra ba'i bang mdzod rnam par phye ba'i lo rgyus chesacomang zhidzo da lta yang de bzhin gyi mur ‘ yod pa mkhas pa'i mdun sar lung rigs kyi srang la gzhal na shes so/ /ston dpyid kyi dus brtsi bzhag gi rgyugs gnyis re len pa dang / rgyan 'jug gi rgyugs ma 'phrod phyin gzhung gsar brgal mi chog pas blo dman gyis kyang dzethal phreng 'dzin skyor byed pa dang / rgan gzhon thams cad la rgyan 'jug gnyis chig skye pher ba yod pa yang gzhan las 'phagasagyipa'i khyad chos shig tu snang ngo // ci 'dul mdzod gnyis kyang lo gnyis re la rdzogs para'agro zhing kune

dgo —1—— sdo ṣa ———— 1 ——rda1 163mkhyen mchog gis mdzad pa'i mdzod 'dul gyi mtha' dpyod chen mo gnyis 'dzin chos su gtong la/ skyabs mgon mchog gis rtsom 'phro can gyi mdzod gnas kha shas dang / gung nga mchog sprul rin po ches mdzad pa'i 'dul ba tshigs bcad ma dang mdzod kyi sdom tshig kun mkhyen mchog gi spyi bstan rtsom 'phro dang khri chen bsod nams dbang rgyalogyi spyi bstan shin tu legs pa sogs kyis lde mig byas 'dul mngon gyi gzhung chen mo rnams gcal du bkram nas lag mthil gyi rdzas ltar gsal bar bgyid do/ /mdor — na bka' pota chen po lnga la lo ci tsam gyi ring la rtsod pa 'gro ba dang / chos thog gang dang gang mu gzhung gang rtsod pa dang tshogs chos grwa'i zhal 'don gyi rim pa dang 'don chos spyod kyi dbyangs rta/ nyams su bzhes rgyu'i 'grig lam che phra mtha' dag pa dpal ldan bkra shisangasgo mang ji lta ba bzhin no// 'o na mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa chen po rnams su bka' pota chen po lnga'i 'chad nyan gtso bor byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na bshad parabya ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i bka' thams cad sde snod gsum du 'du la/ bka' pota lnga ni sde snod gsum gyi sdom lta bu yin pas so//de yang yin te mdo rtsa 'dul ba'i sdom/ dbu tshad mdzod gsum mngon pa'i sdom/ /phar phyin mdo sde'i sdom yin no// — yang bka' thams cad theg pa che chung gi sde snod gnyis su 'du la/theg chen gyi lta ba dbu tshad gnyis dang spyod pa phar phyin gyis 'chad pa dang theg dman gyi lta spyod gnyis mdzod kyis 'cha/da la/ 'dul bas ni theg

164 da blom pa che chung thun mong gi tshul khrims kyi rnam bzhag 'chad pas so/ /yang bka' thams cad 'khor lo gsum du 'du la/ 'khor lo dang polispyod pa tshul khrims kyi rnam ba zhag phodul bas 'chad/ lta ba bden bzhi'i rnam bzhag mngon pas 'chad/ 'khor lo bar ba'i lta ba dbu ma dang / 'khor lo tha ma'i lta ba rnam 'grel gyis 'chad la/ 'khor lo tha ma gnyis karispyod pa'i cha phar phyin gyis 'chad do/ /yang ston pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i grub mtha' smra ba la bzhir nges la/ dbu tshad kyis dbu sems kyi lta ba dang / phar phyin gyis dbu sems kyi spyod pa 'chad/mdo sde pa rigs pa'i rjes 'brang rnam 'grel dang / lung gi rjes 'brang mngon pa sde bdun dang mdzod kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / bye smra'i rang gzhung dngos shig bod du ma 'gyur kyang mdzod las༈ bdag gi mngon pa'i chos 'di phal cher ni/ /kha che bye brag smra ba'i tshul grub bshad//ces gsungs pa ltar bye smra'i 'dod tshul rgyas para'achad la/ 'dul ba ni grub mtha' bzhi ka'i thun yong ba dang bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin pas so//yang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du thub bstan gyen du 'degs pa'i ka ba lta bur gyur pa'i paṇḍi ta mang du byon kyang 'dzam glid mdzes pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis nyid grags che la/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gzhung lugs ni bka' pota lnga nyid yin pas so// de yang yin te / klu sgrub yab sras kyi dbu ma'i gzhung lugs/thogs med sku mched kyi mngon pa'i gzhung lugs/ phyogs glang chos gragasakyi tshad maligazhung lugs/ yon shākaganyis kyi 'dul ba'i gzhung

shad ba kyi zom ltar ga 166lugs zhes nyi zla ltar grags la/ paṇḍi ta de dag gi chos kyi rtsa ba'i dngos su khungs gtug sa ni byams 'jam dbyangs gnyis las/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la brten nas mgon po klu sgrub kyis zab mo lta ba'i srol phye ba dang / rgyal ba mi pham pa la brten nas 'phags pa thogs med kyis rgya chen spyod pa'i srol phye bar ma zad/ byams mgon gyis rgyan gnyis 'byed gnyis rgyud bla ma dang bcas pa mi yul du skyes su bskur bas byams chos sde lnga zhes sa gsum gyi mig gcig bur gyur pa 'di lags so//des na bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yang sngon byon pa'i mkhas pa du ma dang / khyad paradu chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos ni/ ji skad du rtogs brjod las/ de nyid phyir na mi pham chos rje dang / /'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis zhes grags pa'i/ /gzhung la phyogs re ba dang rags pa res/ /tshim par ma byas kun la zhib tu sbyangs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mi pham mgon po dang rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gzhung la rtsal 'don mdzad pas na/ dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i bshad grwa rnams su bka' pota chen po lnga la rtsal 'don mdzad pa yin no/ /bka' pota chen po lnga'i 'chad nyan gyi brgyud pa yang mtha' yas pa zhig yod na yang ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bka' pota lnga'i bshad rgyun byung tshul ni 'di ltar yin te/ de la 'dul ba'i bshad rgyun ni/ bcom ldan 'das nas bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun gyi bar grags che la/ de nas phyir mi 'ong glos mi 'beebs par grags pa ni gtad rabs bdun gyi tha ma legs mthong chen po'i slob sprar khashad khecing / de'i slob ma kha che 'dus

1skye6 dzi jibaspyosdo—ma ga bzang / de'i slob ma slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ de'i slob ma 'dul ba rang las mkhas pa slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba rnam bshad dang bcas pa mdzad/ de'i slob ma shākya 'od kyis sum brgya pa rang 'grel 'od ldan dang bcas pa mdzad/ de'i slob ma dā na shi la dang dzi na mi tra gnyis mnga' bdag khri ral gyi dus bod du byon pa las/ paṇḍi ta dzi na mi tra la lo tsā ba klu'irgyal mtshan dang g.yo dge 'byung la sogs pas 'dul ba gsan pa bu ston chos 'byung du gsungs pas/ de ltar na dmar g.yo gtsang gsum gyis kyang dzi na mi tra la thug par mngon/ mkhas pa mi gsum las bla chen bsnyen par rdzogs shing bla chen gyis gzhan gyi mkhan po mdzad kyi bar du sngar gyi mkhan slob la brten nas bzhugs par grags che bas de las gzhan du 'dul ba gsan pa'i gtan tshigs ma dgos mod/ 'on kyang go rong seṅge grags la yang 'dul ba gsan par bshad do//bla chen gyi slob ma grum ye shes 'bar la klu mes dbang phyug grags kyis gsan cing de la gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan sgyis gsan/ klan tshul byang /ka chu ba tshul 'byung / sne po grags rgyal/ 'dzims pa sher 'od bzhi la gzus kyi bu bzhir grags shing / de'i nang nas 'dzims pa ma gtogs pa la rgya 'dul ba 'dzin pa dbang phyug tshul khrims kyis gsan/ rgya 'dul 'dzin la/ mtha' bzhi brtson 'grus 'bar/ 'dar 'dul 'dzin/ rma tsho byang chub rdo rje/ jo stan nag po dar tshul te slob ma kwa bzhir grags pa sogs 'dul ba'i 'chad nyan pher ba'i grwa ba stong phrag lhag pa byung /de'i nang nas jo stan nag po dar tshul dang rgya 'dul dngos la yang sha mi

da sa rgya tho rna gas / 167smon lam tshul khrims kyis gsan cing / de'i slob ma ka pa dar seng gis thag ma bzung ste 'dul ba'i bshad pa mdzad pas slob ma thag ma rdor gzhon sogs byung bar bshad la/ sha mis 'dar 'dul la yang thug parabashad do/ /thag mas bya 'dul brtson 'grus 'bar la thug par bshad de bya 'dul gyis ni rma tsho byang rdor la 'dul ba gsan snang bas de dag thams cad rgya 'dul gyi bshad rgyun 'dzin pa'o/ /bya 'dul gyis mdzad pa'i 'dul ṭīka la bya ṭīka ces sngon dus 'chad nyan ches cher dar bar snang ngo / /thag ma rdor gzhon gyi slob ma sbal ti dgra bcom pa dbang phyug tshul khrims kyis skyor mo lung btab ste 'dul ba'i bshad pa spel zhing / de nas gdan sa rim par mkhan chen shes rab seṅge / bsam yas pa tshul khrims dbang phyug bde ba can pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ dka' bzhi pa blo gsal sogs rim parabyon nas 'dul ba'i bshad srol bskyangs pa las/ mkhan chen dka' bzhi pa blo gsal la rje rin po ches 'dul ba gsan nas mdo rtsa'i ṭīkka rtsom bzhed kyis mdo rtsa'i zin bris/ gzhi nas 'byung ba'i bslab bya'i zin bris sogs mdzad cing rje bdag nyid chen po la 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gsan nas 'dul ba'i bslab bya chen mo/ dge tshul gyi bslab bya rgyas bsdus gzhi gsum cho ga gleng 'bum sogs mdzad/ yang sha mi nas gra mi/ rgya dur dar ma ye shes/ de la zangs chen pa dar ma bsod nams/ de la mtsho sna ba shes rab bzang pos gsan pa las gnyal gyi zangs po che dang pra gor du bshad pa byung bar — —

168 ba da ba thom rta tsag ma deb sngon las bshad cing / mtsho sna bas 'dul ṭīka nyi ma'i 'od zer mchan dang bcas pa mdzad pa la mtsho ṭīka tu grags so/ /yang dka' bzhi ba blo gsal la/ dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen dang / de la dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen gyis gsan te 'di gnyis la dmar ston khu dbon du grags/ dam ra ston rgya mtsho rin chen gyis bu ston la yang gtugs shing /'dis mdo rtsar 'bru 'grel zhib mo med pa'i dka' 'grel lta bu zhig mdzad paradamar ṭīka zer/ rje dge 'dun grub kyis 'di las 'dul ba'i bshad pa gsan nas gleng 'bum chen mo dang 'dul ṭīka rin chen phreng ba sogs mdzad do/ / rje rin po che'i gsan yig las/ paṇḍi ta dzi na mi tra yan sngar ltar bshad nas/ dra dzi gnyis nas shākya seṅge / rlung po lo tsā ba/ skyogs 'dul 'dzin/ rdzus rdor rgyal/ rdzus kyis klu mes la yang gsan te yas dar dang mas dar gnyis su byas so/ /zhes gsungs pas mas dar gyi brgyud pa ni bshad ma thag pa nyid yin la/ yas dar ni/ rje rang gi gsan yig tu gsungs pa nyid yin te/ deb sngon las/ rlung skyogs gnyis kyis lo tsā slob tu jin te bram ze 'dul 'dzin dang bram ze shākya se na gnyis la phran dang bcas pa gsan zhing lag len bslab ces gsungs pas shes so/ /'di rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngorigs las dka' bzhi ba blo gsal la gsan par gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas de yan chad gsan yig dang rnam thar bsdur nas bkod pa'o/ /

ba da spyi thom rtang ga 169 rje'i gsan yig las/ rgya 'dul 'dzin nas tsha rong ba la de gnyis kyis yar steng ba la/ des ka ba dar seng la/ de gnyis kyis mkhan chen la/ des dbon la/ de gnyis kyis mkhan po chos kyi rje zhig po shes rab seṅge / dbon dang dar seng gis mkhan po gzhon nu brtson 'grus la/ des dbang phyug shes rab la/ des shes rab rdo rje la/ des mkhan po kun dga' 'byung gnas la/ des ka bzhi pa blo gros bzang po la/ zhes gsung ba 'di dka' bzhi blo gsal ba dang gcig gam snyam ste mkhas grub rje'i gsan yig tu yang de bzhin 'byung ngo / /mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad rgyun ni/ mkhas mchog dbyig gi gnyen ngo sa mdzad pa'i mngon pa mdzod rang 'grel 'grel bshad rgyal sras ma dang bcas pa snga dar dus ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur/ dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma gang ba spel/ de'i slob ma dā na shrī la dang dzi na mi tra gnyis la lo chen ska cog zhang gsum gyis mngon pa'i bshad pa gsan zhing phyi dar gyi bar du bshad rgyun ma nub pa yin te bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i bstan pa spyilichos 'byung las/ dzi na mi tras ska cog zhang gsum/nam snang zla ba'i rdo rje/ dpal gyi rdo rje/ rba rgyal ba ye shes/ cog gru mchog gi ye shes/ se btsun gzhon nu/ gar mi yon tan g.yung drung / khu ston shes rab brtson 'grus/ ra khri bzang 'bar rgya rgyal bu tshul le/ brang ti dar ma snying po/ delislob ma 'ban rog gnyis la sogs pa'i bar du mngon pa'i bshad nyan ma chad parabyung ba'i phyir ro zhes gsungs so / /

170 da —— rgya/ rta ga de yang se btsun gzhon nu dbang phyug gi dus su bshad rgyun khams su 'phos par deb sngon las bshad la gar mi yon tan g.yung drungani 'ol kha rdzing phyi'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs mkhan jo bo spyan 'dren du mnga' ris su yang byon pa de nyid yin paramangon te/ bstan pa snga dar gyi mjug gi lcags bya nas jo bo bod du byon pa'i chu rta bar du lo brgyad cu gya gnyis song ba sogs shes dgos so/ /'dir 'ban rog gnyis la brgyud paragasungs pa'i 'ban la brgyud tshul ni/ brang ti dar ma snying po nas rim gyis/ ko ye 'byung / 'ban dkon mchog rdo rje/ tho kun dga' rdo rje| 'jang ('jad )pa ston skyabs/ 'jad pa gzhon byang / zhang 'bring 'tshams pa/ po tong (bo dong ) ba rin chen rtse mo/ stag sde pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ lo byang chub rtse mo/ rje btsun red mda' pa chen po la rje bdag nyid chen pos gsan cing /de la rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyis gsan pa las thams cad mkhyen pa — dge 'dun grub kyis gsan nas mdzod ṭīka thar lam gsal byed mdzad/de la se ra kun mkhyen blo gros rin chen seṅges gsan te 'dis kyang mdzod kyi yig cha mdzad pa sogs so/ /rog gi bshad rgyun ni/ brang ti dar ma snying po nas rog chos kyi brtson 'grus/ yar nag pa/ nyang ther ma/gzad ring mo/ spyil bu pa/ stag ston shes rab 'od zer/ lho grub pa sesgo / tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon po'i bar dang / de la bu ston rin chen grub kyis gsan pa dang / de la dmar ston khu dbon gyis gsan pa'i bshad rgyun rje dge 'dun grub la mnga' ba ste/ de gnyis

da—— —kyi — sdo—ma — — lha — —ga sa— / 171ni bstan pa snga dar gyi dus nas bshad rgyun bar ma chad du byung ba'o/ /dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma mngon pa rang las mkhas pa slob dpon blo gros — brtan pa nas/ kha che dri med sbas pa/ de'i slob ma smri (smṛ) ti tsā na kirti bod du byon pa la/ g.yas chen po shes rab grags pas gsan pa nas rim bzhin/ rwa zhags zla ba/ mchims zhang btsun/ mchims lha rje go cha/ mchims brtson 'grus seṅge / mchims don grub rgyal mtshan/mchims brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ mchims blo gros brtan pa/mchims nam mkha' grags rnams rim par bla slob yin no/ /mchims nam mkha' grags kyis chos mngon pa mdzod kyi ṭīka chen mdzad pa yod la da lta'i mchims mdzod du grags pa mdzad pa bo dang mi gcig ste/ mchims nam mkha' grags ni bcom ldan rigs ral gyi bla ma lam mchog rin po che rtsom mkhan de nyid yin la/ mchims mdzod dam 'grel ba mngon pa'i rgyan rtsom pa bo ni bcom ldan rigs ral gyi slob ma mchims 'jam pa'i dbyangs sam btsun pa 'jam dbyangs zhes grags pa rigs ral gyis bka' bkyon yang yang mdzad pa la 'jigs nas sa skyar bzhugs pa las hor gyis gdan drangs nas bu yan thu rgyal polimachod gnas mdzad pa de nyid yin paramachims mdzod rang gi mdzad byang du yang dge slong 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis pho brang tsong du'i mkhar du grub par bgyis so zhes gsungs pas spyang shes so/ / 'dis yo byad tshan chen po bskur ba'i steng nas bcom ldan rigs ral dang dbus pa blo gsal sogs kyis snar thang du bka' dang bstan ༷

172 da tho ge bcos 'gyur ro cog thog mar bzhengs pa grags che zhing mtshan la 'jam sgeg pakṣi zhes kyang zer ro/ / de nas mkhas pa yon tan 'od zer bshes gnyen chos mgon pa/skyor lung pa blo gros bzang po/ dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen/ dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen gyi bar du brgyud pa las dge 'dun grub kyis gsan/gang ba spel nasporim par/ kha che paṇa snyikya shī zhes yongs su grags pa'i paṇa grub dgung lo brgya phrag brgal ba bzhugs shing bod du byon pa de la sa paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis gsan zhing / de nas 'phags pa rin chen/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ mnyam med grags pa rgyal mtshan/don ri grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/nya dbon kun dga' dpal ba/ rje btsun red mda' ba chen po'i bar du rim bzhin brgyud cing / nya dbon kun dga' dpal la rje rin po ches mngon pa bshad par zhus pas kho bodzeeslob ma red mda' ba la nyon gsungs pas gsan pa ste/ 'di gnyis ni phyi dar dus su gsar du byung ba'i bshad rgyun no/ /de ltar na 'dul mdzod kyi bshad rgyun ni bstan pa snga dar nas bzung ste ma nub pa'o/ /zhes shes par bya'o/ /rnam 'grel ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas nas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/dgra bcom pa chos skyob/ mkhas pa me wam ga slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi bar rje'i gsan yig sogaṭarga su grags che/ de'islob ma tshad ma rang las mkhas pa phyogs glang gis tshad ma'i bstan bcos thor bu brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad par grags shing / de thams cad kyi don gyi gnad bkus

da rngom rna ga / 173nas tshad ma kun las btus pa mdzad/ 'di lo tsā ba seṅge rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba dang dad pa'i shes rab kyis bsgyur ba gnyis yod pas phyi ma bstan 'gyur gyi gras su yod la/ mdo'i don phyogs glang gi dgongs pa bzhin thugs su chud pa dpal chos kyi grags pas tshad ma sde bdun mdzad pa las gtan tshigs thigs pa dang rgyud gzhan sgrub pa gnyis dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba dang / dul lha'i rigs thigs 'grel pa ye shes sdes bsgyur ba sogs da lta'i bstan 'gyur du tshud 'dug pas bstan pa snga dar la yang tshad ma'i skor gyi 'chad nyan dar yang / de nas phyi dar gyi bar la 'dul mngon ltar bshad rgyun ma nub par bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus med par ma zad bshad rgyun chad par mngon te/ phyi dar la lha sde'i dus kha che paṇa chen dang sa paṇa gyis rnam 'grel la 'gyur mdzad mod de'i gong du rma dge ba'i blo gros kyis rnam 'grel 'grel ba 'grel bshad dang bcas pa bsgyur/ khyung po grags seng gis tshad maliskor spel ba la tshad ma rnying ma dang / rngog blo ldan shes rab kyis rnam 'grel yang 'gyur mdzad cing rgyan gyi 'grel bshad sogs bsgyur te 'chad nyan mdzad pa nas tshad ma gsar ba par grags pas so/ /des na chos grags kyi slob ma lha dbang blos rnam 'grel rang 'grel la kha skong gi tshul du le'u phyi ma gsum gyi 'grel ba mdzad/ de'i slob ma shākya blos rang 'grel dang lha dbang blo'i 'grel ba gnyis ka la 'grel bshad mdzad/ de'i slob ma shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pas le'u phyi ma gsum gyi 'grel ba rnam 'grel gyi rgyan zhes bya ba mdzad pas rgyan mkhan por yang

174 kai— sdom rta gas ma grags/ de'i slob ma chos mchog gam rgyal rnga bdun par grags pas rnam nges kyi ṭīkka 'thad ldan sogs mdzad/ delislob ma dza ma ris rnam 'grel rgyan gyi 'grel bshad mdzad/ de'i slob ma dul ba'i lhas rigs thigs kyi 'grel ba slob ma la phan pa mdzad/ dedzeeslob ma thaṅka ra nanta'am bram ze bde byed dga' bas kyang rnam 'grel gyi 'grel bshad mdzad/de'i slob ma waṃ gu paṇḍi ta dang / derislob ma paṇḍi ta shākya shrī/ de'i slob ma sa skya paṇa chen gyis rnam 'grel bsgyur bshad kyis gtan la phab ste tshad ma rigs gter rang 'grel dang bcas pa mdzad la rnam 'grel gyi 'gyur byang du yang / sgra don ji bzhin legs par brda sbyar nas/ /ston pa gangs can 'di na kho bo tsam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni 'gyur gyi go rim dang bstun na tshad ma gsar ba bar gtogs dgos so/ /delislob ma 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ges rnam 'grel rigs mdzod mdzad cing 'dis rje rin po che'ithugs phrogs te sbyan chab 'khrugs par rnam thar du gsal lo/ / de nas zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal/ dpang blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal ba/ rje red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros kyi bar du rim par brgyud la red mda' bas dka' chen bzhi sogs kyi rnam bshad mdzad pa yin te rang gi gsung las/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i rgyan gyur dka' chen bzhi/ /rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum theg chen rgyud bla dang / chos mngon mdzad dang dpal ldan 'dus pa sogs/ /rnam bshad byas pa'i gzhung

ba darwamitshotram̐———rda——rjo 175lugs brgya phrag gcig /ces gsungs pas so/ / nya dbon dang rje btsun red mda' ba gnyis la chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos gsan te rigs pa'i gnad mtha' dag la 'khrul ba med pa'i nges pa rnyed nas tshad ma'i lam sgrigs sogs thor bu ci rigs mdzad cing / lha shāka gi 'grel ba gnyis kyi steng nas bshad srol so sor gnang ba'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pas rnam 'grel gyi rnam bshad thar lam gsal byed dang / sa bcad chen mo/ rnam nges dang rigs thigs kyi 'grel ba sogs dang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas ṭīka chen rigs pa'i rgya mtsho dang yid kyi mun sel sogs mdzad/ yang dul ba'i lha la paṇḍi ta gzhan phan bzang pos gsan/de la rngog blo ldan shes rab kyis gsan te gong smos ltar tshad ma'i bstan bcos du ma'i 'gyur dang 'chad nyan mdzad pas slob ma rnam nges 'chad mkhan nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga/ rgyan dang chos mchog 'chad mkhan lnga bcu rtsa lnga sogs byung / de la khyung rin chen grags dang / de la cha ba chos seng / de nas gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seṅge / gnyal zhig 'jam dpal rdo rje sogs kyis gsan pa las jo nang dang sa skya sogs su yang bshad srol mched de yig cha mdzad mkhan yang mang du byung mod/'on kyang 'dul mngon sogs la ltos na rnam 'grel gyi bshad srol nyag phra zhing rje rin po che ma byon bar la tshad ma'i bstan bcos 'di dag rtog ge'i bstan bcos yin pas nang rig pa'i sde snod las phyi rol du gyur cing grol ba don gnyer la mi mkho bar 'dodapa yang ches māng po byung tshul rje rang gi

17skye da spyo ga mi rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma dang / sras kyi thu bo gnyis la sogs pa'i tshad malibaltan bcos rnams su gsal ba ltar ro/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du yang don ji lta ba bzhin rtogs mkhan nyung bar gzigs nas dpal chos kyi grags pa yang thugs skyo ba'i tshul gyis/ 'gro ba rnams la mtshungs par legs bshad slar 'dzin byed pa mi rnyed pa can kho boligazhung / rgya mtsho la ni chu bo bzhin du rang gi lus la thim zhing nub pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa la dpags na rang re bod dag gis de 'dra smra ba'i rigs so/ /de la rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis mnyam med jo bo chen po'ibaka' lung ltar gsang phu ne'u thog gi dgon pa btab/ khong gi dbon po rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis 'chad nyan rgya cher bskyangs pas slob ma lung chos smra ba nyi khri lhag pa byung / khong sku gshegs nas lo bzhi bcu tsam na cha ba chos kyi seng ge gsang phu'i gdan rabs bzhi par phebs cha bas de gong du yang chos grwa mang po bskyangs shing / lhag par tshad malide nyid bsdus pa che chung gnyis sogs mdzad/ gzhung gi gnad logs su bkol nas las dang po bas 'jug bde zhing 'dum sla bar byas te brgal zhing brtag pa'i srol btod par sde bdun gyi rigs pa'i gnad phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i grwa yin pas na bsdus grwa zhes grags shing cha bsdus kyang zer/rwa ba stod smad dang tshal gung thang gi bshad grwa sogs kyang gsang phu'i le lag tu gtogs shing rong ston smra ba'i seng ge dang / g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal ba sogs kyang rtsa ba'i grwa sa gsang phu yin par snang / cha ba'i

skud bkyisgrumasdistangawas ma/ 177slob ma seng chen brgyad dang / de dag gi slob brgyud gnyal zhig bu dgur grags pa sogs kyi sku ring la bshad grwa du ma 'phel/ snar thang du bgro gleng tshugs shing / 'di las kyang bcom ldan rigs pa'i ral gri sogs byon pa dang / gzhan yang dbu ma dang / 'dul ba'i bshad grwa bka' gdams kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa rgya che grangs mang byung zhing / sa paṇḍi ta sogs kyi 'phrin las las kyang bshad grwa dang brgal brtag 'phel bar byung ste/ 'phros don tsam mo/ /gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las/ bu ston dang rje rin po cheligasan yig na dza ma ri chos mchog gi slob mar byas pa dpyod dgos gsungs nas/rang lugs chos mchog dza ma ri'i slob mar byas snang / 'brug pa pad dkar ba'i chos 'byung du/ dul ba'i lha sngar byung zhing rgyan phyis byon pa ste/ gang las shes na/ dul lhas mdzad pa'i rigs thigs 'grel ba bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba mngon sum du snang zhing / rgyan gyi mtshan dngos shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa ste/bod kyi bstan pa phyi dar dus kyi thog ma tsam na bi kra ma la shī la'i sgo skyong du bzhugs pa'o/ /des na rgyan gyi dngos slob kha che nyi ma sbas pa/ de'i dngos slob dza ma ri'am ya mā ri yin te/ rgyan gyi 'grel ba nyi ma sbas pa/de la dza ma ri'i 'grel ba dngos su snang ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs kyang 'dir rje rin po che'i gsan yig gzhir bzhag gis bris pa'o/ / ri'on kyang dul lha'i 'grel ba snga dar la 'gyur ba dang / rgyan mkhan po phyi dar gyi dus su bzhugs pa rang gis snga phyi'i khyad che bar sgrub mi nus

178 da ba spyi ma ra gas /te/ snga dar la dpal brtsegs sogs byon pa ni khri ral gyi dus yin la/ khri ral me bya la rgyal sar bzhugs pa nas glang dar lcags bya la lha lung dpal rdor gyis bkrong (bkrongs) pa'i bar la lo nyer lnga las med la/ glang dar bkrongs pa nas phyi dar gyi mgo brtsam pa'i bar la lo drug cu skor gcig las ma 'das par bshad pas so/ /gzhan yang dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma blo brtan dang / de'i slob ma dzi na mi tra khri ral gyi dus su bod du byon pa dang / klu sgrub dang legs ldan dpal sbas ye shes snying bo rnams rim bzhin bla slob yin la/ ye shes snying bo cog ro dang lo paṇa yin pa rtsa sheli'agyur byang du gsal ba ltar dang / sangs rgyas mya ngan los 'dasanas lo bzhi brgya na klu sgrub 'khrungs shing / de nas bod du srong btsan 'khrungs pa'i bar la lo stong lhag dang / srong btsan nas khri ral gyi bar la yang lo ches mang la/ legs ldan zla grags gnyis kas klu sgrub la gtugs shing / zla grags dang slob pa'i rdo rje nag po spyod pa btsun mo can sogs bla slob dang / btsun mo can la phyi dar dus 'gos los thug par gsang 'dus chos 'byung las bshad pa dang / byang chub lam rim gyi rgya chen spyod brgyud la jo bo dang thogs med kyi bar du brgyud pa bcu tsam yod kyang / zab mo lta brgyud skabs jo bo dang klu sgrub bar du brgyud pa gsum las med pa dang / mi tra dzo ki dang / a bhya ka ra lta bu phan tshun bla slob yin pa yang yod pa sogs lo rgyus kyi rigs 'di la dpyod pa'i sgo mang du yod par shes so//dbu ma'i bshad rgyun ni/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub kyis dbu

———— da spyorngom ra //sa / 17pyima'i rigs pa'i tshogs drug mdzad de yang dag pa'i lam srol gsal bar mdzad cing / klu sgrub kyi slob ma 'phags pa lhas dbu ma bzhi brgya pa sogs mdzad/ yab sras 'di gnyis thal rang kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin pas gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma pa zhes grags/ klu sgrub yab sras gnyis kyi slob ma sangs rgyas bskyangs dang / de'i slob ma legs ldan 'byed/ de'i slob ma dpal ldan zla grags yin par gsan yig dang rnam thar du ma las bshad do//sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi rtsa shes 'grel ba la legs ldan gyis tshogazhan gyis smras pa'i nyes pa ma bsal ba la sogs pa'i skyon gsum brjod/ zla bas skyon de sangs rgyas bskyangs la mi 'jug cing legs ldan rang nyid la 'jug pa sogs kyi lan mdzad pa la dpags na de gsum bla slob min nam snyam/gang ltar na yang / klu sgrub sras mchog zla grags kyi slob ma rigs pa'i khu byug de'i slob ma pa ra he ta/ de'i slob ma ha su ma ti la pa tshab lo tsā pa nyi ma grags kyis dbu ma'i bshad pa gsan pa dang / yang pa tshab kyis kha che gzhon nu bum pa dang ka na ka war ma la yang dbu ma gsan par rnam thar dang dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'gyur byang du yang thon pa ltar la/ ka na ka war ma ni ha su ma ti'i slob ma yin par bshad de de ni phyi dar gyi dus thal 'gyur ba'i bshad srol bod du byung tshul lo/ /yang klu sgrub kyi slob ma de ba shra mas rtsa ba shes rab kyi 'grel ba dkar po rnam par 'char ba mdzad/ de'i slob ma legs ldan 'byed dang /de'i slob ma spyan ras gzigs baspyol zhugs/ de nas rim par slob

180 da pha mi thom ga nedapon sangs rgyas ye shes/ slob dpon ye shes snying bo/ mkhan chen zhi 'tsho/ ka ma la shī la/ blo gros chen po mi pham bshes gnyen/ dza ya a nasto'i bar du rim par brgyud pa'i bshad srol kyang (yang )pa tshab kyis gsan te de ni rang rgyud pa'i bshad srol lo/ /de yang bstan pa snga dar la rtsa ba shes rab/ 'grel ba buddha pā li ta/legs ldan gyi 'grel ba shes rab sgron me/ 'grel bshad spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs sogs la ska cog gis 'gyur mdzad pa yang yod la/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho dang / ka ma la shi la yang bod du byon pa sogs kyis dbu ma'i bshad srol byung bar nges kyang phyi dar gyi bar du bshad rgyun chad par mngon la/ phyi dar gyi dus mnyam med jo bo chen pos rtog ge 'bar ba gsungs shing rngog gis bsgyur ba dang / jo bos dbu ma'i man ngag che chung mdzad pa sogs dbu ma'i bshad rgyun mi 'dra ba kha shas byung yang pa tshab kyi bshad pa srol che bar byung / de yang pa tshab la dge bshes sha ra bas dbu ma'i dri ba mdzad pa'i lan la thugs shin tu mnyes nas bsngags brjod mdzad cing btsun chung mang bo dbu ma slob tu btang bas kyang bshad srol lhag par 'phel tshul rnam thar mang por gsal la/ sha ra pa'i dris lan du yang gzhi la bden pa gnyis lam la thabs shes gnyis 'bras bu la sku gnyis zung du 'jug pa dgos tshul nan tan du bsgrubs pas zhang thang sag pa sogs kyi 'dod tshul de pa tshab lo chen rin po che'i bzhed par mi snang zhes 'khrul bral mkhas pa'i gsung las 'byung ngo / / des na slob ma pa tshab bu bzhir grags pa byung ba sogs kyis bla ma'i

da rngom ga tshu kyi 18 gsung sgros ma jin pa'am go tshul nor ba'i skyon gyis dgag bya khyab ches pa sogs su gol ba dang / de las gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam bzhag gol bar song ba'i tshul ni rje yab sras kyi legs bshad zla bral rnams su gsal ba ltar ro/ /'on kyang pa tshab bu bzhi'i nang tshan zhang thang sag pas rtsa ba shes rab/ bzhi brgya pa/ rigs pa drug cu pa/ rin chen phreng ba sogs dbu maligazhung mang po'i ṭīkka mdzad cing zhang thang sag tu pa tshab kyi bshad pa'i rgyun tsam bskyangs la/ de yang nyams par gyur pa na rje btsun red mda' bas dbu ma'i bshad pa mang du gnang ba la/ karma dkon mchog gzhon nus da lta gangs can pa rnams kha dbu ma sna dbu ma zer ba 'di red mda' ba'i drin yin/ de'i gong du thang sag na dbu ma shi ba'i ro gcig yod ces gsungs te shin tu tshig nus pa che'o//pa tshab bu bzhi'i nang tshan rma bya byang ye'i slob ma rma bya byang brtson gyis kyang rtsa shes dang tshig gsal stong thun gyi ṭīkka sogs mdzad la/ delislob ma rma bya shāka seng dang / de'i slob ma zhang chos kyi bla ma gnyis ka la mchims nam mkha' grags kyis gsan/ de la bcom ldan rigs pa'i ral gris gsan cing mchims dang rigs ral gnyis ka la mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ de nas dpang blo brtan/ slob dpon byang chub seṅge /mnyam med rje btsun red mda' ba chen po'i bar du bshad srol ma nyams par byung / rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la lta ba'i gnad 'khrul ba med par ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang la bsten na legs zhus par 'khrul ba med par 'doms pa dka' yang lta

182 da ba kyi tho rta gas thom ba 'chad pa la red 'da' (mda')ba las drag pa med gsungs pa ltar rje btsun red 'da' (mda')ba la yang gsan cib / khyad par lta ba'i gnad thun mong ma yin pa rnams rgyal ba'i yab gcig rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la rdzogs par gsan te 'khrul ba'i dri ma tsam yang bral ba'i yang dag pa'i lta ba rnyed pa na/ rang gis ji bzhin gzigs pa'i lam gyi gnad de nyid gzhan la 'doms par dgongs nas rtsa 'jug gi rnam bshad chen mo gnyis/ dbu sems kyi lta ba'i gnad gtan la 'beebs pa drang ba dang nges pa'i don rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos legs bshad snying bo/lhag mthong che chung sogs mdzad pa yin te/ rje rang gi gsung las/'jam dbyangs de yi zhabs kyi padmo'i rdul/ /shugs drag rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dad pa yis/ /snying gi ze'u 'brur bsten pa'i mthu las ni/ /gsung rab de nyid rtogs pa'i rigs smra nges/ /rmad byung gtam gyi spyor ba 'di byas so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/yang rje bdag nyid chen po la sras kyi thu bo gnyis kyis gsan te/rgyal tshab kyis dka' gnas brgyad kyi brjed byang / rtsa shes sbyor ṭīka dang 'jug pa'i sbyor ṭīka gnyis yod kyang gsung 'bum du ma tshud/ mkhas grub rjes stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed sogs mdzad de yab sras gsum gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i yig cha 'jig rten gsum gyi mig tu gyur pa mang du — byung ba 'di 'asdogs so/ /des na bstan pa'i gnyen gcig 'gro mgon lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rjeli gsung mgur las/ sa rnying kar 'brug gi mkhas grub mang pos//

ba da dzee—rwa— rtadngha/spyo—— 183gsal stong 'dzin med kyi rang gi rig pa/ /ka dag lhun grub kyi kun bzang rang zhal/ /ma bcos lhan skyes kyi phyag rgya chen po/ /yin yin min min gyi khas len bral sogs/ /sna tshogs tha snyad kyi zhal pho sgrogs kyang / /gathis lugs thig po zhig yin na legs te/ mdzubra mo 'dzugs sa de ci zhig yin ang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar bod kyi grub mtha' smra ba thams cad las kyang mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i lta ba khyad par du 'phags tshul spro bar 'dod kyang skabs ma yin zhing mang bas 'jigs nas bzhag go /phar phyin gyi bshad rgyun ni/ rgyal ba mi pham mgon po la shing rta chen po 'phags pa thogs med kyis gsan pa nas/ slob dpon seng bzang bar du lam mchog sgo 'byed ltar dang / seng bzang la slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis gsan/ de'i slob ma yon tan bshes gnyen la lo chen rin chen bzang pos gsan te 'chad nyan mdzad/ de la shar phyogs pa zla ba bzang pos gsan/ de la slob dpon bstan skyong ngam 'bum phrag gsum pas gsan/ de la lo tsā pa blo ldan shes rab kyis gsan cing rtsa 'grel gnyis kyi 'gyur yang mdzad/ yig cha yang byams chos sde lnga'i ṭīkka dang phar phyin gyi ṭīka chung so gas yod par skyabs mgon mchog gis gsungs la/dbu tshad kyi gzhung sogs yod par nyid kyi rnam thar gro lung bas mdzad pa las 'byung ngo / /de'i slob ma 'bre shes rab 'bar dang / de'i slob ma ar byang chub ye shes gnyis la 'bre ar gnyis zhes grags shing / 'bre shes rab 'bar gyis snga dar gyi bshad rgyun khams su 'phos pa yang gsan par 'gos gzhon nu dpal gsungs so/ /yang seṅge bzang po nas ku sa li

184 da zom ju ga tshu che chung gnyis dang / de nas gser gling pa/ de nas jo bo chen po la brgyud cing / jo bos bsam yas dang snye thang sogs su nyi snang dang 'grel chung sogs phar phyin gyi bshad pa mang du gnang bas/ jo bo nasa'abrom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang / de nas 'brom ston can nam mgo bla ma/ de nas 'bre shes rab 'bar la brgyud pa la phar phyin 'brom lugs su grags/ yang jo bos snye thang du mngon rtogs rgyan rgyas par gsung dus phyag dar ston pas zin bris byas shing de nas brgyud pa la khams lugs su grags so/ /yang jo bo nasakhu chen po lha ldings pa/ rgya rgyal ba tshul khrims seṅge / li ston chos grags nas 'bre chen por brgyud pa la khu lugs su grags shing / de dag la yig cha dang bshad srol gyi cha mi 'dra ba so sor yod par skyabs mgon mchog nas gsungs pas/ 'bre po nas brgyud pa 'dres kyang bshad srol ma 'dres pa'o/ /ar byang chub ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i phar phyin dang / mdo sdud pa dang sher snying gi ṭīkka sogs yod gsungs la/ delislob ma 'dul 'dzin dkar mo/de nas dkar chung ring mo gzhon nu tshul khrims/ zhang ye ba smon lam tshu‘ra khrims/ gnyal zhig 'jam dpal rdo rje/ gzad ring dar ma tshul khrims/ bo dong pa brtson 'grus rdo rje/ lha ston grub pa seṅge /khro phu pa bsod nams seṅge / tshad ma'iskyes bu bso da nams mgon po/de la bu ston rin chen grub kyis gsan te phar phyin lung gi snye ma mdzad par bu ṭīka zhes grags/ de nas nya dbon kun dga' dpal bas gsan/phar ṭīka yid kyi mun sel mdzad pa la nya ṭīka tu grags shing rje rin po

da ba— rgyathom ga / 185chechathugs 'phrog tshul rnam thar du gsal la/ de nas rje btsun red mda' bas gsan te phar ṭīka kyang mdzad/ de nas chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos gsan nas legs bshad gser gyi phreng ba mdzad pas mkhas pa stag tshang ba'i thugs 'phrogs te/ khyod blo'i nyi ma gzhon nu'i dus kyis (kyi)tshe/ /mdo dang rgyan gyi pad tshal rgyas mthong nas/ /bdag yid khengs pa'i ku mud lhag par zum/ /zab yangs mkhyen pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sogs chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dang mthun pa'i bsngags brjod mdzad/ khyad par rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi man ngag la brten nas gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba'i tshul rtogs brjod las/ de nas gdul bya'i blo mun sel ba'i mchog /'jam pa'i dbyangs la shugs drag mos gus kyis/ /dad pa brtan pos gzhung lugs gdams pa ru/ /'char phyir gsol btab rgyu tshogs kun la 'bad/ /de ltar 'bad pas klu sgrub thogs med las/ /rim par brgyud pa'i byang chub lam rim la/ /thun mong min pa'i nges pa rnyed gyur nas/zab mo'i gzhung mchog phar phyin gdams par shar/ /zhes so/ /ji de lta bu'i gdams ngag gi don bzhin du rgyal tshab rjes rnam bshad snying bo rgyan mdzad/ mkhas grub rjes red mda' ba la gsan nas phar phyin rtog ge'i snang ba mdzad cing / rgyal tshab rje la yang gsan/ rgyal tshab la rin chen byang chub kyis gsan nas yig cha mdzad cing / mkhas grub rjer shar pa rin chen rgyal mtshan pas gsan nas yig cha mang du mdzad/ rgyal tshab rje la gnyal rgod rin chen bsam grub dang / de la

186 gad— —kyi ma ’ra gas ma 'jam dbyangs chos rjes gsan/ de'i slob ma blo gros rin chen seṅges kyang phar phyin gyi yig cha mdzad/ de'i slob ma gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyis drang nges rnam 'byed kyi dka' 'grel sogs mdzad/ derislob ma don yod dpal ldan gyis kyang phar phyin gyiwaṃg cha mdzad/ de'i slob ma dwags nyag rigs pa 'i ral gri'i phar phyin dwags po grwa tshang du 'chad nyan mdzad ces thos/ de'i slob ma gtsang ston dge legs bshes gnyen gyis kyang phar phyin gyi yig cha mdzad/ de'i slob ma chag te'u ra pa dge 'dun bsam 'grub/ delislob ma sgrom mda' pa blo bzang chos 'phel/ de'islob ma dkon mchog chos 'phel/ des kyang phar phyin gyi yig cha mdzad/de'i slob ma rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos kyang phar phyin gyi yig cha rmodzad pa'i mjug tu/ se ra rje btsun pa paṇa chen bsod grags pa/ gung ru chos 'byung sogs kyi yig cha rnams ni ngag 'khyal brjod min tsam las dgos nus gang yang med par bshad de blo gsal rnams kyi mchu sgros kyi 'dab ma bzhad pas so phreng gi ge sar dbang med du ston par byed pa'o / /yang 'bre shes rab 'bar nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi bar du phar phyin kyi bshad srol bar ma chad pa byung ste/ paṇa chen gyi gsung du/ shes rab 'bar dang byang chub ye shes dang / /gzhon nu tshul khrims dang ni shes rab 'bum/ /byang chub 'bum dang 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / /dar tshul brtson 'grus rdo rje rin po che/ /grub pa seṅge tshad ma'i skyes bu ste/ /bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras dang / /rin chen 'phel dang tshul khrims ye shes dang / /'od zer

da ma gas / 187bzang po yon tan bzang po dang / /sangs rgyas ye shes chos kyi rgyal mtshan te/ /phar phyin brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de la rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos bstan pa'i chu mgo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab ste/ dgon ma las bu dga' ba'i 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i lung bstan bstsal pa ltar/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje bkra shis dpal ldan pas dpal ldan 'bras dkar spungs pa'i gling dang /byams chen chos kyi rje shākya ye shes pas se ra theg chen gling 'debs par mdzad/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyis bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi sde chen po btab pa dang / de dag las rim gyis mar me gcig 'as gnyis chad kyi tshul du zhwa ser 'chang ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde bka' pota kyi 'chad nyan skyong ba bgrang gis mi lang ba zhig dbus gtsang dang / mdo stod/ mdo smad/ rgya nag sogs su byung tshul dang / de dang der yig 'jog mdzad pa'i mkhas pa ji snyed byung tshul/ de dag la 'chad nyan dar tshul sogs bka' pota chos 'byung gi tshul du bris na 'brel chags pa 'ong yang yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas bzhag la/ yig cha mdzad mkhan shin tu grags che ba/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i sras kyi thu bo gnyis dang rje 'dul 'dzin pa/ rgyal ba dge 'dun grub/ 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pa/ rje smon lam dpal ba/ gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po/nyan po shākya rgyal mtshan/ dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal/ shar pa rin chen rgyal mchan/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen legs pa don grub/ blo gros rin chen

188 da sdo ga seṅge / se ra rje btsun pa/ paṇa chem/ bsod nams grags pa/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ rje drung shes rab dbang po/se ra bde legs nyi ma/ khyung phrug byams pa bkra shis/ mkhas grub bstan pa dar rgyas/ gung ru chos kyi 'byung gnas/ gung ru rin chen byang chub/ stag lung brag pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ byang ston blo gros rgya mtsho/mkhas mchog sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ shasgri pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ gra chung ba yon tan rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen mchog lha 'od zer/ drung chen legs pa bzang po/ kun mkhyen chos 'byor dpal bzang / rta nag pa dge 'dun blo bzang / byang ston brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ se ra don yod dpal ldan/ dwags nyag rigs pa'i ral gri/ gtsang ston dge legs bshes gnyen sogs kyis mdzad pa'i bka' pota so so'i yig cha mang du yod de grwa sa chen po rnams su grags che ba'i skor ro/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i dngos slob dang / bkra shis 'khyil gdan sa ba'i khrod nas kyang / khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis/ khri chen sprul pa'i sku blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gung thang sprul pa'i sku dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/ thang ring blo bzang dge legs/ rgyal mo rong pa nam mkha' lhun grub/ bya bral blo bzang rin chen/ mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ smra dbang bsod nams dbang rgyal sogs yig 'jog mdzad mkhan mang du byung ste rim gyis 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ lung rigs mgrin pa'i dbyangs snyan skye dgu yi/ /rna ba'i gnyen gyur mkhas pa ngang ba'i khyu/ /sde 'dir zhugs te bshad sgrub

18zhurol rtsed 'bum/ /skyong bas thub bstan mtsho chen ci yang mdzes/ /dam pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsis tshim pa ster/ /sde snod lung dang rigs pa'i dpal 'byor ldan/ /nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' ba'i zhing khams 'di/ /mthong nas dag pa'i zhing la gus pa lhod/ /e ma dbu phar 'dul mngon 'dzam gling gi /mkhas pa'i rgyan gyur dka' chen bzhi zhes grags/ /tshul des mdzes pa'i mkhas dbang 'di dag ni/ /'dzam gling yangs pa'i rgyal khams nyid kyi rgyan/ /smra ba'i khyu mchog phyogs glang grags pa'i zhabs/ /mu stegs rgol ba 'joms la zhugs pa ltar/ /dran dbang stong gis brgal brtag rigs pa'i char/ /rtag tu 'bebs 'di thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gnyen/ /rnam mang lung gi rgyud du nyer drangs pa'i/ /dri med rigs pa'i nyag phran rnon po ni/ /'phangs pas thog med rang la rjes zhugs pa'i/ /log 'dzin rtsad nas gcod pa dgos pa'i gtso/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshikas su bcad pa'o/ / rgyud smad grwa tshang ji ltar’tshugs tshul/༄ // rgyud pa grwa tshang ji ltar tshugs pa'i tshul ni/ de yang ston pa sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi phung po ji snyed gsungs pa thams cad theg pa che chung gnyis su 'du zhing / theg la yang phar phyin dang sngags kyi theg pa gastes las mchog tu gyur pa ni phyi ma yin la/ de bshad sgrub la rag

190 da da nga ga ma las pa dang / de yang dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las par dgongs nas rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i bka' ltar rje btsun shes rab seṅge yab sras kyis gtsang du srad rgyud dang / dbus su dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang 'dzugs par mdzad/ de las mched de rgyud chen kun dga' don 'grub kyis dbus kyi rgyud stod kyang btsugs/ de dag las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul gyis phyogs thams cad du rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde dar zhing rgyas par gyur to/ /rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sde thams cad kyis rgyud kyi yang rtse bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bshad sgrub la rtsal du 'don pa yang don chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'thob par byed pa la bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi lam ya ma bral ba dgos par yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rgyal ba gnyis pa la nan tan du gdams pas so /de'i phyir rgyud shrī 'di nyid kyis kyang bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bshad sgrub la gtso bor bgyid de/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed du gsungs pa sogs kyi lo rgyus mang na yang / grags che ba ni yul u rgyan gyi rgyal po itna bhu tis dgra bcom mang po nam mkha' la rdzu 'phrul gyis phebs pa gzigs nas ci yin dris pas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor gyi nyan thos yin zer ba thos te/ 'khor 'di lta bu dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das de 'dir byon na ci ma rung dgongs ma thag bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa der byon/ rgyal pos 'dod yon la chags pa ma spangs par 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs zhus pa'i ngor chags bral gyi

da da rtang ga ma 191sku'i rnam pa dor te 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs su mdzad nas gsungs shing rdo rje chos la rgyud gtad par mdzad/ de lta bu'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la rgyud kyi dgongs pa 'grel tshul dang dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bzhag 'byed tshul las 'phags yul na lugs mang yang bod 'dir 'phags lugs dang ye shes zhabs lugs gnyis grags che ste/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis srol phye ba'i 'jam rdor lha bcu dgu ma la ye shes zhabs lugs dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i mi skyod rdo rje lha so gnyis ma la 'phags lugs su grags/ 'phags lugs la yang gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir mar 'gos /kyi lugs gnyis gyes te/ mar lugs gdams ngag gis khyad par du 'phags pa dang / 'gos lugs bshad srol gyis khyad du 'phags par rje rin po ches gsungs so/ /de yang mar lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ klu sgrub la ma ti ki pas gsan/ma tiki zhes pa klu byang spyod pa la zhugs pa'i mtshan yin zhes 'brug pa pad dkar bas gsungs kyang rje rin po ches/ klu byang shākya bshes gnyen ma ti ki zhes so sor gsungs pas 'thad par ma mthong ngo / /des na rje'i gsan yig las/ de la ma ti ki ni klu sgrub kyi thugs sras bzhi nye sras gsum ste bdun gyi nang nas thugs sras gcig go /thugs sras bzhi ni/'jam dpal zhal mthong shākya mi tra/ sgrol ma zhal mthong na ga sto rnyi/sa brgyad non pa acha de ba/ spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong ma ti ki pa'o/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de bzhin du klu sgrub kyi bla ma rgyal sras blo gros rin chen yang gser

192 da da gas ma lding ba sogs kyis li tsa byi dri med grags par bshad pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis sa ra har bshad tshul sogs snang ngo / — /ma ti ki nas te lo pa dang / de nas nā ro pa/ de nas mar ba ste 'dis 'phags yul du bla ma brgya rtsa bsten pa sogs kyi rnam thar grags che/ de la slob ma ka bzhir grags pa byung ba'i nang nas mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje la gsang 'dus kyi bka' babs/ de la 'khon gang pa ki rtis gsan zhing / de la bya sgang ba bsod nams rin chen dang / de la thur lha ba tshul khrims skyabagakyis gsan pa'o/ /'gos lugs ni/ mgon po klu sgrub la dpal ldan zla ba grags pas gsan te sgron gsal mdzad pa la 'chad nyan dar/ des slob pa'i rdo rje/des grub thob nag po spyod pa/ des bla ma sprin gyi shugs can la gnang zhing / de la rje 'gos kyis gsan te/ rje 'gos kyis paṇḍi ta'i bla ma bdun cu/ mkha' 'gro'i bla ma gnyis sogs bsten te mdo rgyud mtha' yas pa gsan zhing gsang 'dus kyi stong thun chen mo sogs kyang mdzad/de nas rim par brgyud pa'i bshad srol ltag pa rin chen grags las thur lha ba tshul khrims skyabs kyis gsan te/ de nas mar 'gos kyi brgyud pa gnyis 'dres su gyur/ mar 'gos kyi brgyud pa'i chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa'i bshad srol dang gdams ngag rdzogs par rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang rje btsun red mda' ba las chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos gsan nas bshad pa dang gdams ngagañtsagacig tu dril te 'chad pa rim pa lnga gsal ba'i sgron me dang / sgron gsal la mchan dang yang

— da dathatshong rtaja ga 193mchan dang bsdus don mthan dpyod bzhi mdzad pa la 'grel ba bzhi sbrags zhes snyan pa mngon par mtho zhing 'chad nyan gaṅgā'irgyun lta bu byung ba 'di bzhin lags so/ /de yang rgyud kyi steng nas 'grel ba bzhi sbrags pa la/ sgron gsal dang / mchan dang / bsdus don dang mtha' dpyod bzhi ga dgos la/sgron gsal gyi steng nas 'grel ba bzhi sprags pa la mchan dang yang mchan dang bsdus don dang mtha' gcod nyid sbrags pa mkhas pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /de yang 'grel ba'i bshad rgyun brtson 'grus 'phags kyis rgya ra chos skyong rgya mtshor gsan pa'i dbang gis srad rgyud par brgyud pa zung 'brel dang / rgyud pa rnam rgyal grags bzang gis paṇa chen rig pa seṅge la gsan pa'i dbang gis smad rgyud par brgyud pa zung 'brel byung bar gsungs so/ /kun mkhyen chen po nyid nas brgyud pa zung 'brel gyi gdams pa'i bdud rtsi bu slob rnams la gnang ba'i rgyun slar yang bsam bzhin mi'i rnam rol skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas rgya cher bskyangs pa las da lta phyogs 'di 'dus pa lugs gnyis kyi dbang / rim gnyis kyi dmar khrid rgyud 'grel gyi bshad srol/ bskyed rdzogs kyi bshad lung dang bklags lung sogs dpal ldan 'dus pa'i chos tshul mtha' dag sdud pa'i za ma tog lta bur yod do// //

194 bde mchog gi rgyud kyi byung ba/༄ // bde mchog gi rgyud ni/ rtsod ldan gyi dus su nam mkha' nas lha bzhi dang / dri za bzhi byung nas bu li ra ma la ya la sogs pa'i gnas brgyad bzung / bar snang nas gnod sbyin bzhi dang grul bum bzhi byung nas ka ma ru pa la sogs pa'i gnas brgyad bzung / sa 'og nas klu bzhi dang lha min bzhi byung nas pre ta pu ri la sogs pa'i gnas brgyad bzung ste gdug pa can de rnams kyis dbang phyug la mchod pa lhur len zhing /dbang phyug rang nyid kyis gnas de rnams su de rnams la mchod pa'i rten du rang gi mtshan ma re bzhag ste dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa dug gsum gyis lhag par myos shing sems can la gnod 'tshe rgyun du byed pa de rnams 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa gzigs nas ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis ri rab kyi rtse mor dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i dbus su rang nyid bcom ldan 'das he ru ka'i skur bzhengs te drag po chung ma dang bcas pa zhabs 'og tu mnan/ 'khor rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa sa yul nyer bzhi'i gdug pa can mtha' dag btul/ 'dul byed la gdul bya'i ming gis btags pa'i khaṇḍa ka pa la dang rab gtum ma la sogs pa'i 'khor la dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud gsungasasku shing / phyag na rdo rjes rgyud bsdu bar mdzad de/ sa ra ha dang / des klu sgrub dang /

de gagi da ——ge 195des sha ba ri dang / desangalha.i bal gnang/ tso.i bas bde mchog lha re gnyis kyi sgrub thabs bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim rnal 'byor chen po sogs mdzad pas bde mchog tso i ba'i lugs zhes grags/ de'i slob ma dra ri ka ba la slob dpon rdo rje dril bu bas gsan/ 'dis phyi dkyil lha lnga dang lus dkyil lha re gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim rim lnga sogs mdzad pa la dril lugs su grags/ des rus sbal zhabs dang des dza lasto ra ba dang des nag po spyod pa la gnang zhing 'dis tso.i ba'i sgrub thabs dang zhal phyag sogs kyis khyad zhugs pa'i bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim dpyid thig sogs mdzad pas nag po lugs su grags/ de nas rim par brgyud de khyung po lhas pa la rje bdag nyid chen pos gsan cing / tso nagaXdril gsum ka'i rtsa ba lta buracudagongs nas lha i ba'i bskyed rim 'dod 'jo/ rdzogs rim rnal 'byor chen po/rgyud kyi rnam bshad sbas don kun gsal sogs mdzad pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su lam gyi grogs byed pa dang / mkha' spyod du rdo rje'i glu len pa gsan pa dang / shing (shid)zan zhes pa'ang de nas go zhes pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can brnyes pa rnam thar rin po che'i snye ma ltar dang /mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar du yang te ru ka'i zhal nas/nga'ichos skor la rgya bod gnyis karaspyoblo bzang grags pa'i yig cha lasang bzang ba ma byung gsungs zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /de ltar bde mchog lha nag dril gsum gyi dbang / rim gnyis kyi dmar khrid/ rgyud 'gresmyo zagyi bshad srol sogs 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos tshul mtha' yas pa zhig kyang

196chos sde chen po 'dir dar rgyas gonga'aphel gyi tshu' du yosde de zhibapar ma bris so// // rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi byung ba/ li // rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud ni/ sngon lha dbang byug chen poribu gzhon nu gdong drug dang lha min gdolabadragajipo gnyis 'dzamangabuli gling gi bdas/ po su byed la ma 'cham par 'thab pas gzhonanganu gdong drug pham/ de'i tshe lha dbang byug chen posaṭwāṃnamamakha'atshol spyod pa'i lha rnams dang / sa steng gi nad brgyad gdon brgyad/ lha ma yin dang klu la sogs pa sa gsum gyi dmag dpung dang bcasamite 'ong ba na gdol bcidrag pong 'jigs shing skrags te rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangasangalaskyabs su song bas/'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis de rnams 'dul ba'i dus la babs par gzigs nas rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi skur bzhengs te/ rtsa zhal dang liṅgas dbang phyug chen po btul/ zhal gzhan brgyad kyis phyogs mtshams kyi 'jigs byed brgyad btul/ ma—he'i rwa gnyis kyis lha ma yin gyi rta pa rnams bcom/ glang lpags 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis kyis brgya byin dang / phyag gzhan so gnyis kyis nye dbang so gnyis tshar bcad/zhabs g.yas brgyad kyis gdon brgyad dang / g.yon brgyad kyis nad brgyad mnan/ klu rnams rgyan du bcings te gdug pa can de dag thams

rdoje gsabyedargya ——spyod—— 197cadatshar bcad cing bsgral nas snying khrag gsol ba la sogs pa 'jigs pa chen po bstan nas slar yang gsos shing rjes su bzung ste ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ gdod nas grub pa dang gsar du thob pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor garnams dang /sangs rgyas byang sems nam mkha' gang ba'i dbus su rgyud gsungs pa ni rwa lugs kyi lo rgyus so/ / yang ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis gshin rje rnams 'dul ba'i dus la babs par gzigs nas ri rab kyi rtse mor rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skur sprul/lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i pha rol thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer du byon nas lcags mkhar bcu drug zhabs bcu drug gis mnan/ dbus kyi lcags mkhar liṅga rgyas pas bsnyel zhing / gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po gnad nas gzir/bdud tshogs thams cad rmeg med du bcom pas sde brgyad thams cad kyis srog snying phul/ mna' dor/ gshin rje dang ma mo thams cad sgrol ba'i gying pho mor byin gyis brlabs/ bstan pa srung bar bka' bsgos/srog gi snying bo phul ba sngags su byin gyis brlabs nas rgyud gsungs pa ni skyo lugs kyi lo rgyus so/ /'dililo rgyus snga ma dbang phyug 'dul ched ma te'i zhal du sprul nas gsungs pa ni/ grub chen zhi ba ye shes kyis/ /dbang phyug chen po'i dkyil 'khor na/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang / lo rgyus phyi ma ni/ grub chen darban gyis/ lho phyogs sa 'og rim pa bdun/ /sgo med mun khang bcu drug na/ /zhes so gas dang mthun pa'i bshad pa yin spyang / gzhon nu

1skyeskye rdo ma ga gid skya da ri gdong drug gi lo rgyus dang lha min gyi 3rgyal po ru tra pham tshul sogs la shes byed dka' la/ de bzhin ducirnying malim tre ru tralidape blangs pa'i lo rgyus 'ga' zhig sogs rgyud dang rgya gzhung nas zur tsam yang mi 'byung ba'i lo rgyus snga matre'aga' zhig mi 'thad tshul dang / rang lugs dus 'khor ltar dpal ldan 'bras spungs su gsungs pa'i tshul dang / dbang byug 'dul ched du sa steng du gsungs pa dang /gshin rje 'dul chen thod pa — lcags kyi grong khyer du gsungs ngadang / rdo rje gdan du bdud 'dul ched du gsungs pa dang / longs sprul gyi sangs rgyas gzhan gyis gnasartsodus mtha' yas par gsungs pa'i tshul sogs 'dir ha cang mang bas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ / de yang rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag gsum pa u rgyan gyi yul na bzhugs pa las rtog bdun/ bshad rgyud rtog gsum/ rtog pa bzhi pa/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa rnams lnga li tas rgya gar du spyan drangs par rwa skyo zhang gsum mthun kyang lo rgyus cung zad mi 'dra bar snang ste gzhan du shes par —bya'o rgyashā li ta badzra nas rim bzhin a mo snya badzra ram don yod rdo rje che ba/ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa ste dzñā nā ka ra/ padma badzra ram shrī rakṣi ta/dri pa ka ra rakṣi ta'am me tsa gling pa bar du brgyud cing de las rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis gsan pa la rwa lugs su grags/ don yod rdo rje che ba'i slob ma don yod rdo rje chupab la skyo 'od 'byung gis gsan pa la skyo lugs su grags/ yang lnga li ta badzra nas ye shes zhabs dang / des mar me

rdo sru gas byedakyi da spyo byu 19pyimadzad bzang po dang / des lte li ta badzra chung ba/ des bde sbyin zhabs/ des se na pa/ des mkha' lding zhabs/ des gu na a ka ra bha dra/ de sa ngag dbang grags pa/ des de ba a ka ra tsaṭī/ de la zhang cog gru bla mas gsan pa la zhang lugs su grags/ bod kyi 'gar ldong rgya gsum du grags pa ni rwa skyo'i lugs 'dzin kho na'o/ /rwa lo'i dbon po rwa chos rab la slob ma rwa ye shes seṅge dang / rwa dharma seṅge bya ba gnyis byung ste/ snga ma nas brgyud pa la rwa nub pa dang /phyi ma nas brgyud pa la rwa shar bar grags shing / ye shes seṅge nas rim bzhin/ rwa 'bum seng / rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ rong ba shes rab seṅge / bla ma ye shes dpal ba/ chos rje don grub rin chen la chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos gsan/ nye brgyud ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhi drag gnyis kas rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po la dngos su dbang bskur zhing zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gdams pa'i bdud rtsi bstsal pas/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa dang phyag rdor gyi rgyud las/ nga yi bstan pa byung ba'i dus/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstan pa dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstan pa dang / rje rin po che'i bstan pa gsum don gcig tu bzhed do/ / rje bdag nyid chen po nas srad rgyud dben sa sogs su rim par brgyud pa'i gshed skor gyi dbang dang gdams pa mtha' yas pa zhig 'dir dar rgyas su yod tshul 'god par 'os spyang mang bas 'jigs nas ma bris so// //

200 rgyud dbyangs sogs bshad pa/ rdzo leryā/ de yang rgyud dbyangs dang rgyud pa stod smadadziphyag na cung zad re mi 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bka' gdam sa chos 'byung las/ mkha' 'gro3ma rnams kyis mchod pa dang bstod dbyangs byed pa thugs la bzung nas ting 'dzin pir legs ma dang / dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyapa ris su bkug pa yinangazhes dang / 'jigs byed chos 'byungacikhams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i nyi 'od las/ rgyud dbyangs 'di yang mkha' 'gro ma rna mas kyis tshig mi thos pa'i dbyangs mang po byed pa gsan nas bkug pa yin zhes rgyud rgan rnams kyis ngag rgyun du yod pa bden par mngon/ delidon gyis nyams len cher ma byung yang phyag len ma nyams par byas na byin —rlabs myur ba yin te/ smon lam gnang dus sangs rgyas thams cad kyis de ltar byin gyis brlabs pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang dbyangs chen bzhi tshar gcig 'then pa dang 'bum dag tshar gcig phan yon mnyam zhes ngag rgyun du 'byung ba ltar kun mkhyen gong /mas kyang de bzhin gsungs par zin bris shig las dngos su mthong zhing rgyu mtshan yang dbugs ngal gso bzhi lnga re'i ring la lha'i sku gsung thugs kyi nga rgyal gsal snang bsgrubs pas yin zhes sde khri rin po ches gsung jir ro//

dadabyangam garda/shadage/ 201gzhan yang rnam thar la sa/ /chos skyong rnams la gtor ma 'bul dus dbyangs kyi nga ro dang bcas na kshin tu dgyes par 'dug pas 'di bzhin byed pa yin gsungs nas spyan 'dren pa dang bstod cing bskul ba sogs kyi dbyangs bzhi mdzad ces dang / chos 'byung de nyid las 'ga'azhig gi rmi lam du/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brjid cing zil che ba zhig gis bstod pa'i dbyangs 'di ltar gyis shig gsungs nas 'then pas sa dang ri bo thams cad be re re 'ong ba gcig byung / gshin rje'i ngar dbyangs dang / gshin rje'i 'then dbyangs zer ba yang don 'di 'dra yin snyam zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong mang pos dus so sor 'then tshul mi 'dra ba dang / rje yab sras rnams kyis so so'i gsung gi gdangs su bkug tshul sogs kyis dbyangs mi 'dra ba byung ba yin la/ rgyud kyi tshig zin dang / man ngag gi phyag len so sor yod pa dang / man ngag la yang grub chen so sos rgyud don bkral ba'i man ngag mi 'dra ba du ma yod pa'i dbang gis cho ga'i 'don tshul yang mi 'dra ba du ma yod pa'i rgyu mtshan mang du yod kyang ma spros so/ / des na phyag len la yang ris su bcad nas chags zhen dang sdang zhugs med par gong ma rnams kyis ji ltar mdzad pa'i rgyun ma 'dres par nyams su blangs na byin rlabs che tshul sngar ltar shes dgos so/ /de dag ni 'phros don tsam yinano// //
