202 rgyud grwa dngos kyi lo rgyus/ ༄tsho/ rgyusdo grwa dngos kyi lo rgyus ni/ de yang kun mkhyen chen po de nyid la/ sre (sred)rgyud rdo rje 'chang nas rgyud grwa 'debs dgos so gas kyi zhal bkod dang / 'argyung 'gyur gyi lung bstan du ma genang ba'i tshul zur tsam ni/ 'jigs byed chos 'byung las/ 'di phyogs su rgyud gnyis btsugs pa yang bstan pa la phan po zhig yong ngam snyam pa'i gsung zur du ma yod pa lags/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / ngag rgyun la maṇḍal khru gang ba zhig la dung phran dang 'gron bu star la brgyus pa'i tsho ma bu bkod pa dang / nang mchod ka pā la gcig bcas gnang ste khyed a mdor phebs nas dgon ba zhig 'debs rgyu yong bas/ legs par thesnabs pa na rgyud grwa zhig kyang ma brjed par gal bo cher thugs la bcang dgos zhes gsungs par yang gleng zhing maṇḍal ka pā la dang bcas pa da lta rgyud pa'i nang rten du yod de/ maṇḍal gyi steng na rdo rdze'achang gi drung du phul zhes sbyin bdag gis ri mo 'bur dod bzos snang ngo / /tshu la de thugs la bzhag nas yul dbus dge 'phel du bzhugs skabs nas rgya hor ba phun rte tshogs bstan 'dzin la khyod kyis rgyud smad pa'i 'grig lam/ ri 'don rta dbyangs phyag len thams cad zhib mor rtsad gcod gyis/ rjes sor mkho yong zhes bka' phebs pa lta ra /khong gis rgyud du lo mang por 'grims nas

wad dmas 'o— 203nan tan chen po byas pa smren zhes phun tshogs bstan 'dzin pa nyid kyis gsungs par grwa rgan rnams gleng / de ltar rgyud grwa tshugs dgos kyedagongs bzhed sngar nas yod kyang thugs brel gyi dbang gis cung zad 'gyangs pa las/ dgon pa tshugs nas lo bdun song ba me sprel gyi lo rje red mda' ba'i dris lan gyi ṭīkka rtsom pa'i ched du gsang 'dus kyi skor la zhib gzigs mdzad pas sa lam gyi bgrod lugs la nges pa gting nas 'drongs pa'i spyan chab 'khrugs pa mang du mdzad cing lam gyi mchog 'di mi nub pa'i ched du rgyud grwa bzang po zhig da lta nyid du tshugs dgos par dgongs te glo bur du rab 'byams pa hor blo gsal bla ma dbu mdzad dang /rab 'byams pa phun tshogs bstan 'dzin bying (byings )'dren du bskos/grwa ba gsar bu bcu gsum la tshag btsugs chos grwa'i sa sogs gzigs rtog gnang / chos grwa da lta'i chos grwa/ phan tshun gnyis res mos dang /tshogs 'du khang chen mo'i zhal ras lha khang du 'tshogs nas hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga'i dus chen khyad par can gyi nyin gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ rje rang nyid nas 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi bshad pa dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi tshig bzhag zhag nyi shu'i ring la 'chag med du gnang / chosathog gi mjug tutshogs gtam gnang nas lo re bzhin 'grel ba bzhi srugs kyi bshad pa tshar re dang / ṭīkka'i rtsi bzhag tshang ba re 'gro dgos pa dang 'don rta dbyangs phyag len sogs rgyud smad bzhin byed dgos pa'i bka' khyab bstsal/ chos thog phyi ma la rje rin po ches sher seng la ji ltar gnang ba bzhin nang mchod ka pā la dang / 'gredzeeb bzhi sbrags kyi glegs bam/

da kro4 shad —ḍa sdo——dam sho ka li bcas gnang nas bla ma dbu mdzad hor blo gsal ba rgyud pa'i bla ma dang / rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bla ma dbu mdzad du bskos te rgyud kyi 'chad nyan dang phyag len ma nyams pa byed dgos pa'i bka' phebs/gdan rabs na rim gyis gong 'phel du bskyangs pas da lta dpyid chos nas ston chos chen mo'i bar du 'grel ba bzhi sprags yongs rdzogs kyi bshad pa dang / ṭīkka che chung gnyis dang dwags po nam mkha' grags kyi bskyed rim gyi brtsi bzhag gsung bshad dang bcas pa 'gro la/ ston chos lhag ma gnyis dang dgun chos skabs gsang 'dus kyi bskyed rdzogs chen mo gnyis kyi gzab bshad dang / nam mkha' grags kyi rdzogs rim/ 'jigs byed dang bde mchog bskyed rim gyi rtsi bzhag gtong ba dang / dpyid nag pa zla ba'i mar ngor rdul tshon la brten pa'i bde mchog gi sgrub mchod dang /ston lha babs kyi zla bar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i 'jigs gsang gnyis kyi sgrub mchod dang / de dang dus mnyam par rim lngalidamar khrid skyong srol yod la/ gzhan yang gar thig dbyangs gsum/gtor chen/ glo bur rnga chings/ rgyud kyi dam bca' chen mo/ lhung bzed mchod pa/ bsgab gral sogs kyang rgyud smad dang mthun par byed pa dang / rab gnas / sbyin sreg gtor ma/ 'khor lo sogs kyi phyag len dpal mnyam med dge ldan pa'i thun mong ma yin pa rnams ma nyams par bzhugs shing / rgyud sde zab mo'i byin rlabs mngon gyur gyi lag rtags mngon sum du mthong ba yang mang du byung ngo / /smras pa/ rin chen lta bu'i gdul byas tshe gcig la/ /zung 'jug

206sgrub la gsang 'jigs he ru ka'i/ /lam bzang nam yang zung 'brel dgos so zhes/ /rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gsungs/ /gang phyir sgyu lus gnad la 'dus pa dang / bde stong ye shes gnad la 'khor lo sdom/ /gzhan las khyad 'phags nyi zla ltar grags shing / /'jigs mdzad rgyud ni khyad par lnga ldan gsungs/ /gang zhig rab gsang 'dus pa'i rgyud 'di nyid/ /'chad dang nyan pa'ang byang chub rdo rje dang / /'dra bar blta zhes 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi mar/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpas yang dag bsngags/ /de phyir gsung rab rin chen za ma tog /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i bshad sgrub la/ /gzhol ba'i sngags 'chang sde 'dis 'phags yul gyi/ /grub chen brgyad cu'i snyems pa'ang 'phrog gam snyam/ /gsang chen chos kyi bdud rtsi la rol pa'i/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'dus sde 'di gzigs nas/ /gnas gsum dpa' bro mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i glu/ /'og min mkha' spyod gnas su'ang ca cor gyur/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigasasu bcad pa'o// //dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi byung ba/ra / dus 'khor grwa tshang e wa chos 'khor gling du dus 'khor/kun rig rnam snang mngon byang gi cho ga —sogs phyag len mdzad bzhin pa yin pas/ mdo rgyud gzhan dang bshad srol mi 'dra ba'i dpal dus kyi

206 dab dus kyi mkhor mo'i da kyi / 'khor lo'i rgyud ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya seṅge zil gnon me rta'i zla bshol dang bcas pa'i sa ga zla ba snga maritshes bco lngami mtshan mo lhums su zhugs/ lo de'i dgun zla tha chung rta zla ba'i tshes bdun gyi snga dro sku bltams/ nyer lngar khab tu bzhugs/ nyer dgu pa shing pho khyir rab tu byung / lo drug dka'’ba spyad de so drug pa lcag sa sbrul gyi dpyid zla tha chung sa ga'i nya la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing / phyi de lo dpyid 'bring nag pa'i nya la dus 'khor rtsa rgyud gsungs par bu ston dang mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa sogs kyis bzhed pa ltar kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas kyang skabs brgyad pa'i mtha' dpyod dang bstan rtsis sogs su 'khrul ba med pa'i lung rigs du mas sgrub par mdzad do/ / — kun mkhyen mchog gi gsung gzhan du drag po lcags sprel la sku sgro bltams pa dang so lnga dang so bdun la sangs rgyas pa sogs kyi bshad yam rsha mdzad kyang rang lugs ni 'di kho nar gnas so/ /des na so bdun chu rta nag pa'i nya la lho phyogs dpal gyi ri dang nye ba dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten chen por 'og tu chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor dang / steng du dpal ldan rgyu skar3gyi dkyil 'khor spros nas zhu ba po dpal phyag na rdo rjes sbrulasapa'i shasnya la'i rgyal po zla ba bzang po dang shasnya la'i grong khyer bye ba dgu bcu rtsa drugajigi rgyal po sogs la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa gsungs shing / zla bzang 'khor deng4 bcas pa slar yang rdzu 'phrul gyis shasnya lar byon/ rtsa rgyud kyi glegs barme

da ma rngerjospyo'akhoraritsā da spyo sa 1— 207bzhengs shing rang gis mdzad pa'i rgyas 'grel stong phrag drug cu pa yang glegs bam du bris nas skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag rnams la rgya cher bstan/ sems can rnams kyi dngos grub kyi rgyu'i slad du shasnya la mtha' gangs ris bskor ba'i dbus su padma 'dab brgyad/ de re re la yul bcu gnyis re/ de re re la yul 'khor brgya phrag re/ de re re la grong 'bum phrag re ste grong bye ba dgu bcu rtsa drug gis bskor ba'i lte ba gangs ri mu khyud lta bus bskor ba'i dbus na ka lnga pa'i grong mi khyim bye ba phrag bcu gnyis yod pa/ de'i lho phyogs ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i blos bslang khru bzhi brgya yod pa bzhengs te rdzu 'phrul bstan nas gshegs so/ / shlau de nas chu lug la rang gi sras lha dbang khrir phebs shing / de nas gzi brjid can/ zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/lha dbang ldan te rgyal po drug gis lo drug brgya'i bar du chos bstan/ de nas 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa rgyakha/ po grags pa zhes bya ba byung nas lo brgya'i bar du chos bstan zhing (cing) / 'dis chos bstan nas zhe gcig lon pa dang bod du gnya' khri btsan po byung ba dus mnyam par bshad da/ /de yang rgyal po grags pas nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi zla bzang gis bzhengs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi khang ba der bos nas/ zla ba phyi ma'i nag pa'i nya 'di la khyed rnams la rdo rje theg pa sbyin par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang drang srong rnams skrag nas 'gyel bar gyur pa na/ khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi khang ba 'dir

—shi8 da da mtshosakhewas 1mo daspyo /zhugs shing dbang nod na ni bdag gi bkas khyed rnams rdo rje'i rigs dang lhan cig bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / bag ma blangs pa'i 'brel ba rnaca5 sa kyang bya'o/ / de ltar mi byed pa lta na bdag gi grong khyer bye ba dgu bcu rtsa drug bor la gang dang gang du mos pa der song zhig ces gsungs pa na drang srong rnams kyis chu boshi ta'i lho kha ba can dang laṅga'i gling gi bar 'phags yul du 'gro bar bgros nas ka lnga pa'i grong nas phyung ste nyi ma bcu pa la nags tshal gyi nang du zhugs par gyur to/ /de'itshe rgyal po grags pas khyab 'jug dang tshangs pa dang drag pori —rigs rnams rmongs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par —zhugs pas/ de rnams nags tshal de nyid du rmongs par gyur pa dang /de na gnas pa rnams kyis bcings te khyer nas dkyil 'khor de nyid du rgyalapo grags pa'i drung du bor ba dang / de rnams rmongs pa las sad de/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa mthong ste ngo mtshar gyi tshig smras pa na/ blon po rgya mtsho'i blo gros kyis rgyal po grags pa'i bsngags pa brjod de de rnams la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang zhu bar bskul ba dang / drang srong rnams kyi chos kyi blo rab tu sad de gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rtsa rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa de nyid phreng ba 'dzin pa'i sdeb sbyor gyis bcings te tshigs bcad stong dang sum cu'i bdag nyid kyi bsdus rgyud brtsams thing drang srong de rnams smin par byas te rigs thams cad rdo rje'i rigs gcig tu mdzad pas rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa zhes grags shing / de phyin chad

da su gyi mkhor ma da ri 209shasnya la 'i rgyal po rnams la rigs ldan du grags so/ /'jam dpal grags pa'i rjes su rigs ldan pad dkar byung nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus rgyud kyi 'grel ba dri med 'od brtsams shing lo brgyar chos bstan/ de nas rigs ldan bzang po dang / rnam rgyal dang /bshes gnyen bzang po dang / rin chen phyag dang / khyab 'jug sbas pa dang / nyi ma grags pa dang / shin tu bzang rnams kyis kyang lo brgya rer chos bstan pa'i rjes su bod du srong btsan sgam po me glang la 'khrungs nas lo brgyad pa shing spre'u lo rigs ldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal khrir phebs pa dang ma kha'i yul du kla klo zhugs pa dus mnyam par bshad do/ /rigs ldan sdo mtsho rnam rgyal gyis lo brgya gya gnyis dang / rgyal dkas lo nyis brgya nyer gcig chos bstan pa'i yun tshad bsdoms pa la me mkha' rgya mtsho zhes zer zhing / me mkha' rgya mtsho'i 'jug (mjug)rdzogs nas rab byung dang po shar ba'i me yos la rigs ldan nyi ma khrir phebs/ lo der dus 'khor gyi rgyud rgya gar du spyan drangs pa dang /de'i lo gnyis pa sa 'brug la bod du spyan drangs par bshad la/ yang ta (tā)ra na (nā) thas rgya gar du spyan drangs nas drug cu skor gcig 'das pa'i rab byung dang po me yos la kha che zla ba mgon pos bod du spyan drangs par bshad pa dang / lo rgyus smra ba'i dbang po 'ga' zhig slob dpon rdo rje dril bu ba'i dus nas rgya gar du dus 'khor gyi rgyud yod la dril bu pa nas nā ro pa'i bar du bla ma brgyud pa brgyad yod cing / nā ro pa dang dus zhabs yab sras dus mtshungs pas de'i gong nas dar zer ro/ /

2/1khye rdo su —ma’ rngo da /rwa 'bro gnyis kyi lugs la dus 'khor gyi rgyud rgya gar du spyan 'dren mkhan tsi lu paṇḍi ta yin par mthun la/ tsi lu paṇa chen dang dus zhabs pa che ba gcig mi gcig mi mthun te/ rwa lugs pa dag gis ni tsi lu paṇa rin chen ri bo'i gtsug lag khang du byon/ rgyud sde rnams gzigs pas byang chub sems dpas bkral ba'i 'grel ba zhig dgos par dgongs/ de shasta lar yod par gzigs nas byon pas ri zhig gi steng du slebs pa dang mi gcig gis khyod gar 'gro zer/ shasnya lar byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel ba tshol du 'gro byas pas/ de shin tu bgrod dka' ste 'di nyid du shes pa byung na nyan pas chog mod zer/ de 'jam dpal gyi sprul par shes te phyag byas gsol ba btab pas rgyud 'grel man ngag thams cad bstsal/ byin gyis brlabs pas tshig don ma lus par thugs su chud/ slar rgya gar du byon nas bizlo a tsaṣpe dang / des dus zhabs pa che ba la gsungs par 'dod/ 'bro ba dag gis de dus zhabs pa che ba yin te/ 'di klu byang gi dngos slob sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ de ltar byon pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa mkhyen te rigs ldan dpal skyong gis der phebs nas bshad pa yin zhing / des dus zhabs pa chung ba la bshad zer ro/ /'brug pa pad dkar ba'i chos 'byung du/ de'i tshe rgyal po zla ba'i 'od rgyal saro phebs nas lo bzhi pa yin pa'i phyir des bshad par rigs te/ don du na 'chad pa bodang nyan pa bothams cad sprul pa'i sku sha stag yin pas so so skye bos 'ol tshod byas pas rtogs par dka'/ de'i phyir rnam bzhag

dab dus kyimakhosbru—lo da —— 211mang zhes gsungs kyang / gong smos ltar rigs ldan nyi ma khrir phebs pa'i skabs dang / de nas lo nyis brgya na rigs ldan zla ba'i 'od khrir phebs pa'o/ /dus tshod kyang rab byung bzhi pa'i sa byi la rigs ldan zla ba'i 'od khrir phebs pa la 'khrul ba med la/ de dus rgu lo rnam rgyal chu phag la 'khrungs nas lo nyer drug pa yin 'dug pas so/ /rigasaldan dpal skyong gi dus zer na de bas kyang mi rigs te/ dpal skyong rab byung dgu ba'i sa byi la khrir phebs shing / de'i phyi lo sa glang la paṇa chen bsod grags pa dga' ldan gyi khrir phebs nas chos 'byung mdzad pas so/ /des na gsan yig phal cher las 'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa 'chad skabs zla bzang nas dpal skyong bar dang / de nas dus zhabs pa zer ba brtag dgos so/ /rwa lugs pa dag gis tsi lu pa pad dkar gyi dus zer ba yang brtag pa'i gnas te/ rwa lugs thog mar gsan pa borwa lo'i slob ma rwa chos rab yin la/ rab byung dang po'i me 'brug gi lo mnga' bdag rtse lde'i chos 'khor gyi dus zaris dkar/ rwa lo/ gnyanaglo/ khyung po chos brtson/ btsan kha po che/ rngog blo ldan shes rab sogs yod par deb sngon las bshad cing / pad dkar 'das nas me 'brug 'diribar la lo chig stong chig brgya so gcig 'das pas so/ /'di skor la lo rgyus mabun pa dang mi mthun pa mang po snang ste gzhan du shes par bya'o/ / dus zhabs pa chung ba man chad la rwa 'bro'i lugs gnyis las rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ dus zhabs pa chung ba/ mañtsa kiti/ sa mant+ra shrī/ rwa chos rab/ raye shes sedzña / —lke rwa 'bum seng / rje btsun

212 da nu kho mo da rga lo ste de nas rwa 'bro gnyis 'dres su gyur to/ /'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ dus zhabs pa chung ba/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags/ sgom pa dkon mtshog srung / sgo ston gnam la brtsegs /yu mo dad pa rgya mtsho/ sras chos kyi dbang phyug grub thob nam mkha' 'od/ se mo che ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam gsar shes rab 'od/ rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ rong ba shes rab seṅge / bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ de la bu ston3na po ches gsan nas dus 'khor gyi chos 'byung /rgyud 'grel gyi sa bcad/ sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus/ dkyil chog sbyin sreg rdzogs rim rgyas bsdus/ mdor bsdus dang po dang dbang mdor bltan gyi ṭīkka sogs mdzad/ de la gong gsum bde chen pa chos kyi dpal bas gsan cing / de la rje bdag nyid chen pos gsan pa ste/ rje'i gsan yig las/ bla ma chos kyi dpal ba ste/ des chos 'byung mdor bsdus dang / de'i ṭīska/ sa bcad/ mchan rnams rin po che pas mdzad pa'i steng nas bshad pa rgyas par mdzad nas bdag la gnang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas rigs ldan rnam 'phrul mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rwa tshag blo bzang e waṃ/ khri chen dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ shar ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sngakas chen dge 'dun don grub/ slob dpon dam tshig rdo rje/ sngagagachen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'dzin pa blo bzang rig grol/ dus 'khor pa yon tan dar rgyas/ rje phun tshogs byamarsā pa/

da sus kho tsā da kyi 213khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan/ rgyal dbeng blo bzang skal bzang rgya mtsho/ rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes/ de la bdag cag gi rje bla ma chos kyi rgyal po ratna'i mtshan can gyis zhus so/ /de ni dbang gi brgyud rim yin la/bshad rgyun ni/ bu ston la bde chen pa chos kyi dpal bas bshad pa tshar bcu bdun gsan/ de la bla ma ratnashrī bas bshad bka' tshar bcu gsan/ de nas mkhas pa tsant+ral/ kun mkhyen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang mkhyen rab mchog grub/ byang gling ba dbon rin rdzirgyal po/ 'brog sgang ba chos rje don 'grub rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ chos rje rin chen chos legs/ chen po bsod nams rgya mtsho/ chos rje 'jam dpal mkhyen rab/ zhwa lu ri sbug bla ma byams pa smon lam/ de la bdag cag gi bla ma chos kyi rgyal po chen pos bu ston gyi mchan dang sprags nas gsan te rṣawaṃ chos 'khor gling gi grwa khang du sde snod 'dzin pa bzhi brgya tsam la gnang ste bstan pa'i sgron me sbar bar mdzad do/ /dus 'khor gyi dbang dang bshad rgyun gnyis ka 'dzoms pa deng dus shin tu dkon par snang bas zhib tu bris pa yin no// //

214 rigs ldan gyi rgyal bo rnams/khre ra nam’byene:gyi duso/ sku // 'o na da lta rigs ldan ga( gi dus yin —zhe na cibashad pār bya'o/ /rab byung dang po'i me yos la rigs ldan nyi ma khrir phebs nas lo brgyar chos bstan cing / rab byung gnyis pa'i me lug la sna tshogs gzugagakhrir phebs/ de nas lo bamya 'das pa rab byung bzhi ba'i sa byi la rigs ba'i 'od khrir phebs/ de nas lo brgya 'das —pa rab byung drug pa'i sa ldan zla 'brug la rigs ldan mtha' yas/ tshode nas lo brgya 'das pa rab byung bdun pa'i sa sprel la rigs ldan sa skyong / de nas lo brgya 'das pa rab byung dgu ba'i sa byi la rigs ldan dpal skyong / de nas lo brgya 'das pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me4yos cil rigs ldan seṅge / de nas lo brgya 'das pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me lug la rigs ldan rnam gnon khrir phebs nas lo don bzhi 'das pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags sprel 'di yin pas so /'o na da nas lo ci tsam na drag po 'khor lo can 'byung zhe na bshad par bya ste/ da nas lo nyer drug 'das pa'i rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me phag la rigs ldan stobs po che shasta la'i khrir phebs dgos la/ de nas rim bzhin ma 'gags pa dang / mi yi seṅge dang / dbang phyug chen

ji6rwas na pha rna ma thon du 216po dang / mtha' yas rnam rgyal rnams kyis lo brgya brgyar chos ston pa ra 'gyur bas lo 'ji nas lo lnga brgya dang nyer drug 'das pa na drag po 'khor lo can byon nas lo brgya'i bar du chos ston zhing / lha chen bcu gnyis sogs dang bcas pa'i dmag dpung gis bskor nas chu bo shi ta'i lho 'phags pa'i yul du byon te kla klo rnams dang de dag gi dpung grogs lha min la sogs pa'i dmag tshogs rnams 'dzam gling chung ngu 'dir g.yul du bcom ste thams cad rdo rje theg pa'i chos la 'god cing / de nas sa dum bu bcu gnyis po thams cad du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams pa legs par gsos te/ gling bcu gnyis po thams cad rgyal ba'i bstan pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus ltar dar bar mdzad de/ rang gi sras 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa tshangs pa dang spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa lha'i dbang po gnyis chos ston par bskos nas 'khor dang bcas pa lus ma spangs par 'og min gyi gnas su longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'tshang rgya ba dang / de'irjes su yang bstan pa lo stong brgyad brgyar gnas par gsungs so/ / kla klo las 'phel ba'i mi dag kyang lo lnga bcu tshun chad du rigs ldan gyi lam 'grub par 'gyur ba yin te/ ji skad du/ kla klo'i tshogs ni rab tu bcad nas 'khor dang bcas pa'i skye bo mi yi lo ni brgya phyed na// rigs ldan 'grub par 'gyur te lha yi bkod pa'i pho brang mtho ba ska la sha yi rgyab tu'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de dag la brten nas bstan pa'i gnas tshad kyang rtogs sla ste ston pa sangs rgyas pa'i phyi de lo zla bzang la dus 'khor rtsa rgyud gsungs pa nas 'jam dpaladzāgragasnyopa sda byon bar gyi rgyal po drug

216 ga na spyod dzi wa —rdarda—wa—rda ca la lo drug brgya/ 'jam dpal grags pa'i lo brgya/ pad dkar nas shin bzang gshegs kyi bar—lo brgyad brgya/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang rgyal dka' gnyis kyi lo bzhi brgya dang gsum/ rigs ldan nyi ma nas seṅgedzeebar du 'das pa'i lo bdun brgya/ de'i steng du rnam gnon gyi lo don bzhi ba don grub ces pa sa lug yan chad bsres pas sgyud gsungs pa nas nyis stong drug brgya don bdun 'das pa'i don brgyad pa lcags sprel 'di yin bes so/ /rigs ldan seng gebeesadus rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa glang la chos sde po 'di nyid gsar 'debs rten 'brel gyi mgo tshugs pa yin pas brtsi sla'o/ /de'isteng du drag po 'khor lo can ma byon gyi bar gyi lo lnga brgya dang nyer drug drag po 'khor lo can gyi lo brgya/ tsho'akhor lo can 'das rjes kyi lo stong dang brgyad brgya ste lo nyis stong bzhi brgya nyag ma nyer drug ni slad kyi bstan pa'i gnas dus te snga phyi bsdoms pas lo lnga stong chig brgya nyag ma gsum ste mdo las lnga stong gnas parabashad pa dang / dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad gung bsgrigs pa'o/ /de yang rgyud gsungs nas lo drug brgya na rigs ldan grags pa 'byon pa/ de nas lo brgyad brgya na ma kha'iyul du kla klo zhugs pa dang / kla klo zhugs nas stong brgyad brgya na 'khor lo can 'byung ba dang / zla bzang dang 'khor lo can gyi bar du shasnya lar rigs ldan nyer lnga dang bcas pa'i rgyal po so gsum 'a byon par gsal bar gsungs te/ bsdus rgyud la sa/lo 'di nas ni drug brgya'i lo yis gsal bar mi bdag grags pa shasnya la ru

217'byung / da de nasaklu yilo ༅——ṅgeṅge ṅge —skyezlo —skres parngo— mkhasirā—du bla klo'i chos dag rab tu 'jug ces dang de la bco brgyad lo yis brgya phrag bsgyur te brgya yis 'phags pa'i yul gyi ma kha la sogs par/ kla klo rnams kyi grags pa gang dang gang khrig mun can gyur pa de rnams bdag gis drungs phyung ste/ zhes dang / sum cu rtsa gnyis gdan gyi mthar ni lha min dgra bo tshe lo brgya ba phyag na 'khor lo bsgyur/ zhes dang / gdan ni nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnams rim par yongs su bgrangs pa de yi nang nas dus kyi mthar/rigs ldan rigs la lha yi dbang po lha yi mchog gis btud pa drag po rigs ldan 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// // kun rig gi byung ba/li // kun rig ni/ de yang longs sku rnam par snang mdzad kyis rnam snang zhal bzhi ba zhig sprul pas sbyong rgyud sogs gsungs nas/ de nas zas gtsang gi sras su 'khrungs par bshad pa dang / zas gtsang sras kyis chags bral gyi sku spangs te/ rnam snang zhal bzhi bar bsgyur nas gsungs par bshad pa gnyis yod pas/ lugs de gnyis ka mthun par gnas ni ri rab kyi rtse mo dga' ba'i tshal du gsungs par bshad de/ gnas de ni mdzod las/ phyi rol shing rta sna tshogs dang / /rtsub 'gyur 'dres tshal dga' bas brgyan/ /zhes lha'i dbang po'i gzhal med khang rnam par rgyal

da 218 rkyan ga gi ne ba byed kyi byang du yod par bshad do/ / gnas der bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad ngan song gi rgyud thams cadayongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'gyed par mdzad de/'od zer de'i ming ni ngan song gi rgyud las rnam par grol ba zhes bya'o/ /'od de reg pa tsam gyis ngan song gi sems can thams cad nyon mongasta ba'i 'ching ba las grol te/ lha'i lus bde ba so sor thob cing / lha'i 'od kyis dga' ba'i tshal thams cad snang bar byas/ lan brgya phrag stong du bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyis mchod pa dang / phyag dang / bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de/ e ma'o sangs rgyas kye sangs rgyas/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas mdzad ba legs/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /ces ched du brjod pa yang ched du brjod/brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la/ lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba tshe 'phos nas dgung bdun lags na/ de gang du skyes dang bde sdug ji ltar myong zhus par/ lha'i bu de ni mnar medardzopa'i sems can dmyal bar lo stong phrag bcu gnyis kyi bar dang / de nas sems can dmyal ba chung ngu rnams dang / byol song dang / yi dwags kyi skye gnas su lo brgya brgya dang / de nas mtha' 'khob kyi milirten la glen lkugs dang / mdze dang / phol mig sogs kyi sdug bsngal lo 'bum phrag du mar myong bar gsungs pa na/ brgya byin gyis de bskyab par gsol

skyun ga gi ga 219ba btab ste ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud gsungs shing / brgya byin gyis cho ga byas pa'i mthus lha'i bu ngan song las thar te dga' ldan du skyes nas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin gyi char phab pas lha rnams ngo mtshar du gyur te/ sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med sogs kyi ched brjod mdzad/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i mthus lha'i bu des lha rnams kyi 'od zer zil gyis ma nan te ston pa dang brgya byin gyi gdan ma gtogs pa'i dga' ba'i tshal thams cad g.yo bar byas te/ e ma shākya mgon po yi sogs sho lo ka gsum gyis ched du brjod pa ched du brjod nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mngon par mchod pa byas te rgyud las gsungs pa btus pa'o / / de lta bu'i rgyud 'di'i bshad pa dang dbang rgyun bod du dar tshul la chos 'byung 'ga' zhig las lo chen rin chen bzang pos kha che rin chen rdo rje la yo ga'i rgyud dkyil chog dang bcas pa dang / nor bu gling ba la sbyong rgyud gsan nas bod du yo ga kha che lugs btsugs/ mnga' ris rgyal blon spros pa la dgyes pas/ gzhung na med pa'i mchod phreng dang / khyad par lo chung legs shes gre ba bde bas dbyangs bcos/ paṇḍi ta shra dha ka ra warma/ bla ma nor bu gling bas bod du btang nas rdo rje 'byung ba dang ye shes zhabs lugs gsungs/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta dharmā pā la bal bo'i rten khyad par can rnams ngaskor ba la byon pas paṇḍi ta tshad pas bsnyang nas bod kyi gangs ri mthong sar byon na phan zer bar brten rgyal

220 rkya ga gi blon chos la dgyes bod la phan thogs par dgongasanas mnga' ris su byon/der yo ga gsan pas slob dpon kun dga' snying poligadams pa ma nor ba zhig byung bas shin tu mnyes/ de nas yo ga kha che lugs bzhag nas rgya gar shar phyogs pa'i lugs gzhung gdams ngag dang bcas pa la nyams len dang bshad pa byas pas yo galibadag por gyur/ de yang sku tshe stod la kha che lugs/ smad la shar phyogs dar bas yo ga la bod 'dir stod lugs dang smad lugs gnyis su grags par byung zhes bshad do/ /yang rgya gar shar lho'igrong khyer pa ti kirti zhes par rgyal po rab gsal zla ba 'khrungs/ phyag rdor gyis dpal rir rdor dbyings kyi dbang bskur ba de las de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi 'chad nyan 'phel zhing / ye shes rdo rje bra dzña(pra dzñā)sirnyi sogs rab gsal zla ba'i slob ma bzhi las kun snying gis gsan par bshad la/ kun snying ni grub chen brgyad cu'i bstod par/ sgrol ma dkar mos byin gyis brlabs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la 'grel bshad mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dkyil chog rdo rje 'byung ba la paṇḍi ta rnams kyis bsngags pa'i rkyen gyis rang yul gyi rgyal pos mchod pas rgyal poliyon sbyong ba'i ched du rnal 'byor rgyud brgya rtsa'i 'grel ba mdzad par grags so/ /shākya bshes gnyen rnal 'byor rgyud kyi slob dpon bcu la bsten nas mkhas par gyur cing / de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel ba go sa lalirgyan du grags pa brtsams sangs rgyas gsang bas thos bsam cher ma mdzad par bal yul du utpalaliphung bo gcig dang / ba dmar ser gyi mar skyogs gang / 'jam dpal gyi ras ris gcig dang

dzidag—kaitsho—— 221gsum la brten nas sgrub pa mdzad pas/ nam zhig me tog kha phye mar khol/ ras ris kyang bzhad par gyur pa las dngos grub len ma mkhyen par mar btung ngam/ me tog dbul snyam pa'i the tshom gegs su gyur te/gnod sbyin mo phag sha 'gram bya bas 'gram par thal lcag bsnun pas brgyal/ brgyal sangs pa na/ me tog rnyid/ mar bo/ sku rdul gyis gos pa las mar 'thung me tog phul/ sku'i rdul phyis pas dngos grub phra mo thob ste thos bsam gal che bar dgongs nas thos bsam rgya cher mdzad/ slob ma skyong ba la sun nas gangs te ser sgrub pa mdzad pas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes par bshad pa dang / sangs rgyas gsang bas rig pa'i gnas lnga mthar son/ lo bdun dgon pa ba mdzad pas 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes te rtse mo dang ngan song sbyong rgyud sogs 'jam dpal la dngos su gsan par bshad pa gnyis las yo ga'i slob dpon ni snga ma de yin gsungs so/ /de lta na/ rgya gar du yo ga la mkhas pa'i mi gsum zhes grags pa'i nang tshan kun dga' snying bo nas rim bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje/ shra rnya ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ sum ston ye 'bar nas rim par bla ma 'phags 'od pa la bu ston gyis gsan cing / bu ston gyi slob ma khyung lhas pa la rje rin po ches gsan pa'o/ /yang snga dar gyi dus sangs rgyas gsang ba mnga' ris dang / mang yul na sgrub pa mdzad pa khri srong lde btsan gyis dbas mañtsa shri (shrī) la

222 kyi ga gi sku sogs pa spyan 'dren du mngags par/ slob dpon gyis yi dam gyi lha la zhus pas/ byon na tshe'i bar chad du 'gyur bar mkhyen te ngas byon ba dang 'dratshub gcig bya gsungs nas/ rdo rje dbyings kyi sgrub thabs/ rnam snang mngon byang gi bsdus don/ bsamabyugatan phyi ma'i rgya cher 'grel gsum mdzad nas bskur/ rgyal po la zhal ta'i springs yig dang / bod kyi chos pa rnams la zhal ta'i springs yig sgom chen pa rnams la springs yig sogs mdzad nas bskur bas de dag dang / phyis su dpung6 bzang gi 'grel ba dang rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel ba bskur ba sogs dpal brtsegs sogs kyis bsgyur bshad byas pa dang / yang debyudus shākya bshes gnyen gyi slob brgyud sngags 'chang snyarma kiti bya bas bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba sogs rgyud sde 'og ma gsumacogyi bshad nyan dang lag len dar ba'i lo rgyus mang la/ phyi dar la byang chub 'od kyi dus su/ shra snya ka ra warma sogs warma rnam gsum du grags pa spyan drangs te/ kun snying sogs kyi gzhung mang du bsgyur/ shra dha ka ra gshegs rjes su bya rog gi rjes lam lam babs pas rin bzango gis 'di thig gi dngos grub grub pa zhig yin nam dgongs te thig rtsa mdzad bar gsol ba btab pas/ nor bu gling ba bde ba'i rdo rjes thig rtsa brgya sum cu so brgyad mdzad pa la malas par sbyangs pa'i don bzhin thig rtsa 'grel ba dang bcas pa mdzad/ rin bzang gis rnal 'byor rgyud kyi 'gyur dang / gzhung rtso ma mang du mdzad/dang por de nyid snang ba'i dpe ma rnyed pas 'grel la ko salar byas nas/

rkyan rig gi dzi ba 223lag len rdo rje 'byung ba la byas tshe gtso bo rnam snang mi bzhi rgyab sprad pa lta bu sogs ko sa la dang 'jig rten snang byed sogs kyi chos skad 'dres ma dang / mnga' ris stod na 'dur shid dar bas dbyangs med na ma thul bas/ lo chen rang gis kyang dbyangs bag re mdzad/ lo chung rnams kyang dbyangs byed bcug pas/ lo chung phyag bde zhing spros pa la dgyes bas dbyangs dang rdo rje dril thabs sogs kyi spros pa mang du mdzad pas rgyal blon yang mnyes/ de yan chad lo chen gyi slob ma thams cadakha che'imakhan po shra dha ka ra'i brgyud 'dzin yin par bshad do/ /yang lo tsā pa de nyid kha cher lan gsum byon/ sha snya'i bla ma u rgyan gyi slob dpon sangs rgyas zhi ba dang mjal nas zhus pas kun dga' snying po'i gdams pa phyin ci ma log pa byung bas/ yo ga'i yul dbus kyi dpe du ma bal bonas byung ba bsgyur par sngon gyi kha che dpe las bsgyur pa dang mi 'dra ba rnam snang mi gcig byang bzhi lta bu sogs chos skad mi 'dra ba du ma byung / bram ze rin chen rdo rje la kun snying gi bzhed pa zhus tsa na/ khyi a nanta gadma gsung skad zer ba'ang snang / yang smṛ tis tshong sde ngag gi dbang phyug dang / des kham pa shes rab rdo rje la gnang ba la smad lugs su grags/kham pa shes rab rdo rjes paṇḍi ta nyi ma'i dngos grub la gsan pa la stod lugs su grags/ snyarma pā la mnga' ris su byon dus lo chen gyis gdan drangs nas gsan cing kun snying gi brgyud pa bdun pa yin tshul gsungs shing shar phyogs pa'i rjes 'brang la yo ga gsar ba'am stod lugs su grags zhes pa sogs lo rgyus rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /

224 rkyan rig gi brgyud pa gzhan yang yod de/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas/sku gsum lhun grub rnam snang dze ta ri/ /kun snying rab 'byor bskyangs dang na ya ka /me dri rdo gdan ni ska lam ka'i zhabs/ /re bant+ra dang chag lo legs pa'i blo/ /yang rtse bu ston gzhon nu bsod nams dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang sbyong rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gong smos ltarajidang / shākya seṅge sku'i dkyil 'khor/ tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ 'khor los sgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor/me ltar 'bar ba 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug phyag na rdo rje la lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/gza' chen brgyad/ 'jigs byed dgu phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyal chen bzhi ste so sos bskor ba'i 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug bcas bcu gnyis gsungs pa de dag thams cad kyi bka' yang bdag cag rnam 'dren thugs rje can skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid kyis gsan nas bkra shis 'khyil du mi tra'i dbang gi skabs de dang thun mong ba rnams sbyong rgyud zur bka'i chings ltar gnang ste de ltar rung tshul gyi sgrub byed rgyas par bstsal pa thub bstan gyi dpal du gyur kyang so so'i lo rgyus 'dir skabs su ma babs pas ma bris so/ / de dag ni dbang gi brgyud pa yin la/ bshad rgyud ni bu ston dang rje yab sras phyin chad ji ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus ma 'tshal te/ bu ston gyis gsan tshul ni/ de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i yo ga'i chos 'byung las/ tshul

rkyadzha—1sdo— 225'bar gyis zangs dkar dang sum pa gnyis kyi legs bshad kyi cha bsdus nas rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭīkka rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ mngon rtogs dkyil chog ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi ṭīska/ rdo rje rtse mo'i yig cha/gtsug dgu'i yig cha sogs mdzad de yo ga zangs gsum snang bkral mar grags so/ /de'i slob ma thod pa dbeen rtsa grags/ dge bshes jo khur /thod pa 'od zer/ rong ba chos mgon/ lce blo ldan seṅge rnams la brgyud nas/ rdo rje 'byung ba'i bshad bka'/ rtse mo'i bshad bka'/kun rig gi dkyil chog smṛ tis mdzad pa/ de la brten pa'i bka'/gtsug dgu'i dbang bka'/ sgrub thabs/ cha lag dang bcas pa mnos nas bdag la gnang ngo zhes dang / ye rgyal gyi sras po chos rgyal la bdag gi bla ma 'phags pa yon tan rgya mtshos/ de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud/ 'grel ba skor gsum rdo rje 'byung ba/ sems dpa' 'byung chung /kun snying gi rab gnas chen mo/ stod 'grel lugs kyi dbang bka'/ sbyong rgyud kyi phyag na rdo rje'i dbang bka' bdun dang bcas pa zhus/ de la bdag gis zhus so zhes dang / dge ldings kyi bla ma rtos kyi 'od zer/de la bla ma bas smad lugs kyi dpal mchog rigs bsdus dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang bka'/ de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel ba dang sgrub thabs la brten pa'i dbang bka' rnams mnos nas bdag la gnang ngo zhes dang / rdo rje 'byung ba smad lugs kyi lce zhar lugs dang / zangaspodakar lugs gnyis ka dang / dpal mchog sher dum gyi rgyud 'grel dang /dkyil chog kun snying gis mdzad pa dang / za ca'i jig rtsa rtsa 'grel/

da 226 rkya gigi sgo kun snying gi spyan dbyelicho ga pratra pā li ta'i spyan dbyelicho ga rab 'byor bskyangs kyis mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg lo chen gyis mdzad pa'i rjes su rnal 'byor rnams bla ma chos kyi 'od zer pas gsan/ khong la bla ma pa.oṃgasan nas bdag la gnang ngo zhes dang / dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum gyis rtsa skye'i gtumi ston shag 'khum la stod lugs kyi rdo rje 'byung ba'i bshad bka' dbang bka'/ dpal mchog stod 'grel gyi rigs bsdusadang rigs so so gnyis ka'i dbang thob/ de la bla ma chos kyi 'od zer gyis zhus/ de la bdag gi bla mas mnos nas bdag la gnang ngo zhes dang / yang gtsang nas rim pa bzhin brgyud de stod lugs kyi gtsug dgu gsan zhes pa nas dzñā na shrī'i lugs kyi rdo rje rtse mo'i dbang bka' bshad bka'/ stod lugs kyi gtsug dgu'i dbang bka' bshad bka' rnams mnos nas bdag la gnangangango zhes dang / chag chos rje dpal gyis zhes pa nas/ bdag gi bla ma yang rtse bas dbang bka' bshad bka' gnyis zhus nas bdag la gnang ngo zhes dang / de bzhin du 'jam dpal gsang ldan dang / chos dbyings gsung dbang sogs gsan tshul mtha' yas shing bu ston zhabs 'di bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog mkhyen pa'i mnga' bdag yin pa shin tu ngo mtshar zhing rnam thar de 'dra la rtag tu slob par gyur ci ga snyam du dad pa'i gsos su dang / kun mkhyen gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang nas/ rnam thar snyi7pa'i me tog gsungs pa sogs skabs du mar bu ston gyi mdzothos la rgya cher bsngags pa thos pa dang / spyir deng dus rgyud sde'i bshad pa nyag phra/ lhag par rgyud sde 'og ma gsum nyag

rkyan rdardabyungadzo 227phra zhes spyan chab 'don pa tsam gnang zhing / da dung 'di dag gso thub pa byung na zhes rgyun du thos pas thugs kyi dgongs pa mi nyams gong 'phel gyi ched dang / bstano pa'i don du thos pa la 'dun pa rgya gang che dgos zhes yang yang thos pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi gsung yid la gcags te phyis 'byung snying stobs bskyed pa'i phyir du bris pa'o/ /de las kyang rje yab sras kyi rnam thar mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog par yod pa dag zhib tu shes pa gal che'o yang yo galidabyangs so so'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs la/ pu rangs kyi rten 'brel don ldan (rten cing 'brel 'byung ba/) mchod pa spyi'ibazangos kyi chu bo dal 'bab (tsan dan chu la ma/) mchod pa sger gyi bsang ba la (gnas 'di ma/ ) lce zhar gyi mtho bsang ba la dman re 'jog lo chen gyi tshig glu chen mo (thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa'/ ) stod lugs ye shes bskal chung ma/ stod lugs khro boliche brjod la sku'i 'gyur chung (chos nyid ma/ ) bgegs la bka' bsgo ba snur gyi seṅge'i ngar skad (bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ )nyi zla 'od stong ma/ stod lugs rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs/ bka' babs gnyis la 'dus pa'i bu ston dbyangs gcig (sum bha ni/ ) bla med rdor theg chung ba (dag cing dri med/ ) stod lugs de las gzhan yang ma/ rgya long gi thang dbyangs/ (mnyam med mi g.yo ma/ ) bka' ba bas gnyis 'dus kyi ma mo glur blang / smad lugs sum pa'i drug 'gyur chen mo (rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ ) smad lugs gser khang gi stong gsum

bherji28rnam dag ma/ (stong gsum 'di 'am/ ) gnyan gyi rma bya ldem ldem (stong gsum 'di 'am/ ) smad lugs tho ling gi mchod 'bul mo (chu bo gaṅgā ma/ ) smad lugs skyang po'i rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma/ smad lugs bla med rdor theg ma/ smad lugs rngog gi 'dzam gling rtsi bcud ma/stod lugs lo chung gi nam mkha' 'phang spyod/ smad lugs bram ze tshangs dbyangs che chung / smad lugs skyang polirdo rje gral thog smad lugs 'jam dbyangs phug pa/ smad lugs kun bzang dbyangs chen/ bka' babs gnyis 'dus kyi klan lugs bkra shis dgu 'gyur sogs nga lnga tshan gcigabadun tshan gcig so gnyis tshan gcig kun bsgril bas dgu bcu rtsa bzhir bshad do/ /zhes rdo rje 'chang gi phyag bris ma'i shog dril gcig las mthong ba ltar bris te/ yi ge zhib cing 'khyug drags pas nor ba re gnyis yod mchi'o// //rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud/dku//rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa byin gyis rlob pa/ rdo rje chen po rgya che ba/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang rdo rje 'dzin thams cad 'du ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa mos pas rnam par rol ba/ mtha' dang dbus med cing rtse mo ma tho ba rin po che'i rgyal pos shin tu legs par brgyan pa 'byung ba'i khang bzang chen po

—da —rdarda/kaid da 22byerin po che'i rgyal po'i nang na/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi seṅge'i khri la bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs par rgyud rang gi gleng gzhi las bshad de/ ston pa 'di'i longs spyod rdzogs sku rnam snang gangs can mtshos gzhi snying me tog gis brgyan pa'i 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing du gsungs pa'i don du mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs so/ /de yang gnas der gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes rgyud bshad par gsol ba btab pa'i ngor bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad snying rje po'i snying po 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sku'i yan lag thams cad nas/ de bzhin gshegs pas dang po sems bskyed pa nas sa bcu'i bar gyi mdzad pa'i bkod pa thams cad byung ste/ phyogs bcu kun bskor ba las slar bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i rang rang gi gnas su zhugs pa'i cho 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad de/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba'i bdag po la nyan par bskul nas/thog mar rdo rje slob dpon dang slob ma'i rnam bzhag de nas dkyil 'khor bri ba'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid sa brtag bslang nas slob ma dbang bskur ba'i bar gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga lha so so'i rig sngags sbyin sreg sogs las kyi cho ga mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor dang bcas pa rgyas par gsungs so/ / gzhan yang gsang ba'i bdag pos/ bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen po 'di'i dam tshig la zhugs par gyur pa des bsod

230 ———da —da bya sgo nams ci tsam zhig mngon par 'dudnghabagyis par rig par bgyi zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa las byung ba'i bsod nams mngon par 'du byas pa de tsam du rig par bya'o zhes sogs phan yon 'jug sdud dang bcas pa gsungs theṭa de lta bu'i rgyud 'di nyid dang / de'i bsdus don sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa gnyis ka bstan pa snga dar la/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shi (shī)lent+ra bo rnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs rakṣi tas bsgyur zhus mdzad na yang / dbang dang bshad pa'i rgyun phyi dar bar du ma chad pa byung ba'i lo rgyus mthong thos kyi yul du ma gyur la/ phyi dar la ba ri lo tsā bas rdo rje gdan pa la gsan pa nas bu ston rin po chelibar du brgyud cing / bu ston gyis 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sku yi bkod pa mi zad pa'i rgyan gyi sgo 'byed ces bya ba brtsams/ bu— ston la khyung lhas ba dang /de la rgyal ba gnyis pa shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags ba'i dpal gyis gsan cing / rje bdag nyid chen po dang / khyung lhas pa'i slob ma kunamakhyen shes rab dpal bzang gnyis ka la sher 'byung blo gros sbas pas gsan nas/dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sogs yig sna cha tshang ba mdzad/ de la 'dul nag dpal ldan bzang pos gsan cing / rigs ldan sangs rgyas rgya mtsho bar du srad rgyud pas rgyun ma nub par bzung / rgyud chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gsan te cho ga mdzad/ de la sngags chen dge 'dun don grub/ skyid shod zhabs drung ngag dbang

rna sna mngon zang gi da/ 231pastan 'dzin/ jo gdan blo bzang mkhas btsun/ rje ngag dbang chos grags/ dus 'khor ba yon tan dar rgyas/ bka' 'gyur ba blo bzang tshul khrims/ dus 'khor paṇḍi ta blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me bar dang / de nyid la bdag cag gi rje bla mas chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sar gsan pa'o/ /'di yang dbang gi brgyud tshul yin gyi bshad rgyun sngar nas cher ma byung bar mngon te/ lo rgyus smra ba'i dbang po deb sngon pa'i gsung las/de la bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud rnams la bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i bshad pa gtso che zhing / paṇḍi ta gzhan gyis bshad pa la brten nas dpung bzang dang / gsang ba spyi'i rgyud dang /bsam gtan phyi ma la sogs pa dang / spyod nga 'i rgyud kyi yang rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud la slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i bsdus don gyi 'grel ba dang / sangs rgyas gsang ba'i gsung lo tsā bas bzung ste yi ger byas pa dang / phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i 'grel ba sogs la /bshad pa dang nyan pa'i rgyun yod par snang mod/ phyi dar nas ni bshad pa'i rgyun cher byung ba mi 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang spyod rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigasajirnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud dang / rdo rje'irigs phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud tsam bod du 'gyur bas de'i phyir spyod rgyud kyi gtso bo ni rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud yin te/ rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma las/ rgyud sde gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud rnams kyi/ /gtso bor gyur pa rnam snang mngon byang gi /rgyud

da 232 rnamaske —dzi—shu da — rnge—la sbyangs pas spyod pa'i rgyud kyi phyogs/ /gang yin de yang lags par nges par byas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de yang skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid la chos sde chen po 'dir rgyud sde gong 'og mtha' dag gi bshad sgrub cha tshang ba 'dzugs bzhed kyi thugs dgongs rgyun chags su yod pa dang / khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'chad nyan zhig nges par tshugs dgos zhes paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyi bkas mtshams sbyar ba sogs la brten nas dgon pa tshugs nas lo nga gsum 'das pa'i chu mo lug gi lo mtshan nyid dang rgyud grwa gnyis nas kyang grwa ba kha shas re tshags btsugs/ gsar du grwa rgyun 'dus pa rnams dang bcas zur du 'utshogs nas skyabs mgon mchog nas zhogs kha rgyud sde spyi rnam/ kun rig gi ṭīkka che chung /dus 'khor gyi bskyed rdzogs/ gung tshigs la 'grel dri med 'od dang / ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba bcas chos thog gcig gi ring la 'chad nyan gnang / de nas rgyud stod lho ba sngags rams pa blo bzang bkra shis rdo rje slob dpon dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rab brtan rgya mtsho rdo rje 'dzin par bskos/ bde thang blo bzang yon tan nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba dang /ur lug thar pa spun gnyis kyis grwa khang phug skyor mo lung pa dge 'dun yar 'phel dang / dge 'dun kun dga' gnyis dbyangs dpon du bskos/ bla med dus 'khor/ nornal 'byor rgyud kun rig sbyong rgyud mngon byang gsum la 'chad nyan dang phyag len gyi gtso bo byed dgos kyi bka' babs pa ltar/ da lta rgyun gyi 'chad nyan la/ rgyud sde spyi rnam

sna nabya gi da/ 233dang dus 'khor gyi bskyed rdzogs/ kun rig gi ṭīkka che chung bcas kyi brtsi bzhag dang / kun rig ṭīka chen dang / ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba dang /de nyid yang gsal sogs kyi gsung bshad thar chags su 'gro ba dang /bla ma mchod pa/ dus 'khor dang rnam snang mngon byang gi cho ga tshogs kyi rgyun 'don yin la/ ston dus rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas dbyangs bar rta phyag rgya sogs skyor lung ltar byas te kun rig gi sgrub mchod sbyin sreg dang bcas pa dang / dpyid nag pa zla ba dang bstun nas dus 'khor gyi rdul tshon la brten pa'i sgrub mchod sa gar rta dbyangs sogs rnam rgyal grwa tshang ltar dang 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi gsung gdangs blo gsal gling ltar byed srol yod do/ /nag po skor gsum/ zhal bzhi ba/ rnam sras bcartswakyi bskang gso dang / zhal bzhi ba'i dus gtor chag med du gtong ba yin te/gzhan rnams kyi lo rgyus 'og tu 'chad la/ zhal bzhi ba ni klu sgrub yab sras kyis na lend+rasdzachos skyong du bsten pas klu sgrub yab sras kye lta ba 'dzin mkhan la rang shugs kyis srung skyob byed cing sa paṇḍi ta sogs na lend+ra'i rgyud 'dzin yin pas sa skyar bsten kyang dus phyis sa skyas rbad pa zhig gi skabs mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa la stobs 'phrog dbang pos sku dngos su bstan nas/ khyod rgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa la srung skyob byed pas nga la gtor ma thong zhes gsungs pas/ de phyin chad rje'i (rje)rin po che'i gdan sa pa thamasu cad kyis bsten dgos par bsang mda' ba chos ldan rab 'byor dang / se ra rje btsun pas mdzad pa'i mkhas grub rje'i rnam thar

234 /sda————nabya rdaged/ltar yin la/ lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'i mnal lam du mi nagapo zhig gis nga la 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas gartar ma mi ster 'dug gsungs—pa byung ba'i rkyenadang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas kyang de mthun gyi bka' nan ltar grwa tshang 'dir bskang gso dang dus gtor sogs tshugs pa yin te/ sngon zla grags sogs kyi dus kyi mdza' gcugs 'dor ba med pa'i 'bras rtags dang / ma cig gis gter gyi srung mar bskosapa'i gnad kyis yin nam snyam mo/ /rnam thos sras ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i srung ma dang / mdo mang po dang rgyud mang por rgyal chen bzhi la bstan pa gtad pa dang /rgyun zhugs dang / sa brgyad thob pa dang / mi slob pa'i zung 'jug thob par bshad pa sogs kyi lo rgyus shin tu mang ba ltar gnad che'o/ /mgon chos kyi dbyangs rnga chings stod rgyud ltar byed pa'i bka' phebs dang thugs bzhed yod kyang re zhig bskang gso'i bar rta tsam dang gtor chen —sogs rgyud stod pa dang mthun pa byed kin yod la/ gzhan rgyud sde mang po'i bri thig gtor chen gtor sgrub mdos chen bzhir grags pa sogs kyiphyag len dang / rgyugs rdzogs nas med du mi rung bar yig ris sna tshogs dang / sgra dang rtsis kyi sa ris nges can du slob dgos pa sogs kyi phyag srol bzang po yar rgyas su yod do/ /'di skor la paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa drag po 'khor lo can du 'gyur ba'i tshe/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang dang / rdze'adi nyid blon po zla ba dang / ha nu martur 'gyur bar gsung sa pa dang / yang paṇa chen rin

rdo sna ma na nga gi 235po che ni rje bdag nyid chen po dang / skyabs mgon mchog ni mkhas grub rje'i rnam 'phrul du klong rdol grub pa'i dbang phyug nas gsungs pa dang /yang klong rdol rin po che ni lho brag mar ba dang / skyabs mgon mchog ni rje btsun mi la'i rnam 'phrul du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa sogs shes dgos pa yod do/ / smras pa/ thub pa mchog de zil gnon la bltams so bdun chu rta nag pa'i nyar/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor rnam spros dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten cher/ /rgyud rgyal legs gsungs zla ba bzang pos de yi rjes su bsdus rgyud byas/ /de nas drug brgyar shasto la ru mi bdag grags pa'i nyi ma shar/ /rim gyis rigs ldan nyer lngas ni/ /chos kyi khri la dbang bsgyur gsungs/ /de las bcu dgu rnam gnon che/ /rigs ldan tshogs la dbang bsgyur nas/ /bstan pa nyis stong drug ba rgya nyag ma'i grangs/ /sum cu 'das pa chu mo lug gi lo/ /e waṃ rngos 'khor gling zhes ka lnga pa/ /gnyis pa gzhan zhig mdo smad ljongs 'dir byung / /tshul 'di bskrun (skrun ) pa'i byed po rigs kun bdag / 'jigs med mtshan gyis srid gsum khyab pa gang / /rigs ldan grags pa'i ye shes rnam rol tu/ /tshad mar gyur pa'i lung gis nges pa rnyed/ /e ma ye shes ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ /sku yis kyang ni de snyed khyab gsungs phyir/ zhing gcig la yang sprul pa'i bkod pa 'bum/ /'gyed la mtshar du 'dzin rnams byis pa'i blo/ /klung rnams sa yi 'og tu zhugs gyur nas/ /ro dang kha dog tha dad med pa'i dpes/ /bgrang yas rgyal

236sras chos skur gzhol ba na'ang / /tha dad med gsungs mchogatu dad par gyis/ /nam zhig 'khor lo canagyis kla klo'i dpung / /bcom nas 'gro kun theg mchog dga' ston la/ /'god pa de tshe gus ldan bdag cag spyang / /'og min rgyal ba'i zhing du bgrod par smon/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gso rig gzhan phan gling gi phyag bzhes kyi gtso ribor mdzad pa sman gyi pho rgyus/dku // da ni gso rig gzhan phan gling du phyag bzhes gtso bor mdzad pa sman gyi lo rgyus cung zad bri na/ de yang gso dpyad 'bum pa zhes pa sngon sangs rgyas gser thub kyis tshangs pa la gsungs pa ma 'ongs pa na tshangs pas dran te rang gi bu skye dgu'i bdag ces bya ba la bshad/ des lhalisman pa tha skar gyi bu gnyis la bshad/ de gnyis kyis brgya byin la bshad/brgya byin la slob ma drang srong rgyun shes dang / 'od zer can dang / 'od yangs dang / yan lag skyes dang / lha min 'joms dang /mchod sbyin can dang / gnas 'jog ste lha'i drang srong sde bdun dang / rgyun shes kyi bu dang / me bzhin 'jug dang / mu khyud 'dzin dang /'gro skyob kyi bu dang / bshol 'gro skyes dang / rkang gnyis spyod dang /thang la 'bar dang / nam so skyes te mi'i drang srong sde brgyad sogs byung

ga ga na na gi ga bzhi ga sbo ma da na mo 237ba las drang srong re res bstan bcos re mdzad pa tsa ra ka sdeXbargyad ces —grags/ de rnams kyi don bsdus te dpa' bo'i yan lag brgyad pa sogs kyi sman dpyad rnams rim gyis byung ba yin te / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ tshangs pas tshe yi rig byed dran/ /skye dgu'i bdag la bshad pa yin/ /de yis tha skar des brgya byin/ /de yis rgyun shes drang srong la/ /de yis me bzhin 'jug la sogs/ /de rnams kyis rgyud so sor byas/ /shin tu 'thor ba de rnams las/ /rab gces phal cher bsdus pa ni/ / shin tu bsdus min rgyas min pa/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po byas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang sngon gyi dus su lha rnams kyis 'o ma can gyi rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ nyi zla dang glang chen sa srung / chang dang nor bu ko thu pa sogs dang / de rjes dug gi skyes bunag po brtsegs pa zhes bya ba byung ba tshangs pas hūṃ zhes brjod pas thul te zhig nas dug sbrul dang thang phrom sogs la thim pas rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i dug byung tshul/ de rjes bdud rtsi byung ba lha dang lha min gyis brtsad pas khyab 'jug gis drang srong zho 'thung gi rus pa las grub pa'i 'khor los sgra gcan gyi ske bcad pas bdud rtsi'i thigs pa sa la lhung bas sman skyes tshul/ sgra gcan gyis 'khor lo slar 'phangs pas tshangs pa'i mkhur tshos snad par tshangs pas rma'i zug rngu la brten nas sngon shāka thub chen por sman rgyud thos pa dran pa'i rkyen gyis rma nang nas oṃ a tha zhes bya ba thon te tshe'i rig byed byung tshul dang / 'dzam gling 'dir sngon shed bu ser skyas sa zhag zos pa'i rkyen gyis ma zhu ba'i nad

da 238 ge gagazha na gi ga zhi kyirgurdziparna dathod—na mo kyis mnar te smre sngags bton pa tshangs—bas thos te gserangathubakyis gsungs pa'i gso dpyad 'bum sde las chu skol gyi sbyor ba bshad pa ltar — bslabs pasasashedabu'i nad zhi bas nad la snga ba ma zhu/ nad pa la sdob ser skya/ sman la snga ba chu skol/ sman pa la snga ba tshangs pa byung ba'i tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus rnam grangs mang du snang ste/ khyad paraco'aphags bstod dang / lha las phul byung gi bstod 'grel/ 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel ba 'dod 'jo ba mo/ rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel sogs las shes par bya'o/ / —de yang tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ blun po shes rab 'chal ba'i rtags lnga/ zhes rig byed tshad mar smra mi rung bar gsungs pa ltar thun mong gi rig gnas rnams las rig byed kyi gtam mang du byung ba rnams 'di yin gyi nges bzung smra dke' ba'i dbang gis 'phags yul gyi gzhan sdejidag las 'ga' zhig gis tshangs pa'i zhal bzhi las rig byed bzhi byung bar 'dod pa dang / la las rigabyed sus kyang ma byas pa'i rtag par 'dod pa sogs byung la/ rang sde nangatshob songs rgyas pa'i lugs la 'jig rten chags par rtsom pa'i tshe khams sna tshogs pa'i snying po can gyi chu'i dkyil 'khor rlung gis bsrubs pa las lams rab 'bring tha gsum chags pa dang / nyi zla sogs spyang spyi mthun gyi las las byung bar bshad pa ltar lagalag pas bzos pa'i rnam bzhag mi dgos par snang mod/ 'on kyang drang srong sde brgyad kyi slob ma tshedzeerig 'dzin pa bar chad par/ ston pa shākya'irgyal po'i dus su byung ba'i rdo 'jog gi sman pa rgyun shes kyi bu zhes

ge gage no na ngagi—rgya ba maphroṃrga pa pa pa lhamo 23nyargyal po padma'i dpal rgyas sman pa'i rgyal por dbang bskur ba de nyid kyi bar du byung bar grags shing / de las 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i gsos kyis sman dpyad ji ltar bslab tshul 'dul ba lung las shes par bya'o/ /bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir ni/ sngon chos rgyal srong btsan sgam polidus su rgya bza' kong jos sman dpyad chen mo gdan drangs pa ha —(hwa)shang ma ha (hā)de ba dang / dhwarma ko dzi gnyis kyis bsgyur/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi sman pa bha ra dhwadza bya bas 'bu yag ma bu che chung /sbyor ba mar gsar/ rgya nag gi sman pa hen the wen hang de bya bas rgya dpyad thor bu che chung / stag gzig gi sman pa ga le nas bya bas mgo sngon bsdus pa sogs bsgyur cing / sman pa de gsum ka bsdoms nas mi 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha zhes bya ba bam po bdun pa brtsams nas phul zhes bshad/ mes ag tshom gyi sras ljang tsha lha dbon la 'um gyim shang kong jo blangs skabs su yang hwa shang ma hā gyen da sogs kyis so ma rā dza la sogs pa'i sman dpyad mtha' yas pa bsgyur/ khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su yang rgya gar kha che/ bal bo/ rgya nag stag gzig gru gu dol po sogs nas sman pa mang po gdan drangs nas/ sman dpyad gsar du brtsams pa dang bsgyur pa mtha' yas pa de rnams snga dar gyi dus yin pas gso dpyad rnying mar grags la/ sdi dar la lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi skutshe'i stod la paṇḍi ta snyarma shrī warma dang / snye 'khor lo tsā ba dbyig gi rin chen/ mar lo reg pa gzhon nu/ dbyig gu dge slong shākya blo gros rnams kyis yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i rang 'grel bsgyur/

240 jigag—na na jing gi —pyaka 1zhi dzi sdorna kai — —ṣa rdo —me — — ——da dgesku tshe'i smad la lo rin chen bzang pos dpa' bos mdzad pa'i snying po sdus pa dang / deri'agrel ba zla ba'i 'od zer zhes bya ba kha che zla dgas mdzad pa bsgyur pa sogs la sman dpyad gsar mar grags so/ /'on kyang glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs pa'i skabs su yang gso dpyad skor 'di rang nyid la yang mkho bas ma bsnubs par bzhag pas gso dpyad la snga dar phyi dar gyi tha snyad sbyar du mi rung bar gsungs so/ /de dag gso dpyad spyi'ilo rgyus yin la/ bye brag tu rgyud bzhirilo rgyus ni/ de nyid kyi gleng gzhi'i le'ur/ sman gyi grong khyer lta na sdug ces bya bar rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su ston pa bcom ldan 'das 'tsho mdzad sman gyi bla bai ḍūdma'i 'od kyi rgyal pos/skye dgu'i bdag po myur ba dang / lha'i sman pa tha skar dang / brgya byin dang / lha mo bdud rtsi ma la sogs lha'i 'khor dang / gong du bshad pa'i rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa drang srong gi 'khor dang / tshangs pa dang / sri ral ba can dbang phyug dang / khyab 'jug dang /gzhon nu gdong drug sogs phyi ba'i 'khor dang / rigs gsum mgon po dang / kun dga' bo dang 'tsho byed gzhon nu sogs nang ba'i 'khor mang po la gsungs par bshad la/ de yang sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lnga'am ye shes lnga'i bdag rkyen las drang srong mched lnga sprul te gsung gi sprul pa yid las skyes kyis zhu ba po dang / rig pa'i ye shes mched bzhis 'chad pa po'i tshul du rgyud bzhi gsungs par bshad do/ /'di'i don sgra ji bzhin du bzhed pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis ston pa sman gyi—

gi——ga —zhad — rda gle sdi shardardakai rda—gig— rtso— sdog— ma—dza da — pha rtan spyo sdo ————da ———tram̐tram̐1 wablas lta na sdug gi grong khyer nas gsungs pa 'tsho byed gzhon nu las klu sgrub dang / dpa' bo dang / kha che zla ba mngon dga' la rim par brgyud nas khri srong gi dus lo chen bai ro tsa nas bod du bsgyur ba la phal cher mthun zhing / de nas bka' ma dang / gter ma'i lo rgyus gnyis snang ngo / /de yang 'tsho byed gzhon nu tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes nas bzhugs pas de la klu sgrub kyis gsan te/ sbyor ba brgya ba dang / 'tsho ba'i mdo sogs mdzad/ klu sgrub kyi slob ma dpa' bo ni grags che zhing / sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa sogs mang du mdzad/ de/'i slob ma zla ba mngon dgas dpa' bo'i sman dpyad kyi 'grel ba zla zer mdzad cing / zla ba mngon dga' ni/ dpal chen dge bar grags pa'i sras po chags pa mngon dga'i sras yin par zla zer du 'byung la dpal dge ba ni dpa' bo yin zer yang / dpa' bolirnam thar du mar rgya gar shar phyogs su 'khrungs par bshad pas brtag dgos so/ /bka' ma'i lo rgyus ni/ lo chen bai ro tsa nas chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan la gnang zhing / de nas rim par ral ba can gtsang ma/ rgyal po rdo rje/ lha rje lhun grub/ ral ba can/ lha lung rnam gnyis/'od srung / dpal 'khor btsan/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon/ bkra shis brtsegs pa'i dpal/ bkra shis dpal lde/ gtsug lde/ ye shes 'od/ byang chub 'od/ mnga' bdag rtse lde/ zla 'od/ nyi 'od/grags ldan/ bsod nams rdo rje/ byang ba chos rgyal rnam rgyal grags bzang gi bar du brgyud pa la byang lugs su grags so/ /

242 ge ga ge ske na lha gabazhi spreg tho da na——ma /gteramarmelorgyusani/tre bai ros bod du bsgyur nas chos rgyal khri srong gi phyag tu phul/ des gter du sbas pa gter ston grwa ba mngon shes kyis gter nas bton te/ dge bshes dbus pa dar grags la gnang /des rog ston dkon mchog skyabs dang / des g.yu thog yon tan mgon po la gnang ba dang / de nas rim par sum ston ye shes gzungs/'tsho byed gzhon nu ye shes/ g.yu thog mkhas pa 'bum seng / gtsang ston sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhas pa don 'grub rin chen/ bstan 'dzin don 'grub rgyal mtshan/ brang ti dkon rgyal mtshan/ brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed/ dge slong tshal ba dbang grags/ mkhas ma chog phun tshogs bzang po/ drang srong zur mkhar pa mnyam nyid rdo rje'i bar du brgyud pa la zur lugs su grags so/ /'di la yang lo chen rin chen bzang po nas/ zhang zhung ba shes rab 'od dang / de nas rgya ston grags pa shes rab/ g.yu thog rgya gar rdo rje/ g.yu thog brjid po sogs la brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang / zhang gzi brjid 'bar gyis rgya gar du byon nas drang srong tsand+ra pa la sman dpyad rdzogs par gsan/ de nas rim par brgyud de tsha lung pa dkon mchog skyabs kyis g.yu thog pa yon tan mgon po la gnang ba'i lo rgyus 'dug pas zur lugs dang / g.yu thog lugs kyi sman dpyad mtha' dag gter ma kho nar 'dod pa ni khungs ca/ chod par mngon no/ /byang ba chos rgyal gyi slob ma byams pa dkon mchog rin chen nam mi'i nyi ma mthong ba don ldan gyis g.yu thog pa'i brgyud pa lha'i sman pa bsod nams rdo rje la gsan pas

ga ga ga na phan nga gi ga bzhis kyi ga dzo da ba na sgru ma sa/ 243g.yu thog lu gas gter mar 'dzin na 'di phyin chad kyi byang lugs kyang bka' gter gnyis 'dres su song bar shes dgos so/ / spyir rtsa rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i don 'grel tshul mi mthun pa mang du snang ste/ der bshad pa'i ston pa sman gyi bla yang rgyal ba shākya thub pa nyid sman blar rdzul pa nyid du 'thad ces gsungs pa dang / tshul de bkag nas bde gshegs brgyad kyi nang tshan bai ḍūyo snang ba'i zhing gi ston pa sman blas gsungs zer ba dang / des gsungs kyang zhing de'i ston pa sman bla dang zhing 'di'i ston pa shāka thub gnyis rgyud gcig tu grub pas mi 'gal bar bsgrubs pa dang / lta na sdug gi grong khyer yang o rgyan la bshad pa dadzwa /wa ra blo si la bshad pa dang / ri bo spos kyi ngad ldang la bshad pa dang /rdo rje gdan du bshad pa dang / sman gyi nags su lo bzhi ste zhes pa'i sman gyi nags su bshad pa sogs yod do/ /gsungs pa'i dus kyang 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus su gso dpyad bi ma la mi tra dang yan lag brgyad par grags pa sogs gsungs zer ba dang / la la lung sman gzhi gsungs pa'i dus sman dpyad rgyas par bka' bstsal pa lung gzhir bsdus te bkod zer ba dang / 'ga' zhig gser 'od gsungs dus ston pa rang nyid sngon tshong dpon gyi bu khye'u chu 'bebs zhes bya bar gyur pas yab tshong dpon ral ba 'dzin la sman dpyad gsan tshul gsungs pa'i skabs su rgyud bzhi sogs bka' bstsal pa gser 'od du 'phros tsam bsdus zhes 'dod pa dang / de bzhin du rma bya chen mo gsungs dus dang /drin lan bsab pa'i mdo gsungs dus la bzhed pa sogs du ma yod do/ /

244 ga gag na na lko gi gabazhi — ma dab mo /yang u rgyan du gsungs nas drang srongabyuyid las skyes la gtad/ de rjes ri bo gangs can du rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs par ston pa'i zhal nas 'od zer 'phros pas drang srong yid las skyes byon/ 'tsho byed gzhon nur rgyud bzhi gsungs/ sras rgyal ba khyu mchog gam zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul bkug nas rgyud bzhilisrung mar bskos pa yang 'ga' zhig gis gsungs la/rgyal ba khyu mchog dang / zhang blon gnyis mi gcig par yang mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis gsungs so/ / yang gong du bkod pa'i lo rgyus de nyid la yang / klu sgrub las padma sasta wa dang / des bai ro tsa na la gnang bar bshad pa gcig dang /bai ro las slob dpon dang / des khri srong la gnang bar bshad pa sogs kyang snang ngo / / mkhas pa stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs 'ga' zhig gis ni/ rtsa rgyud du gong gi gleng gzhi de ltar byung yang don la g.yu thog yon tan mgon gyis gso rig gtsug lag la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i rnam dpyod brnyes pa na rang gi thugs rgyud kyi sems byung sems pa la drang srong yid las skyes dang / gtso sems la sman gyi bla dang / shes rab la rig pa'i ye shes kyi ming btags nas brtsams par bshad la/ de yang rgyud 'dir rgya gar la mi 'byung ba'i nag rtsis kyi gtam ches mang zhing / chu brtag pa'i snod dkar yol rgya nag gi snod spyad dang / jalibatung ba bshad pa rgya gar na med par jo borirnam thar las 'byung ba sogs kyis tshul de 'thad par mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis bzhed do/ /

ga gzhan gi ga bzhe ga sdo ma da ba na mo / 245yang 'ga' zhig gis bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus gong ltar la de dus khri srong lde btsan gyi bla sman yon tan mgon nam g.yu thog rnying mar grags pas rgyud ba'i/'ilag len bskyangs shing / rang gi rigs brgyud kyi gsang chos su mdzad pa las/ phyis su rigs brgyud de nyid la g.yu thog gsar mar grags pa yon tan mgon po rjes ma 'khrungs nas khyab bdal du mdzad pa yin zhes kyang zer ro/ /rgyud bzhi'i 'jug (mjug ) don bsdus pa'i le'ur/ bde gshegs rnams kyi sprul pas 'gro don du/ /rgya gar yul du sman gyi sbyor ba gsungs/ /rgya nag yul du me btsa' rtsa sbyong gsungs/ /dol bo'i yul du gtar ga gces par bstan/ /bod kyi yul du rtsa chu'i brtag pa bstan/ /lha yi 'khor la gso dpyad 'bum pa gsungs/ /drang srong 'khor la tsa ra ka sde brgyad/ /mu stegs 'khor la dbang phyug nag po'i rgyud/ /nang ba'i 'khor la rigs gsum mgon po'i skor/ /gso dpyad rgyud 'dir thams cad 'dus par bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa de rig pa'i ye shes kyi gsung gcig nyid lhas gso dpyad 'bum pa dang / drang srong rnams kyis tsa ra ka sde brgyad/ phyi ba rnams kyis dbang phyug nag po'i rgyud/ nang ba rnams kyis rigs gsum mgon po'i skor du go bar bshad pa tsam ma yin par so sor gsungs tshul gyi gleng gzhi dgos mi dgos dpyad par bya'o/ /spyir gso dpyad kyi skor 'di la lo rgyus 'dra min sna tshogs yod par ma zad dpar byang tsam la bltas na yang gong sa lnga pa chen pos rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu stag lo gra thang rgyud gzhir bzhag gis par du 'khod pa

246 ga ga zha na gi ga bzhes kyi ge rna da ba na rngo gnang ba'i rgyud bani'i dpar byang du dang po rgyud bzhi bod du dar tshul/de nas nyes bshad mkhan du mas bslad tshul/ zur mkhar bas zhus dag mdzad pa'i gra thang dpar ma 'di shin tu khungs dag tshul/ byang ngos bstan 'dzin rgyal pos 'di bzhin dpar du 'khod dgos zhus pa ltar dpar du brkos tshul/ tā ra nā thas rtag brtan du dpar brkos pa de byang zur gyi lugs mthun par byas pas 'di yin gyi chag 'jog med tshul/des na rtag brtan sprul sku'i mdzad pa gzhan yang lugs gang dang mi mthun tshul sogs bkod 'dug cing / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos dpar du bkod pa'i rgyud bzhi'i dpar byang du byang zur gnyis sngo sman gyi ngos 'dzin phran tshegs lag len 'ga' re ma gtogs pa la mi 'dra ba med par dgongs pa gcig tshul/ lnga pa chen pos sman tshul bstan mi mkhyen tshul/ dpar byang gi bka' rtsom 'di yang thal che tshul/ byang ngos nas kyang mi mkhas pa'am gzu bor ma gnas dogs tshul/ rgyu mtshan de nyid lnga pa chen po rang nyid la zhus tshul/ lnga pa chen po nas kho bo la rgyus med kyang byang ngos nas sogs de bzhin gsungs pa sor bzhag bgyis na yang / da lam khyod zer ba ltar bden zhes bka' lan phyir phebs tshul sogs 'dra min sna tshogs byung yang lo rgyus gang du yang g.yu thog pa dang byang zur gnyis gso rig gi skor 'di la nyi zla ltar grags che bar snang bas/ rnam thar cung zad re brjod na/ g.yu thog pa zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'dre rje rgya gar rdo rje bya ba de stod lung snyid snar bzhugs skabs nyin gcig zam mo che'i 'gram du bud

rga ge ———nod da dgipyagebazhisaspyogamitsurdo dab —ne mo 247med mtshar mo gcig gis bdag gi yul du phebs dgos zhes dar yug gcig brkyangs par zhabs bzhag ma thag sngar gathigs ma myong ba'i grong zhig gi nang du slebs/ pho brang zhig na sngags nag gi cha byad can gcig nad kyis mnar nas 'dug pa'i sngas mgor spyan drangs/ nad ci las byung dris pas/ ser ba phabs pas ser srung nus ldan gyi thun phog pa yin zhes lus rjen par bstan tshe sha rus pags gsum yungs kar gyis gtams nas 'dug par khyung lnga dang dngul chus nang nas phul/ byug pa rgyan 'khor phyi nas byugs pas skad cig la nad las thar/ bud med des sngar gyi dar yug brkyangs pa'i sner zhabs bzhag pas zam sner yud kyis slebs/ mo na re/ sang da tsam 'dir byon dang drin gzo 'bul zer bar phyir nyin bud med rked pa yan gser g.yus brgyan pa'i ro gcig chus khyer ba zam pa la chags byung ba bya dgar mkhyen nas ro chur sbyangs/gser g.yu rnams khang thog tu bkram nas bskams pa phyugs rdzi sogs kyis mthong nas g.yulithog 'dug go byas pas g.yu thog par grags/ 'dre des rje bzhin du bkur nas 'dre rje badzra du yang grags/ 'di yang rgya gar du byon nas gso rig bslabs/ bod du gso rig gi 'phrin las bskyangs/ de'i sras khyung po rdo rje la yon tan mgon po snga ma 'khrungs nga1 yin te/ 'khrungs pa'i tshe dge mtshan bgrang las 'das shing dgung lo gsum pa'i thog sman bla rig 'dzin dang bcas pa'i zhal gzigs/ klog dang gso dpyad rang shugs kyis mkhyen/ slob ma dge ba rdo rje bya ba nad pa'i g.yog tu bskos nas 'gro phan mdzad/ yab la bdud rtsi sman sgrub

྅48 gi gagezhe —na rgo zhis gerdom wa rwa————/ ——shaṃ———da dgesogs zhus dus sman rgyal dngos su byon nas byin gyis brlabs/ dgung lo bcu pa'i dus mes ag tshom gyis spyan drangs te’gso dpyad la mkhas mi mkhas nyams sad pas bod sman mkhas pa mi dgu'i gtso bor gyur/ dgung lo nyer lnga pa la mkha' 'grolilung bstan ltar slob dpon chen po las bar chad mi 'jug pa'i sngags dang rdzas srung zhus nas rgya gar du phebs/ rgya bal gyi mtshams ri kun tu rgyu zhes bya bar bai ro tsa na dang mjal/ bod du ma slebs par rgyud bzhi gter du mi sbed pa'i gsol ba btab par yang 'ga' zhig gis bshad/ paṇa chen tsant+ra gir rgyud bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa gsan/ bod du byon nas bai ror rgyud bzhi gsan par yang bshad/rgyal po'i bla sman du gyur/ rgya gar du lan gsum phebs/ rdo rje gdan du mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan ltar sman blar gsol ba btab pas lta na sdug gi grong khyer dngos su mjal/ klulirgyal po ma dros pa'i btsun mo nad kyis thebs pa'i bsnyun gsor gdan drangs pa ltar klu yul du byon pas mo nyid nad las thar/ legs skyes su sman rgyal gyi sku g.yu gdugs can sogs phul pa'i sku pho brang po ta lar bzhugs zhes thos/ rang nyid sngar 'tsho byed gzhon nur gyur pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na yon tan mgon por gyur nas gso rig gi bstan pa spel bar lung bstan/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar 'phags pa 'jam dpal las sbyor ba'i phreng ba sogs man ngag mang du gsan/ dgung lo brgya dang nyer lnga bzhugs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar mang bar snang / 'di g.yu thog rnying mar grags la 'di nas mi rabs bcu gsum na g.yu thog gsar ma 'khrungs pa yin snang bas 'di la

ge gagi na nashaṃ rtse rgabazhis spyorda tho mi pa —na ——zi————7khye dayang mes po sogs g.yu thog snga ma dang cha mtshungs pa'i lo rgyus 'ga' zhig —bshad cing / 'ga' zhig gis de mi 'thad zer ro/ /g.yu thog gsar mar grags pa yon tan mgon po ni g.yas ru gtsang gi sa'i cha nyang stod sgo bzhi re thang du grags par khyung bo rdo rje dang / jo mo padma 'od ldan gyi sras su 'khrungs/ sku bltams ma thag nas drang srong rigs lnga mngon sum du byon nas byin gyis brlabs/ sman gyi lha mo brgyad dang lha'i tshogs dpag tu med pas khrus gsol/ nam mkha' 'ja' tshon gyi dra bas khebs/ lha'i rol mo'i sgra dang / dri bzang pos phyogs mtha' dag khyab/ me tog gi char yang chu tshod lnga tsam gyi bar du babs//lha ṣa rdzu'i gzungs thogs med du 'don cing yum la spyan mi 'dzum par gzigs/ dgung lo gsum pa'i tshe byis pa 'tshogs pa'i dbus su rtsa chu'i brtag pa dang sa rdo sngo sogs la sman gyi ngos 'dzin mdzad pa dang gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas kun tu sman dri bzang po rtag par 'thul bas kun gyis ngo mtshar che bar byed/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung ba'i mthus dgung lo brgyad pa'i dus nas rig gnas kun dang khyad par gso rig man ngag gzhung dang bcas pa phul du phyin par mkhyen/dgung lo bcu bzhes pa'i tshe mnal lam du grub pa'i lha moyin zer ba dar sngon gyi gos gyon zhing lag na bdud rtsi bum pa gang khyer ba zhig gis bdud rtsi bum pa gang bo 'di sman gyi bla mas khyed la bskur ba yin pas gsol zhig zer ba ltar zhal du gsol bas rang gi sku lus shel gyi rang bzhin lta bu phyi ltas nang gsal ba zhig tu song bar/ lha mo de'i zhal nas da nas lo

250 dge tsho ༷tram̐ na rgo ga zu skye ga bo ma da pha rna mo gnyis na bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud ces bya ba khyed la 'ong bas 'gro don rgya chen po mdzod zer ba'i rmi lam byung zhing / de'i phyi nyin dge bshes rog ston dbus su grwa skor la byon pa'i lam nas 'bam gyis snyung nas drung du byon pa la 'bam bcos mdzad pas bsnyung las grol te dbus su byon/ dbus pa dar grags la rgyud bzhi zhus nas/ phyir 'khor dus rkang 'bam bcos pa'i drin gzor sgo bzhi re thang du byon nas g.yu thog pa la gzhung 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa phul/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa la rgya gar du phebs nas/ yul ku talizhing du mkha' 'gro ma dpal ldan phreng ba dang mjal zhing / gser gling du drang srong phyogs kyi go cha dang / ka la'i tshal du lha mo bdud rtsi ma dang mjal nas gso dpyad kyi man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan/ nyer gcig pa la bod yul shangs dpal gyer phebs nas 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/dgung lo so bzhi bar mnal lam du lha mo bdud rtsi mas bskul ba ltar slar yang rgya gar du phebs drang srong tsa ra ka sogs paṇa grub du ma dang mjal/mkhra' 'gro ma dpal ldan phreng ba la yan lag brgyad pa bsil zer gyi gnad rgyud rigs drug cu re lnga sogs gdams pa dpag tu med pa gsan —pa sogs/ rnam par thar ba dpag tu med pa mnga' bar snang ste/nyid kyi gsung mgur las/ nang dug gsum gyi rnam rtog sems kyi nad/ /phyi rlung mkhris bad kan lus kyi nad/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i sman gyis sel/ / /sman pa zer ba nga la gyis/ /chos bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur blo nas 'chad/ /mu stegs rgol ngan rigasda pas bcom / /

ga gzhan na gi ga bzhes rgya ga sbo da pha na sa 251sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /mkhas pa zer na nga la gyis/ /dpal gyi ri la phyin pa'i tshe/ /mi rgod jag pas bar du bcad/ /lta stangs gcig gis thams cad rengs/ /o rgyan yul du phyin pa'i tshe/ /sha za mkha' 'gros gnam lcags phab/ /sdigs mdzub gtad pas mkha' 'gro 'gyel/ /siṅga'i gling du phyin pa'i tshe/ /gru rdzings chu boridabus su zhig /bya bzhin 'phur nas grogs kyang bsgral/ /kā la'i tshal du phyin pa'i tshe/ /dug sbrul kha rlangs mun ltar gtibs/ /snying rje bsgoms pas myur du khyi// /stag gzig yul du phyin pa'i tshe/ /sog po'i dmag dang phrad pa'i dus/ /brag ri phar thal tshur thal phug /bal yul 'phags pa shing kun tu/ /bon dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran pa'i tshe/ /nyin phyed bar du nam mkhar bsdad/ /rdo rje gdan nas gangs can ljongs/ /nyin lam gcig la bcad nas 'ongs/ /gnas 'dir me tog skyes su khyer/ /gtsang gi tshong 'dus mgur mo ru/ /rta bdun rgyal bo btson du bzung / /sman rgyal gser mdog char du phab/ /grub thob zer na nga la gyis/ /lar de 'dra brjod pas zad mtha' med/ /sems la rang dbang thob pa'i mi/ /sa chu me rlung lha 'dre sogs/ /brtan g.yo'i dgra yis brdzi mi nus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /g.yu thog pa 'di nyid sku tshe'i stod du yan lag brgyad pa kho na'i 'phrin las bskyangs/ /de nas gangs can gyi ljongs su grags so 'tshal gyi sman dpyad rnams bsdu bar bzhed nas thog mar nad brtag pa la rtsa

252 ga ga ga na gi ga bzhi ga tho da ba na gyi dpyad rig pa rab gsal zhes bya ba sde tshan lnga ba brtsams/ de rjes lag len pod chung bya ba dang / rgyud chung bdud rtsi snying po kha che zla bas mdzad pa ltar bcos nas brtsams/ de nas bdud rtsi snying po gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud ces bya ba le'u so gsum pa gcig bka' yin pa ltar bcos nas brtsams/ de rnams kyi man ngag lag tu blang bde ba shog dril skor gsum dang / de'i zhal gdams gser gyi lde mig skor drug brtsams/de rjes rgyud bzhi 'di nyid gso dpyad kyi yang rtser gzigs nas bka' rgya bkrol te khyab bdal du spel/ yul dus dang bstun pa'i 'gyur bcogatshig bsgyur kha snon phran bu yang gnang bas bka' yin min gyi dogs pa'ang de kas byung zhes zer/ rgyud bzhi la bu'i don du gser mchan dang /slob ma'i don du zong mchan zhes pa'i mang nyung gnyis dang / rgyud bzhi 'chad thabs cha lag bco brgyad sogs mdzad la/ cha lag bco brgyad ni/ de nyid kyi them yig dkar chag me tog phreng ba las/ dang por gso dpyad ma lus pa'i/ /don gyi spyi khog dbub pa la/ /khog dbub khyung chen lding ba yod/ /bshad rgyud go ba len pa la/ /stong thun mdzes pa'i 'ja' ris yod/ /gzhung gi sa mtshams 'byed pa la/ /sa bcad stag mo'i rngams thabs yod/ /rgyud kyi dka' phreng dgrol ba la/ /ṭīkka mun sel sgron me yod/ /bshad rgyud gsal bar ston pa la/ /'grel ba 'bum chung gsal sgron yod/ /phyir rgol rtsod pa zlog pa la/ /rtsod zlog gegs sel 'khor lo yod / /gsar 'jug slob bus go sla'i phyir/ /skor tshoms stong zun bcu gcig

gi gag dzha na gi gabazhi——/skyigartsotha ma da dzo na mo sa 253yod/ /gab yig gsal bar ston pa la/ /ming don brda' sprod rnam lnga yod/ /gdams pa lag tu len pa la/ /lag len rin chen spungs pa yod/ /thor bu'i nad la tshegs med don/ /kha 'thor rin chen spungs pa yod/ /mi shes ma lus bsal ba'i phyir/ /lag len dmar khrid yig chung yod/ /snyan brgyud man ngag gces pa'i 'phyong / /med thabs med pa rnam gsum yod/ /zhal gyi gdams pa kha bskang phyir/ /yang sbas gab pa bco brgyad yod/ /gces pa gud du sbas pa'i 'phyong / /khyad par zab pa rnam gsum yod/ /gzhan dang khyad par 'byed pa'i phyir/ /mkhas khyad ngo mtshar dgu phugs yod/ snyigaso dpyad mdo tsam shes 'dod la/ /rgyud chung bdud rtsi snying po yod/ /blo chung nyung bsdus 'dod pa la/ /gso dpyad mu tig 'phreng ba yod/ /mdzes pa rgyan gyis gdags pa'i phyir/ /phan bya sngags 'bum dkar po yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar te 'ga' zhig gis khog 'bug khyung chen lding ba dang / stong thun mdzes pa'i 'ja' ris gnyis rnying ma ba'am bon po'i sman pa zhig gis brtsams/ ṭīkka mun sel sgron me/ gegs sel rtsod zlog 'khor lo/ ming don brda sprod/ 'bum chung gsal sgron/stag mo'i rngams thabs rnams rje ye shes gzungs shag ram pa nyi ma dpal/sum ston ye shes gzungs rnams kyis ci rigs par byas/ /lhag ma rnams yon tan mgon pos mdzad zer ro/ / gzhan yang sngo 'bum chen mo/ 'bum khu tshur/ thor bu me len/deb chings stogs sogs kyi dpe ris/ byang khog gi rtsa bkra chu bkradzee

254 ge ge gzha na gi ge bzhis rkye ga ma da tho dzha 'khor lo/ /gso rig gi bskyed rdzogs zur du bton pa thun mong ma yin pa zab gnad sman bla gsang sgrub kyi chos skor tshang ba sogs mdzad de/bod mun pa'i gling du nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad ces grags so/ /des mtshon nas sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyis gsocidapyad kyi skor ji ltar gsan tshul dang yig 'jog mdzad pacosogs kyi ming tho tsam zhig bris na yang 'tsho byed gsar bu rnams la shin tu phan che yang mang dogs nas ma bris pas ma mtha' sde srid rin po chelidrang srong dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs tsam re bklags nas kyang man ngag 'tshol ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /byang ba chos rgyal ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i shing phag la ngam ring rgyal sde'i pho brang du sku 'khrungs/ /chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i spyod pa la gzhol/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo dang / bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs las mdo sngags rig gnas la sbyangs pas rgyal po paṇḍi ta zhes snyan —pas sa steng khyab/ hor dka' bzhi ba seng ge rgyal mtshan las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus pas mtshan chos rgyal rnam rgyal grags bzang du gsol/ thub pa'i dbang po dang rgyal po zla bzang / thogs med sku mched/ padma sam bha wa/ mi la ras pa sogs kyi gzigs snang byung /pho brang du gnam lcags babs pas nye skor gyi phal cher brgyal kyang sku la cung zad kyang brdzi bar ma nus/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub dang dri ba dris lan mang du mdzad cing rgyal po zla bzang du bsngags par mdzad/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen par dri ba mdzad pa'i lan du yang / 'chi med rnam par rgyal ba'i rin chen khrir/ /las las grub pa

gsod gadzee na gi ga zhis rgya ga sbong ma dab ———rda —— —/—ge— yo6 dedabang po'i gzhu ris can/ /pho brang ri bo'i rtse na bsod nams kyi/ /me long dri med nang du 'phos pa der/ /zhes chos dang srid kyi yon tan gyi sgo nas brgya byin dang 'dra bar bsngags pa sogs rnam thar ngo mtshar can yod la/ rgyud chung gsum gyi bshad pa dang / rgyud bzhi'i dka' 'phreng mun sel/ sman gzhung rin chen sgrom bu sogs mang du spel nas— gso rig nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad cing / slob brgyud 'dzin pa rnams la byang lugs pa zhes snyan pa rna ba'i rgyan du 'bar bar byupango / /zur mkhar pa mnyam nyid rdo rje ni/ dwags po'i sa'i cha la thog zur mkhar du yab rig 'dzin phun tshogs dang yum bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi sras risu rab byung bdun pa'i sa lug la bltams/ sku na phra ba'i skabs gsung rab du ma rang shugs kyis mkhyen pas kun gyis a bo chos rje zhig yin par 'dug byas pas rnyarma rsā mi'am a bo chos rjer grags/ dgung lo bcu gsum gyi dus ༄ta'ajam dbyangs bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs te khyod kyi chos skal gso rig yin 'dug pas g.yu thog pa la gsol ba thob ces lung bstan pa ltar gsol ba btab pas mnal lam du a ru rnam rgyal rlon pa gcig zhal du gsol ba rmis pas bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin 'khrungs/ nam zhig na zhal dngos su bstan pas sngon gyi skye ba mang po yang thugs la dran/gso dpyad rang grol du mkhyen/ rgyud bzhi'i snying tig shog dhil dang bcas pa'i man ngag gnang zhing rgyud bzhi 'a dir rgan rabs rmongs pas bslad pa'i cha phran tshegs 'dug pa byi dor gyis shig pa'i gnang ba la brten nas rgyud bzhi'i 'grel chen pod shal phra mo/ spyi don dngul

256 ga gagazhan na—da wag zhi ga da tsā dkar me long / glegs bam ring bsrel tsam las man ngag bye ba 'byung bas mtshan de ltar btags pa bye ba ring bsrel sogs mdzad cing 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nasagaso rig spel bzhin du so bdun pa shing lug la skulibakod pa bsdus zhes 'byung / rgyas par nyid kyi dbon po zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po zhes mes porizhal lung sogs 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mnga' bdag de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar 'gag pa med pa'i gtam du shes par bya'o/ / de ltar byang zur gyi man ngag 'dzin pa'i sman rgyal bar ma chad pa —dus phyis bar du byung ba rnams kyi so solilo rgyus gzhan du shes par bya la/sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos byang zur nas brgyud pa'i gso dpyad skor dus dbang la ltos pa'i gang rnyed thams cad rdzogs par gsan te/ bai ḍūyo sngon po cha lag dang bcas pa'i yig 'jog dang / /rin chen ril buphyag bstar sogs phyag rjes kyang rlabs che bar bskrun/ khyad par snga dus kun gzigs rgyal ba'i dbang po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsholi'aphrin las las 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang nub tu nyi thang drung chen blo bzang rgya mtsho slob dpon du bskos tegaso rig 'gro phan gling du ming chags pa tshugs/bsam 'grub rtser gso rig gi slob grwa tsha rong ba tshe dbang rnam rgyal gyis bskyangs te drang srong 'dus pa'i gling du grags pa dang / lha dbang lcog gam shar chen lhog tu byang ngos nang so dar rgyas dang dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags gnyis kyis slob grwa bskyangs pa sogs las bsam 'grub rtse'i slob grwa bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis gtsang pa bcom pa'i dbang
