ga gzhan gi ga bzhes rgya gatsho ma da ba mo 257gis nyams chags su gyur pa dang 'gro phan gling yang nyams chags su gyur pa gso ba'i slad du lcags po rir bai ḍūyo snang ba'i zhing dang cha mtshungs pa'i sman gyi grwa tshang btsugs pa gso rig gi gzhi rtsa gcig bur gnas pa kun gyis mthong bzhin pa kho na'o/ /de yang mkhas pa stag tshang ba chen pos/ 'gro kun lus nad snatshogs kyis gzir phyir/ gso dpyad don du mi gnyer srid mtha' tsam/dku de phyir rig gnas gnyis pa 'di nyid ni/ /don gnyer rjes su 'dzin pa'i mchog tu grub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gso ba rig pa 'di sems can dus min 'chi ba las skyob pa'i mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa dang / gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa thugs la dgongs nas/ skyabs gcig chos kyi rgyal po de nyid nas dang por dus 'khor grwa tshang gi 'dzin grwa zhig gis sman slob dgos par bkas bcad kyang lag len rgya che bas sngags kyi phyag len dang bcas thams cad grwa tshang gcig gis mtha' chod dka' bar dgongs nas re zhig gi bar du tshogs zur du 'tshogs rgyu med kyang zhal ras lha khang du chos grwa zur tshogs byas te/ ching wang bstan 'dzin dbang phyug gi bla sman du rgyal dbang bdun pa chen po dang / mi dbang pho lha ba nas gnang ba lcags ri reg byed gling du gso dpyad la mtha' chod par sbyangs pa'i gtsang sman ye shes bzang po'am bod pa mer gan em chir grags pa dang / em chi de nyid dang bde chen dpon slob 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan gnyis kalidrung du rig gnas spyi dang khyad par gso rig la mkhas par sbyangs pa'i rdo rdzirab 'byams pa dang / phyogs

——258 gag na gi gabazhisamig sbor god——— ———tram̐ — 'dir gtsang sman ye shes bzang po'i gso rig slob ma rnams kyi nang nas yang rtser son pa'i lnga rig pa sog po mer gan em chi blo bzang dar rgyas gsum rim par slob dpon du bskos/ zla ba bzhi pa nas brgyad pa'i bar du rtsa ba dang lo ma dang 'bras bu'i steng nas sngo sman ngo sprod dang / zla ba dgu pa nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar la dpe khrid dang / zla ba gnyis pa dang gsum pa gnyis la lag len dmar khrid kyi rigs zhib tu slob srol btod/ gtsang sman mer gan pa'i dus su sngo sman ngo sprod la gnyan rje gong sngon/ sngo la g.yu rtse/ mgo dkar sngon/ zhal dkar sogs kha gya'i mar khu'i rdza rgyud/ sku bla spun gsum/ klu'ichab brag mdzo mo nu rtse sogs rma 'gram dang rtse 'gram gyi rdza brag spang ri du ma 'grim nas zhib khrid yod par snang / phyis su dgon pa tshugs nas lo don bzhi 'das pa'i shing 'brug lo tshogs kyang zur 'tshogs byas te/ skyabs mgon mchog nas zhabaṭa/ kyi padma mi 'jigs chos kyi khri la rnam par bkod༈ gso rig gzhan phan gling zhes mtshan gsol/ sman mchog che ba dang mi 'khrugs pa lha dgulicho ga tshogs 'don dang / chos grwa'i 'grig lam rags rim/ 'dzin bzang ba rnams kyis rgyud bzhi yongs rdzogs dang / ma mtha' yang rgyud chung gsum gyi rgyugs sprod dgos pa sogs kyi bka' khyab sngar nas bstsal ba yang bskyar nan can du mdzad/ mkhas dbang blo bzang 'jigs med pas khur bzhes la brten nas gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi bkas bcad snga ma rnams je rgyas su btang ste rtsa ba thugs rgyud tshogs 'don dang / bshad rgyud phyi ma

geso gezirda nagle sdo———kaib sa mi ga bor ba da——ka—dzee— / 25byergyud gnyis dang / lam rim gyi brtsi bzhag gung tshigs gsung chos la lam rim chen mo dang / mes po'i zhal lung sogs gsung bshad thar chags su 'gro ba'i 'grig lam mdzad/ sngar bya spyod kyi sgrub mchod med stabs mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i sgrub mchod bya rgyud rang skad kyi phyag len rnam dag tshugs pa yar ldan du yod do/ /de yang sngon chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis rang gi bla shān mched dgu la nad rdzu btab ste/ byi la dang khyi ma bya dang / rang 'thag gi gor ma sogs la/ tha gu btags pa la rtsa pra brtag bcug par sman gyi lha mo'i mngon shes la brten nas legs par shes pas rgyal po dgyes te/ 'tsho mdzad sman par gyur pa 'di rnams la/ /bod 'bangs mgo nag yongs kyis bkur bar gyis/ /ci phyir 'di ni tshe srog ster ba'i phyir/ /mgo nag yongs kyi lha sna btsan po ste/ /de yis bkur bas mtshan yang lha rjer thogs/ /'gro ba'i mgon yin gral gyi gong la zhog /'bol grum stag gzig za 'og gdan du things / /skyel bsu rtas gyis rkang gla gser du phul/ /ci gsungs dang long sman pa'i bka' ma bcag /rgyal srid yin yang mi 'phangs ( phangs) srog rin yin/ /bcos nor lag dgras shi yang stongs(stong ) ma len/ /sman du thal ba sbyar yang sman rin gser du rdzongs/ /zhal du skyems zhus sha gzugs (gzug)rgyun du drongs/ /rgyun du bsten phyir ngo dga' lkog smras spongs/ /zam ber dar zab lham dang rgyam thag phul/ /kun gyis 'khur las phyag dang zhe sa gyis/ /tshe 'dir drin che drin lan yun du’soms/ /zhes bla gtsigs

260 ga da ge dzha gi ga zherdarkyegatshotha ma da pa na mo /bcu gsum phul ba rnams gso bya nad pa'i rigs kyis dus tshod dang mthun par lag len la 'debs dgos shing / 'tsho byed rnams kyis ni rgyud las gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan gang thub byed pa shin tu gal che ste/zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rjes/ mi'inyi ma byams pa rin la mtshan sogs dris pa'i dris lan las/ gso rig gzhung lugs pad tshal legs par 'byed/ /shes 'dod rnams kyi blo mig don ldan byed/ /nad med tshe ring lo tog rgyas byed pa'i/ /ming la drang srong mi'i nyi ma zer/ /las nad che la tshogs sog sgrib sbyong bstan/ /gdon du che la sgrib shing yas su che/ /'chi nges rnams la'ang chos bshad 'phral zug gcog /ming la drang srong mthong ba don ldan zer/ /rang skyon rtogs nas ci nus spong bas drang / /gzhan skyon rtogs nas ci nus 'chos pas srong / /drang srong chen po'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i rigs/ /ming la drang srong rgyud 'dzin bya ba yin/ /bstan 'dzin rnams la srog las gces par 'dzin/ /sdig ldan drin gyis bskyangs nas bde la 'god/ /rang la gnod byed la yang ci phan byed/ /ming la drang srong kun gyi bshes gnyen zer/ /gzhan gyis btang ba'i yi chad nad pa gso/ /dbul phongs skyabs med rnams la lhag par byams/ /ma 'dris glo bur mgron la phebs par skyong / /ming la 'tsho byed skye dgu'i dpal zhes zer/ /chen pos bkur yang khengs pa rnam par spangs/ /gzhan gyi don du sdug kyang skyo ba med/ /bsnyen bkur bsngags pa'i lan la re ba dor/ /ming la drang srong mi'i dpag bsam zer/ /da lta mi rnams

ge ——rji—dge ga zhis gartsoḍoḍa—ma da —— tsā 261'bras bu'i nad las skyobs/ /slad nas 'gro kun dug gsum 'don par smon/ /rtag tu kun la phan 'dogs bsam sbyor can/ /ming la drang srong gzhan phan mtha' yas zer/ /gso rig mdo dang rgyud dzee'agyur ba dang / /lugs sde bzhi yi bstan bcos du ma dang / /gangs rilikhrod kyi gso dpyad phal cher go /ming la drang srong gso rig rab 'byams zer/ /rnyed dka'i sman rnams 'bad/ rtsol tshegs kyis bsgrub/ /sgrub sla'i sman rnams le lo spangs nas bsags/ /gso bya kun gyi re ba yid bzhin skong / /ming la drang srong sman byin bya ba yin/ /phyogs ris mnga' thang bdag tu bzung ba med/ /byams sdang mtho dma' 'byor rgud mnyam par bzung / /'or che tsam yang don du gnyer ba med/ /ming la dge bsnyen 'tsho byed bya ba yin/ /'a tsho byed mkhas rnams bkur snyis bstod cing bsngags/ /gzhon pa rnams la ma brnyasakhaspro ba bskyed/ /rang dang mnyam pa rnams la phrag dog spang / /ming la drang srong sems dpa' legs sems zer/ /'chi bdag zhags pa'i dra ba dum bur gcod/ /zug gzer dug mda' drag po gcur gyis 'don/ /zungs zad glo bur rgas pa dar mar bsgyur/ /ming la drang srong mi 'jigs srog sbyin zer/ /nad pa'i tshogs rnams gsos par byas pa yis/ /de yi gnyen dang mdza' bshes 'khor rnams kun/ /'bral bar mi phod de la dga' ston byed/ /ming la drang srong mya ngan med ces zer/ /gso sla ba rnams zas spyod sman gyis gso/ /de las log rnams bya log khyug dpyad bsngags/ /gnyis ka min la 'khrul

262 ge gagozhan zho skya ga bo warjiwane spyomo 'khor sngags dmigs bstan/ /ming la drang srong thabs tshul dpag med zer/ /sman bla'i dgongs pa gsal byed rtsom pa dang / /rjes 'jug blo mig 'byed pa'i legs bshad dang / /log rtog rtsod pa gcod pa'i ral gri 'dzin/ /mingo la drang4 srong gso rig bstan 'dzin zer/ /nad med bsung dang thabs kyi bcud len 'tsho/ /nad ldan 'du ba 'khrugs pha bde bar 'tsho/ /dge sdig blang dor bstan nas phyi ma 'tsho/ /ming la drang srong rtag tu 'tsho byed zer/ /lha rigs mi'i rgyal pos bsngags thing bkur/ /bstan kha rab dga'i 'chi med du mas bstod/ / mkhas pa du mas yi rangs legs so byin/ /ming la drang srong lha yi rje bo zer/ /gang na'ang su zhig nyam thag de yi skyabs/ /ma 'dris kun la yid gcu/gas pha rīm bzhin/ /sgo gsum spyod pa gzhan phan nyag gcig bsgrub/ /ming la drang srong 'gro ba'i pha ma zer/ /nyin mtshan mun pa'i gling du 'thom pa rnams/ /gser gyi rsār mas chu bur mig phye nas/ /sna tshogs gzugs can 'phral du mthong byed pa/ /ming la drang srong gsal byed sgron me zer/ /mthong thos dran dang reg pa'i sems can kun/ /'gal rkyen kun bral mthun rkyen ma lus 'dzom/ /drang srong po'i go 'phang 'thob par smon/ /ming la drang srong smon la.oṃmatha' yas zer/ /rnag khrag rtsa chu sogs la khyi phag bzhin/ /nad pa'i bang ba kun la bran g.yog bzhin/ /gso bya'i gnyen po kun la 'dod 'jo bzhin/ /ming la drang srong 'gro ba'i khol bo zer/ /don dam gnas lugs spros dang bral bar rig /kun rdzob rten 'brel rmi lam lta bur

gso gag na na ngagi ga zhisakyig/de brtsa wadab nabyum sa/ 263shes/ /thabase shes zung 'jug bgrod gcig lam du mthong / /ming la drang srong rgyal sras gzhon nu zer/ /nyes brgya'i rtsa ba chang gi btung ba dor/ /snying rjeli'agal zla sha khrag bza' btung spang / /dge legs rtsa ba kun tu byang sems bzung / /ming la drang srong dri med brtul zhugs zer/ /snod bcud dag pa'i 'khor lor yid ches rnyed/ /dbang dang dam tshig thob dang bsrung bya (bya'i )rig /rim gnyis rdo rje theg pa'i srog rtsar mthong / /ming la drang srong 'chi med snying po zer/ /skyabs gnas 'dus pa bla ma gcig por mthong / /mchod 'os 'dus pa jo bo sems can rnyed/ /chos lugs thams cad 'khor 'das mnyam par go /mingasgrul drang srong gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin zer/ /tshe rabs du mar gso dpyad gzhung lugs bslabs/ /'phags yul gangs ri'i khrod du 'gro phan byas/ /tshul 'dis 'gro ba 'dren par yi dam bcas/ /ming la drang srong de dang de skad zer/ /gso rig shes 'dod kun la spro bas slob/ /gangs can nad pa'i tshogs kun 'bad pasagaso/ /gzhan phan gang du che sar kho bo gnas/ /ming la rgyal khams lha rje zer ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di lung 'dren du mang song yang yid 'phrogs nas rjes 'jug gi nyams len du bkod pas bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar lag tu 'khyer gang thub la 'bad par bya'o/ /smras pa/ /sman gyi bla dang drang srong thugs rje'i shugs/ /'gro kun shi gsos bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang por/ /babs pa'i gso rig gtsug

264 ga ga na ——shaṃ——na —kaurda ga mdzad ba na mo——rwa /——da walag ljon pa che/ /chos nor bde ba'i 'bras ṇḍaṃbu g.yur du za/ /tshul 'dir sngon tshe gzhan phan byang chub sems/ /snying la 'chang bas 'gro kun rdo rje'i tsher/ /sgrub malas rgyun shes bu la 'gran bzod pa'i/ /phan bde'i gzhir gyur lha rje mkhas mang byon/ /de nas snyigs ma'i me lce dngu / /lhan cig spyod ngan dud sprin gyis/ /lha lam nag por sgyur dogs pa'i/ /ma rung sman pas sa steng gang / /gdengs ldan mi slob nad brgyar sman gcig gahong / /brtag dpyad mi shes gang thon kha dmar gdags/ /mi srog blangs kyang stong gdab mi dgos par/ /blo phugs gtad 'di sman pa'i gshin rje gang / /gang rnyed ldam wum sbyar ba'i sman thun dang / /gang dran chal chol smra ba'i rdzun tshig gis/ /blun po tham thom mgo skor bslu brid mkhan/ /zang zing don gnyer sman pas 'jig rten 'joms/ /tshul 'di ma bzod thugs rje'i mnga' bdag des/ /sngon gyi drang srong byang sems de dag gi /rjes 'gro lha rje mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas su/ /dgongs nas gso rig gzhan phan gling 'di bskrun/ /gang 'di 'tsho byed gzhon nu dang mtshungs pa'i/ /byang sems sman pa'i rgyal po tha stag gis/ /gang bas lta na sdug gi grong khyer ltar/ /lus can nyer 'tsho'i gnas su 'gyur bar smon/ /zhes bya ba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //

———/de zhe ——— shākyi()shu) grwa tshang gi 'don 'grig sogs’kyi skor/༄ //de yang tshogs chen du grwa chang phan chan bzhi ldeb tshogs kyi skabs su tshogs kyi 'grig lam kun spyod/ 'don chos spyod kyi dbyangs rta sogs rags pa 'bras spungs tshogs chen ltar dang / bskang gso'i dbyangs rta sogs smad rgyud ltar byed la/ yar ngor rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gnas bcu'i cho ga dang / mar ngor dga' ldan byang rtse ltar mgon chos kyi bskang gso dang rnga chings sogs chag med dang drug cu ba chag med dga' ldan tshogs chen dang mthun pa sogs yin te/ rgyun du dpa' cig tshogs 'don mdzad pa ni/ spyir dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi mtshan brjod pa las 'jam dpal gyi mtshan lan gcig brjod pa phan yon che bar gsungs thing / 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa thams cad 'jam dbyangs la brten dgos la/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed la rgyu dus 'bras dus ye shes sems dpa'i dus gsum gar 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal dngos su yod cing zhi drag gnyis gang gtso bor bsgrub na gcig shos zhar la 'grub pa dang / pha rgyud ma rgyud gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos mtha' yas mnga' ste/ red mda' ba'i dris lan sogs las shes par bya'o/ / tsāde yang kun gzigs lnga ba chen pos/ rmad byung rnam thar gtsang

266 gididona'akhogegs rgya ma'i khrims dang ldan/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i snying stobs brtan/ /bde stong mchog gi rim gnyis legs spyod pa'i/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bston dngamajal bar shog /ces gsungs pa ltar mdo sngags thams cad gdan gcig lajigru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer nus pa ni dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i khyad chos bla na med pa yin kyang / grwa sa gzhan du sngags kyi phyag lespo sbyang ba'i ched du rgyud grwa 'grim dgos pa dang /rgyud du legs par sbyangs pa dag kyang motshan nyid phyogs la sbug 'thum pa'i phyogs re ba shas che la/ 'dir mtshan nyid grwa tshang kho na 'grim pas kyang rang blos 'chun na sngagasabyukyi phyag len dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi go ba nyams 'og tu chud pa zhig bde blag tu 'ong ba ni gzhan las 'phags pa'i khyad chos yin no/ / de yang 'jigs byed chos 'byung khams gsum rnam rgyal las/ ri bo dge lugs pa'i btsun chung6 zhig yan chad kyis kyang rdo rje 'jigs byed la rnal 'byor du byed pas/ tha na ja mchod tshun chad kyang rang lus lha sku'i ngo bo nyid/ /ro brgya bdud rtsir sred bral zhes pa ji lta ba kho na yin/ /zhes dang / 'jam dbyangs chos rjes rdo rje 'jigs byed yi dam du mdzad pas dpal ldan 'bras spungs lta bu thebs pa yin 'dug kyang rjes 'jug rta las babs nas bong bu zhon mkhan mang gsungs pa ni shin tu go dgos pa zhige yin no/ //des na rje'i zhal nas/ nged kyi brgyud pa 'di la /bla ma yang 'jam dbyangs// yi dam yang 'jam dbyangs/ chos skyong yang dzajam dbyangs la bsten pa zhig nges can du gal che gsungs pa

gi mdon maspreg gas spyo skorna 267ltar 'bad par 'tshal lo / myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po ni skyes bu chen po'i chos skyong /byang chub kyi sems kyi srung ma snying rje'i lha khyad par can yin la/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po ni skyes bu chung ngu'i chos skyong dge sdig shan 'byed las 'bras kyi srung ma khyad par can yin pas nges can du bsten dgos zhes rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rje rin po che la gdams pa dang mkhas grub thams cad mkhyin pa la mgon pos zhal dngos su bstan nas nga'i chos skor las tshar dang bcas pa sgrig rtsom dag ther gyis dang rje bla ma'i brgyud 'dzin la 'phrin las g.yel ba med par sgrub gsungs parang / chos rgyal la gshin rje pho brgyad mo brgyad kyis bskor pa byon nas/ bdag cag rnams ni gshin rje gshed kyi bka' sdod rje bla ma'i bka' srung yin pas rje gla ma'i bstan 'dzin rnams kyis nged cag 'khor bcas bsten cing sgrub dgos pa yin zhes gsungs pa dang / nang sgru/ba la ma heligadong can bzhis bskor pa byon nas kho bo ni gshin rje gshed kyis rje bla mali bka' srung du dngos su bka' bsgos pa yin/ khyed rnams kyis bdag cag la yi dam brtan po byos shig /ces phyi sgrub kyis dbyug to phyag tu gtad pa sogs rje yab sras kyi dus nas da ltalibar du ri bo dge lugatho pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams la mgon chos gnyis lus dang grib ma lta bur 'grogs pa'i rnam thar ma 'a yas pa zhig yod la/ khyad par kun mkhyen rin po che'i sku 'phreng rim byon la chos skyong 'a di gnyis kyis zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las gang bcol 'bad med du baspubs pa'i lo rgyus shin tu

268 —mang yang re zhig bzhag go / // gnas brtan mchod chog gi byung ba/ra //gnas brtan mchod chog gi lo rgyus ni/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la byams pa rdo rje gdan gyi spo la mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du khyed rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar nyan thos kyi cha lugs 'dis sems can gyi don du bstan pa skyongs shig ces bka' bsgos pas lha dang mi'i bsod nams kyi zhing du da lta yang mngon sum du bzhugs pa yin la/ de yang gnas brtan 'di rnams rgya gar nag dang bod du rang rang gi rab tu byung ba'i tshul gyis 'byon par gsungs te/ 'di'i gdams pa jo bo'i slob ma paṇḍi ta cig gis rngog byang chub 'byung gnas la gnang / des gnas brtan yan lag 'byung gi rnam 'phrul dge bshes po to ba chen po la gnang / po to ba nas rim bzhin dar bas mchims nam mkha' grags dang / mchims blo bzang grags pa gnyis kyis snar thang ba'i sgrub yig rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du grags pa mdzad cing / jo bos snar thang gi sa'i thang du phyag mdzub gtad de sa pha gir 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug 'byon zhes lung bstan pa ltar dpal snar thang ba'i bla ma gong ma rnams 'phags pa'i gnas brtan 'di dag la thugs gtsigs che zhing thugs dam du mdzad pas

gnas brtan chod tshog gi nga ba 269bka' gdams gsar rnying gi dgon pa rnams su yang gnas bcu'i cho ga ches cher dar ba yin no/ / —yang rgya nag tu thangadzu'i dzung gi rgyal pos gnas brtan bcu drug gdan drangs te dbyar gnas mdzad/ yul de'i skye bo rnams kyis dar dang gos chen la sogs pa'i na bza' mang po phul ba lhab lhub tu gsol/dgag dbye thon nas phebs par chas pa na rgyal blon rnams kyis sku 'bag re bzhengs shing / de la klu mes 'brom chung bas ma phyi blabs nas thub pa gnas brtan bcu drug dge bsnyen dharma tā la dang bcasogiḍi thang ka bco brgyad bzhengs/ de la se spyil bu bas ma phyi blangs pa sogos 'kho mched pa dang / gong smos ltar rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis pazlo ta'ibaka' ltar bzhengs pa'i dbang gis gnas bcu rgya nag ma dang / rgya gar mar grags pa'i thang ka mi 'dra bar byung bar mngon no/ /gnas brtan bcu drug gis rgya nag tu dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i gnas ni da lta a la sha'i dgon pa chags pa'i gnas 'di nyid yin la/ phyogs der a ka ru'i nags tshal skyes pa yang gnas brtan rnams kyis dbyar gnas mdzad pa nas yin zhes skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas gsungs so/ /de yang po to ba'i zhal nas/ gnas brtan 'di rnams kyi sku re mi bzhugs pa'i lha khang gis gtsug lag khang gi go rang mi chod pa yin/ 'di rnams la gsol ba gdab tu yod pa'i bod 'di rnams bsod nams bsags pa yin gsungs/ 'chad kha pa'i zhal nas/ 'di dag la gsol ba btab na chos dang chos byed 'phel ba ni nyams su myong bar

270 byung / de 'phel ba na gzhan thams cad shugs la 'byung gsungs pa sogasardortogs brjod las shes par bya'o// // rṇa chi — nga cho 'phrul smon lame gyi byung ba/ cho —༄ //cho ༵phrutsho smon lam ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis mnyan yod du rdzogs byed la sogs pa mu stegs kyi ston pa drug btul ba'i cho 'phrul gyi mdzad pa yang dag par bstan pa las rgya gar 'phags yul dang bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yang cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa'i srol rgya cher dar mod kyang / 'jam mgon bla ma chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa pos rab byung dgu ba'i sa glang gi lo lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du — kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin la 'gran par nus pa'i mchod pa'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pa dang bcas te dge 'dun khri ra can tshogs pas lha sa smon lam chen mor grags pa'i cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa mdzad pa ni rgyal ba rang nyid kyis mdo las lung bstan pa'i mdzad pa khyad par can yin zhing /lha ldan smon lam chen mo/ rdzing phyi'i zhig gsos/ dga' ldan sgrub mchod chen mo/ gnyal gyi lung ra chen mo bzhi la rje'i mdzad chen bzhir grags so/ kyi chos sde chen po 'dir ni dgon pa gsar tshugs kyi lo gnyis pa lcags

margyamasmonamam rtangab/ 271yos lo kun mkhyen gong ma rang nyid nas mchod rdzas rnams gsar bsgrigs gnang zhingag/ smon lam gsung chos la chag med du phebs/ — smon lam gyi 'don cha phyag len sogs rje rin po ches mdzad pa'i 'don sgrig gsung 'bum thor bu'i nang duyod pa ltar gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ phyis su skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas dag ther nan can gnang ba'i thugs rje sogs kyis da lta gsung chos la rje'i phyag srol ltar skyes rabs so bzhi ba nges can dang / de'i steng kun mkhyen gong ma'i bka' ltar byams chos re dang bcas pa'i gzhung chen mo gsum re'i gsung bshad shin tu rgyas pa rgya spos gnyis re'i yun tsam dang / tshogs 'don dkyus ma'i steng du chos spyod yongs rdzogs 'gro ba dang / smon lam grwa skor ba'i dam bca'/bla ma ma ṇi pas skor lam du mdo 'dzangs (mdzangs )blun sogs kyi gsung bshad dang bcas skya ser gyi khrom la ma ṇi bskul ba/ phyi dro sngags grwa gnyis sogs nas phyogs gtor gtong ba/ gos sku chen mo'i mchod pa bkra shis lhun po'i phyag len ltar 'cham pa grwa tshang gis 'cham dang bcas te lcags mkhar 'phen pa/ zhal zas rgya mtsho ma/ byams pa gling skor dang / zhar la stag seng 'brong gsob sogs kyi rtsed sna sogs lha ldan smon lam gyi srol ltar yod la/ rje'i gsung ltar ngo mtshar ba'i mchod pa bco brgyad/ mchod pa nyer gcig pa dang / mchod pa nyer lnga pa dang yo byad kyi mchod pa bcu dang / gzhan yang gser gyi dbu rgyan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa/ chos gos gsum/ drang srong gi snod/gdugs rgyal mtshan/ rnga bo che/ dung g.yas 'khyil dang / rgyal

shāṇḍirwa/shāṇḍi ———— ———— srid sna bdun/ 'ardod yon lnga/ bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad sogs kyi 'don cha rgyas par phye ba dang / de dag so soriskabs su dngul srang lnga brgya skor las bsgrubs pa'i maṇḍil gling bzhilibakod pa sogs gser dngul las byas pa dang / bzang gos kyis tshem grub (drab ) byas pa'i mchod rdzas 'grem pa bcas phyag len gyi skor ni da lta'i dus 'dir lha ldan smon lam las spyang 'di nyid lhag pa yod do// // gling bsre'i byung ba/li //gling bsre'i lo rgyus ni/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa la paṇḍi ta'i mtshan 'dogs srol ltar/ gangs can gyiljongs 'dir yang rab 'byams pa dang / dka' bcu dang / dka' bzhi'i grwa skor byed srol dar ba yin la/ de yang mnyam med jo bo chen pos snye thang gi thad kyi lung pa la phyag mdzub btsugs nas rngog la/ legs pa'i shes rab khyod kyis lung pa 'di'i phur dgon pa zhig thob dang / tshad ma'i 'chad nyan dar bar 'ong gsungs pa la/ rngog gis 'o na re zhig gsang bar zhu zhes zhus pas gsang phur grags/ gsang phu'i gnas der rngog legs pa'i shes rab dang rngog blo ldan shes rab kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gzhi ma lung dang rigs pa'i bshad grwa chen po 'dzugs par mdzad/ de gong gnas der jo bo bzhugs dus shig/ byams 'jam

—————sdi———————da ———— 273dbyangs gnyis kyis drang nges 'a/ rtsod pa mdzad pa'i rten 'brel gyis gling stod smad gnyis su gyes shing / gling stod smad gnyis bstan pa la bzang 'gran gyi tshul du phan tshun bsres nas rtsod pa mdzad pa la gling bsre zhes grags/ gling bsre'i srol de nyid dpal ldan 'bras spungs su blo gsal gling dpon slob 'brug stag pa ngag rdabang dpal bzang gi dus su tshugs par grags shing / sde 'dir dgon pa gsar tshugs kyi lo drug pa shing lug gi lo nas gling bsre'i srol tshugs/ phyis su skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas dag ther sogs mdzad pas nyin re bzhin bshad ring pa gnyis/bar gzhung pa gnyis/ phyi gzhung pa bzhi ste brgyad res bkas bcad ltar phar phyin gyi gzhung bzhi re dang / rnam 'grel gyi gzhung bzhi re la bshad pa dang / de re re'i steng nas phan tshun bgro gleng sogs byed pa dang / bla ma gling bsre la tshogs chen /khri rin po ches po ti lnga'i gnyis re lapyi' byams bshad dang / po ti gsum re la don 'bru'i sa bcad/ rgyud pa dpon slob kyis 'grel ba bzhi sbrags dang / rgyud ṭīka dus 'khor dpon slob kyis dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od/ ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba/ sman pa dpon slob kyis byang sa'i nang tshan thos pa'i sa'i nang du gso rig rgyud bzhi bsnan nas rig gnas lnga'i gsung bshad gnang ba dang / de yang sa bcad re re khol bton tsam ma yin par dogs gcod dang bcas gzhung rang rang gi sa bcad yongs rdzogs re nges can du 'chad dgos pa — dang / grwa tshang bzhi'i dpon slob khri gdan zur dang / daṣkaba'i bshes gnyen che bgres thams cad gdan 'dzosas nas rgyan drug mchogadku

274 ———— mi—————gnyis dam pa'i chos kyi bgro ba la zhugs pa lta bur bgro gleng gnang res mdzad nas thub bstan rdzosas ldan gsar ba'i dpal la 'god pa'i srol bzang po gong 'phel du yod do// // ci — lnga mchod’chen mo/ dku//lnga mchod la/ dmigs brtse ma'i 'bras rta/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i cho ga gdangs 'dom smad rgyud ltar dang / ja mchod rta ring /spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ dpal ldan sa gsum ma'i 'bras rta sogs chos spyod/ 'dzin grwa so so'i dus bzang dang / dgon grong tshang ma'i gling me mchod 'bul zhal zas rgya mtsho ma sogs rgya gang che/ dge bskos nas rje'i rnam thar tshogs gtam snyan sgron du zhu ba dang / dge bskos gsar bzhengs kyi bzhugs gral nas rgan shos gcig gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos 'khor bskor nas dge 'dun gyi 'khor 'phel tshul/ 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba la do dam gyi ched du gnas brtan dang zhal ta ba dang / mdzes 'chos pa dang / spong ba'i zhal ta ba dang /lag gi bla sogs bskos tshul/ gnas kyi bla mas gnas pa la chad pa lnga dang / dge 'dunamo gyi las kyi sgo nas kyang nan tur bco lnga sogs gsungs tshul/ ston pa mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshe bstan pa byang dar gyi rten 'brel bsgrigs nas dbu byang du bstan nas gzims pa ltar bod

———— — mtshod dzha mo/ 276gangs can 'dir/ dang po bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ bar du srol btod/ tha mar dar zhing rgyas pa nas rje rin po che'i bar dang / rje rin po ches 'brog ri bo cher dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab skabs zhwa lu pa legs pa rgyal mtshan de nyid lag gi bla dang zhal ta ba zung 'brel du bskos pas da lta'i bar du dga' ldan na zhwa lu pa'i phyag kyug zhal ta bas 'dzin bzhin pa yin tshul dang / rje rin po che zhing la gshegs skabs sras kyi thu bo gnyis nas chos kyi srol geng 'phel du byed pa ma gtogs/ grong ba'i mi nag gi mya ngan lta bu bya sa med pa'i khrims btod de skra sor tshad las lhag pa la spos mes sun 'byin gnang ba ltar da lta yang lnga mchod kyi skabs de bzhin byed srol yod pa dang / de nas rje rin po cheribastan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel la dgongs nas/ rje rin po che zhi bar gshegs pa'i lo gnyis pa'i lnga mchod kyi skabs rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyi bkas mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang dge bskos su ba skos pa ltar da ltalibar du dga' ldan lnga mchod kyi dge bskos gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / de bzhin du chos sde chen po 'dir yang rje yab sras0 kyi phyag len ltar lnga mcho da kyi nyin zhal ngo gsar bzhengs kyi srol tshugs pa yin tshul sogs kyi gral 'phros bslab bya'i tshul du 'bul srol yod de/'di yang bstan pa'i bya ba rmad du byung ba zhigayin ro / / de yang paṇa chen shākya shrī sogs kyis bla ma'i 'das mchod bsgrub pa la phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod par gsungs pa ltar kun mkhyen gong ma gnyis kyi lo mchod zla mchod chag med dang / bla ma gzhan gyi lo

2tso6 mchod zla mchod sogs miphyag srol mdo rgyud kyi khungs ldan yod kyang ma bris so// // — rigs grwa'i’tshogs gleng sogs/ ra //rigs grwa zla phyed kyi ring la blo gsal rnams kyis tshogs thebs re re bzhin po ti lnga'i gzhung du mar brgal brtag tshogs gleng dang / mang 'gyed sogs da pal ldan 'a bras spungs ltar byed srol yod la/ 'o na kyang lhag khyad du grwa tshang so so rang rang gi chos grwar 'tshogs nas mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyanaskyong ba dang / de'i sngon du gtor chen smad rgyud lugs mjug tu gtor 'phen zho ston dang bcas pa/ gos sku zhal 'byed kyiconyin me tog mchod pa/ khyi ra skor gsum gyi 'cham dang bcas rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar gyi sgo nas skye 'gro legs pa'i lam bzang po la 'god pa dang / skabs brgya da pa'i 'phrin las pa gnyis kyis tshogs gleng rdzogs pa'i mjug tu sa bcad 'phroyoring dang tshig bkra gang mang mchod yar rgyas pa byed pa sogs gna' dus kyi bstan srol bzang po skyong ba yin no / /dzwabyar gnas kyi ring la bsdus grwa pa rigs bzang mi baṣka res rwa stod ltar bsdus grwa'i tshogs gleng byed pa dang / ston dpyid gnyis la 'bras spungs ltar rdo bcal rab 'byams pas nyin lnga re'i reng la po ti lnga'i dam bca' 'jog pa dang / dpyid kyi ring la chos mtshams kyi skabs su

rigab da wa gas sog 277bsdus grwa pa rnams kyis brtsi bzhag dge bshes kyi drung nas bsdus grwa mi 'dra ba du ma'i brtsi bzhag mnyan nas rigs pa'i bdar sha gang chod byed pa sogs bshad sgrub kyi srol zla ba nya gang ba'i dpal la 'gran pa lta bur yod do/ /gzhan yang lo re bzhin bstan pa spyi'i rim gror dgun srad rgyud lugs kyi lcags mkhar/ dpyid lcags mkhar dben sa lugs/dbyar smad rgyud lugs kyi gtor chen/ ston mgon po'i zhi rgyas kyi gtor sgrub dang sgrol ma 'bum ther/ dgun nyi ldog dang bstun nas gtor chen rgyud stod lugs dang / bka' 'gyur gsung sgrog bcas chag med dang / zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'khrul 'khor dang / lcags mkhar lugs mi 'dra ba du ma dang / mgon po'i gtor chen thun mong ma yin pa/ stobs chen shugs bzlog gdugs dkar zlog chen/ sgrol ma g.yul zlog gzhan yang rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs rgyud nas bshad pa'i las rab 'byams mang poliphyag len sogs bka' pota lngas mtshon gzhung lugs du ma'i 'chad nyan/ rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad sgrub tha na gar thig 7dbyangs gsum gyi phyag len phra mo re tshun chad/ thun mong ba rig gnas lnga'i slob rgyun/ thun mo nga ma yin pa dbang lung khrid man ngag sogs mdor na bstan pa rnam dag gi bshad sgrub kyi rgyun da lta gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir bzhugs so cog phal cher dar rgyas su yod pa dang / de dag 'dzin skyong bgyid pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen kyang 'og tu 'chad 'gyur gyi gdan rabs rim byon dang / gzhan yang skrub pa snying bor mdzad pa'i

278 na gas sog sgom dang / mdo sngags kyi gnad la go ba chags pa'i dge bshes til gyi gang bu lta bur bzhugs pas phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kyi gzur ga nas don gnyer can rnams sde 'dir zhugs pa tsam gyis don mthun gyi tshong ba nor bu'i gling du slebs pa lta bu zhig yod pa ni mchog dman kun gyi mngon sum gyi yul du gyur pa 'di lags so/ / ri smras pa/ bgrangs yas skye dgu'i bsod nams nor 'dzin gzhir/ /phan bde'i snang ba zad mi shes pa'i gter/ /nam yang spro ba'i byed po thub bstan gyi/ /nyin byed ces su sras bcas rgyal bas bsngags/ /mtha' yas phyogs kyi kun gsal mdzes ma'i ngogs/ /bshad sgrub rta bdun shing rta'i kha lo pa'ang / /rig grol dge 'dun go la'irlung shugs las/ /gzhan du btsal kyang bskal brgyar dmigs su med/ /de phyir lung rtogs chos kyi chu mtsho'i dbus/ bshad sgrub rol rtsed skyong ba'i mig yangs po/ /bshes gnyen ngang mo 'bum sdi'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /'dus pa'i sde chen 'di nyid bsngags par 'os/ /gang du blo bzang chos kyi snang ba'i 'od/ /gang zhig spro mkhas bshes gnyen nam mkhalinor/ /gang gi skal bar thob pa'i blo gsal gyis/ gang ba'i sde 'di chos kyi sde zhes grags/ /chos kyi sde 'dir snyigs dus shāka seng gi /chos tshul mtha' dag ngal bso bgyid pa na/ /chos bzang mdun sar rol ba'i lha rnams kyis/ /chos min pham pa'i rgyal rnga mngon par rdung / /gser bzhin tshad mas sbyangs pa'i byi dor gyis/ /gser bzang 'od ltar 'khrul ba'i

279dris dben pa/ /gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs 'di/ /gser gyi rgyan ltar yid 'ong dga' ba'i gsos/ /kye ho rang sems shelda gyi me long la/ /brten nas sgo gsum bag yod byi dor mkhan/ /chos spyod bcu yi rgyan ldan de dag la/ /rgyal rnams dgyes pa'i ku mud 'dzum dkar dgod/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gdan rabs dngos/ra //bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan rabs lo rgyus tsam la 'di man chad tshe nas chog mod/ 'di yan chad du nya dang nyung ma bsres pa lta bu'i gtam gyis nyis 'gyur du bskyed pa ni chos sde 'di nyid kyi gnas tshul shes par 'dod pa dag dang / chos grwa 'grim mkhan gyi gsar bu 'ga' zhig la phan pa srid dam snyam nas bris la/da ni gdan rabs rim byon rnams kyi rnam thar brjod par bya ste/de yang sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwa gong ma rgya bskyed skabs byang ngos su 'bras bu can gyi shing mang po skyes pa'i rten 'brel ltar bkra shis sgo mang du chos kyi rgyal mtshan btsugs pa de las phyogs 'dir mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi dgon sde 'di chags pa yin la/ thog mar rtse gzhung sa yi thig ler chos thog tshugs phyin chad phebs bzhud kyi tshe yang dge 'dun grub yab sras kyi phyag len ltar chos thog ma chag pa byed dgos gsungs pa bzhin dgon

——ldaX—— tsho—rwarjodarjo sa da genas 'tshol skabs su rong tsho chen bco brgyad sogs kyi sar chos par bteg /de'i phyag srol skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas gsan sbyong dus the bo chab tshan du phebs skabs sogs res 'ga' skyong bar mjod de rten 'brel dang dgos pa che bar sems so / //gdan rabs dang bo kun mkhyen bzhad pa'i rdo sde rje ngag dab nga ba rtson 'grus pa chen bo/༄tsho//grwa chang gsar tshugs kyi tshe kun mkhyen mchog gis khri ba mdzad nas brtsi bzhag gnang zhing skabs skabs su gsar bu rnams la rtsod pa byed bcug ste rtags gsal re gnyis 'phrod mkhan rnams la dge bshes yong ba 'dug sogs bsngags brjod mdzad pa dang / drag zhan kun la blo tshod dang bstun pa'i bslab bya dang babs (bab )'os kyi gnang sbyin sogs dgyes pa cher mdzad cing / grwa ba gsar bu zhig la yang skyon brjod na thugs mi dgyes pa sogs brtse bas bdag gir mdzad pa yin 'dug ste/ lam/ gcig rong phyogs nas dgon par phebs nyin mi zhig gis/ khyod kyi grwa bam̐ gcer bu rnams chibs bsur 'ong shas che zhus par/ khyod kyis ha ma go ba yin/ 'di tshos gangs te se nas bzung ste nged rang gi rjes gtong ma myong zhes gsungs te/ gnas brtan yan lag 'byung dang thugs rgyud gcig pa'i brdar rnam dpyod can rnams gleng / gter lung du byon skabs ldong nge dgra bla zer ba'i bon po zhig gis zhwa dmar gyon/

—dgedanarda dizikasdorwa—/——— 281sil snyan dkrol te khyung khel nas bsus pas cha lugs 'di gongs te se nas mthong myong gsungs ste skyabs mgon mchog dbang phyug mi larasapa dang thugs rgyud gcig par paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa dang 'grig gam snyam ste/ ka lan da ka'i dris lan las/ rwa bcu rgyas pa'i sha ba smug po dang / /la lung bgrod byed klog spyang dmar mo dang / / sha za'i gdong can mgon po rdo rje gsum/ /sa thob dam pa gang las byung ba ltos/ /zhes pa'i don dpyad par bya'o/ /grwa ba'i nang du nad yams thig byung skabs thugs dam gyi rten chos rgyal gyi zhal thang la bka' kyon dang phyag 'bebs mdzad pas nad yams chad song ba ni lha la drag shul spyod par nus pa'i rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la mnga' brnyes pa 'i rtags su gsal lo/ /grwa ba zhig chos grwa mi 'grim par bza' btung dang gnyid 'ba' zhig gis 'da' ba la/ mched grogs 'gas bskul btab par/ tshe 'dir skyid skyid cig gtong dgos phyi mar 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas rtsis kha btang mi yong zer ba mi gzhan gyis sku mdun du zhus pas 'o de ka yin/ rtsis kha gto nga dogs med ces gsungs grwa ba zhig gshegs pa'i rus dum zhig khyer shog gsungs nas zhal phu mdzad/gzhan rnams la yang khyed rang tshos sngags re thob dang a tsa ma gsungs/nyin kha shas nas da legs po byung gsungs nas rus pa de bor bar mdzad/yang lan cig phreng ba de khyer shog dang da res dmyal ba'i zang nga gcog dgos gsungs/ phreng ba bsnams nas zhal 'don gyi rnam pas cung zad bzhugs te/ pho khyo ga lta ba'ikog chags can yin pas grol sla bar

282 gdan sa pa 'dug gsungs/ yang khya dge dpon slob blo gros rgya mtsho sku gzugs ma bde bar sku mdun du mjal bar 'ongs pas khyod ci la 'ong ba yin gsungs nas phyag mkhar ('khar ) gyis mang du brdujas te song gsungs/dpon slob kyis da bsam don grub pa yin zhes phebs song bar zla bo khrel rgod byas 'dug kyang de ma thag bsnyun las grol ba dang / dpon ju nang gi tsha bo lha skyabs mer gan dā'i ching thugs rig ngos mi zin pa zhig byung ste lo mang por thabs gang gis kyang ma phan pas skyabs tshol du 'ong ba bsang gzhung du thon nyin nas bde ru song bar/ khyod 'dir 'ong ba legs/nad bdag de nga'i rtsar 'ong ba lta zhog mda' chen nyag ga yang brgal ma thub/ da nad drag song ba yin kyang phyin chad kyi bsrung ba 'dra byed gsungs nas byabs khrus dang bka' bsgo kha shas mdzad pas sangs dwangs su song ba dang / mi tra brgya rtsa gnang skabs thun bar zhig la mkhan po no mon han la rdung dgos gsungs nas gro bur bzhengs par gsol dpon dbyig kya rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs nas phyogs 'grul shin tu mang stabs de 'dra ma gnang byas sku la 'tham pas ha ma go ba/ nga'itshod 'dzin rgyu e yin gsungs nas phyag 'khar gyis brdungs kyang ma btang bas sa la bzhugs nas brdungs na legs po yin te gsungs/ dbang grol nas no mon han zi ling du phebs par rma chus gru bskyod de grwa pa 'ga' zhig chus khyer/ no mon han dpon g.yog kha shas chu bas zin thub tsam byung ba spyan dmigs kyi mthu yin par nges so/ /'di dag ni bsad gso sogs la mnga' bsgyur ba'i mdzad pa mthun grub yin no/ /

gdan bas da5sa 283yang bu chen 'ga' zhig gis bskyed rim mthar phyin pa'i skabs su zus rgyan sog4mig gis mthong rgyu yod zer ba e bden zhus par/ de los bden/ 'di yin mod gsungs nas dbu g.yas g.yon du kyog nas ston par mdzad pa dang / yang thang sag pa dngos grub rgya mtsho dang khong rnam gnyis kyis gsang 'dus dbang gi lus dkyil ngo sprod kyi tshe lus kyi dkyil 'khor du 'dus pa'i lha so gnyis shel bum nang gi mar me ltar gsal ba ston res mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gtam mtha' yas pa yod kyang 'dir de tsam mo/ / e ma gasgru ma lus su yis btung / /ci 'di kun kyang dbang phyug yin nam ci/ /'on kyang yan lag brgyad ldan chab btung bar/ /brtson par mdzod cig skom pas gdung ba rna'is/ /zhes kyang smras so/ / gdan rabs garnyas ba thugs sras ngag dbang bkra zhis/ra //gdan rabs gnyis pa 'jam mgon smra ba'i dbang phyug ngag dbang bkra shis dpal bzang po ni mdo smad reb gong gi sa'i cha bse'i nya lung zhes par yab rin chen skyabs dang / yum snying mo byams gnyis kyi srasasu rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa rta lor 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas rtsis mkhan zhig gis ser gos gyon dgos zhes pa ltar na bza' dkar bo nab ma myong gsungs shing / sku rtsed mdzad pa na yang sa rdo mang po

284 gad dadzo bsgrigs te gnas brtan bcu drug yin zer nas phyag mchod byed pa/ ma ṇi pa yin zer nas byis pa mang po la ma ṇi bskul ba/ phyag dbang 'jog pa/ khri la bzhugs nas phyogs su bkra shis brjod pa'i tshul sogs dam pa'i spyod tshul ngang gis brtas/ de dus lta ba'i bag chags rang 'khrungs su yod ces zhal bzhes mdzad snang ste/ phyis su grwa slob 'ga' zhig la khyed tshos lta ba tshol 'dod na dgag bya ngos 'dzin la 'bad dgos/ dgag bya bden grub bkag pa'i stong pa ma shar bar stong sang phal ba re shar yang don chung / nga rang byis pa'i dus phyugs rdzi rnams kyis me 'bud pa la 'di ci yin dris pas/ me yin zer/ de ngas kyang shes mod/ me zer don ci yin dris pas mi shes rpār/ de bzhin du sa rdo ri brag gang la yang rang ming de mi 'byar ba zhig yod/ yang bdag gi khu bo zhig rta la sga sgron gyin 'dug par 'di ci yin dris pas rta yin zer/'di'i mgo rkang lag gang la rta zer ba yin snyam bsam blo btang bas rta de med song ba lta bu zhig byung / de nas bzung ste snang ba de rgyun du 'char zhing / phyis su skabs 'gar srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar 'di thams cad stong cham gyis song ba'i snang ba brgya 'gyur du shar yang de lta ba'i phyoṭa na yang mi 'dug gsungs/ 'o na lta ba nam brnyes zhus pas/ burta pā ri ta'i tshig gcig gsungs nas rje rin po che dang / sku phyogs nas kyang tshig 'di'i steng nas lta ba brnyes pa'i tshul gnang bas/ ngas kyang byin rlabs kyi khyad bsam nas tshig de la yang yang dpyad pas sems la 7na pa zhig byung gsungs/ tshig gang yin ngag rgyun la mi gsal yang / lcang

—da —rdasda— kasdo 286skya rdo rje 'chang nas/ rje rin po ches rtsa she'irab byed brgyad pa'i/brten nas 'byung ba ma gtogs pa/ zhes sogs kyi thad burta pā li ta'i 'grel bar gzigs nas stong nyid rtogs pa yin pa 'dra/ rtsa she'i ṭīka chen du lung de lan mang po 'dren par mdzad 'dug ces gsungs par skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas gsungs/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i dngos slob mgar gong tshe brtan rgya mtsho'i drung du rab byung dang dge tshul mdzad nas mtshan sbyin pa rgya mtshor gsol/ lo bcu drug pa la yul dbus su byon/ bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar dpon slob don grub rgya mtsho'i drung du bsdus grwa'i tshig bzhag mnos/ chos grwar zhugs nas cher ma 'gyangs par bgro gleng legs par mdzad thub pa byung / dang por bum pa'i ldog pa bum pa dang mi 'gal tshul la dpyad tshugs pa nas rim gyis rigs lam lhag ma thams cad la dpyod tshugs pa dang / myur du rtogs pa byung zhing 'di nas bzung ste 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gzigs snang nam 'dod du 'char ba zhig yod par rje nyid kyi dngos slob dge bshes bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rnam thar bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs las bshad/ dgung lo bcu bdun par rigs smra bye ba'i mdun sa stag tshang rwa ba stod du phebs/ rje rin po ches gsan sbyong mdzad skabs/ yod rtogs med rtogs kyi brtsi bzhag skyor bzhin shing sdong gcig la skor ba mdzad pas/shing steng du yod par rtogs pa'i tshad ma rtag par rtogs pa'i tshad ma sogs kyi yig 'bru phebs pa snying bor byas nas 'bum lta bu zhig bzhengs pa la rje'i rtag par rtogs pa'i tshad khangasgrudu grags/ de la skor ba byed

286 ga da5 srol ltar rje 'dis kyang lo gcig dang zla ba kha shas kyi ring la 'dzin grwa gsum gyi tshig bzhag thugs 'dzin gnang ste pasdus tshan re re yang grangs bzung nas brgya stong sogs kyi bar du skyor sbyang byas shing zhabs la khrag rdol gyi bar du rtag par rtogs pa'i tshad khang la skor ba mdzad pa sogs brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du bsten pas blo gsal bye ba'i dbus na lung rigs smra ba la zla med pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ 'di skabs tshad me sde bdun gyi don thams cad de'i tshig nyung ngu re'i nang du yang sdud thub pa dang / tshig re res kyang don yongs rdzogs re zlos skyon med par 'chad thub pa sogs nyams 'og tu tshud pa zhig byung gsungs/ slar bkra shis sgo mang du phebs te dpon slob 'od zer rgya mtsho'i drung nasaskabs brgyad ka'i tshig bzhag yongs rdzogs dang / /dbu ma yang gas na cing phar phyin gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs/ nyi thang ba'i dbu ma'i zur bkol/ stag lung grags pa'i dbu ma yongs rdzogs bcas zugs 'dzin mdzad/ gzhung sar gdong lngalisgra dbyangs kyi rgyugs phul bar gong sa drug pa rin po ches thugs dgyes pa'i gsung dang gnang cha yang bstsal/ yang bskyar 'dzin grwa gsham du babs te kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i drung nas dbu ma yongs rdzogs kyi brtsi bzhag bshad pa dang bcas gsan cing / lung rigs gter mdzod kyi smad cha yongs rdzogs dang / stod cha sems bskyed gsum pa'i bar du thugs 'dzin mdzad/ de dus skyor sbyang dpe gzigs phyag sbyangs mchod 'bul sogs la nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu gzhol bas sku zla blo bzang dar rgyas kyis khyod 'di ltar 'bad pa'i dgos pa ci —

gdan ba dalda 287yin zhes dris pa la 'dzum pa zhig mdzad nas lta ba'i bag chags e thebs yin zhes gsungs pa kho rang gi ngag rgyun thos shing / mnal lam du bya rgod phung po'i rir yang yang slebs pa dang / gtsug lag khang zhig na klu spub bzhugs pa'i mdun du slebs kyang dar dkar gyi yol ba zhig gis bsgribs 'dug pa sogs yang yang rmis pa rje gong ma'i drung du zhus par khyod la stong nyid don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i skal ba yod par snang zhes gsungs/ de ltar sbyangs pas dgung tho nyer drug gi tshe lta ba 'khrul med du rnyed par rnam thar las gsungs so/ /'dul mdzod la yang yig cha gsar ba'i thal phreng yongs rdzogs dang chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta so—gas thugs 'dzin mdzad nas zhib tu sbyangs shing gsang phur dka' bcu'i mtshan btags kyang mdzad/ thugs gnyer gyi skabs 'di dag tu nub gcig la brtsi bzhag mtshan skyong /nub gcig la snga thun ltung bshags gsungs nas phyag sbyang dang / ri phyi thun cung zad re gzims/ de'i phyi nub yang brtsi bzhag mtshan skyong mdzad pa ste nub res mos kyis rgyun mi 'chad dang / rwa skor du mtshan skyong gi tshe gzims dkrog pa'i ched du pha bong chen po zhig la rdo zhig gis deg bzhin du brtsi skuzhag skyor bas pha bong de rdo snod chen po lta bu zhig tu song ba da lta yang klu 'bum khang tshan na yod ces bdag gi bla ma khri chen bsod nams grags pa'i zhal nas dngos su thos/ yang gzims spyil nang du mtshan skyong gi tshe mgrin pa la thag pa btags nas lcam gyi gseb tu btags pa'i thag pa dang mchar bus sprel te bstod (brtod )nas brtsi bzhag skyor

288 gasta/ ja5 ji bar mdzad pas mgrin pa sha then du song yod par zhal slob grwa rgan rnams gleng / lan gcig bsnyung gzhi drag po byung ste kun gyis mi 'tsho bar thag bcad de 'bras spungs dge 'phel du kun mkhyen gong ma'i drung du skyabs 'jug zhu bar btang bas dgyes bzhin du srung mdud dang bum chu gnang /tshur 'ong dus phyi dbugs chad nas mal sogs spos tshar kyang srung mdud bcings bum chu khar blugs ma thag dran pa rnyed cing dbugs rgyu ba byung / phyis su kun mkhyen mchog nas bka' bkyon gnang du sa shig khyod ngas bar do nas khrid 'ong ba yin gsungs/ de dus mi la ras pa gnyis pa grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sprul sku rin po che ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho dbus su byon yod pas rje 'di ba bsnyen rdzogs ma thob par 'chi ba la sems 'tsher ba gsan nas chos gos shig gnang / ming la dge slong ngag dbang bkra shis zhes btags pa yin gsungs/ gong gsal ltar dran pa rnyed ma thag mched grogs rnams kyis dge slong ngag dbang bkra shis zhes 'bod pa sogs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa ltar ma 'gyangs par kun mkhyen mchog gi drung du bsnyen par rdzogs shing mtshan yang ngag dbang bkra shis zhes gsol/ ( dgung lo nyer dgu par dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang du phebs/so so skye bo'i blo la nges pa med pas dam bca' zhig byed dgos dgongs te sngags kyi slob gnyer gsha' ma zhig ma byung bar du rnam rtog gzhan gyis mtshams bcad na chos skyong gis tshar chod ces dam bca' mdzad/ ṭīka chung gi skyor dpon mdzad de lo der ṭīka chung le'u dgu‘pa'i mtshams sbyar

rdo dan ba nga / da 289wa sred dang / de'i phyi lo ṭīka chen yongs rdzogs thugs 'dzin gnang / malas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs pa'i drung du bde po/sa/nga sogs rgyud sdedu ma la gsam bsam rgya chen po mdzad pas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gnad la 'phyug med kyi gzer thebs pa byung /khyad par khri chen de nyid dang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje rnam gnyis kyi drung du 'grel ba bzhi sprags kyi gzab bshad lan mang por gsan pas phyes mdo smad bkra shis 'khyil du rgyud kyi bshad pa gnang skabs sa khungs bsgrig lugs/ sa bcad 'grem tshul/ rgyud don 'grel rkyang ges rdzogs mi rdzogs/ kha skong yod med kyi khyad par/ mchan sprags tshul bya rkang ma dang mthing rkang ma dang / 'phar ma sogs sngon gyi sngags pa rgan po du ma'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i legs bshad kyi brgo skal rgya tshar bstsal snang / de ka'i zhar la 'don rta dbyangs gar thig sogs kyi phyag len phra mo tshun chad zhib par sbyangs pas rgyud kyi grwa pa rgan gzhon tshang mas dad gus kyi bser bus bskyod pa'i bsngags brjod mgrin pa'i dril chung rang 'khrol du gyur/ chu mig lung du rim lnga'i dmar khrid bskyangs skabs rlung gegs cung zad byung yang bla ma yi dam dbyer med la gsol ba drag tu btab pas nya gcig 'og sgo nas zhugs pa'i snang ba byung ste gegs las grol/ de ni a ba dhu tī (wa ju tīle )nang du rlung zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las byung ba'i 'od gsal gyi nyi ma 'char ba'i snga ltas su gsang sngags mkhyen pa rnams gsungs/ chos grwar phebs pa'i snga phyi 'di dag tu chos bka' yang mang du gsaske cing khyad par kun mkhyen

290 ga2na ba da5 chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad nga/'i rdo rje rigs kyi cod pan du bzung ste lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung / bslab btus —dngaspyoda'ajug gibashad pa/ bde lam dang 'jam dpal zhang lung gi khrid/ dbumalalta khrid/dben sa lugs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyi nang gsang gsum sogs gsan cing / bka' pota lnga'i dka' gnad so sor dpe khrid dogs/ gcod dri gtug yang yang mdzad pas rkunacamakhyen mchog kyang yon tan gyis thugs khengs pa'i dgyes nyams che ba dang / sngon a ma lab sgron gyi spyan sngar thugs smon mdzad pa'i 'bras bu smin pa'i dus babs bcas dgung lo so gnyis par kun mkhyen rin po che'i zhabs phyir mdojismad du byon/ lam bar du phyag g.yog gang dgos zhus pa'i zhar la nyin mo mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad la dogs gcod dang / mtshan mo gzims gur la phyag skor gyi ngang nas po ti lnga'i skyor sbyangs mdzad pas sngar las kyang dgyes pa tsho jidapag med mdzad/ 'di skabs rta'i skyog bkrol ba tsam yang bla ma'i bsnyen bkur yin pas tshogs bsags snyam du dran shes kyes zin par byas pa yin zhes zhal nas gsungs/ phyis su mdo smad du byon nas kyang kun mkhyen chen po sku ma 'das kyi bar du mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas mnyes par byas te mdo phyogs brgyad stong don bsdus/ 'phags seng gi snang ba gnyis/ byams chos lnga/ 'jug pa rang 'grel/ tshad ma mdo sde bdun deng bcas pa sogs ga zhung chen du ma'i bshad pa dang / khrid chen brgyad dang man ngag gsum sogs srad rgyud rdo rje 'chang nas brgyud pa'i man ngag rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan pas mkhas grub thams

gegen da mi 291cad mkhyen pa sa rje rin poche la nyin mo rgyud sde'i bshad pa dang / mtshan mo bskyed dzogs kye khrid gsan pa'i rnam tharagyi dpe zla zhig mdzad pa yin snang ste/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rje'i/ /zhabs zung padmo gang la reg pa'i rdul/ /yid gnyis gya gyu med par khying dkyil nas/ /yang dag gus pas spyi bo'i gtsug tu blangs/ /'bad pa du mas yun ring mnyes byas pas /legs bshad bdud rtsis snying gi bum pa gang / /de tshe rnam dpyod rta bdun 'od po ches/ /gzhung lugs pad tshal 'dab ma 'bum phrag rgyas/ /zhes dang / rten 'brel gyi mtha' dpyo da chen mo'i mjug tu yang / sngon bsags legs smon bsod nams mi dman pas/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs pad gus bsten nas/ /legs bshad 'tshol la sgra dbyangs sras po dang / /rgyal sras nor bzang zlar gyur kho bos byas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / lcags stag gi lo grwa tshang gsar tshugs skabs su dge bskos mdzad nas gsar bu rnamasal zhwa mo zla gam/ gzan sham sogs gyon tshul/tshogs chos grwalikun spyod sogs gang ci thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas slob par mjod pas gsar bu rnams dge bskos 'di rang re'ipha dang 'dra bar 'dug zer nas—gus zhen che bar byung / lo dedzeeston kun mkhyen chen po nyid nas rang gisasgo mang chos grwar bzhes 'phro'i ras ber dang zhwa mo bcas gnang nas khyod rang bla ma gyis la 'di dag gyon te chos khri'i steng nas brtsi bzhag thongs zhes bka' nan mdzad pa ltar/ de nas bzung ste

292 da da gung lo re gcig pa’sa rtalibar du 'chad nyan mdzad cing / dgon pa gsar tshugs kyi lcags stag nas sa khyi'i bar lo dgu'i ring la chos thog tu ma zad chos mtshams la yang brtsi bzhag chag med du btang nas lo drug gi khongs su 'dzin grwa bcu gsum la po ti lnga'i 'chad nyan tshugs thub nga byung / brtsi bzhag la yang rje gong ma'i phar phyin gyi yig cha skabs dang po nas brgyad pa'i bar yongs rdzogs kyi brtsi bzhag lan mang po song zhing /brtsi bzhag dang sprags nas dka' gnas la gsung bshad nyin re bzhin mdzad pas skabs brgyad ka'i gsung bshad zin bris su byas pa dang /skabs dang po gsum gyi gsung bshad zin bris/ gzhung tshan so so'i zin bris thor bu shin tu mang bar snang / de yang yig cha'i skabs bdun pa'i dpe mtsho sngon gyi dus 'khrugs skabs rje gong ma'i drung yig lha dbang pi chi ji'i dpe cha'i gsepa nas gzhan du 'khyar te dpe rgyun ma byung stabs 'jam mgon khri rin po ches da lta'i skabs bdun pa 'dis kha bskangs pa yin par bdag gi bla ma khri chen bsod nams dbang rgyal bas gsungs pas/ da dung kun mkhyen mchog gi gsung la yun ring du 'dris pa'i nyams rgyus can rnams kyis 'bad pa chen pos tshol bar bya'o/ /zur bkol la yang skabs skabs su brtsi bzhag 'gro gang che dang gsung bshad gnang zhing brtsi bzhag dang bstun nas chas mtshams skabs su rtsod pa byed bcug pas zur bkol bzhi'i gsung bshad zin ris su byas pa shin tu legs pa re dang zin bris thor bu mang du yod la/ dbu ma yang lung rigs gter mdzod kyi stod cha smad cha yongs rdzogs tshig bzhag la

— lha——༷—ra da da / da wa 293btang nas gsung bshad zhib rgyas mdzad pas zin bris —thor bu shin tu — mang zhing / khyad par du bar skabs shig 'gyang ro sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin / gser kha ba bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rkang tsha ngag dbang mkhyen rab/ dbal mang blo bzang don grub/ gling don grub rgya mtsho/ rnga ba rab brtan rgya mtsho/ rnga ba chos skyong rgya mtsho/ 'be bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ rnga ba go thob/ rnga ba mkhar da7ra mkhar nag gnyis/ rab 'byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ da lta ba rin chen chos bzangabyu/ bstan 'dzin rgya yu ma/ rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams sogs dge bshes rgan gzhon du ma 'dzin grwa gcig tu bsdus nas khyed tshosagarto ba la dpyod e tshugs ltos/ ngas kyang gang shes bshad gsungs nas lo gcig la lung rigs gter mdzod yongs rdzogs brtse bzhag la btang ste gsung bshad zhib rgyas bstsal par dge bshes de dag dzokyang chos grwa 'chag med 'grim nas gsung bshad zin bris// nang phan tshun gyi dogs gcod/ yig cha yongs rdzogs kyi skyor sbyang / bsags sbyangs gang drag mdzad pas phal cher gyis zab mo dbu ma'i gzhung la tshig spyi tsam du ma song ba'i go ba rnam dag rnyed de/ rang rang gi lta ba'i nyam5 mgur du ba'es pa las ci rigs pa zhig mig lam du gyur/ khri rin po che nyid nas kyang lta ba'e tshogs cha tshang ba'i sgo nas myong ba 'don tshul gyi gsung mgur bstsal pa ni 'di ltar/ lha mthu ldan gshin rje gshed po dang //mgon rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rtags ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol rje/ /phu bzhad pa'i rdo rjer gus pas 'dud/ /zhabs

2skye4 da rtsibs stong bkra ba'i ri mo can/ /bu dad ldan snying gi padmo'i mtshor/ /dus rtag rospa bka' drin chen po yis/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /zhes pa nas/ da mtha' bral dbu ma'i rnal 'byor pas/ / sems skyo ba'i ngang tshul 'di ltar dran/ /yang dag pa'i rigs pas mthar 'dzin gyi/ /blo 'khrul ba'i rdzun phug ma ri ga nas/ /sems chags sdang bshan pas bsha' lug bzhin/ /lan grang sa med bsad pa'i tshul la skyo//las dge sdig skye 'chi sa lam sogs / /tshul gdod ma'i gshis la cung zad kyang / /yod myong min der ngo ma shes nas/ /sems 'khrul ngor 'khor bar 'khyams la skyo/ /rigs 'gro drug mtho dman skyid sdug sogs/ /nang sems nyid byed por ma shes nas/ / cholas phyi rol bde sgrub sdug sel thabs/ /sha thang thang 'bad pa'i tshul la skyo/ /mthu nus pa3skyes rtsali ci yod kyis/ /dgra dzar 'dzin 'joms pa'i thabs la 'ab da//'di chod na ljon shing rtsa ba ltar/ /srid 'a khor ba'i nyes skyon ma lus zlog /gzhi chos can kun rdzob sna tshogs 'di/ /gcig tu bral rigs pas rnam dpyad na/ /nam tshotho rangs mtha' yi rgyu skar bzhin/ /rdus myur bar chos kyi dbyings su 'gro/ /shul de na lus pa ci yang med/ /gang bltas bltas b.rosnang stong ba bzhin/ /don skye 'gag 'khor 'das bde sdug sogs/ /chos chos min ma lus ro mnyam yin/ /dbyings de las langs pa'i rjes thob na/ /las dege sdig rnam smin so so dang / /sman rtsi bcud rgyu 'bras ma 'chol bar/ /rdzun sgyu ma bzhin /du cir yang 'char/ /de sprul pas sprul pa gzhan sprul bzhin/ /yul phan tshun gcig la gcig

———— rjo sha /rna ma sa / shākyisbyo/(1ltos nas/ /snang bzhin du stong yang stong bzhin snang / /ngo mtshar ba'i srid zhi'i ltad mo 'char/ /dus nam zhig phyi nang rgyu rkyen gyi/ /mthu nus pa bslu ba med mthong tshe/ /'bras tshogs tsam 'dus tsam rten 'brel gyis/ /tshugs mi thub rdzun gyi rang mtshang ston/ /dgra dwangs ma bdag 'dzin nyon mongs mthus/ /gnas mtho ris ngan song bde sdug sogs/ /bden rang ba'in cung zad yod min kyang / /kun rmi lam 'khrul ba dzi bzhin 'char/ /thabs shes rab zung 'brel tshogs bsags la/ /sgo du mas rtag tu 'bad pa na/ /skyabs bslu med sangs rgyas go 'phang rna/ /rdzun sgyu ma ji bzhin thob snang 'char/ /zhes sogs so/ /'di skabs kyi gsung bshad yongs rdzogs jin bris su byas pa rgyas bsdus kha shas rang gis dngos su yang mthong zhing / shin tu rgyas pa shog bu lnga brgya tsam longs pa zhig kyang yod par skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas gsungs/ gong gsal slob mardzikhrod nas kha shas kyi rnam thar slar gdan rabs kyi khrod nas 'chad par 'gyur la/ 'be bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho ni/ting nge 'dzin gye gnas cha brtan cing stong nyid kyi lta ba rnyed pa zhig yin par gleng / gnas cha brtan skabs 'ga' zhig tu bkra shis 'khyil gyi go sar dbyibs bkod sogs de ci lta ba bzhin la/ rgyu rin po che'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i zhing khams lta na sdug pa zhig yang yang shar ba khri chen mchog gi sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang bstan rgyan par zhus pa la don la de bzhirnaganas pa rang nyid kyis kyang gzigs tshul gsungs/ 'ga' zhig gis mo brtag sigs zhus na rlung cung zad re bzung nas mthongasnang ltar

296 da da / gsal bar bshad pa dang / chung dus rmi lam du sbrul chen po zheg gis rang gi lus khyur mid du byas kyang mgo phyi rol tu thon yod pa rmis nas kun mkhyen gong ma la zhus par ha ha mgo yang mid na 'dir mchog gi dngos grub wob rgyu yin pa la gsungs/ 'di rnams bdag gi bla ma khri chen bsod nams grags pa'i zhal nas dngos su thos/ a ru hor chen du phebs skabs slar dgon par phebs mi thub pa'i mtshan ma gsal bar sha ra yang / bstan pa'i don yin gsungs nas spro bzhin du phebs/ bsdusagrwa gagar rtsom dang bcas dgon pa gsar 'debs mdzad pa rim gyis mdo sngags kyi grwa tshang du mar 'phel ba da lta gnas bzhin pa lags so/ / gser kha ba dang mkhyen rab gnyis kyang mgon chos 'jigs gsum gyi man ngag la nang byan chud pa bsnyen sgrub rtags thon pa sogs kyis ching wang gong ma rnams kyis bkur 'dug la gnyis ka khri rgan tshang gi gdan sa 'dzin par re ba'i chos srid kyi 'gying bag can yin par snang / bdag gi bla ma snyan rgyud kyi mnga' bdag ngag dbang grags pa rin po che dbus su ma byon gong dpon slob gser kha ba'i drung du 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang / rim gnyis cha lag dang bcas pa gsan/ dbus su byon nas 'bras sbungs su bzhugs skabs/ bla ma byams pa rin po che'i drung nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi rim gnyis kyi khrid smin rgyas yang yang zhus shing / rwa sgrong rgyal ba sngags rams pa'i drung nas 'khrul 'khor sogs kyi khrid zhib rgyas gsan pas/ bdag gi bla ma de yang sa dbus gtsang du bzhugs na 'de rnams las mi dman pa 'dug snyam pa shar gsu ngas/

gedad —rjiwad 297skyabs mgon rdo rje tāchang mdo smad du byon ma thag tu bdag gi bla ma rin rtsopo che nas sngar dbus su ma byon gong du gser kha dpon slob rin po cher chos 'brel yod tshul sogs dang bcas sku mdun du 'gro rgyu'i dgongs pa zhus pas thugs shin tu dgyes nas de legs po byung 'dug khyed rang yang dang yang du song la sku gong ma nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag sngar thob pa rnams dag ther/ ma thob pa rnams nan tan du zhus nas zhib mor slobs/ nga la yang dri rtog byed rgyu mang po yod gsung nas mtshams 'dri'ikha btags kyang bskur ba gnang bka' bzhin du khong phar phebs tshur rtso —phebs skabs rdo rje 'chang nas man ngag gsum dang / phyagasnalen gyi skor du mar dogs gcod bka' 'dri yang yang bskur ba la sku gong ma sdib sras gnyis kyi gsung rgyun ltar bka' lan gnad du smin pa yang yang phul bas thugs 'phrog pa byung gsungs/ rje gserakha ba de nyid dgung lo gya bzhi'am gya drug gi skabs/ rdo rje 'chang phyogs der phebs skabs shig ched du gnyer nas mjal bar phebs/ tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi skyabs 'jug sogs zhus/ de rjes shig bdag gi bla ma mdun du phebs bar da lo sku phyogs yang 'dir phebs nas nga rang mjal rgyu byung bas nga skal ba bzang / srad rgyud rdo rje 'chang nas brgyud pa'i man ngag phran tshegs khyod la byin yod pa 'di gzhan la dgos pa med/ slar bkra shis 'khyil la 'phrod thabs re rem zhes gsungs par bdag gi bla ma nyid kyi zhal nas yang dang yang du thos so/ rnga ba chos skyong dang gser kha ba gnyis rgya mkhar dgon gyi khri la yang

298 gdalha da —ḍa—pa bzhugs/ lhag bar chos skyong rgya mtshos sku ma 'das kyi bar du bo ti lnga zhalaladon mdzad/ dbu 5ra 'dul mdzod rnam 'grel bcas kyi tshig ṭīka blo nas thon/ 'jam mgon khri rin po che nas mdo sngags gang gsung la zin bris mdzad/ stag tshang lha mor yang mtshan nyid kyi 'chad ‘nyan yun ring du bskyangs/ 'dul khrims mig —'bras ltar srung zhing zhi dul gyi kun spyod dman cha lhur len paspezhigayin par snang / rnga ba go thob kyang rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇḍi tar bgrang du rung ba tsam dang /gsung rab kyi yig 'bru re re la dpyad nas spyod lam gang yin de'i ngang la nyin zhag zugs du ma 'gro ba dang / ri mo dang pi wang sogs rol sgeg du ma bslabs/ lhag par chu 'gram du chu gnyer gyi ri mo brtag pa dang /tha wang gi sgra la yang yang nyan pas lta ba rnyed g.yin zhegabee ri dpon slob mabu stobs rgya mtshos gsungs shing pi wang de rten du yun ring bzung naspo slob ma zhig la gnang 'dug /spyod lam gzhan dang mi mthun pa 'ba' zhig mdzad pas 'phral snang la mi gral du mi tshud pa 'dra yang don gyi gting ga la dpog /phyis su skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi dus u cu mi chin nas skyes shing bkra shis 'khyil du chos grwar zhugs nas bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas dang 'chad rtsod rtsom ga sum la rnam dpyod thogs pa med pas nges par baṇḍi ta zhes smos su rung ba ku shri ngag dbang skal bzang lus kyi spyod lam dang ngag gi smra brjod 'di dang cha 'dra bar/ mkhas blun gnyis ka ngo mtshar ba'i gtam du ma can yin kyang skabs su ma babs pas ma bris bstan 'dzin spya yu ma sdig gnayothams cad lablo gros rgyas pa dang /

gad — ḍa dnghanee karas 20skyertsod ngag gi rigs lam smra ba la 'gran zla med cingapyingo mtshar ba'i bsngags brjod/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas yang yang gnang ba dngos su thos shing / gong gsal be ban bstan 'dzin dang / khazugya ong sha zer ba'i dge bshes dang / 'di gsum ga bkra shis 'khyil gyi grwa rgyun sgo mang grwa tshang du 'jug pa'i thog ma yin la gsum ga'ang spobasapa mtho zhing rtsod rigs rno ba sogs kyis bkra shis sgo mang gi 'dzin grwa gong 'og gang du yang sus kyang lung dang rigs pa'i sgo nas zil gyis gnon ma nus pa lta bur song bas sde 'di rigs lam smra ba la thogs pa medahopa'i grags snyan gyi thog ma de nas byung ngo / / de dus dge bshes gcig khas len shor tshab chenajipo byung nas be ban gyis mjing ba zhon par/dku dge bshes kyis myug bro bo khyod mer song /nga'i ske na paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag mdud yod ces smras pha la/ be ban gyis paṇa chen rin po tshe'i phyag mdud kyi steng du po ti lnga bzhag mi chog pa e red ces smras pa phyis su rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtshos gsan nas de ngo ma mtshar ba 'dug de 'dra byas pa khyad gsod ma red/ po ti lnga'i gzengs bstod yin pas shin tu bden zhes gsungs zer/ bltan 'dzin rgya yu mas khri chen 'di nyid kyi rnam thar brtsams pa'i mjug tu/ mgon gsung ngag las 'ong nam mkha'i lcags/ /gcig tu bral rdo rje rtse brgya bas/ /gdon bdag 'dzin gnad bsnun thal bar—byas / /blta dka' zhing rtogs dka'i btsun pas smras/ /byas 'dug cing lus ngag yid gsum 'phrul skyen pa'i ngo mtshar gyi gtam mang du snong / kha gya dge bshes spyang

300 mngon shes yod par grags la/ mngon shes la las dang skyes thob kyi mngon shes dang / rdzas dngasngags la rten pa dang / sgom byung sogs da nga / sgom byung la yang rigs mang du yod mod/ thos bsam gyi ngos nas bka' pota lnga la nang byan chud pa dang / sdom gsum mig 'bras ltar srung ba dang / 'pho ba la rtsal thon pa'i 'bras rtags kun gyis gleng zhing / zab mo lta ba las brtsams pa'i mgur ma yang yod 'dug la/'di dag dang durtswamatshungs pa'i mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi dge bshes khri 'di nyid kyi slob mar gyur pa bsngags par 'os pa du ma zhig yod kyang / skabs don sgrib par mthong nas ma bris la/ gzhan dang gzhan du yang shes par 'argyur ro/ /de dag ni zhar byung gi tshul du smos pa'o/ /da ni dkyus la 'jug ste/ 'di dus 'dul mdzod la dbu phar lta bu'i 'chad nyan ha cang dmar ba zhig ma byung rpā ltar snang la/ brtsi bzhag yongs rdzogs btang ba'i gtam yang ma tshor mod/ brtsi bzhag gang gnang la gsung bshad mdzad pa'i zin bris thor bu ni mang du snang ngo // sprosdus snya yang phyis kyi 'dzin grwa gnyis tsam ma gtogs pa la brtsi bzhag yongs rdzogs song yang / lo re bzhin bsdus grwa re thugs thog nas gnang ba skyor dpon rang rang gis zin bris byas pas bsdus grwa yongs rdzogs nyer bdun yod kyang da lta mi 'dra ba gsum bzhi tsam las gzhan rnams dpe rgyun dkon par snang ngo / /chos grwa'i gsung chos dang /chos mtshams skabs su bka' chos ched gnyer gyis gnang ba la mdo sde

gdan do byu da 301rgyan/ rgyud bla ma/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ chos nyid rnam 'byed/mngon pa kun btus/ spyod 'jug bshes springs/ bzhi brgya pa/slob springs/ bslab btus/ rnam 'grel rtsa ba/ 'grel ba don gsal/ brgyad stong 'grel chen/ 'bum ṭīka gser 'phreng / rnam bshad snying bo rgyan/ rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal/ legs bshad snying po/ stong thun skalabazang mig 'byed/ byang chub lam sgron/ lam rim che chung / kun gzhi'i dka' 'grel/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i rnam bshad/ byang chub gzhung lam/ thub bstan byi dor/ 'grel ba bzhi sbrags/ bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho/ sbas don kun gsal/rigalnga gdan rdzogs/ rim lnga gsal sgron/ sngags rim mo/rnagagazhag rim pa'i rnam bshad/ 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim chen mo/kun rig ṭīka chen sogs kyi bshad pa bstsal pas phal cher la jin bris re yang snang / rje gong ma'i gsung rab po ti lnga'i bshad pa sngar ltar dang / drang nges rnam 'byed/ bsam gzugs chen mo/ tshig gsal stong thun/ 'jigs byed chos 'byung / grub mtha' chen mo rnams kyi bshad lung / gzhan yang gsang 'jigs/ kun rig gshed dmar sogs kyi0dbang / snar thang brgya rtsa dang bka' chen bcu gsum sogs kyi rje gnang / rje gong maligasung phal cher gyi lung / lam rim dang bskyed rdzogs zhi khro sbrags sgrub sogs kyi khrid/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'khrul 'khor/ gtor mardzi'akhrul 'khor lcags mkhar du grags ba/ gtor sgrub/ drag po'i gtor chen/ mgon porigatad

302 gad 'don dang gyuzhija/ skyongarī gi lartswakhrigs/ gzung sa 'bul/ neb gnas/dkyil 'khor so so'i thig tshon gyi phyag lenasog sa stong gsum gser gyis bkangakhuyang gzhal bar dba' ba'i chos kyi bka' drin rgya cher bstsal pa las byang phyogs mdo smad kyi yul du bub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshad sgrub kyi srol ches cher gsal bar gyur te bstan pa byang nas byang du dar ba'i lung bstan gyi bden pa mngon du gyur pa la sus kyang bsnyon du ske med do/ / lar de dus kyi grwa rgan phal cher kun mkhyen yab sras kyi mdzad par mig lhos kyis tsogarību pa'i sbyangs yon lhur len pa dang / rje 'dis phebasalam du zhal lud cig dor ba la 'dzin grwa gnyisalakyis 'tshang ka byas pa'i lo rgyus sogs kyis mtshon bla ma sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kyis rnam thar bzang po'i rjes su 'brang ba las gang byung la 'gram chu mi ldang ba'i chos kyi rjes 'brang gi dad tshugartswashin tu brtan cing /rjo chos gang gsung la dzig sbyor legs nyes ji ltar yang rang rang gis mi brjed pa'i dran thor byas pa'i zin bris shinartatu mang la/ chos la don gnyer che zhing 'dod yon la mi dgyes pas grwa ba rang ba zhin pa zhig la ja lan 'du gcig byung na shin tu ngo tsha dgos pa'i mtshab du 'dzin pa yin snang ste/ snod kyi skyon gsum dang bral ba'i slob ma bzang po'i rnam thar du shes par bya'o/ /khyad par du bka' gdams glegs bam las kyang / 'dod yon bdud kyi g.yab mo 'byung / /bsam gtan chags sdang dag la 'chor/ /zhes pa sogs bka' gdams gsar rnying gi bstan pa 'di la longs spyod

gad dgorwas/ 303kyis gnod tshabs che ba dang / yang dgos (sgos) dge ldan pa'i bshad sgrub la longasaspyod kyis gnod pa'i lung bstan shin tu mang la/ mdo dbus kyi chos sde che phra du mar nyams chags (chag ) mang po byung ba phal cher skegyi rkyen longs spyod kyis byas par mig gi yul du gyur pa ltar yin kyang shes mkhan shin tu dkon par snang ngo / /rje bdag nyid chen pos kyang de 'dra la dgongs nas dga' ldan du mchod rten brtsigs pa'i 'og tu lhung bzed kha sbrubs te longs spyod la mnan pa mdzad pa yin snang bas rjes 'jug rnams kyis cung zad bag tsha ba byed dgos so/ /'chad nyan de ltar mdzad pa'i zhar la rje rang nyid chos grwar bzhugs nas 'dzin grwa gong 'og bsre ba dang / 'dzin grwa gcig cha gnyis su byas nas rtsod pa dang / dam bca' ba 'dzin grwa gong 'og nas len pa sogs rtsod grwa 'phel ba'i thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas rtsod pa byed bcug ste rgyal pham shan 'byed pa dang / rtags gsal ring po ma byas na don mi rdzogs pa mi/ rigs pa ma byang ba'i rtags yin gsungs nas rtags gsal nyog ring 'phen pa dang / grong tshig gis 'phen pa sogs la bka' bkyon dang /rtags gsal thung ngu dngos gtsang zhing don rdzogs pa 'phen pa la bsngags brjod gnang ba dang / thal skad gtong lugs/ 'khor gsum skor lugs/ thal mo deb lugs slob pa sogs dag ther nan can mdzad pas de dus kyi rigs smra rnams rtsod pa bdar sha chod rpā dang / phas rgol zil gyis gnon pa'i rnam 'gyur rtog ge ba'i spyi lugs drang bor srong ba zhig snang ngo / /dpe cha 'dzin skyor slob gnyer gyi gzhi med du tremi rung ba yin gsungs

304 gi2kairab ——da nas rting bskul cher mdzad cing / rgyugs 'bul mi rnams la gnang sbyin dang dgyes pa dpag med mdzad pas slob gnyer pa drag shos phal cher gyis dbu phar yongs rdzogs re phul ba dang / phyis su gcig la gcig 'gran gyi tshul du 'dzin grwa yongs rdzogs kyis yig cha'i phar phyin skabs dang po sogs rgyugs 'bul srol byung ba la phreng ba chab ril gong zor sogs mngon chen gyi 'gyed cha snyoms pa gnang bas 'dzin grwa de dang des rgyugs sprad par tshang mas shes pa cig (zhig ) yod ces grwa rgan rnams gleng ste bstan pa'i dmigs rkyen la dgongs pa'i lhag bsam mtshon byed kyi rnam thar ro// snga phyir bstan pa spyi sger gyi rim gror lcags mkhar/ gtor sgrub/'khrul 'khor sogs man ngag ltar gang zhib mdzad nas lag len mang du byas shing / khyad par dgon par rgyun bstar gyi lcags mkhar dang gtor sgrub kyi phyag len la rje gong mar lan bzhi lnga re ma zhus pa med ces gsungs/ de dus sgrub gtor 'khyag la shor na 'tshub ltas yin gsungs nas rim gro sgrub pa dang / ril sgrub sogs kyi dus bum pa drod yal na grib kyis phog pa yin gsungs nas khrus gsol byed par grwa rgan mang po las dngos su thos/ phyis su sku gshegs khar sku mdun pa rnams la/ sku phyogs nas bstan pa'i don du lcags mkhar gcig bsgrubs na yig brgya 'bum gyi phan yon 'byung gsungs pa e yin nam gsungs/ yin lags zhus pas/ de bzhin mngon du gyur gsungs/ tshogs 'don phal cher sasar tshugs kyi skabs dbu mdzad gnang ba yin 'dug cing / 'don rta dbyangs sogs nyams skyon byung tshe dbyangs chags la ched gnyer gyis

da wa rda——kai—༷ rda —kasdo rda 306phebs te bskyar bcos mdzad pa dang / 'don rta mi nyams pa'i ched du dbu mdzad byas nas yang yang gsungs par mdzad pas skujimadun du sil snyan rgyun du 'jog dgos pa'i srol dus phyis bar du yod la/ rnam thar gsol 'debs dang kun rig gnyis ma gtogs tshogs 'don 'grig lam gang la yang rje gong mas zhal bkod ma mdzad pa'i rang bzo cung zad kyang med ces zhal nas gsungs/ kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal gzigs kyi snapab rgyun du yod kyang / bar skabs shig cung zad mi gsal ba byung ba tshogs 'don de gnyis tshugs pa sogs la thugs dogs mdzad nas sde khri rin po che la gsungs pa dang / de'i rkyen gyis rten 'brel chen mor mchan bu btab pa sogs rgyud pa dpon slob shes rab rdo rjes gsungs pa thos te/ e ma legs tshogs rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rten 'bre'akhacung zad kyang ma 'phyugs pa 'di shin tu gal che'o/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i dbang du byas na yang / mgon khang / byams khang / sku gdung lha khang gsum dang / 'du khang gi steng shod bcas kyi ngo zhal/ logs ris/ shing tshon/ gser ris dang bcas pa/ mgon khang du 'jigs byed mgon chos bcas kyi 'bag sku 'bras spungs sngags khang gi 'jigs byed sogs dang cha mtshungs pa/ rnga spub/ sil snyan/ the ma ru/ ka bā la sogs mchod rdzas dang gtor cha/ byams khang du nye ba'i sras brgyad dang rje rin po che/ mar me mdzad bcas kyi lder sku khang tshad re dang / chu zom gang re 'gro ba'i mchod rkong brdun tshar sogs mchod rdzas/ sku gdung lha khang du dpon ju nang gi gdung rus la 'jam dbyangs

306 garwa—tshod sa kyi par sku /btab pa sogs nang rten du bzhugs pa'i lha babs mchod rten dngul srang sum brgya las bzhengs pa dang / rje gong ma'i sku gdung gi mdun du mar me'i mchod rkong stong tshar/ tshe 'bar dang yon chab kyi snod du chu zom gang lhag 'gro ba'i bdun tshar mang bo/ /mar me mtshan thub kyi rkong bu brgya tshar gnyis/ 'du khang du yang rnga spub/ dung chen/ rkang gling / sil snyan sogs marngod rdzas/ gtsang khang gsum ga'i mthongs khebs pa'i gos chen gyi bla re khyad 'phags mang po dang / 'du khang du gos yug 'phen gyi bla re kwa bar sum cu khebs pa/ yig cha'i dbu phar gnyis/rnam 'grel/ 'dul ba/ grub mtha' chen mo/ sde bdun rgyan/legs bshad snying bo/ bsam gzugs chen mo/ drang nges rnam 'byed kyi mtha' dpyod chen mo sogs kyi par gsar brkos/ spyi sor yang thab cha/ 'jog rdzas/ su rug zhing sa bcas kyi gzhi bzung ba sogs phyag rjes rlabs che bar snang na yang deb rnying gi rigs ma mthong bas zhib par bri ma nus mod 'on kyang grwa rgan rnams kyi ngag rgyun la kun mkhyen rin po che zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs su rgyun ja bla brang nas gtongatreb gnang yang phyis su dpon po rnams phar rtsod tshur rtsod sogs kyi phra nyag la brten nas khri rin po che 'di nyid kyis lo mang po'i bar du rgyun ja btang / bla ma rjes ma rnams kyis rgyun ja gtong dka' gsungs nas mkhan po no mon han gyi skazims khang gyan bcu gnyis ma chos dbyings lta bur yod pa spyi khang du sbyar/ thab cha dang lo gsum bzhi'i rgyun ja 'dang nges kyi ja mar dang bcas gung ru rab 'byams pa 'phags pa tshe ring spyi so'i sde bar bzhag

da wa da da gakarda——ba dardad — 307seng cho zer mkhan sogs kyi dud tshang lnga khyim gzhi dang bcas gsar du bskrun te mdzo rta lug gsum gyi su rug bzhag rgyab tshang gis lung gar thang phul ba dang / rdo rgod dpon pos rdo sbal thang phul ba gnyis kar rang rang so so la rta sga stan srab gsum re dang gza' mi tshang ma la gyon pa re gnang / phyag rdzas kyi steng nas mang ja bzhi re btang ste tshogs chen nas lho sgo re gnang / phyis su sku 'da' khar sa 'di tshor do dam dang sa 'debs re chags nas phog thebs yo nga thabs—gyis gsungs pa ltar lha sde so so rim gyis chags pa yin zhes gleng / rigs grwa nyi shu rtsa gsum btang zhing / ma cig gi lung bstan ltar rje rang nyid kyis sbyin bdag mdzad nas bstan pa spyi'i rim gror tshogs nas bka' 'a gyur gsung sgrogs tshar du ma dang / snga phyir ya ma rā dza dung phyur gnyis/ shrīḥkhyuḥdang shā sa na/ khro bcu gsum dung phyur re/ tsasnyo ma dung phyur gnyis/ mgon chos kyi bskang ba khri tshar mang po bsgrubs pa sogs chos srid zung 'brel gyi sgo nas skyong bar mdzad/ khyad par bstan pa rnam dag yun ring du gnas pa la med du mi rung ba'i mtshan nyid kyi 'chad nyan gting tshugs par mdzad pas bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab cing / sku bskung ba'i skabs sogs su yang ngas 'chad nyan ma thub par gson bor bsdad pa'i dgos pa chung gsungs nas brtsi bzhag re re chag med dang /gsung bshad sngar rgyun ltar lo gcig gi bar du gnang / 'di skabs zhabs phyir rlom pa 'ga' zhig gis sku gzugs kyi nyams grwa mang la bsgribs (bsgrib )dgos zer nas yol ba'i phag nas brtsi ba zhag gnang bcug pas

308 da rda—/—rten 'brel cung zad nyes par sems/ rje 'di nyid byang phyogs mdo smad kyi ljongs su kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i legs bshad spel ba la 'phrin las 'gran zla med pa'i thugs bskyed kyi mthu grub par sus kyang bsnyon du med la/ ma cig lab sgron gyi lung gis kyang zin pa'i skyes mchog bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yin kyang khron pa'i ruyosbal gyi rnam thar 'dzin pa'i zhabs phyi re gnyis kyis 'phrin las kyi sgo bkag pa mang du snang mod kyang spro dgos ma mchis/ de ltar bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che zin nas sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs pa na dgung lo re gcig pa sa rta hor blo dang po'i tshes nyer lnga'inyin ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te zhi bar gshegs so/ /'dir mdor bsdus te bkod la/ zhib par dngos slob blo bzang don grub pas mngod pa'i rnam thar dad pa'irnasnye gzhes bya ba cigayod pas der shes parobya'o/ / smras pa/ nges 'byung shugs kyis tshangs spyod brtul zhugs brtan/ /gus rtags (rtag )ba rtson pas bshes gnyen zhabs pad bsten/ /gzhung lugs mang thos mkhas pa'i rtser son pa'i/ /snyan pa rang bzhin gyis ni 'brel bsarimadzes / /e ma'o rnam mang yon tan mdzod la mnga' brnyes kyang / /khengs dregs chos brgyad rang don 'khri ba nye bar spangs/ /rtag tu bshes gnyen dam pa'i bka' lung gtsug bsten te/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la gcig tu gzhol ba 'di rmad byung / /chos kun sgyu ma ltar gzigs kyang / /'dul khrims mig 'bras ltar srung ba'i/ /tshogs gnyis spyod pa'i drang

gdan ba——dasos 309srong 'di/ /nye bar 'khor ram gzhan su zhig /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs so// gdan rabs gsum pa sde khri blo bzang don grub/gdan rabs gsum pa gsang bdag grub pa'i dbang po sde khri rin po che blo bzang don grub dpal bzang po ni/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu glang gi lo khri ka'i sa'i cha lan kyo zhes par ltag ring gi rus las yab — dge bsnyen zer ba'i sras su 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas gzhan gyis ma bskul bar rten gyi drung du mchod 'bul phyag 'tshal sogs rnam dkar la brtson pa dang / sprang po mthong tshe spyan chab phyung ste rang gi bza' btung bgo bsha' byed pa sogs dam pa'i spyod pa lhun gyis grub pa zhig yod par grags/ lo lnga drug gi dus khu bo rab 'byams pa zhig yod pa'i rtsar klog slob par la mo bde chen dgon du phebs/ klog sogs brda sbyar ba tsam gyis mkhyen cing / khyad par 'jigs byed/ chos rgyal/gsang bdag dmag zor ma rnams kyi sku 'dra mthong na yang lha gzhan mthong ba las lhag pa'i dga' tshor skye ba dang sgrub thabs gtor chog sogs kyang bklags pa tsam gyis blo la zin pa sogs tshe rabs snga mar 'brel che ba'i rtags mtshan chung ngu'i dus nas mang la/ gsol ba btab na yang byin rlabs gzhan las myur ba zhig yod ces zhal nas gsungs/ rab byungasmodang dge tshul gyi mkhan slob gang yin ma nges kyang bsnyen rdzogs ni

310 gad dmu kun mkhyen rin po cher zhus pa yin snang ste bsngo ba'i skabs su don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te bdag gi mkhan rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang brtson 'grus pa'i zhal snga nas zhes gsung gi yod par dngos slob rnams gsungs/ bslab khrims mig 'bras ltar bsrung zhing rab byung dang dge tshul gzhan nyes spyod la zhugs na khyod ngo mi tsha'am khrel bdas byed pa dang / tshangs spyod kyi brtul zhugs dor ba'i khyim pa 'ga' zhig gi dri la 'dzem nas sna bkab pas 'ga' zhig gis khrel gtam yang byas zhes grags/ mnal lam du mi dkar po zhig gis khyod dbus gtsang la 'gro zhes khrid nas 'di lha saligatsug lag khang yin zhes sogs mang po zhig ston par mdzad pas phyis su bkod pa sogs de dang 'dra bar 'dug gsungs te gnas chung dgra lha 'od ldan dkar pos bskul btab par mngon/ de nas bzung ste mthong tshudzide dag rgyun du 'char ba dang /man la lam du ser 'bras dge gsum yang yang mthong ba sogs kyi rkyen byas nas dbus su 'gro 'dod shugs drag po skyes kyang mthun rkyen 'grig dka' tsam byung bar rje rang nyid kyi sring mo zhig gis mthun rkyen gang drag bsgrubs te dgung lo bcu drug gi dus 'phags yul gnyis pa dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du byon nas mkhas pa gdengs can bye ba'i rol mtsho bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar zhugs/ smra ba'i dbang rgyug bya bral dge 'dun phun tshogs dge rgan du bsten/ rgyal sras chen po don grub rgya mtsho'i drung du bsdus grwa'i tshig bzhag thog mar mnos/ phar phyin yang bla ma 'di la gsan zhing po ti lhag ma rnams chos rje tā dbon pa kun dga' 'od zer la

gdanangab—didangos 311gsan pas bla ma 'di gnyis kyi mtshan smos skabs 'jam dbyangs bla ma zhes gusu pa chen po mdzad par dngos slob rnams gsungs/ blo 'dzin sogs nyin gcig la 'di cam 'dzin dgos snyam pa phal cher 'dzin thub pa'i thugs rab 'gran zla med par grags che zhing / zhal nas kyang nged rang 'dzin bzang zhing brjed ngas chung bas chos mtshams skabs su nyi ma kha shas re las chos mtshams yongs rdzogs la dpe cha 'dzin mi dgos shing skyor sbyangs la ha cang sdug rus byed dgos pa ma byung zhes gsungs/ skabs skabs su mdo smad nas char gos su bsnams pa'i 'phying (phying ) ser zhig yod pa mnabs dbu zhwa zhwa snam zhig yod pa leb 'jog byas te steng g.yogs med sa zhig tu skyor sbyangs mtshan phud re mdzad/ de'i tshe mtshan ril bor char babs kyang ji mi snyam par bzhugs pas grogs mched cig gis khyod kyis rgyun du skyor sbyangs mi byed skyor sbyangs byed skabs char la yang mi 'dzem pa ci yin dris pas/ bya ba gang brtsams mthar 'don pa ya rabs kyi lugs yin gsungs/ thugs 'dzin dang 'dzin rgya grwa thog de na rje 'di dang mnyam pa med par grags pa don la yang gnas pa yin 'dug ste/ dbu ma'i yig cha mi 'dra ba bdun tsam blo la bzung yang ha cang sems tshim pa zhig ma byung phyis su dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod blo la bzung bas cung zad go ba byung zhes zhal nas gsungs pa dang / mdzod kyang mi 'dra ba du ma thugs 'dzin dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta nyi ma bdun la thugs 'dzin mdzad par khong nyid kyis gsungs par skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas dngos su thos/ de ltar mkhyen dpyod

312 — — gidarda—— ———rda 'gran zla med pa'i grags snyan gyi dbyar rnga gang gi snyan dbang rma bya dgyes pa'i dus ston du gyur pa na sgo mang dpon slob chos kyi rje kun dga' 'od zer ram 'od zer rgya mtshor grags pas bka' nan mdzad pa ltar dgung lo nyer lnga pa la lha sa smon lam gyi grwa skor mdzad/ de'itshe rtog ge mgo mkhregs du mas klan ka tshol bar blo gros kyi rtsal sprugs te nan tar 'bad spyang / dmatrebaca' rdo rje ri bo la lung rigs kyi nyag phran khu tshur bzhin du gyur cing / skye bas thob pa'i rnam dpyod cang shes kyi rta mchog la'agran bzod kyi 'o dod dbyangs su gyer ba'i rmongs rtul mgrin bzang gi tshogayo rnams rang mtshang mngon par gsal ba'i khang bur dal gyis yibs te/phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs thugebastan gangs ri'i rgyan du che ba gcig byung snang ngo / /de skabs yul mi rnams nas rang yul du 'byon dgos pa'i yi ge nan can phul kyang / nye du dang thag bsring ste sgrub pa sha stag cig byed par dgongs nas pha yul du mi 'byon par dam bca' mdzad/ phyis su bkra rshas 'khyil du bzhugs skabs kyang yul nas yang yang gdan 'dren zhus kyang zhadzobazhes tsam yang ma mdzad pa la/ grwa rgan rnams nas yul du mi phebs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhus pas/ rje mi las/ pha yul bdud kyi btson ra yin/ /thar bar dka'o myur du bros/ /zhes gsungs yod ang 'ching ba je dam du ma btang ba yin gsungs te/ nor gyi don du chos gtong zhing / nye dulidon du srog gtong ba'i dam pa 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar dang 'gal ba ltag sprod kho na'o//
