gid rna da sad 313de ltar dben pa'i ri khrod cig tu gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas te tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i thugs 'dun yod kyang / de dus grwa sa grwa tshang so sor skyid sdug gan bub kyi res 'jog bar 'gyang med pa byung ba dang / khong chos srid gang nas kyang mkhyen rgya che zhing gting mi dpog pa / ngang tshugs brtan cing bya ba la mi skyo ba/ kun dang 'grogs mkhas shing blo gtad mi bslu ba sogs rgyal po chen po'i dgongs blon du 'os pa'i kha thabs can zhig yin stabs klu 'bum kham tshan dang sgo mang grwa tshang spyisdzabya ba thams cad rang nyid gcig bu'i thog tu babs pa 'dra ba cig gis gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrel por med pa'i tshul du song ste ri khrod kyi thugs dgongs thog tu ma khel/ de dus 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag rlabs che zhing phugs brtan pa/ byed tshul thabs mkhas shing gzhan dbang du mi 'gro ba sogs kyis sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos kyang thugs dgyes po mdzad de gzhung gi tshogs 'du'i gras su nan gyis 'jog pa gnang zhing / rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i sku mdun pa yang byed dgos byung ste/ tsa na ka rgyal po'i lugs kyi bstan bcos las/ bya ba ma yin mi byed cing / /bshams pa mkhos la phebs pa dang / /yul gyi 'dod pa thag bsring ba'i/ /skyes bu mkhas pa sus mi bkur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// bkra shis sgo mang gi sde ba yang rgyun ring du mdzad cing / de dus bod skyong lha bzang han gyis rje gong ma rigs kyi cod pan du bkur bzhin pa dang / rje 'di ba lha bzang gi blon po gnang chen lta bur thugs

da dzisdo /ka ka ——gekashaṃ——/gtsigs che ba bcas rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i thugs rje rīdang / rje 'di'i thabs mkhas zung 'brel la brten nas sgo mang la mchod gzhi (sa/zhis ) mang po byung bar grags che ste/ dam pa dpon du bskos gyur na/don grubha pa dang bde skyid 'thob/ /ces pa'i dam pa'i rnam thar ro/ /sgo mang4 gi mchod gzhis mi ser la lta rtog byed skabs ngo 'tshab mngags bzhin pa yin kyang / ri skabs —3shig gas po rta zhang gnyis la rang nyid phebs 'dod skyes nas phebs pas/ rta zhang chos rje'i gzims khang zhig song bar thugs shin tu skyo ba zhig byung / tshur phebus nas rje gong ma'i drung du mjal bas/ khyod kyi khang ba ga 'dra 'dug gsungs/ nged kyi khang ba gang yin zhus pas/ rta zhang chos rje'i khang ba de yin mod gsungs/ de ngas mi shes zhus pas/ rta (nang chos rje ni 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i bu chen chos rje rang gi sku tshab tu rgya nag la phebs nas gong ma'i lung dang las kas mtho ba zhig yin/ khyod de'i skye ba yin par 'dug ces gsungs/ rta zhang chos rje'i khang ba'i nye 'khor na mnan pa zhig yod pas bdag la gnod pa'i nyams gzigs nas rta zhang du sdod pa'i mtshan mo der kun mkhyen mchog nas phyir bzlog mdzad snang zhes sde khri rin po che nyid nas bdag gi khu bo yon tan seng ge la gsungs 'dug cersā dusta 'khor dpon slob ngag dbang don 'grub pa'i zhal nas thos so/ /sde ba ra bzhugs skabs su yang chos min gyi g.yeng ba'i 'khor lo ma bskor bar rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che tshadku bzhi ljags klog dang / dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod thugs la bzung nas bsags sbyangs dang dpyad pa

gad wabasadadza 315da mdzad pas blo skyed che bar byung zhes dngos slob mang por zhal nas gsungs/ dgung lo nyer brgyad pa la rdzegong ma sgo mang gi khrir bzhug sa pa'i phyag mdzod byed dgos byung ste/ sgo mang gi sde ba dang zung 'brel mdzad/ de skabs da phyin chad dpon slob 'di 'dra dka' bas khyed rang tshos grwa tshang rang la po ti yongs rdzogs kyi yig cha rtsom rgyu'i zhu 'bul gyis zhes dka' rab 'byams spyi la sgron btang ste de dag gis zhus pa'i ting mar rang nyid nas snyan bskul nar mar zhus par brten kun mkhyen rin po ches mdzod 'dul phar phyin gyi yig cha 'di dag gsung rtsom gnang bas yig cha 'di'i sgo nas nga yang khyed rang tshor drin che zhes gsungs te bstan pa rin po che thugs la bcang ba'i rnam thar du shes so/ /dgung lo so bzhi pa me khyi'i lo kun mkhyen ri na po che'i zhal nas da lta mi tsho tshab tshub che bar 'dug pas khyod kyis dge bskos gnyer ba zung 'brel byed dgos/ der ma zad rjes sor nga rang tsho gang la 'gro dgos kyi tshod yang mi thig pas nga'i bsam don thams cad khyod kyis sgrub dgos pa zhig yong zhes bka' phebs pas sum sbrel byed dgos pa byung / gsung dang mdzad spyod 'di dag la dpags zing cha che ba'i skabs de dag tu rje gong ma la myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sogs bstan srung du ma'i gzigs snang rgyun mi 'chad par byung 'dug pas de dag gis de ltar lung bstan pa yin nam snyam// de skabs rgya nag nas sku zhabs tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho gdan 'dren du 'ongs par rje gong mas ni/ nam mkha'i nyi zla bzang po dang mthun na/ gling bzhi'i dbus na mngon par mtho la brjid/ /bzlog na dus mtha'i me yis rgyal

316 gdalha da5 / khams 'tshig /ri rab srid par bcas pa chags 'jigs (chag 'ji ga )yong / /zhes 'jam dbyangs gong ma poligasung dang ma bstun na dga' ldan pho brang gi bstan srid la chag 'jig 'ong ba'i lung bstan dang /gzhan yang dbus su mtshon gyi bskal ba 'char ba dang / sa la khrag gi char baji'abab pa sogs kyis lung bstan mang po'i dus la babs 'gro bar 'dug pas rgya nag rgyal po'i dgongs bzhed dang bstun na legs tshul gsungs kyang / se 'bras so solilas sna gros mthun gyis sku zhabs rgya nag tu byon na bod su la brten zer nas rgyal ba rin po che 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs te grwa mang gisasrung res byas pa'i gras su sgo mang grwa tshang ma phebs pas nyin gcig rje 'di 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang du se 'bras kyi che grags rnams 'tshogs yod pa'i sar bos nas/ khyod sgo mang gi mtho dman bar gsum gyi sems na ci yod 'tshogs pa'i dbus su shod ces sgyur sbyangs btang bar/ nged tshos sems la ci yod khyed rang tshos 'tshogs thog nas thag bcad pa de yin mod/ ngas bshad dgos don mi 'dug ces snyems tshul gyis bzhugs ba la/ 'o na rgyal ba rin po che rgya nag tu phebs 'jug rgyu yin min gyi lan gsal bo dgos zer bar/ ngas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'di la phebasachoga'adi la phebs mi chog ces bkag 'gog byed mi thub byayopas/ khyod kyis de ltar bkag 'gog mi thub na se 'bras dge gsum gros mthun gyis thag bcad na de'i gras su 'dug rgyu e yin zer bar/ rgya nag gong ma bdag po chen po dang / bod kyi rgyal po lha bzang han gnyis kyi dgongs par mi

dasdor da5 3 7 'bab pa'i gros cig (shig )byed na de'i grabs nas mi 'dug de min pa'i gros gang byed kyang gros grabs gcig yin gsungs nas har gyis bzhengs te phebs yong bar zil ston par sus kyang rngo ma thogs snang ste/shes rab sdong bu las/ ji srid 'jigs pa ma byung ba/ /de srid 'jigs la 'jigs par bya/ /'jigs pa mngon du byung ba'i tshe/ /'jigs med lha bur gnas par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar snying stobs rmad du byung ba'i rnam thar yin no//de nas der 'tshogs thams cad kyis sgo mang bas dkrug shing byas tshozer nas dmag rgyag par thag bcad de khong tsho'i gras su song ba'i sgo mang gi grwa pa bsam blo dkar ding zer ba dang / hal kha dge 'phel zer ba gnyis kyis dmag dgesan byas pa'i grwa dmag gis bde yangs grwa khang steng nas me mda' sogs 'phangs te sbyor ba log pa la zhugs pa dang / rje 'dis kun mkhyen gong ma'i drung du zhus par/ skyon med/ nga zla ba grags pa las je ngan du song ba med gsungs zhal rtsed mdzad/ khyod kyis 'dam ka ma byed par snyan dar zhig longs gsungs pa blangs pas rnam bcu dbang ldan can zhig byung / chos rkyal gyi zhal thang la 'then gsungs pa ltar 'then pas pha rol phyo rnams dus kyi 'thor rlung lta bu'i rlung nag 'tshub ma'i po brang du tshud de lag pa brkyang bskums tsam yang mi mthong ba bzhin du gyur te shod du rang babs spu song / de ma thag dmag dpon gnyis spyos naspogacig gisakho chos rgyal yinabyurwa 'di min nam zer mgo ston/ gcig khyi spyon zhig dngathug ste rdzorang dang khyi smyon gnyis phan

31skye ged da wa— da5sa༈tshunajikhyi 'dzing ba ltar byas gnyis ka cher ma 'gyangalge par shi bas dpon ji slob thams cad mi mthun pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar gyur to/ / de skabs mchog dman tshang mas kun mkhyen chen poligasung dang du blangs na legs tsho—gas che bar yong rigs su 'edug kyang / gegasachag gi dbang gis gong bkod ri rab nyi zla zung du 'brel na legs pa'i lung bstan gyi zlog phyogs thog tu babs nas rgya bod dmag 'khrug byung ste blo gsal gling gi rdo bcal mtshon khrag gis dmar por gyur pa sogs grwa sa grwa tshang dang bstan srid spyi sger la nyams chag tshedhebar byung na yang / sgo mang grwa tshang mtsho la dar chags pa bzhin dkar 'jam yug gcig tu gnas pa ni/rgyud brtag gnyis las/ 'chad ba bo nga chos kyang nga / rang gi tshogs ldan nyan po nga / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gsang —ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i ye shes kyi zla ba gcig nyid gzugs skulirdzing bu du mar rol ba'i kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang rje 'di pa rnagaganyis kyi byin rlabs kyi 'jug pa dang thabs mkhasakyi byed pa thung du 'brel ba'i mthu yin no// de yang kun mkhyen rin po che gsang bdag gi sprul par bo nga du bkod pa'i lung bstan gyis 'grub la/ rje 'di pa lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i sku'i skye bar kun mkhyen rin po che'igasung rgyun kyang thos la/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun rgya mtshos rje 'di nyid kyi mchog sprul 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtsho dpal bzang por bstod pa mdzad pa las kyang / gsang 'dzin las rdor la sogasangamakhas grub kyi/ /skye 'phreng rim

gdadzha dasos/ 319brgyud lung rtogs yon tan dang / /mdzad 'phrin dbyar gyi chu mtsho ltar rgyas pa'i/ /mtshungs bral mchog sprul dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /skabs shig kun mkhyen mchog naspogatam gsar ba zhig thos par 'dug pas nga rang tsho lha sar 'gro gsungs nas da pon slobaske —rnams phebs te lha sar mchod mjal mdzad pas/ kun mkhyen rin po che la rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs dang gzhan yang lha du mas 'byung 'argyur gyi lung bstan mang po gnang ba rje 'dis gsan kyang ma gsan pa ltar —mdzad/ yang kun mkhyen rin po che lha khang gzhan zhig la phebs par/chos rgyal sdotram̐ btsan sgam po'i sku brnyan zhig gisasngon klu mes kyi dus su zer nas gsung mang po zhig gnang byung bar rje 'dis kun mkhyen rin po che la mang po zhig bshad gi 'dug pa de su ren ces ma mkhyen pa ltar zhus pas srong btsan gyi sku 'di da res gcig bu ma yin par nam mjal dus gsung gleng gnange gi yod gsungs/ de nas cher ma 'gyangs par dpon ju nang yab yum yul dbus su byon nas kun mkhyen rin poche mdo smad du 'byon pa'i gsol ba btab pa yin 'dug der ma zad rje thong masamado smad rtse mdor byams pa'i zhal gzigs skabs rje 'di bas kyang gzigs pa dang stod lung rtsa sgye mor 'brom ston gyi zhal gzigs pa'i rnam thar gsu nga skabs khyed rang yang sa der song dang zhal gzigs 'ong zhes gsungs pa ltar 'di bas kyang sa der 'brom gyi zhal gijigs pa sogs rje 'di la kun mkhyen mchog nas gsang ba'i rnam thar cung zad spyang sba gsang mi mdzad cing / bkod ma thag ba lta bu'i zhal gzigs kun mong ba yang ches ming

320 gdan darngo bar bu slob rnams gsung ngo // dgung lo so bdun shaṃ sa glang gi lo rjertsogong mas nged rang gi zhabs phyo rtso phyir mdo༄da du 'gro dan sa gsungs pa la yudzodu mi 'gro ba'i dam bca' —yod pas gnang ba gnang dgos zhurasakyang pha yul du 'gro mi datho/sa/ nged rang tshos mdo smad du dgon pa btab na cibastan 'gro la phan pa 'ong gsungs pas sngon ma cig yum sras kyi thugs bskyed dpag bsam gyi ljon shing la gzhan phan gyi 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i dus la babs par dgongs nas mdo smad dubyon/ de skabs rje gong ma'i spyag mdzod rab 'byams pha ngag dbang gshegs paritshab tu slar yang phyag mdzod byed dgos byung ste gang ci'i las don thams cad mkhyen par mdzad/ spyir kun mkhyen rin po che'i sku don 'argangs che ba'i rigs rdze'adi la gros phugs gtad pa zhig sngar nas yod la/ khyad par mdo smad du chibs bsgyur ba nas bzung ste rje 'dis las don che phra gang bsgrub la bcos — rdzi bsgyur cung zad kyang mi mdzad cing bsnyen rdzogs kyi skabs phal cher la rje 'di bar las slob byed 'jug pa dang / chi sa mo glang gi lo gnyan rje'i ri zhol du grwa rgan rnams sa brtag bslang dang bkra shis kyi gso sbyong du dzo — mngags pa'i tshe yang sde pa blo bzang gisapyimado thon gsungatsopa sogs gzhin las khyad par du 'phags pa'i gzengs bstod rgyun du mdzad pa dang / lazhabs phyi ba gzhan rnams la bzhugs sgar zu ra du med kyang rje 'dis bod pa kha shas zhabs phyir sger du khrid/ bzhugs sgar yang zur du phye nas phesmesasnyo pastse rsāb tshang zer nas drag zhan kun gyis brtsi mthong che zhing chos

dan rna sa da 321srid kyi mkhyen rgya dang / stobs 'byor zhal dbang go bab gang nas kyang lugs gnyis kyi 'gying bag gis rnam par brjid pa'i (pas ) zhabs phyi thams cad kyi dbus na mngon par mtho ba yin snang ste/ ji skad du/shes rab sdong bu las/ bdog pa rigs pas nyer bsgrubs shing / /'jig rten kun la phan 'dogs gang / /de ni 'jig rten thams cad kyis/ /spyi la me tog phreng bzhin bkur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi skabs su rje gong ma'i bka' ltar 'jam mgon khri rin po ches 'chad nyan gyi srog bzung / rje 'di bas 'du khang dang grwa khang / sku zhabs bla brang sogs dgon pa'i gzhi gsar bskrun/ grwa tshang gi gtong sgo ring thung / yul dus babs (bab ) bstun gyi chos sri da kyi khrims sogs mdor na dgon sde gsar bskrun dang 'brel ba'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rdzogs ldan la 'god pa'i chos dang srid kyi 'phrin las gser gyi gdung chen gong du 'degs pa'irdzoka ba lta bu mdzad de sku drin shin tu che bas bla ma khri rgan sde rgan gnyis zhes grwa rgan rnams kyis dad gus bcos min gyi bsngags brjod rgyus med kyi blor mi shong ba gnang ba ni don la gnas pa kho na'o/ / dgon pa'i 'du khang sogs grub ste gzhi legs par thing ba na sku gzugs mi bde ba'i snyad kyis dgon pa'i rgyab ri'i rtse mo bde mchog klad dang / byi'u rgyal mo sogs gnas dben pa mang po dang dgon par bzhugs skabs su yang lo 'khor zla 'khor gyi bcad rgya 'ba' zhig gi khong nas nyin mtshan gnyis kar thugs dam bar ma chad pa mdzad —cing / phyis su grwa

322 gdardo da /rgan mang pos rje nyid mizhal 'don gang la mdzad kyin yod zhus par/ rsha na da la 'jigs nas rta phyag khyung gsum gyi bsnyen pa dung rgyur re ma mtha' song yod tshod yin/ nyams len gzhan mi shes gsungs te rgyal dbang gsum pa'i rnam thar du sngags grangs mang po song bar gsungs pa dang cha mtshungs pa'i rnam thar du snang / sku ma 'das kyi bar du mtshan mo mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs dang gsang bdag gi sngags/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtsa sngags sogs zhal 'don mdzad kyin tsog bu'i rnal 'byor la bzhugs pa kun la mthun grub kyi rnam par thar pa ste/ lus kyi 'khri thing rgas pas rnan gyur kyang / /chos kyi 'khar ba sems kyis yongs ma btang / /zhes pa ltar ro/ / gsang sngags grub pa'i snyan pa yang shin tu che zhing khyad par grwa ba nad ba zhig mi 'tsho bar thag bcad de rje 'di tshogs dbur gdan drangs ṭwāṃ nas khrus dbang dang mjal kha zhus par phu zhig btab ste khyod tshe pha rol tu btangartan nga mi min gsungs pas de nub nas thim pa lugs zlog lta bur ngag kyang grol te bde bar byung ba sogs mo rtsis mkhan dang sman dpyad pa thams cad kyis 'chi bar thag bcad pa mang por byabs khrus dang bka' bsgo srung mdud bum chu re gnang ba tsam gyis tshe'i bar chad las grol te gdon bgegs kyi gnod pas mi brdzi ba'i mchog sbyin bstsal pa'i lo rgyus shin tu mang ngo / /shal nas kyang rgyal nad kyis thebs pa yin na de'i gnyen po nga yin zhes gsungs par bu slob rnams kyis gsungs/ bcad rgya'i skabs su yang dgon pa'i chos srid kyi las don la phyag bris tshun chad

ged rabs—ka5 323kyi sgo nas bkas khyab par mdzad pa dang / 'jam mgon khri rin po ches kyang spyi sger gyi las don thams cad rje 'di bar dgongs bstun ma zhus par phyag len mi gnang ba zhig yod ces nyams rgyus che ba'i grwa rgan rnams gleng / khong rnam gnyis thugs nang gtsang bas tha na gsung gleng gi ched du zhal 'dzom mdzad long med skabs 'gar tshogs su 'du khang phug gi sa stegs kyi khar lhan rgyas kyis gsung gleng mdzad pa yin snang bas gleng brjod phal cher chu shing gi snying bor go skabs shig rgan gya paṇḍi tas rgya'i mi drag kha shas khrid 'ongs te dgon gnas kyi sa cha'i skor la smra mchu bslangs par/ nyin dang bor kho rang gis lab pa phal cher bden tsam las rje rmedis gang yang ma gsungs/ nyin gnyis par da pon junang gis rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa gdan drangs tshul dang / yon mchod gnyis kas mtsho sngon gyi dpon khag so sor dgon gnas gang rnyed du dgon pa btab e chog dris pas kun gyis dang blang byas tshul/ a khu bā thur tha'i ji mtsho sngon gyi spyi dpon yin stabs gcig 'thus kyi bka' shog zhus tshul sogs zhus par paṇḍi tas kyang bden byas pas/ rgya dpon khros te 'o na nga 'dir 'ong don ci yin zhes paṇḍi ta tshar bcad pas kho rang mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la dbang med du gnas dgos byung ste/ de ni lugs kyi bstan bcos las/ nags kyi glang chen zhags pa yis/ /bcings nas dbang du byed pa yang / /thabs mkhas tshul la gnas pa yi//yon tan rnams kyi mthu stobs yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gdul dka' 'dul ba'i thabs mkhas kyi yon tan bla na med pa'o//

3pho —— /narwa——— da—— chu yos lo mtsho sngon dus 'khrugs kyi dbang gis phyogs 'di'i sde dgon phal cher rlung gis bskyod pa'i chu nang gi gru lta bur gyur skabs bkra shis 'khyil gyi grwa slob che bgres rnams bstan 'dzin wang la mjal 'dzom du phebs par dā'i ching kho shu'i chi dang yon mchod yin stabs bstan 'dzin wang nas khong rnams kyi snying gi khye'u la 'jigs pa'i rma skyed pa'i tshig gi mtshon char phab kyang rje 'di'i snying stobs kyi go cha gzhig pa'i go skabs ga la zhig te lan gyis zlog par mi nus pa'i bden tshig rdo bsgrigs pa lta bu gcig lan gnyis brtsegs kyi tshul du byung bas wang rang nyid cung zad 'jigs shing / nub der wang la shangs khrag rdol ba dang / bkra shis 'khyil du dmag gi grabs byed pa'i mi bzang kha shas la gzer thung byung ba sogs kyis lhag par skrag rsādabal mang dang mgo rta tshang sogs dgon pa'i yin zer tshad kyi mi ser thams cad bde 'jags su phul zhing slar yon mchod byed dgos sogs tshig gi gzengs bstod tshad med pa byung bas grwa rgan gzhan rnams kyis bstan 'dzin wang la gang ci'i rgyab brten gyi bka' shog zhu grabs byas par rje 'dis kho rang gar 'gro'i tshod khyed tshos e jig gsungs te thog tu khel ma bcug pas phyis su mtsho sngon dang yon mchod du 'brel ba'i mdo smad kyi dgon pa phal cher la bstan pa spyi'i gegs su che tsho ba'i nyams chag bzod dka' ba byung skabs bkra this 'khril grwa zur cung zad kyang ma nyams pa byung ba dang / rjes sor dra'i ching kho shu'i chi la ching sbang byung skabs dmag dngul dang / nas mdzod rgya bre chig khri sogs datsen par 'byor bas ltogs sla me 'bar rnams kyis dgon pa'i lha

da rab dadzos 326sde grwa mang bcas nas skal ba len rtsis byas kyang dgos pa med gsungs nas grwa tshang la nas phog gi ched du rta rgod ma bcu bdun tsam gyis nas bre lnga brgya nyo tshong byas pa'i gnas tshul gyi yig gnon mdzad pas da lta bkra shis 'khyil gyis zos pa slar skyugs mi dgos shing sna thag bsig bldab — byed mkhan med pa 'di rje 'di'i bka' drin yin pas thugs rje che bar kun gyis shes dgos so// lcags phag lor rgyud pa bla ma tsho 'du dge 'dun rgyal mtshan pa sku gshegs nas rgyud par bla ma bsko bzhag byed dgos skabs/ 'jam mgon khri rin po ches rgyud pa grwa tshang la khyed tshos da res sde pa tshang la gsol ba thob dang mchod yon thams cad la phan pa yong gsungs/ der thams cad kyis khong dgung lo yang mtho/ sku gzugs kyang mi bde zer nas mjal kha re yang mi gnang na rgyud pa'i bla ma ga nas 'ong zhus par/skyes bu dam pa sku gzugs dang na tshod la ltos pa med/ bstan don thugs la bzhag na lo kha shas la rgyud pa'i bla ma las sla gsungs pa ltar sna grwa slob thugs 'dun gcig dril gyis rgyud pa'i khri'i snyan gsan riphul bas/ — khong gi zhal nas bla ma chos grwar song nas chos bshad dgos sdi yin tsa na/da 'gro bsdad kyang mi thub/ mig kyang mi gsal ba khyed tshos shes pa de ka red gsungs/ re zhig zhal gyis ma bzhes kyang grwa tshang nas chos grwar phebs mi thub na gsung chos nyan par gzims khang du 'ong chog da lan bla ma ma mdzad na nged tsho thugs nas dor ba yin zhes mgrin gcig tu nan zhus byas pasazhal bzhes gnang dgos byung ste gza' ska ra 'phrod sbyor bzang po'i

da 3 2 lti dzi na dnghaḍatram̐ da5 nyin gsang chen chos kyi khri la zhabs pad rnam par bkod/ de nyin yid du 'ong ba'i char gyi rgyun bzang pos sa gzhi rnam par brlan pa dang chab (chabs ) gcig par lha rnams kyis shis pa brjod pa'i dbyar rnga dal gyis sgrogs pa sogs rton 'brel legs tshogs che bar byung / zhal nas na tshod mthon po yin zer nas mig ltos ngan pa mi 'jog chos grwa la yang 'gro/'chad nyan yang gang lhogs byed dgos gsungs nas zhabs stegs kyi khar ngal gso lan bzhi re tsam mdzad mu nasachos grwa chag med lta bu gnang / 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi lung ma thob cing bstan pa bshig mi rung bas sku phyogs bla ma tshang la zhu dgos gsungs nas khri rin po cher 'grel ba'i bshad lung zhus nas smad rgyud ltar lo re bzhin rdzogs par ga nang ste rgyud sde kun gyi rtse mo dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad sgrub dus kyi mthar yang mi nyams pa'i bka' drin mdzad/ sngar rgyud par gsang 'dus kyi bdag 'jug tsam zhig las sgrub mchod tshugs rgyu ma grub 'dug par ston bdun phrag gnyis kyi ring la 'jigs gsang gnyi/sa ka'i sgrub mchod kyi rgyun gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ snga sor 'jam mgon khri rin po ches grwasmob bdun brgyad cig la bde mchog gi rgyugs bzhag ste khong gis sbyin bdag mdzad nas zhal ras lha khang du dus bzang lta bu byas nas gsung ba ma gtogs rgyud pa rang la bde mchog tshogs 'don du ma tshugs 'dug par/gling bsre zhig gi skabs su bde mchog rtsa rgyud la bshad pa mdzad cing / khyad par du bde mchog gi gnas pho brang / lha rnams kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan dang 'gying stabs kyi khyad par/ lus kyi cha shas lha so so dang ngo bo

ga 3na rda——ka sdo—snye 3273 dbyer med lugs/ mchod pa'i khyad par/ rdo rje glu'i 'then lugs kyi gnad sogs bskyed rim gyi bshad pa rgyas par gnang bas blo gros dang ldan pa kun gyis he ru ka dngos su byon yang 'di las lhag pa gsung rgyu med ces bsngags brjod kyi rol mo sgrog par gyur/ de skabs dus kyi sgrumatha' 'dir byin rlabs gzhan las myur ba sogs 'khor lo bde mchog gi che brjod rgya cher gnang bas nang gsang sngags la dga' ba'i gdul bya rnams rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lam la mos pa'i dad gus kyis rgyud brlan pa dang / phyi nor 'dzin gyi gzhi kun dus kyi char rgyun bzang pos brlan par byas pa sogs phyi nang gi rten 'brel legs tshogs su gyur pa ltar ma 'gyangs par tshogs 'don du bde mchog tshugs thub pa byung /de nas bzung ste dpyid chos gnyis pa yongs rdzogs la chos grwa'i shis brjod spyang bde mchog gis byed dgos pa'i srol btsugs pas chos thog de la bde mchog chos thog ces grags/ yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu dang bde mchog bskyed rim brtsi bzhag la gtong ba'i srol yang tshugs par mdzad pa dang / rgyud khang steng du chog grwa so sor dus 'khor 'jam rdor 'khor chen sogayokyi cho ga phyag len dang bcas tshugs shing / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la slar dus 'khor grwa tshang tshugs dgos pa dang / dben sa lugs kyi lcags mkhar 'cham dang bcas pa tshugs dgos kyi zhal chems phul ba sogs rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i gsang sngags kyi bka' srol yongs su rdzogs pa phyag len du btab/ sngar rgyud khang bzang po zhig med stabs grwa khang gsar rgyag gnang na dgongs kyang phyag rdzas kyi phu thung nas gtong

328 ges ba dpas/ba'i phyag skyong (rkyong) bde bo min pas re zhig thugs thag tshod pa zhigasgom byung / lan cig sngon gyi skyes chen dam pa mang po 'i rnam thar ltar dkon mchog la blo gtad nas snying stobs bskyed na skyon mi yong bas skar bzang zhig la mgo tshugs dgos dgongs ma thag nam mkha' nas/ grwa tshang gi sku bsod kyis 'du khang grub 'ong / rda gzhi tshugs dang gzugs can gzugs med kyis mthun rkyen bsgrub 'ong zhes pas sgra zhig gsal bar grags pa byung / de nas hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyin thig 'debs par byon/ der tshogs chen dge bskos rab 'byams dzikun dga' bkro shis dang / smo nadkulab donamibazang gnyis mjal du 'ong bas rten 'brel legs/ khyed gnyis ming bzang don bzang yin pas thig skud 'then rogs gyis gsu ngas nas thig btab/ rgyud pa'i grwa rgan kha shas kyi sa rgyud khang 'bub sar te'u 'bur yod pa la bltas nas rgyud khang 'phug pa bka' drin che mod kyang te'u mgo 'edi dka' mo6red ang zhusatrepas/nga bla rgan la te'u mgo 'di min pa'i blo rtse gtod sa cang med gsungs/ te'u mgo de'i phyogs bzhi nas 'du khang gi gru bzhi bzung bas sa thams cad de kas lag ma thogs par 'du khang dang kha 'grig so 'grig citu song zhing / gru rdo rnams kyang sa te'u de ka'i nang nas byung bas thams cad ya mtshan pa byung / grwa ba kha shas kyis pha bong chen po zhig bcom pa'i nang spos sbal ba mi sdug ches pa zhig thon par skrag nas zhus pasatsho/ de la skrag mi dgos/ de 'dra la phan thogs pa tsam las ka 'di tsho'i zhar byung tsam yin gsungs/ de skabs 'ga' zhig gi rmi lam du zhon pa sna tsogs nan

gdan rabs dardo / 37ba'i mi mang po ga shed du 'gro ba su yin dris pas/ phyogs 'di'i gzhi bdag rnams sde ba rin po ches rgyud khang 'phug pa la rogs byed par 'grotre ba yin zhis rmis pa'ang byung zhing de dang don mthun par rgyud pa'i grwa ba rnams rdo len par phebs skabs shul 'dir sang rdo len rgyu mi 'dug snyam na yang phyi nyin shul der snga nyin las lhag pa'i rdo zhig byung 'dug ces grwa rgan rnams mgrin gcig tu gleng zhing / phyogs 'di'i grong mi rnams kyis sdong bo mang po bskul ma dgos par zhal 'debs su phul bas kwa gdung —lcam gseg phal cher rang shugs kyis 'grig pa sogs byung / bar skabs su ja mar sogs lag 'thog (thogs ) pas las byed kyi do dam pha sbyin pa zer bas thams cad kyi phyag rdzas kyis gtong 'di yin med par las ka 'di 'dra rtsom mi nyan zhes zhus kyang ma gsan pas nom pa zhig yod na da khyer shog ces zhus skad/ cher ma 'gyangs par sog yul gyi mi khyim phyug po zhig byi tshad kyis stongs song ba der de'i nye du rnams kyis gdan— drangs pa ltar chibs kha bsgyur/ ge sar rdo rtags nas rje gong ma'i sku tsha dbon po btsan po ma dgon par 'ong ba'i lam nas mjal te/ grwa ba 'di tsho snying mi rje ba e yin/ byi tshad kyi nang du phebs lugs yod dam zhes chibs mthur la 'jus pas/ grwa ba 'di tsho'i mgo mi thon na nga thal ba 'gam par 'gro rgyu e red/ glen rtags ma stonapyigasungs te las kyi dbang gis dmyal bar skyes pa yang btsan thabs kyis 'dren nus na 'phral gyi nyer 'tshe phran bu las skyob pa lta ci smos pa'i gsung du sems/ der phebs pa na thams cad kyis dad gus chen pos khyim de'i phyi nang gi yo byad gang

330 gdan ba da snye yod phul ba sogs mthun rkyen 'bad med lhun grub lta bu byung / de skabs spen pad kyi 'og nas 'du khang gi rked kyi bar du gyang la ser ga byung bas thams cad skrag ste zhus par/ phyag gis gas srub la reg nas skyon med kha 'dam gyis chod la zhog gsungs/ 'phral du mi zhig 'jim pa bzung nas song bas ser ga je chung la song 'dug ces gleng / de nas bzung ste dus phyis shing yos lo gtsang khang ma bskyod bar du lo bdun cu skor cig song yang ser ga je cher ma song ba yang nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i che bar snang / de ka'i rkyen gyis yin yang zer gang ltar nyin gcig glo bur du thugs khros nas dgon pa'i byang shar gyi mtshams na spre'u zer ba'i brag cig yod pa der byon/ brag la phyag gis sta re lan kha shas bsnun/ 'di bshig gsung nas bshig ci thub cig byas pa rgyu mtshan shes dka' yang / spre'u 'dis dgon pa la gnod pa'i lung bstan zhig kyang mthong la/ lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung zhig kyang thos te 'og tu 'bri bar 'gyur ro//'gran zla med pa'i rje btsun dam pa thu'u bkwan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal nas kyang spre'u 'di gnyan chen sngo la g.yu rtse'i sa srung zhig yin stabs gnyan chen 'khor mang po'i dbus zhig na zil bskyed nas yod pa'i mdun du spre'u kho rang klad pa dmar tsa re song nas nga la blabrang sde bas 'di ltar byas song byas pas/ gnyan chen gyis de la ngas kyang glags rnyed shas mi 'dug ces zer gyin yod pa mig mthong can zhig gi snang bar 'ong ba'i skatam rgyud kyang yod gsungs/ phyis su yang kya sgar

dan sa da / 331bas rgyud pa gdan drangs te ma ṇi tshugs skabs sngo la g.yu rtses rje 'di bar cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan kyang glags ma rnyed par rang gi mdog cha lugs bzhon pa sogs kyi rnam 'gyur gsal bar bstan te gus par byas pas gsol mchod brtsams pa yang yod do//gzhan yang 'jam mgon khri rin po che rtse gzhung du phebs skabs gzhi bdag gtor ma re chag med gnang rgyun yod par rje 'di ching wang gi usger phebs dus shig ma mdzad pas grwa ba rnams the tshom du gyur kyang zhu ma nus/ tshur phebs nyin tsartse ma dung phyur song zer ba'i sngags pa zhig mjal du 'ong bar sngags chu zhig dgos gsungasajite grwa ba rnams sa la nan gyis 'dzin bcug ste phebs pa'i lam nas dre'u zhig glo bur du brgyal song bar sngags chu blud gsungs pa ltar sngags chu khar blugs ma thag tu dre'u yar langs nas khal khur te mgyogs par rgyugs song bas mi ma yin 'di tshos sngags chu re tsam yang mi bzod cing bzo rta gang yang med par garnod 'tshe la dga' ba 'di gad mo 'chor ba 'dug 'di tsho lang shor la gtong mi nyan gsungs pa sogs 'di 'dra'i rigs mang yang yi ges 'jigs nas bzhag go /de ltar grwa khang ka ba nyi shu shing rtsi logs ris dang bcas pa/ phugs su dri gtsang khang bzhi thog shing rtsi logs ris dang bcas pa/ lha khang g.yon mar 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs yum bcas dang / mgon chos gnyis bcas kyi 'bag thog tshad dang mnyam pa/ lha khang g.yas su thub dbang gi 'bag sku thog tshad dang mnyam pa/ rigs lnga yum bzhi 'bag de'i phyed tsam re bzhengs shing

332 gid rnab da / thog shod gnyis su rgyal ba'i bka' krugyur rin po che sogs sku gsung thugs rten mchod rdzas thab cha sogs dgos cas thams cad gsar 'jog gnang ste dpon slob bla brang gi gzhi yang tshugs par mdzad spru dang / 'chad nyan 'grig lam/ gtong sgo sogs gang ci je rgyas su btang ste chos srid kyi srol rnams 'char can gyi tshul du nyams pa med par gnang ba sogs gdan rabs thams cad kyi nang na rgyud grwar rje 'di las bka' drin che ba med ces grwa rgan rnams zhal 'cham par snang ste don la ga nas pa kho na'o// nyin gcig rgyud khang du snyan dar 'bul bar 'gro gsungs nas phebs te rten so sor snyan shal 'bul bar mdzad cing / lha mo re ma ti'i sku logs ris shig yod pa de la yang snyan dar zhig phul gsungs/ 7'dog sa mi 'dug zhus pas/ 'phongs la thongs gsungam pa ltar 'phangs pa na snyan shal mngon sum du bzhes pa byung bas lha mo de la lha mo dar len ma zhes skugrags/ nya phyis su dkon gnyer zhig gis the tshom gyi dbang gis lag pas 'then kyang ma lhung bas bzod gsol zhu dgos byug zhing / dus phyis shing yos lo gtsang khang bskyod skabs snyan dar thams cad bsal ba'i 'og na sngon gyi snyan shal de ka mdog tsam yang ma nyams par thod khrag 'dzin pa'i phyag tu yod pa rgyud bla'i khur 'dzin kho bo cag sogs der 'khod kun gyi mig lam du gyur cing / lag pa'i 'du byed kyis len pa'i sbyor ba brtsams kyang ma lon par 'phrin bcol sogs zhuge pas rang shugs kyis nam yong cha med par mchod stegs kyi steng du byung

gdan rabs da / 333bas rje 'dis dme can bran du bkol ba'i mthu stobs dang / dpal ldan lha mos dam ldan bu bzhin skyong ba'i thugs rje la dad pa mchog tu 'phel bar gyur/ skabs shig mgon khang du rgyun gyi bskang gso pa mi bzhi yod pa'i mig lam du chos rgyal gyi 'bag sku cung zad sgur yod pa lta bu zhig byung / zhib tu bltas pas rim gyis rim gyis spur 'gro bar mgon khang ba rnams skrag nas sku mdun du zhus par/ myur du nga yong bas khyed rang tsho skrag mi dgos gsungs/ phebs nas snyan dar cig phul/ mgar ba shākya zer ba bos nas khyod kyi dkulcags thag gcig dang lcags phur gcig rdung dgos gsungs nas phra sbom ring thung sogs bkod khyad gsal bar gnang / des kyang ma 'gyangs par brdungs nas phul ba sa/ chos rgyal gyi sku la kha dar se ral khar btang / lcags phur gyang la brdabs te sku lcags thag gis btags nas bzhag ste/ 'chi bdag ma tshar gcig gis 'phrin bcol gnang / ngas rgyud khang gi chos rgyal 'di la dga' ldan gyi chos gyil lcags thag ma 'dra ba cig yod na snyam yod de/ da bsam pa ltar byung ba yin—/ khyed rang tshos dga' ba sgom (sgoms) la bskang gso sogs 'bad 'bad gyis gsungs te 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i g.yar dam bka' sdod chos kyi rgyal pos dbu dud pa dang bcas te gus pas nod pa'i 'bras rtags su sems/ rgyud pa'i khrir bzhugs skabs tshogs chen dus bzang rigs grwa'i skabs nga sogs su tshogs la chag med du phebs/ tshogs su bzhugs skabs tshogs chen zhal ngo nye 'khor du slebs pa na na bza' sogs lhag par tshulo mabun

334 ga na da /gyis bzhes nas dbu dud de bzhugs pa yin zhesu gleng ste dge 'dun gyi spyan ltos la dgongs par mngon/ skabs de dag tu yang khri rin po che thugs brel ba dang / phyis sku bskung skabarsā sogs su dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gsung chos smon lam gyi tshogs dbu las du ma'i rdo rje slob dpon sogs mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi brtsi bzhag ma gtogs pa'i tshogs chen khri ba'i byed sgo thams cad kyang mdzad dgos byung ste rang shugs kyis khri las thog pa lta bur song / de nas 'jam mgon khri rin po che sku 'da' kha rje 'di bar khyed kyi sku'i lcogs ring la rgyas pa'i gtor sgrub dang lcags mkhar gnyis ma chag pa gyis gsungs pas don gyis bsko bzhag gnangu 'dug kyang / grwa ba tshos khyed kyi 'phror bla ma su yin bsko bzhag gnang dgos zhus par/ nged las lhag pa a lags bla ma tshang yin mod/ dma khong la gsol ba btab na khyed tsho thams cad la legs po 'ong gsungs/der rje 'di la mi dad pa zhig gis 'o na nga yang tshogs chen khrir bsdad chog sogs 'khyal gtam sna tshogs zhus pas/ khri rin po ches 'o na khyed rang tsho'i su 'dug na'ang sdod/ nga la sku phyogs nas khyod kyis tshe gang bor 'chad nyan gyis gsungs pa ma gtogs/ bla ma 'di bskos gsungs pa med gsungs/ de nas bzung ste de skor la gsung zur tsam yang ma thon/ zhal nas kyang kho bos grwa ba 'di dag lo 'di tsam gyi ring la chos 'jig rten gyis bskyangs nas/ nga la chos kyi drin gzo med na yang dgon par 'khrug long byed rgyu'i gtam rna bar bskyal ba 'di yi mug pa zhig 'dug gsungs/ thugs skyo bzhin du gshegs pa ni 'byung 'gyur ltar

gad da / 335bdud rigs re gnyis kyi log smon gyi mthu brtas pa yin par snang /khri rin po che zhi bar gshegs pa sa rta'i lo de'i zla ba bzhi pa'i nang du mili dbang mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma dgon gnas su phebs/ rje 'di la bla mar bzhugs dgos kyi snyan gsan zhus shing / /grwa mang gis kyang 'jam mgon khri rin po che nas zhal chems khyed la phog pas don gyis bla mar bskos pa dang / dpon mo rnam rgyal dgung lo bdun cur phebs pa 'di yang ched du gnyer nas phebs pa thams cad la thugs bsam btang nas grwa tshang thugs nas ma 'dor zhes phur tshugs su zhus par/ nga lo mthon por song bas phung pos mi lcogs snyam pa ma gtogs grwa tshang 'di 'dra zhig la po ti lngalibartsi bzhag cig 'chad rgyu byung na skal ba dang ldan par 'dug gsungs nas zhal bzhes mdzad de 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i gtsug gi rgyan du gyur/ chos srid gang nas kyang sngar srol gang yod ma nyams paraphumadzad pas grwa tshang la 'phel rgyas che bar byung ste ma 'gyangs par grwa ba stong lhag tsam 'dus pas ma dad pa rnams kyang the tshom gyi 'phyang mo nyug tu gyur/dase/ bshes kyang thon che ba byung ste/ 'chad 'gyur ltar gyi gdan rabs du ma dang / gzhan yang se 'bras dge gsum la nyi zla ltar grags shing skutshes zin na dga' ldan khri ba yong nges pa'i rtsod med kyi dge bshes a bar dka' bcu dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang / lcang skya rdo rje 'chang nas kyang deng sang 'di 'dra yod dka' zhes bsngags pa'i dge bshes a bar bzod pa sogs kyang rje 'di ba'i dus kyi grwa rgyun yin no //snga sor 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i dus su dbu phar gyi zur bkol

336 gag rabs da /rnams kyang brtsi bzhag lī gnang rgyun sgood pa rje 'dis ma mdzad kyipas ske 'ga' zhig gis kha zer gyin yod pa gsan nas/ dpyid chos mo zhig la brdzi bzhag ring po gnang nas 'dzin grwa re rer yang shog gu mda' tshad bzhi bcu ma long tsam re song bas phal cher gyis brtsi bzhag gi rjes zin dka' ba byung tsho chos thog gi mjug tu tshogs gtam gyi zhar la ha cang brtsi bzhag mang po btang na khyed rang tshos rgyugs sprod rgyu sogs la dka' snyam nas yang cha byas pa ma gtogs grwa sa se 'bras dge gsum la brtsi bzhag gtong dgos na yang lag thogs mi yong zhes zhal pho yang gsungs / sngar rgyud kyi khrirobazhugs skabs/ su chos grwar phebs dus zhabs stegs kyi khar ngal gso ba lan bzhi re tsam mdzad dgos pa yin kyang / tshogs chen gyi khrir bzhugs pa na sku gzugs yang zor che bar song ste chos grwa chag med mdzad pa la dka' tshegs med pa byung bas kun gyis ngo mtshar che bar gleng / gshin chog sogs la yang dka' tshegs mi gnang bar nye 'khor 'di na smon lam zhig btab nas gser srang stong len rgyu yod kyang nga rang gi skal ba yin/ khab skud gcig len rgyu med kyang smon lam zhig 'debs dgos6 pa nga rang gi khur yin gsungs/ gsung bshad spung rgyas gnang dgos zhos 'ga' zhig gis zhus par/ma bshad log bshad ha cang bshad pa'i skyon gsum spangs nas 'a chad dgos pa yin/hathong mang mi dgos gsungs shing gang gsung gnad 'dril ba cig yod par bu slob rnams gsungs/ yig cha 'dra gsung rtsom gnang dgo sa zhus par/ tshad mar gyur pa re res brtsam na legs/ — mkhas pa

gdanarabasadaros/ 3yod mang na yul 'jig zer gsungs te blun po mkhas par rlom pa rnams dzra ba nyung na bstan pa la phan pa'i gsung du snang / rgya bod kyi lo rgyus la shin tu mkhas pas zhal nas/ deng sang nga 'dra ba'i lo rgyus shes mkhan dkon bsam pa yod ces yang yang gsung ste chos 'byung zhig rtsom bzhed yod kyang skul mkhan gyi lhan cig byed rkyen ma byung bas nyer len tsam gyis rngo ga la thogs/ 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i rnam thar zhig mgo brtsams yod /kyang / phyogs lhung gis 'then khyer du song nas ting bskul ma zhus pas rtsom 'phro lus snang ste/ rtsom pa sbyangs pa zhig min kyang thugs rab kyibye shugs kyis tshig sbyor legs shing rno ba dang ngos gtsang ba zhig snang zhes skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas dngos su thos/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dang / lung rjes gnang gang zhus ci 'dod du stsol pa dang / rje gong ma nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi khrid dang rjes gnang / 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi rjes gnang sogs rgyun dkon pa 'ga' zhig gzhan gyis ma zhus kyang ched du gnyer nas gnang bar mdzad pa sogs skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams sgo du ma nas skyong bar mdzad ci4nga / khyad par du rang cag rnams kyi me tog phog pa'i lha gcig skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang bka' drin 'khor mtha' ma mchis pa de nyid rang gi bzhugs gdan gser khrur zhabs zung bkod de mdzad pa 'phrin las kyis nor 'dzin yongs su 'gengs pa'i dga' ston la rang cag gis ci dgar longs spyod rgyu byung ba 'di ni rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi bka' drin yin pas 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa la gus pa rnams kyis rgyu phun

mi38 gdan spo da / spe0tshogs ga la yang gus parabyubya dgos pa nyid do //byude'i don gyis 'di ba'i mchog sprul rin po cher skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas gzengs bstod kyi bka' shog bstsal pa'i nang du kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po srid pa tso gsum na ches cher g.yo ba de nyid kyis mdo dbus gnyis su 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba lta bu mdzad cing / de lta busdzarje btsun chen po de nyid la bstan pa 'dzin zhing spel ba'i grogs byed du bsam bzhin sku'i skye ba bzhes pa'i thugs sras du ma yod pa'i nang nas ma cig lung bstan las/ grol sde rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ni/ /khri zhes bya ba'i yul du 'byung / /ngur smrig tshul 'dzin dge 'dun skyong / /zhes lung gis bstan pa'i mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang rgyug chen po dpon slob blo bzang don grub pa de nyid kyis/ thog mar dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang du bstan nas gsung rab kyi don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad de mkhas pa'i dbang bor gyur/ thos pa'i do na de nyid bsgom pa dang bsgrubs pas rtogs pa mchog brnyes/ de nas bar skabs su kun mkhyen chen po sgo mang gi chos khri mdzad ring la sku zhabs su rgyun 'thud nas bzhugs te kun dga' bo dang 'brom sto na pa'i rnam thar gyi rjes su 'gro ba'i zhabs tog zla med pa sgrub cing / chos grwa chen po 'di nyid gsar 'dzugs kyi skabs su gang ci'i skor la sku drin shin tu che ba dang / grwa tshang phan tshun gnyis kyi khri mdzad skabs su sku tshe la ma bltos par 'chad nyan —dmar po mdzad pas dge 'dun gyi sde yang dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel/ rgyud

/dan ba da5byu 339par 'du khang gsar phub sogs mdzad pa phyag rjes rgya che ba dang lhag don chos grwa chen po 'di'i chos srid bya ba bla ma bzang bo'i skyong 'phro nyams su ma bcug par ma zad gong 'phel du gtong bzhin pa'i ngang nas kho bo cag la gtad pa sogs gang sa nas gzhan dang zla med pa byung zhes bka' drin che ba'i bsngags brjod mdzad snang ngo / /'di skor la rje 'di'i 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar po gyen du 'a/degs pa'i yu ba lta bu ni/ mi'i dbang mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma zhes rang srid du gtogs pa rnams kyis ma lta bur 'dzin pa de nyid yin kyang mchog sprul gdan sar phebs rgyur thag bcad 'phral glo bur du sku ma 'tsho ba ni/ a ma lab sgron gyi lung bstan ltar bdud rigs zhig gis zas skyon phul ba yin zhes gleng / lar sa dbang dam pa dga' ldan ernyi ni ju nang dang /mi'i dbang mo 'di gnyis sku tshe snga ma du ma nas kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang thugs bskyed dang smon lam lhan gcig pa yin tshul dang /ma 'ongs pa na yang yang zhal 'dzom par 'gyur ba dang / sku tshe 'dir yang kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras rnams kyis 'khrungs rabs sogs las brtsams pa'i bsngags brjod gzhan gyis blor mi shong ba mdzad tshul deng /lhag par mi'i dbang po 'di nyid 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor shin tu brtan cing / sha'i mig shis ri rgyal lhun po yang gzigs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan gyi phung por gyur tshul dang / chos sde chen po 'di la bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pas / dpon yab yu ma 'di gnyis dgon par phebs skabs rang gi pha ma rgyungs(rgyang )ring po

340 gdan rabs datshu nas 'ong ba dang khyad par med pa'i spro dga' rgyas ba zhig yod ces grwa rgan rnams zhal 'cham pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gre bar bskyil mi bzod pa mang du mchis kyang / rang nyid na re/ ho cang rang bzhin drang bo'i gtam/ /smra ba'ang skyon du 'gyur ba ste/ ༈smra mkhas nee tso dbang med du/ sgrog gis bcings pa'i rgyu rkyen ci/ /zhes re zhig dgag byar byas so/ / 'di skabs mi bsrun pa'i skye bo du mas brlang spyod sna tshogs byas jikyang / rje 'dis mthu stobs dang thugs rjelidapung bskyed de gzhan dbang du cung zad kyang ma shor ba mdzad/ tshogs gtam la yang / khyed rang tsho yang skabs 'dir smon4lam btab nas 'ongs pa red de/ nga yang khyed tsho'i gnyen por smon lam btabatshonas 'ongs pa yin zhes dang / sngon nas da lta'i bar du sdig pa mi dge ba la goms pa'i bdud rigs khyed tshos /chi dgon pa 'di bshig thub mi yonge / ring bor mi thogs par chos skyong srung ma tshos khyod tsho la rtags bstan yong / khyed tshos nga rgas 'dug pas myur byu shi yong zer nas bshad kyin 'dug ste/ bstan pa thabs cad kyi 'byung khungs dgon pa 'di'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i srol bzang po 'di bstan pa'i bdag —po cig la ma sprad par shi na ngas khyed tsho'i dri chu 'thung ba dang khyad med ces pa dang / khyed tsho'i ske la rdo btegs nas bsang chu'i nang du 'phangs kyang tshe 'dir 'ong rgyu med pa gzhir bzhag ste/ phyi ma la yang 'ong rgyu yod med mi shes zhes gsungs pa 'di dag ma mtha' sa dang po yan chad kyi rtogs pa nig brnyes pa'i gsung du lung rigs la sbyangs pa

——— gdan bas dges 341rnams kyis dpyad na shes sla'o/ / yang khyed tshos gros ci byed gi yod pa ngas shes/ nga la nyin par mis ribashad gi yod/ mtshan mo 'dres bshad gi yod gsungs pa ni chos srung rnams kyis 'phrin las— sgrub pa'i gsung du snang la/ khong tsho'i rmi lam du yang bud med dre'u zhon pa dang / tsholhas chen zhal ngo sogs kyis brdung bsdigs byed pa dang / glang dang g.yag gis bdas pa sogs rmis na phyi nyin rje 'dis tshogs gtam zhig mdzad rgyu'i ltas 'khrul ba med —par mi bsrun pa'i skye bo de dag gis gleng ba'ang thos so/ /der ma zad bla chen dpon chen 'ga' zhig gi khyim du zhag tu bsdad phyin nad kyis thebs pa dang / thug chom gyi sgra sgrogs pa/ yo byad ci rigs mi snang bar 'gro ba sogs rgyal 'gong mngon sum du yod pa lta bu byung bar rje 'di zhag cho bzhugs re mdzad pas thul song ba shin tu mang zhing / gza' gdon gzugs dngosatsho su bestan nas sku'i nye 'khor du mtshan mo gcig 'da' bar byas kyang glags ma rnyed pa'i rgyus grags che la/ sbyin bdag cig la klu gdon gyi gnod pas tshe mthar mi 'khyol ba'i dar sri mi rabs ga sum bzhi 'i bar du byung bar/ rim gro zhig mdzad pas sbrul 'dra ba'i srog chags dmar nag mtho gsum tsam yod pa zhig dngosasu byung ste rnam 'gyur sna tshogs bstan nas mthar khri'i 'og hūṃ zhugs te mi snang bar gyurno pa zhabs phyi thams cad kyis mthong ba dang / dgon pa'i gling du 'brum nad mched pa'i lo gcig lnga mchod kyi dgu gtor la phebs skabs me bkra shin tu 'tshubs shing / me lce phyir 'khyil nasi sku lus mgo mjug gang yang mi

342 gdasgru ra dpa mthong bar dkris pas thams cad 'jigs zhum pa zhig byung yang gtor ma 'phangs pa dang me yang rang zhi la song zhing sku'i cha shas gzhan lta zhog zhwa sgro la yang me stag tsam gyi skyon ma byung zhing thag ring gi dngos po du ma me lces gnod pa mthong nas grwa rgan rnams kyis ya mtshan gyi gtam da lta'i bar du gleng ba sogs mthu stobs nus pa'i dbang por grub pa'i lo rgyus thin tu mang ngo / / des na rje bla ma 'di nyid lugs gnyis kyi yon tan zad du byung ba'i sgo nas kun mkhyen mchog gi 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar po ma nyams par bzung ba'i bka' drin zla med pa zhig yin par ma zad ma cig lab kyi sgron ma dang / lha dang chos skyong du mas lung bstan gyi me tog gis mngon par bsngags pa zhig yin snang ste/ kun mkhyen sprul pa'i sku rin po che gdan sar bkod pa'i rjes tsam du bu slob rnams kyis gsol 'debasathig gnang dgos zhus par/ 'jam dpal zhi khro dgyes bzhad rdo rje yi/ /bzhed don sgrub par myur mdzad mgon po sogs/ /bstan srung du mas lung bstan chos kyi rje/ /blo bzang don grub zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes bstsal pas kyang shes so/ /'di'ilung bstan tshul ji ltar yin zhus pas /sgro skur du ma song tsam yod ces gsungs par bu slob che bgres rnams kyi zhal nas thos la rang gi rnam rtog la shar ba'i gtam gong du bkod zin pa ltar ro/ / dgung lo don gnyis pa la khri zur bzhugs mdzad cing de skabs zhal nas da dgon pa 'di'i chos srid gnyis ka bdag po la 'phrod pas bsam

—— 'a ji rjo /lha ()phyi ji/midon thams cad grub pa yin/ lo kha shas la sos bde mor bsdad nas pha bla ma'i mchog sprul gyi mdzad pa 'phrin las la mjal kha zhu rgyu yin gsungs thing / de nas bzung ste sku ma 'das kyi bar du phal cher bcad rgya lta bu'i tshul du bzhugs/ dgung lo don bzhi ba me stag gi lo cung zad bskung ba'i tshul mdzad par zhabs brtan sgrub rtsis byas kyang nga rang gi kha 'don 'gro 'dug bza' btung gang la yang skyon zhugs pa med pas khyed rang tsho sems bde mo gyis gsungs nas zhabs brtan sogs sgrub ma bcugaskyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang stong skor dgon du phebs rgyu'i snyan gsan phul bar re zhig bzhugs dgos pa 'dra yang gang ciligrwa sgrig tshar 'dug pas thugs bzhed ltar mdzod ces zhus/ nyin gcigapyinye gnas khyab bya ngag dbang dpal bzang zer bar nga rang gtsang spyod la 'gro dgos pas khyod kyis rogs shig gyis gsungs/ khos ci byed na snyam phyin pas gtsang spyod nas tshur phebs skabs khyod kyis nga khur la 'dug sar skyol gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas thugs mnyes te bzang bzang yong ba 'dug gsungs/de skabs sku mtshams shig gi mjug nas lo gcig gi ring la dbu skra dang sma ra ma bzhar bar bzhag yod pas / nye gnas kyis dbu skra bsil na zhus pas / rgya gar na grub chen rnams kyi dbu skra dang sma ra 'jog pa'i srol yod pas ngas grub chen gyi gras su 'tshang kha cig byas pa yin gsungs/gzhi nas rje 'di nyid sku'i zil shin tu che bas rgyus med rnams sku mthong ma thag tu ha las 'gro ba dang / spobs pa shin tu mtho ba rnams kyang mthong ba tsam gyis 'jigs zhum par 'gro ba zhig yod ces zhal mngon du gyur pa

344 gedagirji dasnyo rnams mthun par—gleng zhing khyad par 'di dus dbu skra sma ra sogs kyis gzi brjid lhag par che jes/ bdag gi bla ma grub dbang bsori nams grags pa'i zhawonas/ de skabs mdun du phyin na dpal phyag na rdo rje dngos kyi ram pa 'char ba 'dug gsungs/ de nas sku khams dzorim lod du song ste hor bla drug pa'i tshesapanyi shu'i tho rangs khar gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad/ de skabs dang por sku gzugs sgur ba'i rnam pa can lta bu zhig yod kyang dpon slob ngag dbang bstan 'dzin pa gdung mdun du phebs te/ der 'khod kyi grwa ba rnams dang bcas sbyana'adren khrusadzi gsol byas pa na rim gyis je dratna la song ba der 'khod tshang mas mthong snang / gdung zhugs 'bul gyi nyin skas kyi them pa dog pas mi mang po thar dka' zhing / mi gcig gis gdung mi theg pas ci byed thag ma chod pa'i skabs/nye gnas ngag dbang dpal bzang gis sngar gyi gsung dang mdzad pa dran nas lo rgyus bsnyad pas khur nus pa byung / zhugs la phul skabs sgyud shing 'phen tshul nyes pas rus tshigs gzhan 'thor kyang dbu'i rus pa cung zad kyang ma grug cing mdog dung ltar dkar ba zhig byung ste gdung rtags 'di 'dra phyir mi ldotshi pa'i rtags su dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar du 4 gsungs so/ / de nas grwa tshang gdung rus spyan 'dren la byon skabs khri rin po ches dbu'i rus pa ma nyams pa grwa mang la bstan/ tshems brtsis nas bzhi bcu tshang bas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ gdung rus kyi khrod na dbu skra thams cad snyogs gcig tu song ba cung zad kyang ma nyams par gos skud dhe

gedan—bas dasdo 3yobyekyi chun po lta bu zhig byung ba yang thams cad kyis mthong bas deng sang gi bar du ngo mtshar du 'dzin par snang ngo / / rje 'di la ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar ba mang du yod 'dug rung sngar phyogs gcig tu bris pa zhig mi 'dug pas / 'dir ni bdag gi bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang blo bzang snyan grags/ smra ba'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang rgyal/ grub dbang bsod nams grags pa/ khri chen rab brtan rgya mtsho bzhi rje 'di'i dngos slob thun mong ma yin pa yin pas de dag gis ji ltar gsungs pa'i gsung rgyun dang / gzhan yang dus 'khor dpon slob mkhas dbang blo bzang rin chen sogs slob ma drag shos gzhan gyi gsung las ji ltar thos pa dang / rje nyid kyi dngos slob brag dkaru dpon slob kun dga' bkra shis bas kyang rnam thar gyi sa bon lta bu'i lo rgyus sna tshogs bris pa'i nang du thor bu gang yod kyis kha bskangs te bris pa yin zhing da dung dpyod ldan gzhan gyis ngag sgros khungs ldan rnyed na zur gdab par rigs so/ / smras pa/ lung rigs smra la dbang 'byor rtog ge'i gtso/ /bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rig sngags 'chang / lugs gnyis gzigs pha'i mkhyen dgongs mes po'i zla/ /khyod ni nges par blo bzang don yod grub/ /yid la re ba'i skya rengs shar tsam gyis/ /'dod pa'i don gyi nyi sa 'od po che/ /mngon par gsal byed rta ljang shing rta ni/ /bsod namarsā dpung la sa gzhan pa su zhig dmigs/ /dam pa'i rnam thar rnam dkar

346 gad babyu da rgyu 'bras kyi/ /rangasubazhin yid la 'grogs pas yid dul zhing / /rtag tu brtul zhugs snying bor mnyam bzhag pa'i/ /skyes bu bran du gyur kyang lha miligatso/ /zhes pa yang bar skabs su tshigs su bcad de smras so// // gdan rabs bzhi ba rje ngag dbang bstan 'dzi na / gdan rabs bzhi ba 'dul 'dzin chegapo ngag dbang bston 'dzin pa ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me byi la rnga ba'i yul du spro tshig ces pa'i rus su 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas kha gya'i bla ma 'gyang ro zer ba'i skye ba yin tshul mang du gleng na yang sus kyang nyan 'jog ma byas pas/ skabs shig dbon po btsan po ma de phyogs su song bar byis pa kho rang gis 'phrin bskur ba yin yang zer gang ltar 'gyang ro'i bla ma gur dmar gser tog can gyi dbon po rnams kyis nyer spyad kha shas khyer nas song ste ngos 'dzin bcug par phreng rdog 'ga' zhig bsal te nga'i ma red zer ba sogs cung nezad kyang ma 'khrul ba byung bas kha gya'i sgar du gdan drangs/ ma ni pa shes rab bkra shis de phyogs su byon pa'i drung du dge tshul bsgrubs/ re zhig kha gya'i sgar du bzhugs kyang mkhas mang zhig gi khrod du thos bsam gsha' ma zhig byed 'dod cher skyes pa dang / 'jam mgon khri rin po ches kyang gsung phrin bskur bas rkyen byas/ bros stabs kyis bkra shis 'khyil du byon/ dgon pa mthong ba dang tshogs dung 'bud pa dus mnyam

gdan rab dasos/ 347du byung / yul mi rnams sleb dogs nas thog mar bla brang du phebs te rje gong mar mjal bas khyod la de ring rten 'brel ga 'dra byung gsungs/dgon pa mthong dus tshogs dung 'bud ki 'dug zhus par/ nged 'bras spungs su mjal ba'i dus kyi rten 'brel de ring khyod la 'grigs pas dgon par phan thogs 'ong gsungs/ 'di de ring tshogs su gral mgor sdod chug gsungs nas zhabs phyi zhig gi zhwa zlam bsgron/ gsol dpon shes rab dpal ldan la khyod kyis khrid gsungs pa ltar/ khong gis tshogs su khrid nas bka' ltar gral mgor bzhugs su bcug chos grwar yang de nyin zhugs shing 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon mdzad de bsdus grwa yongs rdzogs gsan pa'i zin bris kyang yod par grags/ dus rgyun khang steng du skyor sbyangs mtshan 'phud dang / char sogs kyi rkyen byung tshe rdo sogs 'bar 'bur mang pos bzhugs mal gzims mi bro ba zhig byas nas skyor sbyangs mdzad/dbu phar gnyis bshad pa dang bcas yongs rdzogs dang / 'dul mdzod gnyis kyang khri chen nyid la gsan zhing phar phyin gyi skabs dang po gsum gyi gsung zin bris kyang mdzad pa bdag gis kyang mthong la/ skabs lhag malizin bris kyang yod par grags/ dbu ma snga phyir tshar gnyis gsan zhing lung rigs gter mdzod phyis su dgung lo mtho ba'i skabs su yang skyor rgyu yod ces dngos slob rnams gsungs/ dgung lo zhe gsum gyi bar du khri rin po che de nyid 'bral med du bsten nas sde snod kyi bshad pa gang gnang ma lus par gsan pas dge bshes chen por gyur/ /gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs dang cho ga phyag len zhib par mkhyen cing / kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras kyi

348 gdan bas dpasakyi drung du mi tra brgya rtsa sogasachos mang du gsan/ 'a jam mgon khri rin po ches kyang dbachinge rjes gnang sogs kyi skabs mchod g.yog byed du bcug ste cung zad 'phyug pa la yang bka' bskyan dang phyag 'bebasasdusogs slobaphyom gzhan las lhag pa'i gceso spras mdzad/ dzee gong ma'i mdun nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa nas bzung ste sku ma 'das kyi bar du phyi dro'i kha zas til 'bru tsam yang gsol ma myong zhing / mtshan mo tsog bu'i rnal 'byor kho na mdzad pa sogs mdo sngagasamikyi mkhyen rgya dang zhi dul gyi kun spyod 'dzoms pas bgres gzhon kun la rtsi (brtsi)'jog dang dag snang che bar byung / dpon ju nang yab tsom gnyis kyis mthong dang dad gus shin tu che zhing / rje gong mas kyadzwabyur dkar gyi phyag phreng zhig bor song ba rje 'di dang rab 'byams pa nam mkha' bsam grub gnyis kyis rnyed nas phul bas khyed rang gnyis kyis bgos gsungs/ khong gnyis nas phreng ba cha gcig dang / rgyan cha gcig byas te rgyan 'phangs pas rje 'dis phreng ba thob par kho rang gis rten 'brel 'phyug mi yong gsungs pa sogs thugs mnyes pa'i bka' phebs yang yang 'byon par dngos slob du mas gsungs/ tshul khrims kyi dri ngad rgyang ring po'i bar du 'thul bas rgyus med rnams kyang yid dbang med du 'phrog pa zhig yin 'dug smon lam rarba 'byams pa'i mtshan btags mjod nas da phyin chad gral mgor sdod rgyu min/ ming btags kyi gral mtshams dzñabasdad na chog gsungs nas der bzhugs pa ni dman cha la dgye sa pa'i rnam thar du snang / de phyin chad grwa rkyang gi rdang (ngang )tshugs kho na mdzad nas 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i zhabs phyir phebs skabs sogs

na ra sa da 340khyed thun la bzhugs mi dgos zhus na yang nan gyis bzhugs pa dang /phyis su bsnyung g.yog kyang mdzad pa sogs bla ma'i zhabs tog sngon gyi dam sku rnam thar dang mthun pa mdzad/ tshogs chen zhal ngo dang rgyud pa bla ma dbu mdzad pa yang byas shing / de skabs sde khri rin po che dgung lo bdun cur phebs pa dang sku gzugs ha cang lci ba'i stabs rje 'dis slob chung ba byas nas lo gnyis kyi ring la mtshan nyid grwa tshang la brtsi bzhag gnang zhing skyabs mgon mchog gi yongs 'dzin kyang mdzad/ de nas sde khri rin po che zur bzhugs mdzad skabs skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dang /ching dbang (wang)bstan 'dzin dbang phyug sde khri rin po che thun mong nas tshogs chen gyi khrir bskos/ bsdus grwa'i brtsi bzhag thugs thog nas gnang zhing 'chad nyan dang gtong sgo sngar rgyun ma nyams pa mdzad/ —sa 'brug lo khri zur bzhugs gnang ste/ yun ring po'i bar du thugs dam zab mo'i nyams bzhes nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu mjod/ lan cig sku drang bor bsrang / phyag mnyam bzhag mdzad dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad nas bzhugs 'dug par/ grwa slob rnams kyis myangan las 'das par thag bcad de chos gos phul zhing dbu rgyan sgron/ mchod rdzas bsdu bshams byas/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gdan 'dren zhus par spyan 'dren khrus gsol dang / smon lam chos spyod 'ga' zhig gsungs nas phebs pas thams cad nyams mtshar ba zhig byung / nyin zhag gsum nas slar man la sad pa lta bu zhig mdzad de khyed rang tshos ci zhig byas pa yin sogs rgyus med kyitshegatam mang po gsungs/ khong la ci byung zhus pas nga gnyid song

wa3gi zha— kai—ḍi————1lda / ba lta bu zhig byung ba las gzhan ci yang ma gsungs pas 'ga' zhig gis sems dben gyitshu'od gsal mngon du mdzad dam zer ba byung / de nas yang lo gcig tsam gyi ring la thugs dam gong 'phel gyi mur bzhugs pa las dgung lo re bdun pa chu rta la gshegs so/ / // gdan rabs lnga ba rje ngag dbang bstan ba'i rgyal mtshan/ gdan rabs lnga ba khri chen mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che ngag ske dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni/ dga' ldan khri rin po che dge 'dun phun tshogs ba'i skudzeeskye ba ste/ khri chen de nyid ni dbal shul gyi rigs las gcal zhes bya ba'i yul du 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nagorab tu byung ste bstan pa'i sgor zhugs/ gangs can rigs smra bye ba'i mdun sa dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar bka' pota chen po lnga la sbyangs pas gzhung lugs 'bum sdelidagongs don rigs lam nas smra ba lke la 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas pa'i go 2phang thob/ dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang du yang gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs la cher sbyangs pas mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rje dzadzin pa chen por gyur pa'i snyan grags dbyar gyi rnga gsang ldir ba bzhin du byung ste/ smad rgyud grwa tshang gi khri dang / byang rtserigadan sa dang / rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bzhugs sa/dan gser khrir rim bzhin phebs nas bstan pa nyin mo ltar

dan rabs dpa / 351gsal bar mdzad/ zhal slob kyang mchog sprul pad dkar 'dzin pa ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan/ rgyud smad mkhan po dge 'dun lhun grub/ sgo mang dpon slob blo bzang dam chos/rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku ye shes grags pa/ grub pa'i dbang phyug don yod mkhas grub/ a ka bsod nams bzang po/ bkra shis 'khyil khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis/ sde khri rin po che blo bzang don 'grub sogs mtha' yas shing cun gar nas se 'bras dag ther gyi skabs grwa ba lnga brgya dus gcig la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad pa'i ming la dge 'dun sha stag sbyar bar dge 'dun pa lnga brgya zhes grags pa'i khrod nas kyang dpon slob dge 'dun bde chen sogs grags can mang du byon/ lha sa'i rgyud khang dang gsang sngags mkhar gyi rgyud khang / 'grel ba bzhi sprags kyi par gsar brkos/ sgo mang grwa khang du gser gyi rgyal mtshan cha sogs gsar 'jog dang / dga' ldan gyi dngul gdung chen mo gser gdung du bsgyur pa dang / rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshor dngul srang sum stong lnga brgya dod du phul nas zhus pa ltar/ phyis su khri ngag dbang mchog ldan pa'i smad rgyud par glang ra'i gzhis ka bde mchog sgrub mchod kyi thebs su gzhung nas gnang ba sogs phyag rjes rlabs che la/ skuliskye greng gi dbang du byas na rje btsun shes rab seṅge / grub chen te lo ba zer ba'ang snang / nā ro ta ba sogs dang thugs rgyud gcig par khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan/ 'jam mgon khri rin po che/ grub dbang sde khri rin po che gsum kas gsungs pa dang / gnyan lo tsā pa dar ma grags yang thugs rgyud gcig par khong

362 gdan ngabs da / nyid kyis zhal gyis bzhes zhes lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i gsu/nga rgyun 'khrul med thos la chung ngu 'i dus nga cho sa pa yin gsungs pas chos pa rin po cher yang bzhed par snang ngo / /zhal nas kyang bdag 'dzin 'di a re 'jigs/ kho bo mdo smad du rkang ba na nas gsang bdag gi bsnyen pa byas/ lha'i nga rgyal bzung ba'i tshe nyi dkyil gyis rkang ba tsha'am snyam pa shar zhes grub dbang stobs ldan sngags rams pad la gsungs/ yang nga gsang ba 'dus pa'i ched du'obya rbe'i gdul bya yin snyam pa yod kyang rlung rgyu lugs 'dus pa dang mi mthun4pa 'dug kho bo gzhon dus nas rtsa rlung thig le rang grol du yod ces khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan la gsungs paralcang skya rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs zhes skyabs mgon mcho ri—/ gi zhal nas thos te gsung de gnyis ni rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor lhan skyes snyoyod pa'i brdar gdon mi za'o/ / dgung lo re gcig pa shing sbrulā la zhi blor gshegs te gdung zhugasaul phul ba la lus dkyil gyi lha gnas so sor bde mchog gi lha yongs rdzogs byon kyang sgo mtshamyas ma brgyad yongs grags khyi gnas dang mi mthun par gnas gzhan du byon/ de'i nang nas thugasal bde mchog zhal phyag yongs rdzogs byon pa khri no mon han gyis bzhes nas gsang sngags mkhar gyi 'jigs byed kyi nang rten du bzhugs/ ri mthe bong g.yas pa la rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i sku byon pa rje rang gi gcung 'tsho byed ngag dbang dar rgyas kyis rang yul du gdan drangs pa khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis pas bzhe sa nas da lta bkra shis 'khyil gyi byams pa'i gtsang khang gi nye sras nang

— — dge—ngabs da / 353 tshotshan kun tu bzang po'i thug sa khar bzhugs/ gzhan yang rna lteg g.yas su spyan ras gzigs/ g.yon du sgrol ma sogs sku dang ring bsrel gyi gong bur gyur ces rnam thar gyi zin bris shig las 'byung ngo / / de ltar sku gshegs la nye ba na khri chen no mon han dang phyag mdzod rab 'byams pa ngag dbang phun tshogs sogs kyis da dung bstan 'gro'i tre don du zhabs pad brtan dgos tshul dang / zhing gzhan du thugs dgongs gtad pa cis kyang bsgyuranemi btub tshe/ nged cag rnams la brtse bas dgongs te yang srid 'khrul bral zhig cis kyang 'byon dgos zhes yang yang nan gyis zhus pas / sems ngal mi dgos/ spyir dzeeji rin po che'i bstan pa dang khyad par rang gi bla ma kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i legs bshad dar sa zhig la 'dun pa gtong gsungs/ yu/la phyogs ga 'dra zhig la ang nyan byas na dga' zhus par/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dang la mo chos skyong gnyis la zhus gsungs/ tshung bstan thams cad mthun par dga' ldan gyi nye 'dabs cha zhes bya ba'i yul du ang nyan gyis gsungs pa ltar/ der yum la bsnyun sogs med sprur yongs grags kyi mngal las mtho tsam du byis pa zhig chags shing / yab yum la ngo mtshar ba'i rmi lam gyi mtshan ma mang du byung / lus kyi phyir mngon tsam byung ba na lha rje 'ga' zhig gis skran du go nas yuyol sman mang du phu la zhing bsnyung bar bzhugs ba cug pas / zla grangs rdzogs pa na shel sgong lta bu'i phru ma'i nang na yod pa'i byis pa zhig btsas shing / phru ma bsal pa'i cho ga byas pa na sku nyams shin tsongan nasngo baspred bsring ba'i cho ga byas kyang ma

354 gdan da sa da wa—da wa phan par zla ba gsum tsam nas sku grongs so/ /slar yang rgyal ba yab sras dang chosaskyong khag nas sngar gyi der ang nyan gyis gsungs pa ltar rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me lug gi lo mchog gi sprul pa'i sku 'di nyid sngar gyi yab yum de ka la 'khrungs/ de'i tshe lung bstan kun mthun par sprul sku 'khrul med yin pas tshur myur bar blangs nas gtsang sbra byas na legs gsungs pa ltar/ dgung lo gsum pa'i tshe yum dang bcas gung thang du gdan drangs te bzhugs shing tshogs mang la mjal kha yang gnang ba shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su snang / sku na shin tu phra ba'i skabs su yang zhogs kha snga bar bzhengs te skyabs 'gro dang dmigs brtse ma 'dron pa dang / nga'i yul a mdon yod sogs sngon gnas rjes dran gyi gsung 'byon pa dang / sku rtsed mdzad pa na yang chos 'chad pa bgro gleng gtong ba dam bca' 'arjog pa liṅka bsgral chog gi rnam pa mdzad pa sogs dam pa'i spyod pa lhun gyis grub pa byung / dgung lo lnga ba'i tshe bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa rgyal sras ye shes grags pa'i drung du gtsug phud phul te mtshan ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du btags/ dgung lo bdun pa'i tshe mkhan po de nyid las tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos shing blang dor gyi gnang bkag phra mo tsam las nam yang mi 'da' bar mdzad/ lo der bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar phebs/tsha kho zangs dkar gyi rab zhabyams pa bsod nams dar rgyas sam dge bshes yangs pa can du grags pa dge rgan du bsten nas bsdus gzhung la sbyangs/ 'jigs byed kyi cho ga dang 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi zhal

gdadag —da wa 355'don chag med mdzad cing sgo mang dpon slob blo bzang dam chos pa'i drung du tshig bzhag dang bka' chos 'ga' zhig kyang gsan/ dgung lo dgu pa'i tshe rgyal dbang bdun pa mgar thar nas lha sar phebs par mjal kha zhus pas rgyal dbang mchog dang / khri chen no mon han/ lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa sogs kyis bkur gzos thin tu che ba mdzad/ sngar khri chen de nyid nas rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa 'gran zla med pa'i bla mar bzung nas bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas mnyes pa tshad med pa bsgrubs shing yab sras rnams nas jo bo rin po che'i drung du mdosmad du bstan pa spel ba'i thugs smon phyogs gcig tu gnang ba dang / kun mkhyen rin po che mdo smad du chibs bsgyur skabs dung dkar po dri ma med pa phyag tu phul te khyed kyi legs bshad dar ba'i phyogs der bdag gis chos kyi dung sgrog par shog cig ces smon lam btab pa'i rten 'brel gyi 'bras bu smin pa'i dus la babs pa na 'di nas 'jam mgon khri rin po che dang / grub dbang sde khri rin po che gnyis nas dpon ju nang mi'i dbang mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma la yang yang snyan bskul zhus par brten lo 'dir rgyal dbang mchog gi 'tshams zhus dang / dpon ju nang gi dgongs rdzogs sgrub pa dang sprags te rje 'di gdan 'dren zhu ba'i ched du dpon tshang nas dar han the'i ji/ jo rig thu em chi/ er khe je sang gsum dbus su mngags te/ mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi drung du snga sor bla ma 'di gdan 'dren gyi ched gzhung sar zhu ba lan gsum phul yang ma gnang / da res cis kyang gnang dgos zhes dpon ju nang gi skang ra'i rnam pa'i zhal chems dang / de mtshungs

da wa366 gidzān ma sa da dngo na mo rnamā rgyal sgol mas kyang zhu yig dang ngag ma nan can phul bar mi dbang nas/ dpon /dā'i ching ho shu'i chi yab yum bugs bden kyang sngon chad paṇa chen rin po che'i brtag pa ma chud/ / da res pāṇa chen rin po che nas brtag pa chud na gang gsung ltar las med ces bka' phebs/ paṇa thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes nas gungatsho thang sprul sku da lo phebs na mdo smad du bstanaci 'gror phan thogs yong gsungs pasami dbang nashā dgongs pa khrol/ rgyal dbang rin po cher thon phyag zhus par khyed kyi sku gong ma cigazhan dang mi 'dra zhing / sku tshe 'dir yang sngon gyi thugs nesmon khyad par can yod pas da lam lo gsum tsam la mtsho sngon gyi phyogs su 'gro don mdzod/ lo gsum nas yar phebs te thugs gnyer bstan 'gro la dzon nges shig mdzad rngodagos sogs dgyes pa'i bslab bya mang po mdzad/ rgyal ba nyid kyi phyag gis tshe dpag med kyi sku byin can zhig gnang rīzhing ci gnan yang thon phyag spam mtho ba bstsal/ de mtshungs mi dbang nas kyang kho bos rgyal sa 'di len skabs mi mang po bsad pa'i sdig che bas khyed kyi thugs la 'dzin dgos/ phyogs gzhan la phebs 'jug rtsis med kyang dpon mo rnam rgyal 'di nga'i ma dang 'dra zhing yang yang bskyar bas da lan phebs dgos byung yang lo gsum nas cis kyang dbus su 'byon dgos gsungs nas thon phyag phon che ba nas bka' shog kyang gnang / khri chen no mon han ginas kyang sku gong ma de nyid rang gi bka' drin gsum ldan gyi bla ma yin pas gus pas phu dud bya ba'i gnas su bzung ste mjal kha zhus nas phebs rdzong rme (rdzongs )rgya che ba bstar zhing mchod yon zung gi bka' gnang ltar nga rgad

dan bsadarngo / ṭaṃ52wa po yod ring la cis kyang phebs dgos zhes thugs 'phrangs pa'i gsung dang bslab bya mang po bstsal/ 'bras spungs nas chibs bsgyur skabs grwa chang nas thal skad dang dar yug sogs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs shing lha sar mchod mjal zhib rgyas mdzad de rim gyis mdo smad du byon par 'bri chu nas bzung ste dpon tshang gi bsu ba snga phyi du ma dang rma chu nas rim gyis gang ci'i yo byad nam mkha' mdzod lta bus legs par bsnyen bkur ba dang bcas me 'brug gi dbyar under phyag phebs shing dbyar thog der bzhugs/ dpon tshang nas su rug dang lha sde shwa bo chu nag gi sa cha sogs phul te shangs len kyang yang dag par bsgrubs/ de skabs khri rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis pa sog yul du phebs pa'i zhar la rta bco lnga sogs kyi phyag rten dang bcas sku mdun du mjal te/ khyed kyi sku gong mas kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang lhan du thugs smon dang zhal bzhes ji ltar gnang ba ltar bkra shis 'khyil du phebs dgos zhes zhu ba phul bas mtshams sbyar te lo de'i ston ka bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs/ 'jam mgon khri rin po che dang grub dbang sde khri rin po che gnyis nas khri chen sku gong ma de nged rang tsho'i bka' drin 'khor med kyi bla ma yin gsungs nas bkur gzos che bar mdzad/ khri rin po ches rje 'di ba'i thugs gnyer gyi ched du bsdus grwa zhig kyang ched gnyer gyis brtsams te da lta bsdus grwa rgyas pa zhes grags pa rtsom 'phro can 'di yin no/ /sa rta'i lo grub dbang sde khri rin po che khrir phebs pa'i drung nas bsdus grwa'i'aphro dang blo rtags dbu phar bcasasko gsan te/ dgung lo nyi shu ba me

358 gad sad /stag gi bar du mdo sngags kyi gsan bsam rgya chen po mdzad/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi drung nas byams chos lnga/ 'jug pa/ rigs tshogs/ mdzod dang rnam 'grel gyi rtsa ba sogs kyi lung gsan cing /de dag gi 'grel ba dang 'grel bshad spyi thal sogs la zhib tu gzigs nas dpyad pa 'ba' zhig mdzad pas tshig spyi tsam ma yin par don gyi gnad thams cad rjen par shar bas thos bsam ci tsam mdzad pa thams cad rtogs pa'i bogs 'don du 'gyur ba zhig yod par snang ste/ gsung rab kyi don la dpyod pa dang bcas skyor sbyangs mdzad pa na spyan chab dbang med du 'chor ba zhig yod par mnyam du skyor sbyangs mdzad pa rnams kyis gleng ba thos so/ /tshad ldan gyi rdo rje slob dpon du ma bsten te yi dam du ma'i dbang dang rjes gnang bskyed rdzogs du ma'i bshad pa dang khrid mtha' yas pa gsan ske cing / de'i yan lag gar thig dbyangs gsum rol mo rdung lugs tshun chad kyang zhib tu bslabs pas gsang sngags la mkhas pa'i tshad du phyin/de yang sngags za chos su khyer ba ma yin par bstan pa thugs la bcang nas bka' dam dog che zhing / phyag len re mdzad pa na yang gang zhib zhib gnang bas tha na bum pa'i kha rgyan 'jog lugs dang / bsang chu 'thor lugs/ bgegs gtor tsam bshams lugs kyang byed dka' ba zhig yod ces drung du btud pa'i grwa slob rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu gleng ngo / /rong bo mer gan chos rje ngag dbang rgya mtsho dang 'tsho byed ngag dbang nor bu sogs tha snyad rig pa'i slob dpon du ma bsten te/ sgra dang snya na

da wa gdanawarabasas dzras/ 359ngag rtsis dkar nag sman dang sdeb sbyor sogs zhib tu sbyangs pas kun bshad kyi ma tshan tshangs sras dgyes pa'i rdo rje zhes lnga rig smra ba yongs kyi dbus na mkhas pa'i snyan pa mngon par mtho zhing gsung rtsom gyi rim pa yang mang du snang / lar sku gsung thugs kyi kun spyod mtha' dag sngon gyi bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar las mi 'da' zhing / rtag tu dman cha kho na bzhes te che tshugs dang 'gyig bag mi mdzad par tshogs su phebs skathas su yang sgo 'phyor nas skyor sbyangs dang / rdo bcal nas phyag sbyangs mdzad nas bzhugs pa dang / chos thog gi dgung ja tsam yang chag med du 'grims pas/ las sne brtsi thal ches pa lta bus dgung ja gcig gi rjes ma zin pa'i dbang gis dge bskos kyis kyug pa btang ba'i lo rgyus kyang snang / gsung ngag shin tu 'jam zhing gsong bor smra ba las log sgrub ji ltar byas kyang tshig tsub lta zhog zhal 'gyur ba tsam yang mi mdzad par spyan sngar nye ba'i skye bo thams cad mgrin gcig tu gleng ba thos la/ thugs dran shes kyis rgyun du bcings pas gang mdzad bstan 'gro'i don ma gtogs/da res phyogs lhung dang rang don gyi 'khri ba cung zad kyis gos zhes bya ba zhig gang gi yang dran lam du 'gyur ba tsam yang med la bstan 'gro'i don du 'gyur na lus srog la yang ltos pa med pa'i rgyal sras snying stobs chen po rnams kyi rnam thar bdag gir mdzad pa yin snang ste mgon po'i gtor sgrub kyi smra bcad zhig gi skabs yid glur blangs pa slar yi ger bris pa'i gsung mgur las/ tha chad kyi yul dus 'di lta bur/ /bstan pa dang 'gro la phan thogs shig /bdag 'dra yis sgrub pa dka' na yang / /snying stobs

360 gdan nga daso dang brtson 'grus cher bskyed nas/ /bshad sgrub kyi bya ba la 'bad na/ /bstan 'gro la phan pa 'byung srid na/ /sgyu ma yi lus 'di ring 'tsho zhing / rnam dkar gyi bya ba yar zla ltar/ /'phel rgyas su 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ /gal te na gzhan phan nam mkha' yi/ /pad mo yi mched zlar nges 'gyur na/ /tshe 'di yi snang ba myur 'gags nas/ /phan pa dang bde ba'i legs tshogs sam/ /kun mkhyen gyi bstan pa rin chen la/ /rgya chen gyi phan pa sgrub nus pa'i/ /dal 'byor gyi lus rten gsar ba yi/ /dga' ston la myur du spyod pa'i grogs/ /myur mdzad kyi mgon po nyid rang mkhyen/ /de skad kyi gsol 'debs glu chung 'di/ /snying khong nas min par kha tsam zhig /yin na ni mthu ldan tshogs rnams kyis/ /bdag nyid kyi mgo bo stong du khos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bstan pa'i rgyun la dgongs nas mtshan nyid kun ldan gyi slob dpon du ma 'bad pas btsal te dbang lung rjes gnang zab khrid sogs mtha' yas pa zhig gsan snang yang brir mi lang bas gsan yig tu shes so/ /de ltar mang thos nam mkha' ltar rgya chen po mdzad pa yang / gcig tu rgyal ba'i bstan pa thugs la bcang ba'i rnam thar yin te/ nyid kyi gsan yig rin chen phreng mdzes las/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bstan pa'i nyin mor byed/ /chu lha'i phyogs kyi sa 'dzin rtse mor gzhol/ /lnga phrag snyigs ma'i grib so rim gyis 'phel/ /phan bde'i pad tshal nyams pa'i dus mtha' 'dir/ /thos dang bsam pas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kyang / /nyams rtogs 'bras bu smin du re ba'i tshe/ /nadi snang rnyed

gdanarabasadaso / 361 wabakur snyan grags phun tshogs kyis/ /mgo bo bskor nas gtan 'dun ci yang brlag /'du byas mi rtag chos kun bden med ces/ /lung rigs gad rgyangs smra bo phal che ba/ /rtag par 'dzin dang bdag lta a 'thas su/ /song bar mthong tshe shes ldan gad mo bro/ /yid 'ong rgyan dang ldan pa'i ba lang dang / /lo 'dab mdzes par g.yo ba'i e rartse/ /thos dang bral ba'i deng dus sgom chen rnams/ /lta na sdug kyang don gyi snying bos dben/ /mi gtsang rdzas snod lus phrar chags gyur cing / /las 'bras khyad gsod dug gsum gdon gyis brlam/ /grub pa thob par khas 'che mang po zhig /nag chang spyod 'dis dang kha 'gags snyam byed //tshe sngon sbyangs pa'i dam pa'i bag chags brjed/ /blang dor 'byed pa'i blo gros dkor gyis bsgribs/ /'gro phan lhag bsam nyams pa'i sku skyelitshogs/ /zog rdzu rang mtshang ston la 'bad par byed/ /ches cher rmongs pa'i na kra'i grong khyer du/ /bsam ngan dug gis thar ba'i srog 'phrog cing / blun gtam 'brel med phud sgra sgrog byed pa'i/ /deng dus bshes gnyen phal cher sbrul gdug 'dra/ /dbang lung zab khrid rang gis ma mnos bzhin/ /zang zing mthong tshe lhug par 'doms pa rnams/ /tshenga'adir khe dang rgyal kha bzhes mdzod la/ /phyi ma mnar med gnas su mi 'gyod 'tshal/ /de ltar cher snyigs mi zad gcong rongs su (rong du)/ /spyod ngan dug gi tsher masdzatshogs 'khri gas pa'i/ /tshul 'dis skyengs te dam pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /zhi ba'i dbyings su gzims nas shugs ring 'byin/ /zhes bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'grib pa la thugs kyi gting nas

362 gad rab dalda mi bzod pa'i skyo ba 'khrungs tshul dang / /de 'dra'idus su rang nyid kyis thub bstan 'dzin skyong khur du bzhes pa'i tshul yang / de nyid las/bsregs bcad brdar ba'i sa le sbram bzhin du/ /dpyad gsum dag pa'i dam pa'i zhal lung rnams/ /nam mjug rdzogs pa'i dus kyi nyal 'gro bzhin/ /dus kyi dbang gis rim gyis je phrar gyur/ /'on kyang sngon bsags mi dman skya rengs kyis/ /drangs pa'i dal 'byor mi lus rta ljang can/ /bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas par byed pa 'di/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rten du kho bos thob/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs dran pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i rgud pa kun sel dam pa du ma bsten/ /bsten pa don ldan bgyid phyir phan bde'i legs tshogs ma lus 'byung gnas zab mo'i chos tshul mang zhig thos/ /thos grangs bsags tsam min par bsam dang bsgom pas dal 'byor rin chen rten bzang don ldan byas/ /byas tshul dam pa'i rnam thar rjes 'gro dran tshe tshangs sras dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i sems bag gcig tu dro/ /zhes dang / bdag blo dad pa'i sa bon grung bo las/ /rgya chen mang thos myu gu ci yang 'phel/ /gang de 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i nyin byed kyis/ /bla med thugs rje'i 'od kyis bskyangs pa las yang dag lam gyi 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i rtser/ /sku gsum rdo rje 'chang de cis mi 'khrungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar dgung lo bcu gcig nas nyi shu'i bar du phyogs gzhan du chibs ba skyod cher med par bkra shis 'khyil rang du mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gsan sbyong 'ba' zhig gtso bor byas nas sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis

gad rabs daldas/ 363dam chos thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i rnam thar phyag len la thebs par mja da/ dgung lo nyi shu ba la khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs pa'i thugs sras dam pa gnyan rtse dpon slob ngag dbang chos 'phel ba las thugs rdzogs bzhes pa dang / zab chos du ma gsan pa sogs kyi ched ngo yul du chibs bsgyur/ mjal ba tsam gyis dpon slob gnyis pha dang bu 'phrad pa lta bur gyur cing dam pa'i chos kyi gsung gleng dus 'da' bar mdzad/ brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i 'dul 'dzin chen po de nyid kyis mkhan slob sbrags ma mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i— dbus su bstan pa'i gzhi ma so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i yang rtse bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po nod de nges pa don gyi thub pa'i gdung 'tshob tu gyur/ gsang bde kun rig tshe dpag sogs kyi dbang dang /4 snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang sogs chos bka' yang mang du gsan/ khyad par bde mchog gi dbang gi skabs khri chen gyis rang la gnang ba'i rus rgyan yongs rdzogs sku la bsgron nas/ sngon khri chen de nyid kyis kho bol bde mchog gi dbang gnang skabs nyid kyi sku la bzhes pa'i rus rgyan yongs rdzogs gnang nas/ 'di slar khyod kyis nga la gtad dgos pa yod ces gsungs yod pa ltar da res khyed bdag po la 'phrod pa yin/ zhes gsungs nas dkyil 'khor gyi bdag por mnga' gsol bar mdzad/ gnyan rtse dpon slob rin po che 'di nyid cun gar gyi dus su rtsod pa'i batshodan thob pas dga' ldan shar rtse'i gdan sa gtad kyang mtshan mo gsang thabs kyis 4bros te mnga' ris skor gsum sogs 'grims/ rim gyis rang yul du

364 gdan rabs da byon nas sku tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms par mdzad pa mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi skyes bu dam pa zla dang bral ba zhig go / der chos kyi bzhed don thams cad legs par grub nas ma 'gyangs par gdan sa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du phyag phebs/ skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' dang grwa tshang nas kyang 'dun pa chig dril gyis gsol ba btab pa ltar rgyud pa grwa tshang gi khrir phebs te bde gsang 'jigasabyugasum gyi 'chad nyan sogs gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan ches cher bsgreng bar mdzad cing / rgyud kyi 'grig lam dang phyag len sogs dag ther bla na med pa mdzad/ snga sor ston khrid chen drug gi khrid skyong srol yod kyang / 'jam rdor 'khor chen dus 'khor sogs cho ga khyab bdal med stabs yun ring du gnas dka' bar dgongs te smad rgyud ltar rim lnga'i dmar khrid gcig dril du skyong ba'i srol tshugs pa da lta'i bar du yar rgyas su yod/rgyud kyi khrir bzhugs pa 'di nas mdzad 'phrin yang rgya che khyab bdal du byung ste zang zing gi 'du long dbyar gyi char sprin 'dus pa bzhin du gyur/de yang gdan sa 'di nyid du smad rgyud pa'i ga dngas dbyangs phyag len phal cher bla ma khri rgan tshang dang phun tshogs bstan 'dzin pa gnyis nas bslabs pa yin kyang bde mchog gi gdangs dbyangs zhib mo tshugs ma thub par yod pas / 'di skabs phun tshogs bstanartso'adzin pa dgung lo bgres kyangasngar rdo re dge slong zer ba la bslabs yod pa rje 'di nyid kyi bkas slar yang zhun thar bcad nas tshogs mang la zhib rgyas su bslab par phun tshogs bsnan 'dzin pas kyang gsan/ rdo re dge slong dbyangs rta mi 'chol ba'i —

/lordasdarjosadadzo 365ched du ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin du sdod bcug nas ri khrod du bde mchog gdangs dbyangs dang bcas pa tshugs/ ri khrod pa rdo re dge slong sku ma gshegs bar du bla ma'i bka' yin zer nas bde mchog sgrub mchod kyi skabs su rgyud khang gi rgya mthong (mthongs )nas dus rgyun du lta rtog byed pa zhig yod ces rgyud rgan rnams gleng ste bla slob tshang ma'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba'o/ /dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa 'brug hor zla dgu ba'i lha babs dus chen gyi nyin chos grwa chen po gang gi mi 'jigs chos kyi khri la zhabs sen nye bar bkod de blo gsal 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i mgon du gyur/ lo snga mar bod du mi sna mngags pa lo 'dir phyir 'byor ga/dong rgyal ba'i dbang po blo bzang skal bzang rgya mtsho nas khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs pa de nyid lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi gzi byin mngon par mtho bar ma zad khri chen no mon han ngag dbang mchog ldan pa'i bka' drin che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig bu yin pa'i stabs kyis rgyal mchog rang nyid kyis kyang bla ma dang 'dra bar bkur gzos 'os tshul sogs kyi bsngags brjod zhibaco'akhod kyi bka' shog dang shi re ge thu no mon han gyi cho lo dang mkhan chas sogs kyi gzengs bstod mdzad pas chos kyi rgyal po zhes pa'i ming don 'dzoms pa byung / grwa tshang rang la chos srid kyi srol gang yod shing rta chen po'i srol bzhin du mdzad cing / mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun rgya mtsho gdan drangs te tshogs yongs la mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang gnang bcug pa sogs bstan la dgongs pa'i lhag bsam gyis 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad sgo yongs por phye/
