366 gaka—na—ḍidi1—dngos/khyad par snga sor grwa tshang phyogs gnyis su gyes pa'i 'ur zing zhig yod par g.yas nas rta gris gzhogs pa dang / g.yon nas tsan dan gyi lde gus byugs pa la yang nye ring chags sdang mi mnga' ba'i btang snyoms kyi rgyu mthun gsal bar shar te dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang gis 'chad nyan 'phel ba kho na byung / 'di skabs mgon po'i gtor chen thun mong ma yin pa bstan pa spyi la dgongs nas drag po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi phyag len kyang mdzad/ dgung lo nyer drug pa chu sprel gyi dpyid khri zur bzhugs mdzad cing bka' 'gyur ba ngag dbang nyi ma gdan drangs te rgyalatreba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi lung dang / rje'i gsung 'bum/ bla ma byams pa rin po cheligasung 'bum phal cher so (sogs)gsan/ grwa tshogs che bas tshogs chen 'du khang cung zad rgya bskyed na dgongs brtag pa mdzad pas da dung re zhig dus la ma babs shing / slar rgya bskyed de sgrub mkhan gzhan zhig yong bar 'dug de dus kyi las ka do dam byed mkhan bla ma sma ra dkar po yod pa zhig yin 'dug ces ma 'ongs mngon sum du gzigs pa'i gsung byon te/thebs de nyid las bstan 'gyur skya pota spus gtsang ba zhig dang / brgyad stong ba tshar brgya dngul gyis bzhengs/ gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur sogs sku gsung thugs rten dpag tu med pa gsar bzhengs mdzad/ snga sor rgan gya'i brag dkar dgon du mtshan nyid grwa tshang zhig yod pa cher ma gnas pa'i rkyen gyis la kha tā le hu thog thu dang de phyogs skya ser tshang mas mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pa la brten nas der phebs/ gnas de

gdan rabs dpa / 367nyid du bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang bskur ba sogs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor zhing shis brjod kyi me tog nam mkha' la chags pa kun gyis mthong ste dad gus 'phel ba'i bsngags brjod da lta'i bar du snang /sngar gyi bshad grwa ba rnams kyi steng du grwa rgyun gsar du bsdus nas smad rgyud dang cha mtshungs pa'i rgyud grwa gsar du tshugs nas lo gsum gyi bar du skyong bar mdzad pas da lta'i bar du bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod 'grel ba bzhi sbrags dang ṭīskye bskyed rdzogs kyi 'chad nyan sogs bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su 'gro nges yar rgyas kyi tshul du yod de/ ji skad du/bstan pa rin chen mchog gis ma khyab pa'am/ /khyab kyang nyams par gyur pa'i phyogs der ni/ /snying rje chen pos yid rab bskyod pa yis/ /phan bde'i gter de gsal bar byed par shog /ces gsungs pa ltar gyi rnam thar rmad du byung ba'o/ / dgung lo nyer brgyad pa la brag dkar dgon du bzhugs yod skabs dgon pa'i 'chad nyan slob dpon blo bzang don 'grub pa urgo khrir phebs dgos byung ba dang / de rjes bla ma gnas brtan pa khrir phebs pa yang chos thog kha shas nas sku tshe ma 'khyol ba sogs kyis gdan sa la phra nyag byung zhing skyabs mgon mchog yul thag ring na bzhugs pa dang / wang rdo rje pha lam sku na phra zhing grwa tshang yang phyogs gnyis su gyes pa sogs kyis bya thabs zad de bla grwa tshang mas mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pa ltar slar yang tshogs chen gyi khrir phebs te 'chad nyan gyi srog bzung / lo der yul dbus su rje rang gi dbon po nang so mi snar ched mngags mdzad de skyabs

368 gdan rabs da sgro/mchog nyid mdo smad du myur du 'byon dgos tshul dang / rje nyid sgrub pa snying bor byed pa thugs gzhol bas dgonatresde'i 'dzin skyong sogs bya ba mang po la gang ci nas mi spro bas cis kyang 'byon pa ma shar tshe gdan sa pa yang bsko bzhag dgos tshul zhu ba gnang / dgung lo nyer dgu ba la yang 'chad nyan dmar bar mdzad cing rigs grwa sogs 'char can dang 'phar ma'i gtong sgo yang mang du gnang /skyabs mgon mchog nas rje nyid kyis bstan pa'i bya ba khur du bzhes pa la bsngags brjod dang / skyabs mgon mchog nyid re zhig mdo smad du 'byon par dgag dgos nang 'doms shing sa yos la cis kyang phebs rtsis yin tshul sogs zhib mor 'khod pa'i chab shog snyan tshig gis spras pa dang /re zhig yang bskyar khri pa blo bzang don 'grub pas khri nyis 'dzin dgos tshul gyi phyag bris gnang ba dang bcas mi sna rnams phyir 'byor ba dang bstun nas khri zur bzhugs mdzad/ de nas rje nyid kyi gsung las/ da ni khor yug sna tshogs me tog bkra/ /rkang drug ldan sogs 'dab chags dbyangs snyan sgrogs/ /bag phebs ri dwags rgyu zhing dwangs bsil chu//lhang lhang 'bab pa sa 'dzin mthon po'i ngos/ /lo 'dab rab mdzes ljon shing na chung ma/ /yid 'ong me tog phreng pas thod mdzes rnams/ 'du 'dzis g.yeng ba sgrib phyir lag sbrel zhing / /skabs 'gar shub bu'i sngags bzlas la brtson dbus/ /kun gsal mdzes mas nyi zla'i sgron 'degs shing / bde ldan gnas ltar yid 'ong dben gnas su/ /dam pa'i zhal lung thos don sman gyi mchos/ /rtse ga cig bsam dang bsgom la

gdan rnabs daros 369brtson par smon/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dben pa'i gnas kyi dga' bdes thugs 'phrogs nas/ ri khrod cig 'debs bzhed kyis bde mchog klad/ byi'u rgyal mo/ bkra shis ska rags/ maṇḍal klad/ dgon pa'i byang phyogs rgyab yol sogs su gnas btsal bas phyi ma thugs la 'bab pa byung yang chu med pa la grog mo skam po zhig tu gnag phyug gi rmig rjes mngon tsam gyi rlan zhig yod pa der brkos gsungs nas chu mig cig rdol bar mdzad/ chu mig 'di la klu khas zhan pa zhig gis gnas g.yar snang bas chu bdag gzhan zhig med na kho'i lag nas klu dbang che ba tshos 'phrog las che gsungs nas rdo rje legs pa'i rdo sku zhig bzhengs nas der bzhugs bcug ste ji srid sgrub sde gnas kyi bar du bstan pa skyong ba'i bro dam mdzad/gsang 'dus kyi lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa so gnyis kyis kyang spyil chung re bting / gzims spyil dang 'du khang yang gsar du bskrun te/ sdom gsum gyi phyir bcos rgyas pa sogs sma da rgyud kyi gso sbyong chen mo lta bu dang dbyar dgag gnyis kyi phyag len/ tshogs 'don la bde mchog bdag 'jug dang bcas pa/ gsang 'jigs mi 'khrugs pa bcas kyi cho ga /bde lam bla mchod sman bla gtor ma brgya rtsa bskang gso/ gnam lo gsar tshes la srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa'i dus ston/ lo re la lo mtshams pa bzhi re 'char can dang dus rgyun nang (nangs )nub la shag so sor mdo sngags kyi nyams khrid dam ma mtha' bzlas brjod kyi thun gnyis re nges can du skyong dgos pa dang / grong chog sogs la gtan song mi chog pa dang / rje nyid kyi zhabs phyi lta bur 'akro

370 gad— ——— sad sa dgos byung tshe rnyed pa spyi sor sprod rgyu dang / nad pa lta bu ma gtogs tshogs su med phyin ja mar gyi skal ba tsam yang blang mi chog pa sogs snyigs ma'i dus su shin tu lag len la thebs par dka' ba'i bka' gdams rnam thar gtsang ma'i srol bstan pa'i rgyan du 'gro nges su rkang tshugs par mdzad pas/ da lta'i bar du 'dul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung ste mdo sngags kyi rnal 'byor la gzhol ba'i mang thos tshul ldan gyi drang srong ‘ spong ba pa'i bste gnas mchog tu gyur pa 'di bzhin snang / dben gnas de nyid la yid dga' chos 'dzin zhes ming 'dogs gnang ba rten 'brel dang dgos pa che bar mngon la gnas der dgung lo so gsum gyi bar du thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor zab mo'i nyams bzhes lhur mdzad pa'i zhar la spong ba pa rnams kyis gtsos chos kyi bdud rtsi don du gnyer ba rnams la dbang lung rjes gnang sogs gang mos kyi chos 'khor rgya cher skor bar mdzad/ khyad par lo gcig gi ring me tog bcud len gyi dka' thub mdzad pa'i khong nas thugs dam nyams bzhes nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu mdzad pas nyams rtogs klong rdol ba lta bur gyur te/ mgur ma ci rigs nyams dbyangs su mdzad pa mang du snang / lo mtshams kyi skabs shig snyigs ma'i ngang tshul la thugs gting nas zhen pa log pa'i tshul gyi gsung mgur zhig bstsal pa'i nang du/ zhing khyad 'phags yid dga' chos 'dzin dran/ /lha rgyal tshab mi pham mgon po dran/ /gsung yan lag drug cu'i chos gsung dran/ /mgon khyad 'phags nam mkha' dri med dran/nga'i bla ma 'jam dpal snying bo dran/ /grogs theg gsum 'phags mchog

gad—narabaḍa dasdos 371dge 'dun dran/ /chu yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing bu dran/ /shing dpag bsam shing dang lha gos dran/ /rang skye gnas 'dab stong padma dran/ zhing der khrid rtsa ba'i bla ma dran/ /der bgrod pa'i lam bzang 'od sbug dran//lam bar chad srung ba'i chos skyong dran/ /nga'i dran pa bcu gnyis glu chung 'dir/ /don ji bzhin 'grub par bla ma dang / /dpal mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung tshogs bcas/ /thugs ma g.yel 'phrin las sdongs grogs mdzod/ /ces dag pa'i zhing du dgongs pa gtad pa'i gsung byon par grwa slob rnams tab tab por gyur te grwa tshang spyi bsdus kyis dngos 'bul dang bcas yang dang yang du brtan bzhugs kyi gsol ba nan can btab par zhal bzhes bzang po gnang ste/ de gong sku'i nyams zhan pas mi gnyis res brten dgos pa yin kyang / de nub nas bde ru song ste bzhengs bzhugs chig skya pher ba byung ba ni skye 'chi la mnga' brnyes pa'i sar gnas 'phags pa'i rnam thar du shes par bya ste/ deng sang gi brtan bzhugs phal cher ni ji skad du/ slob ma khram pa'i ngo bstod gsol 'debs dang / /bla ma zog po'i rdzun shob zhal bzhes kyis/ /bla slob gcig mgo gcig gis bskor pa yi/ /'khor ba'i brtan bzhugs spel la gad mo bro/ /zhes pa kho nar snang ngo //dgung lo so gsum pa sa yos la lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me dbus gtsang du bzhugs pa la/ gong ma bdag po chen po nas bka' ched du bab ste rta tshag rje drung zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshab tu rgyal ba yab sras kyi 'og nas rtse thon gyi bla ma zhig rgya nag tu phebs dgos tshul byung

——3khu gdan da5 dged bar/ rgyal sras sgrul sku rin po che dang / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gnyis la rim bzhin bka' phebs kyang so so nas dgongs pa nan zhus byas pas khrol cha mi gnang thabs med byung ste/ rje 'di ba sku yon go bab gang nas kyang 'os tshul gong gi gser snyan du phul bar brten/ gong nas rgya'i mi drag ched mngags kyis gser yig babs pa ltar lo de'izla ba bzhi ba'i skor la 'dzam gling gi 'khor sgyur gnyis pa'i gser zhal mjal phyir chibs kyi kha lo mngon par bsgyur/ zla ba drug pa nyis brtsegs yod pa'i drug pa snga ma'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin rgyal khab chen por phyag babs/ lo snga ma zla ba bdun pa nas bzung ste char gtan nas oṃbabs par/ gong ma chen po nas kyang char 'bebs kyi thabs sna tshogs mdzad pas kyang ma babs pas/che chung thams cad 'u thug nas re thag chad pa'i skabs sne shan gyi mi drag rnams nas bskul btab par brten char 'bebs kyi spyan dmigs mdzad pas pho brang du 'byor ba'i nyin der char rgyun bzang po mngon par babs nas zhing la sor (son) btab chog pa byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gser snyan du son pa las gong ma chen po nas dgyes gzigs bla na med pa mdzad de/ pho brang du 'byor ba'i phyi nyin der gser zhal mjal chog pa gnang zhing 'tshams zhus kyi kha dar phul ba yang phyag gis bzhes/ dgyes nyams kyi sgo nas lam gyi bde dog sogs bka' bzang po dri med kyang mang tsam bstsal/bdag po chen po nyid kyi phyag gis kha dar dang rin po che khyad mtshar las grub pa'i cod pan gnang zhing gos yug 'ga'i gnang sbyin kyang bstsal/mdun du 'khod pa'i lha sras gzhon nu zhig la bka' gnang ste phyag gis

gdanajabasadasos/ da dngha 3 7 wa brten nas phebs pa sogs gzhan las khyad du thon pa'i bka' drin rmad du byung ba gnang / drug pa phyi ma'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin 'jam dbyangs mi rje'i gar mkhan gnam sa'i dbang phyug mchog la zhabs brtan phul skabs/ bdag po chen po rang gis bzhes pa'i bu la han gyi dā hu/ mang nog gi lwa ba/ las 'phreng / gos yug chen mang po sogs dang /spyir gong ma'i phyag g.yog yun ring du zhus pa'i bla chen re gnyis tsam ma gtogs gdan ser po bzung chog pa'i thob gnang srol med rung / de nyin gdan ser po bzung chog pa'i thob dang / bzhugs gdan ser po rgyab yol dang bcas pa gnang zhing gzhan gyis rnyed par dka' ba'i bka' drin gyis mngon par bskyangs/ de nas gong ma chen po ri dwags kyi sar byon nas slar rgyal khab chen por phebs skabs chibs bsur byon pa la/gong ma chen pos gung thang hu thog thus nged la bus mo 'dzugs mi dgos zhes che 'don gyi bdag rkyen gzhal du med pa gnang / zla tshes la yung hwa gung gi dgon par dus gsum sangs rgyas gsar bzhengs rab gnas kyi rdo rje slob dpon mdzad par 'don pa chos spyod 'grig po byung zhes gong nas bka' bzang po phebs pa dang snga phyir gser zhal nam mjal la spyan bskyang gzhan dang mi 'dra zhing thugs dgyes pa'i bkur gzos zla tshes kyi 'phel kha lta bur gyur te khrims kyi lugs srol rgyus yod pa rnams ha las pa byung ba ni/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / 'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag

374 gdan sa dpa rsābyar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / / de ltar mdzad 'phrin gyis nyi martso'achar nub kyi mtha' tshun chad khyab par gyur te sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs pa na/ yos lo de ka'i dgunabasnyun tshul bstan par gong ma chen po nas kyang 'tsho byed gzhon nu lta buli bla sman pasadu ma dang khyad par lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa bod nas phyir 'byor ma thag gong nas ched du bka' babs pa ltar rang nyid dngos phebs kyi sgo nas sku'i rim gro phu dud rgyun du mdzad cing khyad par phyag rtsa gzigs te sku la sgo bsnyun nad rtsa chus 'jal nus pa gang yang mi 'dug pas thugs 'dun gtso che bar snang zhes yang yang gsungs pa ltar kun gyis zhabs brtan dang brtan bzhuṭa nan can zhus kyang lan gsal po ma gnang bas dgongs pa gzhan du gtad par thag chod/ da ni mchog sprul zhig gi gsol ba gdab dgos par 'dug ces bu slob rnams bgros nas de don snyan gsan phul bar zhal bzhes bzang po gnang ste hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gsum la zhi bar gshegs so/ /de lta bu'i bdag nyid po 'di ni lung gi yon tan rig pa'i gnas lnga'i pha rol tu son pa/ rtogs pa'i yon tan bslab pa gsum gyis thugs rgyud rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang mthun par dul ba ste mkhas pa dang btsun pa'i yon tan/ bstan 'gro'i don du lus dang srog la yang mi lta ba'i lhag bsam gyi yon tan/ thun mong ba'i ting nge 'dzin snyoms 'jug gi stobs kyis 'das ma 'ongs mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mngon shes kyi yon tan/ thun mong ma yin pa bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pas

gdan rabs dngos 376dngos grub brgyad sogs ting nge 'dzin tsam gyis grub pa'i yon tan/rdzogs rim nyams 'og tu chud pas sgyu ma'i rnam thar gyi rtsal gyis dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing khams mtha' yas pa gsal bar gzigs pa sogs blos dpag par dka' ba'i rnam thar dang ldan pa zhig yin te de dag gi lo rgyus zhib par spro dgos mang du mchis kyang tshig mags kyis 'jigs nas re zhig bzhag go / rnam thar 'di nyid kyi mdo smad du byon pa yan chad rje rang gis rtsom bzhed kyis gnang ba'i zin bris dum bu zhig mthong ba dang rgya nag la phebs pa'i skor skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la nang nyams zhib lhug tu phul ba'i phyag bris ngo ma mthong ba la gzhi byas shing / lhag ma'i lo rgyus lo zla tshes grangs kyi nges pa dang bcas grwa thog gcig pa'i dge bshes dang slob ma nye gnas du ma dag bsdur nas bkod pa yin pas shin tu yid ches pa'i gnas su yod do // // gdan rabs drug pa rje blo bzang don grub/ gdan rabs drug pa mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan chen po blo bzang don grub pa ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me pho byi ba'i lo/ /dbal mang gi nang tshan a gnam zhes pa'i rus su 'khrungs/ khu bo tog ra dka' bcu rin chen rgya mtsho zhes pa tog ra khams tshan la spyi khang gsar rgyag sogs kyi byas pa che bas khams tshan gyi grwa ba gzhan las khyad du thon pa'i gzengs bstod kyi bka' shog da lta yang khams tshan na yod pa de nyid khu dbon dang

376 gden bas da sa bcas dpon ju nang yab yum gyi thar mi chi yin stabs 'di ba chung ngu'i dus nas/ /dpon mo rnam rgyal sgron malisku mdun du blangs te gces par bskyangs/ khong gi yum dpon mo ratna gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su sras gcig 'jog rgyu'i dod du dgon par chos grwar bzhag 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i drung du bka' pota lnga la mkhas par sbyangs/ bsam gzugs mo dang dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod gnyis kyi rgyugayophul/khri rin po tshe nas rje gong ma la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor kyang ljags rtsom mdzad nas gnang / mgon 'jigs gnyis kyi gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs par mnos shing / phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas rnams man ngag ltar bsgrigs te mgon po'i bsnyen chen kyang btang / 'di kalitshogs chen dge bskos kyang byas shing / al dar a bo dang / ching wang bstan 'dzin dbang phyug gi phyag mdzod kyang byas te bla dpon gyi chos srid kyi khur yun ring du bzung bas gnyer ba rab 'byams pa zhes 'jig rten la mkhas pa'i tshod du rtsi (brtsi) ba byung / lhag bsam che bas bse sprul pa'i sku la sbyin bdag bskul te sgrub thabs rgya marngoo'i rjes gnang skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas tshogs mang dang mnyam du gnang ba dang dpon gong ma'i pho brang bkra shis mthong smon sogs kyi 'bul ba dang rje'i gos sku chen mo gdan 'dren mnga' ris pa dar han chos rje dpar gyi sbyin bdag tu bskul ba sogs kyi mgo 'dren dang rang gzhan la phan grogs khur len can du grags che/ gnyer ba'i ming thob rung mtshan mo tsog bur bzhugs pa la the tshom can mang pos na bza'i steng du phye rtsam gyi thig btab pa sang zhogs ji

gidan bas daso / 377lta ba bzhin du yod pa dang / 'pho ba btab yul mang po la rtags thon pa dang / nye 'khor gyi yo byad thams cad dang mdun du zhag gcig tsam lus pa'i kha dar la yang tshul khrims kyi dri ngad ldang bas kun dad gus che bar thos/ dpon mo eṅge sha ra'i zhabs phyigyir bya khyung du phebs skabs dam bca' 'jog dgos thabs med byung bar yig cha bamyur nas lo nyi shu tsam song 'dug pas brjed yod snyam nas thog mar cung zad skrag kyang 'dul ba'i ko lpags kyi gzhi'i skabs nas shor tshabs gcig byung / de min khas len 'di shor snyam pa med ces grwa rgan 'ga' zhig la dngos su 'dug cing / bya khyung gi bla grwa rnams kyang ngo dzatshar te dbe/ bshes 'di gnyer bar 'jog tshul la bltas na yang na khyed tsho'i yul de'i mi thams cad yon tan can yin pa red/ yang na yon tan shes mkhan gcig kyang med pa red ces dpon mo la zhus skad/ gang ltar yang tshur phebs 'phral mchod yon bka' bgros kyi thog rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad la bsko bzhag gnang / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang yul dbus su phebs skabs tshogs chen khrir bsko bzhag mdzad pas bdag gis rgyud pa grwa tshang 'dir phan gang thogs shig byed rtsis yod cing / tshogs chen khri'i kha thabs med pas dgongs pa thugs rjes gzigs dgos zhus kyang chos srid gang nas kyang khyed la 'os pas gnang ba zhu lugs med gsungs nas thabs med byung ste spre'u lolidapyid khri 'don mdzad/ po ti lnga'i tshig bzhag dang rigs grwaligatong sgo 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i dus ltar gnang / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dbus nas ma phebs bar du gdan sa dzadzin bzhed yod kyang /

378 5dan—ngabaḍardad / —da wa de'i phyi lo'idaphyidadaponamo.endeshalnge skugaṅgegasasongastabs wang gi se dod thams cad gros mthun gyi thog bla grwa spyi la zhu ba phul te/ dpon mo sku gshegs/ wang rdo rje pha lam sku na phra stabs uṅge khrer bla dpon gnyis kalidod du dgon pa nas grwa tshang phan tshan gyi bla ma gnyis po gang rigs zhig ma phebs na phyogs gzhan nas bla ma zhig btsal rgyu yin zhes tshig dmar 'jus byas par rgyud pa dpon slob ma phebs par brten thabs med byung ste urnye khrir phebs/ de nas rgyud pa dpon slob blo bzang gnas brtan pa ston chos gnyis pa'i skabs khrir phebs kyang shing khyi'i dpyid khri thog nas gshegs pas/ gung thang mchog sprul rin po che sla ra yang khrir bzhugs nas/ lo der skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la gdan 'dren pa ched mngags kyi gdong gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong gi gnas tshul zhus par brten/ bla ma 'di bar gsung shog bstsal ba'i nang du/ rje nyid re zhig mno smad du 'byon par mi spro ba dang / dgon par rim gro seng gshor gyi gegs chags che ba byung rung / khyed rang dgon pa rang gi 0 gu lag skyes kyi dge bshes yin par ma zad chos srid gang nas kyang re che bas 'dor lugs med pa sogs gang ci'i rgyu mtshan zhib 'khod dang bcas uṅge grwa tshang dang dgon pa'i gdan sa zung 'brel byed dgos pa'i bka' nan lci bar phebs pa ltar slar yang dgon par phebs shing dgon pa nas kyang chibs bsu ser sbrengs sogs sngar las lhag pa'i bkur gzos bstabs/ yang bskyar khri 'don byas te 'chad nyan gtong sgo sogs sngar las mi dman pa mdzad/dgung lo re gcig pa me byi'i dpyid utshwa wang gi zhabs brtan la

—— dngharda ka ṣardageb —— — dasna—— 3 90—phebs pa'i lam bar nas sku bsnyung ste su rug tu phebs/ zhabs brtan mang po bsgrubs kyang phan skyed cher ma byung / sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin dkyil 'khor bshams pa sogs tshad ldan byed bcug ste rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi cho ga dal bus gsung ste bdag 'jug bzhes/ tshes bco lnga'i zhog kha (zhogs ka) bsnyung g.yog rab 'byams pa blo bzang tshul khrims la de ring sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga yin ang gsungs yin zhus pas/ de ring nga'i tshod mi thig pas khyed rang sems ma 'tshab/ nga la nad g.yog bzang po byas pas khyod rang gis bsod nams chen po bsags pa yin/bla ma nga nad pa pha ma sogs gzhal du med pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing yin par gsungs yod gsungs/ yang kho bo'i bca' lag 'di grwa tshang gi phyag tu 'phrod nges shig gyis/ gzhan yin na mchod rdzas bsdu bshams sogs byed srol yod kyang de khyed rang tshos mi shes/ yin kyang dung dkar cha 'bud cig byed dgos/ nged rang dgon pa'i gdan sa pa yin pas rten 'brel yod gsungs/ de nas gzhan gang yang mi gsungs par nga'irkang ba'i bol 'di la ltos gsungs te lan kha shas la bltar bcug skabs shig bus mo yang grang 'dug zhus pas/ nga nub phyogs su kha ston gsungs/de nas nub phyogs su zhal 'khor te spyan zim mer cung zad cig bzhugs nas dpa' bo g.yul 'jug nas gsungs pa'i 'pho ba'i gsol 'debs dbyangs dal bus tshar gcig 'then pas de dus kyi drung 'khod 'ga' zhig da lta yang gtam de gleng dus mig nas mchi ma 'khrug par snang / mtshams shig tu hig btab pas khong ba'i nang nas rtsa zhig chad song ngam snyam pa'i

380 gad tho daso sgra zhig grags pa der 'khod kun gyis tho sa shing / de dang dus mnyam du dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'gags te sku gzugs kyi mdangs shin tu gsal zhing tshul khrims kyi dri ngad rgyang ring po'i bar du khyab pa zhig byung / gdung zhugs la phul bas ri nga bsrel gyi phung portor gyur cing / bka' gnang ltar dgongs rdzogs rlabs chen bskrun te gdung mchod kyang da lta'i bar du ma nyams par yod do// // gdan rabs bdun pa rje blo bzang gnas ba rtan/gdan rabs bdun pa smra ba'i khyu mchog blo bzang gnas brtan pa ni/stod kyi sog po'i yul du dbal shul gyi rigs las 'byor ba dang ldan pa'i mi bzang gi rgyud du rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me byililo 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas thugs rig rno bas kun yid 'phrog pa zhig yin stabs grong chog gi sa na se ra'ibya rog gdong zer ba'i dge bshes chen po zhig yod pa la mtshan nyid zer ba 'di ji ltar brtsad pa red ces dris pas des nyams sad byas/ rdo zhig dang shing zhig bstan nas/ mtshan nyid pa'i lan 'debs lugs la/ 'dod/ rtags ma grub/ khyab pa med/'gal khyab zer ba bzhi yod/ rdo 'di chos can/ thing 'di yin par thal/rdo 'di yin pa'i phyir byas na ci zer rgyu yin e shes ltos byas pas/ bsam blo cung zhig btang nas 'gal khyab zer ba e yin zer bas dge bshes pa thugs dgyes te/ ban chung khyod sog po'i yul 'dir bsdad nas ci byed//

——— gdan ba datshus/ 381rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas bkra shis 'khyil du dgon pa 'debs kyin yod pa der song na legs gsungs/ pa'i rkyen gyis bskul te bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ bya lag mdor rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i drung du mjal nas bsdus grwa'i tshig bzhag mnos/ dge bskos ngag dbang bkra shis pa'i drung du rtags gsal mi go tshul zhus nas ngus pas mtshan mo brtsi bzhag skyor bzhin du sku zhabs rin po che'i gzims gur la skor ba gyis gsungs/de nas bzung ste de ltar rgyun du nam zangs thal la yatang bas rje gong ma thugs dgyes nas phru gu 'di la yag po yong ba 'dug gsungs/ bsdus grwa'i tshig bzhag gi 'phro dang / blo rtags dbu phar dang bcas pa 'jam mgon khri rin po cher gsan zhing brtson 'grus dang shes rab go ga'adzol ba'i stobs kyis rigs grwa gsar tshugs kyi skabs phyis su sgo mang bla ma byas pa sangs rgyas rdo rje dang rgol phyi rgol byas te chos 'khor gyi tshogs langs mdzad skabs sogs su dbus nas byon pa'i dge bshes rnams kyang thugs khengs pa byung / dbus su phebs te dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar tshig spyi tsam du ma song ba'i thos bsam gnad du 'gro nges mdzad pas ming dang don mthun pa'i dge bshes kyi go 'phang thob/ lha rams pa'i grwa skor mdzad skabs sus kyang 'khor gsum ma song bas rtog ge mgo mkhregs du ma'i nga rgyal gyi ri bo nyil zhing bsngags brjod kyi rdza rnga brdungs/ de skabs dge bshes’gterabyum 'di da bar du gang nas bsdad btang ba red ces se 'bras dge gsum gyis ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa byung ste sngar lha sa'i bgro gleng sogs la gtan nas mi bzhengs par gab nas bzhugs pa ni

382 da sa datha /grags skam la mi dgyes pa'i rnam thar du snang / slar mdo smad du phebs nas bkra shis 'khyil du po ti lnga bsdus grwa dang bcas pa la dam bca' bzhagade skabs bstan 'dzin rgya yu ma zhes pa de langs nas bgro gleng btang bas/rje 'dis sangs rgyas mthe bong tsam zhig med ces khas blangs par/ 'jam mgon khri rin po ches mthe bong ston pa gnang bas/ rgya yu ma na re sangs rgyas mthe bong tsam zhig yod par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi mthe bong de yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'phangs zhes grags/ 'di 'dra'i rigs phran tshegs ma gartogs lung rigs rnam dag dang 'gal ba'i shor tshabs cher ma byung bas dpon slob thams cad dga' dad gus gsum 'phelobar gyur te rgan gzhon kun gyis dka' gnas kyi dogs gcod zhu ba sogs yon tan gyi bkur gzos che zhing rnam dpyod 'gran zla med pa'i bsngags brjod da ltalibar du sgrog par snang / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'a chang gi mtshan nyid gsan sbyong skabs sku mdun du yang yang spyan drangs nas dka' gnad kyi dogs gcod gnang zhing phan tshun rtsod yig kyang mang du mdzad snang ste/ rtsod yig mjug tu/ gzhu mkhan shākya thub pa dang / /mda' mkhan rje btsun 'jam dbyangs yin/ kyi /mda' 'phen mkhan 'jigs med dbang po ste/ /'ben rgyal bas bzhag kyang thub par dka'/ /zhes yod pa dang / derilan mjug tu/ gzhu mkhan shākya thub pa dang / /mda' mkhan rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /mda' 'phen mkhan 'jigs med dbang po ste/ /'ben 'jog mkhan rigs pa'i dbang phyug nga / /zhes yod pa dang / sku zhabs nyid la yang lan mi 'tshom par zhu ba ni rgyud pa

—— ga—da na —ra bas sdo sdo3/—— 383rang gi rtags yin no/ /zhes yod pa'i rtsod lan gyi yi ge sogs bdag gis kyang mthong la da dung ga/zhan mang po yang yod ces grags so/ /de skabs kyi mtshan nyid zhabs phyi lung rigs la mkhas bsdus byas pa kun phyogs gcig byas kyang rje 'di'i rtsod zla yong dka' zhes grags pas rtsod pa'i khyu mchog 'di las lhag pa chos sde 'dir sngon chad ma byung ba lta bur snang / 'di ka'i tshogs chen zhal ngo dang rgyud pa bla ma dbu mdzad kyi go sa rim par brgyud de rgyud pa'i khrir phebs/ rgyud kyi 'chad nyan dang bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung bshad star chags su mdzad cing 'phros pa gnang dus gral thar chags su dri ba gnang ste lan 'debs dgos pa khral lta bur mdzad pas dpe cha 'dzin skyor dang lta rtog mi byed thabs med cig yod ces de dus kyi rgyud rgan rnams gleng / de skabs mtshan nyid kyi dge bshes che bgres mang po yang rgyud du zhal 'dzoms nas chos grwar gsung bshad nyan par chag med dang / tshogs chos grwa'i gseng bar kun tu mngon chung gi tshul gyis sngags kyi rtsod pa byed pa sogs slo ba gnyer gyi gzhi bzung ste grwa slob 'dzoms pa'i stobs kyis rgyud pa rang nas gsang sngags la mkhas pa'i dge bshes mang du thon snang / chu bya'i lo tshogs chen gyi khrir 'khod de 'du khang steng shod du bzhugs/ de skabs srod 'khor la grwa ba zhig gis 'du khang la skor ba byed bzhin du rtsa shes skyor ba gsan nas spyan chab bsil ba dang / zhal nas klu sgrub yab sras dang rgyal ba tsong kha pa rnams bka' drin shin tu che/ khong rnams ma byon na bstan pa'i snying bo stong pa nyid 'di ga nas shes gsungs pa thos te tshig skam gyi dge bshes tsam min

384 gad bas daso sa par shin tu gsal lo/ /tshig bzhag gang gnang la gsung bshad mdzad pa sogs 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i rnam thar ltar 'chad nyan dmar bar gnang rtsis yod kyang cher ma 'gyangs par de'i phyi lo shing khyi'i dpyid smon lam grol rjes ma 'gyangs par gshegs/ de skabs sku ha cang drang bo zhig mi 'dug kyang rgyud pa grwa tshadzā gis sku gdung mdun du gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i mtshams shig nas glo bur du je drang la song ba mang pos mthong ste ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar du shes par bya'o// //gdan rabs brgyad pa rje ngag dbade ba stan pa'i rgyal mtshan bskyar bzhugs/gdan rabs brgyad pa ni gung thung mchog sprul rin po che ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan te/ slar yang gdan sar bzhugs nas chos srid zung 'brel gyis chos khri skyong bar mdzad cing rnam thar gong du bkod pa las shes par bya'o/ /gdan rabs dgu ba rje blo bzang don grub bskyar bzhugs/ — gdan rabs dgu pa ni gong du bkod pa ltarazudabal mang blo

gdan ba da 385bzang don grub yang bskyar gyis khrir bzhugs pa yin te/ lo rgyus bshad zin to/ /gdan rabs bcu ba rje don grub rgya mtsho/ gdan rabs bcu pa rmad byung yon tan gyi gter mdzod gling don grub rgya mtsho ni gling rje ge sar dang rus gcig pa yin zhes gleng ba bden rdzun kha tshon gcod dka' na yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas dpa' rtsal che ba'i mi kha shas rngon pa'i tshul du yul mang po 'grim pa las mthar me rgan dā'i ching gi ru sde'i nang du 'brog gzhi bzung bas gling mod du grags pa'i rus su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu rta la 'khrungs/ chung dus nas bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs/ blo rno na yang rtsal shin tu rgod pas re zhig gi bar du rtsub spyod shas che yang 'jam mgon khri rin po che nas mi dgyes pa'i nyams med par dge bskos na rim la gling phrug 'di la khyed tshos ting bskul rem rem gyis dang rjes sor phan thogs can zhig 'ong zhes gsungs shing thugs 'dogs mdzad/ kun mkhyen gong ma'i mgron gnyer sangs rgyas kyis do dam byas nas de'i shag tu bsdad kyang mgo skor sna tshogs btang bas/ mgron gnyer gyis kun mkhyen rin po cher bdag gi nang na yod pa'i gling phrug 'di la gang yang mi nyan pas yul du 'gror bcug na ci 'dra lags zhus par/ ha ha de la mi nyan pa dang khyod la nyan tshar ba e red gsungs/ nan gyis zhus pas/ kha rog sdod/ phra

386 gdadzha bas dpa nyag cig la phan thogs pa'i skal ba yod gsungs ha ldong tshil gor du grags pa'i jes sang bla ma tshon po ma tshogs chen zhal ngo'i skabs tsha 'jun drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis bsam blo zhib tu btang bas sngar gyi byed tshul nor bar mthong nas tshogs chos grwa tshul bzhin 'grims te slob gnyer hur thag byed pa dang / zhi dul gyi kun spyod lhun grub cig glo bur du byung bas thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur/ bka' pota lnga la mkhas par sbyangs pas dge bshes grags ldan gyi go 'phang thob/ khri chen nyid nas dge bshes rags bsdus la dbu ma gnang skabs lung rigs gter mdzod yongs rdzogs thugs 'dzin mdzad/ phyis unde grwa tshang du bzhugs skabs kho bo lo drug pa'i thog zhal mjal bas dge bshes don 'grub mgo khra tshang dang thugs nang gshin lugs dang bcas yon tan bzang po slob dgos pa'i zhal ta dang sngon gyi dge bshes mang po'i rnam thar gsungs nas nged rang de tsam gyi dge bshes yar zad kyi gras min kyang dbu ma la dga' snyam pa yod ces lasungs pa yid la dran/ 'jig rten gyi mkhyen rgya shin tu che bas mchod yon nyi zla zung gi chos srid zung 'brel gyi mdun ma'i skor la sku dbang che ba byung /'di ka'i tshogs chen dge bskos dang bla ma dbu mdzad kyi go sa rim par brgyud pa las me byisdzalo khri thog pa blo bzang don grub sku gshegs song bar sa skyong dam pa bī si bā thur dā'i ching nas dbus su 'os tho khyer na 'chad nyan la bar stong 'ong ba 'dug pas bab 'os can zhig bskos pas 'thus gsungs nas bsko bzhag mdzad pa ltar tshogs chen gyi khrir 'khod de 'chad nyan gtong sgo sogs gang ci sngar srol ma nyams pa mdzad/ 'di skabs

gid ge da byu/ 387bse sprul ba'i sku dbu ma'i 'dzin grwar phebs pa la sngon gyi rten 'brel ltar lung rigs gter mdzod yongs rdzogs brtsi bzhag la gtong bzhed mdzad na yang ston chos shig gi skabs tshad 'gog nas 'phro can du lus/ lo gcig rigs grwa'i gtor chen gyi gtor ma zhig song ba la gzhan gyis rnam rtog gi gtam mang po zhus par chos skyong dgyes pa'i mtshan ma dang bar chad kyi mtshan ma gang yin kyang bden zhen la gsos btab pa'i dgos pa med ces gsungs la/ de ka'i gtor rgyag gi tshe the'u rang sri la brku ba bzlog ces pa'i skabs gtor sdeb gnang zer te thugs dgongs zab par snang / phugs su thugs shin tu sgam pas dgongs pa'i gting mi lon kyang / 'phral snang la dman cha bzung ste kun dang mthun zhing 'grogs mkhas pa zhig yin pas dgon pa'i gling du snga phyir zing cha byung ba'i skabs sogs su phan thogs bzang po byung snang ste rje 'di'i rang bzhin ni kun gzigs lnga ba chen pos/ lhag par dga' yang 'dzum chen mi bya zhing / /ma mgu gyur kyang bzhin gyi 'gyur ldog spangs/ gdengs tshad yid la bzung nas nges med gtam/ /brjod pas gzhan dag 'phyang mo'i dra bar 'jug /ces gsungs pa ltar mi chos la mkhas pa'i tshad cig yin par grags che ste/ bla brang gi el chir rong bo dgon du phebs skabs shig rgyal mkhan chen pas sun 'byin byed 'dod nas/ khyed rang tsholibakra this 'khyil na rje btsun byams pa sangs rgyas yin zer ram/ sems can — yin zer dris pas/ 'thad dus sangs rgyas dang / ma 'thad dus sems can yin zer zhes de 'dra 'ga' zhus pas glags ma rnyed pa sogs

388 dan darjos — gleng / sa yos lo skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dbus nas phyir phebs par byin rlabs dang rten 'brel gyi khyad kyis gdan sa'i khur bzhes dgos zhes gsol ba nan gyis btab pas rdo rje 'chang nas kyang zhal gyis bzhes te mkhas mang gdong lnga'i tshogs kyis rnam par bteg pa'i chos kyi khri la zhabs kyi padmo mngon par bkod/ skabs de dag tu yang rdo rje 'chang thugs brel ba'i skabs sogs su tshig bzhag btang zhing gang ci'i la rgyaliskor la thugs khur che bzhes mdzad pas skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas kyang thugs mnye sa pa'i bsngags brjod mdzad par snang / de nas bī si bā thur dra'i ching gis wad gi uṅger grwa tshang gsang sngags smin rgyas gling gi khrir spyan drangs naspo lo kha shas der bzhugs te khri thog der re ba rgyad pa sa glang la sku zhi bar gshegs so// // gdan rab sa bcu ga cig pa ku na mkhyen sku’phre nga gahaṃs pa rje 'jigs med dbang bo'i sde/ gdan rabs bcu gcig pa ni rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rjerirang gzugs dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba chen po kun mkhyen gnyis pa mi bskyod dgyes bzhad rdo rje nyid kyis mjod pa yin te/ zhib par rnam thar las shes par bya'o/ / 4

gedadzha bsadangos 389 gdan rabs bcu garnyas pa rje ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs bkra zhis/gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa ni 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i mchog sprul ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs bkra shis pa lags te/ mdo smad rgan gya'iphyogs su rigs rus phun sum tshogs par rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa rta zla ba bcu gnyis pa'e tshes gnam gang ngam sa lug zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig la sku 'khrungs/ grub —dbang sde khri rin po ches 'jam mgon smra ba'i dbang phyug de nyid kyi sprul skur ngos 'dzin mdzad nas bkra shis 'khyil du sbyan drangs te bugs gnyer mdzad/ mtshungs med chos rje ngag dbang bstan 'dzin pa'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngar sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'irjes gnang dang mgon po'i bka' chen bcu gsum gsan cing dgon li ri khrod pa mkhas grub rin chen dang gser kha pa bsod nams rgya mtsho thar mi chi blo bzang don 'grub sogs las nyer mkho mang du zhus/ rdo rje 'chang de nyid gdan sa'i khur 'jog pa gnang skabs rje gong ma'idus ltar sku be ra sogs na bza' cha tshang gnang nas dgon pa'i 'dzin skyong gi khur khyed la gtad pa yin gsungs kyang / nag phyogasu bdud rigs kyis bar chad brtsams te cher ma 'gyangs par khrilidagongs pa nan zhus kyis bkrol te gter lung yid dga' chos 'dzin du phebs te da lta tshoganas der thugs darda gong 'phel du bzhugs so / /

390 gdan nga da gdan rabs bcu gsum ba rje blo batharda snyan grags/gdan rabs bcu gsum pa sar gnas kyi rgyal sras chen po blo bzang snyan grags ni rtse mdo bkra shis chos rdzong dang mi ring ba'i sadzeecha lha mo'i bla mtsho'i nye 'dab tu ('dabs su)rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa khyir a rig gi dpon rgyud du 'khrungs/ chung ngulidus nas dam pa'i bag chags ma ngon par brtas shing klog sogs tshegs med par mkhyen/ rang gi phu bo se ra'i dge bshes bya rog gdong du grags pa'i drung nas rab tu byung ste bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs/ 'jam mgon khri rin po ches 'du khang steng du brtsi bzhag gnang gi yod par baji bzhag dang po nyan nas der thog mar mjal bas/ ming la ci zer gsungs/ snyan grags lhun 'grub zer zhus pas/ phyin chad blo bzang snyan grags kyis/ khyod rang la yag po yong gsungs/ grub dbang sde khri rin po che'idrung du bsdus grwa'i 'phro dang blo rtags phar phyin bcas gsan cing bsnyen rdzogs kyang rje 'di'i drung du zhus/ po ti lhag ma bzhi rje ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ gung thang mchog sprul rin po che/ khri ba blo bathong don grub gsum las gsan te/ yig cha'i po ti phal cher 'dzin skyor byas shing dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod dang / 'grel ba don gsal sogs mang po'i rgyugs spyang phul/ lto gos sogs yal bar bor nas chos la spro shugs drag pos dka' tshegs khyad du bsad de nyin mtshan thos bsam gyis 'da' bar

li smyo ————sa ba 3()1mdzad pasalung rigs kyi dga' ston spel ba la rnam dbyod mchog tu yangs pa'i grags pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi mdzad spyod 'dul khrims las mi 'da' bas kun gyis mthong dang dag snang che bar byung / gung thang mchog sprul rin po ches ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin du sdod gsungs par/da lta 'dul ba dang sngags la slob gnyer ma byas pas cho gasdzanyams len dang bslab bya'i bgrung mtshams zhib por mi shes ltabs ri khrod la song yang dgos pa chen po mi 'dug 'dul ba dang sngags la bag chags shig bzhag nas bka' ltar sgrub zhus pas/ thugs dgyes nas de ka gyis gsungs te thugs dgongs de ni bstan pa'i gnad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar du snang ngo / /me byililor skyabs mgon mchog nas snga sor gsung shog bstsal pa ltar dbus su byon nas rigs smra mkhas pa'i blta gnas se ra byes pa grwa tshang du zhugs/ bsdus grwa nas 'dul ba'i bar gyi 'dzin grwa so sor nyi ma bcu gsum la dam bca' bzhag pas lung rigs kyi yon tan la gus pa'i rtsi 'jog dang dag snang 'phel bar gyur/ sngar mdo smad du bzhugs skabs thugs rlung gi smyung gzhi zhig yod pa se ra'i rta mgrin la mjal ba nas sang dwangs su song ba ni lha dang chos skyo nga gis rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma khyad par can du go se rar po ti lnga dang / mdo sngags rig gnas gzhan la yang sbyangs pa mdzad/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje/ rje ngag dbang byams pa/ bā ri dpon slob ngag dbang don grub sogs kyi drung du zab chos mang du gsan pas mdo dang sngags kyi gdams pa'i gter mdzod

(mi()rwarkye tsho mi smyo sna —du rgyur/ me glang gi lo byes pa dpon slob—byams pa smon lam pa'i sku zhabs nas bkur gzos che ba gnang ste/ khyed grwa sa 'di ka'i rgan pa gyis min kyang mdo smad kyi dge bshes sku yon can zhig red pas dmigs bsal ming btags che khag cig bzhes cidagos gsungs par bdag la bka' drin shin tu che na yang mdo smad nas 'ong skabs su smon lam dang bag chags ci thebs byed snyam pa las ming btags kyi re ba med cing sdod yun tshod mi thig pa sogs kyis dgongs pa gnang dgos zhus nas ming btags ma blangs/stag lo'i mjug tu slar yang yos lo'i lha rams pa zhig lha 'brum gyis ma thar pas dam bca' 'jog ma thub pa'i dod du lha rams pa gyis gsungs kyang /zla bo rnams myur du nag chur 'gro skad kyis dpe cha yang dos su btsud/grwa sa nas dgongs pa yang zhus tshar bas stabs mi bde snyam nas ma byas gsungs/ tshul 'di ni chos brgyad don gnyer gyi g.yan pa dang bral bas ming skam gyi phrug spyad tshol mi dgos pa'i rnam thar du shes par gyis/ sa yos lor skyabs mgon mchog mdo smad du byon pa dang lhan du rang yul du phebs/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgyud grwar gsang sngags la sbyangs pa mdzad nas ri khrod la phebs rtsis kyis rgyud pa'i 'jug sgo la sgug yod skabs/skyabs mgon mchog nasarisku mdun rdu bos te gdan raphar cog tse sogs kyis bkur gzos dang bcas/ dbus na lha sa smon lam rab 'byams pa/'bras spungs rdo bcal rab 'byams pa/ dga' ldan rab 'byams pa chen mo/ se ra rigs grwa rab 'byams pa dang gling bsre dka' bcu sogs grwa sa spyi sger la ming btags kyi srol yod pa ltar/ nga rang gis kyang

gedan ba da5 393dgon pa 'dir rdo rams pa'i ming btags 'dzugs rgyur khyed snga sor rigs lung zhabs phyi'i dus nas rgyus yod cing / dbus na yang lharams pa 'os pa'i gras yin pa dang / blo bzang snyan grags zhes ming bkra yang legs pa sogs kyis rdo rams pa'i thog ma byin pa yin/ gdan 'phar cog tse sogs phyin chad rdo rams pa'i bkur gzos kyi thob yin zhes bka' phebs par skyabs mgon mchog gi mdzad pa khyad par can zhig gi thog ma rang la gtad pa yin 'dug pas skal ba bzang snyam nas lags so zhus pa yin gsungs/ de nas bzung ste dam bca' 'jog bar la tshogs chos grwa chag med mdzad pas da lta'i bar du bzang po'i dpe srol rang 'jags su song / phyi lo'i rigs grwa'i chos mtshams la skyabs mgon mchog dang grwa tshang so so'i dpon slob khri gdan zur rnams rtsod dpang du bzhugs te mkhas mang rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su po ti lnga la nyi ma lngar dam bca' bzhag de skabs skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ltar grwa tshang phan tshun dang ri khrod gong 'og na bzhugs pa'i dge bshes thams cad bzhengs nas bgro gleng mdzad pas po ti lnga'i dka' gnad gang nas btang yang lan thogs pa med pa'i rnam dpyod kyis dpon slob yongs kyi thugs 'phrotha / par gyur/ de nas rgyud du phebs te bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs cho ga phyag len thams cad la zhib par sbyangs/ rgyud pa rgya mkhar sgar du chos thog la phebs skabs nyin mtshan gnyis kyi ring la po ti lnga'i dam bca' bzhag ste legs bshad kyi skyes bstsal/ de skabs skya rked cung zad ltem par yod stabs las sne rnams nas dmigs bsal gyis chibs pa la

394 da dadza / phebs chog byas kyang / lam bar nas cis kyang ma nus na ma gtogs/cung zad nus bzhin du 'grig lam dang 'gal ba mi byed gsungs nas zhabs thang la phebs pa dang / tshogs chos dgung ja tsam yang chag med du 'grim pa sogs dmigs rkyen la phan nges mdzad pas bla ma dbu mdzad dang mnyam pa'i baji 'jog dang dad 'dun tshe bar byung / lo de'i ston mjug bse sprul skus dgongs pa zhus te mchod yon bka' bgros kyi thog rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad zung chulidage bshes ngag dbang ba tshogs chen gyi khri dang / rje 'di bla ma dbu mdzad la bsko bzhag mdzad kyang / zung chu'i dge bshes pa thugs rlung 'phar nas khri 'don ma mdzad par gnang ba zhus pas/ rje 'di la mchod yon rnam gnyis nas tshogs chen gyi khrir bzhugs dgos zhes snyan gsan gyi kha dar gnang ba sku tshab so sos phul byung bar/ 'chad nyan dang 'grig lam gyi ting bskul/ gtong sgo sogs gang ci mi lcogs pas gnang ba zhu dgos gsungs te bzhengs nas phebs grabs byed thog grwa thog gcig pa'i dge bshes phal cher stabs gcig tu byon nas khyed cis kyang bzhugs dgos zhes rang rang nas kha dar phul bas gnang ba zhu ba'i dbang ma byung gsungs/ de nas lcags sbrul hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes dgu la khri 'don mdzad nas me phag gi lo bar du po ti lnga'i 'chad nyan 'gran zla dang bral ba gnang / chos grwa re re yang 'chag mi srid pa lta bu mdzad pas 'dul mdzod dbu phar bzhi'i thal phreng lo re la rdzogs par song zhes zhal nas gsungs/ longs spyod kyang chos bzhin byas na char bzhin gyi dpe ltar byung nas rigs grwa sogs ma nyams par

ge 1da wa — dzi 395btang / 'grig lam yang skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi bka' gang gnang ltar las gzhan du cung zad kyang bsgyur du med pa'i ngang tshul u tshugs mthar skyel gyi tshul du mdzad pas/ de phyin chad nas 'grig lam rim gyis je zhib dang / chos srid kyi dpal 'byor rim gyis je 'phel du song bar skyabs mgon mchog gi rnam thar du gsal lo/ /'khrul 'khor lcags mkhar gtor sgrub sogs bstan srid spyi wer gyi rim gro gang ci'i skabs su yang phyag len gang zhib tu gnang bas ya mtshan pa'i ltas kyang mang du byung snang la zhal nas kyang nga rang grwa rkyang gi dus phyag len slob 'dod che bar byung nas rab gnas/ sbyin sreg gtor ma/ 'khor lo sogs kyi skor zhib por bslabs shing / phyis su rdo rje slob dpon lan du mar byed dgor byung bas/ chos skyong tshos rgyud bskul ba yin nam snyam gsungs/ snga sor dgon pa'i gling du 'khrug zing che ba yang rje 'di'i sku ring la zhi song bas skyabs mgon mchog nas kyang lab sgron gyi ma yig chen mo las dgon 'dir re zhig 'khrug pa mang po 'ong yang khri thog bcu gsum pa'i ring la 'khrug pa zhi nas de phyin chad mtsho la dar chags pa bzhin du gnas 'ong zhes lung bstan pa de rje gong ma nas brtsis na khyed rang yin gsungs dgyes pa tshad med mdzad/ de nas khri zur bzhugs byas te dgon pa rang du rgyun mtshams ltar bzhugs nas thugs dam zab mo'i nyams bzhes gzhan gyi blor mi shong ba mdzad cing / grub dbang bsod nams grags pa'i drung du gcod dbang gsan nas dgung lo drug cur nye skabs gnyan khrod brgya rtsa yang 'grims pa dang / res 'ga' dbang dang rjes gnang lung khrid

3skyeskye dan ba da5 sogs kyis don gnyer ba rnams kyi yid kyi re ba skong bar mdzad pa sogs skabs su gang babs kyi bshad sgrub rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa bzang pos nyin mtshan 'da' bar mudzad bzhin pa las sa khyi'i lo skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ltar gtsos rgya mkhar sgar ba'i khrir phebs/ 'di skabs dang sngar tshogs chen gyi khrir bzhugs skabs su gtum po mang pos brlang spyod du ma byas kyang spyan zur gyis kyang ma gzigs pa lta bu mdzad pa'i mthus ma rungs pa de dag phyir zhing dad par gyur te 'di phyi'i skyabs mgon dam pan 'dzin pa byung ba ni paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ khams gsum skye dgu ma lus khros gyur te/ /gshe (gshes)shing mtshang 'dru bsdigs shing srog gcod cing / /mi 'khrug gnod lan phan pa sgrun byed pa'i/ /bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bzod pa'i phar phyin la goms pa'i rnam thar du snang / gzhun yang zhal nas/ kho bo tshogs chen gyi khrir yod skabs tshogs gtam gtong dus rang gi kun slong la brtag sngags byang sems so thar gyi bslab bya dang 'gal mi 'gal dpyad nas tshogs gtam btang ba ma gtogs/ rang 'a—gar (dgar)bag med kyi gtam zhus pa mi dran zhes gsungs/ 'di ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i sngags brjod kyi yul du gyur pa'i rnam thar bzang po zhig tu snang bas 'di 'dra'i mgon la bsten pa lta zhogamathong thos dran pa tsam yang rnyed dka' bas dga' dad mngon par 'phel bar gyis shig lar deng dus mdosmad lho byang gi phyogs 'dir rgyal ba'i daswengs pa dang mthun pa'i mkhas btsun bzang gagu ma gyi yon tan bum

gdan pha dngo / 397nang gi mar me ltar sba ba'i nges pa don gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams cir yang mi rtsi la/ yid mi min gyis brlams pa'i lha mthong 'dre mthong byung rgyal du smra ba dang / chu gnyan dkrug cing shing gnyan gcod pa sogs tho co'i spyod pa dang / g.yo sgyu'i mdangs phyi rol tu shar ba'i tshul 'chos kyi rdzu bag dang / zang zing gi ched du gzhan mgo skor ba'i kha gsag mkhan dag la dam par 'dzin pa ches mang ba ni ji skad du/ skal chad nags kyi khang bu na/ /nyi ma'i 'od las me khyer brin/ /zhes pa ltar/snyigs ma'i rang gzugs mtsho ltar rdol ba'i ngang tshul yin no/ /des nomakhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas gzugs brnyan gsal ba'i me long du ji ltar gsungs pa ltar thar 'dod rnams kyis gzugs dang gzugs brnyan gyi dbye na phyed pa gal che'o/ /skabs shig bla dpon gnyis kyi bka' ltar uge grwa tshang gi khrir phebs te lo kha shas la rgya mkhar sgar dang bcas khri gnyis 'dzin yang mdzad/ der bzhugs ring lo re bzhin dgon par phog chen re chag med dang rgya mkhar sgar du yang phog chen kha shas btang zhing / sngar snar thang gi bka' 'gyur rgyal dbang bdun pa rin po ches lhag gnas kyi me tog 'thor ba'i byin rlabs can zhig dang / 'di skabs su skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la dngul srang stong dang lnga brgya'i rtsis kyi rta nor phul te snar thang nas bstan 'gyur gdan drangs pa dang / dgon par 'du khang chen mo'i rgya mthongs khor yug tu gos jus ma sna tshogs phye phur ltar bsgrigs pa'i chu dar spus legs gos chen rgyan bzhi ma'i bla re lnga sogs 'jog pa gnang zhing / snga phyir grwa tshang so sor mang

398 gedan dasobyu 'gyed kyi thog ma ṇi dung phyur gnyis bsgrubs pa dang / mnyan yod cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa'i mang 'gyed sogs zang zing gi dngos po phyag tu gang byung thams cad dge 'dun mchod pa dang / sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa sogs thabs mkhas bla na med pa'i sgo nas mi zad pa'i gter du sbas te dad pas sbyin pa chud mi 'dza' bar mdzad/ gshin po'i gos kyi tshal bu re tsam na bzaligras su 'gror bcug cing nyal stan phul ba yang zhag kha shas re la bzhugs gdan dang / gos skud kyi bca' lag rnying ba 'ga' zhig gzan chings gnang bar 'di ci yin zhus pas/ nye du tshos nga la re ba byas nas phul ba red tsa na longs spyod bzhin du gzungs sngags re bzlas na phan e thogs bsam pa yin gsungs te/ bar do'i 'phrang la nyam thag par 'gro ba'i dmigs yul gyi gshin po yal bar dor nas/ brgya 'bul la mig zur gyis lta bzhin du yon bdag gi ngo gang zin byed pa'i 'gro ba'i 'dren pa rnams dang mi 'dra'o/ / de skabs bsnyung gzhi kyi ba zhig byung yang gsang sngags smin rgyas glitha gi grwa dpon slob kyis brtan bzhugs phul bar/ nga la rang dbang ci la yod rung bla ma'i zhabs brtan la slob ma'i brtan bzhugs 'di sa chod che bar snang bas skyon med 'gro gsungs/ de nub nas sku bde ru song ba ni skye 'chi la dbang ba'i rtags su snang bas/ gdan rabs bcu gsum pa sa thob kyi sems dpar gsungs yod ces grags pa dang gung 'grig gam snyam mo/ / de nas khri zur bzhugs mdzad de da lta dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa grwangs

ge ga skye90yin kyang yig cha cung zad kyang ma bsnyel bar gsung bshad kyi lung 'dren sogs shar shar thon pa dang / gsang sngags kyi phyag len phra mo zhig kyang ma nor bar thugs la shin tu nges pa dang / sku rlung la gnod tshul zhus kyang phyi dro'i kha zas cung zad kyang mi bzhes pa sogs blos dpag dka' zhing / bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag 'jug chag med lta bu dang /lam khrid dang smyung gnas sogs mdosngags kyi nyams bzhes gong 'phel du bzhugs pa 'di lags so/ / ci cilko 4 — — —— — pi4// gdan rabs bcu bzhi ba rje ngag dbang 'grin las/gdan rabs bcu bzhi ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang rgyug dam pa ngag dbang 'phrin las pa ni/ gtsos 'brong lce'i sar yul delisde dpon zhig gi rgyud du rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me bya'i lo 'khrungs/ sku na phra ba'i dus khya dge dpon slob yin zhes gtor zor deb pa'i stangs ka mdzad pa sogs dam pa'i spyod tshul lhun grub tu byung zhing / a ra pa tsa na rgyun du zhal 'don mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa'i dus brag dkar dgon gyi mtshan nyid grwa tshang du phebs te mkhas dbang dbyig kya rab 'byams pa ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs pa'i drung du bsdus grwa'i skyor dpon mdzad/ nyid kyi phu bo phyis su sgo mang bla ma byung ba pra nye ngag dbang dge legs bkra shis 'khyil nas dbus su song bar brten/ bkra shis 'khyil du phebs 'dod drag po skyes te smon lam gyi mjal ba dang 'gogs nas 'bros stabs kyis

400 gizhi ra / 'ongs/ dgon pa'i skor lam du sleb dus khri rin po che gsung chos nas phebs pa'i rgya gling gtong ba dang / 'du khang du tshogs dung 'bud pa sogs rten 'brel legs pa byung / da lta ba rin chen chos bzang zhes bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge spushes chen po/ chos brgyad kyi spros pa gtan nas mi mdzad cing / ma rgyud kyi bskyed rdzogs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du mdzad pas sku gshegs skabs thugs dam la zhag nyer lnga bzhugs shing steng sgo nas byang sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pa sogs rdzogs rim mngon gyur gyi rtags mtshan dang ldan pa de nyid dge rgan du bsten/'jam mgon khri rin po che'i drung du bsdus grwa/ blo rtags / phar phyin/sde khri rin po cher dbum 'dul mdzod bcas gsan nas sbyangs pa cher mdzad/ gung thang mchog sprul rin po che ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs shing / khong rgya nag tu 'byon skabs skyes rabs so bzhi ba'i dpe cha zhig gnang nas 'di khyod la dgos gsungs pa ni phyis su gsung chos 'chad dgos pa'i lung bstan du snang / des mtshon rje de nyid nas dgyes pa tshad med pas gsung gleng sba gsang med mi ra grwa thog ga cig pa rnams gleng / rgyud la yang lo kha shas phebs nas 'grel ba dang / ṭīska bskyed rdzogs sogs la zhib par sbyangs/ bar skabs shig skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas rgyud na bzhugs pa'i dge bshes rnams tshogs chen du 'ong dgos gsu ngas pas slar mtshan nyid grwa tshang du phebs/ de skabs su gsang 'dus kyi cho ga chag med mdzad cing /'dus pa'i blos bslang bzhengs rgyu yin na nga la gsal po 'char gi 'dug

rte— lte /de zing sage wa 01cesanyeganasadamapadage baṅgesang ga dbang tshul khrims la gsungasazute 'jim bzo shes tsam min par rten gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa gsal bar shar ba'i gsung ngo / / phas rgol zil gyis gnon pa la rnam dpyod 'gran blo med pa'i mkhyen rab kyi rtsal shin tu che zhing khri chen rgyal mtshan seng ge ching wang gi urger phebs skabs dang / skya bas mgon mchog gdan sa'i khri 'don mdzad skabs sags su tshogs langs mdzad pas bgro gleng / thal skad/ 'khor gsum/ smra brjod/ sku gzugs/ spobs pa thams cad kyis khrom non pa byung bas snyan grags cher rgyas/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dbus nas byon skabs zhabs phyi dge bshes bzhis chos grwar dam bca' bzhag par/ rje 'dis lan gyis zlog par mi nus pa'i thal 'gyur gyi phreng ba spro bar mdzad pa la de gras kyi dge bshes zung chu ngag dbang ba zor bas/ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis rdo zhig la bgro gleng btang na yang rdo des kha zhig grag dgo sa rgyu red snyam pa 'char zhes bcos min gyi bsngags brjod mdzad/ rdo rams pa'i mtshan btags skabs zla gam rked par dkris nas khyab 'grig 'phen pa dang / shags rno zhing khas/ len jib cha che dzodang / lan ngar zhing myur bas phyi rgol gyi spobs pa 'phrog pa sogs rtog ge ba'i lugs bzang po ma nyams par byas pa'i bsngags brjod da lta'i bar du snang bas/ grags snyan la re ba tshos de ltar mdzad na legs kyi ngo tsha ba'i yus kyis spug 'thums te shi min gson min gyi tshul du yin yin min min gyi gtam nyog pos mkhas mang gi dbus su nyi ma ci 'khyong byas pa tsam la

402 dka' bcu dngarab 'byams smra ba'i dri tsam yang mi bro'o/ /de ltar lung rigs la mkhas pa/ mkhyen rgya che ba/ gzu bor gnas pa/ snying stobs brtanapa/ spyi'i bya byed gzhan ngor mi gtong0ba sogs chos srid gnyis 'dzin gyi yon tan dpag dka' bas tshogs chen zhal ngo dang rgyud pa bla ma dbu mdzad kyi go sa them skas rim bgrod kyi tshul du tshogs chen gyi khrir phebs/ brtsi bzhag chag med mdzad pas khri snyan grags pa dang rje 'di ba gnyis kyi sku ring la zla chos chen mo rer brtsi bzhag med pa'i chos bun zhig byung na shing slong btang ba lta bulisnang ba 'char zhesathams cad kyis mabun par gleng / grong chog nas phebs 'phral chos grwa 'byor tshogs yod na bla brang du mi 'byon par chos grwar 'phral du byon nas btsa bzhag gtong ba rgyun du gnang bas dpyod ldan rnams kyis lhag pa'ilhas byin gyis brlabs payin nam zhes bsngags brjod mdzad pa don la gnas par mngon te/ zhal nas/ kho bo tshogs chen khrir yod skabs grong chog sogs la 'gro dus sang gi brtsi bzhag la tshar re re tsam bltas nas phyin pas/ mtshan mo nyal khar bsam blo btang na cung zad kyang mi 'char/ nam phyed tsam bsam blo btang na thor re ba zhig yid ngor 'char/ tho rengs bsam blo btang na khra lam mer 'char zhes gsungs/ grang ngad che skabs su yang brtsi bzhag rgyun ring gnang zhing char zhod skabs chu 'khyil la yang gzur mi chog par nang du bsdad nas brtsi bzhag nyan dgos pa sogs dka' spyad mang du btang nas khri rgan sde rgan tsho'i dus su nga rang tshos kyang 'di ltar byas pa

rte dan da / 403yin gsungs/ chos thog gi skabs su tshogs chos grwa'i yar 'tshogs mar grol/ 'don pa'i dal brel sogs dbyar dgun gyi nyi tshod blangs nas las sne so sor bkod pa gnang zhing / de las 'das na bka' baspyon dang phyag 'bebs kyis tshar gcod pa dang / chos mtshams kyi skabs su mtshan mo 'du khang gi steng nas skyor sbyangs la gzigs rtog gnang ste rgyun ring skyor sbyangs byid mkhan tsho la/ khyod kyis skyor sbyangs legs po byed kyin 'dug de ltar byas na kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i gyin rlabs zhugs yong / zhes chos grwa nas gzengs bstod pa sogs tshar gcod rjes 'dzin ha cang rung ba mdzad pas 'chad nyan dang 'grig lam shin tu dmar ba byung / khyad par du skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang rgyal khab chen por chibs bsgyur gnang skabs gos ber/ paṇa zhwa/ sku chos bcas gnang zhing / nged phyir 'byor bar du dgon pa'i chos 'chad nyan sogs snyi nang gi la rgya mtha' dag la grim grim gnang dgos zhes bka' babs pa ltar gdan sa chos srid gdan sa (gang nas)grwa thur cung ma nyams par bzung bas skyabs mgon mchog nas bsngags brjod mang po mdzad pa dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas rna lam du gyur/ 'di dus lcags mkhar la bzhugs skabs shig mnal lam du/ rje nyid grwa tshang gi tshogs dbur bzhugs pa la mi rgya chas can zhig gis zangs kyi sbu gu sdong dum 'dralhab rtse mor rma bya'i sgro chun btsugs pa 'du khang gi sgo mo che la mi shong ba'i tshod cig khyer 'ong nas sku mdun nas khyed la bskur ba yin zer zhing / bzhugs khri'i g.yas phyogs kyi ka ba la dar dkar gyis bcings pa zhig rmis gsungs/

404 da dpa /de ni —rje gong ma la rwa los sge rnyi pā la gtad pa'irgyutshulodang cha mtshungs sam snyam mo/ / lcags yos lo smon lam gtor rgyag gaskaphas/ de ring gtor rgyag de rgyal bsen bar chad byed pa bzlog ces pa'i steng du e khel gsungs/khel lags zhus pas nyams mtshar/ gtor ma de dkyil nas cha gnyis su song ba'i rtsa ba phyir 'khor/ rtse mo phar log song bas sku zhabs rin po che zhabs pad brtan pa gzhir bzhag kyang / da lo dgon par 'tshume skyon gzhan zhig yod pa 'dra gsungs shing / lo der ching wang rdo rje pha lam sku gshegs song ba dang / yang skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa rgya nag nas gdan sar phepas skobs/ 'dre ngan zhig gi ngo yod 'dra bas de la dmigs nas khyod kyis glo bur las bcol zhig gyis zhes bka' babs pa ltar mdzad skabs/ gtor sdeb de nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlog ces pa'i steng du e khel gsungs/ khel zhus pas de bzang gsungs/sngar dgon pa'i nang du nad rims shig yod pa de 'phral du zhi song ba sogs gtor ma'ibakra bzang ngan las legs nyes 'byug med du ston pa zhig yod la/ gtor rgyag sogs kyi skabs rlung tshur log yod kyang shangs bug nas rlung drag po zhig bus pa dang dus mnyam du rlung ri bo la rdugs pa bzhin du phar log 'gro ba dang / grong chog cig—la phebs kha ra chi bas pa la zer (gzer)phog nas brgyal 'dug pa la thugs khros pa lta bus sku gzan gyis lan gsum bsnun ma thag tu rta langs nas nad sangs 'dug par chibs nas phebasatrepa so gas grub pa'i rtags mtshan shin tu mang ngo / /

gdan ba dngo / 405der ma zad skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas kyang nyin gcig sku mdun du gdan drangs nas lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gis bdag la/ nged kyi rmi lam du chu chen po zhig gi 'gram na dgon chen zhig 'dug ste khyod kyi dgon pa yin 'dra zhing chu de'i phar kha'i ri zhig gi steng na spre'u 'jigs su rung ba steng na me 'bar ba zhig dgon pa'i nang du tshur 'chor ba 'dra ba la skor lam nasas glang sngon po zhig phar rgol bas spre'u yul de nas bskrad (skrod)thub kyang mi bskrad ( skrod)pa zhig rmis pas chos rgyal gting nas bskul dgos pa'i rtags yin pa 'dra gsungs pas da lan khyod kyis lcags mkhar sgrubs la thugs dmigs drag po gyis gsungs pa dang / shing rta'i lo ma cig gi lung bstan ltar 'du khang gi phyogs bzhir zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg gnang skabs drag po'i sbyin sreg gi rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' rje 'di la babs pa sogs la dpags na rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug cig tu gdon mi za'o/ /zhal gzigs dang lung bstan sogs dngos su zhal gyis mi bzhes kyang gsung zur las dpog nus te/ yos lo grwa ba thams cad kyis da lo'i zhal ngo 'di rab 'byams pa dge 'dun bsam 'grub la 'os zer gyin yod par/ 'jig rten gyi grags pa stobs che bas bsko bzhag byed dgongs yod kyang bsko rgyu'i zhogs ka da lo dge 'dun bsam 'grub dge bskos la ma bsko zhes pa'i sgra zhig grags pas/ 'os tho'i dang po la 'dug kyang gzhan zhig bsko bzhag byas pas lo der dge 'dun bsam 'grub gshegs song gsungs pa dang / grwa ba zhig na nas mi 'tsho bar thag bcad yod skabs skya gdung gi mdun du spyan 'dren khrus gsol zhig gyis zhes 'dzin grwa la

406 da ba dado bka' babs ltar byas pas grwa ba de bde song ba dang / chos grwa yar 'tshogs shig giskabs sa stong de na 'dug mkhan su yod gsungs nas grwa ba zhig la zhabs chag 'phangs nas bkyon/ phyi nyin zhig tshogs gtam gyi zhar la chos grwar 'tshogs skabs bar stong bzhag na grwa ba thugs mi mthun pa'i rten 'brel du gsungs pas ngas kha sang tshag 'dzin byas pajiyin pas phyin chad khyed rnam pas thugs la 'dzin dgos gsungs/ ma 'gyangs par 'dzin grwa zhig nas zing cha cung zad byung / delirkyen gyis zing cha rnying ba'i me ro cung zad 'bar bar brtsams kyang rje 'dis thabs mkhas drag pos me rgyun rbad chod du mdzad pas de phyin chad gtam tsam yang nub song ba dang /gung thang rje bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pa'i mnal lam du 'du khang nas bya lag mdo'ibar du bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri ba rnams yin zer nas khri sum brgya dang bcu gsum gyi steng du bla ma re bzhugs pa la bla ma gnas brtan pa khri med pa'i bar stong zhig na bzhugs 'dug pa byung ba sogs kyis lung bstan gyis zin pa'i khri thog bcu gsum pa rje 'di ngos 'dzin mkhan yang snang ngo / / / de ltar chos srid gong 'phel gyi ngang nas gdan sar lo hril bo bdun bzhugs rtsis kyi rten 'brel dang rmi ltas byung yang dgos dbang zhig gis lo hril bo drug 'das pa'i lo ngo bdun pa chu sbrul lo dgongs pa nan zhus byas te khri zur bzhugs mdzad/ de yang hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kyi shab shub cher mi mdzad kyang / rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa/ /brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya/ /zhes

/ke ske da 40/gsungs pa ltar gyi brtul zhugs kun gyi snying bo de las mi 'da' ba zhig yod snang ste/ skabs 'gar lkog—nyan byas na mi rtag pa sogs la nges shes 'drong ba'i chig lab mang po 'char ba zhig snga nas yod par nyid kyi nye gnas dmapa ngag dbang tshul khrims pa gsungs shing / phebs bzhud sogs kyi tshe chibs thog nas legs bshad snying bo skyor bzhin phebs par zhabs phyi rnams gleng ngo / / e ma bcom ldan 'das kyis mang thos tshul ldan gyi gang zag gis dkor la bdag po'i tshul dang / mang thos tshul ldan re re bas bu lon gyi tshul dang / de gnyis gang yangalhamed pas lcags gong 'bar ba'i tshul du longs spyad dgos par gsungs pas/ dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar yid la dran nas mdzub mo nang du dgug par rigs so/ /yang zhal nas/ kho bos dgon pa 'dir phan thogs chen po gsum byas yod kyang sku zhabs rin che ma gtogs gzhan gyis shes kyang mi shes la/ gal yang mi che gsungs pa dpyad gzhi che yang gna' dusargyud grwar dbyar phyi ma tshugs tsam ma gtogs thams cad la dbyar dgag gnyis ma tshugs la/ 'di dus bstan pa'i rtsa ba so thar gyi lag len da lta mig mthong lag zin du khyab che ba'i gzhi0gsum gyi nang tshan dbyar dgag gnyis tshugs pa dang / gong bkod ltar bag chags brtan byung gi 'khrug zing ming tsam yang nub pa dang / mtshan nyid grwa tshang thos bsam gling zur du phye nas da lta'i chos srid rkang tshugs pa 'di ka'i gzhi yarode dus tshugs pas dge 'dun thugs mthun khrims gtsang gis 'chad nyan la 'bad na thugs dgongs rdzogs ༷'i

40skye gidadzha tshu dadzi /gsung yin nam snyam/ dgung lo donagacig pa me lug zla ba gsum pa'i nang du zhogs ka zhig gzims sad ma thag tu bsnyun zug gzhan med par phyag zhabs bsgul skyog mi nus pa zhig byung bas thams cad kyis zhabs brtan sgrub rtsis byas kyang skyon med/ nga sngon dbus su song skabs lha sar slebs pa'i nub mo lcags po ri'i phyogs nas bud med dkar mo mda' dar bzung ba zhig 'ong ba la nga'i tshe tshad dris pasakhyod kyi tshe tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig yin zer/ nga rang la dgon pa na las don chen mang po bsgrub rgyu yod khu sa tshe tshad bsring dgos byas pas 'o na don lnga'am don bdun du sdod zer bas da lo mi 'chi gsungs/ ji ltar gsungs pa ltar snyung gzhi sangs dwangs su song nas yar mar la phebs thub pa zhig byung / dgung lo don bzhi ba lcags khyi'i lo hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la zhi bar gshegs so / / de skabs mnal lam du byang gi phyogs nas bla ma sku bong (bongs)che zhing ston pa'i cha lugs 'chang ba bzang po'i bzhugs stangs kyis bzhugs pa zhig mthong / der bdag yul gzhan du 'gro grabs byas par bla ma de tshur myur bar phebs nas khyod yul gzhan du 'gro dogs nas nga 'dir 'ongs pa yin gsungs pa zhig rmis gsungs pa ni yid dga' chos 'dzi na du gshegs pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can du gdon mi za'o// //

go na cabs derngos 4dubyegadan rabs bco lnga ba rje bsod nams dbang rgyal/gdan rabs bco lnga ba smra ba'i khyu mchog 'gran zla med pa bsod nams dbang rgyal ni sngon btsan po don grub rgya mtsho sku 'khrungs pa'i yul btsan mo sna zhes pa chos 'khor dang nye ba'i sar mang nge zhes pa'i rus su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me rta la 'khrungs/ mkhas dbang dbyig kya rab 'byams pa ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs pa'i drung du rab tu byung nas bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs/ sde khri rin po che'i drung du bsdus grwa'i brtsi bzhag gsan cing / rigs pa'i seng chen blo bzang gnas brtan dge rgan du bsten nas bsdus grwa blo rtags phar phyin bcas la sbyangs pas rtsod pa la thogs pa med pa'i snyan grags thob/ yul dbus bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar bka' pota chen po lnga la slob gnyer rdo rus thug par mdzad/ de dus chos thog phal cher la chos grwa 'chag med kyi dam bca' dang / chos mtshams phal cher la brag phug sogs su dpe mtshams la phebs te nyin mo thugs 'dzin dang / mtshan mo sa mtho sa'am 'gol sa rer skyor sbyangs sogs nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu thos bsam la gzhol bar mdzad/ zhul nas/ kho bo dbus su slob gnyer skabs sdug rus ha cang che ba dang / cha rkyen bkren pas gdan tsam yang med pa'i stabs kyis rlung dang gcong nad 'dis thebs pa yin zhes gsungs/ de ltar sbyangs pas thugs kyi chu mtsho mkhas pa rnams la brin pa'i legs bshad kyi bang

the/10 ———gad mi bsnye mdzod du gyur pa na dpe khrid dang dogs gcod zhu ba sogs kyi ched du blo gsal brgya phrag du ma pad mo'i mtsho la ngang mo 'du ba bzhin du byung / lha ldan smon lam du dka' pota chen po lnga'i grwa skor mdzad de bstan pa'i bya ba yang dag par bsgrubs shing khri chen nam mkha' bzang gi drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ stod rgyud grwa tshang du phebs te rgyud sde bzhi'i gzhung man ngag mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes dbus su byon skabs ba so'i lta khrid kyi bshad pa zhib rgyas sogs chos mang du gsan par/ paṇa chen rin po che nas dgyes gzigs chen po mdzad cing phyis rang yul du 'byon kha bkra shis lhun por mjal skabs su/ khyed sku yon bzang bas sgrub pa snying por mdzad na legs zhes sku gzan sogs kyi gnang sbyin dang bcas dgyes pa'i gsung gnang / khri chen nam mkha' bzang dang / lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje ngag dbang byams pa rin po che/ stag phu grub pa'i dbang byugabrag rgyab dpon slob blo bzang chos 'phel sogs kyi drung du zab rgyas kyi man ngag mtha' yas pa zhig gsan/ zhal nas kyang dbeen gnas re nas ma ṇi 'ga' bgrang na mkho bar 'dug snyam nas bka' chos ci thub nyan pa yin gsungs/ khyad par bla ma byams pa rin po che'i gsung zhal rtsed tsam yang man ngag tu mdzad de/ phur bu lcog bla ma'i sku shogs nas 'di 'dra gsungs zhes yang yang slob ma'i rna bar skyel zhing / rnam thar gsung gleng gnang dus spyan chab dbang med pa 'khrug pa zhig snang / pha yul nas gdan 'dren pa lan gnyis song yang sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis

gdan dngos 411brlabs pa'i dbus gtsang gi gnas 'dir ri khrod cig bsten dgos dgongs nas ma phebs pas yang bskyar gdan 'dren pa song skabs skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas yi ge nan can gnang 'dug par brten mdo smad du byon/ bkra shis 'khyil du po ti lnga bsdus grwa dang bcas par dam bca' bzhag pas mkhas pa'i yon tan mngon du gyur/ ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin du phebs 'dun gyis skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la dgongs pa zhus par/ khyod ri khrod la 'gro mi khoms/ ngas tshe 'dir bstan 'gro la phan ci thogs shig byed rgyur/ nged rang tsho tshe rabs du ma nas 'brel ba yin pas nga la grogs shig byed dgos/ deng sang gi skye bo la phan thogs pa shin tu dka' bar 'dug /nga'i rmi lam du thang chen po zhig na skye bo grangs med pa zhig tshogs nas 'dug pa nga rang gis ri rtse nas thag pa btang ste yar 'then pas thams cad ri rked cig nas mi yong ba 'dug skabs shig mi nag po zhig gis nga la 'then grogs byas pag de'i phyed tsam ri rtser thon thub pa zhig rmis gsungs/ mi nag po de su lags zhus pas/ de ye shes kyi mgon po yin par 'dug pas/ khyed rang gis kyang mgon polirnal 'byor la 'bad na legs gsungs/ de nas bzung ste bla mgon dbyer med dang snying zhugs grib sel sogs dang gzhan yang mgon polirnal 'byor zab khyad can du ma thugs nyams su bzhes par gda'/ skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs phyir rgya nag tu phebs skabs de phyogs su slob ma mang ba'i stabs kyis snyan grags che bar byung ste/ sbyin bdag phal cher gyis zur du 'bul nod bstabs pas phyag rdzas gtos che ba

412 gdan rab da kyi byung yang mang 'gyed du btang ste 'dod chung /chog shes kyi rnam thar gsal bar bstan/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang gi drung du rim lnga gsal sgron gyi bshad lung gsan skabs dka' gnad kyi gsung 'phros gang gnang la lan thogs pa med par phul bas thugs shin tu dgyes nas sger gyi gsung gleng 'phel zhing thon chag kyang spam mtho ba gnang / sku la yun ring bzhes pa'i sku 'gag cig kyang bstsal pa phyis bkra shis 'khyil du thub dbang gi sku mi tshad tsam bzhengs pa'i gzungs gzhug tu 'bul bar mdzad/dgung lo zhe brgyad pa chu sbrul lo tshogs chen gyi khrir phebs te me bya'i dpyid bar du 'chad nyan gnang / chos grwa'i gsung chos la lam rim gyi gsung bshad gnang bas nyan mkhan thams cad snang ba 'gyur 'gro ba zhig mthun grub yin la/ brtsi bzhag gnang skabs po ti lnga'i dka' gnadi la res 'ga' bshad ba dang / res 'ga' 'dzin grwa so sor rtsod pa gnang ba sogs nyin res mos dang / 'dzin grwa res mos su mdzad pas/ dbyar dus nyi ma shin tu ring ba'i skabs su yang nyin ring po chos thun gnyis tsam gyis 'da' zhing / 'dzin grwa gsham ma'i zla bo byed mkhan rnams kyis brtsi bzhag sleb kyi bar du phan tshun bgro gleng tshar bzhi re tsam byed long yod par myong stobs kyis grub/ char che ba'i dus su btsugs shing la char skyon byed mi 'jug cing / kha char dang grang ngad tsha ba'i dus su brtsi bzhag rgyun lhag par bsrings nas gnang ste/ da res tshogs sog sgrib sbyong tshan che snyam pa'i skal pa bzang po la sbyor ba dang / srod chos sogs la yang 'phros pa yun ring gnang zhing / skabs 'ga' zhig tu mtshan mo

gid5 khris dar / 413'dzin grwa gong 'og bsres nas rtsod bcug ste yun ring gzigs rtog gnang ba sogs rting bskul cher mdzad pas 'chad nyan me ltar 'bar bar gyur/khri chen blo bzang snyan grags pa nas rje 'di ba'i bar 'grig lam je zhib dang / 'chad nyan je 'phel gyi mu phra nyag med pa byung bas bla ma 'di gsum gyi ring la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis rgyal bstan spel bar nus pa'i dge bshes thon che bar byung zhing / lhag par 'di skabs skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la snyan bskul rim par zhus pa bzhin thos bsam gling la bca' yig zur du bzhag tshogs chen la sbyin bdag zur ba med skabs thos bsam gling la grwa ja star chags su gtong ba'i srol btsugs/ po ti lnga'i rtsod grwa hor khongs su mi lus pa'i ched du rtsod yig bzhag bsdus grwa ba rnams spobs pa skye ba sogs kyi ched du rwa stod ltar bsdus grwa'i tshogs langs — gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ gling bsre rigs grwa sogs 'grig lam mang po dag ther zhib mos bka' rgya bzhag slob gnyer ba drag shos rnams la ting bskul mdzad nas rnam bshad gser phreng sogs gzhung chen mo du mali skyor sbyangs kyi srol btod/ gtor sgrub lcags mkhar gyi phyag len 'don chog sogs snyan rgyud dang ngag sgros su bzhugs par dag ther zhib cho/ gnang ste 'don chog nag 'gros su bkod pa sogs phyag rjes rlabs che ba bskrun/de nas khri zur bzhugs mdzad pa'i bar skabs shig skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' zlog ma nus par klu 'bum ja sag gi bla mar rib tsam phebs/ dus de tsam ma gtogs bya lo khri zur bzhugs mdzad pa nas bzung ste sku ma 'das kyi bar du lam khrid dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi

414 ged5 bas daso khrid/ zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi ljags bzlas/ dmigs brtse ma'i khrid/bde mchog lus dkyil gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ lta khrid/ mgon polirnal 'byor zhal las shes pa du malikhrid sogs phal cher nyams bzhes chag med gzhir bzhag gis dbyar dpe gzigs dang / dgun bsnyen sgrub gtso bor gnang zhing / bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs sogs su yang thun bar la dpe gzigs rgyun mi 'chad pas dgung lo mtho ba'i skabs su yang yig cha'i tshig phal cher thugs thog nas shar shar thon cing / bsdus grwa'i khas len gyi 'dzin mtshams phra mo re yang ma bsnyel bar thugs la nges pa dang /rgyun du kha ta re gnang ba yang byang chub lam rim gyi glegs bam kha phye ba lta bu zhig yin pas bdag lta bulidamu rgod kyi skye bo rnams kyang drung du slebs pa tsam gyis 'phral du rang mtshang la 'gyod pa rang shugs kyis skye ba zhig yong / skabs 'di dag tu yang bstan 'gro spyi la dgongs pa'i lhag bsam gyi mthus dgon pa'i 'grig lam sogs skyabs mgon mchog gi chos srid kyi mdzad 'phrin la thugs khur shin tu che zhing / mdzes lam du ma song ba'i snyan bskul gyi chu rgyun du ma phul ba thugs kyi chu mtshor gzhol bar gyur te/phyag len la thebs pa'i rlabs phreng spros pa mang po zhig mngon sum gyi yul du gyur/ snga sor khrir bzhugs skabs skyabs mgon mchog la lcags mkhar gyi rnam bshad cig bka' rtsom gnang dgos zhus par/ 'o na khyed kyis bsdus grwa zhig rtsoms zhes lha rdzas nang mdzod dang bcas bskul ma mdzad pa ltar bsdus grwarirnam bzhag gsung rtsom mdzad cing / legaspobashad snying po'i dka' gnad kyi zin bris dang / rnam thar sgo gsu gagyi

gad/—ra —1 rwadardos/ 415mtha' dpyod/ 'dul ba'i spyi bstan ljags zhus kyi 'phro can sogs mdzad la/ dbu phar gyi zur bkol du ma bka' rtsom gnang bzhed yod kyang bskul mkhan ma byung / 'chad 'gyur bla ma rjes mas rje'i gsung 'bum gnang ba'i phyi de nas rim gyis paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung 'bum/ bka' gdams pa'i gsung du ma/ bka' gdams gzhung drug sogs rgya gzhung gang mang / bla ma byams pa rin po che'i gsung 'bum sogs kyi lung / lam khrid yang yang / bshad lung dang zab khrid du ma/ rjes gnang gang zhus sogs stsol par mdzad/ dgung lo re brgyad pa chu glang gi lo bcad rgya'i bar skabs shig bad kan gyi bskung gzhi cung zad 'phar kyang je bder song 'phral yang bskyar bcad rgyar bzhugs pa la/ slar bskun lci bar song ste bcad rgya grol/ slob ma drag zhan thams cad la mjal kha dang / bab bstun gyi zhal ta bstsal/'di skabs thugs dam zhig gi skabs spyan chab nyil gyis byung ba de skabs ci yin ma shes kyang / sku 'da' khar kha sang dus phyis dge sbyor kha 'don gyi rigs ma nus pas rlung 'gro 'ong gnyis po 'di kho na yin te/ da sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags mang po byung gsungs pa la dpags na/ de skabs gtong len la brten nas byams snying rje dang / bdag gzhan mnyam brje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gnang bas 'gro kun sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la mi bzod pa'e snying rje'i shugs kyis spyan chab bklags par the tshom med do/ / hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer gcig gi dgung mo bsnyung g.yog

416 gdan ba dasdos rnams la dgyes pa'i gsung phebs par/ dpa' ris dge slong 'jigs med dam chos kyis/ nyid kyis gzigs na sku khams kyi babs (bab)ci 'dra 'dug zhus par༈ sa khams kha sang nas thim song gsungs/ 'o na sku tshe 'dir thos bsam sgom sgrub/ 'chad nyan gang nas kyang sku don mthar phyin pa yin 'dug pas/ da ni 'byung ba'i thim rim nas bzung ste 'od gsal ba bu bsre ba'i bar gyi thugs dam gyi skor sogs thugs nas ma bsnyel ba'i ngang nas sku yon dran nus pa'i mchog sprul zhig 'byon rgyu'i thugs 'dun gnang dgos/ skyabs mgon thams cad ma/khyen pas kyang rang re tsho tshe rabs snga ma nas 'brel che bas/ phyi mar yang 'di bzhin smon lam 'debs dgos zhes bla ma snga ma rnams la yang yang gsung gi yod pa thugs mnga' ltar lags zhus pas/ skyabs mgon rin po che dang 'brel che ba 'dra/ chung ngu nas rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis ba spu g.yo ba zhig yod cing / phyis su gzims khang du song na yang de ltar du 'dug sku zhabs rin po ches kyang tshe rabs snga mar 'brel che zhes gsung skabs shig 'o na nga khyed kyi sku gong ma'i nang gzan zhig tu skyes sam zhus par/ khyed tsha kho rab 'byams pa dge 'dun grags pa'i skye ba yin par 'dug gsungs song / tshe 'dir mchog sprul zhig dang mjal ma thub kyang / phyi mar mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs pa gzhir bzhag yin gsungs/ da nga'i lus kyis tshugs mi thub pas glo g.yas su nyal dgos gsungs/ de ltar mdzad nas ston pa sangs rgyas kyang 'di ltar bzhugs pa yin gsungs/ skabs shig ngas skyil krung byed dgos pa

gedan rab daros/ 41tso'adug gsung zhabs skyil krung gis drang bor bzhugs/ brda' gnang ba ltar thugs dam gyi rten mgon po dang / 'jam dbyangs kyi thang sku'i zhal phye bar thal mo sbyar nas gzigs par mdzad/ de nas phyag mnyam gzhag mdzad de hig gsum gnang bas tha ma'i skabs dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad de thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bde chen stong pa'i dbyings su zhugs pa'i thugs dam gyi ngang nas dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang du gshegs so/ /de'i tshe dbyar dus ltar na bun 'thibs pa dang / nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa dang / 'khor lo dang padma'i dbyibs can gyi kha ba shel ltar 'tsher 'thor ba sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang du byung ba mig gi yul du gyu ra to/ /gdan rabs bcu drug ba rje 'jigs rmed lung rigs rgya mtsho/gdan rabs bcu drug pa sde khri rin po che'i mchog sprul 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtsho ni/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang dge 'dun rgya mtsholidabon por rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa 'brug lo 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i mdzad spyod rang chas su yod cing / sde khri rin po che'i sprul skur thag bcad pa'i lo rgyus sogs mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar dang rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs su gsal/ gdan sar spyan drangs pa la dga' ston rgya cher bsgrubs shing skyabs mgon mchog nas sde khri gong ma

418 gdan rab da /de nyid kyi sku'i che ba'i yon tan dang bka' drin che tshul gyi bsngags brjod dang / da cha sprul sku 'di ba bla ma de nyid kyi skye ba yin par gzims khang phu nas zan brtag sku zhabs stong 'khor rin po che'i lung bstan/nged kyi rmi lam sogs 'khrul med byung ba'i stabs gdan sa la spyan drangs nas thob go sa sogs dpon slob gong ma'i ring ltar phul yod pas chos sde chen po 'di nyid la gtogs pa'i ser skya drag zhan tshang mas de lugs kyi brtsi 'jog bkur gzos dgos tshul gyi bka' rgya zhib mo gnang ste tshogs pa'i dbus su klog bcug mdo sngags yongs rdzogs kyi dge bshes chen po bka' bcu dkon mchog rgya mtsho dge rgan du bsten nas klog sogs sbyangs shing / dgung lo bcu gsum pa la bkra shis 'khyil du chos grwar zhugs nas bsdus grwa blo rtags phar phyin dang bcas pa gsan sbyong mdzad/ dgung lo bcu bzhi'i skabs nub gcig mnal lam du khyod la gza' phur bus gnod pa 'ong bas myur bar tsaṇḍa ma thon zer ba zhig byung ste tsamā ma gsung bzhin mnal sad/ bla mgon dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs 'ga' gsungs nas gzims rtsis gnang yang gzims gtan nas ma 'ongs pas/ bzhengs nas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma tshar gcig dang mjug tu 'jam dpal mtshan brjod gsungs pa na/ gzims chung gi g.yas phyogs kyi gru nas 'od cig dkar lam me song bar gzigs pas mig ya gcig 'od lam me yod par mthong / der bzhengs nas rje gong malin bza' zhig bzhes te mtshan brjod gsung bzhin pa'i ngang nas gzigs pas mgo dgu yod pa zhig tshur nur nas 'ong bas nang thams cad 'od kyis khyab song / der

pyokaubasadaldas ———————da wasdo —dzeegi khong gis rdo rje 'jigs byed yin nam snyam gzigs pas rwa mi 'dug mgo dgu'i dang po bya rog gi mgo la mjug ma sbrul du yod pa/ lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje bzung nas mdun gyi ka ba la gtad/ g.yon pa brkyangs nas zhags pa dang gri gug bzung ste g.yo 'gul med par 'dug pa mthong tsa na bza' mchog rwa hu la yin par shes nas phyag rdor zhig sgom dgos snyam kyang mtshan brjod kyi/ ha la ha la gdong brgya ba/ /gshin rje gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal/ /zhes pa'i mtshams su slebs 'dug pas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la dmigs pa cung zad gtad pa na 'gul nas sil sgra dang bcas mi snang bar gyur ces rje rang nyid kyi zhal nas thos pa ltar bris pa'i zin bris shig las 'byung / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi drung nas 'jigs byed kyi dbang gsan pa'i sta gon gyi nub mo mnal lam du rje rang gi mda' gzhu thogs 'dug pa mi gzhan gyis khyed kyi mda' gzhu thogs pa ci yin dris pa'i lan du/ shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs/ /nyon mongs mi shes g.yul ngo sel/ /dpa' bo bdud dgra bdud 'dul ba/ /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa sel bar byed/ /ces lan 'debs pa rmis tshul zhus par mnyam du dbang gsan pa rnams kyi ngag nas thos/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang dgon lung du lan gnyis pa phebs skabs mjal du byon par lcang skya mchog nas kyang bkur gzos mdzad cing / sku gong ma de nyid dgon pa la bka' drin che bar brten er ti ni mer gan shi re thu mkhan po zhes pa'i cho lo dang bka' shog sogs kyis gzengs bstod gnang / skyabs mgon mchog gi 'khrungs rabs gsol —'debs shig bka' rtsom zhus te sgo

420 — rgu nog dande mang grwa tshang dang bkra shis 'khyil gnyis kar mang 'gyed kyi thog tshogs 'don du btsugs/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa la yul dbus chos kyi zhing du byon nas bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar po ti lnga'i slob gnyer yang dag gnang bas sprul sku spyi lugs kyi bam 'jog tsam ma yin pa'i lha sa smon lam gyi grwa skor mdzad/ nyer brgyad pa shing lug lo a mdo nas gdan 'dren pa 'ong skabs mnal ltas mi legs pas nga mi 'gro gsungs na yang nan gyis phebs dgos byung bar paṇa chen rin po che nas 'jam dpal no mon han zhes pa'i cho lo dang / rgyal dbang rin po che nas er ti ni zhes bsnan te yab sras gnyis ka nas bka' shog dang bcas/ rta dar/'bog lcag tham ga gdugs ma gtogs pa'i mkhan chas kyis gzengs bstod gnang / dgon pa nas kyang chibs bsu snga phyi dang ser sbrengs sogs kyis bkur gzos rmad du byung ba bstabs shing me sprel hor bla bdun pa'i nang du dgon pa rang du phyag babs/ bka' blon rdo ring paṇḍi ta zhes chos srid rig gnas la blta ba'i blo mig can de nyid la/ rnam bcu dbang ldan lha sa khyams ra chen mo'i nub phyogs na yod pa ji lta ba bzhin sgrub thebs dngul dkar srang lnga brgya sogs phul nas sgrub bcug par legs par bsgrubs nas gnang yang / 'di theg pa'i lha khang a mdo na e yod dam gsungs pa de da lta gser khang chen mo'i spen pad kyi rgyan du mdzes pa 'di lags so/ /de bzhin du 'du khang chen molisgo shan sgo phor dang bcas pa rdo ring paṇḍi ta nas gnang / gser khang chen mo'i de rnams bsam 'grub pho
