ged ngabasad sa 421brang nas dang / bla brang thub bstan pho brang gi tshoms chen 'dod dgu 'khyil ba'i de rnams rgyal tshapa rin po che rta tshag no mon han la zhus pa ltar 'dod 'jo dpal mo nas bsgrubs pa sogs gnas 'di'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rnams kyang khungs ldan sha stag yin te 'phros tsam mo/ /me bya hor zla gnyis pa'i yar tshel la tshogs chen khrir phebs/ brtsi bzhag gnang skabs 'dzin grwa re la nyung mtha' shog gu re las mi dma' zhing rgyun du de las kyang mang ba gnang ste/ grwa tshang 'di lta bu gsum la 'chad nyan byed dgos na yang byed rgyu'i spobs pa yod ces tshogs gtam gyi skabs su gsungs/ skabs skabs su chos grwar rgyun ring bzhugs nas sku mdun du 'dzin grwa res mos kyis dam bca' tshugs pa la gzigs rtog dang / dbyangs chags la ched gnyer gyis phebs nas dbyangs slob pa dang dag ther sogs mdzad cing / srod chos med skabs su yang dgung mo'isku rim la thengs 'ga' phebs pa dang / 'grig 'gal phran tshegs kyi skor bsnyel dogs nas sam ṭa la phyag bris gnang ba bsnams nas chos grwar tshogs gtam gnang ba sogs rting bskul che bar mdzad/ dmigs gsal zhig gi tshe gtor rgyag gnang skabs zhal la lta mi bzod pa'i 'jigs rngam che zhing / dmigs yul gyi mthu dpung theg med bcom pa'i rtags mtshan mngon du gyur/ 'dul ba nas bzung ste kha dog dkar dmar gyi bar la brtsi bzhag kher rgyugs len par/ dpe cha nyid kyi phyag tu bsnams nas mi dang po de'i 'don 'phro nas gnyis pa des 'don dgos pa sogs thar chags su rdzogs pa na sngar mjug 'don mkhan gyi mi de la yang bskyar

422 gidatram̐ —da ḍarjo—༷/— gyis mgo nas 'don 'jug pa sogasacalugs ldog mdzad pas tshul min gyi g.yo sgyu cung zad kyang byed thabs med cing / rgyugs ma 'phrod pa rnams la bab 'os kyi chad pa ldog (zlog)tu med par 'gel bas 'dzin skyor shin tu 'phel/ rigs grwa lan gnyis btang zhing 'du khang steng du lam rim lha khang bzhengs rtsis kyi bsod snyoms la phebs skabs gsol tshigs bsags naspogrwa tshang la sharitshab ra gtong ba gnang / de ltar chos srid gnyis kyis skyong bzhin pa'i mur glo bur du sku bskyong bzhes pa thabs gang gis kyang zlog ma nus par dgung lo so gcig pa sa khyi hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /gzhan lha dang bla ma'i gzigs snang gi gtam yang thos la lung bstan thogs pa med pa sogs kyi lo rgyus mang na yang 'dir de tsam mo// gdan rabs bcu’bdun ba rje bsod ’ nams grags pa/ gdan rabs bcu bdun pa lung dang rtogs pa'i gter mdzod khri chen bsod nams grags pa ni hal ha dang cusagar gnyis 'khrugs pa'i skabs hal harimi 'ga' mtsho sngon phyogs su 'ong ste mergan dra'i ching gi ru sdelikhrod du 'brog gzhi bzung ba'i rgyud cig tu rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu yos la 'khrungs/ chung nguridus nas ma cig gi bdud gcod la thugs zhen shin tu che bas khros nag lha lngaridabang gsan cing lus sbyin ma chag pa mdzad/

dzin wasatshospo 423 bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar sde khri rin po che'i drung du bsdus grwa'i tshig bzhag thog mar gsan cing / 'be bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho zer ba'i dge bshes lta ba'i gnad 'khrul ba med pa dga' 'jigs kyi nyams dang bcas te shar bas rjes thob tu yang sgyu ma lta bu'i snang ba rgyun du 'a/char ba zhig yod pa dge rgan du bsten/ dge rgan pa des dbyangs can ma bsgrubs nas las tshogs ltar gyi dngos grub brnyes 'dug par dbyangs can ma'izhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi man ngag gsan nas bsnyen pa mdzad pas mtshan ma khyad par can byung / bkra shis 'khyil du bsdus grwa blo rtags phar phyin bcas la sbyangs shing / skyabs mgon mchog gi bgro gleng zhabs phyi pa yang mdzad/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dang gung thang rin po che ngag dbang bstan po'i rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis kyi drung yig mchod dpon gsol thab pa sogs kyis sgrub dgos pa'i zhabs phyi'i rigs la 'di ma zhus bya ba gang yang med/ rang gi dge rgan 'jam pa'i dbyangs lta bu de la yang me 'bud/ thal phyag ('phyag)chu len sogs phyag g.yog thugs zin nges shig bsgrubs yod gsungs te dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten pa'i rnam thar du snang / dbus su byon nas sgo mang chos/ grwar po ti lnga'i slob gnyer dpyis phyin pa gnang zhing lha sa smon lam gyi grwa skor mdzad/ smad rgyud grwa tshang du phebs te skyor dpon mdzad nas rgyud ṭiko chen mo le'u gsum pa'i mtshams sbyar bar du rdzogs par thugs 'dzin dang bskyed rdzogs cho ga phyag len thams cad la mkhas par sbyangs shing rgyud pa'i 'grig yang shin tu nges pa byung / de nas 'bras spungs dge 'phe—la du

424 ged ba da bzhugs pa las snga sor skyabs mgon mchog mdosmad du 'byon khar bka' babs pa ltar ge re pho brang phun tshogs bde ldan du phebs nas/ lha btsun skal bzang tshogs gnyis dang / rwa stod pa blo bzang rab rgyas kyi drung nas 'jam dbyangs mgon po nas brgyud pa'i ma cig zhi drag gi dbang dang chos skor gyilung rgyun gang yod gsan/ slar dge 'phel du byon nas lo gcig gi ring la bcad rkya mdzad/ bcad rgya grol ba dang dus mnyam du ge re lha ba nas yi ge zhig byung ba'i nang du snga sor gsung ba ltar 'di gar gnyan khrod la phebs rgyu yin na deng sang zla bo zhig kyang 'dug pas myur phebs mdzod dang mthun rkyen gang drag zhus chog byas yod pa ltar yang bskyar ge rer phebs/ ge re shar nub gnyis ka na chu mig mang bas der gnyan khrod chen mo 'grims/ sngon gye re ngag dbang phun tshogs nas bdun mtshams dang po gye re mig ma nag mor mdzad 'dug pas/ nga/sa kyang bdun mtshams dang po mig ma nag mor phyin pas nyams dga' ba byung / gzhi nas gnyan khrod kyi skabs gnas spor gyin thun bzhilinyams len 'chag med byed dgos stabs snang ba thams cad 'gyur nas rgyud la rtogs pa zhig da lta bar skye ba 'dra snyam pa 'char zhes gsungs/ de ltar gnyan khrod mdzad skabs dngos dang nyams snang la gcan gzan skad sna —tshogs sgrogs pa/ wa drag tu brgyal ba/ khyis rub brgyab nas cog gur 'dral ba/ srog chags khyi'i gzugs 'dra ba la rked pa ral yod pa sogs nam mkha' nas rang gi steng du lhung 'ong ba/ gzugs mi snang ba zhig gis mgo dang rkang lag nas 'then cing mgo la dbyug pa gtong ba —

gedan ga sa dngos 425sogs cho 'phrul dang / shin tu 'jigs skrag skyed pa'i rmi lam skyi g.ya' ba sogs phyi nang gsang gsum gyi slong mang po byung 'dug kyang / de lta bu'i slong gang byung gi tshe 'gal rkyen rang sar grol ba'i gdams ngag gis snang ba thams cad dmigs med yum gyi ngang du rgyas 'debs pa'i rtog pa rkyen thog tu bsres pas gcod kyi gzhung khungs ma nas chod tshad mthar phyin pa'i rtags su gsungs pa'i nyams rmis kyang tshul bzhin byung snang ste/ mtshan ltas kyi dran tho zhig mdzad 'dug par gsung ba'i gnad mang du mchis kyang gsal bar 'god ma nus so/ /gnyan khrod rdzogs pa'i mnal lam du/ rang gis rkang gling gsum btang bas skad cig la ngo shes pa dang mi shes pa'i skye bo mtha' mis pa zhig 'tshogs pa la/ mdun du chang snod chen po mang po bzhag pa'i nang nas thod pas chang bcus te/ ston mo'i tshul du stobs pa zhig rmis te/ gcod dbang lan mang por spel nas sa dar rdo dar du song ba 'didzeeltas yin pa 'dra zhes zhal nas gsungs/ gnyan khrod grub nas lo gnyis tsam gyi ring la yul dbus kyi dben gnas sna tshogs su sgrub pa snying por mdzad cing /snga phyir paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me/ rje bla ma byams pa rin po che/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan/ bā ri dpon slob ngag dbang don grub/klong rdol grub chen ngag dbang blo bzang / zhogs gur smon pha dka' chen thabs mkhas rgya mtsho sogs kyi drung du chos bka' mtha' yas pa gsan/ ci khyad pan klong rdol rin po che rang gi shag tu gdan drangs

426 gdan rnabs dasos nas zla phyed lhag tsam gyi ring la zab chos mang du gsan skabasacigrub chen gyi zhal nas/ nga'i mi lam du gser gyi seṅge rkang ba brgyad pa zhig dang spos kyi glang bo che zhig gnyis yod par/ glang bo che des seṅge de rgyun du mig gis 'tsho dgos pa zhig rmis/ khyod dge bshes yin bas sems la zhog ces pa las gsal kha yogasungs/ cher ma 'gyangs par mdo smad nas bsu mi 'byor te skyabs mgon mchog nas rang yudzeedu 'byon dgos kyi sa/sung nan bstsal 'dug par/ klong rdol bla ma rin po che'idrung du phebs nas nga rang gis yul dbus 'dir ri khrod cig bsten snyam yod kyang / bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad ba rin po che nas mdo smad du 'ong dgos zhes gsung nan rtsi bar mdzad6'dug pas ji ltar byas na dga' zhes gros zhus par/ grub chen rin posgyuches khyod 'gro dgos pa zhig yod/ sngar gyi seṅge rkang pa brgyad pa de bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhade pa dang / spos kyi glang bo che de khyod yin pas/ khyod kyis bla ma de'i gang gsung bka' bzhin sgrub dgos gsungs pa dang / rje rang gis skyabs mgon mchog nas rang gisadabu'i steng du byin rlabs rgyun ring gnang nasami khyod la rtsis kha nam yang btang mi yong gsungs pa zhig sngar rmis pa dang mthun pa bcas yos lo rang yul du phebs/ chu 'brug la rgyud pa'i khrir bzhugs shing skyabs mgon mchog nas rgyud pa'i 'grig lam bcos dgos kyi rigs yod tshe dbus kyi smad rgyud dang mthun pa gyis/zhes bka' phebs pa ltar lhungaspre bzed mchod pa darosngags kyi dam bca' sogs gsar du tshugs/ 'grig lam mang po la dag ther mdzad/ chos

— sa rna sa zi dze/shākyi7cho grwa—nas khrid chen brgyad sogs chos bka' yang mang du ba stsal kyang sgron gsal las/ tshigs med 'od ma 'dzag pa 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar pad dkar lta bu'i gang zag mang du byung / de nas urge grwa tshang gi khrir phebs/ de skabs gsang sngags smin rgyas gling la grwa ba brgya zur du phye nas 'chad nyan sogs kyi srol btod cing mi ser la bde skyid kyi sgo 'phar yangs po mdzad par mchod yon gnyis kyi bka' gzhan du 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang tshugs bzang ba'i stabs kyis chos srid kyi bde skyid dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel/ gzhi nas thugs rang bzhin drang bas mtho dman su la yang khrom 'tshogs kyi dbus nas skyon mtshang dmar 'don byed pa la ngo srung cung zad kyang med la/ mdzes lam cung zad re dgos tshul gzhan gyis snyan sgron phul na yang gsan dgongs mi mdzad pa zhig yod de/ dpon chen 'ga' zhig gi btsun mo la phyag phreng gis mjal kha gnang bas/ mi gzhan gyis khong tsho phyag dbang gnang lugs la cung zad mi da ga' bar 'dug zhus par/ ma dga' na sdug kyong yin/ —khong tsholi mgo skam po dang / ngalilag pa 'khyag pa gnyis thug nas ci yong / reg pa'i lhag ma zhig skye shas che gsungs nas bzhad mo zhig mjod/ 'byor ldan gyi pho mo rnams dga' ba skyed pa'i ched du dpral ba dgyes sbyor gyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa rnams kyis gsung 'di thugs la bcangs nas bde chen gyi ye shes la gzab par zhu/ phyag rdzas che chung thams cad la chags pa skyed pa'i rgyu 'di phar khyer gsungs nas 'phral du phyag mardzod la ltos med kyis sprod paske las/ do dam legs nyes sogs spyan zur tsam gyis gzigs pa mi mdzad

42skye gidadzha darngo cing / dkon mchog gi ched du gtong ba la cung zad kyang mi 'phang (phangs)pas/ sa paṇḍi tas/ slong ba phongs pa 'du ba bzhin/ /'bul bar 'dod rnams de bas mang / /zhes gsungs pa'i tshul mngon du gyur / snga phyir dgon par grwa ba re la ja bag re thems nges kyi phogs chen bcu gcig gis mtshon mang 'gyed lan mang btang zhing / 'du khang gsar bzhengs kyi thebs su dngul srang drug brgya phul ba dang / sgo mang grwa tshang dang / smad rgyud grwa tshang / sku 'bum/ dgon lung sogs mdo dbus kyi chos sde du mar mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur dang /skyabs mgon mchog nas dkar po gshong du ri khrod 'debs dgos kyi bka' babs pa ltar der 'du khang shing rtsi dang bcas pa gsar bskrun/thub dbang / mar me mdzad/ byams mgon gsum gyi sku brnyan mi tshad re/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che sogs sku gsung thugs rten/spyi sor rta nor lug gsum ja mar sogs kyi 'jog rdzas phon che ba dang /zhing sa sogs sbyor 'jags mdzad de zang zing gi dngos po rdzogs byang gi rgyur bsgyur ba'i thabs mkhas rmad du byung ba bsgrubs/ de nas sa phag gi dpyid tshogs chen gyi khrir bsko bzhag mdzad pa ltar khri 'don mdzad/'chad nyan dang gastong sgo la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i bugs khur mdzad cing gang ci'i mthun rkyen lhun gyis grub pa byung ba ni chos skyong gi thugs rje yin zhes zhal nas gsungs/ de yang gsung rang ga ba zhig min par snang ste/tshogs gtam zhig gi skabs spyi so nas rgyud ja sogs rkyen khyag nges gtong dgos/ grwa tshang gi thugs ma mnyes na khyod tshosaXganas chung chos skyong la

gdan da sa/ 429bskang gsol ci tsam 'bad kyang legs po byas mi yong / grwa tshang mnyes po byas na chos skyong gis kyang gzigs yod la/ nged tshos kyang bya ba lam du 'gro ba'i sdongs grogs mdzod ces zhus yod/ ces pa dang / zla lhag chos thog cig gi skabs gling gseb tu chom rkun pa zhugs par tshogs gtam gyi zhar la/ dbus tsho na zla lhag chos thog gi skabs su nged rang tsho'i zla lhag chos thog yin zer nas sde ba gzhung la zhus 'gro/ gzhung nas kyang chos thog gi thebs gnang yong / sa cha 'dir de 'dra zhu ba'i srol yang mi 'dug zhus na ga 'dra yin yang mi shes/ rang rang gi tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong yin snyam pa gyis la tshogs chos grwar phebs lugs bslab pa slob gnyero'adzin gshar sbyangs gang cir sngar las mi g.yel ba mdzod/ chos skyong rnams kyis thugs nyams re zhog khyed rang tsho la rdo rje 'chang nas bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa bu bzhin skyongs shig cesaganyer gtad byas yod 'ang (ang)gzhan min na yang grwa ba tsho'i bag khug mgo thon dgos pa 'dug dus rgyun du khyed rang tsho la mchod bkur bsnyen gsum ga 'dra byed ki 'dug pa/ khyed rang tshor sha la dga' ba/ khrag la rol ba zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/ sogs gsungs pas thams cad 'dar zhum me ba byung / ma 'gyangs par thun ma de dag la mi 'dod pa'i dngos po du ma thog tu babs pa'i rkyen gyis kho rang tsho'i khrod nas 'phrin pa byung ste rkun rdzas rnams sprad byung ba dang / rigs grwa'i gtor chen zhig gi skabs gtor zor brdabs pa'i rtse mo ma bsnad par sa la khab btsugs pa bzhin yun ring sdod pa byung ba mchod dpon sogs nye 'khor na yod pa thams

430 dan dgegacad kyis migagis mthong ba sogs chos skyong las la bkol ba'i rtags mtshan mngon sum du grub pa ltar ro/ / — dpon mo rig 'dzin dbang mo sku bsnyang skabs glo bur du phebs nas srin lag skud pas bsdams te khyod su yin zhes bsdigs mo mdzad pas nad bdag gis 'o dod byung ste yul 'dre zhig‘yin tshul sogs zhib par zhus shing phyin chad 'dir mi 'o' zhis khas blangs pa dang / thor god dkon mchog ja sag bkra shis 'khyil du phebs pa'i lam du dpon mo bsnyung nas rje 'di la.oṃbar du gdan drangs te phebs skab sa kho rang tshos mi 'tsho bar thag bcad 'dug kyang / 'phral du bka' bsgo zhig gnang / chi ge lud gsungs/ 'thung yang mi thub/ nad gzhi yang rgod malichang la brten pa yin zhus kyang ljags bsngags gnang nas khar blugs gsungs pa ltar blugs pas ma 'gyangs par dran pa rnyed de pade song ba dang / rgyal gdon drag pos bslad pa'i spyon pa dag kyang gcod dmigs re re tsam gyis btul ba ches mang bas sangs rgyas gnyan ston pas rta mgrin gyi rigs sngags kyis smyon pa brgyad bcu btul ba'i rnam thar dang cha mtshungs shing /gzhan yang yul grong mang polind rims dang sri ngan bcad pa sogs kyis tshe pha rol tu cha sa pa du ma la mi 'jigs pa srog gi mchog sbyin bstsal pa'i lo rgyus mang ste/ de ni bdud gcod don gyi nying khu las / nad pa sman pas bor ba'i mi/ /'a chi ba'i dus btab snying rjeliyul/ /byang sems ldan phyir man ngag gis/ /nad pa 'chos pa man ngag yin/ /bu chung sri (sri'u)nag ma sos pa/ /cis kyang gso datshe༈sa byung ba na/ 'chi

ra ge 431med yum gyi man ngag gis/ /sri'u gso ba man ngag yin/ /mi phyugs nad rims gcod 'dod na/ /'dzin bral drag po'i spros bcas kyis/ /kun la yar shag mar shag bya/ /stong pa sgom pa man ngag yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bdud gcod mnga' brnyes pa'i rnam thar mtshon byed tsam mo/ / khrir bzhugs skabs skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ltar sa phag sogs la 'du khang steng shod dang zhal ras lha khang sogs nas grwa mang la rjeri gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung gnang bas de phyin chad mdo sngags kyi chos rgyun khyab bdal du 'phe la ba'i sgo phye ba lta bu byung / gzhan yang dbang lung rjes gnang zab khrid sogs gang la gang 'tsham pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston rgya cher bstsal cing / khyad par gcod dbang bdag gi dran yul du nges pa lan brgyad kyis mtshon snga phyir mang du bstsal pa la mkhas pa dang bla chen mi chen du grags pa'i khengs ldan du mas kyang ched gnyer gyis gsan pas thams cad sa 'ur rdo 'ur langs nas 'jig rten khams thams cad phaṭa sgras khengs tsam byung ba ni chos sde 'dir a ma lab sgron gyi gdams pa zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul dar ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar rje 'dis 'byed dgos pa yin par gdon mi za'o/ / der ma zad 'dzam gling yongs la dbang ba'i stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i gtsug rgyan rje btsun das pa blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas kyang sngon ma cig gi sras thod smyon bsam 'grub tu 'khrungs pa'i dus kyi rten 'brel gsal 'debs su brgyud pa gzhan gyi gcod skor mang du gsan kyang rje 'di

432 gi lda ched du gdan drangs nas brgyud pa 'di nyid gsan pa sogs la dpags na ma yig chen mor/ ma cig gi sras shig gis chos sde 'dir gcod kyi tshogadams pa spel bar gsungs yod ces gragasanepa dang / chos skyong 'ga' zhig gis rje 'di la yocig sraspo mchog thod spyon la ston zhes bsngags brjod mdzad pa gnyis don dang mthun nam snyam/ chu yos lo khri zur bzhugs mdzad nas don gnyer can rnams la bka' chos gang 'dod du gnang bas skal ldan rnams re ba skong bar mdzad pa las re bdun pa sa bya'i lo dkar pho gshong ri khrod nas sku gzugs cung zad ma bde ba'i rkyen gyis bkra this 'khyil du byon/ sku la sman dpyad rim gro sogs kyis phan ngo che ba ma byung / nyin gcig zhal nas/ nged tshur 'ong skabs skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dang nged rnam gnyis dga' ldan du 'gro rgyu yin zer nas nam mkha' la 'gro ba zhig rmis gsungs/ yang lo snga ma zhig tu nam mkha'i khams thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis gang 'dug kyang byang ngos kyi 'jigs byed rnams rim gyis mi gsal ba zhig tu song ba rmis gsungs/yang nged snga mo chos grwar 'gro skabs nyal kha do nub 'jam dbyangs kyi sku —blta snyam nas nyal bas/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad 'ja' tshon gyi dra bas khebs pa'i nang na 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku che chung ma nges pa du ma zhig sgrin ltar 'khrigs nas yod pa'i 'jam dbyangs re re'i sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs thams cad la zhib par bltas nas/ da phyag rdor gyi sku ci 'dra yin snyam tsa na/ glo bur du 'jam dbyangs thams cad dag nas shul du phyag rdor gyi sku 'char ba sogs yin kyang / deng sang dkor

rdo gisna 43nugyis tshig nas de 'dra med song zhes gsungs pa dkor gyis rgyud bred na lha'i byin rlabs gsar du 'jug 'phro 'chad par ma zad sngar zhugs kyang nyams 'gro ba'i brdar snang / de nas hor zla lnga ba nyis brtsegs yod pa rjes ma'i bcu bdun gyi nyin/ nyams mtshar de ring nga la 'ong ma myong ba'i ltas shig 'ong gin 'dug gsungs/ ci 'dra 'dug zhus par/ shod shes sa mi 'dug gsungs/ de nas nga la gdan shoms gsungs kyang bla mdzeergyud tshod slob mas bzung ba'i rkyen gyis re zhig la dang blang zhig ma byung / bar skabs shig nan gyis bshams bcug ste steng du zhabs skyil krung phyag g.yas pas ḍā ma ru dkrol ba'i stangs ka lan kha shas mdzad pa'i mthar myag gnyis mnyam bzhag dang sku drang bor bsrang ste thugs dam la bzhugs/ zhag gsum nas thugs dam grol te dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ / gdan rabs bco brgyad pa rje rab brtan rgya mtsho/gdan rabs bco brgyad pa mdo sngags smra ba'i dbang phyug rab —brtan rgya mtsho ba ni/ klu shod phyogs kyi g.yi zhes pa'i rus su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu yos la 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar sde khri rin po che'i drung du bsdus grwa gsan/ kha dog dkar dmar gong du phebs skabs 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon brje dgos byung ste/ dge bskos rab 'byams pa gling don grub rgya mtshos khyed rang spyor dpon gyis zer/ nga

434 dasha da sadadzi ————la rtags gsal ma chags pas skyor dpon mi pher zhus par/ khyod la sde khri rin po ches skyor dpon gyis gsungs pa yin zer/ sde khri rin po chelisku mdun du mjal nas sngar ltar zhus pa la/ skyon med rtags gsal myur du go yong / skyor dpon gyis da nga bzang gsungs pa ltar ma 'gyangs chopar rtsod pa bzang shos kyi gras su chud tsing / dka' rams 'dzin grwar thon nas kyang lo bdun te/ lo bcu bdun gyi ring la skyor dpon mdzad pas thal phreng tshang ma thugs 'dzin grub/ 'grel ba don gsal rgyun gyi zhal 'don lta bur skyor sbyangs mdzad pas shin tu byang ste me shing gi rjes su lha chab tu 'gro skabs su yang lam zhor nas tshar gcig 'gro ba 'dug ces zhal nas gsungs/ rdo bcal rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btags mdzad cing rgyud pa grwa tshang du gsang sngags la yang legs par sbyangs/ sman dang rtsis la gzigs 'dod che bar byung ste zhib tu bslab cing / zhar la srung 'khor gyi rigs sogs lag len gzhan mang po yang nyams 'og tu chud pa mdzad pas gzhan phan khyab bdal du byung / lcags mkhar/ gtor sgrub/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg sogs dang / gzhan yang gtor ma'i bca' bzo/ rgyud sde so so'i dkyil 'khor/ mchod rten brgyad dang lto 'phye'i thig sogs mthong brgyud ma nyams pa'i khungs ldan sha stag zhun thar bcad nas bslabs pas phyag len la mkhas pa'i tshad du gleng /zhal nas/ smad rgyud pa'i gtor chen brag ri mdzime ri dra tshul mi mthun pa 'ga' 'dug pa yid ma ches nas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin pa'i mdun nas bslabs pa yin/ lcags mkhar gyi liṅka bri tshul sna tshogs byed pa

— gedan rabs dngos 436mthong nas sgom pa rin chen bstan 'dzin gyi drung nas legs par bslabs zhes gsungs te dbang rnon chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rnam thar du snang /dus 'khor grwa tshang gsar tshugs kyi chos thog gnyis par rdo rje 'dzin par bskos/ de skabs skyabs mgon mchog nas rtse gzhung du skam pa'i hwa mo che zer ba'i sa dpyad mi legs pa zhig yod pa der khyed rang phebs nas mchod rten rtsig dgos zhes bka' babs ltar der phebs/ rgyus yod rnams nas sa 'di shin tu rtsub cing lhag don bla chen gyi rigs mang pos thang sgar tsam bzung na yang gnam dgra sogs kyis sdod mi ster ba zhig yod pas sa 'dul byed rgyu yon tan pa gzhan la bcol na dga' zhes zhus pa ltar gzhan 'ga' zhig gis sa 'dul byed rtsis yod pa dpon bī si bā thur dā'i ching gis gsan nas/ sa 'di gtses (gtsos ) rwa zhig btsugs pas thul mi yong / lho 'phye'i thig 'debs dgos/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dang rje rin po che gnyis 'phyug song na byed thabs med/ces gsungs pa ltar/ rje 'dis sa bslang dang lto 'phye'i thig 'debs pa nas bzung rab gnas kyi bar cho ga thams cad ma tshang ba med par bsgrubs te dpyad ngan gyi mi shis pa bsal nas dge mtshan gyi sgo 'phar yangs por mdzad cing / phyogs de'i gzhi bdag rnams nas kyang mthun rkyen legs po bsgrubs song zhes zhal nas gsungs/ mchod rten 'di ltar rtsig dgos par dpon gong ma na rim gyi dus rgyal ba yab sras gong ma rnams kyis lan gcig ma yin par gsungs pa'i gsung rgyun dpon gong ma'i mdun na 'don seng chen lta bu dag gis gleng ba mngon sum gyi yul du

436 gad datsās da wa gyur spyang / dus phyis rmongs pa mang pos 'gro ba'i 'dren par bkur ba zhig gis skam pa'i hwa mo che mchod rten gyis bcad pas sog yul gyi nad bdag gi lam chad de yul 'dir gnas nas nad yams sogs 'tshub po byung ba red pas 'di bshig na dga' zhes gsungs par grags/ de ni ma brtags pa'i bab col byung rgyal du smra bar shes sla mod/ 'on kyang sku gsung bugs rten bzhengs na nad yams 'tshub la/ mtshams med lnga dang nye ba'i mtshams med lnga sogs byas na bde skyid 'byung ba'i gtam smra ba sogs 'di 'dra'i mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la tshad mar 'dzin mkhan mang ba ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag polidapung rgyas pa'i ngang tshul du shes par gyis shig de nas dus 'khor grwa tshang gi khrir phebs te/'chad nyan/ 'grig lam/ 'don rta dbyangs/ cho ga phyag len thams cad la grwa tshang gsar tshugs kyi bab dang bstun pa'i rting bskul thabs mkhas po gnang bas grwa tshang rme chos srid kyi tshugs zin nges byung /su nyid g.yokṣiṃru'i tha'i ji las skyabs can nas yul phyogs la phan thogs nges kyi bla ma zhig thugs rjes gzigs dgos zhes zhu nan ma bzlog pas skyabs mgon mchog nas bka' babs pa ltar de phyogs su byon/ der yang char 'bebs/ char gcod/ rtsis/ sman dpyad/ gsung brtag sogs gang ci nas gzhan phan che bar byung zhing / khyad par du snga phyir dus 'khor gyi dbang lan gsum dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs dbang dang rjes gnang du ma bstsal pa dang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs skyong phrag brgal ba balhabs te mtha' 'khob kyi yul du dam pa'i

da wa gdanarabs daro 437chos kyi srol rgya cher dar bar mdzad pa ni rnam par thar pa shin tu rmad du byung ba'o/ /lcags byi'i lo dgon par phebs te skyabs mgon mchog tshogs dbur spyan drangs nas dngul srang chig stong sogs bdog pa'i dngos po gya nom pa'i mchod sprin bstar/ 'du khang du rje gong ma'i sku gser zangs las bzhengs pa mi tshad tsam sogs grwa tshang spyi sger la bab 'os kyi gsar 'jog dang bcas dngul srang 'gyed phul te 'brel tshad don ldan du 'gro ba'i bsngo smon zhu ba gnang / bar skabs su rong bo dgon bkra shis chos rdzong gi khri pa yang mdzad cing / dgung lo re gcig pa chu yos lo tshogs chen gyi khrir zhabs pad bkod de 'chad nyan sogs ma nyams pa mdzad/ zhal nas/ nged snga mo ha cang 'dzin bzang gi gras min kyang deng sang brtsi bzhag sogs la dka' tshegs cher mi dgos pa ni dmigs brtse ma mang du bton pa'i thugs rje yin gsungs te/ gsung 'phros sogs kyi zhar la tshar re gzigs tsam gyis chog pa kun la mthun grub tu byung / de skabs skyabs mgon mchog nas/ rigs grwa'i gtong sgo ha cang che ba 'di slar grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan la gnod pa'i nyen 'dug pas rigs grwa'i 'gyed che ba ras lo re dang bcas 'gyed sna gsum dang bla ma grong chog la ma phebs par brtsi bzhag chag med dgos pa'i bka' rgya 'jog bzhed kyis grwa slob spyi la 'dam ka btang bar/ thar pa don gnyer ba rnams chos kho na la 'dun pa'i thugs bzhed zla shel gyi dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur kyang / spyang grung gi khur 'dzin rnams chos srid zung la 'dun pa'i sgra gcan gyis

438 gdan bsadatshusakyi — bye —bsgribs te spu brang lag pas mi theg pa dang / bubs rkyal chu thub pa gnyis ka yong min gyi dbye 'byed ma byung bar brten/ brtsi bzhag 'chag med kyi zhar la thag nye ring gi gshin bsngor mtshan 'gros kyi dka 'a tshegs la dgung lo mtho shos de ltar phebs kyang thugs sun pa'i rnam pa cung zad kyang mi mdzad pa ni bstan 'gro'i don la skyo ngal med pa'i rnam thar du snang / lar chos sde 'di ka'i gdan rabs rim byon rnams nas gzhan gyis dus gcig la sgrub dka' ba'i chos srid kyi bya ba nyi zer gyi rdul 'khrigs pa lta bu'i khong nas 'chad nyan gyi nyin byed la bri gang gtan nas med pa'i srol ma nyams pa mdzad par/ gzhan phar zhog tha na chos thun gcig gis brtsi bzhag la 'dzin grwa rer shog phyed re tsam btang na yang gung zhog gnyis la dpe shog bcu gsum re tsam 'gro zhing / srod chos yod tshe de las kyang mang bar 'gro bas bsngags pa'i gnas so/ /shing 'brug lo skyabs mgon mchog dbus su 'byon khar dbu gdugs ser po zhig dang / 'bog lcag cha bcas gnang nas phyin chad smon lam gsung chos sogs kyi skabs gdugs bzung chog pa'i srol btod pa yin/ nged dbus gtsang nas phyir ma 'khor gyi bar la dgon pa'i chos srid kyi khur khyed nas 'dzin dgos zhes bstsal ba ltar bya bzhag che chung thams cad la bka'i drang thig gis thebs pas chos srid gang nas kyang sgor khyil le ba byung zhing / khyad par deng sang skyabs mgon rin po che thag ring na bzhugs pa sogs kyis dgon par nyams tshad rigs yong shas su 'dug pas/ ngas nyin mtshan gnyis kar rim gro 'bad 'bad byed

spyod ba da'o // 43skyekyin yod ces gsungs shing / mchan mo tsog bu'i sbyangs yon la gnas nas zhal 'don 'ba' zhig mdzad phyag phreng bzhi la rgyun du grangs gsog mdzad pa mig gis mthong / 'phral snang la thugs shin tu 'jam pas drung 'khod tsho la yang spyan log tsam gyis gzigs pa mi mdzad cing /thabs mkhas pa dang / ngang tshugs shin tu brtan pas thugs 'a dgongs pa'i bya byed thams cad gzhan dbang du cung zad kyang ma shor ba zhig rang shugs kyis 'grig 'ong ba dang / gsung gleng phal cher rgyus med kyis nyan na rtsed mo gsungs pa lta bu zhig yin kyang / zhib tu brtags na sems la bcang dgos pa'i gsung rus pa can sha stag yin pas/ thugs kyi gting lon dka' zhes bya bzhag mkhan dag gis rgyun du dogs zon byed par snang / zhal nas kyang / bya ba rgya chen po'i rigs sgrub dgos byung tshe phyi lhod cing nang grim pa kun dang mthun pa zhig byas na sgrub sla zhing 'phral du mdzes la phugagobartan pa zhig 'ong / sa paṇa gyis/ 'jam nyid rno zhes mkhas rnams smra/ /zhes gsungs pa yang de 'dra la dgongs pa yin gsungs/ de nas dgung lo re lnga ba me lug gi lo khri'i dgongs pa zhus par/ skyabs mgon mchog nas da dung lo re gnyis la bzhugs dgos pa 'dra zhes gsungs/ kho bo zhe gcig nas re lnga'i bar la dgon pa 'di'i las sne kho na byas nas rgas tshul sogs zhus par nan ches na thugs dgongs ltar las med gsungs nas dgongs pa dgyes bzhin du gnang / de skabs zhal nas/ da phyin chad tshogs mgo tsam la yang 'gro rgyu min/ kha 'don yang byed rgyu min/ 'don long yang cher mi

440 me 5 mu / — 'dug skyabs mgon rin po che'i zhabs brtan la maṇḍal re phul nas nyal rgyu yin zhis gsungs/ ji ltar gsungs pa ltar 'gol bzhugs mdzad nas thugs dam gong 'phel du bzhugs pa las/ dgung lo re brgyad pa lcags khyi'i lo grang rlung gi bsnyung gzhi zhig yod pa lci bar song nas sman dpyad rim gro gang yang phan ngo ma byung bas hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer drug gi nyin skyabs mgon mchog gzim khang du gdan 'dren zhus/skyabs mgon mchog nas kyang sngar dgon par phan 'dogs che ba sogs kyi dgyes pa'i gsung du ma dang / da dung yang dag pa'i zhing du skyes nas kyang brtse ba shugs drag pos kun nas bslang ste thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis ma dag pa'i zhing du phyin nas sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos bstan pas rgyal bas bsngags pa'i lam rnam par dag pa la 'god nus par gyur cig /ces pa'i smon lam thugs la 'dzin dgos zhes gsungs par/ de ltar 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug thugs rjes gzigs dgos zhes zhus/ de nas bzung ste gsung gang yang mi phebs par gang ci'i byed sgo thams cad phyag brda 'ba' zhig gnang / de'i phyi nyin zhogs kar yang phyag brda gnang nas thugs dam rgyun bstar gyiza byed mkha' 'gro'isbyin sreg dang / tsha tsha 'debs rgyu dang / brgya rtsa shoms sogs gsungs nas ma chag 4pa mdzad / nyi ma yol tsam na phyag brda gnang ste gdan kha gang ma gcig gi steng du gding ba bting / der gdan 'dren bcug sku chos dang snam sbyar sgron du bcug zhabs skyil krung dang phyag mnyam bzhag mdzad nas thugs dam gong 'pho mdzad de rgyal

gi nga 441 ba 'jam dpal snying po'idrung du gshegs so// gdan rabs bcu dgu ba rje darkon mchog bde chen/gdan rabs bcu dgu ba 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog dkon mchog bde chen pa ni/ mdzod dge smad kyi sar rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me sbrul la 'khrungs/ 'khrungs dus kyi rtags mtshan dang / lha dang chos skyong du ma'i lung bstan ltar rgyud pa dpon slob ngag dbang dpal ldan pa'i sprul skur thag bcad de bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ 'di ka'i chos grwar bla chen dang sprul sku spyi lugs kyi 'gying bag spangs te slob gnyer phur thag mdzad/ khyad par du grwa tshang rang gi yig cha'i thal 'phreng zur bkol du ma dang / legs bshad gser 'phreng gi skabs dang po yongs rdzogs/legs bshad snying po sogs thugs 'dzin byas te/ skyor sbyangs mtshan skyong rgyun du mdzad/ zhal nas kyang / ston ka dro grang snyoms shing nyin mtshan mnyam pa rig pa dwangs pa sogs kyis skyor sbyangs rtsal du bton pas ston ka re rer yang mtshan skyong sum cu rtsa grangs re grangs bcad byas nas song ba yin zhes tshogs gtam skabs gsungs/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dang mchog sprul rin po che tshangs sras dgyes pa'i rdo rje sogs kyi drung du dbang lung man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang la mi tra brgya rtsa gsan skabs ye shes 'bebs pa'i tshe thal skad btang ste sdeb legs kyi tshigs bcad mang po thogs med du spel ba ni rgyud nas bshad tshod kyi ye

442 gidanaradzo da wa— shes pa babs pa'i 'bras rtags su sems/ yul dbus su sgo mang chos grwa lo ngo gsum tsam 'grims kyang skyabs mgon mchog mdo smad du phebs rgyur sems skyo nas gzhan ṣṭingag la ma nyan par nan gyis mdo smad du 'ong ba yin te/ mar lam skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs phyi thugs zin nges shig bsgrub rgyu byung zhes zhal nas gsungs/ bkra shis 'khyil du rgyud kyi khri ba lo phadun mdzad cing / chos rdzong gi rgyud pa dang / bla ri mgul dgon pa sogs la yang zhal bdag re gnang / skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs phyir rgya nag tu phebs skabs de phyogs su snyan grags cher rgyas shing zang zing gi 'du 'god dbyar gyi char sprin 'dus pa bzhin du byung / slar bkra shis 'khyil du byon nas rgyud khang zhig gsos dang / rung khang tshogs khro dang bcas pa/ dam can gyi btsan khang rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs rdzogs/ rgyud khang du chu dar/ bla re/ chas 'jug mchod rdzas sogs snga phyir phyag rjes rlabs che ba bskrun/ dgon pa'i shar ri maṇḍal klad du ga zims spyil bting ste 'gol bzhugs dang thugs dam mdzad kyang lung bstan 'ga' zhig las gnas der khang ba mi legs zhes yod tshul gleng ba thos so /bar skabs skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ltar gtsang dgon dang /brag dkar dgon gnyis 'dzin mdzad cing / brag dkar dgon par 'du khang spyi khang sogs gsar bskrun dang / gtsang dgon pa chos srid gang nas kyang grwa zur ma nyams pa mjad pas bka' drin che bar mgrin gcig tu gleng / de skabs su yang gnya' gong brag dkar dang gser

7gdan bas dasdo / 443chen stag rdzong du grags pa'i brag phug sogs dben gnas du mar thugs dam nyams bzhes nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu mdzad/ skabs shig phyag rdzas gang yod gser du bsgril nas bya btang gi tshul du gnas skor mdzad de mdo smad kyi sgrub grwa bzhi sde zhig yan chad kyi chos sde che phra thams cad la mang 'gyed spyi 'jog sogs bab bstun gyi bsnyen bkur mdzad de zang zing gi dngos po rdzogs byang gi gter du sbas/ de ka'i zhar la dan tig shel gyi yang dgon sogs sgrub gnas du mar sku mtshams mdzad de gnas 'brel bzhag slar gtsang dgon par re zhig bzhugs skabs bdud shul phyogs kyi dgra jag gis dpon slob la gnod 'tshe che bar brten/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nang du jun wang ngag dbang dar rgyas nas dmag dpung bteg pa dang lhan cig de phyogs su phebs/ mgon po'i gtor chen mdzad cing go ra'i dug mtsho'i nang du khrag grod pa gang blugs te dmod bcol mdzad ma thag 'khyag rom gas pa'i gseb nas chu khrag mdog gcig 'phyur bas sbal sbrul gyi ro du ma phyi rol tu phud pa der 'khod tshang mas mthong / cher ma 'gyangs par dmigs yul rnams kyang mi dmigs pa'i rgyas thebs so/ /zhal nas/ kho bos dmag mi rnams la brag dkar spun gsum gyi ri 'ben du zhog la me mda' phongs zhes lab kyang khong tsho skrag nas ma nus/ de ltar byas na mi ma yin 'di tsho la bzo rta cher med ces gsungs/ phyis brag dkar gzhi bdag khog zhugs kyis de dus khong tsho ar la gtad tshul gyi gtam mang po dang rdo rgan sum sna na pha bong gnyan po zhig yod pa bar skabs shig nas med song yang phyis su go ra gab

444 gdan bsad sa ron zhig na yod pa mig gis mthong zhes a rig gi mis bshad pa lan gcig ma yin par thos so/ /gtsang dgon gyi skyong khur bzhag nas kyang brag dkar lha ldings (sdings)sogs dben gnas du mar sgrub pa snying bor mdzad bzhin pa las me lug lor skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ltar tshogs chen khrir phebs te 'chad nyan dang gtong sgo sogs sngar srol ma nyams pa mdzad/ sngar dbu ma 'jug pa'i sems bskyed bcu ba yan chad las tshogs 'don mi mdzad kyang sa sprel lo rigs grwa'i skabs skyabs mgon mchog la dgongs bstun zhus te mjug yongs rdzogs tshogs 'don du btsugs/ tshugs ston du thos bsam gling la ja srang brgyad re'i 'gyed btang phyin chad 'grig lta bu zhig tu song / sa bya'i lo dgongs pa nan zhus byas te zur bzhugs mdzad/ de nas gsang sngags smin rgyas gling gi khrir rib tsam phebs shing / phal cher maṇḍal bde chen klad dang / dom lung stag mo rdzong sogs dbeen gnas du mar 'gol bzhugs mdzad de zhal 'don dpe gzigs phyag sbyangs sogs dang yig drug zhal 'don gtso bor mdzad cing /phyogs gar phebs su dge bskul mdzad pa'i ma ṇi dang smyung gnas kyi tho yi ger bris pa la yig drug ther 'bum chen po gcig lhag tsam snang / gsol tshigs thams cad kyi rus dum bsags nas gzungs sngags kyi zhal phu rgyun du mdzad cing / skabs rer rus chog byas te bye ma ri rtser 'thor bar mdzad pa dang / rgyan 'jug mdzod rtsa/ 'jug pa rang 'grel rnamasajirgyun du zhal 'don mdzad pa sogs bsngags par 'os pa'i rnam thar gong

gdadzha rab dngos/ 445'phel du bzhugs pa las dgung lo drug cu ba me 'brug la zhi bar gshegs so// gdan rabs rnya shu ba rje 'jigs med rigs pa'i seṅge /gdan rabs nyi shu ba lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi gzi byin mngon par mtho ba mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che 'jigs/ med rigs pa'i seṅge dpal bzang po ni rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab khri chen dpal ldan grags pa'i skuliskye ba ste/ khri chen de nyid ni mdo smad shar phyogs rgya dang nye ba'i sa char hor tshang gi dpon rgyud cig tu 'khrungs/ ba so rje drung ngag dbang dkon mchog nyi ma mdo smad du byon pa'i drung du rab tu byung / dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang du mkhas btsun gyi snyan pa skye dgu'i rna ba'i mdzes rgyan du 'bar zhing / stod rgyud grwa tshang du gsang sngags la yang sbyangs pa cher mdzad/ kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs/ 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje sogs las zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mtha' yas pa gsan/thos don gdams par shar bas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs shing / khyad par byang chub kyi sems kyi mnga' bdag tu grags che zhes skyabs mgon mchog gi gsung las dngos su thos/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yonajitan gyi gzi byin mngon par mtho bas rgyud stod dang shar rtse rim par brgyud de rgyalab gnyis pa'i bzhugs gdan gser khrir zhabs kyi padmo rnam

446 gedan ra sa dadzi par bkod/ zhal slob kyang khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan/ khri rgyal mtshan seṅge / khri chen nam mkha' bzang / tsha gan no mon han ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs nyi zla lta bu'i mkhas grub mang du byung / rgyal ba'i dbang po blo bzang skal bzang rgya mtsho mtshan nyid gsan sbyong skabs yongs 'dzin gyi go sar mnga' gsol te/dbu ma 'dul mdzod sogs kyi brtsi bzhag phul zhing thugs rdzogs skabs las slob kyang mdzad/ zab rgyas kyi bka' chos gsan bzhed kyi ngang las bya lo khams phyogs su zhi bar gshegs/ gdung zhugs la phul bar gdung rus la yig 'brulirnam pa gsal ba zhig byon pa rgyal dbang rin po ches bzhes/ zhun thig nor bu dga' 'khyil gyi dbyibs can pad ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing 'tsher la brjid pa zhig rgyud smad mkhan rin po che ngag dbang mchog ldan pas bsnams nas rgyal dbang rin po che dang gdan 'dzoms skabs gong bzhes gnang / yang thugs ljags spyan gsum dang / dbu thod la 'jigs byed rang byon/ sku smad kyi pur rus la 'jam dbyangs dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can 'od skor dang bcas/ ya ma rā dza'i sngags phreng gdung rus kyi ngos la bris pa ltar phebs pa/ gsang bdag gi sku dang sngags/ gzhan yang ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur ces phyag mdzod blo bzang tshul khrims dang dge slong chos grags rab brtan gnyis kyis bsgrigs pa'i sku gdung gi dkar chag las bshad do/ /de lta bu'i dam pa de nyid gshegs nas ring po ma lon pa na sku ma cig gi rmi lam du/ rje de nyid yin zer ba'i bla ma paṇa zhwa gyon pa 'brug

—ge darda—rdaḍaḍa — ka—ḍo—sa —/— 44tsol zhon pa zhig nam ma kha' nas babs te rang la thim pa'i rmi ltas byung ba ltar lcags phag lo sngar gyi rigs rus de nyid la slar yang lang tsho gsar ba'i zlos gar mngon par bstan/ grub dbang sde khri rin po cher rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos shing / mtshan blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtshor gsol/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhuganu/ te bsdus grwa nas rim gyis gsan sbyong mdzad/ mthong na mi mthun pa med pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis dad gus kyis yid dbang med du 'phrog pa zhig yin par zhal mthong ba'i skye bo kun gyis mgrin gcig tu gleng / lung rtogs kyi yon tan nya gang ba'i bstan 'jin rgyu skar gyi bdag po zhig 'char bar rtsom pa'i mod la sde khri rin po che sku gshegs pa sogs kyi rkyen du ma'i dbang gis thugs la skyo snang shar ba'i mur lha 'brum bzhes/ zhabs 'brang rnams nas zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab par/ gsung las/ nam mkha' nas tshon skud kha dog sna lnga ba sne mor sha zung btags pa 'dra ba zhig byung nas rang gi lus la reg pa'i snang ba 'char gi 'dug pa khyed tshos e shes gsungs/ mi shes zhus par gti thug gsungs te bkyon/ de gong bdag la blo rtse gtad sa med pa 'dra ba'i skyo snang shar gsung ste/ don la bsam bzhin du ye shes gong 'pho mdzad rgyu'i brdar mngon zhing / me yos hor zla gnyis pa'i ches bcu bdun la zhi bar gshegs/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen pos sprul sku myur 'byon bslab gsum zhi dul ma 'phral du gsar rtsom gnang zhing spel bar mdzad pa ltar slar yang yos lo de nyid kyi mjug tu sngar gyi yul phyogs

448 gedan rabs dadzo / der khyu mchog gi rigs su rje 'di nyid sku bltams/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang lha dang bla ma'i bka' lung mthun zhing sku tshe du mar goms pa'i bag yod kyi kun spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang gis khri chen de nyid kyi sprul skur nges shes 'drongs pa byung / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang 'bum gling gi gnas gzigs la phebs pa'i lam nas ched gnyer gyis phebs te gtsug phud bzhes nas mtshan 'jigs med grags par gsol/ dgung lo lnga ba'i tshe ban sgar du gdan drangs nas der bzhugs shing / dge slong bsam gtan las klog bslabs pas 'bri 'don gnyis ka tshegs med du byang ba byung / de dus sku na shin tu phra yang yab yum sogs la chags zhen gtan nas med pa dang / thugs rab shin tu che bas yi ge sogs la dpyad pa zhib mo 'jug pa zhig yod cing / klog gi slob dpon de la yi ge zer ba 'di gang nas byung ba yin dris pas dbus nas byung ba red zer/ 'o na dbus la gang naspobyung ba red dris pas khos lab rgyu ma rnyed par ngo mtshar ba byung / dgung lo brgyad pa'i tshe khri chen rgyal mtshan seng ge nas rang gi bla ma'i sprul sku yin pa'i gnad kyis phu dud bya ba'i gnas su dgongs te rgya mkhar sgar du gdan drangs/ bsu ba rim par btang zhing gzims chung gi phyi logs su khri chen nyid phyag 'khar bsnams nas bsu bar byon/ nang du phebs nas khri khar bzhugs 'phral brkyangs phyag gsum 'tshal nas mjal kha zhus/ de dus khong dgung lo ha cang mtho bas phyag 'tshal dka' ba byung bar zhabs phyi 'ga' zhig gis phyag gnang mi dgos 'o brgyal zhus par nga bla ma'i sprul sku la phyag 'tshal rgyu byung ba 'di skal ba bzang gsungs

gedan bas dadza 449nas mjal kha zhus/ de nas rgya mkhar sgar du chos grwar phebs dgos nan can stabs de nyid du chos grwar phebs shing khri chen de nyid kyi drung du chos bka' 'ga' zhig kyang gsan/bcu gsum par skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dbus nas mdo smad du byon par chibs bsur phebs nas rtse gzhung du mjal zhing zhal mthong ba tsam gyis pha dang bu phrad pa lta bur gyur/ bkra shis 'khyil du phebs dgos gsungs par/ sngon gyi sku tshe du mar 'brel ba'i thugs smon gyi bden pa mngon du gyur te gsung dang blangs mdzad nas dgung lo bcu bzhi bar gdan sa chen po 'di nyid du zhabs kyi pad mo nye bar bkod cing /hor zla gnyis pa'i yar tshes dge bar rigs smra bye ba'i mdun sa grwa tshang thos bsam gling gi chos grwar zhugs/ nyin der mkhas mchog bye bas mngon par bteg pa'i 'chad nyan chos kyi khri la skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs sen mngon par bkod pa'i drung du gsung gi bdud rtsi'i thog ma myang ste ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su mdo sde'i gtam gyi bdud rtsilithog ma kun shes ko'u de n+ya la bstsal pa dang chos mtshungs par gyur/ de nas bzung dgung lo nyer gsum pa sa glang gi bar du bkra shis — 'khyil rang du thugs sbyong gtso bor mdzad cing / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngar zab rgyas kyi gdams pa yang mang du gsan/ sangasargyas dngos kyi 'du shes kyis ci gsungs bka' bzhin du bsgrubs pas phyis su skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas/ hor tshang gser khri tshang 'di

450 gnenar da /bas chung dus nas nga'i ngo dkar nag 'ba' zhig 'tshos te ngag gcog ma myong gsungs/ rje 'di nyid kyi zhal nas/ skyabs mgon mchog nas de ltar gsungs pa de rang gi sems la 'dzin rgyu zhig yin gsungs/skyabs mgon mchog gi bko' ltar dbus su phebs rgyu'i ched sa glang lor sog yul dang mdzod dger 'bul sdud phran tshegs tsam gnang nas lcags stag lo gangs can mkhas pa'i mdun sar phebs te dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mngagi chos grwar sa khyi'i lo bar du bka' pota chen po lnga'i thugs gnyer rdo rus thug pa gnang bas bstan pa'i gnad la gzhan gyis bkri bar mi nus pa'i nges shes rnyed/ rje gong ma de nyid rgyal dbang gong ma'i yongs 'dzin du song gshis gzhung sa nas gzhan las khyad du thon pa'i bkur rga/zos tshad med pa gnang / po ta lar paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal pos rgyal dbang mchog la bka' chos gang gnang chag med du gsan cing / lam rim chen mo dang bde lam gyi gsung bshad la zin bris kyang khyad du 'phags pa zhig btab/ bstan pa'i gnad la nges pa rnyed pa/ las 'bras kyi blang dor la cung zad kyang mi g.yel ba/ yon tan gyi gter du gyur kyang khengs dregs mi mdzad pa/ chos dang srid kyi cha nas mngon par mtho yang dman cha la dgyes pa sogs bsngags par 'oyopa'i yon tan gyi gter du gzigs nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa nas kyang dgyes gzigs bla na med pa mdzad/ de ltar rang gi yon tan dang gzhan gyi bkur gzos sku phreng rim byon gyi go bab gang nas kyang bla chen spyi lugs kyi 'argyang bag cig 'dor na bzhed dgur 'grub mod kyang / dgung lo bcu

gegirke rapa dngos 451bzhi ba lcags 'brug nas so gnyis pa sa khyi'i bar du mdo dbus gnyis kar rtag tu dman cha kho na lhur bzhes te thos bsam la brtson pa 'di ni sngon gyi dam pa'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba deng sang gi cher rlom rnams kyis rmi lam tsam du rnyed par dka' ba zhig tu snang / po ta lar gnang ba'i gsung mgur las/ skyabs gsum ngo bo 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ /g.yam la rgyugs pa'i bla ma min no/ /gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar ba'i/ /thar lam ston pa'i sa mkhan lags so/ /a'o/ /bkra shis sgo mang ma dgon bu dgon/ /chags sdang spel ba'i rten gzhi min no/blang dor drang nges dgag sgrub byed pa'i/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'byung khungs lags so/ /a'o/ /mthun grogs yang rtse rdo rje spun gang / /'di snang zhen pa'i col chung min no/ /rim gnyis zab mor nang byan chud pa'i/ /gcig chog zhe phugs gtad sa lagasaso/ /a'o/ /gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs/ /'jog sa bral ba'i mdo med min no/ /skal bzang dbang bo yang rab rnams kyi/ /rdzogs byang chen poligazhung lam lags so/ /a'o/ /bdag rang rnagasnang dgyes pa'i rdo rje/ /blo rtse zhig pa'i mgo 'thom min no/ /gtan gyi mdun ('dun)ma chos la gtad nas/ /rang tshod thigs lo'iban rgan lags so/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di bka' sde snod gsum gyi don thams cad rang gi rnam thar du dril nas 'doms pa'i man ngag zla bral du shes par gyis/ snga phyir yongs 'dzin rin po che ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ba ri nyi thang bla ma ngag dbang don 'grub/ brag rgyab dpon slob blo bzang chos 'phel sogs

452 gedan rab dngo las zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gdams pa yang mang du gsan/ dbus su thog mar phebs skabs 'bras spungs chos skyong la skyabs 'jug cig zhus pa'i lan du 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas dus rgyun sdongs grogs byed gsungs pa la/ rgyus yod rnams kyis chos skyong 'dis 'phrin las byed zer rgyu zhig srid mtha' tsam las mi 'ong ba la da res 'di 'dra byung ba ya mtshan zer zhing / phyis su nam zhus na yang 'phrin las byed zer ba zhig mi 'ong mi srid gsungs/ sa phag gi lo mdo smad du chibs bsgyur bar la mo zhabs drung rin po che nas sku gong ma'i bka' drin la dgongs nas bkur gzos chen po gnang zhing / wang nas kyang mthun rkyen khur bzhes gnang /skyabs mgon mchog nas spyang bsu ba snga phyi rim pa du ma dang grwa tshang nas ser sbrengs rgyas pa sogs byed dgos kyi bkod khyab gnang ba ltar ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun nyis stong gis gus pa'i bkur ste dang bcas hon zla brgyad pa'i tshes dgu'i nyin gdan sa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du phyag phebs/ skyabs mgon mchog dang zhal mjal ba la shin tu rings par gyur te gzims shag tu yang ma phebs par bla brang thub bstan pho brang du byon/ yab rje mchog si/ zhabs pad spyi bor blangs te theg pa mchog gi yongs 'dzin gyi bsten tshul mkhyen pa'i rnam thar du snang / skyabs mgon mchog nas kyang dgyes tshor che bar mdzad de rgya mtsho'i gling gi tshong ba gnyen dang 'phrad pa'am pha dang bu phrad pa bzhin gsung 'phros zhib tu mdzad cing shangs len gyi ston mo yang rgyas par bstabs/ lo der bkrashis 'khyil du sku'i bcad rgya lta bu mdzad nas bzhugs shing lcags byi'ilo

gdan rabs daras/ 463 skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ltar mdzod dge stod du brag lung gong 'og ces sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyi sgrub gnas ya mtshan zhig yod pa der dben gnas dga' ldan rab rgyas kyi gzhi 'ding bar mdzad/ skabs skabs su bkra shis 'khyil du byon nas yab rje mchog gi spyan sngar sgrub thabs rin 'byung / snar thang brgya rtsa/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor sogs kyi rjes gnang / mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu dang lha bcu gsum sogs kyi dbang /bka' gdams glegs bam/ bka' gdams gzhung drug sogasakyi lung dang / gcig brgyud kyi gdams ngag mang po sogs zab rgyas chos kyi bdudarirtsi pha zas bu skal gyi tshul du bzhed dgur mnos shing / gsang chen gdams pa'i gter mdzod brag dkar dka' bcu ba ngag dbang grags pa rin po ste'i drung nas spyang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho sgrub thabs brgya rtsa sogs kyi rjes gnang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rdzogs/ 'khrul 'khor lcags mkhar/ sbyin sreg sogs kyi khrid/ mgon po'i be'u bum/ dben sa bka' 'bum gsung 'bum mang po'i lung / khri chen bsod nams dbang rgyal ba'i drung nas zab khrid du ma dang gsung 'bum 'ga' zhig gi lung tsā bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gnas brtan ri khrod pa ngag dbab mkhyen rab la bla ma byams pa rin po che'i gsung 'bum/ rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur 'bum/ gcod khrid/ 'pho khrid nyams myong ma/ gtum mo zhag gsum ma'i khrid sogs mang du gsan/ don gnyer can du mas zhus ngor snga phyir lam khrid dang / skyabs 'gro'i khrid/zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi khrid/ 'pho khrid/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i ci

464 ged ra ——ma/sda kyikhrid/ tshe khrid/ rje'i gsung 'buca / rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung 'bum/ lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang choyoldan pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung khrid dbang rjes gnang mtha' yas pa gnang / de 'dra'i skabs ma gtogs/ lcags byi nas sa bya'i bar du skebs phal cher dben gnas dga' ldan rab rgyas rang du bzhugs nas thugs dam zab mo gzhane gyi blor shong dka' ba mdzad pas nyams rtogs mngon du gyur pa'i zhal bzhes kyang mdzad snang ste/ de kalisgrub phug tu bcad rgya zhig gi skabs su gsung mgur gnang ba las/brag lung chos rdzong dpal gyi lte ba'i steng / /brag dkar lha ri snying bo'i mgul gyi gnas/ /ma bcos lhun 'grub ngang rgyung phug 'di la/ /sgrub khang ting 'dzin phug tu kho bo smra/ /bsngags par 'os pa'izudaben gnas dam pa 'dir/ /dam pa rim byon gser ri'i phreng rnams kyis/ /yang yang zhabs kyis bcags shing rjes bzung ba'i/ /byin rlobs rtags mtshan mang po mngon sum snang / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /sa bya'i lo g.yer gshong sprul pa'i sku dge 'dun zla ba grags pa mchod yon bka' bgros thog nas tshogs chen gyi khrir bsko bzhag gnang yang khong nas grwa tshang la mang 'gyid dang bcas dgongs pa nan gyis zhus pa ltar khrol cha mdzad de yab rje mchog gi dgongs bcad kyis rje 'di ba tshogs chen gyi khrir bsko bzhag gnang ba ltar/ nag zlalibaco lnga'i dugachen gyi nyin 'dus pa rgya mtsholimagon du gyur gdan sa ba la chos srid zung gi thugs brel che ba'i stabs kyis sngar sku 'khrugs kyi bsnyan gasdi yod

—gaḍi na — —1— hūṃ——/ ————ge—tsho6de pa bab lci bar song yang dgung zhogs la bzhes sman rgyun mi 'chad du bsten khong nas brtsi bzhag 'chag med dang / gtong sgo yang sngar las mi zhan pa dngos gtsang bar mdzad pa sogs rang gi phyag len du thebs dgos pa'i rigs la gu yangs phra mo tsam yang mi mdzad la/ 'grig 'gal sogs la sger dmigs kyi tshogs gtam dang gsung lci bar gnang ste/srid pa'i zug rngu gcod byed lam/ /ngas ni khyed cag rnams la bstan/ /zhes pa'i tshul du dgongs/ 'on kyang skye bo mig dang sems med pa 'ga' la ni bcom ldan 'das kyis spyang / sna med rna sdum la sogs gang yin pa/ /de la me long dag ni dgos mi 'gyur/ /nes gsungs so/ /skyabs mgon mchog nas sngar mi sdodzeedabang gdan sa 'dir gnang song yang rdor phreng gnang bzhed dang / dgon pa nas kyang zhu mur lus yod pa 'di skabs lcags khyi'i lo ched gnyer gyis zhu mkhan byung ba'i dbang gis grwa tshang nas kyang zhu rgyu rang 'grig tu song ba dang / sngar dge lugs pa rang nas brgyud pa'i bka' 'gyur gyi lung rgyun zhig mdo dbus gtsang sa/sum du 'bad pas tshol ba gnang yang ma rnyed pa de 'di skabs cha har bka' 'gyur ba gdan sa 'dir phebs nas gnang rgyu byung ba dang / byams sku mthong ba don ldan yang skabs 'dir bzhengs pa sogs chos srid kyi ji 'byor ba dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba byung / lcags khyirilo rigs grwa'i rjes su skyabs mgon mchog gi drung du byon nayoyul dbus na bla ma tshos rigs grwa gnyis btang phyin bla ma'i ༷ḍi spe zur bzhugs byas chog pa ltar ge —

456 gdan ba dasdo — —cibadag gis kyang rigs grwa gnyis song bas da cha lo 'dir khri khur spos chog pa zhig thugs rje che dgos zhus par/ yab rje mchog gi zhal nas/ deng sang bdag thag nye ring gang du song na yang khyed gdan sar bzhugs yod pa 'dis sems shin tu bde gle zhig yong gi 'dug pas re zhig de 'dra rto gsungs pa'i bab 'brel mi 'dug gsungs par/gi — gsung gyen ldog byed phangs pa zhig byung nas rozhig sdod dgos pa byung zhes ldal nas gsungs/ lcags phag lo dbyar dus shig nas da lo'i lo 'di dus ngan pa zhes skyo ba'i gsung yang yang 'byon zhing res 'ga' spyan chab kyang 'don par snang ste/ rdo rje 'chang nas zhing gzhan du thugs dgongs gtad pa thabs gang gis kyang zlog dka'i tshul de dgongs par snang / lo de'i dgun skyabs mgon mchog nas ka mdo bkra shis chos rdzong du mdzad pa'i tha ma bltan par/ sku gdung gdan 'dren gyi skor dang gdung mchod kyi skor sogs la thugs khur che bzhes mdzad/ sngar zla mchod gang yin la 'jug pa gsung rgyun snyoms par bcad kyang sku snga phyi gnyis kyi zla mchod la 'jug pa yang bskyar tshugs pa gnang / chu byi lo smon lam gsung chos sogs gang rgyas dang skyes rabs kyi bshad pa sogs nam mkha' ltar rgya che ba bstsal te/ bstan pa'i nyi ma nub song dus 'dir phran tshos mdzub mos gnam ga la theg ru nga thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir rang gis nang shes zhus pa yin gsungs/ lo de'isnga ma'i cho 'phrul gyi bco lnga'i nyin skyabs mgon mchog nas bstan 'bar ma'i bsngo ba rgyas pa gnang ba rten 'brel la dgongs nas phyin chad kyang rgyas pa byed dgos pa'i srol tshugag/ dpyid chos kyi skabs khri khur

gdan ba da sa/ 457'jog pa'i gsung gnang bar/ drag zhan thams cad dang khyad par grwa mang gis ngu ngag dang bcas bzhugs dgos kyi zhu ba nan tam/ rim bzhin phul bar/ da res 'di bzhin byas na rang gzhan la legs tshul sogs zlog dka' ba'i gsung 'gangs can du ma phebs pas bya thabs dang bral/ya ba rje mchog gi gsung zur sogs gang ci nas da res kyi bla ma 'di gung thang rin po cher 'os gsungs nas de skor la thugs khur che bzhes gnang /grwa tshang la mang 'gyed kyi thog bla bre dang zhing sa sogs sbyor 'jags mdzad/de 'phral bcad rgyar bzhugs shing bar skabs su rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang sogs chos bka' mang du gnang/ chu glang lor brag dkar rgyud pa'i khrir gdan 'dren gyi zhu ba phul bar gnya' gong brag dkar gyi dbeen gnas 'di nyid 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i gnas chen yin pa dang / grub dbang skal ldan rgya mtshos kyang gnas 'dir nyams rtogs khyad par can brnyes pa sogs kyis thugs phrogs te dben gnas de nyid du thugs dam mdzad par dgongs nas zhal gyis bzhes nas der phebs/ 'chad nyan sogs bla ma dbu mdzad pas bka' gnang ltar bsgrubs shing gtong sgo che phra thams cad 'phar ma'i tshul du gnang ste/brag dkar lha sdings kyi dben gnas dam par lo lnga'i ring thugs dam dmar bar mdzad/ zur bzhugs mdzad nas gdan sa bkra shis 'khyil rang du thugs dam nyams bzhes la nyin mtshan 'khor mo yug tu gzhol zhing sa mo lug gi lo lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i dbang phyug sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa'i bya btang bka' 'gyur pa 'jigs med rab rgyas las rgyal

458 gdan ba da ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po cu dang / yab ma mchog gi gsung 'bum/rwa pod kyi lung sogs gsan/ mi tra rdor phreng sogs kyi dbang / brgya rtsa gsum dang rin 'byung sogs kyi rjes gnang / lam rim dang bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid sogs skabs su gaje babasakyi chospokyi 'khor los gdul bya rnams yang dag pa'i lam la bkri bzhin par zhabs sded lhun chags par bzhugs pa 'di lags so/ /de yang skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la rang nyid kyi thugs zin pa'i bu chen mang du yod kyang gsang sngags kyi bstan pa'i bka' babs ni rje 'di nyid yin te/ mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang gnang skabs rje 'di nyid sku mdun du phebs par/ khyed la chas 'jug e yod gsungs/ yod zhus pas ci 'dra zhig yin gsungs/ legs po zhig yod zhus kyang ngas khyed la chas 'jug cig ster gsungos nas tshem drub ma zhig gnang / 4dbang gi skabs su skyabs mchog rang nyid kyi mdun du nyar tshags gnang nas nyin re zhing phyag tu bsnams nas sgron par mdzad pa mig gis mthong / de skabs yab rje nyid nas dkyil 'khor sgrub lugs dbang rdzas bkram lugs tshun chad kyi phyag len shog dril du bris nas gnang zhing dbang skur tshul sogs kyi zhal babo/da kyang mang du bstsal/rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang gi nyin de ring phyag len rgyas pa'i nyin 'dir/byung na slob ma thams cad khrus stegs la 'god dgos pa yin kyang / slob ma'i gtso bo gcig khrus stegs la bkod pas 'thus gsungs pas/ tshogs chen khri rin po che nas gdan sa'i bab dang slob malibagres gzhon sogs kyis 'os pa yin kyang rje 'di nyid khrus stegs la bkod/ rdo rje 'chang

—rtse— da gekanasda dza da rngoge— da wa04tshod rang nyid kyi sku la bzhes rgyu'i rus rgyan rdzogs par bsgron/ dbang rdzas re re'i grangs bzhin rje 'di ba gcig pur phyag len cha tshang ba re sger du khrid/ tshogs pa thams cad kyi sngon du rje 'di ba'i phyag gi rdo rje nas rdo rje 'chang rang gi phyag g.yas pas bsnams nas khrid bzhin du skor ba lan gsum mdzad pa'i mthar/ lha la gtad pa sogs ba spu g.yo bar 'os pa'i mdzad pa mig gi yul du gyur to/ / 'phral snang la yang thug/sa shin tu sgam pas chags sdang nye ring gi gtam zur tsam yang mi gnang zhing drung du gleng ba la yang thugs mi mnyes par ma zad/ bzhed don gang gi skabs su yang thugs la bab sa ma babs kyi gsung zur tsam med par bzang ngan thams cad rgya mtshoriklong du rdo ba skyur ba ltar lhod kyis bzhag ste dgongs pa'i gtad so g.yo 'gul med par bzhugs tsa na/ bzhed dgu lhun 'grub tu 'ong ba zhig yin te/zhal nas kyang / mnyam med jo bo chen pos/ gang yang 'dod khar mi mchi pha rol las la ltos pas lhod kyis glod la zhog /ces pa 'di sems la 'dzin dgos gsungs/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bum nang gi mar me ltar sba gang thub mdzad pa'i bka' gdams gong malirjes 'gro mthong sgro thos dran reg 'dren pa'i thugs rje'i mnga' bdag nyid du yid ches par yod cing / phug ron la gnang ba'i gsung mgur las/ ra ba khor yug 'ja' tshon ji ba'in/ /la la tsam min rtag par 'di bajin/ /sha tsha'i sems bstun blo phugs gtad na/ /sa lam bgrod pa'i yid smon 'cha'o/ /zhes gsungs pas kyang shes so/ /

460 rgadan ngabs dalda /gdan rabs nyer gcig pa rje dkaun mchog bstan— thopa'i sgron mee/ ri gdan raXs nyer gcig pa skyabs mgon mchog gi thugs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon me dpal bzang po ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu rta'i lo hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes dge bar yab lcags po byams dang yum bo cog gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ sku 'khrungs pa'i snga lo mes po rgad po zhig yod pa des mtshan mkhan zhig la lag ris bstan pas khyod la gser gyi bka' 'gyur zhig bri ba'i bsod nams 'dug zer ba byung / de ni thub bstan yongs su rdzo/gas pa'i mnga' bdag 'di nyid rang khyim du 'khrungs pa'i mtshan ma lus kyi dpyad du shar ba la the tshom med do/ / sku bltams ma thag nas zhabs skyil krung gis sku drang bor bzhugs pa dang / nyin der a ma zhes lan gsum 'bod pa gnang bas yul mi thams cad kyis byis pa rar mtshan pa zhig min par 'dug ces gleng ba byung /lhums su zhugs pa dang / sku bltams pa'i snga phyir yab yum dang yul mi rnams la ngo mtshar ba'i rmi lam dang mngon sum gyi ltas ya mtshan pa bar ma chad du byung ba'i rkyen gyis khu bo rab 'byams pa dge legs seṅge bkra shis 'khyil du phyin nas skyabs mgon rin po cher rgyu mtshan zhus par sngags —bhacas kyi srung mdud dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i bum chu gnang / gtsang

ged ba daso / 461sbra sogs gang legs dgos pa'i zhal ta nan can bstsal/ ming mgon po tshe brtan du btags pa yin gsungs/ yul du 'byor ba na mes rgad po des srung mdud bcang nas 'di khyod la 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po ches gnang ba red byas pa la ang zhes lan btab pas kun ngo mtshar du gyur/ sku na phra ba'i dus sku rtsed mdzad pa na'ang chos 'chad pa dang /klog pa dang / phyag dbang 'jog pa/ khor gsum dang thal skad gnang ba dang / bka' bsgo byed tshul ston pa dang / shis pa brjod pa sogs ya rabs kyi spyod tshul ma bcos lhug pa'i tshul du ston pa zhig yod par yul mi dag mgrin gcig tu gleng / dgung lo lnga ba'i thog skyabs ma rgon mchog mdzod dge dgon bkra shis chos gling du phebs skabs mjal du khyer bas khri'i steng du 'jus shing na bza' la 'tham pas skyabs mgon mchog kyang thugs dgyes te ljags bsngags kyi ka ra thum bcas bstsal te/ gang gi mgur gyi bum bzang nas bstsal ba'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i ro yis rnam dpyod ro 'dzin tshim pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar dang po phye/ sku phreng snga phyi gnyis kyi mdzad pa'i bab dang / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi bka' lung gang nas the tshom med kyang spyi lugs ltar ngos 'dzin 'bul mkhan 'byor ba la yab mes rnams nas khong tshang la sprul sku de 'a dra rgyus med zer mjal du ma btang bas slar ldog dgos byung / de nyin nas khams ma bde bas khong rnams rtab rtab por gyur te bkra shis 'khyil du 'ongs nas sku mdun rgyu mtshan zhus te ngos 'dzin pa rnams gdan drangs pas ngos 'dzin kyang ma

462 gdanardorjo—1dzee—/ 'khrul bar ma zad sku khams kyang dwangs shingatreya mtshan pa'i ltas kyang sang du byung / dgung lo bdun pa byi ba lolizla ba dang po'i tshes la bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ chibs bsu ser sbrengs sogs bkur gzos cher bstabs/ dam pa'i mdzad spyod ma bcos shugs 'byung du yod cing sngon ga nas rjes dran sogs lung rtogs kyi yon tan la 'gyur ba med par dpog nus kyi gsung thol byung du ma phebs pas grwa slob rnams dga' bde dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel/ de'i bcu gsum gyi nyin skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi drung nas dge bsnyen rab byung dge tshul rnams dkyus gcig tu bsgrubs te mtshan dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me zhes gsol te 'byung 'gyur dang mthun pa'i don ldan gyi mtshan du shes so/ / rigs smralidabang byug dam pa blo bzang rin klog gi slob dpon du bsten nas yi ge bslabs pas ngo shog phyed gnyis tsam nas sbyar klog pher ba byung zhing / zla ba gcig gi khongs su 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma thugs 'dzin byang bar byung ste zhal 'don chag med mdzad/ skyabs mgon mchog nas gcod pa blo 'dzin cis kyang byed dgos gsungs pa ltar thugs 'dzin dang / 'don cha chos spyod kyi skor rnams thugs su chud par mdzad/ mdor na dgung lo bdun pa'i skabs 'di nas dbus su ma phebs kyi bar la 'dzin skyor dang thos bsam gnang tshul bshes gnyen bsten tshul dbang rjes gnang sogs zhu gnang bsnyen sgrub sogs byed tshul tha na thag nye ring gi 'byon bzhud sogs kyi bya ba che phra thams cad yab rje

lha ———mo dzo / sna (mi snyemachog gi bka'i rjes su 'brang ba ma gtogs rang dgar mi 'jug pa rje'i rnam thar gyi dper 'os mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa chu sbrulapyihor dzra gnyis pa'i tshis gsum la chos grwar zhugs/ de skabs lo de'i 'brug gi thog ma grags pa ni kun gyi ngomatshar gyi yul du byed/ chos grwar gsar du phebs pa'i dgong mo chos grwarirdo khridzeesteng nas zhal mar 'khod nas bzhugs pa la grwa rgan rnams nas sku gong ma yang sgo mang chos grwar phebs skabs 'di ltar gnang ba dang cha mtshungs pas rten 'brel legs zhes gleng / btsan po'i bsdus grwa/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi bsdus grwa/ yig cha'i blo rtags dang don bdun cu/ sde bdun rgyan sogs thugs 'dzin gnang zhing / thugs rig rno zhing zab pas gzur gnas rnam dpyod can rnams chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dad pa lhag par 'phel/ /dbus su phebs rgyu'i ched stod phyogs mdzod dge dang sog yul du 'bul sdud mdzad par snga phyir dngul srang chig khri lhag dang rta nor lnga stong brgal ba sogs 'bul nod rlabs che ba byung / cher rlom la la'isku tshe gcig gi rnam thar bsdoms na 'di tsam yang dka' bar snang / bar skabs rnams su skyabs mgon mchog gi drung nas lam rim gyi khrid/ legs bshad snying po'i bshad lung / gsang bde 'jigs gsum dus 'khor kun rig sogs kyi dbang / chos skyong du ma'i rjes gnang sogs chos bka' mang po gsan zhing phal cher sger zhus kyi sbyin bdag kyang mdzad/ dpa' gcig gi dbang zhus skabs rmi ltas bka' 'dri gnang bar khrag thod pa gang 'thung ba rmis zhus par bzang gsungs

4skye4 gid rna da nas dgyes tshor dpag med mdzad de lam gyi snying bo bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub kyi sar gshegs pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi ltas su gsang sngags mkhyen pa rnams gleng / dgung lo bcu drug pa la 'dzin grwa gzhung gsar du phebs thal phreng gi yig cha skyor sbyangs mdzad/ thugs rig sngar las zab cing rtsod pa 'gran zla med pa kun gyis mngon du gyur pas bstod bsngags kyi rol mo dbyangs su 'khrol ba byung / dgung lo bcu bdun pa la dbus gtsang du chibs bskyod mdzad rgyur sngon chos rje don grub rin chen gyis rje rin po che la bslab bya mdzad pa dang cha mtshungs par skyabs mgon mchog nas snga phyir dbus gtsang du phebs rgyu'i gra sgrig phebs pa'i dus tshod dbus gtsang du bzhugs tshad thugs gnyer gnang lugs phyir phebs lugs sogs kyi bya ba mtha' dag zhib par bkod 'doms gnang / skabs 'dir yang phebs rdzongs gya nom pa dang bcas 'phral phugs kyi zhal bkod mang du mdzad pa'i mthar/ da mdor na dbus su sku yon gsan sbyangs dpyis phyin pa zhig mdzad nas slar mdo smad du byon nas dgon sde 'dir phan thogs gang drag gnang dgos/ nga yang lo mthon po 'di 'drar song 'dug pa'i tshegs len re byed dgos gsungs nas dbu lo dkar po ston par mdzad pa sogs 'byung 'gyur mngon sum du gzigs pa'i lung bstan dang thugs gtad pa'i gsung mang du gnang / phebs pa'i nyin yang dgon pa'i phyi logs su grwa mang gis thal skad dang dar yug sogs rten 'brel gang legs bsgrigs par skyabs mgon mchog nas thar ba rtse'ite'ur phebs nas gzigs rtog gnang ste

gi ngab dalda 466char zim bu babs pa sogs rten 'brel legs zhes mnyes ma nyes mdzad cing rgyang ring po'i bar du spyan skyel gnang / tshogs chen khri las thog pa sde khri rin po che 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtshos gtso mdzad grwa tshang phan tshun gyi dpon slob khri gdan zur/ sprul sku khag sogs kyis chibs skyel zhus/ rim gyis phebs te zla ba brgyad pa'i mjug tsam 'a/ dbus su 'byor/ dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi choṭa/ grwar 'dzin grwa gzhung gsar nas zhugs shing / chos srid yongs la 'gran zla dang bral ba'i hor dpon slob skal bzang dngos grub pa dge rgan du bsten/ rgyal dbang rin po cher rta brgya/ dngul srang sum brgya lnga bcu sogs dngos 'bul gya nom pa dang / 'bras spungs tshogs chen la dngul zho 'gyed/ sgo mang grwa tshang la zho gsum re'i 'gyed/ se ra dga' ldan gnyis la de mtshungs ras 'gyed/ bkra this lhun por 'gyed dang / paṇa chen rin po cher bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang dang / tshe dpag gi dbang sogs gsan zhing / rta nyi shu/ dngul srang nyis brgya sogs kyi mchod sprin bstar/ lha sa smon lam chen mor dngul zho 'gyed dang / gsung chos ra ba drug stong skor la ras 'gyed sogs btang zhing / dbus su bzhugs ring lo re bzhin 'bras spungs tshogs chen la sku 'gyed re ma chag par btang / phyag mdzod rab 'byams pa dge 'dun grags pa gshegs pa'i dge rtsar yang grwa tshang spyi sger la mang 'gyed gya nom pa dang / phyis su lha rams pa'i gtong sgo la lha sa smon lam la yang mang 'gyed grwa sa dang grwa tshang la 'gyed mang ja gya nom pa dang / phar phyin ston mor yang de

466 lha me —mtshungs dang / lo re bzhin lha sar mchod 'bul chag med dang / sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs gnang ba sogs bsdoms na dngul srang chig khri lhag tsam song snang bas 'brel tshad don ldan du bsgrubs pa'i rnam thar du shes par gyis/ de ltar phyag rdzas gang yod dkon mchog gi phyogs su btang ste gzhi 'dod chung chog shes la gnas nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung thams cad rang rgyud 'dul ba'i nyams len du 'khyer ba'i bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bzang po skyong bzhin pa'i ngang nas dgung lo nyer lnga'i bar du yul dbus su bzhugs nas thos bsam mdzad pa yin la/ phar phyin du bzhugs ring yig cha'i skabs dang po/ skabs gnyis pa/ bzhi ba/ gser 'phreng gi dge 'dun nyi shu/ dpon slob chos grags pa'i rten 'brel/ legs bshad snying bo'i sems tsamo skor/ yig cha'i drang nges rnam 'byed chen mo/ bsam gzugs zin bris rnams bugs 'dzin dang rgya bod kyi yig cha du mar thugs dpyad zhib par mdzad/ khyad par 'dzin grwa skabs dang por slebs pa nas bzung ste dpyod blo dang don gnyer sngar bas kyang lhag pa zhig byung zhes zhal nas gsung ste/ kun mkhyen gong ma brtsi bzhag sbyor la ma la sleb skabs 'jam dbyangs kyi gzigs snang byung ba'i rnam thar rjes 'jug la gsal bar byas pa'o/ /dbu ma gsar bar phebs nas kyang lung rigs gter mdzod kyi stod cha phal cher thugs 'dzin gnang / de skabs lha rams pa'i mtshan btags gtad pa'i stabs kyis dka' rams 'dzin grwar phebs te mdzod 'dul gyi rtsod pa mnyam du gnang zhing / de nas bzung ste me rta'i lo

——3 nd+ra3rjo—wadarda —/———— 467—dam ba ca' ma thon bar du 'grel ba don gsal/ rgyud bla ma/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ dmigs brtags/ nyi shu pa/ sum cu pa/mdzod rtsa/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba/ grub mtha' rtsa ba/ kun gzhi rtsa ba/tshig gsal thal zlog /mdzod 'dul gyi yig cha bsdus pa cha tshang re/dgongs pa rab gsal gyi sa bcad dang 'jug pa sprags ma rnams rgyun par skyor sbyangs mdzad/ chos grwa chag med du 'grim pas lo gsum gyi ring la brel ba zhig gi dbang gis gung tshigs chos grwa gcig min pa chag ma myong /chos mtshams la dgung re bzhin shog bu brgya dang sum cu yan chod re nges can du byas nas skyor sbyangs byas zhes zhal nas gsungs te/ mang thos don gnyer gyi blo gsal rnams nas sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar lag len du thebs pa re thugs rjes gzigs par zhu/dgung lo nyer gcig pa la gangs can gyi pad dkar 'chang ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i drung du sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga dus chen gsum 'dzoms nyin bsnyen par rdzogs/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs bsten nas ltung ba bsngo bgrang yo byad byin rlabs/ tha na rung chu 'debs pa sogs kyi gnang bkag phra mo tsun chad bla ma nyid kyi bka' bzhin phyag len mdzad de tshul 'di ni rgyal ba dgyes pa'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba'o/ / rje de nyid la 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i bshad lung gi gsol ba btab par dgyes pa chen pos zhal gyis bzhes te rme rur lo ltar bka' chos gnang ba'i mtshams der gnang rtsis mdzad pa la/ gzhung gi rgyal tshab co ne no

468 gdan bas daldas/ mon han nas/ dkyus kyi paka' chos ma gtogs mdo rtsaglobashad lung lta bu'i snang ba gang shar gyis me ru'i grwa khang bshig mi chog de 'dra yin na khyed rang tshos gdan 'dren zhus gsungs par khong grwa rkyang lta bur song — gshis bya thabs dang bral te yongs 'dzin hor dpon slob pa la bskul ma byas pas khong nas 'bras spungs bla ma tshogs 'dur gros mgo bton nas yongs 'dzin rin po che 'bras spungs su gdan drangs/ gdan yochen po gsum gyi mkhas 'dus lnga stong tsam la mdo rtsa'i bshad lung rgyas par bstsal/ /grwa tshang so sos gsol ba btab pa ltar sgo mang du mngon rtogs rgyan gyi bshad lung / blo gsal gling chos grwar 'dul ba rgya mtsholibashad lung bstsal te ji ltar bcom ldan 'das drang srodza lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba la zhugs pa lta bu'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan srid rtse'i bar du bsgrongs par gyur to/ / de ka'ichos mjug tu bla ma'i zhal nas/ da lan nged dpon slob 'di tsam zhig gis chos 'chad nyan 'di lta bu zhig byed rgyu byung ba khyed la brten pa yin pas khyed rang bsod nams tshe zhes thugs dgyes pa'i bka' phebs dang sbrags/ bstan pa'i bdag po thub dbang gi sku brnyan byin can dang / nyid kyi rgyun bsnams 'khar sil bcas gnang nas rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob tu dbang bskur bar mdzad/ snga sor no mon han nas bka' chos la grwa mi 'grig pa'i gsung phebs skabs thugs 'tsher nas yongs 'dzin rin po che la zhus pas/ khyed sems 'tsher mi dgos/ da res nged rang tsho'i 'di ci las kyang phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'ong

gdan rabs da / 469 —gsungs pa ltar don thog tu smin pas thugs dga' bdes khyab par gyur/de ltar gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gzhi byas/ de'isteng du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rje rin po che la gdams pa ltar bla ma yi dam dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs/ tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong / gzhung chen mo'i dpyad pa sum sgril la 'bad pas 'phags bod kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i smra ba'i khyu mchog gi go 'phang brnyes te/ yul dbus kyi grwa sa rgya mtsho lta bu gsum du mkhas mang rgyu skar gyi dbus na zla ba bzhin du mngon par 'phags par gyur/ lha ldan smon lam gyi grwa skor mdzad skabs sus kyang 'khor gsum ma song ba tsam du ma zad bgro gleng gang btang la tshad ma'i lam nas drangs pa'i lan thogs pa med cing / lung 'dren la byams chos rigs tshogs sa sde rje yab sras kyi gzhung phal cher thugs thog nas thon pas mkhas pa 'bum sde'i sems kyi rma bya lung rigs dbyar rnga'idabyangs kyis dad gsum mngal gyi thig le cir yang lci bar gyur to/ /de skabs dpyod ldan kun gyis sngon byon pa'i mkhas pa gong ma rnams dngazu'adra bar mdo sngags rig gnas yongs la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum thogs pa mi mnga' zhing mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu 'di 'dra snyigs ma'i dus 'dir byon pa ngo mtshar zhing skal ba bzang zhes sgrob tsam ma yin par yon tan la ched du bsngags pa'i rol mo dpyod ldan yongs kyi kha la lhan skyes su 'grogs pa lta bur gyur pa don la gnas pa kho na yin te/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs kyi yon

470 gdan rab dpas/ tan gang la yang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i sras mchog nyi zla lta bu rnams kyi rjes su 'gro ba la sus kyang bsnyon du med do/ /zhal nas kyang grwa skor skabs grwa tshang dam bcar mdzod kyi khas len gcig shor/ lha sa'i dam bcar khas len 'di shog zer rgyu zhig ma byung bas brdab shog gi grags skam che nges byung / 'on kyang thams cad shes snyam pa'i khengs pa med par ma zad rmongs pa mang du song ba lta bus go sa 'di min na tshe gang bor gsung rab la thos pa'i bag chags ci thebs shig byed rgyu byung na snyam pa'i 'dun pa rnal ma skyes te/ sgro btags skyes rabs rwa bcu'i gdengs ka can/ /mtho mtho'i rdza ri nyul ba'i sha bo las/ /skyes sbyangs rig pa'i rwa rtse rnon po can/ /gzhung lugs thang la rgyu ba'i rgo skya bde/ /zhes sogs nyams 'char gyi tshigs bcad 'di dag bris pa yin zhes gsungs te/ mkhas pa 'bum sde'i gtsug rgyan du gyur kyang khengs pa mi mnga' zhing chos kyis mi ngoms pa'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba'o/ /lha sa'i dam bca' thon pa'i rjes su skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gtsang nas lha sar phebs te bka' chos mang po gnang ba chag med du gsan par/ mi tra brgya rtsa/ rdo rje 'phreng ba/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ ba ri brgya rtsa/ mgon po bka' bcu gsum/ zhal rnam 'gyur bcu bdun gyi rjes gnang sogs mtha' yas pa gsan/ 'di skabs rgyal tshab no mon han nas chos nyan mkhan rnams la 'brum dogs la brten pa'i sgyur sbyangs nar mar byung ba'i gshis kyis chos nyan pa mang tsam zhig ba ri brgya rtsa'i phyed tsam nas ldog dgos byung zhing snar thang brgya rtsa'i re ba ma grub par brten rje 'di la gsol ba btab pa

lhadanes——dalda lngednghasdi 271—gyeltar/ 'dulabadaponaslob/ shagaskoraskepoṅge slobasogs don gnyer can sum brgya skor la bya bral spyi khang nas chos kyi re ba yongs su skong bar mdzad/ gzhan yang blo gsal gling mkhan zur/ byams chen mkhan poci sogs don gnyer ba rnams kyi ngor snga phyir lam gtso'i khrid/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ rten 'brel bstod pa'i bshad lung / lha dang chos skyong mang po'i rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos mang du bstsal/ de skabs yongs 'dzin rin po che de nyid 'dzam gling yongs kyi gtsug rgyan gyi bla ma gcig pu yin stabs grags can gyi slob ma nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu yod kyang de dag gi nang nas rje 'di nyid la lhag par dgyes gzigs bla na med pa dang / gsung 'phros nang bcar ma bu'i gtam gyi tshul du yodal khyad par nyin gcig da nga rang tshor thob thob mang dgos pa'i nges pa med/ rje bla ma nas brgyud pa'i man ngag bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' drin la ngas gang thob pa de khyed la cha tshang ba zhig byed/ sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sogs kyang nged kyis sbyar chog pas deng sang gi sku skye tsho ltar mtho 'grogs dang bya byed mang po ma rtsom par yul dbus 'di gar bzhugs zhes gsungs pa la/ bdag la gsung 'di lta bu gnang ba bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskyangs pa yin kyang / bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che de nyid bdag gi sdom pa gsum sogs chos kyi bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnos pa'i bla ma yin zhing / khong nas snga sor mdo smad du 'ong dgos pa'i bka' phebs yod pasad res kyang ci zhig gsung yong zhus par gtam de snyan/ khyed kyi zhal nas bla ma'i gsung gcog mi nus

472 gedan sa 2rngo pa'i tshig de 'dra 'ong ba'i re ba'ang yod/ da khong la ngas bstun chog gsungs nas khong rnam gnyis nas 'di skor gyi gsung bgros gnang ba ltar nyin gcig yongs 'dzin rin po che nas/ da khyed bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar mdo smad du mi phebs pa'i thabs mi 'dug pas de bzhin gyis zhes gsungs shing thugs brtse bas bslab bya rmad du byung ba skyes kyi tshul du gnang / de mtshungs klong rdol grub dbang rin po che nas kyang / rje dge 'dun grub dang / 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pa gnyis kyi rnam thar gsungs nas/ da khyed kyi 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i las ka gang la yang spu su ma shor ba'i sgo nas thugs khur gang drag mdzod ces gsungs te 'gran gyi do zla med pa'i bla ma gsum ga'i bka' bgros mthun par byung ba ltar skyabs mgon rin go che dang lhan du mdo smad du chibs bsgyur gnang / lam bar du skyabs mgon mchog gi drung nas rnam sras bka' bco lnga'i rjes gnang dang / sa skyaligaser chos skor/ lam rim chung ngu'i bshad lung sogs gsan te 'di yang yab sras gnyis kalirnam thar khyad du 'phags pa'o/ / bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gsum la yab sras lhan du bkra shis 'khyil du zhabs pad bkod/ dgon pa'i 'du khang steng du dngul srang brgyad brgya skor las grub pa'i gser gyi rgyal mtshan cha gcig gsar 'jog dang /tshogs par zhwa snam re sku 'gyed gnang / dgun smad der ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin du bcad rgya gnang zhing ri khrod pa rnams la sgom zhwa dang maṇḍal gyi 'gyed bstsal te/ nang re bzhin sems bskyed cho ga chag med kyi

gdan bas dardo 473srol btsugs/ de nas bzung ste khyi lo'i bar du dben gnas de nyid dang bkra shis 'khyil gnyis su res mos kyi tshul du bzhugs shing / grong chog sogs g.yeng ba btsan chod kyis thun mong ba byang chub lam gyi rim pa dang /thun mong ma yin pa rim gnyis zab mo'i nyams bzhes la gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad pas nyams dang rtogs pa'i klong rdol zhing lha dang bla ma nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu'i sku'i snang ba mngon sum du shar bar mngon/lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi bshad lung dang 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo'i bshad lung / byams chos sde lnga'ilung / mdo sde rgyan gyi bshad pa dang /mngon rtogs rgyan sdud pa dang sbyar te bshad lung / dpag bsam 'khri shing gi lung / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang ba ri brgya rtsa/ sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang sogs chos bka' yang mang du gnang / skyabs mgon mchog gi drung du rigs tshogs drug bka' gdams gzhung druga'adul ba me tog phreng brgyud/ 'od ldan/ bzhi brgya ba/ jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa sogs kyi lung / bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos du ma zhus par yon gzabs te phul/ sku gsung thugs rten kyang gsar bzhengs mang du mdzad/ khyi lo'i dgun skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ltar da tshang lhun 'grub gling du tsha kho ngag dbang grags pa'i gdan sar phebs/ rang rang gang 'dod kyi chos dang / dgon pa spyir mang 'gyed gya nom pa'i thog rta nor phyed dang nyis brgya skor sogs spyi 'jog byas te chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad nas slar bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ sngar bzhin thugs dam gtsor 'don bshad smub zung 'brel

4ṭwāṃ4 gid /rke5 / ri gyi mur bzhugs pa las/ skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ltar rnga ba'i phyogs su phebs/ der dgon gsar 'debs la sa brtag bslang bkra shis kyi gso sbyong sogs rgyas par mdzad cing zung 'phan tā zhin mgo log gi dmag don du der 'ong yod pas tshe dpag dang sgrol ma'i rjes gnang zhus te bkur gzos tshad med pa dang dgon pa'i don la mthun 'gyur gang drag zhus/ de nas tsha kho da tshang du phebs nas bzhugs yod thog skyabs mgon mchog dag zhing du phebs pa'i gtam gsan phral thugs skyo shas mnan na mi bzod pa 'khrungs te glo bur mtshan mo de ka rang la khal rta'i rjes ma zin yang zhabs thang du phebs/ de nas rta shad kyis nyin mtshan gnyis kar phebs pas zhag drug gis gdan sar slebs pa byung / sku gdung gi mdun du brgya mchod/ dngul srang brgya/ rta bzang nyi shu/lan 'du bcu sogs phul zhing0sku zhabs thu'u bkwan rin po cher yang phyag rten chibs spus legs sogs dang bcas mjal 'dzoms mdzad/ tshogs su yang gdung mchod kyi ched mang ja dang ja srang bzhi reli'agyed phul/skyabs mgon mchog gi drung du dge slong gi dngos po don du gnyer ba'i thar 'dod brgya phrag lhag tsam bsnyen rdzogs gnang ste yid kyi re ba skong bar mdzad/ gzhan yang shar phyogs rgyal khab chen po nas skyabs mgon mchog gi zhal dkyil mjal zhing gsung gi bdud rtsi myang bar lhags pa'i don gnyer can du ma la dbang lung rjes gnang sogs kyis chos kyi skal ba mi dman par mdzad/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che 'jigs med rigs pa'i seṅge nas khri'i dgongs pa zhus te khong gis mtshams sbyar ba —
