gdan jabs daros/ 475ltar bla brang dpon tshang dang grwa mang bcas nas thugs 'dun rtse gcig gis gsol ba nan tan btab par brten/ chu byi zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga thub pa'i dbang bo'i mdo sngags chos 'khor gyi dus khyad par can la chos sde chen po gang gi mi 'jigs seng gelikhri la zhabs kyi padmo mngon par bkod de 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i mgon du gyur/ snga sor skabs shig nas tshogs chen dbu mdzad le lo can zhig rgyun ring nas sa khyi gong 'og zhig nas khro bcu'i bzlas pa sogs je nyung dang / tshogs 'don gyi rigs je myur du song / dbu mdzad gcong nad can dang / dge bskos bgres pa mtshan mo 'gro larma mi mthong ba zung du 'brel nas chos grwa yun je thung dang zhal 'don je myur/ char zim bu tsam la 'du khang du tshogs pa'i gu yangs btsal srol dod/ de'i shan grwa tshang gzhan la zhugs zhing / zhal ngo 'ga' zhig nad kyi dbang gis gling zhib mo skor ma thub par brten skyor sbyangs cung zad 'grib/ las sne 'ga' zhig gis khur du blangs rung phyar ba gru bzhi 'degs pa'i grogs ma 'dzoms pa dang / las sne phal cher gyis snyigs malingang tshul kha yan la btang ba'i shugs kyis bla rabs rim byon gyis 'grig lam la phan 'gyur gyi me tog gshis ngan skye bo'i byed spyod kyi ba mos bcom ste chos sde chen po gang gi bshad sgrub rnam dkar gyi skor cung zad nyams par rtsom pa gzigs nas/ gang bsam lag tu mi 'gel ba'i gdengs dang 'dun ma mtha' ru 'don pa'i snying stobs kyi shugs brtan pos gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs zhi drag sna tshogs mdzad pas chos mabun gyi 'grig lam je zhib dang je brtan du song ste tshogs chos grwa'i yun

476 gdan ra sa darngos/tshad zhal 'don gyi dal brel/ chos mtshams kyi skyor sbyangs sogs gang ci snga sor sgrig lam zhib pa'i dus dbyar dgun gyi nyi tshod kyis 'jal gyin yod pa ltar sor chud pa byung / gzhi nas 'grig lam gnang tshul gyi bab khri chen blo bzang snyan grags pa nas bla rabs gsum gyi grwa zur ma nyams par mig mthong lag zin de ka la chag 'jog gnang zhing / de skabs kyi gang ci'i byed sgo thugs la babs pa'i bsngags brjod kyang thos so/ /phebs bzhud cher mtshan mo la 'thud blangs nas nyin par brtsi bzhag re re tsam yang mi 'chag par mdzad pas bsdus grwa blo rtags dbu phar bcas kyi brtsi bzhag lo re bzhin rdzogs par song zhing / dbu ma la stod cha rdzogs nas smad cha yang thal blog dang bden gnyis sogs kyi bar lo re bzhin 'thud dgos pa byung / bsdus grwa ba rnams la bsdus grwa'i 'phror grub mtha' rin chen phreng ba lo re bzhin song / srod chos la 'dzin grwa gong ma rnams la rtsod yig ltar 'gro gang che dang / bsdus grwa ba rnams la lo phal cher la grub mtha' rtsa ba dang / shing yos lo/ rig pa bdar sha mi gcod par rtags gsal nyog ring 'phen pa'i mig ltos dgag ched bsdus tshan mang po nas rigs bsdus kyi brtsi bzhas/ thugs thog nas gnang ba bsdus grwa ba rnams kyis zin bris su btab ste spyan 'bebs zhus par mjug tu tshigs bcad 'ga' zhig gnang / der yongs grags kyi yin thag chod mang po dgos pa'i dbang gis min sgrub sha stag mdzad 'dug pa'i rigs lam shin tu ngo mtshar ba dang tshigs bcad kyi nang du rnam pa gzhi med lta bu rdzas spyi ma sogs 'phangs nas bdar sha gcod pa 'di btags

ginan bas dngos 477don btsal na mi rnyed pa'i dbu ma'i lam gyi 'bab stegs yin par gsungs pa la skye bo blo yi nor can dag ldog tu med pa'i dad pa'i shugs kyis bsngags brjod kyi rol mo 'khrol/ de ltar 'chad nyan dmar bar mdzad pas rtsod grwa shin tu 'phel zhing / khyad par 'dul mdzod kyi slob gnyer shin tu dmar ba 'di 'dra snga sor chos sde 'di tshugs nas da ltari bar du byung ma myong zhes dge bshes rgan pa rnams mgrin gcig tu gleng /de skabs zhal nas 'dul mdzod kyi bshad nyan 'phel ba 'di legs mod kyang dbu phar ma nyams pa gal che/ phyis su sgo mang grwa tshang na 'dul mdzod gtso bo byed gi 'dug kyang sgo mang ba dbu phar gyi grwa tshang yin par grags che bas dgon pa 'di yang dbu phar gtso bo byed dgos/ lnga brgya phrag bcu'i lung gi le'u'i go rim sogs la dpyad pa mang po yod pa 'dra zhes gsungs pa thos so/ /chos grwa'i gsung chos la lo dang po gsum gyi ring la lam rim chung ngu'i gzab bshad lung rigs kyi (kyis)brgyan te rdzogs par gnang / de nas shing yos nas 'grel ba don gsal dang sdud pa gnyis gsal bar sbyar zhing / mdo rgyas 'bring sogs dang sbyar tshul don thob kyis go ba byas te/ 'phags seng gi snang ba gnyis/ rnam bshad gser phreng sogs khog bsdur te yig cha du ma'i 'phros dang bcas te 'byams bshad rmad du byung ba gnang bas thar 'dod rnams kyis sher phyin gyi tshig don blta ba'i blo mig rnam par phye zhing zin bris kyang mi 'dra ba lnga —drug tsam snang / shing sbrul gyi lo 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i bshad lung gnang ste lung sde bzhi 'grel ba dang bcas pa dang / rgya bod kyi 'dul gzhung spyi

478 gedadzha rathos da'o /ṭīka mtha' dpyod mtha' dag gung bsgrigs te dgag bzhag gi spros pa rnam par bskyangs pas thar 'dod mtha' dag 'dul ba 'bum sde'i gzhung lugs la rnam par dpyod pa'i sgo phye/ gzhan yang chos grwar bka' gdams gzhung drug rigs tshogs drug byams chos lnga/ po ti lnga'i rtsa ba/ 'dul ba me tog phreng brgyud/ 'od ldan/ sum brgya ba/chos chung brgya rtsa sogs kyi ljags lung gnang ste gzhung lugs chen po de dag gi 'chad nyan nam yang mi nyams gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo phye zhing thugs smon kyang nan cher mdzad/ cho 'phrul smon lam gyi gsung chos la rje'i bka' srol ltar skyes rabs so bzhi ba dang / kun mkhyen gong ma'i bkas byams chos re dang bcas gzhung chen gsum re 'chad dgos par skyes rabs/ mdo sde rgyan/ spyod 'jug gsum bshad gzhir byas te/ tshoms byang sa bslab btus gsum dang sbyar te gzab bshad rgyas par bstsal bas bka' gdams gzhung drug gi bshad srol 'byed mkhan rgyal sras po to ba de nyid dngos su byon kyang 'di las lhag pa gsung tshul med pas 'di lta bulitheg pa mchog gi bshes gnyen dang mjal rgyu byung ba ni bdag cag skal ba mchog tu bzang ngo zhes rnam dbyod dang ldan pa dag gis mgrin gcig tu gleng / skabs 'dir gsung chos kyi dbang gis 'di ltar gnang rung / spyir tshoms rtsa ba dang skyes rabs 'grel ba'am mtshan gzhi'am 'phros kyi tshul du sbyar tshul/ sa rgyan bslab spyod sogs la yang le'u sbyar tshul/ mdo rgyas kha bskangs nas sbyar tshul/ don tshan gcig la yang mi gsal ba gsal byed du sbyar tshul/

gdan rabs dngo / 479ming 'dogs tshun chad kyi zhib cha dang 'phros sbyar tshul sogs mtha' yas pa zhig bstsal rung skabs ma yin la zhib tu 'god par yang gar nus/ gling bsre'i bshad pa la po ti lnga 'chad dgos pa'i 'grig ltar lo dang por dka' gnad la dogs gcod kyi 'byams bshad dang / spyi khog la don 'bru'i sa bcad/ lo gnyis par rtsom pa bo rnams kyi rnam thar gyis zur brgyan/ lo gsum par lam rim gyi sa bcad khog gcig tu byas par po ti lnga'i sa bcad blangs te gsung bshad 'byams klas pa ra bstsal/ yang lo gcig la ston pa'i rnam thar thams cad bstan 'bar ma'i steng nas bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len du bsdus shing / de ston pa'i sde snod gsum gyi dgongs pa 'grel byed bka' pota lngar byas pa'i bshad pa ya mtshan pa sogs gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba'i rnam thar mngon sum gyi yul du gyur/ rigs grwa sogs sngar srol ma nyams pa gzhir bzhag la ngos gang gtsang gnang zhing / rgyun ja rkyen theg pa gal che bar dgongs te rgyun ja'i thebs su dngul srang brgya sbyor 'jags gnang ste 'debs tshad srang la gzhal ba'i srol tshugs/ chos rgyal gyi gos thang khyad 'phags/gnas chung gi gser sku che ba/ kwa bar dgu khebs pa'i bzang gos kyi bla re/ gos chen bzang bsgrigs kyi kwa 'phan gser mgo ma brgyad/ dngul srang lnga brgya skor las grub pa'i ma ṇḍal che legs ngos la/ dkon mchog thugs rje bden mthus byams mgon gyi/ /bstan pa'i sgor zhugs thos bsam bsgom pa yi/ /sgron mes srid zhi'i rgud mun sel phyir du/ phul bas 'dun pa gegs med 'grub gyur cig /ces pa'i smon tshig 'bur dod

480 gdan rabs da /du yod pa sogs sbyor 'jags gnang / 'brug lo gdan sa chen po dgon lung spyi nas gsol ba nan che bar btab pas khrir bzhugs te gdan sa gnyis po zung 'brel du skyong bar mdzad/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa dag zhing du phebs nas dgon pa'i chos srid kyi khur bsnams te/ mdzad srol bzang po ma nyams par bskyangs pas 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba spyi dang khyad par bshad sgrub chos kyi bang mdzod cung zad kyang nyams pa med par rdo rje 'chang gi gsang mdzod 'phags pa lag na rdo rje la gtad pa'i rjes su 'gro ba mdzad/ skyabs mgon mchog sprul nyi ma gzhon nu'i'adzum zhal myur ston gyi ched du khro bcu bye chen/ yadku rā dza dung phyur/mgon chos kyi bskang ba 'bum ther/ tha re bzhin sgrol ma 'bum ther gser khang chen mo sogs su maṇḍal bzhi ba/ gzims chung du 'bum stod jo boridrung nas bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi sgrub mchod/ bka' 'gyur dag tshar/ mgon po'i zhi rgyas dang bar chad sel ba'i gtor sgrub/lcags mkhar chen mo/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg sogs chag med du bsgrubs shing ma 'ongs mngon sum du gzigs pa'i 'bras rtags 'khrul med kyi mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan kyang zhib par brir mi lang la gzhan du yang shes par 'gyur ro/ /sa rta'i lo mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che nam mkha'i nor bu mthong ba don ldan nyid mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la bkod de bstan pa'i bdag —por mnga' gsol zhing tshul 'di ni mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas/ mdor na yab rje —dam pa'i bka'/ /rgyal ba'i ring lugs yongs rdzogs pa/ /

gdan bas dasos 481nyams pa med pa'i bka' drin mdzad/ /phan mdzad khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bsngags pa dang cha mtshungs pa'i rnam par thamo pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing bka' drin gzhal dka' bar shes par gyis shig skabs de dag tu 'khor lo gsum gyi sgo 'phar brgya phrag 'byed pa'i zhar la snga phyi bsdoms par sgrub thabs brgya rgya ma gnyis/ mgon po bka' bcu gsum/rnam sras bka' bco lnga/ sgrol ma nyer gcig sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum/ snar thang brgya rtsa sogs kyi rjes gnang / 'jigs byed dpa' cig bde mchog lca nag dril gsum/ thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med lha dgu/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug nam mkha' sgo 'byed sogs kyi dbang / gzhan yang lho brag snyan brgyud kyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa/ dpag bsam 'khri shing / bka' gdams glegs bam/ mi la'i rnam mgur/ rigs tshogs drug byams chos sde lnga sogs kyi lung / gzhan yang gdul bya rang rang la gang mkho ba'i 'dod chos kyis so so'i re ba 'phral du skong ba dang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi dngos po don du gnyer ba thag nye ring nas bar ma chad lta bu 'ong ba la 'phral du re ba smin par mdzad pa sogs ni bstan 'gro'i don la skyo ngal mi mnga' ba'i rnam par thar ba'o /bka' rtsom gyi rim pa yang legs bshad snying po'i mchan/ rten 'brel gyi mtha' dpyod/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi mtha' dpyod/ dmigs brtag gi 'grel ba rgyas bsdus gnyis/ bden bzhi'i rnam bshad/ lta khrid kyi zin bris/ phyag chen gyi zin bris/ skyabs mgon thams cad

482 godanarabasadasdo ༈ ————mkhyen pa'i rnam thar rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs/ rig byed ma'i bstod 'grel/ kun gzhi'i mtha' darpād rgyas pa/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub dkyil cha tshang / bka' rtsom thor bu'i skor sogs mang du mdzad cing spel bzhin pa'o/ /de ltar chos srid gnyis kyi sgo nas skyabs mgon dam pa de nyid kyi 'phrin las kyi srol ma nyams par bskyangs te/ pha nor gnyen la bcol ba 'bogs pa ba'in du mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che seng ge'i khri la mnga' gsol ba na re zhig gdan sa'i khur bzhag ste lo la shas kyi ring la mdo smad kyi bshad grwa thams cad kyi phyi mo lta bur gyur pa dgon lung byams pa gling du rigs pa dang grol bar smra ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi sgo nas skyong bar mdzad/ de nas zur bzhugs mdzad de da lta 'khor lo gsum gyi sgo nas sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes te/ zhabs pad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du brtan par bzhugs bzhin pa lags so/ / 3rje 'di nyid la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par thar ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang / thun mong ba spyi sdom tsam zhig bkod pa yin gyi rgyas par gzhan du shes par 'gyur ro/ / lar bdag sis las smon bzang po'i dbang gis sangs rgyas dngos kyi bla ma du ma'i zhabs pad bsten cing de dag gi gsang ba gsum gyi rnam par thar pa la log lta ma skyes tsam du yod cing / mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi/ /rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ so so'i mdzad pa'i bab las rjes su dpag pa

gdanaragasdo sa/ ——dnghatram̐d dang / gsung gi zur las thos pa dang / mig gis mngon gsum du mthong ba la yang thun mong ma yin pa'i gtam gre bar bskyil mi bzod pa mang du mchis kyang gzhan gyi blor shong dka' bas ma bris la/ snang tshod tsam gyi rnam par thar pa nyung ngu re brjod pa 'di dag rmongs zhen dang phyogs lhung gis min gyi gang gis mthong zhing thos pa de dag gis dam pa'i rnam thar lag len du thebs te mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang du nam yang 'gro bar ma gyur cig gu snyam nas bris pa — lags so//gdan rabs nyer garnyas pa rje blo bzang chos dar/ gdan rabs nyer gnyis pa dam chos sgo mang 'dzin pa blo bzang chos dar ba ni/ mdo smad rma chu'i g.yas 'gram ka ring zhes pa'i salichar 'khrungs/ dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar thugs gnyer dang lha sa smon lam rab 'byams pa'i grwa skor kyang mdzad/ 'bras spungs 'dul ba dpon slob dang dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi chos khri rim par lo nyer gcig mdzad cing rigs grwa gsum btang / lugs zung la mkhyen spyan nam mkha' ltar yangs pas gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba'i sku tshab tu gser gyi rgyal khab chen por lan gnyis su byon te/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i gser zhal lan mang mjal/

484 gdan ba daso /khyad par bkra shis sgo mang gi khri mdzad skabs sdig can gor dzi pas dbus gtsang du dus zing bslangs pas nyen che skabs yin kyang / bkra shis sgo mang gi chos srid ma nyams par bskyangs pa dang / rgyal ba'i dbang po 'ga' dag tu mi phebs pa sogs kyi don rtsalikhur len mdzad pas dga' ldan pho brang bas kyang bkur gzos shin tu che/ de nas sngar skyabs mgon mchog nas bkra shis 'khyil du phebs dgos kyi bka' dang / dpon mo rig 'dzin dbang mo dbus su phebs skabs zhu ba'i mtshams sbyar ba'i rkyen gyis bkra shis 'khyil du byon/ mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin po che nam mkha'i nor bu mthong ba don ldan 'di nyid kyi bka'i dang po phebs pa ltar sa rta la 'dus pa rgya mtshodzeemagon du gyur/ 'dir yang sngon gyi lung bstan gyi gegs che ba'i dus yin kyang dpon slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe cung zad kyang med par thugs mthun khrims gtsang bshad sgrub dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar gong 'phel gyi ngos nas zhabs pad lhun chags par bzhugs pa 'di lags so// smras pa/ gang zhig ngo mtshar zhing gi bkod pa ni/ /nye bar rtsom tshe gser mdog chu skyes kyis/ /rnam 'dren nyi ma stong gi skal bzang bo/ /mtshon pas lha yi bskal pa bzang por bsgrags/ /de las stobs sprucu mnga' ba gsum gyi bstan pa'i dus / /yongs su rdzogs te gzhan las lhag pa'i thugs bskyed kyis/ /bu ram shing ba'i bstan pa'i nyi 'od rtse dga' ni/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro ba'i dpal du deng 'dir

dan ba dalda 4skye5shar/ /gna' dus sa chen 'di yang rnam mang gtsug lag khang gis mdzes/ /der ni 'dul 'dzin bye bas sde snod bshad sgrub rtsed 'jos rol/ /de dag zhabs skyes rdul yang sa skyong dag gis gtsug tu len/ /de 'dra'i dge legs dpal nyams da ni snyigs ma'i rang mtshang ngom/ /la la chen po'i 'gying bag lhur len blun po mchod pa'i 'os su 'dzin/ /kha cig grub rdzu'i tho co mkhan bsten rang yang 'chol bor spyod la gus/ /phal cher tshul 'chos kha gsag can la 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas dam par 'dzin/ /rmad byung dam pa'i rnam thar skyong rnams mi khyur tshud pa srid mtha' tsam/ /kha cig brtag kyang dge ba'i bshes kyi skyon yon 'khrul/ /la la ma brtag khyi yi zas bzhin gang byung bsten/ /phal cher bshes 'dor mchil snabs tsam du'ang mi rtsi ste/ /slob ma bzang po bla mar gus ldan shin tu dkon/ /mkhas pa phal cher tshig tsam la g.yel sgrub pa 'dor/ /sgrub par rlom 'ga' bying rgod dang 'grogs bzlas pas 'da'/ /bshad sgrub zung gis thub bstan dge legs byed po ru/ /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa'ang nyin skar tsam/ /de lta na yang mkhas pa'i mdun sar ngal ba mang bsten mdo sngags gzhung kun zhib par sbyangs/ /yang yang dpyad pas bstan pa'i gnad la the tshom kun chod lung rigs las 'ongs nges pa rnyed/ /slob ma dang bcas 'khor gsum bya bas thub bstan legs spel sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar skyong / /de 'dra'i bshes kyis til gang ltar gtams sde 'di bkra shis 'khyil gling zhes grags don dang ldan/ /'di yi ngo mtshar bdag yid la/ /—sdin ring 'grogs pas bsngags pa'i

4skye6 —gisdotsho———— sa —ka sod/ gtam/ / rang bzhin brjod pa'i dbyangs nyid kyis/ /sgrog la brel bas ngal ma gyur/ /e ma ma 'ongs dus su nga nyid 'jig rten rjes ‘gzung la dgongs tha mal slob dpon gzugs su gnas/ /gang gi don ldan dag la nga nyid de yi lus gnas sgrub tre gzhan las mchod pa len no 'es/ /thub pa'i mchog delisnying rjerishugs kyis bgrang yas 'khor la tshangs dbyangs kyis rbesnyad bka' lung tshad ma 'di/ /bsams kyin bsams kyin bdag cag skal ba bzang zhes thar ba 'dod rnams dga' ba'i zlos gar bsgyur pa'i rigs/ /dus kyis bskal yang sngon byon dam pa'i mtshan snyan rna bar lhung ba'i mod/ /de dang de yi rang bzhin e ma ji lta bu zhes sems pa yi/ /yid la gdung ba'i rnam 'gyur ri mor bris bzhin nye bar 'dzin pa gang / /de dag gdung sel brgyud pa'i gtam 'di sngon rabs gsal ba'i springs yig mchog /kwa ye mkhas blun legs spyad nyes spyad gzugs/ /gsal bar mtshon pa'i chos kyi me long du/ / rang spyod blang dor brtag la brtson pa ni/ /bde gshegs bye ba'i ljags yangs padmo'i bcud/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //

— sna /rdoXngargyud smad grwa tshang gi gdan rabs/ gdan rabs dang po rje 'jam dbyangs rdzo bzhad pa'i rdo rje rang haṃd/ da ni rgyud pa grwa tshang gi gdan rabs dang po ni khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gzugs su shar ba'i kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje rang nyid yin te gdan sa rim byon rnams kyis rdo rje 'chang gi thugs bcud gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa phyogs brgyar spel ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar 'byed par mdzad pa snyoyin no// gdan rabs garnyas ba rje hor blo gsal rgya mtsho/gdan rabs gnyis pa nges pa don gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen wo po hor blo gsal rgya mtsho ba ni/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi nye 'dabs gnam la'i nang tshan hor gyi rus su 'khrungs/ phul dbus sgo mang grwa tshang du bka' pota chen po lnga la zhib tu sbyangs pas rje gong rma'i grwa slob mdo smad du phebs pa rnams kyi nang na dbus su bzhugastsoskabs 'di ba mkhas pa'i snyan grags

488 da da gi gad sa che shos yin —par grags/ mdo smad du byon nas sprel lo bkra shis 'khyil du tshogs chen dge bskos mdzad/ de skabs rgyud grwa gsar tshugs kyi bla ma dbu mdzad pa chos thog gcig byas shing / de'i chos thog rjes ma la kun mkhyen mchog nas 'grel ba'i glegs bam/ sho ka li nang mchod kyi ka pā la bcas sher seng ltar gnang nas bsko bzhag gis rgyud pa'i khrir phebs ce lo lngar 'chad nyan gnang / lcags byi'i lo khri zur bzhugs mdzad de zom chen ri khrod du sku 'das par thos la ma cig gi sras shig gi skye ba yin tshul rje gong masdzagasung rgyun kyang thos so/ /'di bar rje gong mas zhal rtsed kyi tshul du bya'i nang na khā ta dang / mi'i nang na gnam la ba 'di dag gis sa rgya chen po mi chod pas/ khyod skye ba phyi mar yang rang yul la 'gro shas che gsungs pa ltar/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags phag la slar rigartswargyud de nyid du sku 'khrungs par 'jam mgon khri rin po ches bka' phebs te sprul sku'igo sa gnang / bkra shis 'khyil du po ti lnga la sbyangs shing / gser kha ba ngag dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho'i drung du srad rgyud rdo rje 'chang nasarim par brgyud pa'i snyan brgyud mang du gsan/bla ma gnas brtan pa tshogs chen gyi khri mdzad skabs rgyud pa dpon slob bsko bzhag gi skor la lab gzhi byung ba'i rkyen gyis bla 'tshab lo gsum byas te 'chad nyan mdzad/ skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ltar brag dkar dgon dang / gcu 'khor sgar gsang sngags chos sdings gnyis kyi khrir rim par 'khod/ de nas gnya' gong brag dkar gyi nye 'dabs nyi ma shang sdo ri khrod cig ba—tab ste derda thugs dam nyams bzhes dpag dka' ba

da da tha gigad diju —4tshad mdzad/ mtshan mo tsog pu'i rnal 'byor la gzhol ba'i khong nas sdi ཿṣṭha ཿkhri phrag re 'chag med dang / mgon 'jigs kyi gdams pa thugs nyams su bzhes par gda'/ skabs shig gnyan khrod brgya rtsa 'grim par phebs pas chu mig nga gcig pa'i steng nas sku bsnyang ste mthar 'don rgyu ma byung bar/ phyi lo yang bskyar kha skong la phebs pa nas chu mig kha skong la nye ba'i skabs glo bur du ngu brgyad pa sa bya la sku gshegs so/ /sprul pa'i sku blo bzang 'jam dbyangs pa 'di dam pa'i spyod pa lhun gyis grub pa zhig yin pas lo rgyus zur tsam bkod pa yin no //gdan rabs gsum pa rje blo bzang mkhas mchog gdan rabs gsum pa mang thos blo bzang mkhas mchog pa ni/dbal shul gyi rigs las rje gong ma dang gdung rus nye ba zhig tu rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa rta la 'khrungs/ sgo mang/ grwa tshang du thugs gnyer mdzad pas dge bshes grags pa don ldan gyi go 'phang brnyes/ rje gong ma'i zhabs phyir mdo smad du phebs/ thugs dad shin tu che bas chos srid gang nas kyang khri rgan sde rgan sogs las mi dman pa'i zhal rdzo yang mdzad skad/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'cha5 gdan sar phebs ma thag gi skabs nad rdzu btab nas usge khri ba 'tsho dka' ba'i tshul gyi gsung brtag zhu bar bkra shis 'khyil du tho rangs 'byor ba'i tshod du mngags nas gzisdasru —swāl gar bzhugs brtags pas kun mkhyen gong swā'i gzisda mal —

4bye0 kaiwad wa—kai—ga tsho— kai—— na bzhugs pa nges 'drongs gsan posajishugos yid che tshoglespru dang ka — khodzwa gi ma tshe 'phos skabs skyes chen dome pa snyan grags canaca'ega'e zhig gdan — 'dren rgyu'igros zhus par/ ri dpono tshang3genyer rba rab 'byams pa blo bzang don grub la smon lame zhigo'adebartsochugakor daci/ meshes mkhan yin paso gzhan cidang mi 'dra/ tsho de nase lo kha chu kha gengo du 'a/ khyer kyang khyed tshos shese zhes gsungs par de rtadusasgoskusgo mdune rdu 'khode pa zhig gi ngage nas thosazulasangagrags skam tsam gyisagami gligu ba zhig 4zholasnang / 'dzin shin tu bzang bas rje gong ma dang dpon ju nalda genyis kyi esmir sgyen gar du phebs skabs hung theliji'i mdun nas khong tsho'i yul phyogs su 'dzin shin tu bzang ba'imogragagidzi can zhiko dang/ rgyal btsugesapas gcig rgos kyis shog gu kha shas blangs te dben pa gcig tu song / rje 'dis shog gu kha shas phar slog tshur sloge byed mezhin du dbon polirmedun nas gtaskem sno tshogasabyed kyin bzhugasangapas skabaso shig gcig shos 'ongs tshonas 'don grabs byas par dpon pos rje 'di la khyed kyis ma bzungatshu.ang gsunges — par/ zin tshar zhes shar rber thon4pa —dang / gcig shos la tho re ba zhig las ma 'ongase pagrethams cad ngo mtshar du—gyur/ khri rgano tshapa no yon ha sha ga gshegs sar byon skabs rje gong mas dge bskos la bka' ( babs ti sang zhogs nged rang chos grware 'ongame nas brtsi bzhag cig gtopa rgyu yin pas de dus grwa tshange mnyam 'tshogs kyis gsung si/dhe de nes grwa mang gis 'di bar khyed nagoskyor dgos zhus pa ltar phyi nyin rje kkodis spose ring gcig sbir nas chos grwar phebs/ rje gong mas chos grwa nas dasbu zhwa

ge wa da wa da da——3 rda—da lha —rda3 ba 491 phyagatu bzhes te skyor dpon su yin gsungs—par rje 'dis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du spos bathung nas nga yin zhus pas nges po gyis ang gsungs nas/ rten 'brel yongs rdzogs kyi brtsi bzhag chos thun gcig laganang ba lhag chad med par bskyor bas shog gu bco lnga ma longs tsam zhig da lta'i bar du 'khod pa 'di yin zhes de dus miskyor dpon reb tsa bka' 'gyur tso glenas gsungs zhes snyan grags rdo rje 'chang nas dngos su thos te/mkhyen rab gzhal du med ba'o// de skabs zlogong mas tshar gcig las ma gnang zhing / grwa tshang tshur phebs nas rje 'dis tshar gsum bskyor bas skyorodapon phalacher dang grwa ba mang pos zin pa ni 'khor gyi dang por 'gyur ba'i smon la.oṃdon thog tu smin pa'i rtagasasu snang / rje gong ma'i bang chen du cun gar la lan gnyis phebs pa dang / phyis su re zhig gi bar du bla brang gi las don thams cad kyi khur yang 'dzin par mdzad pa sogasa'ajig rten gyi bya ba yang rgya mi chu nga tsam mdzad/ lcags bya'i lo rgyud pa'i khrir bzhugs te 'chad nyan mdzad/ bla brang gi dpon po tsho dang zugs mthun min rkyen gyis gsang sngags smin rgyas gling gi khrirorgyun ring bzhugs te der don gnyis pa sa sbrudi khu zhi bar gshegs so// gdasdo radis ba zhe ba rje rmengago dbadi dpal— ldan / gdan rabs bzhi ba myur mdzad grudzoba'i dbang po ngag dbang dpal

492 da da tre gi gdan snyeldan pa nin dpa' risarīstod du gser khog dang sgroba'i sa'i ra rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me 'brug la a rin zhes pa'i rus su 'khrungs/gser dgon dam—chos gling du bzhugs nas thugs gnyer dang phyag len 'ga' zhig kyang sbyangs shing / yul dbus sgo mang grwa tshang du bka' pota lnga'i thugs gnyer mdzad/ rdzegong ma'i gsol dpon dang mchod daspon zung 'brel lta bur zhabs phyi nar ma byas shing / bugs rab rkin tu bzang bas mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang gnang skabs mchod dpon pa yin kyang brel ba'i gseng bar nas gsung bshad min brimakhakyang snang / rje gong mas rgyun du shes rab che ba'i bsngags pa brjogacing / nyin gcig las banirdzisbyin sreg gi mchod dpon byed skabs skyin sreg bzhi ka khri gcig gi steng nas blug chog pa byas pas khyod shes rab chen po 'dug pas ming la shes rab dpal ldanagyis zhes 'dogs pa gnang / 'ga' zhig gis khyung thornal 'byor gyi skuliskye bar gsungs kyang zer / gang ltar khyod mgon po dang 'brel che bas mgon po'i rnal 'byor thun drug ma chag pacis gsungs/ de mi smyo g.yozhus pas me rmineba'i bstod sgrubakyisan ngag ltar thon gsungs pa bzhin chag med mdzad cing / the bo chab tshan gyikha nas mdzo zhig rkun mas khyer bar/ lha mordzikhrag mtsho'i nang du gtor ma zhig brdabs pas khrag mtsho lo gsum gyi bar du skam/ denas bzung ste da lta'i bar du rkyang tsha phyogs nas dgra jag gis gnod ma myong ba sogs mgon po'i las sbyor gyi sgo nas bstan dgra du ma tshar bcad pa'i lo rgyus mang / rgyud pa'i khrir bzhugs skabs rgad— khang kwa bzhi ma shir57logs

da da gi gdan ba 493ris dang bcas pa/ phug tu mgon chos 'jigs byed kyi 'bag sku/khrid khang so gnyis kyi nang da rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi sku so gnyis/ rdo rje stolegs pa'i brtsan khang sku logs ris dang bcas pa sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rgya che zhing / 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i bka' gnang ltar dbyar phyi ma dang gsang 'jigs kyi bdag 'jug sgrub mchod tshugs pa sogs rgyud grwar phan pa cher mdzad/ 'di skabs lo gcig gi rigs grwa yang gtong ba gnang zhing / chu stag nas sa sprel gyi bar lo bdun gyi ring la rgyud kyi 'chad nyan dang / de nas zur bzhugs mdzad/ re gcig pa me 'brug hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la zhi bar gshegs so/ /gdan rabs lnga ba rje dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ gdan rabs lnga ba rigs pa'i dbang phyug dge 'dun rgyal mtshan ni/sog yul rtse gzhung du tsho 'du zhes pa'i rus su 'khrungs/ yul dbus bkra shis sgo mang dang stag tshang rwa ba stod sogs su lung rigs la sbyangs pas dge 'dun ske ser rgol ngan tshar gcod pa la 'gran zla med pa'i rtog ge mgo mkhregs kyi tshad du brtsi ba byung zhing / rje gong ma'i zhabs phyir a mdor phebs te sa sprel gyi lor rgyud pa'i khrir—bzhugs/ 'jam mgon khri rin po cheridrung du 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi gzab bshad/ ye shes rdo rje kun btus dang de'i rnam bshad/ lha mo bzhis zhus dang de'i rnam bsha da/snags rim chen moribaskyed rim gyi gzhung bshad sogs ched gnyer gyis

494 ༷ da rdo— gi dan gsan nas 'grel glebazhi sprags kyi bshad pha lo re bzhin—rdzogs par—mdzad de 'chad nyan gyi rgyal mtshan mngon bar bsgrobs/ rgyun gyi 'a—jigs byed bdag 'jug tshugs pa sogs phan sgo che bar nod kyang cher ma 'gyangathas par— lcags 9phag la sku zhi bar gshegs ma //kyidze —dku — dngha gad na rabs dru ṅge ba sde khri blo ba za nga don grub/ — sto gdan rabs drug parme ni gsarobadag mi yi gar4bakhan sde khri rin po che blo bzang don grub dpal bzang po yin te/ rī rnagathar zhung shas gong du brjod zin pa ltar/ grwa tshang 'di la rgyud pa grwa tshang zhes pa'i ming brjod (rjod)byed kyi sgra don mabun du 'jug pa ni bla jum 'di'i bka' drin yin par shes par bya'o//ske gdan rabasna— ba dun —pa rje sdo rngam dbya sdos da bal lda na / 4 gdan rabs bdun pa sngags 'chang dbang po 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan pa ni/ rje gong ma dang gdung rus nye—ba'i dbal shul rnying ba'i khrod du rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi'ilor 'khrungs/ yul dbus su pheb sa nas thos bsam la brtson par mdzad/ ki mdotsod du byon nas kun mkhyen bla ma yab sras kyi drung du mdo sngags spyi dang khyad rpār sngags kyi man ngag dang phyag len zhu gtugs sdogs gcod nan tanamadzad/ rgyud pa

spre ————————de//—byung——————lha gesmyo ge / sna skye5 dpon slob dge 'dun rgyal mtshan dang / grugle dbang sde khri rin ji po che gnyis kyi ring la bla ma dbu mdzad pa byas shing / de nas nga bdun pa sa rta'i lo rgyud pa'i khri ra phebs te lo re bzhin dbyar 'grel ba bzhi sbrags yongs rdzogs dang / bskyed rim gsung bshad dang bcas pa 'gromo zhing / dgun bskyed rdzogs chen mo gnyis kyi gzab bshad dang dka' gnad kyi dogs gcod rgyun ring sogs 'chad nyan zla med mdzad/ sde khri rin po ches rgyud khang steng du 'khor chen 'jam rdor sogs kyi chog grwa tshugs yod thog 'di skabs/ ston rim lnga'i dmar khrid kyi ska bas khrid chen brgyad btang nas khrid pa so sor skyong du bcug pa dang / gling bsreliskabs su yang bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / ngan song sbyong rgyud la bshad pa mdzad pa sogs sgo du ma nas gsang sngags kyi bstan pa spel/ grub dbang sde khri rin po che'i bka' ltar lo mjug gi drug cu ba chen mo'irdo rje slob dpon yang lan kha shas mdzad/ uṅge grwa tshang gsang sngags smin rgyas gling gi khrir rgyun mi ring tsam bzhugs/ snga phyir grwa tshang spyi sger la bsnyen bkur sang du bstabs shing / 'grel ba bzhi sbrags dang yig chalimadzod gnyis par du brkos pa dang / tha na dre'u'i sga chag du ma yan chad kyang tshogs shing du 'bul ba sogs dad rdzas cung zad kyang chud mi za bar mdzad de las 'bras la yid ches pa'i 'bras rtags sa snang / / de yang sngar rgyud pa dpon slob ngag dbang dpal ldan sku gshegs skabs 'jam mgon khri rin po che nas khong dga' ldan na bzhugs yod ces yid smon gnang ba la rje 'dis de la smon rgyu med/ zhing 'di lta bur chos spel ba'i

/skye/ /// ///lha9 ji gi tha ged / — — — —di — chid du yun ring sdosnomakhan de la kha dar gtong ba'i 'os yod zhus bar khri rin po ches 'o na khyed thams cad kyi rjes su sdod lasto dar longs gsungs pa'i lan du/ 'o di yin nga thams cad kyi rjes su sdod rgyu yin gsungs/ji ltar gsungs ba bzhin du ji gong ma'i zhabs phyir dbus nas phebs pa'i slob ma che bgres rnams kyi tha ma lta bur don gsum pa shing khyiḥbalo mya ngan las 'das so// gdan rabs brgyad ba rje ngag dbang ci bsnyan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ gdan ra bas brgyad pa mtshog gi sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nam tshangs sras dgyis pa'i rdo rje dpal bzang podzeernam bar thar pa ni sdang du brjod zin to// gdan rabs da gu ba rje blo bzang gnas ba rtan/gdan rabs dgu ba smra ba'i seṅge blo bzang gnas brtan pa'i rnam par thar pa yang gong du smos zin pa ltar la 'di bsi tshags chen khri mdzad pa nas re zhigajisprur du hor sprul sku blo bzang 'angom dbyangs pas bla 'tshab mdzad kyang khri 'don ma gnang bas gdan rabasausu mi rtsi'o gsungs//

ji8 lha gigige ge / 49lhagadan rabs bcu ba rje rab brtan rgya mtsho/gdan rabs bcu ba mtha' bral dbu ma'i rnal 'byor ba rab brtan rgya mtsho pa ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me glang gi lo dbal mang gi nang tshan hor gyi rus su 'khrungs/ dpon ju nang nas dgon par thengs gcig la grwa rgyun brgya bzhag pa'i gras su bkra shis 'khyil du chos grwar zhugs/ 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i drung du bka' pota lnga la zhib sbyangs kyis slob gnyer rdo rus thug pa gnang bas/ khri chen gyis kyang thugs khengs pa'i bsngags brjod rgyun du mdzad cing nyin gcig sku mdun du khri mthon po bshams nas 'dir sdod gsungs/ de mi phod zhus par/cis kyang sdod dang ngas khyod la rten 'brel zhig bsgrigs pa yin gsungs nas khri mthon po bstabs pa ni rgyud kyi bla ma 'ong ba'i lung bstan yin zhis khong nyid gsungs/ gzhi nas de dus kyi grwa rgan rnams dka' spyad kyis mi skyo ba/ snying rus che ba/ bla ma la dad pa/ chos la don gnyer che ba/ rnyed bkur la mi dgyes pa sha stag yin la/ khyad par bla ma 'di nyid tshogs chos spu re re tsam yang mi— 'chag cing / skyor sbyangs la shin tu 'grus pas tha na chu len pa dang / ngo 'thag sogs kyi skabs su yang skyor sbyangs chad med mdzad pas brtson 'grus kyi tshad du 'khyer ba yin zhes gleng / dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod thugs la bzung nas sku ma 'das kyi bar zhal 'don mdzad cing zab mo'i lta ba yang thugs la 'khrungs

31//ni/blo tsu smyo ——————thun 4sha / sha tsu / —— — pa yin par gda' ste/ zhal nas/ nga la gdon 'ga' zhig gis gzugs dajos kyis cho 'uphrul sna tshogs bstan kyang stong pa nyid la bsam blo re btang ba tsam gyis med 'gro bar 'dug pas/ zab mo'i lta ba la dad pa skye ba'i rgyu rkyen du song ba'i cha nas gdon bgegs de rnams nga la drin shin tu che zhes gsungs/ bla ma dbu mdzad dang khrir bzhugs yun bsdoms pa'i lo bcu gcig tsam gyi ring la 'grelnga ba bskyed rdzogs kyi bshad pa sogs 'grig dang 'chad nyan dmar ba kho nas 'da' bar mdzad/ dus rgyun thugs nang du phyogs pas sku mdun gyi bya byed phal cher mi gzigs shing mjol mi la phyag dbang mi gnang ba dang / res mngol mi lta bu glo bur du byung na gzims sad pa ltar had de 'gro ba zhig yod par rgyus yod kyis gleng / gtor chen zhig gi skabs mdun gyi ka bā la'i nang nas nang mchod khol te khyur gyis 'phyur ba tshogs pa mang mas mthong ba da lta'i bar du gleng / khri zur bzhugs mdzad de re bdun pa chu lug gi lo sku nye rnams kyis sog yul du gdan drangs pa nas sku bsnyung ste chos mthun gyi zhabs brtan mang po bsgrubs kyang bskyed ma byung / nyin gcig sog poli lugs srol la nad pa'i srog 'tshab gtong ba yin zer nas skam (skams)lug bsad pa'i sha khrag 'gyed du gtong srol ltar gsang thabs kyis skams lug 'dzin gi yod pa gsan nas/ mi gcig gi don du sems can mang po'i srog bcad pa'i dgos pa med/ lag gang snga blta dgos gsung /gsol dpon la thabs med kyis gding ba 'ding bcug ste chos gos dang snam sbyar rgyan te nyika mthon po zhig btab pa dang dus mnyam du gshegs

skud da tha nga gi gdan ba 499tshul nges 'odrongs thos so// gdan rabs bcu gcig ba rje bkra‘zhis rgya mtsho/gdan rabs bcu gcig pa byams dang snying rje'i gter mdzod bkra shis rgya mtsho ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me khyi la dbal mang gi nang tshan 'ba' re zhes pa'i rus su 'khrungs/ dus 'khrug gi skabs su bsang gzhung du 'ongs pa nas thor nag byung nas 'chi la khad kyi skabs khri gin tshang nas grwa rgyun la 'jog na skyon med ces gsungs pa bzhin khas blangs pas de nub nas bde ba byung / ma 'gyangs par bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs/ dbal mang rab 'byams pa blo bzang don grub dge rgan du bsten nas sku ma 'das kyi bar du nye gnas mdzad de sri zhus mnyes par byas/ nyin gcig khri rin po che nas brtsi bzhag gnang ba skyor dpon gyis ma zin pas bkra shis rgya mtsho khyod kyis skyor gsungs pa ltar de nas bzung ste skyor dpon mdzad cing / da lta'i brtsi bzhag gi bsdus grwa 'di nyid skyor dpon khra ras su grags pa'i zin bris yin zer ba yod kyang bdag gi bla ma khri chen bsod nams dab nga rgyal ba nas 'di ba'i yin zhes gsungs/ rgyun du gshar sbyangs mtshan skyong kho na mdzad skabs rnga ba go thob zer ba'i dge bshes shag mtshe ba zhig gis brtsi bzhag la dpyad pa gtong bzhin nam zangs thal la btang / skabs skabs su gsol ja re blud nas khyod kyis sgra dag pos sngar ltar spyor dang nged rang la

600 ga da tre gi gdan ba blo skyed chen po 'dug byas pa da lta'ang ngo mtshar du gleng / zhi dul gyi kun spyong blo bzang rgyal ba zer ba'i grwa rgan spyod lam dul ba'i tshad cig yod pa dang 'dra bar byung nas mtshan la blo bzang rgyal ba btags/dge bskos kyi skabs zhogs ja dang po'i ring la gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur gyi sngags brgya rtsa gsung dgos pa la rang nyid kyis grangs bzung nas ma rdzogs par phyag bde mi slongalab dang / chos mtshams skabs su zhogs ka gling bskor te grwa ba gling gseb tu phebs mi 'jug cing / mtshan mo zla ba rang rang gi nya skar la chag bzhag ste mtshan phyed bar du gling skor ba sogs grim zhing phur thag pa zhig yin zhes gleng / rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad kyi skabs su dgung/ja tsam yang chag med du gnang nas 'grig lam la phan gang che dang / khrir lo bdun bzhugs par lo re bzhin 'grel ba bzhi sprags kyi bshad pa rdzogs par 'gro zhing / bskyed rim gsung bshad dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs dang / ṭīkka che chung gi le'u mtshams yan chad lo gnyis re la rdzogs par mdzad/ khyad par khri rin po che ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dang / khri ba blo bzang don grub pa las 'grel ba'i bshad lung kha yar gsan pa sogs kyis rgyud pa'i gdan rabs rnams kyi khrod na 'grel ba bzhi sprags 'chad pa la 'gran zla med pa'i grags snyan da lta'i bar du mchis/ lar deng sang sgron gsal gyi sa bcad bsdus don la dmar ser gyi rtags khra chem me ba zhig byas nas sa bcad 'phrod par rtsi ba dang / 'ga' zhig de tsam yang mi shes par bsdus don la mchan bu btab nas 'grel ba bzhi sbrags byed khul mdo dbus gnyis kar snang

da da gi gdan ba 501ba de dag gis tshig spyi'i bshad sgrub ces shin tu smad pa de tsam yang rngo ma thogs mod kyang / blun po slob pa ngo tshar 'dzin pa'i skyon dang / ma bslabs pas kun mkhyen du mi 'gro ba rgyu 'bras kyi gshis lugs yin pa/slar bstan 'dzin du khas 'che ba rnams kyis lnga brgya phrag bcu'i tha ma spyan 'dren gyi pho nya de dag rgyang ring du spang ba la 'bad dgos so//skabs shig mnal lam du mi nag po zhig gis/ 'di khyod la gong ma rgyal pos gnang ba yin zer nas ba so'ithod dbyug cig ster ba rmis te 'tshub ltas yin snyam yang de phyin chad snga phyir lcags mkhar bdun 'phen dgos byung ba'i ltas yin pa 'dra zhes zhal nas gsungs/ gzhan gyis mya ngan gyi tshig zhus na gting nas mi bzod cing / drung 'khod rnams kyis kyang da res khros 'dug snyam pa zhig 'char ma myong ba lta bu'i byams sems shin tu che ba dang / tha na spyod lam khang bar phebs pa'i lam du yang sku 'dra zhig la skor ba gsog pa sogs spyod lam chos kyis don ldan du bgyid pa'i rnam thar la kun gyis dad gus che zhing / rgyud kyi khrir bzhugs ring gtong sgo'i skor sngar srol gang yod las 'phar malithog sngar med kyi mchod rdzas gang dgos gsar bsgrigs dang / dngul srang sum brgya'i yon sbyar te rgyud ṭīka chen mo dpar du bsgrubs pa sogs chos srid gang nas kyang bka' drin che shos shig tu brtsi bar snang la/ khri zur bzhugs mdzad nas thugs dam gong 'phel du bzhugs pa las bar skabs sku bsnyung lci ba zhig byung ste zhabs brtan sogs kyis phan bskyed ma byung bar brten/khri rin po che blo bzang don grub pa dang rnam pa gnyis kyis bca' lag dbye

502 da da —gigadan ba /'byed gnang ste yo byad thams cad spong thag la btang / da bla maligazims chung nas ro'ajog mi rung gsungs nas zur du khang chung zhig tu spos/ dmigs brtse ma dang blo gros mtshungs med ma bton na dga'o—ldan du skye gsungs pa yid ches nges su snang gsungs shing / re gcig pa me khyi la zhi bar gshegs so// gdan rabs bcu’garnyas pa rje dkaun mchog bde chen/ gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa ngo mtshar yon tan gyi gter gyur dkon mchog bde chen pa'i rnam thar gong du song zin la/ skabs 'dir skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid nas chos thog gcig gi ring la rgyud grwar 'chad nyan gnang nas gdan sa byin gyis rlob par mdzad kyang gdan rabasasu brtsi mi brtsi lung bstan gyi zin thodang gsung rgyun ma 'tshal bas btang snyoms su bzhag go / dku gdan rabs bcu gsum ba rje tes rab rdo rje/ de nas gzur gnas mkhas pa chen po shes rab rdo rje ni bkra shis 'khyil dang ha cang mi ring ba'i sar tsa yu'i nang tshan tshar tshalirus su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags yos la 'khrungs/ /'jam mgon khri rin po

/ ——— zla —dhe da —wa na /ke—— (mi(/'u————che dngasdekhririn pocheganyis—kyi dru nga du ba ka rno po nalnga'islob gnyer gshis phyin pa zhig byas shing rdo bcal rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btags kyang mdzad/ skyabs mgon mchog gdan sar zhabs pad bkod skabs gtsos rab 'byams pa ngag dbang 'phrin las dang rje 'di ba gnyis kyis tshogs gleng mdzad pa sogs rnam gnyis grwa thog gcig la mtshan snyan 'dra bar snang /tshogs chen zhal ngo mdzad skabs su yang grwa tshang gi zhabs tog gind du 'gro nges dang / rgyud pa dpon slob skabs su 'grel ba'i 'chad nyan sogs bla grwa tshang mas thugs nyams su bstar rgyu'i 'grig lam gyi rigs cung zad kyang mi nyams par mdzad cing / las sne che chung sus kyang bag yangs dang sla chos su 'gro ba'i rigs la skyon mtshang rjen par byung ba'i bka' bkyon dang phyag 'bebs sogs 'phral du gnang ba las thabs 'phrul mang po mi mdzad pas thugs rang bzhin drang zhing gzu bor gnas pa'i tshul la skyabs mgon mchog nas kyang bsngags brjod mang du mdzad pa thos/gtor chen sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs mang ja'i ja mar gyi srang tshad yan chad spyan lam du bstar nas gtong dgos pa dang / lo re bzhin phyag tu gang yong sku 'gyed du 'bul bar mdzad pa la 'ga' zhig gis de 'dra ma gnang phyag rdzas phran tshegs gsog dgos zhus pas/ nga la bu dang bu mo gso rgyu med/ 'di tsho sbyin bdag gis rgyud pa grwa tshang bsams nas phul ba ma gtogs/ nga rang gi lung rtogs kyi yon tan bsams nas phul ba ma red/ grwa tshang gi phyag rdzas grwa tshang la 'bul ba la nga rang tshos ser sna byed

rtsakhye4 — ge dzizhe lha ge8zhe don ci yod gsungs/ phyis su sku gshegs khar yang nga rang grwa tshang gi thugs rjes tshe 'dir chos dang zang zing gnyis nas skyid po byung ba yin/grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa dang lhan cig tu smon lam legs po btab pas grwa ba zhig gyilus blangasa'iyong / gzhan sbrul sku sogs kyi re ba ma byed par bca' lag 'di tsho grwa tshang gi thugs rjes byung ba yin pas cung zad kyang ma god par byung yang rgya mtsho dang / thim yang rgya mtsho'i dge ltar grwa tshang la thebs dgos gsungs nas gzims khang sogs kyang grwa tshang gi thebs su 'gro ba mdzad/ lar grwa tshang reliyong sgo bsdu mkhan rnams kyis gsung rus pa can 'di dag yid la dran na rang nyid mi 'phung bar 'dug cing / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis dge slong gis dngos po mang du bsrel dgos pa byung na rnam brtags byas nas 'chang bar gsungs pa yang go dgos so/ /khri zur bzhugs mdzad nas kyang lo mang por dgon pa rang nyid du dge sbyor chig dril mdzad cing / dgung lo don bzhi ba shing 'brug la zhi bar gshegs so/ / gdan rabs bcu bzhi ba rje bsod nams grags pa/gdan rabs bcu bzhi ba grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams gragasadzo pa'i dpal gyi rnam par thar pa gong du brjod zin to/ /

rna 4skothe 3 / 4la /mi4//te/ gdan rabs bco lnga ba rje blo bzang sbyiddha/ pa/gdan rabs bco lnga ba rigs pa'i dbang byug blo bzang sbyin pa ni a rig gi rus las sog yul rtse gzhung du rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa sprel la 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil rtsapo ti lnga la mkhas par sbyangs pas rigs pa smra ba'i snyan grags kyi dbyangs snyan mngon par mtho/ skyabs mgon mchog gi mtshan nyid zhabs phyi dang rdo bcal rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btags kyang mdzad/ phyis su dgung lo bdun cu rtsa grangs kyi skabs shig zhalīnas/ snga mo rigs lung zhabs phyi'idus bgro gleng zhig btang bas/dam bca' bas khyab pa klong na dngos 'gal du 'gro ba zhig la khyab pa klong byas par/ gnas brtan tshang nas de'ikhyab pa chos can/ khyod klong tshul med par thal/ khyod med pa'i phyir gyis zhes bslabs pas nga rang gis lab rgyu ma rnyed/ de nas bsam blo yang ma btang / dus phyis shig dran nas bsam blo btang bas/ 'o na gang zag gi bdag chos can/khyod 'dzin tshul med par thal/ khyod med pa'i phyir/ ri bong rwa 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen yul chos can/ khyod 'jog tshul med par thal/ khyod med paliphyir sogs rigs 'gre mang po 'dug gnod byed dngos ni thal 'gyur desdzarjes khyab rnal ma nges na thal 'gyur deli'agal khyab rnal ma nges pas khyab par thal ba yong dgos gsungs te/ shin tu rjes su yi rang ba'i gnas so/ /

8khye6 —— wazhed sko——— thodasdirjonage rī /31gas chen zhal ngo dang —cho / ma/ da hūṃ mdzad kyi gos rim par brgyud de rgyud pa'i khrir phebs shing / 'chad nyan 'phros pacho sogs bla ma gnas brtan pa'i dus ltar mdzad/ snga phyir nyid kyis mgo 'dren gnang ste rgyud pa grwa tshang nas skyabs mgon mchog la gsang bde gnyis kyi dbang dang /rim lnga gsal sgron gyi gzab bshad rgyas pa zhus shing / gsal sgron gyi dka' gnad du mar gsung 'phros gnang ba la lan thogs med du phul pas der 'tshogs thams cad rnam dpyod kyi rtsal la mgu bar gyur/ lo gcig skyabs mgon mchog gling bsrer phebs nas bgro gleng gnang ba la cung zad kyang mi 'khum par lan ngar bo 'bul ba yang mngon sum gyi yul du gyur cing / khri chen bsod nams dbang rgyal ba dang rigs pa'i dbang phyug dus 'khor dpon slob blo bzang rin chen pa dang / rje 'di pa rnam pā gsum gyis gling bsre mdzad skabs phyogs glang chos grags gnyis rtsod pa la zhugs kyang 'di las lhag pa'i rtsod tshul yod dam snyam pa'i snang ba 'char tshode nas skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ltar mdzod dge stod du mchod gnas kyi bla mar phebs nas lo kha shas bzhugs/ de skabs dgon par yang snga phyir bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa zhus shing / dngul sungari bzhi burgya skor gyi rgyu yon sbyar te rje'i rnam thar brgya dang bcu gsum pa'i rarsā bris yid 'phrog pa zhig bzhengs te chu yos lo 'di khang du 'jog pa gnang / shing 'brug lo khri chen blo bzang snyan grags pa sku bskung ba dang skyabs mgon mchog dbus su phebs par brten/ jun wang ngag dbang darorgyas nas uṅge grwa tshang gi bla 'tshab byed dgos gsungs nas der phebs

da da gi gdan bas 507shing me rta'i lo khrir bzhugs/ byi ba'i lo zur bzhugs mdzad kyang shing stag lor lha lcam rig 'dzin dbang mo dbus su phebs skabs/ sngar wang la sras med kyang khyed uṅger bzhugs skabs sras 'khrungs pa da lta yang sku tshe brtan pa dang / wang rin po che yang rgyal khab pe'i cing du lan mang po phebs skabs sogs mgul cham yang bzhes ma myong bas rten 'brel — legs lam du gyur pa'i stabs/ yang skyar uṅge grwa tshang gi khrir bzhugs dgos zhus par brten/ slar yang gsang sngags smin rgyas gling gi khrir lo gsum tsam bzhugs shing da lta dgon gnas rang du thugs dam la brtson pa mdzad bzhin pa lags so// gdan rabs bcu drug ba rje blo bzang mchog grub/gdan rabs bcu drug pa rgyal ba'i sras po blo bzang mchog grub pa ni rgyud pa dpon slob rab brtan rgya mtsho ba'i dbon por rtse gzhung du rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags byir 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas ngo mtshar yon tan gyi phung bor grub pa zhig yin te/ skabs shig ching wang nas dbus gtsang du 'khyer rgyu'i grwa rgyun bsdu mkhan gyi el chi mngags par/rje 'di yab yum gnyis kyis sa 'gol sar 'bros bcug pas/ khong nas bsam blo btang bas dbus su song na chos byed pa dang / yul du bsdad na phyugs 'tsho skyong byed dgos snyam pa byung / de gnyis las gang bzang bsam na cis kyung mthar 'chi dgos 'dug pas/ 'chi dus bskyur nas

508 da da tsha gi gdan rsā 'gro rgyuribyugasa' tsho skyong las de dus dgos pa'i chos shig byas na bzang rgyu red de/ 'di tsholiblo rtse ci yin snyam pa byung zhes zhal nas gsungs /nyin gcig phu bo dang 'grogs nas tshe'akhor du rgyugs rdzir phyin pa sa rte rtso skabs shig phu bo na re a ma chu len par song bas nged gnyis yul la 'gro zer ba la/ nyams mtshar yul zer ba gang la zer ba yin/ pha gzhan du song / ma chu ṣa na 'dug sbra phug pa'i ming la yul byas pa ma red/de las gzhan na yul zer ba zhig mi 'du ga snyam bsam blojibatang bas yul stor song ba'i snang ba zhig byung ste/ de ni lta ba'i bag chags shig gi stobs yin zhes zhal nas gsungs/ bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar po ti lnga lamakhas par sbyangs pas tshig skam smra ba'i khengs ldan gyi rtog ge ba tsam zhig ma yin par nges pa don gyi da ge bshes bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pa zhig byung ste rdo rams pa'i mtshan btags kyang mdzad/gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde gong 'og thun mong ba'i rig gnas thams cad la bhyangs shing / zhi dul gyi kun spyod/ bslab khrims kyi bsrung mtshams/sde snod gsum gyi yon tan gang nas kyang bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyi ma ched zlar 'os pa tsam yod pas rgan gzhon thams cad la kha 'e med pa'i dad gus shin tu che bar snang / bar skabs shig gsang sngags smin rgyas gling gi bla ma dbu mdzad pa yang byas/ de skabs byi tshad kyis shi batshigashin sngas la phebs pas mi gzhan gyis ma legs tshul zhus par skyon med mod/nged kyis skyabs 'gro rgyun du byed ki yod gsungs te rnam thar shin tu legs/ gshin sngas la phebs pa'i gshin po thams cad kyi ming tho bris

da da tha tsha gi gdan 0sa 509nas rang gis bsngo smon rgyun mi 'chad dang / gzhan la yang bsngo ba zhu ba sogs mdzad/ de nas skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' nan ltar rgyud pa'i khrir phebs/ sngar bka' bstan 'gyur sogs dpe gzigs ha cang nan ches pas spyan gsal bo min stabs brtsi bzhag gzhan gyis bskyar nas thugs 'dzin dang// 'grel ba'i bshad pa thugs thog nas gnang ba sogs gsung rab la nang byan chud pa'i mdzad pa gsal bar bstan/ de skabs mi zhig jag pas bsad tshul gyi gtam thos te nye du rnams kyis gdan 'dren zhus par 'pho ba zhig btab nas de ma shi ba 'dra gsungs pa ltar zhag kha shas kyi 'phro nas slebs byung bas thams cad dad pa mngon par 'phel/ khri chen blo bzang snyan thags pa'i drung du se ra ba la grags pa'i 'pho ba 'jag tshugs ma gsan nas bskyangs skabs/ zhal nas rnam shes rdo rje rtse lnga bar mos pa'i stabs rnam rtog gi khyad kyis spyi gtsug nas thon 'gro rgyu red snyam pa 'char gsungs/ dus rgyun du snga dro bde lam dang 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid res mos dang / phyi dro bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag 'jug res mos/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku zhig 'bral spang du bsnams nas bstod sprin rgya mtsho chag med mdzad pa sogs thugs dam nyams bzhes bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad cing / sa ga zla ba la dkar po phyogs brgyad chag med lta bu mdzad pa'i skabs shig mnal lam du gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun yin zer ba'i lha khang yang thog rim pa de snyed yod pa zhig tu rim gyis byon pa dang gtsang ma'i gnas lnga yin zer ba'i gnal mesdo khang snga ma las kyang bzo bkod

510 —dzad dngha—dgerdad zu phun sum tshogs pa sngo'i nang du rim gyis zhugs pa rmis/ 'grel ba don gsal mang du skyor ba'i skabs shig mnal lam du nye ba'i sras brgyad ser sbreng gi tshul du ga shed cig tu phebs pa la spyan ras gzigs 'al phyir 'khor nas yang yang gzigs pas khong gi thugs la spyan ras gzigs kyi brtse nyams 'di 'dra nye sras rnams la yang mi snang snying rje'ilha khyad par can du grags pa thin tu bden snyam byed pa dang / yang nye sras brgyad dang rigs gsum mgon pos rang nyid bteg nas bang tshad lta ba sogs yang yang rmis shing / lan gcig lcags mkhar la bzhugs dgos kyi tshags btsugs par drag las la mi dgyes pa'i stabs kyis gnang ba zhu dgos dgongs pa'i mnal lam du jo bo a ti sha dang rje rin po che gnyis bzhugs pa la rje rin po ches lcags mkhar gyi skor yin rgyu'iglegs bam zhig bsnams nas 'di dag gi tshig re relidon du bdag gisangal ba mang du byas kyang deng sang thams cad kyisaurtsis med par 'dug cespo zhu ba rmis pa dang / mgon po'ibasnyen mtshams la bzhugs skabs nyin gcig spyan 'byed 'dzum gang byas spyang dgon pa'i rgyab ri lta bu zhig gi ngos thams cad mdog nag cing spu sdug pa'i zhol tho mo mang pos gang yod pa'i snang ba shar ba sogasade ske 'dra shin tu mang / rje rang dang grwa thog gcig pa'i dge bshes bzod pa ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin du lo mtshams skabs zhal nas a bar bzod pa'i rgyud la rtogs pa ga 'dra zhig skyes yod mang gsungs par/slob ma rnams kyis stong nyid rtogs yod mod zhu sa phas/ stong nyid sngar nas rtogs zin/ de las mtho ba'i rtogs pa ga 'dra skyes yod mang snyam

——— da da wa ——— —————— —— — da / 'a gi gdan ga bsda / — ——— 511pa yin gsungs shing / dge bshes pa de sku gshegs skabs rje 'di grwa rkyang yin kyang nang du gdan drangs nanu/ byin rlabs zhus te smon lam btang nas sku gshegs pa sogs nang phan tshun gyi dag snang shin tu che bas na ga ge ra gling gi rnal 'byor pa'i lo rgyus ltar gogazhan yang lta ba'i bag chags yod tshul bkod zin ltar dang / nye du 'gas lug bshan par btsong ba la skyo shas kyis bskul ba'i gsung mgur du byang chub kyi sems la myong ba thon pa'i gsung ca/nga du 'dug pas/thabs shes khyad par can gyi bgrod pa la brten nas 'khor ba phra rags kyi rgya mtsho brgal bar chas pa'i rgyal ba'i sras po zhig tu gor ma chag la/chos grwar phebs skabs su grwa ba slob gnyer ba thams cad kyis dpe khrid zhu ba dang / 'ga' zhig nga rang gis rtags gsal mi go bar 'dug pas mchog grub tshang la khas len zhu dgos zer ba yin 'dug ste/ de 'dra ba de ni bslab pa gsum dang byams snying rje'i stobs su gsungs so//slob ma mang po la rig gnas kyi bshad pa gnang skabs shig rig gnas 'di la ha cang zhen pa'i dgos pa med ces gsungs te/ ji snyed rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gros mnga'/ /thun mong rig gnas gnam ru sra ba yi/ /rgyud du bkug nas rnam dpyod lus stobs kyis/ /gang du 'phen pa'i nyes can 'ben de gang / /zhesacibastsal pa slob ma rnams kyis gsungs pa lta ra gang shes byang chub kyi lam du 'khyer ba'i dam pa khyad par can zhig tu snang ste/ gsung de yang lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dri ba ltar bsam dgos pa zhig go / sgyu

612 da da tha lda gi gdan rabs rgyud kyi khri mdzad skabs ngas yi ge mi mthong bas da mdzo rtsan sbal bas bcad dgos mi 'dug ces yang yang gsungs shing cher ma 'gyangs — par nga brgyad pa me bya'i lo zhi bar gshegs so// — gdan rabs bcu bdun pa rje don grub rgya ma /gdan rabs bcu bdun pa tsho 'du sprul sku don grub rgya mtsho ni/ ho sho ching wang gi mda' tshan bcu gcig gi nang tshan sha bi nar du tsho 'du'i rigs su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing glang la 'khrungs/ rgyud pa dpon slob tsho 'du dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyi sku'i skye bar skyabs mgon mchog nas lung bstan/ bkra shis 'khyil du slob gnyer dang / bde mo dga' ldan chos 'khor gling du mtshan nyid kyi 'chad nyan lo mngari po'i bar du mdzad pas 'phrin las rgyas pa byung / dgon par rgyud kyi 'chad nyan lo kha shas mdzad pa'i skabs nas sku bsnyung ste dgongs pa zhus nas zur bzhugs mdzad/ yang bskyar dga'/ ldan chos 'khor gling du phebs te 'chad nyan gyi mur zhe gsum pa me lug la dgon gnas de nyid du zhi bar gshegs so// gdan rabs bco brgyad pa rje nam mkha' rgya' mtshan/gdan rabs bco brgyad pa dge bshes nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa ni/

da datha rjorjigi did narabs 513rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags phag la tsa yu'i dpon rgyud cig tu 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil du thugs gnyer mdzad pas po ti lnga la go ba gting tshugs pa'i dge bshes chen por gyur/ rdo bcal rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btags gnang nas rgyud la phebs shing / bla ma dbu mdzad dang khri ba gnyis lo bcu drug gi ring mdzad/ bla ma dbu mdzad pa dge bshes chen po ngag dbang tshul khrims pa dang khong rnam gnyis nas khur len mdzad de skyabs mgon mchog la bde mchog gi dbang dang / 'grel ba bzhi sprags kyi gzab bshad zhus pa dang / grwa tshang la bca' yig zhu ba'ang mdzad/ sbas don kun gsal gyi bshad lung snyan gsan zhus kyang bstan pa'i gegs chag bdo bas gnang rgyu ma byung / khri zur bzhugs mdzad nas cher ma 'gyangs par drug cu ba lcags khyi la zhi bar gshegs so/ /gdan rabs bcu dgu ba rje 'jigs med mkhas mchogagadan rabs bcu dgu ba mchog sprul dam pa 'jigs med mkhas mchog ni/ stod kyi sog po'i yul du dbal shul gyi rigs su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu sprel lo 'khrungs/ kung thang mchog sprul rin po che ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sog yul du byon skabs shig she re thu blo bzang mkhas mchog gi sku'i skye bar ngos 'dzin mdzad/ skyabs mgen mchos gi spyan sngar sdom pa gsum gyi skal ba nod cing chos kyi bdud rtsi yang mang du mnos/ bkra shis 'khyilka— du po ti lnga'i slob gnyer rgyun ring

dnghad 1 1tshogrwa —dzeerda kairda——zid da gnang zhing rdo bcal rab 'byams pa'i mechen btags kyang mdzad/ e waṃ chos 'khor gling du phebs te dus 'khor gyi bskyed rdzogs sogs dang /sgra mdo dbyangs can ma sogs tha snyad rig pa mang po yang sbyangs/ rgyud pa'i khri pa lo brgyad mdzad ring la 'chad nyan sngar srol ltar ma nyams par mdzad cing thugs rgyud shin tu 'jam pa sogs kyis dad 'dun che zhing /mang 'gyed 'jog pa gang la yang gdan rabs snga ma las 'phar ma sha stag gnang / de nas khri zur bzhugs mdzad pa las dkar po gshong ri khrod dang brag dkar rgyud pa grwa tshang gi 'dzin skyong rim bzhin gnang dgos pa byung ste so sor bzhugs ring gzhan gyis dpag par dka' ba'i thugs dam dge sbyor la rtsal 'don dang / gang la gang 'tsham gyi 'gro don mdzad nas deng sang bkra shis 'khyil du thugs dam gong 'phel du bzhugs so/ /gdan rabs haṃ shu ba rje dkaun mchog rgyal mtshan/gdan rabs nyi shu ba ni chos brgyad kyi khol po bdag lags te/ de yang dbal mang blo bzang don grub pa sku gshegs nas lo brgyad kyi ring la sprul sku yin zer mkhan zhig ma byung bar brten/ shing lug lo dbon po ngag dbang dpal ldan dbus su phyin nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par gsol ba btab pa'i ngor bden tshig bstsal pa dang / bla ma de'i mtshan gyis skyob dgos pa'i las smon gyi stobs kyis shing sprel lor bdag gis dal 'byorda rnyed de/ bsdi nyag 'atram̐X sdi —bhe nyadaṣas— di—ṣad gzhung du

———kai—rwa—shaṃrwadab 516tsharotsha zhes pa'i rus su skyes/ skyabs mgon mchog gi bkas sprul skur thag bcad pa ltar lo drug gi skabs zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal te rab byung bsgrubs shing 'phral du dbal mang spyis 'dod mos ltar sog yul du phyin/dge slong bsam gtan seṅge klog gi slob dpon du bsten nas yig rigs bklag thabs sogs la sbyangs shing / tshogs 'don gyi smon lam chos spyod kyi rigs rang radzogi bar rta dang bcas pa/ bskang gso'i skor dbyangs thung bar rta dang bcas pa/ rgyan 'jug sogs lo brgyad la sleb bar du byang ba byung / lo ngo bcu gcig lon pa'i lnga mchod kyi thog chos grwar zhugs shing dgun chos skabs smon lam grwa skor ba rnams la bgro gleng shar shar byed thub pa byung / lo bcu bzhi ba la rtags rigs kyi tshogs gleng / bcu drug pa la zhabs drung grags rgyan pa dang mnyam du drang nges rnam 'byed kyi tshogs gleng / bco brgyad pa la phar phyin ston mo'i grwa skor dang smon lam rab 'byams pa'i grwa skor sogs dga' rab byung / nyi shu la mdzod du slebs/ nyer gcig nas slar yang 'dzin grwa gsham du babs te dbu phar bskyar rtsis dang mdzod la lo gcig tsam rtsod pa byas te nyer bdun ba la dka' rams 'dzin grwar slebs/ chos grwa 'grim dus che tshugs 'dzin pa‘'di yon tan gyi gegs su mthong nas tshogs chos grwa chag med du 'grims/ grwa rkyang dman pa'i tshugs bzung zhing snga phyi thams cad du 'byor ba e sog gi re ba ma byas pas/ khengs dregs kyi sdong bo la chos brgyad kyi lo 'dab g.yur du za ba'i bla chen mi chen byings kyi blo la mi 'bab pa byung mod kyang / rje mi las/ sgod bu mo mchor mo spun rnams dang /

516 wa gi gdan nga gung thang gi mi la ras pa gnyis/ zhe sang phar khrel tshur khrel yin/snying yang phar rje tshur rje yin/ /zhes gsungs/ dbu phar man chad kyi thal phreng zur bkol dang grub mtha' mo 'dul mdzod kyi rtsa ba gnyis sogs gshar sbyangs byang po byas shing phal cher gyi rgyugs kyang phul/ sgra snyan sdeb sbyor rtsis dkar nag sogs la phyogs 'gro tsam sbyangs kyang zhib tu brtags na/ bya ba mi 'dra brgya phrag rtsom/ /mthar phyin bya ba gcig kyang med/ /ces pa ltar song bas yi mug skye ba'i rgyur snang / nyer dgu ba chu byi la rdo rams pa'i ming btags gtad byung bar/ smon lam gyi rten du bsams nas lo der tshogs chos grwa chag med du 'aspims/ gung thang mchog sprul rin —po ches chos grwaligasung chos la lam rim chung ngu skyes bu chung 'bring gnyis—kyi skor rdzogs par gnang ba sang chos thun gcig la chos grwa'i rjes ma zin pa ma gtogs ma chag par nyan/ rgya bod kyi yig mang por dpe klog re byas te don ma go rung bag chags ci thebs dang bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor la 'bad pa byas/ chu hphang zla ba dang po'itshes bco brgyad nas dam bca' 'jog dgos pa yin kyang tshes bco lngalinyin jun lang ngag dbang dar rgyas nas rgyud pa bla mar bsko bzhag byas pa/ rdolde 'chang thu'u bkwan rin po che'i bka' 'gyur gyi lung spel bar sku 'bum du 'gro dgosatshul zhus kyang zlog ma nus par hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyin khri 'don byas/ 'grel ba'i 'chad nyan dang / bskyed rim gyi brtsi bzhag bshad pa dang bcas pa lo re bzhin rdzogs pa dang / gsang 'dus kyi bskyed rdzogs chen mo gnyig spyang bshad pa mdor bsdus —

— da ṣa shaṃ— rdosha gi ga ka da rab / 517re dang bcas tshar phud sogs rgyud rgan rnams gsung ltar dang / thig rdul tshon sogs la yang dag ther phran tshegs re byas shing / phyag len nges pa rnams la tshag btsugs te rang gis bkod pa btang nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi blos bslang rtsig ji 'i srol btod/ gsang 'jigs gnyis kyi dbang dang / 'chad nyan gyi yig cha dang 'don cha'i skor gyi lung gang yod kyang phul/ bsnyen pa las rung dgos tshul sogs kyang nan tan byas/ bla ma dbu mdzad pas khur bzhes dang bstun su rug gi steng nas rgyu sbyar gyis dri gtsang khang rnying ba bskyod de gsar ba'engs grub/ dgon pa'i rgyan dang sa dpyad sogs kyi rten 'brel che tshul thos pa bcas bzhi thog cig bzhengs e thub kyi re bas smad phyogs kyi grwa rgyun dang sbyin bdag mang por zhal 'debs kyi mthun rkyen zhus par brten/ snga phyir dngul srang sum brgya lhag cig byung yang ming skam la re ba ma byas par byurorim bzhin las byed pa so sor sprad kyang ba'i thog 'phub rgyu ni 'grig ma song / grwa tshang gi nang rten la bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi lha yongs rdzogs re byung na snyam/ ting bskul las sngar phan su nyid dka' bcu bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis 'jigs byed kyi gtso bo zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi sku brnyan mi tshad lhag tsam dang / su nyid blo bzang sngags rams pas bde mchog gi gtso bo de mtshungs shig bzhengs nas 'dir spyan drangs pa la gzungs 'jug sogs tshad ldan du bsgrubs nas nang rten du bzhugs/ thu med phyogs kyi dgon pa'i grwa rgyun spyi la rting bskul zhus pa ltar/ khong rnams nas kyang rgyal mtshan cha gcig dang / galdi ra gcig bcas bsgrubs te phul ba yang

51skye da rdo —da rga tho da da —ge dgegrwa khang gi steng du yod pa 'di bzhin la/ sa sprul lo skyabs mgon mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che 'khrul med thag gcod kyi ched du dbus su 'gro dgos kyi tshag btsugs par brten las sne'i khur spos te dbus su phyin/mchog sprul rin po che'i thag bcad tshul sogs gzhan du shes la dbus gtsang gnyis kar gnas mjal dang dge ba'i bshes gasnyen rnams la chos kyi bgro ba yang ci rigs par byas/ dga' ldan khri rin po che tre bo blo bzang bkra shis/ paṇa chen mchog gi yongs 'dzin 'brong rtse zhal snga nas blo bzang tshul khrims dang / gu ge zhal snga nas blo bzang bstan 'dzin rnam gnyis/brag ri dge bshes khyab bdag rdo rje sogs las zla ba kha shas kyi bar du 'di phyogs su rgyun dkon pa'i dbang lung khrid sogs chos bka' mang du nyan/ phar yang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i gtsang dbus kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig la/ paṇa chen thams cad ma/khyen pa'i rnam thar gyis mtshon pa'i skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi gsung 'bum tshang ma'i lung / kun mkhyen gong ma'i gsung rgyun thor bu'i dpe gang rnyed/ rgyal sras thogs med dpal bzang gi bka' 'bum/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i gsung bka' rgya ma'i skor/ rje thu'u bkwan rin po che'i gsung 'bum sogs kyi lung / 'khrul 'khor lcags mkhar/ zhi khro sbrags sgrub sogs kyi khrid le tshan kha shas/gsang 'dus sngags btu'i rjes gnang sogs dbus gtsang du nyag phra ba'i chos rgyun ci rigs pa zhig spel zhing / gzhan yang bka' gdams gzhung drug sogs rgya gzhung mang po dang / sgra ka la pa dang / dbyangs can ma

da da—ḍi—pang garjidan bas 519rtsa 'grel/ snyan ngag dbyangs can dgyes glu rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa/sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas rtsa 'grel man ngag bka' rgya ma dang /man ngag lhan thabs kyi lung sogs kyi sgo nas 'dun ldan mang po'i re ba bskangs/ sa rta lor bkra shis 'khyil du 'byor te/ mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin po che nam mkha'i nor bu mthong ba don ldan 'di nyid kyi zhabs pad spyi bor len pa'i skal pa bzang po'i sgo nas gdan sa rang du bag phebs par gnas te/ de yang phyis su rnam g.yeng lhur blangs pas snga dus grogs khyad par can gyis bskyed pa'i bsam pa bzang po 'gyur te/ da lta rje grub pa'i dbang phyug skal ldan rgya mtshos/ reb gong stod kyi jag pa/ reb gong smad kyi skal ldan/ /phyi yi kun spyod ma gtogs/ /nang gi bsam tshul thun no/ /zhes gsu/ngas pa kho na ltar gyur mod/ 'on kyang tshe lhag 'dir lus 'du 'dzi dang sems rnam rtog las rgyang bsrings te nyin mtshan chos kyis don ldan zhig yong na ci ma rung snyam du yid smon 'cha' ba'i skabs lags so// gdan rabs nyer gcig ba rje dkaun mchog lhun grub/da lta'i khri thog pa dkon mchog lhun grub pa ni/ mdzod dge sbo tshang gi sa char sku 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung ste bstan pa'i sgor bzhugs/ bkra shis 'khyil du thugs gnyer mdzad pa'i rigs pa smra ba'i graṭa pa thob cing / rdo bcal rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btags kyang mdzad/

520 da da —kairdadan ba rgyud du yang lo kha shas phebs te sngags kyi dam bca' yang thon/ gdung ru sa gcig pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams chos 'khor gyi sa char mchod gnas star chags kyi bla mar song ba'i rgyun bskyangs te de phyogs su 'phrin las cher rgyas/grwa tshang thos bsam gling gi dge bskos dang tshogs chen zhal ngo sogs byas skabs skyabs mgon mchog gi thugs zin nges byung zhing / gtsos rgya mkhar dgon gyi khrir yang phebs/ khong rgyud kyi bla ma dbu mdzad gnang skabs phran gyis rgyud pa bla ma byed dgos byung bar 'grel ba dang brtsi bzhag lo ltar rdzogs dgos dang / bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho dang rim lnga gsal sgron yang tshar phud re 'gro dasgas kyi rting bskul dang khur len yang dag pa gnang bas 'chad nyan dmar ba byung / chos 'khor dang mdzod dge phyogs su yang yang phebs dgos gshis bla ma dbu mdzad pa tshogs chos grwar rgyun du yong dgos pa'i rgyud kyi 'grig lam la gnod gsungs nas bla brang la dgongs pa zhus par/ rgyud pa'i dge rgan bzhi sogs nas 'di ba gzhan dang mi 'dra bas tshogs chos grwa chag med ma thub kyang chog pa'i dmigs bsal dang bcas bla ma dbu mdzad la bzhugs dgos zhus par brten/ phyag mdzod dar han chos rje nas de bzhin chog gsungs nas dmigs bsal gnang ba yin pas rjes ma tshos rang gis rang la dmigs bsal mi gnang ba gal che'o// me sbrul la rgyud kyi khrir phebs shing / sngar bla ma dbu mdzad kyi skabs su grwa khang gi dri gtsang khang rnying skyon che bar dgongs nas rtse gzhung du grwa tshang gi su rug yod pa'i steng nas ja lan dos brgya dang bzhi bcu bsgrigs

— ——— ——— — da da gigadaja rabs/ 521te zur du bskos pa'i las byed pa gnyis la gtad de snga ma ar chog byas nas gsar du bzhengs pa las 'di skabs shing rtsi logs ris rab gnas dang bcas pa legs par grub/ kho bo rgyud du yod dus khong nas ji ltar gsungs pa ltar 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi sa khungs rgyugs ma sprad par ṭīkka che ba dang / nam mkha' grags kyi gsang 'dus bskyed rim rgyugs ma sprad par ṭīkka chung ngu song mi chog par byas pa'i rgyun ma nyams par bskyangs pas deng sang gi bar 'dir 'grel ba'i sa khungs kyi rgyugs sprod mi bdun cu rtsa grangs dang bskyed rim gyi rgyugs sprod mi yang de snyed cig byung bar khong nyid kyis gsungs pas phan pa che bar byung snang / chos srid gnyis ka la mkhyen pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i grags pa mngon par gsal ba'i ngang nas da lta khri thog tu zhabs pad lhun chags par bzhugs so/ / smras pa/ /deng dus chen po phal cher dam pa'i mtshan snyan ri dwags rnga ma bstan te bong sha btsong ba'i tshong dpon nyid/ /lung rigs sbyangs pa'i grags ldan 'ga' yang dbang lung rjes gnang bshad pa'i zong gis rang gi lha yang bdud du 'bebs/ /dben par gnas pa'i rgan po la la rang gi bzlas brjod dag kyang btsong ste tsan dan sol bar ci yang bsgyur/ /de dag kun kyang kha sha zho snying bal mig dpe ltar gzhan phan zol gyis zang zing lhur len de lta na'ang / /rdo rje 'chang dbang te lo nā ro dang / /mar mi jo 'brom rgyal ba gnyis pa sogs/ /pha mes lung dang rtogs pa'i khyad rnar rnams/ /'di snang skun polilag tu ma shor bar/ /dam pa'i

522zhabs bsten dad dang dam tshig gtsang / /thos bsam bsgom pa'i brgo bskal dus su mnos/ /blo dang 'tsham par gzhan phan 'chad nyan spel/ /'di dag nges par chos kyi khri la dbang / /dus kyi tha mar gyur kyang thub pa'i bstan/ /mdo sngags chos tshul kun 'dzin bshes gnyen dag /snyigs ma'iljongs 'dir thub dbang gnyis pa bzhin/ /rdzogs ldan dga' ston gsar ba'i byed po nyid/ /chos dang bshes gnyen dal 'byor tshangs spyod grogs/ /phun tshogs bzhi ldan stong log mi byed par/ /'khor 'das skyon yon bsam ste nyin dang mtshan/ /chos kyis don ldan mdzod cig grogs po dag /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// // e waṃ chos 'khor gling ske gdan rabs /gdan rabs dang po kun rmakhyen sku 'phreng garnyas ba rje dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bo/ dus 'khor grwa tshang gi gdan rabs dang po ni/ rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo mtshungs med yab rje dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po ye shes brtson 'grus grags pa'i sde'izhal snga nas nyid yin te/ ( e waṃ chos 'khor gling zhes yongs sagrags pa 'di nyid byang phyogs sham lha la'i rigs ldan

tshordodiwa'i zigan tho 523gyi pho brang dang mtshungs par byin gyis brlabs par mdzad pa yin no// gdan rabs gahaṃs ba rje blo bzang bkra zhis/gdan rabs gnyis pa gsang sngags kyi ljon pa chen po blo bzang bkra shis pa ni khams sho ba mdo zhes pa'i sa'i char rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa glang lo sku 'khrungs/ yul dbus rgyud stod grwa tshang du rgyud sde bzhi'i cho ga phyag len thams cad la zhib par sbyangs shing / khri chen nam mkha' bzang sogs mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs pad bsten te man ngag gi bdud rtsi mang du mnos pa sogs kyis lho ba sngags rams pa zhes gsang sngags la mkhas pa'i snyan pa dbyar gyi rnga gsang ldir ba bzhin du byung / dgung lo lnga bcu bar skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi bkas mdo smad bkra shis 'khyil du byon/skyabs mgon mchog nas grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi 'chad nyan gnang ba'i ring la rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / de nas lo lnga'i ring la dus 'khor grwa tshang gi gdan sa ba mdzad de/ cho ga'i ngag 'don/ dbyangs rta 'dur/ thig bca' bzo sogs dam pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes ma nyams pa rgyud sde'i dgongs pa dang mthun par gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ phyag len la shin tu mkhas pas skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas kyang bsngags brjod chen po mdzad/ thugs shin tu zhib pas tha na zhal zas la mar khu byug rgyu tsam yang rtsing chos la thugs mi dgyes pa gnang bas/ thig rdul tshon gtor ma'i bca' bzo rol mo rdung lugs sogs gang cir phra zhi bdag ther du 'gro

624 cho ma/ra wa dgadadzha ba /ba'i phan pa chen po byung / /khri zur bzhugs mdzad pa nas bzung ste bkra shis 'khyil rang du thugs dam nyams bzhes chig dril mdzad cing / dgung lo don lnga ba chu yos lo zhi bar gshegs te gdung zhugs 'bul gyi nyin skar lan gsum bzung yang thugs dam ma grol/ rjes ma'i skabs sang zhugs 'bul gyi do nub thugs dam grol rgyu'i snyan gsan phul nas ja phor gang 'thung ba'i tshod tsam na sku gdung yo zhing sbrang ma 'khor ba dang / shangs bug nas byang sems babs pa sogs thugs dam gyi 'bras rtags mngon du gyur to/ / gdan rab gsum pa rje rab brtan rgya mtsho/gdan rabs gsum pa mdo sngags smra ba'i dbang phyug rab brtan rgya mtsho ba'i rnam par thar ba ni/ thos bsam gling gi gdan rabs su bshad zin to// ṅgedan rabs bzhi ba rje blo bzang ri na chen/ gdan rabs bzhi ba rigs pa'i dbashā phyug 'gran zla med pa blo bzang rin chen ni/ khri chen don grub rgya mtsho gang du 'khrungs pa'i rigs rus gong gsal de nyid du rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa phag la 'khrungs/chung ngu'i dus nas bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs te 'dzin grwaliskyor —

cho mkhor gli gi gdan jab / 525dpon mdzad/ nyin gcig rtsed mor phyin te chos grwar lus song bas khri rin po ches bka' bkyon gyi tshul du brtsi bzhag nyis 'gyur du gnang ba chad lhag med par bskyor bas thugs dgyes te kho la rno 'bug 'dra ba zhig yong ba 'dug gsungs pas skyor dpon rno 'bug ces grags/ khri rin po che de nyid kyi drung du bsdus grwa dang blo rtags grub dbang sde khri rin po cher dbu phar/ khri chen ngag dbang bstan 'dzin la 'dul mdzod gsan nas legs par sbyangs pas rtsod pa la 'gran zla med pa'i snyan grags kyi rol mo rna ba'i bcud len du 'bar ba byung / skyabs mgon mchog gi mtshan nyid zhabs phyi ba yang mdzad cing / sku yon la thugs khengs pa'i bsngags brjod rgya cher mdzad pa thos/ rnam darpād kyi rtsal bsam gyis mi khyab pas sgra dang snyan ngag sogs la bslab sbyangs cher ma byas kyang gzigs pa tsam gyis thugs su chud pa zhig yod pas rig gnas smra ba'i snyan grags rgyas shing tha snyad mkhan po rnams nga rgyal gyi ri bo nyil bar mdzad/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi 'grel ba/ bslab bya mu thi la'i 'khri shing gi 'grel ba shes rab padmo rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ mtshan nyid pa'i bstod pa rgyas bsdus sogs tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i rtsom pa mang du spel snang / zung chu ngag dbang brgyag pa ma zhes sgo mang grwa tshang na rigs smra'i mchog tu 'dzin pa de gdan sa 'di nyid du rtsod pas pham par mdzad cing / sku 'bum dgon lung soṭa phyogs du mar phyi rgol gyi spobs pa rmeg med du bcom pa'i lo rgyus shin tu mang na yang / rang bzhin gyis lhan skyes su 'grogs pa lta bu'i yon tan du song bas bri ba'i rngo ma thogs/ spyir mdo rgyud rig gnas thams cad

526 mi tshos kho gi gdan ba la shin tu mkhas kyang thugs kyi byingasabyude mtshan nyid la shin tu dgyes shing zhal nas kyang / mtshan nyid kyi dge bshes rnams kyis rgya mtsho chen po nas chu 'bab pa ltar don re re la phyogs phyogs nas rigs pa mi 'dra ba brgya phrag gis dpyad pa mdzad pa la nyan na 'di las lhag pa'i bstan pa 'dzin lugs ci yod snyam du rang dbang med par dad pa 'phel ba zhig 'dug ces dang / mtshan nyid kyi rigs lam rang nyid kyis dngos su ma brtsad spyang / rtsod pa la rna bas nyan pa tsam gyis log rtog mang po rang shugs kyis 'gags 'gro bas rmongs pa'i mun pa sel ba dang / bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa la mtshan nyid kyi slob gnyer 'di med mi rung yin zhes gsungs te bstan pa' gnad mkhyen pa'i gsung du snang ngo //deng sang bstan 'dzin du khas 'che ba mang pos bstan pa 'dzin mi 'dzin ni go sa mtho dman dang / stobs 'byor che chung dang / grwa ba'i mang zhung sogs kyis 'jog par dgongs tshod du 'dug ste/ de dag gis ni ji skad du kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbyig gi gnyen pos/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i kho na'i sgra'i rnam bcad rang gis mi shes kyang gzhan la dris na legs so// lung rigs seṅge'i nga ro bsgrags pas rab 'byams smra ba'i mtshan —snyan nges pa don ldan du 'gro ba'i rdo bcal grwa skor kyang mdzad/ rgyud pa gru tshang la phebs te gsang sngags la sbyangs pa mdzad pas thub bstan yongs

zhe mkhog gigadan / 627 da su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen chen por gyur/ khri gung thang ba rje ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pas thugs dgyes pa che zhing / slob ma'i drag shos yin pas mchog sprul dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron meliyongs 'dzin kyang mdzad/ lo bcu'i ring dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa dang dpon slob rim bzhin la 'grig 'gal rgyun du byed mkhan gyi rtsing bo kha shas yod pa 'phral du gnas dbyung sogs gang la gang 'os kyis sgo nas tshar bcad cing / bslab sbyangs tshul bzhin du byed mkhan rnams la legs so'i gzengs bstod sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ 'grig lam la dag ther nan can mdzad pas grwa tshang 'di'i 'grig lam phyag len mtha' dag mig la mdzes pa/ rna bar snyan pa/ yid dang ba 'dren pa 'di nyid bla ma 'di'i bka' drin las byung bar bsnyon du med la/ dad rdzas phyag tu gang byung chud mi 'dza' bar phyag tshags dam po mdzad nas dge 'dun gyi zhal du 'gro nges gnang ste phu chung ba'i rjes su 'jug gang ci'i phyag rdzas kyi do dam rang nyid kyis mdzad cing / nye 'brel sogs su gang gi dbang du yang mi gtong bas dge 'dun gyi gtong sgo sogs la bar chad byed mkhan med pa ni yul shi pi pa'i rgyal po'i skyes rabs las/ rgyal po de ni nor la dbang yod phyir/ /phongs pa rnams ni 'dod pa'i don 'grub pas/ngo 'dzum mi gnag bzhin bzang mthong bas dga'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// dmu dge'i dgon du yang skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ltar rgyud kyi'achad nyan yun ring mdzad cing / de nas zur bzhugs mdzad pa nas

628 sa mkho nga gi gdan bzung ste gnas mchog bkra shis 'khyil du thugs dam zab mo'i nyams bzhes nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu mdzad pa las/ dgung lo don lnga ba chu glang gi lo zhi bar gshegs so//gdan rabs lnga ba rje blo bathang bkra zhis/gdan rabs lnga ba khya dge dpon slob blo gros rgya mtsho'i sprul sku blo bzang bkra shis ni rgyud pa dpon slob 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan pa'i sku tshar rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu khyir 'khrungs/ khya dge dpon slob kyi sprul sku yin tshul sogs kyi gsung byon kyang dpon slob de nyid nas sprul sku gdan drang mi chog gsung yod stabs gdan ma drangs/ bkra shis 'khyil du thugs gnyer mdzad cing 'dzin thin tu bzang bas gung tshigs mang ja ma 'tshogs gong du shog gu mda' tshad bco brgyad re star chags su 'dzin par grwa thog gcig pa rnams mgrin gcig tu gleng / skyabs mgon mchog gi drung du yig cha'i phar phyin skabs dang po nas brgyad pa'i bar yongs rdzogs/dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod yongs rdzogs/ yig cha'i mdzod gnas dang po nas brgyad pa'i bar yongs rdzogs bcas kyi rgyugs phul/ nyid kyi khu bo bkra shis 'khyil gyi dge bzhes lung rigs dang skad bzang 'dzoms pa bstan 'dzin mgo leb tu grags pa rgya mkhar dgon gyi khri ba bka' drin can yin stabs gtsos rgya mkhar sgar gyi khri dang / de nas usge grwa tshang gi khrir yang bzhugs zhing / dus 'khor grwa tshang 'di gar rdo rje 'dzin pa

mkhoja— gigadan bas 529dang 'chad nyan pa rgyun ring mdzad/ 'og tu 'chad 'gyur ltar rdo rje 'dzin pa don yod tshul khrims pa dang khong rnam gnyis zung 'brel gyi mdzad pas grwa tshang la phan pa'i sgo btod/ khri zur bzhugs mdzad nas che ra ma 'gyangs par zhe gsum pa shing 'brug la zhi bar gshegs so//gdan rabs drug pa sde don yod tshul khrims/gdan rabs drug pa dka' bcu smra ba don yod tshul khrims ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me lug la bkra shis 'khyil dang mi ring ba'i gnam la zhes pa'i sar 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus bkra shis 'khyil rgyud pa grwa tshang du zhugs/ de skabs smra dbang 'gran zla med pa 'be bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i zhabs phyir sog yul a ru hor chen du phebs/ bshes gnyen pa de yul der sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs sogs gar cir zhabs tog 'gyur nges mdzad/ phyag rdzas rnams chud mi 'dza' ba'i thabs mkhas mdzad de bkra shis 'khyil du yang mang 'gyed gya nom pa bsgrubs/ dbus gtsang du yang rang nyid ched gnyer gyis phebs te/ chos sde so sor bsnyen bkur dang / gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po yab sras dang / skyabs mgon mchog la yang bsngo rten spam mtho ba bstabs te grogs kyi mchog ni mi bslu ba'o zhes pa'i sgra don rang steng du bsgrubs// der yul dbus bkra shis sgo mang du cung zad bzhugs nas slob gnyer mdzad cing / slar mdo smad du byon nas bkra shis 'khyil du slob gnyer gyi 'phro skyong bar mdzad/ chos srid

bhesbyi0 'khor dzagad ngab gnyis ka la mkhyen pa rgyas pa'i snyan pa shin tu che ba ltar 'di ka'i thos bsam gling zur duphye ba'i grwa tshang dge bskos kyi thog ma dang tshogs chen zhal ngo mdzad skabs sogs snga phyir grwa tshang spyi sger la phan sleb che ba byung /dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa dang dpon slob gnyis lo bcu lhag mdzad cing /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang / sgra dang rtsis sogs rig gnas kyi slob rgyun btsugs pa sogs gang ci'i phan pa rgya cher mdzad/ de nas mdzod dge stod du mchod gnas kyi bla ma rgyun mi ring tsam mdzad de/ da lta dgon gnas rang du thugs dam gong 'phel gyi mur bzhugs so// gdan rabs bdun pa rje ngag dbang phun tshogs/gdan rabs bdun pa rab 'byams smra ba ngag dbang phun tshogs ni/dgon pa gsar tshugs kyi skabs rnga ba'i las mi kha shas kyis dgon pa'i nye 'dabs su grong gzhi bzung ba'i mi tshang zhig tu rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me stag la 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas dgon par mtshan nyid kyi slob gnyer bar ma chad pa byas pas skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gis/ sa nag nang nas tsan dan skyes gsungs nas rdo rams pa gnang / phyin chad rdo rams pa sngags grwa res mos su 'gro dgos gsungs pa ltar e waṃ chos 'khor gling du phebs/ grwa tshang thos bsam gling gi dge bskos kyang mdzad pas dpon slob yongs kyi thugs zin nges byung / dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin

da wa zhe chos 'khor gling gi gdan rnab 531pa lo kha shas mdzad de khrir phebs/ de skabarme a ru hor chen rtag brtan rpā lis mchod gnas kyi bla ma zhig dgos tshul zhus par brten/ skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ltar de phyogs su phebs te lo kha shas bzhugs nas mdzad 'phrin shin tu rgyas pa byung / slar bkra shis 'khyil du byon te skyabs mgon mchog gi 'dra sku mi tshad ma longs tsam zhig 'du khang du 'jog pa gnang zhing / grwa tshang spyi sger thams cad rnyed pa dang bkur stes yang dag par mchod de thugs dam gong 'phel du bzhugs pa las slar yang rtag brtan rpā lis nan gyis spyan drangs te da lta de phyogs su gnen phan yar ldan du bzhugs so// /riri — gdan rabs brgyad pa rje ngag dbang don grub/gdan rabs brgyad pa nges pa don gyi dge bshes chen po ngag dbang don grub pa ni/ klu shod kyi yul du ma kha zhes pa'i rus su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu byi la 'khrungs/ sku na phra ba'i dus su ma phyag skor la 'ong ba'i g.yog gi ched du bkra shis 'khyil du byon/ sde khri rin po cher mjal bas/ khyod chos grwar bsdad na legs pas cis kyang sdod dgos gsungs par mdun der lags so zhus kyang pha mas chos grwar bzhag mi yong bas rdzun du 'gro snyam nas 'gyod pa chen po byas zhes zhal nas gsungs te/bden pa smra ba la goms pa'i 'bras rtags su snang / yul mis bar chad ma byas par chos grwar zhugs nas khri chen ngag dbang bstan 'dzin pa'i
