532 sa mkho gli gi gdan sa/drung du bsdus grwa'i dzig bzhag thog mar mnos/ g.yesdo ba cung zad kyang med par slob gnyer la gcig dril mdzad pas/ rnam dpyod thogs pa med pa'i snyan grags dpyod ldan yongs kyi kha la ri mor bris pa lta bu byung zhing / rdo bcal rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btagasakyang gnang / grwa tshang thos bsam gling gi dge bskos mdzad skabs khri rin po che bsod nams dbang rgyal ba dang khong rnam gnyis dgongs pa chig dril gyis skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la zhu ba phul ba ltar thos bsam gling la bca' khrims kyi yi ge bstsal pa dang / bla ma gzhung las pa mdzad skabs su yang skyabs mgon rin po cher gling bsre dang / rigs grwa sogs kyi 'grig lam la dag ther gyi snyan bskul zhus par brten/ de dag so so'i yi ge bzhag pa sogs gang cir phan sgo cher mdzad/ lar 'di dus skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi bka' ltar dge bshes gang che du ma tshogs 'du'i gras su bzhugs pa dang / skad grwa ba dang 'dzin grwa so so'i dbyangs dpon byed pa sogs rgya gar 'phags yul na bya ba'am 'dun ma thams cad kyi rtsa ba sde snod 'dzin pa la rag las par gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin du yod pas/ bya bzhag thams cad 'dul ba dang mthun zhing las 'bras dpang du 'jog pa zhig yin kyang / dus kyi dbang gis zhum por gnas pa tsam chos su rlom pa mang du song ba ni/ bstan pa'i dbu 'phang mtho ba'i rkyen du 'gro dka'am snyam mo //rgyud du yang lo mang bor phebs shing sngags kyi dam bca' ba'i thog ma yin pa yang legs par thon/ skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' ltar

chos mkhor gi gdan 533thor god dkon mchog ja sag gi bla ma rgyun ring mdzad skabs kyang don med chos brgyad kyi 'khor lo rgyang ring du spangs te gnas dben pa rer rgyun mtshams lta bu mdzad de/ bka' bstan 'gyur gnyis tshar kha shas ljags klog mdzad pa sogs dal 'byor don ldan gyi mdzad pa bzang pos dus 'da' bar mdzad// dgon par snga phyir mang 'gyed dang / grwa tshang thos bsam gling la rgyun phogs kyi thebs su lan 'du lnga bcu sbyor 'jag mdzad/ sman pa grwa tshang gso rig gzhan phan gling gi grwa khang gsar rgyag gi ngos shing rtsi logs ris sogs mdzes shing gya nom pa bsgrubs pa sogs phyag rjes rlabs che ba bskrun/ de nas skyabs mgon mchog nas gang ci'i bab 'os yod tshul rgyu mtshan dang bcas e waṃ chos 'khor gling gi 'chad —nyan par bsko bzhag mdzad/ lo bdun gyi ring la dus kyi 'khor lo dang ngan song sbyong rgyud sogs gsang sngags gong 'og gi 'chad nyan 'gran zlas dben pa gnang / grwa khang snga ma sgres skyon che bar dgongs te phyag rdzas yod sprugs byas nas dgos chas thams cad bsgrigs/ do dam gyi khur len yang rang nyid kyis gnang nas grwa khang ka ba nyi shu ma dri gtsang khang dang bcas pa gsar du bskrun te/ de yang rdo rtsig ngos snyoms shing zur legs par dod pa/ rtsigs (rtsig)pa'i ngos la legs par sbyangs pa'i tshon gyis rigs ldan gyi rgyal po nyer lnga sogs mdo sngags brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs bye ba'i snang brnyan go mtshams med par bris pa ni phyogs bcu'i longs sprul gyi zhing khams sa la 'phos pa lta bu/ byang phyoṭa sham bha la yi grong khyer ka la (lnga)tsakra'i pho brang mchog gi mtshan nyid yongs

534 sa mkho gad su rdzogs pa dang / rigs ldan grags pa kla klo 'joms pa la zhugs pa'i bkod pa mthong ba tsam gyis rgyud rgyal gang gi bshad sgrub la spro ba ngang gis 'phel ba/ rgyal ba nyi ma stong gis mngon par byang chub pa'i gnas 'phags yul badzra ā sa na dang / shrī ju na ka ṭa ka sogs kyi bkod pa ri mor bris pas dzasbru brikṣas mdzes pa'i lho gling gi snying bo mtha' dag yongs su bsdus pa bzhin du gang gis mthong ba de dag dad pa'i sa la 'god pa//kwa gdung bre gzhu sogs kyang lha'i bzo bo bi shwa karmas sna tshogs pa'i tshon gyis ri mo ci mdzes su bris pa lta bur mig dang yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog ste kye ma 'di ni sgyu ma mkhan bzang pos glo bur du sprul pa'o snyam byed pa/ phyi nang gi ri mo thams cad legs par sbyangs pa/ legs par btul ba/ lhag par gsal ba'i gser bzang po'iri mo 'gro gang che 'ba' zhig tu bris pas shing rtsi logs ris mtha' dag 'od du 'bar zhing nyi zlali dpal gyi mdzes pa yang zil gyis gnon pa/ steng gi mthong kha (mthongs ka)thams cad kyang gos bzang po 'ba' zhig las bsgrubs pa'i bla re rnam par bkra bas dwangs pa'i nam mkha' 'ja' tshon gyis khyab pa lta bur mdzes pa sogs rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang mchog la 'gran par bzod pa/ phyi dang nang gi dbyibs dang bkod pa'i khyad par thams cad mig la mdzes pa/ yid du 'ong ba/ lta na sdug pa/ yid du 'thad pa'i gtsug lag khang rmad du byung ba 'di nyid gsar bzhengs mdzad/ de nas dkon mchog ja sag 'bangs dang bcas pas yang bskyar mchod gnas kyi bla mar phebs dgos tshul nan can byung ba'i ngo ma bzlog par rib tsam de phyogs su 'gro don

rdoṣa di/————/31 —ge11 535mdzad/ slar yang gdan sa chen po bkra shis 'khyil rang du thugs dam nyams bzhes gzhan 'gran bral ba'i sgo nas bzhugs pa 'di lags so/ /kadan rabs dgu ba rje 'jam dbyangs grags ba/gdan rabs dgu ba dka' bcu ba 'jam dbyangasagrags pa ni/sman lung gi phyogs su rab byung bcu gnyis pa la sku 'khrungs shing bkra shis 'khyil du thugs gnyer mdzad/ rdo bcal rab 'byams pa'i mtshan btags kyang gnang zhing / grwa tshang thos bsam gling gi dge bskos dang tshogs chen zhal ngo / dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyi go sa rim par brgyud de e wa chos 'khor gling gi khrir phebs/ cho gang ci'i srol legs par bskyangs nas zur bzhugs mdzad/ skyabs mgon mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che nas bka' babs pa ltar/ da lta bde mo dga' ldan chos 'khor gling gi khrir phebs te bka' pota lnga'i 'chad nyan skyor bzhin pa lags so// gdan rabs bcu ba rje dkaun mchog dar rgyas/da lta'i khri thog pa bstan 'dzin dam pa dkon mchog dar rgyas pa ni/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu khyi'i lo kha gya'i dpon rgyud du sku 'khrungs shing chung dus kha gya dgon du mtshan nyid kyi chos grwar cung zad phebs pa las/

536 sa mkhong gi godan ra sa/bar skabs su sngon gyi smon lam gyis bskul nas bkra shis 'khyil du 'bros stabs su byon/ dgung lo zhe bzhi bar du bkra shis 'khyil rang du g.yeng ba cung zad med par bka' pota lnga'i slob gnyer rdo rus thug pa mdzad pas kha gya dar rgyas zhes dge bshes rgan gzhon ci tsamaji'atshogs na yang lung rigs kyi dogs pa gcod pa'i yul dang tshad thub kyi dpang por 'dzin cing dka' spyad dang brtson 'grus kyi tshad du gleng ba byung / yon tan kho na'i dbang gis skyabs mgon mchog nas kyang / gzhan las 'bur du dod pa'i dgyes gzigs che bar mdzad de rdo rams pa'i ming ba tags kyang grwa thog gcig pa yongs las snga mgyogs su gnang ste zhe gsum pa shing 'brug gi lo rdo rams pa'i grwa skor mdzad/ lar 'di dus sku rim mar grol la zhwa brda dang lag brda thu brda sogs kyi srol med pas rje 'di dang rigs smra 'gran zla med pa dge 'dun dpal bzang / rigs pa'i dbang phyug ces brjod du rung ba 'jigs med rab rgyas sogs lta bu dbu phar gyi slob gnyer pa rnams kyis gzhi bzung / mdzod 'dul nas dge bshes bsam gtan dang / dge bshes mkhas mchog sogs lta bu dang / rdo rams pa thon zin rnams kyang 'dzoms nas dka' gnad kyi rtsod pa rigs lam brdar sha chod pa rtsal du 'don pas mtshan phyed bar du 'jug gcod kyi thal skad gtong mi thub cing / dgong mo re re'i rtsod grwa tsam gyis kyang rmongs pa'i grong khyer bcom thub pa'i tshod du yod do//skyabs mgon mchog dbus su 'byon pa'i zhabs phyir 'gro dgos gsungs nas dbus su byon/ de dus dbus gtsang gnyis ka nas skyabs

ma sa mkho gi rgudan ba 537mgon mchog gi drung du mkhas pa'i skye bo sprin 'dus pa lta bu byung ba la/ mkhas dbang blo bzang 'jigs med dang / rje 'di ba rnam gnyis kyis dam pa rnams la skyes kyi mchog tu gsungs pa'i legs bshad kyi gtam zad mi shes pa spros pas de dang des bsngags pa rgya cher brjod pa dag sgra 'dzin gyi yul du gyur/ klong rdol bla ma rin po che nas kyang / khong rnam gnyis la gzigs pa dang bkur gzos che bar mdzad cing / lhag tu 'di bar khyed dge bshes gzhan dang mi 'dra bas nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems/ yang dag pa'i lta ba gsum la nan tan mdzod ces bka' phebs/ phyis su 'di ka'i byams sku mthong ba don ldan rab gnas kyi skabs su klong rdol rin po che nas lha rdzas nang mdzod bzhi snyan shal du 'bul rgyu skyabs mgon mchog la bskur ba'i nang du snyan shal bzhi bo 'di tshad med bzhi'i mtshon byed yin pas rab gnas grub ma thag tu snyan shal gyi dang por rdo rams pa dar rgyas la 'bul du chug ces phebs shing snyan shal rang rang gi sne mor shog tshar btags te dkon mchog dar rgyas/ 'di g.yas su phul/ dkon mchog dar rgyas/ 'di g.yon du phul zhes bkod 'dug pa thugs kyi gting nas dgyes pa che ba'i gtan tshigs su snang / skyabs mgon mchog dbus su bzhugs pa'i lo gsum gyi ring la sku drung du bcar bzhugs mdzad nas po ti lnga'i dka' gnad phal cher la dri gtugs dang / khyad par dbu malidaka' gnad la dri gtugs dang dogs gcod yang yang zhus pas sngar slob gnyer byas pa bas kyang lhag pa'i go ba skyed che bar byung gsungs/ me rta lo mdo smad du phebs nas rgyud grwa lo gsu ma 'grim zhing sngags kyi dam

638 —— ——rdodago——rda gegigadan /bca' yang bzhag de skabs su bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs yi dam du ma'i bsnyen pa dang / sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs dngasge'agrel ba ṭīkka sogs la zhib tu sbyangs/ skyabs mgon mchog gi drung du nam mjal res kyis mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad la dogs gcod nar mar zhu ba mig gis mthong /sa bya lo mtshan nyid kyi yig cha brjed du phangs gsungs nas yang bskyar grwa tshang thos bsam gling du phebs shing / skyabs mgon mchog bya khyung gi khrir phebs skabs bya khyung dang sku 'bum du dam bca' bzhag de nas bzung ste dgung lo nga lnga bar du chos thog phal cher chos grwa chag med dang /chos mtshams phal cher la sku mtshams mdzad nas zhul 'don dpe gzigs rtsa shes dang lam sgron/ rgyan 'jug mdo rtsa/ 'grel ba don gsal sogs skyor sbyangs mdzad cing blo gsal du ma la dpe khrid dang dogs pa gcod pa sogs rnam dkar kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ de dus 'dul ba mdo rtsa dang rgya cher 'grel rgyun du gzigs nas so thar gyi lag len gang zhib mdzad pa mngon sum gyis grub ste mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog pa'i rnam par thar pa'o zhal nas 'dul khrims gtsang ma bsrung ba 'di dgra bcom 'thob byed kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa yin pas 'dul khrims rnam dag bsrungs na tshe 'dir dgra bcom thob pa la the tshom mi dgos zhes nan tan 'doms pa dang 'dul ba 'di las lhag pa'i bla ma bsten rgyu mi rnyed pas khyed tshos 'di la 'chang nas sdod ang zhes yang yang gsungs pa lan mang du thos/ nga lnga pa me 'brug la rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa dus 'khor gyi khrir

cho khong gli gi gdan jabs/ 539bskos skabs/ dgon pa'i dpon slob khri gdan zur gyis gtsos grwa rgan zhib 'tshogs kyi tshogs 'du rgyas pa nas kha gya dar rgyas lta bu'i dge bshes da lta dgon pa rang la med pas da res cis kyang rdo rje 'dzin par bsko dgos zer ba la/ phran nas khong la thugs 'dod med cing dge sbyor gyi bar chad du mi 'gro ba'i nges pa med tshul sogs gleng bar kun gyis mgrin gcig tu/ thugs 'dod med kyang rang re'i ngos nas 'di bar chos kyi gdan sa zhig ma gtad na de las ngo tsha ba med tshul sogs dang bcas 'os tho gcig 'thus lta bur phul bar brten/ dus 'khor rdo rje 'dzin par bsko bzhag dang / sa rta lo e waṃ chos 'khor gling gi khrir phebs/ 'di dus zhal nas/ bdag la 'di 'dra'i go sa gnang ba la dga' spro spu tsam skye rgyu mi 'dug kyang ha cang dgongs pa u tshugs kyis zhus na ngo shes khyi gu stag la zug pa'i dper 'gro bas nan cher ma byas/ yin kyang dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhung la bag chags 'jog rgyu byung ba skal ba bzang bas/snying bo ci lon cig byed dgos gsungs nas/ sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi cho ga 'phral du thugs 'dzin dang las rung gi bsnyen pa yang btang / kun rig gi yang cho ga'i gdangs phyag rgya dang bcas pa zhib tu bslabs nas las rung gi bsnyen pa gnang zhing 'grel chen dri med 'od dang ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba sogs gzhung mang po la zhib gzigs dang dpyad pa rgyun du mdzad pa gzhir bzung nas bshad sgrub kyi bya ba dbyar mtsho ltar spel/ gzhi nas dus rgyun du gsu/nga rab kyi don la dpyad pa mdzad kyin bzhugs pa ma gtogs/ rnam g.yeng dang snyoms las kyi dbang du song

540 mkho gdan ba'i bag yangs cung zad kyang mi mdzad pa ni kun la mthun grub yin te dran shes kyi ra ba las mi 'da' bar brtson 'grus dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i sgo nas rnam grol don du gnyer ba'i rnam thar bla na med pa'o/ /ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus gzhan yang zhib tu bri bar spobs na yang snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro ba la gzu bor gnas pa ches shin tu dkon pas bsnyon du med pa'i rnam par thar pa nyung shas shig bris pa'o//smras pa//ji ltar mkha' la rgyu skar grangs mang yang / /mtshan mo'i mgon dang bral tshe mdzes ma yin/ /de bzhin dge ba'i bshes kyis ma zin na/ /zhi dul slob ma'i tshogs kyang ga la mdzes/ /ji ltar legs bris tshogs kyis 'chi med dbang / /mdun du bdar bas chos bzang 'dun sa brjid/ /mang thos dus su 'doms pa'i slob dpon gtso/ /slob ma'i 'khor gyis bskor bas chos grwa brjid/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis zin pa'i slob malitshogs/ /gru chen zhugs pa'i tshong ba ji bzhin du/ /snyoms las ma byed srid mtsho'i pharol bgrod/ /nges legs nor bus 'gro kun tshim par mdzod/ /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //

541 gso rig gzhan phan gling gi gdan rabs/gdan rabs dang tho kun mkhyen 'jigs ched dbang bo/ sman pa grwa tshang gso rig gzhan phan gling du yang dang por rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sbyi/ gzugs skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen nyid nas zhabs kyi padmo mngon par bkod de/ ji ltar sman gyi grong khyer lta na sdug ces bya bar ston pa sman pa'i rgyal po byon pa dang chos mtshungs so// /gdan rabs gahaṃs pa rje blo bzang’'jigs med/gdan rabs gnyis pa ni gnas lnga rig pa'i dbang phyug blo bzang 'jigs med pa yin te/ sngon ku ma bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis hal ha os lod nas khrid 'ongs pa'i mi sde'i nang tshan the (thor)god ces par rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing glang la sku 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas sngon gyi bag chags kyi shugs kyis yig rigs du ma dang / sum rtags/klog thabs sogs la sbyangs pa cher ma dgos par rang shugs kyis mkhyen pa byung / bkra shis 'khyil du bka' pota lnga'i slob gnyer dpyis phyin ba

542 ga gagazhan nadang gdanangab mdzad pas rigs smra 'bum sde'i khrod du smra ba'i ljags yangs skyong (rkyong )ba'i mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang yab sras rnams kyi drung du sgra dang / snyan ngag rtsis dang sdeb stor sogs rig gnas du ma la sbyangs pas mkhas mang bye ba'i dbus na mgrin pa sgrog gis bcings pa med par lnga rig smra ba'i spobs pa mngon par martsi/ bkra shis 'khyil du rdo bcal rab 'byams pa'i grwa skor mdzad cing / sku 'bum byams pa gling sogs mdo smad kyi rigs smra'i 'dus sde phal che bar bka' pota lnga'i grwa skor mdzad de lung rigs sgron me'i snang ba spro bar mdzad/ rgyud pa grwa tshang du lo bcu gsum gyi ring la sbyangs pa mdzad pas rgyud sde kun gyi spyi bo dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam gyi gnad la nges shes rnyed/ gsung rtsom gyi rim pa yang gang blo ma'i 'grel ba nyi ma'i 'od zer/ dpal ldan yon tshogs ma'i 'grel ba don gsal snang ba sogs lha dang bla ma'i bstod tshogs du ma'i 'grel ba/ gsang 'dus rgyuda'a'agrel gyi bsdus don mdor bsdus sngon 'gro bshad thabs dang bcas pa rdo rje'i lam sgron/ po ti lnga'i bshad thabs sngon du 'gro ba'i bsdus don tsan dan 'khri shing / dus 'khor bsdus rgyud kyi bshad thabs sngon du 'gro ba'i bsdus don/ rig gnas lngalibashad thabs sngon du 'gro ba'i bsdus don sbrang rtsi'i 'a byung gnas/ kun gzha'i rtsa ba'i mchan 'grel gser gyi lde mig kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i gsang rnam dad pa'i 'khri shing / dri med grags pa'i rtogs brjod dza tili'akhri shing gzhan yang lha dang bla ma'i bstod tshogs sogs mkhas pa dgyes pa'i snyan ngag mang du spel snang yang / gser dang ra

gso gagazhan rdad —ṭaṃ—gdanajub / 543gan 'byedajishes pa'i/ /mkhas pa legs bshad ngo so mtho/ /rton bzhi lugs ldog byed rnams la/ /bka' 'gyur las kyang zan chang brin/ /zhes kho bo smra'o//chu byi'i lor khri rin po che 'jigs med rigs pa'i seṅge dang / bla brang phyag mdzod chos rje sogs nas 'os tho phul ba ltar mi'i dbang po jun wang ngag dbang dar rgyas nas gso rig gzhan phan gling gi khrir bsko bzhag gnang / grwa tshang 'dir sngar gang cili'agrig lam srol cher ma dod par yod pa la thugs khur che bzhes ngos/ rgyal tshab khri rin po che 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i bka' bzhin du gong bkod ltar gyi 'chad nyan phyag len 'grig lam thams cad kyi srol btod de bstan pa'i dmigs rkyen du 'gyur nges gnang / de nas zur bzhugs mdzad pa las/ da lta rong sngon po thang gi dgon pa dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling du po ti lnga'i 'chad nyan gyis mtshon pa'i bshad sgrub bstan pa'i bya ba gong 'phel gyi sgo nas grwa tshang de ka'i skyong khur 'dzin bzhin pa'i skabs lags so// gdan rabs gsum ba rje blo bzang rgyal mtshan/gdan rabs gsum pa mkhas pa'i dbang po blo bzang rgyal mtshan pa ni/ sman lung sa yi thig ler tshar tsha'i ruyosu rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing byi la 'khrungs/ bkra shis 'khyil du bka' pota chen po lnga la zhib tu

544 ga ga gzha na gi gdan sbyangs pas rigs pa smra ba'i dge bshes yang rtser son zhing lung rigs la mkhas pa'i snyan pa mngon par mtho/ zhi zhing dul ba'i kun spyod kyis 'dris pa dang ma 'dris pa'i skye bo thams cad kyi yid dbang med du 'phrog pa zhig lhan skyes kyi tshul du yod pas mkhas pa dang btsun pa gnyis ka'i cha nas kun gyis dad gus dang bsngags brjod shin tu che/ skyabs mgon mchog gi drung nas sgra dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor sogs gsan pas rig pa'i gnas la blo gros kyi pad mo mngon par phye/ skyabs mchog gang gi bka' ltar sku 'bum/ dgon lung / bya khyung / rong bo dgon/ la mo bde chen sogs mdo smad kyi chos sde du mar grwa skor mdzad de po ti lnga'i dam bca' bzhag bkra shis 'khyil du yang rdo rams pa'i mtshan btags dang /rgyud du yang lo mang tsam phebs nas sngags kyi dam bca' yang bzhag blam gzhung las pa gnang skabs tshig bkra snyan ngag gis spras pa'i rna ba'i bdud rtsi 'ba' zhig dang / bgro gleng phar zhog gzhung 'god kyi smra brjod dang thal skad tsam gyis kyang mkhas blun kun gyi yid dbang med du 'phrog cing / don gnyer can rnams la chos bka' ci rigs kyang stsol par mdzad/ lo lnga tsam gyi ring la thor god dkon mchog ja sag gi bla ma mdzad cing / de nas dgon par phebs te thugs dam nyams bzhes rmad du byung ba gnang bzhin pa las/ sa rta lo gso rig gzhan phan gling gi khrir phebs te/ chos srid kyi srol gong 'phel gyi sgo nas da lta chos kyi khri la (nabs pad lhun chags par bzhugs pa 'di bzhin lags so//

645smras pa/ mkhyen daphyod rgyas pa'i gnam ru la/ /rig gnas lnga yi mda' sbyar te/ /kun rmongs dgra bo 'joms mkhas pa'i/ /srid sgrub 'di dag e ma rmad/ /khyad par gso rig yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /thos brtson ral bar bstims nas sa gsum gyi/ /rgud pa'i dri ma dag byed mchod yon du/ /'grem mkhas sngon med mgrin sngon 'di su zhig da ni skal ldan shing rta mang zhig gis/ /tshe yi rig byed lha yi yon chab rgyun/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad 'joms bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /phyogs bcur 'gyed pa'i mchog sbyin sgo brgya phye/ /zhes pa yang bar skabs su bsam don bskul tshig tu smrasapaso// // rten sogs don gzhan bshad pa/de yang sngon ston pa mnyan yod du bzhugs skabs bskun gyi dbang gis dge 'dun gyi tshogs dbur 'byon ma thub pa'i tshe ston pa ma bzhugs pas gral gyi dbu mi brjid cingami mdzes pa'i tshul nyan thos rnams kyis/ zhus pa na/ nga'i dod du sku gzugs bzhengs nas dge 'dun gyi gral mgor zhog cig ces bka' bstsal pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i dod du bris 'bur gyi sku gzugs dang / gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cus gdul bya'i khams kyi rim pa dang 'tsham par chos ston pa'i dod du sde snod gsum

546 na thagabyu don gzhan ba da gyi glegs bam dang / byang phyogs so bdun gyis bsdus pa'i lam gyi bgrod pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i thugs spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi dod du mchod rten bzhengs par gsungs pa ltar/ shar nub rgya mtsho'i mtha lebar gyi grong dang grong khyer dang yul ljongs rnams su rgyal blon dang khyim bdag dad pa can rnams kyis bsod nams rlabs po che bsgrub pa dang /dge 'dun gyi sde che phra rnams su bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing nam yang mi nyams pa'i byin rlabs kyi rten du sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa'i srol ches cher dar ba ltar chos sde 'dir yang sku gsung thugs rten ji ltar bzhugs pa'i tshul ni/ sngon rje gong malidus su 'du khang ka ba brgyad cu ba dri gtsang khang dang bcas pa bzhengs pa las phyis su tshogs pa ha cang rgya che bas go yul dog par brten skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas dngul srang chig khri'i bdog pa'i mthun rkyen gyi steng nas legs par bsgrubs pa'i 'du khang ka ba brgya dang bzhi bcu ba kho ra khor yug steng 'og thams cad dbyibs dang kha dog bkod pa'i khyad par yid du 'ong bas rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la 'gran par nus pa 'di nyid kyi dri gtsang khang nub ma'i rten gtso gser zangs las bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan bzang po'i bzhugs stangs can nyis thog dang mnyam pa 'di ni rje gong ma de nyid zhal bzhugs skabs bal bolibazo bo ched du bos nas rags bzo phal cher legs par grub pa'i mjug 'jam mgon khri rin po ches bskyangs shing / thugasakar g.ya' rilirmog lung gi gter nas spyan drangs pa'i gter bum bzhugs par khri chen de nyid kyis gsungs pa

rtedasogs5nargazhanapasha—ba/ 647da thos zhes lo lnga bcu nas gya gsum gyi bar du tshe mtshams kho na mdzad pa'i dge bshes blo bzang mkhas mchog gis gsungs shing / dge 'phel nas rje gong ma rang gis sgrub pa gnang ba'i dge 'dun 'du ba'i 'khor lo sogs bzhugs par ngag rgyun du gleng / 'dilirab gnas kyi skabs 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i mnal lam du rje gong ma de nyid byon nas rab gnas kyi phyag len ma 'phyug pa byung zhes dgyes pa'i gsung byon pa rnam thar du gsal/ g.yas g.yon du rje rin po che dang mar me mdzad/nye ba'i sras brgyad dang bcas pa'i sman sku thog tshad dang mnyam pa 'di dag 'jam mgon khri rin po ches bzhengs shing gezungs gzhug rab gnas sogs byams chen dang mnyam du mdzad/ de'i g.yas kyi mgon khang nang gi 'jigs byed dpa' cig zhal phyag yongs rdzogs dang / mgon chos /gnyis kyi 'bag sku shin tu che ba gsum ni/ rje gong ma'i bka' ltar 'jam mgon khri rin po ches sbyin bdag dang bkod khyab mdzad nas/lha dang chos skyong gi bsnyen pa legs par thengs shing dam tshig mchog tu gtsang ba a 'gron ri khrod pa la bzhengs 'jug pa gnang / rje gong mas gang blo ma'i bstod sgrub mdzad skabs 'jam dbyangs kyi par sku chung ngu zhig 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos su gyur nas rjes su bzung bar rnam thar las 'byung ba'i sku de nyid 'di'i 'jigs byed kyi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs shing / mgon bo'i thugs kar rje gong ma'i sku la bcang rgyu'i mgon po'i srog 'khor thun mong phayin pa dang / chos rgyal la yang man ngag nas 'byung ba'i rten 'ga' zhig dang / mkha' spyod

548 rte gas rdodzha gzha shad grub thob sangs rgyas chos 'phel gyis ma rungs pa 'ga' zhig 'dul ba'i ched du phyag zhabs 'dam bu ltar bcom bcug ste rus pa sogs phyi rol du dor nas slar yang sku dar ma zil che ba zhig gi rdzu 'phrul bstan pa'i dus kyi zhabs ngar gyi rus pa'i dum bu sogs yod par gzungs bri sgrub byed pa bo dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhal nas dngos su thos zhes bdag gi bla ma brag dkar dka' bcu ba ngag dbang grags pas gsungs/'di gsum ga'i sku rgyu'i 'jim pa la ku na mkhyen mchog gi shangs mtshal mang du bsres shing sku rgyu byin rlabs dang yo byad rab gnas srog shing dang sngags 'god lugs gzungs gzhug tshul sogs rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag ltar mdzad pas shin tu gnyan zhing / dus phyis shig chos rgyal gyi zhal nas khrag 'dzag pas zhal ras sgrib byed kyi dar sogs sku la 'byar ba khri rin po che dkon mchog bde chen pas bkog nas len dgos byung zhing / de'i rgyu mtshan skyabs mgon mchog la zhus pa na lha gzhan gnyis la zhib tu ltos gsungs par 'jigs byed kyi zhabs 'og gi tshangs pa'i gdong nas khrag 'dzag pa btsal mkhan kun gyis mthong / de gong skyabs mgon mchog gi 'phrin las la 'tshe ba'i ma rungs pa 'ga' zhig dbang du 'dus skabs chos rgyal gyi zhal nas khrag yang yang 'dzag pas mche ba'i rtse sogs su khrag zham chur babs nas skam pa da lta dngos su mjal rgyu yod do //gtsang khang shar gyi rten gyi gtso bo ni kun mkhyen gong ma rnam gnyis kyi sku gdung ril bor bzhugs pa'i mchod rten rin po che gnyis yin te/ de yang kun mkhyen gong ma'i sku gdung ril bor bzhugs pa'i byang chub mchod

ten sogs rdon gnan bshad / 64skyerten bang rim man chad dngul dang bum pa nas nyi zla'i bar gser bzang po 'ba' zhig las bsgrubs pa bzo bkod khyar par du 'phags pa 'di nyid mi'i dbang mo rnam rgyal sgrol mas bzhengs/ de'i g.yon gyi skyabs mgon mchog gi sku gdung ril bor bzhugs pa'i dngul gyi mchod rten 'di nyid phyag mdzod dar han chos rje blo bzang dar rgyas kyi dus su bla brang chen mo nas bzhengs shing / sku gdung phyag mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'i mthil na kun mkhyen gong mas dpon ju nang la gnang ba'i tshems ring bsrel skya phrom me ba shel gyi khang bzang gser gyi rgya phibs dang bcas pa bzhugs/de'i g.yon gyi dngul gyi mchod rten 'di ni gna' dus kun mkhyen mchog gi sku gdung ril bor bzhugs pa'i mchod rten yin la/ phyis su sku gdung gong gsal gyi mchod rten du gdan drangs shing da lta chos sku'i ring bsrel gyis phyur bur bkang ste yod do//kun mkhyen mchog gi sku gdung gi g.yas kyi dngul gyi mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang can ni 'jam mgon khri rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis pa'i sku gdung mchod rten gdung rus la 'jam dbyangs kyi sku par btab pa sogs nang rten du bzhugs pa dang / g.yon gyi gral mgo'i dngul gyi byang chub mchod rten 'di ni gung thang mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin po che ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung mchod rten dang / skyabs mgon mchog gi sku gdung gi g.yon ngos kyi dngul gyi mchod rten chung ngu 'di ni rgyud pa bla ma shrī re thu blo bzang mkhas mchog gi gdung rten dang /di dag gi g.yas kyi gral mgo'i dngul gyi mchod rten batho bkod phun sum

660 rte5 ges do gezhadzwa ba da tshogs shing phra rgyan gyis phyug pa 'di ni 'jam mgon khri rin po ches zhal bkod ltar dpon ju nang gi sku rus la 'jam dbyangs kyi sku par btab pa nang rten du bzhugs pa yin la/ de nas rim bzhin tshar du bsgrigs pa'i dngul gyi mchod rten lnga ni dpon gong ma na rim gyi dgongs rdzogs su bzhengs pa yin no//mchod rten de dag rgya khyon shin tu che zhing bzo bkod phra rgyan sogs kyis spras pas mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa sha stag yin no/ /'du khang nang gi rten gyi gtso bo gser zangs las grub pa'i ston pa'i sku brnyan jo bo shākya mu ne dang zhal gyi dbyibs shin tu cha mtshungs pa 'di ni 'jam mgon khri rin po che nas lha sa'i jo bo rnam gnyis gang rigs kyi 'dra cog cig rten 'brel gyis gdan 'dren dgos zhes bskul ma gnang ba ltar dpon ju nang gis gzhung la zhus nas gdan drangs/ bsu ba'i ched du khri chen de nyid uṅger byon nas jo bor mchod 'bul gyi sar jo bos nga dgon par 'gro zhes gsung byon pas drung 'khod 'ga' zhig gis jo bo'i sku cung zad 'gul lam snyam pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis tsheg sgra zhig grags snyam pa sogs byung tshul rnam thar rtor la/ de nas gdan sa 'dir spyan drangs nas rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs su gsol te gnas 'di yul dbus rdo rje gdan dang gzi byin mnyam par bsgrubs pa yin la/ 'di'i nang rten sogs kyi lo rgyus de skabs gzhung sa rin po ches bsgrigs gnang dkar chag gi tshig sna cung zad bstungs te 'god na/ dkar chag las/ 'dir byang phyogs kyi nor 'dzin gyi khyon la chos bzhin du spyod pa'i rgyal rigs shing su

rte sogs don zhan ba da 551la chen po lta bur mchog tu 'phags pa'i dad stobs kyi dbang phyug dam pa ho sho ching wang dga' ldan er thi (ti) ni ju nang gis rnam par dag pa'i thugs bskyed ston zla ltar dkar ba'i mthu la brten nas ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i sku brnyan legs byas kyi dpyid du gangs can sa'i lte ba lha ldan byang rgyud ra mo che'i garto lar bzhugs pa'i 'dra cog gsar bzhengs khyad par can zhig 'di khul bkra shis 'khyil gyi rten gtsor byung na rgyal bstan 'phel rgyas dang / phyogs 'di'i'agro ba'i tshogs gnyis spel ba la 'phags yul dang gangs can gyi gnas rnams dang dbyer ma mchis pa lta bu'i sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po cher 'gyur bas cis kyang dgos tshul elci ched mngags kyi gdong du/ gser zho nyis brgya/ dngul srang lnga brgya/ gos yug lnga bcu/ dar yug brgya/ man yug brgya dang lnga bcu soṭa bstsal cing der ma zad dgos cha gang dgos rim par yong tshul gnang byung ba bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung rabs rnams kyi nang tshan rgyal bstan gyen du 'degs pa'i thugs bskyed rmad du byung ba'i dgongs bzhed sgrub thub na 'bad pa lhur len zhu ba gzhir bcas pas yo byad kyi skyes sos/sa ci la dgos pas/ 'di ka nas gang dgos gra bsgrigs ngos/ de ma thag mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyas bdag gis dad brtson chen po'i sgo nas be sa la'i yul nas ljongs 'dir lhags pa'i bzo sbyang rig byed mkhas pa'i rtser son pa rnams kyi sne mo las byed dang bcas par myur ba nyid du sgrub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten/ sgo gsum 'bad pa chen po lhur blangs pas bla gnyis la nye bar bskrun thub pa'i dge mtshan dang ldan

552 nye ga rdon ga da pa 'di'i sku tshad sogs rgyal ba mchog gi bdag rinyid paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen por bslab ston zhus pa/ sku tshad ra mo che'i jo bor chag bzhag zhal dkyil phyag stabs sogs shākya mu der chag bzhag na rten 'brel la legs pa'i bka'i gnang ba thob cing / sgo du ma nas yo byad che phra las su rung zhing sgrub sla la byin chags pa rang byon du phebs pa dang khyad par med pa 'di nyid kyi gzungs gzhug la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung rtsod bral bdun/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang chos rgyan pa'i tshems ring bsrel gyi gong bu/ tā la'i bla ma lnga ba chen po'i na bza' cha tshang / po ta la'i nang rten nas lnga ba chen po'i sku gdung gi pur tshwa tha pag gang / rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i sku ber gyi cha shas/ baṇa chen rin po che blo bzang ye shes kyi na bza' sku chos bubs/ bla ma sems dpa' chen po'i bzhes jan shing 'bras kyis bkang ba/ ma ṇi dung sgrub khag bcu gcig song ba'i ril bu dang gzungs thag ril bu 'di'i phabs rtar 'phel gdung / dam rdzas/ rgya bod kyi paṇa grub du ma'i nang rten las byung ba'i myong grol byin rten shin tu 'phel che ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'gangs can sha stag la bsgril te dge 'dun brgya khag mang pos zla chos su sgrub pa smin rgyas mdzad pa/ rgyud smad pa tshogs yongs nas bya lo dang khyi lo sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe gzungs dung phyur tshar gnyis song ba'i ril bu 'di'i phabs rtar de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung gi a ma dang /'phel gdung rtsod bral sum cu/ rje rin po che dang lnga ba chen po'i tshem ring bsrel can gyi bye ma/ sa skyalibadud rtsi ril bu khri rdo/ ma ṇi dung

no sogs ron gzhan ba da / 553sgrub lan bcu drug so nga ba'i ril bu/ skye bdun ril bu/ 'chi med tshe'i ril bu/ mdor na 'dzam gling na mchis pa'i byin rten khyad 'phags yod do cog lta bulirten 'dus ril bu bcas le tshan de dag kun kyang dri bzang gis klubs pa'i phur ma la dar zab dri ma med pa'i dril chas dang lhan cig tu gtams pa/ de nas gtso che ba chos sku'i ring bsrel gzungs rnams kyi skor la/ ljon shing bzang po'i srog shing tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad ldan pa la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i gzungs sngags/ 'odod don 'grub pa'i sham bu dang bcas pa/ de nas gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang / rig pa chen po sogs dbu gzungs dang gnas gzungs kyi rigs/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan sngags/bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ dgyes rdor/ dus 'khor gyis mtshon bla med thams cad dang / de mtshungs rnal 'byor rgyud rnams so so dang /bya spyod rigs gsum gyi khongs su 'du ba'i lha so so'i gzungs dang /gzungs chen sde lnga/ mdo sde nas bshad pa'i gzungs zab mo sna tshogs dge lugs chos skyong rnams kyi gzungs/ gzhan yang srog shing brten pa/'khrug sel/ shis brjod/ brtan bzhugs bcas gzungs rnams kyis kyang legs par gtams pa la de dag dril chas dar gos dri bzang /sman bzang bo'i phye ma sogs gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i thog gzungs 'bul bya rgyud kyi gzhung bzhin ngos rab gnas bla med dang mthun par gang ci'i phyag len rgyud stod shar ba chos rje sgo mang rab 'byams pa nam mkha' bzang gi zhal snga nas grwa slob bcu skor dang bcas pas legs par bsgrubs pa'i

554 rten sogs rdodzha gzhan ga da / rgyu song lam tsam gong tshad du phab par dngul srang stong phrag gnyis lhag tsam song zhes 'byung ngo //de'i g.yas kyi tsan dan 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i tsan dan jo bo'i 'dra cog 'di ni skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas rten 'brel du mar dgongs nas rgya nag nas dgon par chibs bskyod skabs gdan drangs pa yin/g.yon gyi jo bo lo ke shwa ri'i (ra'i ) sku brnyan gser zangs rag gsum gar blugs las grub palirgyu bzo khyad du 'phags pa 'di ni/ gong ma taliming yung lo rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i jo bo brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang tshan te ang kar zhabs drung gis 'dir gdan drangs nas bzhugs su gsol ba'o /'du khang gi g.yas phyogs su bzhugs pa gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa'i sku bzang po'i bzhugs stangs can sku tshad 'du khang gi ka ba dang mnyam pa 'di ni jun wang ngag dbang dar rgyas kyis dngul dkar srang sum stong gi yon phul te rgya nag nas gdan drangs pa yin la/ wang rang nyid kyis dbus nas gdan drangs pa'i snar thang gi bka' 'gyur cha tshang sogs rten byin rlabs can du ma gzungs gzhug tu bzhugs shing / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang ched gnyer gyis spyan drangs nas rab gnas bkra shis snye ma'i sgo nas lhag gnas mdzad pa'o// de'igayon gyi tsan dan las grub ba'i jo bo lo ke shwa ra'i sku brnyan 'di ni/ klong rdol grub pa'i dbang phyug gis yun ring thugs dam gyi rten du mdzad nas skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la phul ba las/ me rta lo skyabs

rtenasog shirwanab da bhe 665mgon mchog gis dbus nas gdan drangs te rje de nyid kyi thugs dam gyi rten yin tshul gyi bsngags brjod dang bcas nas 'dir bzhugs su gsol ba'o de'i g.yon gyi sman 'dam las grub pa'i rje gong ma'i sku brnyan 'di ni 'jam mgon khri rin po che nas rab gnas brgya dang brgyad byas pas rab gnas brgya rtsa mar grags shing / khong la gsung yang yang byon pa'i gsung 'byon ma dang khri chen bsod nams dbang rgyal ba'i dus mar me che chung ci 'dra zhig phul kyang phal cher mtshan 'khyong ba'i me 'dzin ma yang yin par khri chen de nyid kyis dngos su gsungs so//'du khang gi g.yon ngos su bzhugs pa'i tsan dan 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong gi sku brnyan mda' gang ma 'di ni dpon bre si bā thur dā'i chang gis rgya nag nas gdan drangs pa yin la/ gser zangs las grub pa'i rje gong ma'i sku brnyan mi tshad tsam dang /yang gser zangs las grub pa'i skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyan de dang cha mtshungs pa gnyis ni rim bzhin khri chen rab brtan rgya mtsho dang /dus 'khor dpon slob ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis rgya nag nas gdan drangs pa'o//yang 'du khang gi phugs su bzhugs pa'i thub dbang gi sku brnyan mi tshad lhag tsam mchog zung dang bcas pa/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i sku brnyan mi tshad lhag tsam/ rgyal ba byams pa'i sku bzhengs stabs can mi tshad lhag tsam/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong gi sku brnyan de las shin

ca66 na ga sgo gezhanarda tshobakatu che ba/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i sku brnyan mda' gang ma/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyan de mtshungs nams ol jos thu rab 'byams pa blo bzang tshul khrims kyis bzhengs pa yin la/ 'jam dbyangs chos rjeliskuni rigs grwa'i tshogs dbur gdan 'dren rgyur khri chen bsod nams dbang rgyal bas bka' gnang nas de dag gi thog mar bzhengs pa dang / rje rin boche'i sku ni sde khri rin po che 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtshos bka' gnang ltar bzhengs pa yin la/ de lhag rnams de'i rkyen gyis spro shugs 'phel te rang nyid kyis lhag bsam rnam dag gis bzhengs shing / sku rgyu rnams tsan dan dkar po dang / bzhugs khri rgyab yol rnams shug dmar dang shug skya 'ba' zhig las bsgrubs shing / thams cad kyi bzo bo ni sor mo'i 'du byed phul du byung ba'i co no lha bzo bi lig thu dbon pos byas so//de dag gi nang rten phyogs gcig tu 'god na/ thub dbang gi nang rten du sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung 'khrul med gcig grub thob brgyad cu'i sha ri ram/ kun mkhyen gong ma'i zhabs chag skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi dbu skra bubs gcig gos ber shangs mtshal las grub pa'i 'jigs byed kyi sku par/ rgyal ba yab sras sku na rim/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang / bla ma byams pa rin po che/ khri chen nam mkha' bzang / stong 'khor rin po che ngag dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho/ khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis/ grub dbang sde khri rin po che blo bzang don grub/ gung thang mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rnams kyi na bza' dang / rgyud sde nas 'byung ba'i gzungs sngags byin

rten sogs don gzhan bshad / 557rlabs can du ma bzhugs shing / rgyal ba yab sras man chad kyi na bza'i skor 'di rnams 'og nas 'god 'gyur gyi rten 'di rnams la yang thun mong ba'o/ /byams pa'i sku'i nangu rten du sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung 'khrul med/ grub thob brgyad cu'i shi ri ram/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'gag dbu skra/ lo chen rin chen bzang po'i dbu skra/ khri nam mkha' bzang gi dbu skra/ rgyal sras ye shes grags pa'i na bza'/ gong gsal gyi na bza' thun mong ba'i skor phal cher dang / chos sku'i ring bsrel mang du bzhugs/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong gi nang bzhugs la rgyal dbang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dgung lo bdun pa'i tshems gcig skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi tshems gcig stong 'khor rin po che'i tshems gcig 'di mdo rgyud rgya mtsho zer yang bsod nams rgya mtsho yin nam snyam/ pha dam pa rgya gar/ paṇa chen smṛ ti/ rje rin po che gsum gyi phyag tsha 'khrul med re/ gong gsal gyi na bza' dang mtshan thebs pa phal cher gyi dbu skra sogs bzhugs shing / rje sku'i nang rten du/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / grub thob brgyad cu'i sha ri ram/ mnyam med jo bo'i phyag tsha/ paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyi phyag phreng /kun mkhyen gong ma'i sku chos/ sku lcug sku 'gag sku gzan bcas kyi tshal bu/ skyabs mgon mchog gi dbu skra bubs/ sku gzan/ khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs pa'i dbu zhwa sne ring / gzhan yang bo/nga gsal na bza'i skor sogs dang / skyabs mgon mchog gi sku'i nang rten du/rgyal dbang skal bza' rgya mtsho'i tshems/ chos rje don grub rin chen gyi —

558 rten ga non ga na ba da gdung ring bsrel bdud rtsi/ gong gsal na bza' dang dbu skra rnamasaspyadang / 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i nang rten du gong gsal gyi dbu skra na bza'i skor phal cher dang / rten de dag thams cad la chos sku'i ring bsrel gyis phyur bur gtams shing / rgyud stod smad dang bkra shis 'khyil sogs kyi ma ṇi ril bu dang / rten 'dus ril bu/ bdud rtsi ril bu sogs byin rten gyi rigs dang / rgya gar nag gi gnas chen du ma'i sa sna sogs bzhugs so// gzhan yang lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad sogs dang / 'od gsal phug gi rje 'od zer ma sogs kyi lo rgyus dkar chag rnams su bkod pa ltar logs ris kyi lha 'ga' zhig gi ngo mtshar ba'i gtam cung zad smos na/ 'du khang phug gi rgyal ba tsong kha ba chen polisku 'di ni skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gis 'di khang rab gnas mdzad pa'i phyi de nyin lha so sor snyan shal phul skabs rje'isku la yang snyan shal zhig 'phangs pa g.yas phyogs kyi pad sdong la ral grir dpyangs pa bzhin du gnas pa lo mang po'i bar du de bzhin yod kyang phyis su dkon gnyer zhig gi rten gyi bsam pas yin nam nan gyis blangs pas snyan shal gang du 'byar ba'i thad kyi zhal ba sen mo tsam kog pa'i shul da lta yang yod de rje rin po che dngos dang khyad par med pa'i byin rlabs can no/ /'du khang rnying ba gsar bzhengs kyi skabs sgo chen g.yas g.yon gyi chos rgyal phyi nang gnyis dang / 'du khang phug gi 'jigs byed dpa' cig rnams bzhengs skabs rtags mtshan legs gsungs nas skya ris grub

rten ga don gzhan ba da pha/ 55zhu'aphral snyan shal re 'bul ba mdzad ces kun mkhyen gong malirnam thar du 'byung ba ltar la/ ngag rgyun du chos rgyal gnyis kyi logs ris grub 'phral lha bris pa rnams brgyal ba dang 'jigs snang sogs byung bas ye shes pa zhugs pa'i rtags yin gsungs shing yol gor brgyab nas brir bcug nas slar snyan shal gyis sgrib par mdzad ces gleng / nub ngos kyi mgon po'i sku'i logs ris bzhengs pa'i thad de nas mgon po'i sku'i zhal gzigs bstan pa 'jam mgon khri rin po che steng shod du 'byon pa'i skas steng nas gzigs pa'i rten 'brel gyis bla sku mang po'i bar der mgon polisku bzhengs pa yin zer la/ 'du khang rnying ba bskyod skabs skyabs mgon mchog nas ar chog gi me long bstan 'phral du smos ma thag gi 'jigs byed dang mgon chos kyi logs ris gas ka shig shig por gyur pa kun gyis mthong zhing / 'du khang gsar ba rab gnas kyi skabs skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas sngar gyi me long ye shes pa rnams rang rang gi sku brnyan dam tshig pa la bstims nas dam ye dbyer med du bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs shin tu che ba'o /byams khang nang gi gnas chung chos rgyal khog zhugs ma'i logs ris 'di ni/ 'jam mgon khri rin po che'i mnal lam du ku shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis ngas dgon pa 'dir nyin mtshan dus drug tu lta rtog byas kyang khyed tshos nga'i ri mo tsam yang mi 'bri bar snang zhes zer ba byung nas bris tshu' rje de nyid kyi rnam thar du gsal la/ sku 'di'i zhal la rdul mi chags pa dang kyi rtsig pa la gas ka zhugs pa sku la 'jug ma nus par phyag gi gru

660 ten tshugs ldan gezhan bgad bkyimo'i thad nas sdig mdzub kyi rtse mo'i bar du 'khyogs pa dang / 'di dang 'du khang gi mgon po'i sku/ mgon khang gi 'bag sku rnams kyi gzi byin gyimathus sde brgyad ma rungs pa'i cho 'phrul gyis bskyed pa'i gnam lcags kyi me tog spyang rlung gis bdas pa'i shing bal ltar gyur pa'i mtshan ma kun snagyis mthong bzhin pa'i lo rgyus grags che'o//yang gsung gi rten la tshogs nas dus rgyun gsung sgrogs gnang bzhin pa'i bka' 'gyur li thang mtshal dpar ma dang / bstan 'gyur rgya nag gi mtshal dpar ma kun mkhyen gong mas gzigs dper byas pas gos skud dang ser rtags kyis spras pa 'di gnyis dpon dga' ldan ernyi ni ju nang gis bzhengs pa yin la/ yang ching wang bstan 'dzin dbang phyug gis bzhengs pa'i dngul gyi bka' 'gyur cha tshang gcig dang / jun wang ngag dbang dar rgyas kyis dbus nas gdan drangs pa'i bstan 'gyur snar thang gi dpar ma dang / dpon gong ma'i mdun na 'don dar han tha'i ji mkhar khos gdan drangs pa'i bka' 'gyur sde dge'i dpar ma sogs —yod do//'du khang steng gi shar gyi mchod khang dang po'i nang du bzhugs pa'i nerje'i sku 'di ni rgyal ba tsong kha ba zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su 'dra sku bdun bzhengs pa la byin rlabs kyi me tog rang nyid kyis 'thor nas nga dang 'dra zhes gsungs pa'i nga 'dra mar grags pa bdun gyi nang nas gcig dga' ldan ha sdong gi rten gtsor bzhugs pa las jun wang ngag dbang dar rgyas stakyis gdan drangs pa dang / byams chen chos rje'i bzhugs khri rgya bzo 'diho

gas don gzhan ba da 661ni skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gis mdzo mo mkhar nas gdan drangs pa yin la/ gzhan yang tsanaspyodan las grub pa'i jo bo lo ke shwa ra'i sku che chung gnyis dang / klu 'jim gyirtsorgya nag hwa shang / tsan dan las bzhengs pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas/ gzhan yang gser sku dang li ma gang mang sogs ni jun wang ngag dbang dar rgyas kyis dbus nas gdan drangs pa'i skor yin no//g.yon gyi lha khang gnyis pa ngo mtshar lha khang gi rten gtso paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi gser sku khru tshad ma 'di ni mi'i dbang mo rnam rgyal sgrol mas paṇa chen de nyid la drag po 'khor lo can gyi 'khor du skye ba'i rgyu dang skyabs 'jug zhus pa'i phyir phebs su/ kho bo'i 'dra gzugs shig gser 'ba' zhig las bzhengs na legs phebs pa ltar/ gser gar blugs las bzhengs te paṇa chen rang gis phyag nas 'thor ba'i byin rlabs can/paṇa zhwa sne ring dang na bza' sogs la tshil chags pa kun gyis mthong rung du yod la/ 'di ni sa le sbram srang gi 'khor lo mkha' dang thig dang 'byung ba'i grangs ldan yin pa thos nas za lar gyi rkun ma sta gri thogs pa kha shas li ma khang du zhugs pa na dkon gnyer skrag nas ci yang smra ma nus kyang yid kyis gsol ba btab pas dngul gyi mchod rten zhig bcom pas shing du song / lci yang la brtags nas paṇa chen gyi sku la reg pa na snying 'phar kyang shing sku las kyang yang ba byung ste bzhag pa mig gis mthong bas rdzu 'phrul bstan pa yin zhes dkon gnyer ring lugs ming can las dngos su thos so/ /

562 te ga don ga na ba da /gzhan gtsug lag khang 'dir bzhugs pa'i thub pa klu 'jim ma dang /thub pa rtse kṣim ma dang / mar me mdzad rtse kṣim ma dang / rje 'od zer ma/ rje zhabs smyung ma/ rje bzhad 'phar ma/ kun gzigs lnga ba'i sku rje rang nyid kyi phyag nas brgya rtsa ma sogs dang / rgya gar shar nub dang rgya nag sogs nas gdan drangs pa'i li ma dang / gser zangs kyi sku brgya phrag brgal ba dang / gser dang dngul las bzhengs pa'i bla ma yi dam gyi sku brnyan rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa shin tu mang ba bzhugs pa 'di dag ni dpon ju nang dang ching wang bstan 'dzin dbang phyug yab yum gyis bzhengs pa sha stag yin la/ phyis su dpon bī si bā thur dā'i ching gi dus bī zi rang nyid kyis jo khang gsar bzhengs gnang ste/ lha cikhang dbus mar jo bo dang / g.yas kyi lha khang du mnga' ris pa dar han chos rjes bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba seṅge nga ro dang / g.yon gyi lha khang du bī zi rang nyid kyis byams sku mthong grol chen mo gsar bzhengs dang / steng shod du li ma dang gser dngul gyi sku 'di rnams gdan drangs te li ma lha khang zhes grags pa las/ phyis su jo khang ar chog byas nas gser khang chen mobazhengs skabs byams sku mthong grol chen mo'i tshab tu byams sku mthong ba don ldan bzhengs shing / jo bo sogs rten gzhan rnams 'du khang dang /li ma khang gi rten rnams lha khang 'dir gdan drangs te skyabs mgon mchog nas ngo mtshar lha khang zhes mtshan gsol ba yin no / / yang klong rdol bla ma rin ngo che nas bka' gdams mchod rten nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / rgya gar nag gi li ma nyer bdun/ tsha tsha'i dpar kong shin tu

ten sogs don gzhan bshad 563che ba dang nyid kyi phyag nas ma gnyis sogs gnang ba rnams kyang lha khang 'dir bzhugs shing / 'di'i mchod rten rnams kyi lo rgyus ni/ klong rdol bla ma rang gis gsung shog ngo ma bstsal ba'i nang du bka' gdams mchod rten 'di rnams sngon gyi bka' gdams gong ma dag gi gdung rten 'ba' zhig yin kyang bod du bzhugs na mi chen gyi ngo 'dzin du 'thor nyen che bas/ de lta bas na bkra shis 'khyil gyi 'du khang du bzhugs rgyur phul ba yin zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang dpon ju nang gis gser bzang po 'ba' zhig las bzhengs pa'i rje'i gsung 'bum po ti bco brgyad dang / mdo rgyud kyi glegs bam gser dngul gyis bzhengs pa shin tu mang ba dang /tsan dan las bzhengs pa'i bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod rten/ dngul gyi byang chub mchod rten dang rnam rgyal mchod rten sogs kha shas/ gser zangs kyi byang chub mchod rten sogs mchod rten shin tu mang bo/ skyabs mgon mchog nas gdan drangs pa'i paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyi na bza' gos ber sne ring sogs nang rten mang du bzhugs/ 'dilidangul gyi mchod rten gnyis dang / 'od dpag med kyi gser sku ngo mtshar can sogs ni ching wang dā'i ching kho sho chis dar han tha'i ji mngags nas thebs phul ba'i steng nas bkra shis lhun por bzhengs shing parṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis rab gnas gnang bar rnam thar 'od dkar phreng ba las 'byung ngo / / lho ngos kyi sgo mang lha khang du chas pa sku skye bstan pa rgya mtshos dngul srang stong dang lnga brgya skor las bzhengs pa'i byams pa'i gos sku shin tu che

564 rten ga don gzhan bshad snesgo —ba dang / chang wang bstan 'dzin dbang phyug gis dbus nas gdan drangs pa'i rje rin po che'i gos sku/ gung thang rin po ches bzhengs pa'i chos rgyal gyi gos sku rmad du byung ba sogs dang / lnga mchod chen mo'i skabs 'du khang du bkram rgyu'itsong kha brgyad cu'i zhal thang khyad 'phags bcu gsum rgyud pa slob zur blo bzang sbyin pas dngul srang bzhi brgya skor las bzhengs pa/ dbyar gnas kyi skabs su bkram rgyu'i gnas bculizhal thang sngon gyi dbus bzo rmad du byung ba bcu gcig gung thang rin po che ngag dbang bstan rgyan pas 'jog par gnang ba/ yang dbyar gnas kyi skabs su bkram rgyu'i dpag bsam 'khri shing gi thang ka dbus bzo shin tu legs pa sum cu so gcig rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan pas bzhengs pa/ cho 'phrul smon lam gyi skabs su 'du khang gi ka ba brgya dang bzhi bcu'i kwa mgor bkram rgyu'i bla ma yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi thang ka gras mtshungs spus legs nang so yi dam skyabs kyis bzhengs nas phul ba dang /dpon gong ma na rim gyis bzhengs pa'i kun mkhyen mchog gi rnam thar zhal thang lnga dang / 'khrungs rabs zhal thang / sangs rgyas stong sku'i gser thang dang mtshal thang / se 'bras dge gsum gyi bkod pa/ zhing bkod kyi rigs mang po sogs zhal thang shin tu mang ba rnams kyang 'dir bzhugs/ de'i g.yas kyi dpe mdzod lha khang du skyabs mgon mchog nas mdo rgyud rgya gzhung sogs kyi glegs bam shin tu dkon pa sum cu skor cig thog mar gnang nas lha khang 'dir bzhugs su bcug cing / grwa ba sku gshegs pa sogs kyi dpe cha dkon pa rnams 'dir bzhag nas dpe mdzod

rten ga dod gzha5 ba da 665cig byas na klog pa thos bsam pa rnams la phan che zhes bkod khyab gnang ba ltar ring bor ma thogs par mdo sngags rig gnas kyi glegs bam mkho dgusdzabang mdzod du gyur pa/ 'di ni skyabs mgon mchog gi 'phrin las dang chos sde 'di nyid kyi khyad chos rmad du byung ba zhig yin pas zhib tu bri bar 'os kyang yi ges 'jigs so/ /dri gtsang khang steng gi nub ngos kyi gtsug lag khang du thub pa gnas brtan bcu drug gi sku 'bag bskums khru longs pa dang / sde khri rin po che 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtshos bzhengs pa'i lam rim bla brgyud po to ba yan chad mda' tshad longs pa sogs dang / g.yon ngos kyi gtsug lag khang du khri ba bla brang gi rtsis sprod du gtogs pa'i li ma dang gser zangs sogs bris 'bur gyi sku dang glegs bam bgrang las 'das pa bzhugs kyang gnyer ba rnams kyis 'bru sgam du bcug pa lta bur bzhag yod stabs bri ma nus so/ /yang rigs grwa'i me tog mchod par mchod mjal gtong rgyurinang rten gyi skor ni/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i thugs dam gyi rten ston pa'i sku jo shāka rnam gnyis dang sku rgyu gcig pa gna' dus 'bum stod du bzhugs pa dus tshod cig la 'bum stod kyi jo mjal du grags pa'i chos ston sogs kyang yod pa kun mkhyen gong mas dge 'phel du gdan drangs tshul rnam thar du gsal ba ltar gyi rten byin rlabs can de nyid dang / rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i gos ber bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi mag pa thor god mer gan ju nang gi lag tu byung ba las rim gyis de'i bu rgyud rnam sras ja sag

5skye6 rte ga don ga da /gshegs dus skyabs mgon mchog la phul ba dang / de dang mnyam du byung ba'i paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi sku chos/ mnyam med jo bo chen po'i gdung ruyonang rten du bzhugs pa'i bka' gdams mchod rten dgon pa ba chen posdzathugasadam gyi rten/ ta larilo ma la bris pa'i buṣka pā li ta dpal ldan zla grags kyi phyag dpe/ rje btsun tā ra nā thaliphyag dril/ shar lho bsil pa'i tshal gyi rdo nag gi ngos la rdo dkar 'bur du dod pa'i ma ṇi rang byon/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi phyag tu bsnams pa'i gnam lcags kyi rdo rje/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i phur bu/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i mdun cog dang sho ka li/paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyi phyag shan phe ring ma/ srad rgyud dkon mchog yar 'phel/ lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan/lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje/ stong 'khor mañtsa shrī lnga ba ngag dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho sogs kyi dbu zhwa dang zhabs chag kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje gong ma'ispyag phreng / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi snam sbyar/ ma cig lab sgron gyi dbu thod/ rgyal ba tsong kha ba po'isku brnyan bkra shis do kha ma brgyad kyi nang tshan rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshorithugs dam gyi rten sde ba lha rgya ri ba nas rim par brgyud pa'i lo rgyus kha byang zhabs su bris yod pa sogs bzhugs te/ 'di dag skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa nyid nas kha byang gnang ba ltar bris pa'o/ /yang gser khang chen mor rong byams chen pa'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i byams sku mthong ba don ldan dang / de'i nang du dpon ju nang gis

na gas da / 567bzhengs pa'i gser dngul gyi bka' 'gyur bzhugs pa sogs rten brten par bcas pa'i lo rgyus logs su shes par bya'o/ /yang gzims khang bkra shis mthong smon du bzhugs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten dang / khyad par der bzhugs pa'i mdo sngags rig gnas du ma'i glegs bam gyi dpar shing ni lus can bye ba'i phan bde zad mi shes pa'i 'byung gnas yin pas zhib tu bri bar 'os kyang yi ges 'jigs so//yang rgyud khang phug gi gtsang khang g.yas su sde khri rin po chedzeesku gdung mchod rten gdung rus la sku par btab pa dang / dbu thod kyi du ma bu dang / dbu skra mes ma tshig pas rtsa bar gzhob ram chags pa chun po gcig sku chos gzungs sngags dang 'khor lo sogs bri sgrub tshad ldan byas pa rnams nang rten du bzhugs pa dang / khri chen sprul pa'i sku blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku gdung mchod rten/ khri ba blo bzang gnas brtan pa'i sku gdung mchod rten/ kho bo cag nas bskul ma btab pa ltar su nyid blo bzang sngags rams pas gser zangs las bzhengs pa'i bde mchog zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi sku mi tshad lhag tsam rin chen bzhi'i sngags 'bum phrag re dang skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi na bza' sogs nang rten du bzhugs pa sogs dang / mgon khang du kho bo cag nas bskul ma btab pa ltar su nyid dka' bcu bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis gser zangs las bzhengs pa'i 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi sku mi tshad lhag tsam/sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi 'phel gdung 'khrul med dang / sngags gsum

668 rte ga do go ba da ka 'bum phrag re'i snying bo cagadang / dpon slob dkon mchog lhun grub pas rting bskul gnang ba ltar gser zangs kyis bzhengs pa'i mgon po'i sku gong mtshungs la kho bo cag nas dpar du btab pa'i mgon po'i sku 'bum phrag gzungs su phul ba dang / dpon slob de nyid kyis bskul ma ltar bzhengs pa'i gser zangs las grub pa'i chos rgyal gyi sku sngags 'bum phrag gi snying bo can sogs dang / phyi nang gsang rten dpag tu med pa bzhugs shing / rgyud khang nang du 'jam mgon khri rin po ches dpon tshang la bka' gnang ste/ dbus na rgyud stod grwa khang gi phugs su jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje bzhugs yod pa ltar 'dir rgyud khang gi phugs su bzhugs rgyu'i jo bo'i sku zhig gdan 'dren dgos tshul gyi bskul ma btab pa ltar/ dpon tshang nas gdan drangs pa'i jo bo'i sku khyad du 'phags pa sogs dang / steng shod du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur co ne'idapar ma tshar gnyis sogs sku gsung thugs rten bgrang las 'das pa bzhugs// — e waṃ chos 'khor gling gi grwa khang du/ sde khri rin po che 'jigs med lungajirigs rgya mtsho'i sku gdung mchod rten dang / ching wang rdo rje pha lam gyis bzhengs pa'i dngul gyi bka' 'gyur sogs dpon de nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten phal cher dang / dgongs rdzogs su bzhengs pa'i dngul gyi mchod rten yang 'dir bzhugs/ gzhan yang klong rdol bla ma rin po ches gnang ba'i rigs ldan nyer lnga'i zhal thang daro/sha la'i bkod pa khyad 'phags/ dpon slob rab brtan rgya mtsho ba

ske rtinasogs don gzhan ba da pha/ 66zhusogs kyis—rgya nag nas gad na drangs pa'e dus 'khorngo dang mngon byang gi sku brnyan gser zangs las bzhings pa/ dpon slob ngag dbang don grub la thor god dkon mchog ja sag gis phul ba'i bsta na 'gyur sde dge'i dpar ma cha tshang sogs mang du bzhugs// gso rig gzhan phan gling gi grwa khang du/ skyabs mgon mchog nas gnang ba'i sman bla'i pho brang / su nyid tho yon blo bzang rab rgyas kyis phul ba'i gser zangs las grub pa'i sman bla'i pho brang khyad du 'phags pa/drung yig sngags rams pa chos 'dzin dar rgyas kyis bzhengs pa'i sku 'bum gyi tsan dan las grub pa'i thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal sogs mang du bzhugs/ grwa khang de gsum kar bzo bkod rmad du byung ba'i bris sku brgya phrag mang po dang / 'bur sku che chung shin tu mang po dang / grwa—khangaso sor dpe mdzod kyang so sor yod la/ gzhan yang 'jam mgon khri rin po ches ching wang bstan 'dzin dbang phyug la bka' gnang ste lha sali rang byon lnga ldan gyi dod du bzhengs pa'i bcu gcig zhal gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa'i lo rgyus dang / bla brang chen mo'i gzims khang bsam 'grubacirnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/gzims chung thub bstan pho brang / tshoms chen 'dod dgu 'khyil ba/gzims chung legs bshad dga' tshal/ bla brang steng gi li ma khang dang mgon khang sogs su sku gsung thugs rten bgrang lartswa'adas pa dang /phyag dpe khang so sor glegs bam po ti khri phrag brgal ba sogs kyi tho zhib tu bri bar 'os kyang yi ges 'jigs pas rten tho sogs mjal nas shes par

570 don ga na da bya'o smras pa/skyon—bral yon tan kun rdzogs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /des gsung dam chosachos sgrub dge 'dun gyi/ /yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab ji lta bar/ /dad pa'i rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ /gang zhig bla na med pa'i mchog gsum dang / /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten la/ /bsod nams zhing du mnyam pa'i dad gus kyis/ /mchod dang bkur ba'i 'bras bu'ang mnyam par gsungs/ de slad dad pa dang ni dad pa'i yul/ /bgrang yas mngon du gyur pa'i skal bzang 'dir/ /nyin re zhing yang dad dang gus pa'i sems/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i spyan sngar cis mi gtong / /dad dang gus pa'i sems kyis rab bskyod de/ /mang mang rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten la/ /yang yang phyag mchod bsnyen bkur lhur len par/ /'bad 'bad gcig tu brtson de skal ba bzang / e ma mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / dad pa'i spu long g.yo byed pa'i/ /rten mchog bsam yas gzi byin gyis/ /dbus 'gyur phyogs 'dir 'phos pa bzhin/ /gang gi byin rlabs sbrang char gyis bskyangs pa'i/ /skal bzang dad pa'i myu gu re rer yang / /spangs rtogs 'bras bu g.yur du za ba na/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i khyon yang skal bzang byed/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs mthong ba dang / /mtshan tsam thos pas chos mig rnam dag pa'i/ /sgra sgrogs skye bo'i tshogs ltar bdag cag kyang / /thugs rje mchog gis skyongs shig bcom ldan

snyen sogs dodzha gzhan ba da 571'das/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigasasu bcad pa'o// //de ltar bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten bgrang las 'das pa'i gtsug lag khang / /lung sdesnod gsum gyi sgra dbyangs rgyud mar sgrogs pa'i dga' tshal/ bslab gsum rim gnyis kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'e mtsho chen/ mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skye bodu malibaste gnas/ rig pa dang grol bar smra ba'i 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i mdun sa/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i chos grwa chen po dga' ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra shis 'khyil gyi rten dang brten pa las brtsams te ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan nyung ngu tsam rang bzhin brjod pa'i gtam du byas so/ /tshul 'di yang ji skad du/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyes pa'i rabs las/ grags pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa bzang po 'di rnams kyis/ /bde bar gshegs gyur lam rnams gang yin bstan par 'gyur/ /yid la dad pa med pa rnams kyang dad par 'gyur/ /chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar don chen po dang ldan par go bar bya'o/ / /smras pa/ gang gi yon tan phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun gyi/ /'phrin las bye ba'i nyal 'gro chad med du/ /'thung bas mi ngoms bdud rtsi'i ro ldan pa/ /'di yi ngo mtshar ma lus sus brjod nus/ /'on kyang sbrang rtsis myos pa'i rkang drug dang / /chu khur yongs su rdzogs pa'i sprin sngon ltar/ /drin dang yon tan mthong ba'i dad gus shugs/ /'phel ba'i gtam 'ga'

572 rtedzha gas don ga nab da mi smra rang dbang ci/ /blang dor rdul mang phyogs lhung shugs kyis 'khyog por bsgrod pa'i lo rgyus 'tshub ma'i rlung / /gang 'tsham las kyis bkod pa'i sna tshogs ngang tshul 'dab chags gshog sgro bskyod pa'i rlung / /nyon mongs gdung sel zhi ba'i dpal ster sa gsum snang byed rnam thar go la'i rlung / /'di dag srid na lhan cig spyod kyang mtshungs pa'i go skabs rnam pa kun tu spangs/ kha/theg mchog bshes gnyen nyi zla'i 'od kyis thub bstan gling bzhi'i khyon kun gsal/ /mkhas grub rgyu skar bye ba'i tshogs kyis bshad sgrub 'od brgya'i rtse dga' 'gyed/ /thar 'dod rkang drug bye ba'i tshogs rnams gzhung lugs 'dab brgya'i bcud kyis tshim/ /'di ko rdzogs ldan gsar ba'imidapal mo min nam ngo mtshar dpag yas yol go nyid/ /byin brlabs bdud rtsi'i gter gyur rten mchog spyan sngar skal bzang phyag mchod yur ba 'dren/ legs bshad bdud rtsi'i bcud rdzogs bshes gnyen mchog la blo gsal dam chos bgo skal nod/ /bsod nams zhing mchos/ 'dus pa rgya mtshor dad ldan bsnyen bkur me tog 'thor / /phan dang bde ba'i yan lag kun tshang 'dun ldan bye ba'i dpag bsam ljon/ /e ma gang gi ngo mtshar gtam/ /thos pas brtan pa 'phrog pa yis/ /byed pos blta phyir gdong ngazhi dang //mnyan phyir rna brgyad sprul min nam/ /mkhas grub sge bas

rtenasog don dab da / 5730'khoragasum mdzad pas skyongs(skyong )/ rigs smra 'bum sdes bshad sgrubartse dga' 'gyed/ /gus ldan skye bo bsod nams gsog pas brel/ /rnam dkar las kyi byedapo ma tshang med/ /gang 'di bstan 'grolibade skyid chu klung 'bum/ /phyogs brgyar 'gyed pa'i zla 'phel klung nyid du//grub phyirasras bcas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yang / /thugs las chung ngur bzhugs pa'i mnyam bzhag skyong / /'on kyang mtha' yas rgyal ba yi/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las shugs/ /bsam mi khyab phyir gsang gsum gyi//rol ba'i pha mtha' su yis gzung /de ltar zhing mchog bsngags pa'i legs spyad me tog dkar poli char/ /mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i spyan sngar kun bzang mchod pa'i char sprin du nyer 'khrigs te/ /lus can phan bde sbrang rtsilibacud rdzogs thub bstan badmo'i tshal chen po/ /stes cher spel ba'i legs byas byed por yid bzhin nor bu nyid gyur cig/blo bzang thub bstan spel la dpe zla rab dkon tshulo khrims mchog gis rgyud bsdams shing / /'jigs med spobs pas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la rgyal ba'i dbang po gnyis pa bzhin/ /rigs pa'i 'od 'bar ye shes sgron mes srid zhi'i gdung sel smra ba'i seng ge'i tshogs/ /rgya mtsho la ni chu bo ji bzhin 'du zhing 'phel bar gyur cig smon bzhin du'o/ /'khor gsum rgyal srid skyong ba dam pa'i mgon/ /bub bstan bka'

sko574 3 ga lha dzha gezhidzhadzo da /bzhin 'dzin nus dag pa'i 'khor/ /chos mabun las byedapamathun rkyen ma dros mtsho/ /phan tshun 'gra na pa yar zlalirjes 'gror shog /gzhung lugs 'bum sdes (sde'i) rgyud las nyer drangs pa'i/ /rnamadag lung rigasachos kyi dbyangs snyan po/ /malus snye dgu rmongs pa'i gnyid 'thug las/ /slong ba'i byed por nam yang mi nyams shog /rnam mang 'dus pa'i sa 'dzin 'phreng ba gang / /rnyed bkur sprin gyi stod g.yogs 'dzin pa dang / /lhag cig snyan pa'i dbyar rnga ldir bzhin du/ /dri bral mkha' ltar rgyud ni dag par shog /dus kyi 'gro rnams mi dgelibashes gnyen dang / /sdig spyod gla klo'iphyogs su mi gzhol bar/ /rtsom pa mtha' dag bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /byang chen rgyu ru lhun gyis grub par shog /shāka seng bstan pa lnga brgya phrag bcu yang / / rithub dbang dus kyi 'phel bar 'gran bzhin du/ /mi pham blam 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs bcas/ /zhing 'dir theg mchog dga' ston 'gyed gyur cig /gzhan yang bdag gis sgo gsum brtson pa bgyis dang bgyid 'gyur kun/ /lus can mtha' dag rnam kun bde ba'i mchog sbyin dam pa ru/ /zad mi shes pa'i bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam ljon pa chen po ltar/ /byang chub mchog gi snying bo can du mchog gsum byin mthus 'grub par shog /tshul 'di mthong thos dran dang 'bad pa kun//

da rten garda—rdon ——sna zhadab da kyi 575tshe 'dir yang dag laya la 'jug 'gyur zhing/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu phan bde'i tshal/ /bkra shis me tog bzhad pas mdzes gyur cig /nam yang bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing / /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pas rgyud sbyangs te/ /sa bcu lam lngas 'gro kun tshim byed pa'i/ /rnam thar mchog la 'dod dgur dbang 'byor shog /rto gas brjod 'di yang srid pa ji srid du/ /mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i 'phrin las nyi ma'i 'od/ /lus can padmo'i tshal du 'babs ('bab)pa'i rgyur/ka /mthu ldan srung mas rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs (sgrubs)/ sde chen gang gi ngo mtshar ri dwags gzugs/ /dpyod ldan yid kyirdzizla bar 'phos pa'i gtam/ /skye dgu'i kha la ri mor bris pa bzhin/ /mtha' dag 'jig rten kun dgar bgyid gyur cig / / / ces bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas chos sde chen po dga' ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas bkra this 'khyil gyi gad na rabayorang bzhin dbyangs su brjod pa'i lha'i rnga bo che zhes bya ba 'di ni ༈ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas rang re'i dkar chag snga ma de gdan rabs kyi rnam thar cung zad nyung 'dug pas/ so so'i rnam thar rgyas par phye ba zhig byung na legs zhes yang yang phebs pa thos pa'i rkyen dang / rang nyid kyis kyang chos sde chen po gang gi bka' drin gzo ba'i ched du 'bri 'dun cung zad yod pa'i thog yongs 'dzin dam pa bka' drin 'khor med bsod nams dbang rgyal ba

576 rten ga do ga ba da — nas gyiskyabs mgon mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir khyod kyis cis kyang sgrigs shig ces bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dang bcas ba ka'anan yang yang phebs shing / sku 'da' khar zhal chems kyi tshul du yang bañtsal pa dang /yongs 'dzin dam pa gzhan dag nas kyang de ltar legs tshul phebs pa— dang / grwa tshang phyi ma gnyis kyi gdan rabs thams cad dang snga ma gnyis kyi gdan rabs bcu gsum pa phyin chad rgyus che ba'i stabs rdo rje'i spun sde —snod 'dzin pa du mas kyang de bzhin mol ba sogs la brten nas/ rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo srid gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa paṇḍi ta dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i sde yab sras rnams kyi bka' drin las yid kyi bum bzang chos kyi bdud rtsi'i snod du gyur pa paṇa chung rigs pa smra ba dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas bstan pa lnga brgya phrag bcu'i tshul khrims le'u'i steng nas brgya so drug 'das pa rab —byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags sprel chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen khyad par can gyi nyin chos grwa chen po gang du rang gi bste gnas nyams dgar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dad brtson rnam dpyod yangs shing yang dag lam la 'dun ldan dge slong dkon mchog chos bzang ngo / /'dis kyang thub bstan snying po srid mthalibar du 'jig rten na nyi zla ltar gsal bar gyur cig /maṅgelo/ slar rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i lcags sbrul lo phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos sde po gang gi lho rgyud mdo sngags kyi chos sgra
